dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur nyi dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i la gludapyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du btan mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes snye—— 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin——legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o//spung sha'i bod rig pa dpe na khang nas/spyi lo 2009'o'i zla 8par/2

ste/nga gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho snang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha spel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyen kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung 1

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nod te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ / rider brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las gar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las dar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser tha khuganang bstan dpe rnying 'chos ba/phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba6pa'i tshes7la/

ba//sgrig gas95 bshad/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir sa spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb nyanas 4bar pod rtags (ka) 9) (gnakhong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar bod rtags 6) 'a) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam bod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (ja spu (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags6) ste rgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags 6)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags 6)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags lda)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags 6)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i 5

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags khra)ste bstod tsho gos dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcuskegacig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (5) 'on khu4ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza/ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zhen ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (kha)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma rtoge ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/ chidamigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañdza mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du la lha'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang / tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ med la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'byul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser ka khuganang bstan dpe rnying 'tshul bsdu phyogs ga khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/7

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyalapo'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog cesabyar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags spyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras(gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'khrungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpa' phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'brungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo rme chog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos ྅phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhedas/ chos gnyis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser ba khug nang blta na dpe rnying 'chos bas phyog ga khang nas//()

dkar chagaza hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i 'di snang 'khrul pa'i rol rtsed rtogs brjod kyi tshul du bkod pa du kū la'i gos bzang las glegs bam gsum pa/ (1)dgung lo drug cu par 'bras spungs su bzhugs pa'i phyag dpe nang ma'i dkar chag dang na bza'/ glegs shing / glegs thag dang bcas pa dngos gtsang ba bsgrubs shing /mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan dang / tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po bcas kyi rnam thar mdzad pa bcas kyi skor/ (1)dgung lo re gcig par ris med 'dus sde khag nas bstan srid spyi dang bod khams bde thabs kyi rim gro dang / kha che paṇa chen lugs kyi bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bskyar du bzhes pa sogs kyi skor/ (38)dgung lo re gnyis par chos 'khor rgyal gyi rten mchod gsar bsgrigs mdzad skor dang /bsgrub bya mang por paṇa chen lugs kyi sdom rgyun stsal ba/ 'dus sde khag nas ring 'tsho'i brtan bzhugs phul zhing bstan srid kyi jus rim chos sbyin rgya che spel ba sogs kyi skor/ 〈91)dgung lo re gsum par sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sde srid du bskos shing khri 'don gyi rten 'brel rgya cher bsgrubs pa'i skor dang / bsam yas kyi nang rten byin can khag gi dkar chag /'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog mdzad pa bcas kyi skor/ (148)

dgung lo re bzhi par ris med 'dus sde khag nas rim bzlog sogs kyi ched du rim gro dang / rta tshag rje drung gis gtsos skya ser khri tsho lhag la dam pa'i chos kyi zab chos gnang zhing / dga' ldan bde chen gling gsar 'dzugs dang gzhud sger gyi byas can khag la bdag rkyen stsal skor sogs/ (236)dgung lo re lnga par lha rtse chos sde dang / dga' ldan bdud 'joms gling / mtsho sna dga' ldan 'gro don gling sogs chos sde mang po gsar 'dzugs mdzad skor/ (300)

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum / (ja)no༅༅//za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i 'di snang 'khrul pa'i rol rtsed rtogs brjod kyi tshul du bkod pa du kū la'i gos bzang las glegs bam ga sdo/ma pa bzhugs/dgung lo drug cu par 'bras spungs su bzhugs pa'i phyag dpe nang ma'i dkar chag dang na bza'/glegs shing /glegs thag dang bcas pa dngos gtsang ba bsgrubs shing /mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan dang /tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po bcas kyi rnam thar mdzad pa bcas kyi skor/༄༅/ /hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la dpon mo bsod nams chos 'dzom/dga' ldan rab stims pa/gnas rnying sprul sku/yang dag sgrub mchod kyi don skor la gser gling bla ma dang gnyer pa sogs kha shas dang phrad cing dpon mo bro 'tshal bar mgon po phyag drug pa'i bka' bsgo byas/ri khrod dga' ldan zur pa blo bzang rnam rgyal gong dkar chos sder chos nyan pa'i mthun rkyen dgos tshul byung ba ltar ja mar 'bru 'dzin mdo pa chos rjer bskur/tshes gnyis la gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon gra bcas kyis mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo lugs kyi brtan bzhugs kyi tshe chog dang 'brel ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing bdog pa spel/zhan la bstan pa spyi rim du gdugs dkar gyi mdos chen zhag bcur btsugs pa'i rgyab chos brag dbar ba brgyas gdugs dkar 'gro gang che/thams cad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtoge mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches sgrub mchod gnang dus me tog gi char babs pa'i bde mchog gi dkyil (2na)thang sogs kyi zhu rten bcas dgos tshul bzhin tsha rong rje drung nam 'tsho'i bar khong rang gi mthun rkyen dang / slad mar gzhis rtse gso rig slob gra drang srong 'dus pa'i gling gi sman bla'i mdo chog gi thebs su tsha rong pa brgyud bcas la lha bris pa chos dbyings kyi 'dzin shul ser khyim dgon bkra shis chos sdings mi gra yong 'bab dang bcas pa 'jags gnas bgyis/ 'dar pa bsod nams lhun grub rdo rje'i phyi rten du rin 'byung gi brgya thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam dang / rgyud pa dge slong zla ba grags pa'i ngor gsol 'debs bris/ tshes bdun la stag rtse sde pa lha rgyal rab brtan byon pa'i dkar dro'i spom 'bul bteg /khal kha she( rod kyi mi sna rnams la thon gdong gi ja gral btang / gung thang rab 'byams pa bshes gnyen rnam rgyal dol dga' ldan gsung rab gling gi slob dpon du 'gro bar tshad ma ra ba stod pa'i lugs la ṭī ka'i sa bcad thar lam gsal byed dang 'bru bsnon gra ṭīka /(2ba)dbu phar gnyis kyi dogs sel gang dgos rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal dang snying po rgyan/ mdzod kyi dogs ma chod pa gzhung lugs 'bum phrag brgya pa dngos grub dpal 'bar gyi yig cha/ 'dul ba skyed tshal ba'i lung rigs gter mdzod nas byas na legs tshul rgyu mtshan lab/ spen pa snar ma'i 'grub sbyor gyi skar 'dzin khyad nas co ne chos rjer po rod la bskur rgyu'i yi ge rnams sprad cing rgyu mtshan rags rim gleng / gsang sngags pho brang gi chos skyong rnams kyi thug shing cung zad rul bsagasar spo'i do dam la mchod dpon pa can btang ba dga' gdong sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtshos rdo rje slob dpon byas te grangs bcad kyis tshes gsum mig dmar dbyu gu'i 'grub sbyor nas 'go brtsams/tshes brgyad la thug chog dang bcas rgyas par btsugs/ sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis 'khrungs rabs gra tshar bzheng ba'i lha bkod/ sku so so'i mngon rtogs kyi dpe/ rten chung ngu rnams la gzhug pa'i gzungs sogs len mi byung ba zhib cha'i kha gsal dang bcas bskur/ gdan sa gong nas—2

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)zhabs drung rin po che'i bka' shog tu bar pa khag gi mi sna lhor gtong rtsis phag ri rdzong sdod dang dmag dpon rnams kyis 'gro ma bcug pa btang chog pa dgos tshul 'dug pa sde par mol zhing mchod yon rnams bka' bgros pa'i lho 'brug nyam pa che drags gshis tshad ldan mi yong dgongs pa'i mdzad bzhed mi 'dug rung lto bod tshang mar gas pa'i rdo kha ci 'dra gnang gi dri skor mdzad rtsis 'dug pa de mthongs kyi bka' lan phul/tshes bcu la rdzing phyi mkhan las thog pa co ne chos rje/ klu 'bum chos rje/ blo (3na)bzang legs ldan chu shur thar pa gling gi bla mar 'gro rgyu sogs la grub rgyal lugs lha gcig bum gcig gi tshe dbang /rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs dang phyag drug pa gnyis kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na/ khyung khra/ sme brtsegs gsum gyi rjes gnang byas/ de nyin 'tsho byed ngag dbang lhag bsam can ༈ bsnyen rdzogs su bsgrubs/ sngar rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyis gtsos gnas bskor ba'i bya tshang chos mdzad bstan 'dzin dbang pos 'di ga'i ring 'tsho la dmigs pa'i tshe dpag med/rnam rgyal ma/ sgrol dkar gsum gyi bsnyen pa dang de grub bstun zab lam nā ro mkha' spyod kyi nyamasalen la tshig dril du tshe mtshams byed pa'i dam bca' byas song ba dbang po rab 'bring gi grol lugs ma byung yang nying 'tshams mkha' spyod du zang thal ler 'gro 'dod par sems/ dbus gtsang dwags kong rdzong dkar skyid grong bcas pa'i dgon rab 'bring mtha' gsum gar mang ja bsngo rten deb shar ma/ dbusakhul ang dang dge 'dun bcu re/ gnyis par bcu gnyis rer rgya khams kyi khyad par tsam las dngul srang re/ gsum par mi rer 'bru gzhor khal re'i gong rgyab kyi dpus cha/ gtsang yar 'byog lho brag kong long bcas pa'i ang dang dge 'dun bcu gnyis re/ gnyis par bcu bzhi rer dngul dpus gong 'dra/gsum par gtong lugs gong mtshungs khyon rgya dngul srang bzhi stong so drug /khams dngul srang nyis stong nyis brgya bcu dgu /dpus char gshor khal nyi khri dgu stong brgya brgyad song ba myang 'das gsum (3ba)po gang rung du sems bskyed na de 'bras 'byin par nges kyang gnas skabs 'dod sred kyi ro la —3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pozhen pas bskor lugs mi gcig pa ma gtogs 'khor ba 'di ga'i brtan bzhugs su song ngam snyam/tshes bcu gsum la co ba chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas zhes sog po rnams rdo rje 'chang du brtsi ba de'i sku skye o ching dha ra khu thug thu/ e chi ga chos rje/ o ching tha'i ji sogs kyis dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/ gser mdong gcig dang dngul mdong drug /tha phag drug /dngul khog /jagos dar gyis thog drangs stong 'bul du grags pa'i rnyed pa ster byin la bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor shi gson kun la phan re byas/ de dang phyogs mtshungs su rgya shod ban sgar bla ma/ smyung gnas ras chen gyi skye ba/ 'brug phyag mdzod ngag dbang ye shes/ lha ri bla mar thon pa'i dka' bstobs ma gtan rgya mtsho ni mas dang phrad cing 'brug phyag mdzod ra lung nas yong zhor bde chen chos 'khor du yongs 'dzin sprul skus phyag chen sogs kyi chos mang po gra btsun 'ga' chab sgor bzhag skyi pard sbug sku skyes gsung tshab byas nas bsgyur gyin 'dug zer ba sangs rgyas kyi dus zhal nas gsungs pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ rjes su gnang ba gsum las ma byung yang gsung brgyud bsgyur gyi bka' zhig kyang byung bas nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gral 'gor phebs chog rigs su 'dug kyang 'khrid pa re re bzhin nas rtogs pa bzhed pa sogs 'brug lugs kyi phyag len smin po de skyid sbug pas bar bcad de ma byung ba 'dra'o/ /tshes bcu drug gi nyin gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po/ rgyal mo/ mi bzang sogs (4na)kha shas la ja gral dang zhal ngo rnams la rkyen sel du rta mgrin zhabs brgyad pa'i byin rlabs phul/ gser mdong zho nyis stong lnga brgya bzhi bcu yod pa dang dngul lnga bcu ma bzhis gtsos mang du bstar ba bla ma tsho'i chos tshong 'di la khe gyong sna tshogs yong 'dug kyang khe ba'i tshad cig byung / khal kha rab brtan khung tha'i ji'i shul mi dpon mo dge tshul ma gnyis sras bcas/ de ga'i chos rje gnyis bsam yas nas chos rgyal chen po'i sku khog rnams dang phrad cing chos skyong gi che bar bsams byur kong gi ster bya sogs bdag rkyen gang legs byas/ gra tshang gi gra pa mang tsam gyis dkyil 'khor bris thig sbyong ba'i dbu btsugs/ gsung snyan rdzogs 'a sprul sku'i sku skye myur 'byon gyi bden tshig dbon po'i 'dod pa ba smi bkod/ dga' ldan lo

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)phun gling gi gra pa blo bzang yon tan gyis gsar rtsom gyi mdzod dang brag gdong chos mdzad blo bzang tshe dbang gis gra tshang gi zhal 'don shog grangs lnga brgya skor gyi rgyugs sprad/lho mos gzhis dar/khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i nyams len gsung ngag slob bshad kyi smin grol rgyab brten dang bcas pa'i chos 'khor bskor bar nye bas nyer gnyis kyi nyin gnas gsar dbon rin po che nam mkha' bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po/'dar pa rje drung blo gsal bstan 'dzin/gong dkar gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gsum la phogs sogs mthun rkyen/nyams len la tshig dril dgos pa'i bslab bya/dgyes mdzad rdo rje dang chos skyong gnyis kyi sgo nas byin rlabs bka' bsgo'i 4ba〉tsor du bstar/gsas khang dgon pa bas yum rgyas pa re gsum dang sgrol ma sher snying sgo sor bdun stong lnga brgya re/'di ga'i tsho gis gsog la mnga' ris rdzong dkar du dga' ldan 'phel gling ba/ngam ring du bsam grub dga' ldan pa dang ya ga chos sdings pa bsgril ba/shel dkar du chosasde ba/ lha rtser dga' ldan 'og min gling pa/ rnam gling du dga' ldan chos 'khor ba/ gzhis rtser gangs can chos 'phel ba dang myug chos gling pa rnams so sor dge 'dun brgya res bka' 'gyur tshar brgya dang lnga/dga' ldan phun gling du dge 'dun brgyas dkon brtsegs dang phal chen gyis thog drangasamado mang tshar drug cu/gzhis rtser ngor pa lnga bcus zhag bco lnga'i bar tshe dpag med 'chi bdag 'jomasapa'i sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i 'chi blu/rin spungs su byams chen pa brgyas yum rgyas pa dang bskal bzang brgya rtsa re/gong dkar du thod ri ba brgyas mtshan brjod 'bum/chos sde ba lnga bcus zla gcig bar rnam rgyal stong mchod/e waṃ lcog sgar ba bcus zhag bco lnga'i bar rgyal btsan gyi mdos/'phyong rgyas su ri bo bde chen pa brgyas rgyud 'bum tshar drug cu dang nyi khri brgya rtsa/dpal ri bas khro rol dang nyin lnga'i bar rgyal bas gyi mdos/pho brang du ri bo chos gling pa dang dar rgyas gling pa bsgril ba brgyasagadugs dkar 'bum/bkra shis chos sde ba lnga bcus zla gcig bar sgrol dkar gyi bzlas brjod/g.yul rgyal lhun rtser sde drug nas rags bsdus brgyas zla gcig bar tshe gzungs/dwags po sku rab

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gernam rgyal du dga' ldan rab (ldan)brtan pa brgyas ril sgrub dang 'brel ba'i ma ṇi dung / chos 'khor rgyal du ja tshul bco lnga'i thog sgrol ma 'gro gang che/ dga' tshal du dmag zor ma'i bskang ba khri/ gur zhal/ beg tse/ pu tra gsum la stong / de phyin chos stong so sor brgya re/ mthil du phyag drug pa/ lasagashin/ rnam sras gsum la stong / ser 'bras su ja tshul bcu rer dmigs brtse ma 'gro gang che/lha sar gsas khang pa brgyas brgyad stong pa chig stong / gra tog gser gsum dang gzungs bsdus so sor brgya re/ dbus gtsang gi mchod rten brgyar zhig gsos/ sku dkar/ cod pan/ gzungs/ rab gnas/ las byed 'u lag la gla lto/ yang rjong du rdo rje brag pa/ mchims phur dpal ri ba/ shel brag tu skyon smin grol gling pa/ chu bo rir tshe chu sgrub sde gsar ma ba/ mkhar chur gnas gzhi ba/ zab phur sgrol ma ba/ bkra bzang du rang gra rnams so so nas zhag lnga'i bar tshogs brgya/ zhang ston pas sa bdag 'khrugs bcos dang klu bcos/ pha bong kha'i dge slong bcus klu gtor/ lha sar bde yangs pa lnga bcus zhag bco lnga'i bar spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ bzang spyod/ lhung bshags/ sman bla rnams gang 'gro/ sems can gsod sar khrid pa sum brgya'i srog blu/ btson dong thar lnga rnams dang / sde pa'i sku rim la mkhar rtser thang sag pa brgyas bka' 'gyur bcu/'bum nyi shu/ bskal bzang brgya/ lha sar yer pa ba brgyas gdugs dkar khri/ sher snying 'bum/ tshe (5ba)gzungs gang 'gro/ lha rtser thub bstan dge 'phel ba dang bsam grub dgon gsar ba bsgril ba brgyas mtshan brjod 'bum/ 'phyong rgyas su skyes lha yul lha dgra lha la sogs la gsol mchod/ rgyal du dmag zor ma'i bskang ba khri/lha sar sgrol dkar brgya thang / zhang ston pas dgra lha'i spang mkhar/ dgra sri mnan pa/ dgra sgrub/ the'u brang yul 'dre bzlog pa sogs gang smin kyi khyab cha bgyis/brag sna chos rje blo bzang ngag dbang gis gtsos grangs bcad kyis zhag bcu bdun bar gshin rje dmar po'i mnan zor nyams su bstar/ mtshal gyi dpon sa hor mo 'das pa'i bsngo rten 'byor don ltar byang chub kyi rgyur rgyas btab/ nag zla'i mgon po che chung gi mchod gtor rgyas pa'i 'jug tu bskang —6

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)ba zhag sbrel du btsugs/tshes bcu gsum gyi gung gi bzhugs gral thog cung wang gi mi sna thon gdong gi rdzong bda' bgyid skabs mi sna rgan pas sngon rgya nag rgyal po yong lus thang ka zhig bris/ de la rgyas btab nas 'di'i rgya sus bshig pa'i dus rgyal sa 'chor bas ma bshig ces pa'i kha chems bzhag par brten mi rabasabadun tsam gyi bar bshig mkhan ma byung yang khrung ci rgyal pos bshig pas thang gar man nu'i mi la rgya nag gi zan 'dren cing 'dud pa'i tshul 'dug pa de 'dra'i rten 'brel sa rgyas sa'ang shor tshul sogs gtam ngo mtshar can 'ga' gleng bar snang / mi sna rgan par rnam rgyal ma'i sku thang dang gzhen par nged rang gi 'dra 'bag byin/ byams pas dam bcas pa dang byams sman gyi lung bklags/ de dang phyogasamathun du mi snar rab 'byams (6na)pa rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang 'jam dbyangs 'od zer gnyis btang ba'i gzhen pa can gnyis bsnyen rdzogs dang dge tshul gnyis bsgrubs/ de nyin sems dpa' sprul sku/rgyal legs bshad gling zur pa/ stag lung lhun grub rdzong pa/ lha rtse/ snye nang 'phel rgyas gling gnyis kyi slob dpon/ 'jam mgon sku skye/ gon jo dbu mdzad/ g.yon ru dga' ldan co tha'i ji'i mi sna gto skyes tshogos gsog pa phun tsho gos rgya mtsho/ don grub rgyal mtshan/ dar khan dbon po rnams dang phrad cing gon jo dbu mdzad kyis rta dgu dang dre'u bcu gsum gyi phyag rten bstar/tshes bcu bzhi la dga' ldan hung tha'i jis tshogs chas sogs yon rgya cher sbyar ba'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung du gra tshang nas tshe chog mdzad/ ster bya'i khrod du bi chi yi chi dge slong rgya nag tu tshong la btang skabs dngul srang stong phrag gsum tsam sprad nas gsang thabs su nyos pa'i 'phrul sgam du grags pa tsan+dan/ byang chub shing / gser dngul/ g.yu rtsi sogs las grub pa'i khang bzang nang chu brag ljon shing lo 'bras dud pas mdzes pa mdun gyi 'khor lo bskor bas 'og khyams kyi skor lam chu ris kyi thog mi chung gru gzings gtong ba/ bar thog ka phebs nang rnga sbug /'khar rnga/ dung sogs rol mo sna tshogs 'brol zhing steng rtser gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng bas mtshon sems ldan gyis dngos su —7—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pobyas pa bas kyang ches cher tshar du dngar ba dus gcig tu mngon sum la yong ba'i rdzus la med du byung ba sngon chad phyogs 'dir ma grags pa'i ya mtshan pa mchis/ lha rtse chos sde (6ba)brten 'byung bsgrig par byon zhor lha sar sman bla tshig khri brgyad stong / tshe gzungs bzhi 'bum bdun khri lnga stong lnga brgya/tshes bcu bdun nas yang zab kyi rdo rje gro bo lod kyi bzlas bsnyen 'jur bar bgyis/'di ga'i dpe cha nang ma'i gras rnams 'bras spungs su sdod skabs tho sgrigs lam tsam grub pa la zhib cha byed dgos tsho sde pa chen mo sku gshegs pa sogs zin med kyi g.yeng ba chu gnyer ltar gyis gnas brtan dan 'bag pa'i chos bzhin lus pa 'di skabs dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang dpal grong sngags rams pa gnyis kyis nang nas gra bsgrig dang phyir 'don byas pa dkar chag dang bstun pa'i tshang ma tshang gis mtshon zhib cha'i gra bsgrig 'dar ba lo chen dang rnam gling paṇa chen gnyis kyis byas te glegs bam bdun brgya skor la tā shun nam ling / gos chen/ ma ham la tha sogs na bza' bzhi brtsegs/ si ta hu dang stong skud khra lhas kyis gtsos glegs thag glegs shing bcas dngos gtsang ba bsgrubs/ dga' gdong sngags rams pas thog drangs gra pa dgus bdun bzhi'i bar 'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i srung bzlog bsad mnan cha lag shin tu tshang ba rje btsun rat+na'i phyag bzhes 'khrul med du btsugs/ bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal pos paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa'i gcings rabs gra tshar bzheng bar mdzad pa'i rgyab yig /dpon tshang tsha rong pas bskul ngor drang srong 'dus pa'i gling gi bca' yig /grong smad kyi deb bzhi'i 'go brjod/ gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas khri rin po che byams pa bkra shis kyi bkas bskul ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ khyab (7na)bdag sman lung pa'i sku'i skor la chos rje ngag dbang thub bstan pa dri ṣ+ka la byung bar mtshan ngag dbang shākya blo mchog dang brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad rnams bris/lha rtse dga' ldan 'og min gling gi gra pa blo bzang don yod/ dam chos rgya mtsho/ dge legs rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ smon lam rgya mtsho/ seng ge lung pa ngag dbang rgya mtsho rnams kyis dbu phar gsar brtsom yongs rdzogs/ bkra shis rgya mtshos phar phyin dang —8

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)dbu ma sems bskyed drug pa yan/ bstan pa phun tshogs dang dga' ldan bstan 'dzin gyis dbu ma dang phar phyin skabs dang po/ ye shes rgya mtshos dbu phar thal phreng / tshul khrims bstan pas phar phyin dang dbu ma sems bskyed dang po/ bstan 'dzin cho ge bzang dang tshul khrims rgya mtshos dbu ma dang phar phyin thal phreng / ngag dbang chos grags dang tshul khrims rgya mtshos dbu ma/ bshes gnyen rgya mtsho/chos 'phel bstan pa/ dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang bstan pa/ bkra shis chos 'phel/ dga' ldan blo bzang rnams kyis dbu ma/ gting skyes dga' ldan rtse'i gra pa dge slong shākya bstan 'dzin dang dge slong shākya phun tshogs gnyis kyis byams chos sde lnga rnams kyi rgyugs sprad/hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gnyis nas rim bzhin chos sde chen po 'bras spungs/ se ra theg chen gling / 'phan yul gsas khang dgon/ lha rtse chos sde ba/ rme ru ba rnams kyis (7ba〉so so'i lugs dang 'brel ba'i zhal 'don bdog pa gya nom pa dang / rta tshag rje drung gis yo byad bzang po sbyar te gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa/ bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po dang gra tshang so so nas sgrub mchod kha skong tshogs chas zang zing gi dngos po bcas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung smin rgyas dang gdan sa gong nas bden brjod kyi bka' shog gnang cha bcas pa dang gra tshang du mang jag ser 'gyed stsal/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan chen kha rab pa/ ri khrod dga' ldan zur ba blo bzang rnam rgyal/ gser sdings bla ma/ thor god rgya mtsho dge tshul ma/ er khe da'i ching / er te ni khung tha'i ji/ khal kha se chen ji nong / saskyong mer gan tha'i ji dang bzhi'i mi sna gdan sa 'og gi btsun mo/ stag rtse tha'i ji/ co ni chos rje'i sku skye/ brag yag sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi sku skye/ bar ta blo bzang spun sogs bod sog gi phrad mi mang ba byung zhing gzhis ka shar a gur spun khyo shugs kyis dkar dro bteg /o chir dha ras gtsos bsnyen rdzogs nga gnyis dang dge tshul nyer lnga bsgrubs/ bde chen chos 'khor sprul sku gshegs pa'i mnga' bdag nyang gi phyag sbug yin zer ba 'byor don bzhin byang chub mchog gi rgyur bsngos/sprel zla'i tshes bcu 'di la hor zla lnga pa drug pa bdun pa gsum la ngos 'dzin lugs kyang sna —9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (petshogs pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges shing lnga par zhod 'go tshugs pa'i char gcod sogs mangs na than skyon byung dogs kyis 'di lo nas bzung snga (8na skor gyi gar 'chams rgyas par bstar/ lha rtse chos sde ba tshor sman bla sprul sku mtho brtsegs kyi rjes gnang / phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs/ zhal snga nas stag lung brag pa'i nyams bzhes dkon cog chos 'phel gyi gsung rgyun bzhin dmigs brtse mar brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs skor/ rta tshag rje drung / dga' ldan rtse shar gyi chos rje/ lha rtse bla ma/ khal kha o chir dha ra sogs bod sog bzhi bcu skor la sman bla sprul sku/ spyan ras gzigasagatso 'khor gsum pa/ 'jam dkar gtso 'khor lnga pa/ zhu mi de rnams kyi thog gra tshang gi gra pa brgya skor la rnam 'joms ljang sngon ba ri lugs/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo thun mong ba brgyud pa bdun ldan/ gur nas bshad pa'i 'byung 'dul/ 'jam dbyangs chos skor nang gi las gshin phyi sgrub/phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs/ tshe dbang grub rgyal ma rnams bskur/ lha rtse chos sde ba drug gisagatsos bsnyen rdzogs brgya dang soganyis/ dge tshul gnyis rnams la sdom pa phab/ 'di ga'i rkyen sel ched du lha sar sgo 'gyed la dud rer tā tshwa nyag do re'i rtsis la sbag brgya dang brgyad/ ga slong la sbag brgyad/ rdzong gzhis khag rnams bsdoms par bka' 'gyur brgya dang drug /brgyad stong pa chig stong /gzungs bsdus dang gser 'od brgya rtsa/ mtshan brjod nyis 'bum tshig khri bdun stong dgu brgya/sman bla bzhi khri lnga stong bzhi brgya/ rnam rgyal stong mchod/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub mchod/ gdugs dkar (8ba)tshig 'bum chig khri brgyad stong bdun brgya/ sgrol ma chig 'bum bdun khri nyis stong brgyad brgya/sher snying chig 'bum sum khri bdun stong bzhi brgya/ tshe gzungs sa ya gsum dang drug 'bum drug khri/tshe chog khag lnga/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug gsum du brgya mchod rnam lnga/ gser chab/ snyan shal/ spyan 'dren/ khrus gsol/ pha bong kha/ yer ba/ ka tshal/ yom bu/ mkho mthing / gtsang 'gram/bu chu/ grom pa rgyang / byams sprin rnams su nyer spyod sna lnga lnga bsto tshar/ snyan shal/ spyan 'dren/ khrusagasol/ mchims bu/ yang rdzong / shel 'brag /chu bo ri/ mkhar chu/ gter sgrom/ zab phu/ bkra —/0

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)bzang rnams su tsho gis brgya/ sāts+tsha 'bum lnga/ srong btsan du bskang ba brgya/ yer pa'i mchod rten tshor sku dkar dar lcog /phyugs lug brgya dang nya 'bum gyi srog blu/ klu sbug tu pha bong kha pa bzhis zla gcig bar klu gtor/ sde pa'i sku rim la 'bum brgya/ brgyad stong / bskal bzang / mtshan brgya/ dpang stong rnams nyis brgya re/ gzungs bsdusang brgyad/ dkon brtsegs re lnga/ nyi khri don gsum/ mtshan brjod bdun brgya/ gdugs dkar sum stong bdun brgya/ sgrol ma sum 'bum drug stong brgyad brgya/sher snying nyis stong bzhi brgya/ tshe gzungs nyis 'bum nyi khri dgu stong / gra tshang du dmag zor ma'i bskang brgya/ gnas chung du gsol mchod zab rgyas/ mchod rten sum cur sku dkar dar lcog /lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug gsum du dar chen/ bstan srid spyi rim la/rdo rje brag /dpal ri/ smra bo lcog /brag la ba/ sgrol ma ba/ chu mig pa/ brag dkar chu bzang pa/ nub dgon pa rnams kyis dgra mnan/ drag po'i gtor bzlog /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg /dgra (9na sko dpangs bstod/ wer ma mchod pa/ srid pa'i lha chen/ rje'i mgur lha/ 'bangs kyi srog lha/ bstan ma bcu gnyis rnams la gsol mchod 'dod gsol dang bcas pa/ rgyal gsol/ gdugs dkar mdos chen/ yig drug dung bzhi bcu/ 'di lo nas bzung bskal pa ma stongs bar sa ga zla ba'i tshes bdun nas bco lnga'i bar 'bras yul skyed tshal bar sman bla rgyun btsugs/ chu bo ri'i sman chab zhag lnga bsten cing se chen dbon pos rta drug cu byin/gra tshang du srid gsum bdag mo mdos mchod 'bum gyis dgyes pa bskangs/ lhun grub rdzong nas sde pa chos srid snyung gzhi kha mi 'cham pa'i gtam sna tshogs dang bcas gshegs par spyi sger gyi smon lam rten 'byor pa ltar dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i bsngo ba yang dag bgyis/thang po che dang khra 'brug tu spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtsho/ bsam yas pe dar lcog zhig gsos kyi thog mar chos skyong phebs par zur khang pa don grub dbang rgyal/ la mor dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa gsum btang ba'i so sor phrin gsol tshigs bcad spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor dang bcas bzabs rgyas su spel/ skyed tshal mkhan zur pa byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin lho —11—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pomos su gnas mal phogs sogs mthun rkyen sbyar nas a spyi'i bsnyen chen btang ba grub cing kha stong gi sbyin sreg 'phral zin legs pas dgos cha yong tshul mol yang rtog ge rgan po'i sāts+tsha par gcig gi nang du rang gzhan thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan zhes 'char ba chos nyid nas slar rtses dang rang du mdzad rgyu'i khul gyi bsti gnas su bzhud/ dbu mdzad blo bzang yon (9ba)tan gyi ngor khal kha rgyal po'i gsol mchod/ chos rje bco brgyad pa/ gnas gsar dbon rin po che/ lcags zam rje drung gsum gyis lho mos su khyab bdag zha lu par brtan bzhugs 'bul bar sgrol dkar la brten pa'i cho ga 'chi blu dang 'brel ba/ blo gros dpal 'byor gyi ngor bla ma chos grags rgyal mtshan dang blo bzang pad+ma'i gsol 'debs/ dbon po chos dbyings kyis rdzogs chen sprul sku'i dgongs rdzogs su bsgrubs pa'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba dang yang srid myur 'byon gyi smon lam 'dod sbyar/hor zla lnga pa'i nang du gter sgrom chu tshan blangs pa'i 'phrod bsten zhag shas bstar/ nag zla'i nyer gnyis lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor thog tshar chen/ rje dbang rab khu dbon/ mkhan chen zha lu pa dang bzhi'i rnam thar gyi mchod brjod sogs dbu btsugs pa'i skar 'dzin ngos thog mar zla ba 'di'i tshes gsum gyi nyin khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i rnam thar dad pa'i rlabs phreng tshig don gnyis ka legs khul /sna di/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po'i bka' dang gnas gsar ba mkhyen rab blo ldan dang mkhyen rab rnam rgyal gnyis kyis sa bon dang bcas bskul ba'i rkyen dang rang nyid kyi dad pa'i rgyu sgogs pa'i steng / bco brgyad chos rje dbon rin po che nam mkha' bsod nams dbang rgyal/ lcags zam rje drung gsum gyi lam 'bras kha skong du rim gyis grub par bgyis/dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i tshe po ti so so'i mjug tu 'bri rgyu'i smon lam/ skyid thang nor bus dad rten bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /zur thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku skye'i (10na)thebs su bzhag pa'i phyag dpe rnams la slar yang zhib brtsis kyi tho bkod dang 'go —12

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)brjod/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po'i bka' gnang bzhin rin po che bco brgyad pa/ zhabs drung dbon rin po che/ lcags zam rje drung gsum gyi brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad/ rgyal skor bsod nams dbang pos 'jam dbyangs kyi bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /'phyong rgyas mgar tshang pa ngag dbang nam mkhas dad rten du 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /bde chen chos 'khor gra ris rnams kyi ngor sprul sku myur 'byon gyi smon lam/ pha bong kha gdan sa pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas par sku mang du bzhengs pa'i bsngo smon/ 'dres lnga chu skor ba ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i gser sku bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /lcag sdig gi thod sku la brten pa'i zil gnon bsnyen thabs reg zig mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs dang rab gnas chog nyi ma'i gzi 'bar/ 'chi bdag bye ba dgu rings kyi 'phren las rnams bkod/ snying thang dgon bla mas rta nyer gcig byin/lho brag mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gsang bdag dngos dang dbyer med pa'i bod 'bangs spyi bye brag gi phan bde'i 'byung gnas dang rgyal ba bcong kha pa chen po thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi rang bstan dar ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo phye yang ban pa theg phyi'i gtsug lag khang 'di spyi rta sgal ral du song ba'i rje mi la'i yab bzhis lta bur gyur par zhig gsos rim grub kyi mus sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga gso bran/ ldebs ris su tshe dpag med kyi stong sku/ bder gshegs (10ba)brgyad/ mdzad bcu/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod/ gnas bcu/ mtshan brgyad/ shud bu ba las kyi rdo rje dang rgyal ba btsong kha ba chen po'i rnam thar bcas bskrun pa'i do dam lha rtse lha khang pa'i btsun pa/ bris 'bur gnyis yong ba'i lha bzo lha khang sku skye can bzhis zla ba gsum song bar gla yon rgyas pas bsnyen/gra sa phan tshun du ja tshul nyer lnga re/ yon snon gra pa rer 'bal sran khal re/ yon dge 'dun bcu drug re la ya ju bar khag re btang bar khor drug nga brgyad song / zhal 'don sher snying drug 'bum lnga stong bdun brgya/ kong po gro khang steng par chos gnyis zhan pa'i sa snon du rtse la sgang nas shas zhing bdun brgya thon pa'i sa 'byed/ tshong 'dus nas bshan pa bya khrid mig gcig pa g.ya' ri gong du byon —13

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ponas lo gsum mi yong gsung ba lo ngo gsum gyi thog khog pa gsar du btsal par lha mi dga' ston gyi dang por tshigs bcad 'phrin gsol tshogs 'khor spyan gzigs dang bcas spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtsho mngags/tshes bcu gcig la sa'i tshangs pa bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po 'khor bcas dbyar gyi ring 'dam du bzhugs par 'byon pa la 'bangs bcas lnga brgya skor la lag pa'i 'degs 'jog dang zhal ngo rnams la bka' bsgo srung mdud phul/ gzhan yang rgyal mo no mun dha ra/ gser mdog can mkhan po/mal dro 'chad ka bla ma/ thos bsam dar rgyas gling bla ma/ khal kha no yon khu thug thu sogs bod sog lnga brgya skor dang phrad/ de nyin me tog gi char kha ba ltar babs zer ba dngos su ma mthong yang bden na sang (11na snyan zur kun mkhyen bla ma'i sku skye dngos phebs kyi sngon 'gro'am khyab bdag khra tshang pa'i sprul sku stabs skyur du bzhag pa gshegs pa'i gtam 'byor pa gang gi rtags yin dpyad ma shes/tshes bcu gnyis la zur chos dbyings rang grol gyi sku skye byon pa bstan ma khang du bzhugs shing bcu gsum chad pa'i bcu bzhir lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor thog sku skye dang ngos phrad kyi thog mar mnga' bdag gis sham snugangs nas spyan drangs pa'i sku tshab pad+ma mthong grol/ bde 'dus shog ser/chos dbang rin po che'i gter byon log gnon gnam lcags rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs phul/ sprul sku de brtul zhugs dang gzi brjid che zhing spyan gyi gzigs stangs sogs byis pa tha mal pa dang mi 'dra ba'i ngo mtshar can zhig snang / rdo rje 'amang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar bdud rtsi'i za ma tog legs par grub pa khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i rtogs brjod kyi bskul ba po rnams kyis mtshams sbyor dang rang nyid kyi mos brtson gyis ci nus su bsgrubs/tshes bcu drug la sprul pa'i skur tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster/ nyang gi drag dmar gyi byin rlabs lu gu rgyud/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs phul zhing bdog pa'i skyes dang bcas re zhig rang gnas su thegs su bcug /gsang chen slob bshad gegs med du grub nas bco brgyad chos —14

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja) rje dang lcags zam rje drung gnyis rang gi bsti gnas su rdzong ba dang dpon rin po che skor cig chos 'phro dang bcas bzhugs pa'i bslab bya bgyis/ ā tsarla ya ma ri ṣi ri zhes mig 'byed mkhan yin zer bar gser gla rtsi ras dar (11ba)gyis mtsho ni pa'i ster byin byas shing lha sa skor la'ang mig 'byed tshul dang ldan rgyu ma byung ba'i khar dpal ri sprul sku'i spyan ya gcig slong ba sogs za 'dod mkhan deb shes shig yin tshod du 'dug /gtsang stod dar mgon gyi brgyud pa dge slong gzhan phan lhun grub zer ba gso rig gi sbyangs stobs dang thos rgya che ba zhig byung bar bstan rgyun la bsams nas dbon tshang byang ngos pa na rgyal tshe dbang / dpon tshang dkyil spe ba/ chos rje na bza' gling pa/ drung 'tsho lhag bsam/ dar mo sman rams pa/ slob ma dang bcas pa sum cu skor la yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa/ zin tig gces bsdus/ gser bre/ byang pa rigs ldan rnam rgyal grags bzang gis mdzad pa'i bshad rgyud 'grel chen sogs lung man ngag mang du spel bcug /gso dpyad kyi lung man ngag 'di tsho bod mkhas par yod 'dra zer ba zha lu mkhan rin po ches dri rmed gnang ba'i lan du med tshul dang rjes 'brug rtogs tsho'i ske la the'u byung skabs de las thar du re ba'i rgyun yod khul dang bla brgyud kyang gang dran sna tsho gis bkod/ rked par phur pa gzer nas rnying ma ba yin khul gyi sgrib shing sogs rnam 'phrul ci yang ston gyin yod 'dug pa dwags brgyud pa'i ngang tshul kho nar zad do/ /dge slong rgyal bas rdo rje slob dpon byas pa'i gra tshang du phye ring bye ba bzlog sngags dang bcas pa'i mthar gtor bzlog bstar/ ban sngags bon gsum rags bsdus khag nyer lngas mdos/ gtor bzlog /dgra mnan/ gra sa phan tshun du ja tshul nyer lnga'i ring gdugs dkar nyis 'bum sum khri lnga stong/sher snying sa ya bzhi dang chig khri rnams nus rem la btang / thod ri bshad sgrub gling gi gra pa dka' bcu (11ba)blo bzang lhun grub kyis dbu ma dang / tshe dbang rgya mtsho so phar phyin gyi rgyugs sprad/ mer gan nyung tha'i ji can gyis rta nyi shu byung /hor zla drug pa'i tshes drug nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog rgyud stod smad/—156

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (7gsang ne'u thog gi zhabs drung gnyis dang chen slob kyis gtsos pa/ lha sa ru bzhi/ khri rin po ches dbu gnang gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i dpon slob bzhi bcu skor/ skyor mo lung / tsher gseb dgon pa rnams kyis so so'i lugs srol ltar bdog pa maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul sngon du 'gro bas ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing khyad par khri rin po che byams pa bkra shis kyis gsar rtsom tshigs bcad du lang tsho zhes pa byis pa gzhen nu sogs lngar byas pa'i dkyil ma yin pas slar yang drug cu thub par khas blangs par song zhes gsung bshad ci yang mdzad/ skyid shod sde pa yas mas sog po'i dpon dpon mo/ bkra shis lhun po'i brtan bzhugs 'bul mi mgron gnyer/ rta pa drung 'khor sogs nyis stong lnga brgya skor dang phrad cing tsher gseb sku rten par rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs dbang bzhi bskur/ co ne chos rje'i sku skyer rung mthun gyi gos cha tshang / shal dkar dmar snam phrug gis thog drangs pa dang / g.yon ru'i tsho gos gsog rab stims pa/ rgyal sras rdo rje/ dpon mo bsod nams tshe dbang / khal kha ja sag thu rgyal po/ lha btsun ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ bzod pa yel deng / mer gan hung tha'i ji/ da la'i nyung tha'i ji/ er te ni pā thur sogs kyi mi snas mtsho ni (12ba)par gang 'tshams kyi rdzong bda' bgyis/ dar mgon dbon po la phogs dong kyi smin grub byas/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku chos yin zer ba dang gso rig gi pu ti mang ba bcas kho rang gis brtsams pa'i tshig bton nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ skyid shod bde chen sku gzhen pa/ mon phyogs su dbus dpung bteg pa'i dmag dpon tshag sgur ba/ mda' dpon rgan pa tshe dbang / gzhen pa che gsum pa/ rtsis pa ngag dbang / thugs dkar ba zla ba sogs mang dag dang phrad/ gnam lcags sdig pa'i chos sde nas gsungs pa'i dus dgra'i dbang po yab yum gyi thod sku chu rta lo zur thams cad mkhyen pas phyag bris su stsal ba mtshan ltas legs tshul rnam thar du gsal ba de bsnyen pa bskyar ma dang sbrags bsgrub 'dun che'ang gong nas yar 'khor ba'i lo gsum bzhi tsam phan rnam g.yeng chu mnyer lta bu'i gzhan dbang gis gnas brtan dan 'bag pa'i chos kyi dpe bzhin mos blo kho nar —16

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)zad/ de nas mi ring bar srid skyong dang bro nad kyis mnar ba sogs sgo du mas thod sku gzims chung mgon khang du tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra'i ngang la song /lcags byi lo 'bras spungs kyi gra khang gsar bzo'i dus mtshams khang shod la bzo bskyar dgos gshis mchod rten bcas chog phral te mgon khang lcang lo can du yod pa khang las tshan ches pa'i khar 'og thog tshor rlung gi rgyu ba'ang nyung bas gsher thag chod par lo mang rab 'thogs pa dang khang gsar rlon par ka ca'i rigs 'byon sngas na myur du sarba ga tsā 'ang 'byung skyon gyis sa sprel phan rim lus su gyur/sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis mchod rten gyi skor lam (13na lo ma gzhig pa chub pa dang zur kun mkhyen chen por phyag khrid cig kyang zhus song bas byed thub tsam yod 'dra rung sde pa'i go sar 'khod/nged rang dgon par 'gro ma thub pa sogs nas da bar 'gyangs pa lcags sdig lugs kyi bcas chog cig kyang bzo 'dun yod pas rkyen byas thod sku sgrub mkhan nyungs na dus kyis bcar ba'i bsnyen tshad mi 'gro 'dug gshis rdo rje slob dpon dga' gdong sngags rams pas byas te gra tshang yongs rdzogs kyis tsho mes chen du phyi nang gi mtshams shin tu dam pa'i ngos tshes bcu gcig nas bzung bdun gnyis kyi ring gzhung man ngag zhal shes rnams go bstun pa'i 'khrul med du bstar ba la skye ring bye ba/ e thung nyis 'bum/ so sdebs nyis stong / yum nas lhan thabs yan nyi khri/ sprul pa nas za byed kyi bar bdun stong / sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las bcas la sum khri rnams smin rgyas su song zhing stong srog gri snying bla byang sogs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len 'phyugs med kyi nang bzhugs lag tshags dam par byas/tshes bcu bzhir rgyal po chen mo'i rgyal mo bsod nams chos 'dzom dang stag rtse rgyal bu lha rgyal sogs dang phrad cing rgyal bur mgon po phyag drug pa'i bka' bsgos/ tshangs pa dung thod can gyi sku khog dbang 'dus rgyal por tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin sku phebs zhus pa sku rten snga ma ji lta ba las —17—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('khog pas bsgyur nyams gyi yid mi ches pa ye mi 'dug cing slob dpon chen pos dam la bzhag par 'gyur mdog ga la srid kyang bsnyel gso'i phyir du slob dpon chen po'i phyag rdor chos dbang rin po che'i gter byon dbu gtsug tu (13ba〉kod nas rigs na brgyud pa'i mtshan rnams brjod de 'phrin 'chol gyi ched du dam bsgrags/ zang zing gi bdog pa sogs spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang bas 'byung 'gyur lung bstan gyi mol mchid rgyas par mdzad/ phyi dro sku khog 'khor bcas la ster cha gya nom pa bgyis te thon/ tha'i ji bsod nams bkra shis lhor dpung thog la thon gdong mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi byin rlabs byas/ 'phags yul lho phyogs kyi sa bya si tsa tur gu ṇa dzā tir sa snying srang phyed dang chas kyis mtshon pa'i mthun rkyen byin/lcags 'brug lo zur chos dbyings rang grol gyis phyag len gnang ba'i 'chi bdag zhal dbye dang rta nag sgrol ma ba sangs rgyas rin chen gyis bsgrubs pa'i 'phyong rgyas mkhar nag gi zhal dbye gnyis kyi tshon rtsi sogs la chag nyams phran bu byung ba gzhis ka shar lags a gur pha bu dang 'bal 'bal pha bu gnyis kyis gso bran gyi zhabs tog byas pa dngos gzhi sngar gyi sgrub thod rnying pa yin rung nyer dgu nas bzung dge slong blo gros rgyal bas rdo rje slob dpon byas pa'i drug cu skor gyis tshoms chen du mun mtshams shin tu dam par bgyis te bsgrubs pas skad 'byin pa sogs rtags kyang kha yar brtsams/dge slong yon to dpal bzang / sngags rams pa blo bzang chos ldan/ rdo dgon pa blo bzang don ldan/ drung yig dar rgyas bkra shes te bzhis ring po nas bskul zhing nye char tshangs pa dung thod can gyi sku khog gis mtshams sbyar bar brten rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi mngon rtogs pad+ma rā ga'i 'phreng ba/lam rim lha khang dang sngags (14na〉nga gnyis kyi deb ther 'go brjod/ sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis sku rten sman sku mang ba/ gsung rten bka' 'gyur/ thugs rten dngul gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten dang /dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i dkar chag /dga' gdong sngags pa don —18

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)grub rgya mtshos gra k+ṣe du 'bul rgyur dngul srang nyer brgyad kyi phud phor dang chos rje rdzong ri ba blo bzang pad+mas gra tshang gi dge skos 'jog la srang bcu bzhi las grub pa'i pad sder gyi kha byang / tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang shes rab brtan pa thun mong dang blo bzang don yod kyi ngor ring 'tsho re tshigs bcad/zha lu mkhan chen khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam thar dpyod ldan yid dbang 'gug ga pa'i lcags kyu/ 'phyos grib btsan pa'i 'phrin las/mchod dpon pa'i lha dbang gling du 'dri rgyu'i kun 'khor le phywa/ sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pas chu dbar dgon gsar du 'dzugs rgyur tshe ring mched lnga'i gsol mchod dpyad gsum dag pa'i rgyud mang rnams brtsams/hor zla bdun pa'i nang du 'di ga'i rim gror 'bum dang nyi khri brgya rtsa re/ brgyad stong pa stong /sman bla chig khri/ gdugs dkar tshig 'bum sum khri/ sgrol ma sum 'bum chig khri dgu brgya/ tshe gzungasasum khri bdun stong / bka' 'gyur lnga/ gzungs bsdus dang gser 'od brgya re/ dkon brtsegs dang phal chen bcu re/ sher snying nyis 'bum bdun khri bzhi stong / ra sa/ zan g.yang / khra 'brug gsum (14ba)du brgya mchod/ snyan shal/ dar chen/ lha sa'i phyogs bzhin rgyal mtshan/ shel brag /mchimasaphu/ yang rdzong gsum du tshogs brgya/ nyer spyod sna lnga lnga bcu re/ sde pa'i sku rim du dmag zor ma dang rnam sras kyi bskang ba brgya/ srog blu dgung grangs/ ri bo bde chen du mang ja spong dag /rgyal mtshan bkra shis dgu brtsegs/ dgon sum cur gtor chas ja thug gi thog gtor bzlog nyin gang ma/bstan srid spyi rim du 'bum so gcig /dkon brtsegs bcu/ nyi khri nyer gcig /gzungs bsdus brgya/gra tog gser gsum brgya re/ ser 'bras gnyis su ja tshul bco brgyad re'i thog gdugs dkar nyis 'bum drug khri drug stong / sgrol ma sa ya lnga bdun 'bum nyi khri nyis stong / sher snying bye ba gcig sa ya dgu sum 'bum drug khri sum stong / tshe gzungs bzhi khri lnga stong / mgon po g.yul bzlog dang khro rol tshar gsum re/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug gsum du dgra mnan/ mchod pa sna lnga dang bstan pa rgyas—19—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (popa'i smon lam/ chos 'khor rgyal du dmag zor ma'i bskang ba chig stong chig brgya/ dar tshon sna lnga/mgon po dang las gshin la brgya/ lha sa/ ra mo che/ yer pa/ pha bong kha/ ka tshal/ bsam yas/khra 'brug /yum bu/ mkho mthing gtsang 'gram/ grom pa rgyang rnams su mchod 'bul/ snyan shal/ri 'go mtho ba brgyar dar lcog /rdzong bzhis dang sde dpon tshang mas dgra lha dpangs bstod/ brgyagasarngan/ yul so sor bsangs dang gsol mchod/ chu mig (15na)brgyar klu sman/ dgon khag bzhi bcur mang ja/ gra pa bco lnga rer gser zho re'i 'gyed bcas gdugs dkar sher snying gi bzlog pa rnams bstar/tshes bcu gsum la rta tshag rje drung rin po che dkon mchog nyi ma sogs bsnyen rdzogs bzhi dang dge tshul bcu bzhi bsgrubs/ rang nyid kyang rtsom pa'i 'dun pa yod par ma zad sgra mdo bzhi sogs rig gnas mang por blo gros kyi mig yangs pa 'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub kyis 'bad pa chen pos yig sna mang po'i khungs bsdu ba'i brtson pa dang bcas bskul ba la brten tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar slob bshad bstan pa'i nyi 'od ces pa dam pa nyid 'dus pa gsum gyi 'phrang gegs las rnam par grol ba'i grub mtha' stogs te rdo rje btsun mo'i grong khyer du gshegs pa tshes bco lnga'i nyin rdzogs par grub cing thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dang kun mkhyen klu sgrub rgya mtsho sogs kyis rnam thar mi mdzad pa 'di la dgongs sam zhes pa bsngags pa brjod pa ni 'dar los gzhan ngo bsrung ba tsam mo/ /chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse/ dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa/ rdo pa ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs gsum gyis gser zangs las 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag dang bsam mkhar ba bde chen dbang rgyal gyis ma'i don du zhal thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /dkar brag pa dang ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs/ chang khyim pa gsum gyi ngor gsol 'debs smon lam/ yer pa'i 'du khang ldebs bris kyi dkar chag /nyi thang spyi tshogs kyi ngor bla ma shes rab sbyin pa dang / rdzing phyi spyi so'i ngor 'di ga dang sde (15ba)pa'i —20

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)brtan bzhugs/ 'dul ba slob dpon lha btsun blo bzang dga' ldan gyis bskul nas stod lung sdings kha'i gtsug lag khang la ldebs bris byas pa'i smon lam rnams bris/de yang zur thams cad mkhyen pas zhal bkod gnang nas bzhengs pa'i lcags 'dra lugs kyi bcas chog dang por mkhas pa gnubs dang dum pa rgya/ bar du mkhas pa gangs shāka g.yung ston/ tha mar mkhas pa se ston chen po'i bzhed pa khri srong rnam sprul dpal bkra stobs rgyal gyi phyag len zhabrul med byin can bzhugs pas ma khyab pa min na'ang gnam lcags sdig pa'i chos sde las byung ba gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum chabs cig tu brtsegs pa dum pa rgya'i bka' srol mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje dang chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs las nye bar brgyud pa lha sras rnam 'phrul dbur smyon chos kyi grags pa'i zhal gyi drod rlangs ltar bzhed 'dun sngar nas yod pa las byed dang len gyi rkyen la'ang bltos gshis mchod dpon pas bskul ma kha shas byung ba nas bde gshegs brgyad kyi nang tshan cho 'phrul mchod rten gyi thig rtsa kun mkhyen bu/ mkhas pa sman thang pa/ sprul sku 'phrang kha ba sogs kyi yig cha las byung ba kho nas cung zad mi rtogs pa gnubs sangs rgyas rin po che'i man ngag thig rtsa'i gzhung bzhin dgos pa mnga' ris sngags 'chang chen po dkon cog lhun grub kyis rje chos kyi grags pas bzhengs pa'i mchod rten dang bstun nas ras gzhi la phab pa'i thig rtsa dbyar stod bskur byung ba dang gter gzhung rdo rje mtshon rnon sogs yig cha rnams dang go bsdur zur gyi sngags 'chang gzhis ka shar (16na)pa dang sngags rams pa legs 'byor gnyis kyis thig btab/ do dam sger logs blo bzang dar rgyas/ shing bzo ba lam rnyed can gyis byas te zhi drag gi shing sna rdzas sogs stod smad so sor dgos pa mtha' dag ma tshang ba med pa dang bcas gzhis ka shar pa rogs bcas kyis tshon rtsi'i las 'go btsugs/ a gur pha bu dang 'bal 'bal pha bus stong srog /gnod sbyin nor lha'i 'khor lo/bzlog bsad mnan gtad kyi 'khor ling sogs rnam grangs shin tu mang ba nyin mang por bris/ steng 'og bar gsum gyi lcags thag dgu bsgril gyi sku phyag mtshan gzungs 'khor lo srog shing thod pa thun —21—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (polam sogs bkod shoms phyag len la gnas skabs su rig pa'i 'phrul gyi gnad dgag byed dgos rnams mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bkod pa bgyis/ gter kha 'di la mngon rtogs che 'bring chung gsum/ bstod bskul che 'bring chung gsum/ sgrol ma rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs rnam grangs rgya che zhing khyad par sgrub chen mchod rten rgyun 'khyer gyis mtshon gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i so so'i skabs thob dbye shes dgos pas lha'i mngon rtogs dang sngags byang sogs dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang dpal grong sngags rams pa gnyis kyis dpe 'tshol ba dang zhus dag zin bris byas te gzhis ka shar pa 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyis sku gzugs dang rgyab yig gtsang pa 'jam dbyangs dbang pos bris/ steng bcas bar bcas gzungs 'di ga'i khyad par gyi sgos chos dang bcas pa dbye 'byed dge slong byed du bcug /bcas rnams thams cad 'grig pa'i zla ba bdun pa'i zla dkar gyi gza' tshes dge bar kun bzang (16ba)bde chen du ngos kyis phyin pa'i steng bcas kyi gzungs phul/ mchod rten dngos gzhi'ang lam tsam bsgrigs te gnubs chen gyi man ngag gter gzhung las byung ba bla ma'i phyag bzhes kyis brgyan pa'i rab gnas rten 'brel tsam bsgrigs/ de nas mi ring bar mchod dpon pa mtshams khag las byed dang bcas pa 'bras spungs su brdzangs/ bar bcas kyi gzungs 'bum mchod dpon pa'i zla bo dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas byas te bcas yan legs par grub pa mtshams khag gnyis so so nas yongs grags rab gnas dang 'di ga sgos kyi rab gnas thun du bcad nas nyin gsum gyi bar dam ye gcig tu bsres/tshes bcu drug nas gsang sngags pho brang 'og gi mtshams khang du rdo rje slob dpon blo gros rgyal ba dang mtshams khang gsar par rdo rje slob dpon dga' gdong sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtshos byas te bsnyen sgrub kyi sgrub pa bdun gcig dang lhan du dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas rdo rje slob dpon bgyis pa'i bla srog yid gsum 'gugs pa'i mtshams btsugs/ 'brub khung du sdig pa dngos su zhugs pa dang nye skor du gla ba 'khor ba dang lha dbye'i nub chu rlung 'thab pa dang mi'i skad —22

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)ngan lta bu kha bstad nas 'gro ba'i mtshan ltas legs pa byung / bar der sa stegs 'brub khung sogs dang sgrub pa grol nub 'og bcas kyi 'khor lo rnams mchod dpon pa'i lag bdar te tshags dam par byas ngos las sbyor gyi sgrub pa btsugs pa nyer dgu'i nub dgra bo'i bla tshe srog dbugs 'chi bdag ral pa tshar dgu'i zas skal du gtad nas rig pa ye dag kun tu bzang po rang chas su yod par rang ngo sprad/ dus mtshungs (17na)su dmar po rir rgyun bskang pa kha shas ma gtogs gra tshang gzhis bzhugs rnams kyi rdo rje slob dpon gram pa ba sngags ban blo bzang ngag dbang gis bgyis te chos dbang rin po che sogs gter kha du ma'i zab gnad chu gtad kyi las sbyor tshoms chen du bcad rgya dam par btsugs skabs mi dang ra lug sogs sems can sna tshogs kyi skang rdzong mdun du brgyag pa dang lha sa'i bshas ra nas lug glo bur du bros nas mchod khang dmar po'i ka spungs 'og tu slebs/ gtad rgyab dus skad cig pa 'brug sgra drag po dang ser chol sogs 'tshub ltas mang du byung / rong po dka' bcu can gyis rta nyer lnga byin/ bkra shis sgo mangs pa'i rigs gra'i skal skyel ba nyis brgya dang rgyang ro gser sdings bla zur/ khams ldan ma bla ma/ dpa'i kho sho'u chi'i dpon mo/ bsod nams bkra shis kyi dpon mo sogs lnga brgya skor dang phrad/ rigs 'dzin stobs ldan dbang po'i sras zil gnon dbang drag rdo rje mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi zhig gsos mchod 'bul dang bstan srid kyi sku rim par song gshis stod phyogasasu dbang dang grong chog gis mtshon pa'i 'gro phan skyong bar dmar ser zhwa gos 'dzin pa rnams kyis mi bgag pa'i tham kha dang shel dkar rdzong nas 'bru khal sum brgya re'i gshor 'debs ji srid bar sbyar/mchod dpon pas 'bras spungs su spyil po lha dbang gling brgyab pa'i kha dror sde pa dpon g.yog gra tshang dang bcas pa gdan drangs pa'i skal ba'i bsnyen bkur gis sna cha tshang gis gtsos pa'i bdog pa bstar/ rgya gar ba pra ya ga'i bram ze nan+da dī par gser zho (17ba)gsum dang gos sna tshang ba byin/rta tshag sprul pa'i sku re zhig sgra snyan sogs tha snyad rig pa'i gsan bsam mdzad par skor cig bzhugs 'dod 'dug na'ang khams nas gnyer pa mgo skyes zla ba'i cod pan 'ching ba zhig 'ongs —23—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('ate da lam mi 'byon na dgon gzhis sa ris rnams gzhung du phul nged gra rigs tsho 'thor zer ba'i khams pa'i brtul zhugs la 'gyur ldog ma byung ba'i gshis zla ba yar 'phel gyi thugs bzhed la dmar cha'i gleng brjod thugs kyi tsher mar gyur cing mgyogs 'khor gyi nyer sdogs phebs rdzongs su paṇa zhwas thog drangs na bza' cha tshang / bla chas cha 'grig /gos dar snam phrug /chos gzhis dgos tshul byung bar brten spag shod bsam grub dgon gzhis ka ma lag rten gsum mchod rdzas che phra rang 'jags mi ser bod 'brog dud 'dzin brgyad brgya bco lngar lag yong 'bru rkyang thog dpus char gong rgyab bcas pa la nyis stong bdun brgya sum cu brgal ba sbyor 'jags bgyis/ stag rtse nas tha'i ji rdo rje rnam rgyal gos sna gsum bzhes spro dang bcas dbyar mjal du byon pa dang lhan du gra sa phan tshun gyi dbyar gnas pa stong phrag tu nye ba la lag pa'i 'degs 'jog 'bad de byas/ dus rim du ser 'bras so sor ja tshul sum cu re'i thog gdugs dkar nyis 'bum dgu khri brgyad stong / sgrol ma dang sher snying so sor bye ba sa ya nyis 'bum nyi khri bdun stong / tshe gzungs sa ya gsum drug 'bum brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams bsgrubs/ma ma mtsho sman gyi bur sdod gnas dgos tshul la yar shar dom po che ba'i 'dzin shul gyi ra ma lhas ra/zhing mig dgu la khal nyis brgya thon khungs/ pho brang lho rong (18na〉nga chung par sa brjes ngo dkar du bde chen khang gsar gyi khang pa rto shing 'dzin bdag khal brgya thon khungs/ yar klungs bkra shis chosasder khegasum gyi bogs stir brje tshab tu lho rong khang chung pa'i khang pa drug brgya'i thon khungs sbyor 'jags byas/ 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag slong mi mang gshis ster rgyur kha shas/ khal kha g.yon ru thu shi ye thu rgyal pos thebs bzhag pa ltar dpal ldan 'bras spungs su gser gyi rgyal mtshan cha/ mtha' 'dul yang 'dul rnams su 'dzugs rgyu'i gzhir drug dang bcas pa bzo ba'i do dam stag lung phyag mdzod dbu ma can/ gser gsol sde pa phon mdo ba can gyis mdzad/chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa dka' bcu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos chos mngon rin cen 'dren pa'i shing rta dang bshad sgrub gling pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis dbu ma theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru —24

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)rdzings kyi rgyugs sprad/ 'di ga'i rim gror hor zla brgyad pa'i ches gcig la sāts+tsha 'bum/ phyugs lug brgya nyi shu'i srog blu/ sde pa'i sku rim pa gzungs bsdus brgya bcu gcig /gra tog gser gsum brgya rtsa re/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan sum stong bzhi brgya/ stobs po che bzhi stong bzhi brgya/ phyogs bstomun sel bzhi stong lnga brgya/ ri 'go mtho ba brgyar dar lcog /jus rim du rdo rje brag /dpal ri/ smin grol gling / chu mig pa/ bkra bzang pa/ sgrol phug pa/ 'ug bya lung pa/ gong ra ba/ brag dkar chu bzang pa/ nub dgon pa/ brag la ba/ smra bo lcog pa/ gnas gzhi ba/ ka tshal zur pa/ (18ba)ban grong pa rnams kyis so so'i lugs bzhin gyi dgra mnan/ dbus gtsang gi sa dge'i gra tshang sngags grasagator bzlog /mdo gras mdo sgrub/ de phyin grub mtha' gzhan ma rnams dang adhi gsum pa bcasapar mang ja sbyor sbrel/ gong gi mang ja 'phar kha yod med la ma bltos pa'i dgon adhi dang por khal gnyis/ gnyis par phyed gnyis/ gsum par gcig ma yong rtsis kyi dpus cha'i yon dang bcas smin rgyas su bgyis/tshes gnyis nas drang srong a ga sduḥs nyal 'gro'i dug gzhil ba nas nyin gsum gyi bar bsten/gdan sa 'og nas zhabs drung rgyal mchog rin po che dag zhing du phebs pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rten sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan/ zhal dkar zhal stegs kyis gtsos dngos po gtos che ba 'byor don bzhin nam mkha'i mtha' snyed kyi 'gro kun sgrol bzhed dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs yang dag par zhus shing gdung 'bul du brgyad tshan drug gi dang por gser srang gang / gnyis par dngul mdong srang so gnyis dang nag po khor drug ma/ gsum par dngul srang dgu'i sder ma/ bzhi par zi ling brgyad ja/ lnga par dngul phor dang ya ju khor drug ma/ drug par 'bru khal brgyad brgyas gtsos pa rnams 'bul du grub rgyal gling pa blo bzang dngos grub brdzangs/ rwa sgreng mkhar thog khri rin po che zur pa dang spyi sgo bsdoms pas rta nyi shu'i gnang skyes byung / thang wo mkhan po dung dkar ba/ mtshur phu phyag mdzod/ bi lig er khe tha'i ri'i dpon mo/ do go long gis mtshon pa'i bod sog —23—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ponyis brgya skor dang phrad/'phags (19na〉kyil wa ra ṇa si'i bram ze ru dra dwa sa byung bar gser zho bzhi/ gla 'khor bzhi/zur mas bstar/ gsung ngag so gos chos bka' grol ba'i zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'dzin pa/ bco brgyad chos rje/ gnas gsar dbon rin po che rnams lho mos nas phebs pa dang mjal zhing chos dang 'brel ba'i gsung gleng 'phel/tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin khyab bdag zha lu pa dang dbon rin po cher chos rgyal byang pa'i phyag bzhes kyi lcags sdong ma phar phul/ bcas de ga'i steng nas bskyar sgrub kyis mkhan rin po ches der 'khod la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i phyag bzhes ma de tshur stsal/ rje bla ma gtsang du phebs rdzongs la sku ber gyis sna drangs na bza' cha mgrig /dngul lnga bcu ma/ dngul mdong / dngul nyir/ ja gos dar gyisamatshon rgyas pa dang drag dmar gyi bka' bsgo phul zhing gsung zhib cha'i ngos chibs kha bskyod/ dbon mkhyen rab blo ldan dus kyi chos nyid du 'gyur bar nye ba'i dbon rin po che bkra shis chos sder mgyogs 'khor gyi phebs rdzongs bstar/stag rtse tha'i ji rdo rje rnam rgyal dang bi lig er khe tha'i ji nyis brgya skor la phyag drug pa'i byin rlabs bar chad kun sel byas/ mchod dpon pa rgyal gyi gtor gsos rgyas pa zhig byed pa rdzong bda' bgyis skabs byams chen dang mgon khang so so'i bris 'bur gyi sku rnams dang sde pa a bar gyis ma pham mgon po/ mchod dpon pas byams pa dang dmag zor mas mtshon par snyan dar kha byang / gzhan yang spyan gzigs go mtshon tshogs chen du mang ja 'gyed kha shas bskur/ rang nyid rtsom 'dun dang byang (19ba)bdag sprul pa'i sku mchog gis bskul ma mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis khyab bdag blo mchog rdo rje'i rnam thar nyung ngu rnam gsal/ mkhan chen zha lu pa'i bka' nos te gnas bcu'i chog sgrigs rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyi nyams len du gtor ma brgya rtsa dang gsur bsngo/rta ra mdo pa dzam la pha bu'i ngor gsol 'debs dang nyal sgom rgyab yig /dge slong 'jam dbyangs —26

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)grags pas ma'i don du snyan dar dang smon lam/ gram pa blo bzang ngag dbang gis bris thang le tshan 'dres lnga chu skor ba gsol dpon ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi 'brungs rabs/ 'phyong rgyas blo bzang dbang ldan gyis rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po/ chos rje rkan bu ba zil gnon rdo rjes thang sku gsum rnams bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /rgyas dar ba 'tsho byed skal ldan sogs slob ma tsho'i ngor nged rang dang dar mo sman rams pa gsol 'debs/ gnyal pa blo bzang rnam dag gis bskul nas ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad rnams bris/khu lu dbon pos rta bco lnga/ klu 'bum hor can gyis rta bco brgyad/ big du chos skor gyis rta bco lnga/ mkhar rgya dpal ldan can dang 'phrin las chos 'phel gyis rta nyer bdun re/ blo bzang nor bu can gyis rta bco lnga/ rdo rje dka' bcu can gyis rta nyi shu/ rong po blo bzang can gyis rta nga bzhi rnams byung /tshes bcu bdun la ri chos pa dam chos dbang rgyal phur pa/ ri bo bde chen pa ngag dbang dge legs bka' brgyad/ klu phug blo bzang dngos grub/ 'brom stod pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ gong dkar ba blo bzang bsod nams/ stag ru ba (20na)ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dang bzhis tshe bdag /'phyos pa ngag dbang phun tshogs rta mgrin rnams la bsnyen pa byed pa'i dmigs skor dang mthun rkyen sbyar/byams:nga dang thar ba'i mkhan po/ rtse chen rgyal po dang khal kha g.yon ru da la'i gyi mi sna/ bstan 'dzin da yan rgyal po'i dbu skor chung ba sogs bod sog lnga brgya skor la byin rlabs byas/ bsnyen rdzogs brgyagasum dang dge tshul dgu bsgrubs/ tshangs pa dung thod can gyi sku khog dbang 'dus rgyal pos dgos tshul ltar mal dro phrang smad nas dud 'dzin lnga lag 'bab bzhi brgya bco lnga/ nā lan+da par snga sor gyi 'phros mkhar rtse mthong smon nas dud 'dzin brgyad lag yong zhe bzhi rtsis sprad/hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gsum la de mo sprul sku thog mar byon pa'i phyag rten la kha btags/ gser srang nyi shu/ gos yug bdun/ khrab bcu/ ja bzang ngan 'dres pa khor drug brgyad brgya/ rta brgya bcu gnyis/ dre'u brgya dang nyer bzhi/ mdzo brgya/ g.yag lnga bcu sogs khri 'bul bstar/ tsug phud blangs —27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (peshing mtshan ngag dbang nam mkha' 'jam dbyangs su gsol/ dpon slob sum brgya skor la ja gral gyi tshe sprul sku sku na phra ba'i tshod la tshugs kha dang bzhugs tshul ya mtshan pa snang / chab mdo rje drung gi sprul sku/ brag yag sku skye/ dga' ldan rab 'byams pa/ dga' ldan dar rgyas/ dpon mo ma ga dha/ yu'i ching a kha'i/ da
