la'i pā thur/ dha sa kho sho'u chi sogs khal kha du ma dang / sa skyong mer gan tha'i ji dang bal po ye rang gi mi sna kā shing ma/ klu 'bum gyi 'grul pa nyis brgya skor sogs khyo zhe nyis stong tsam dang phrad/(20ba)dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas gtsos gra pa kha shas zangs rir rten gyi gzungs 'bul dang rab gnas byed par brdzangs pa'i zhar byung 'khor zhag dang sbrags srong btsan bang so'i gtsug lag khang byin can der gañdzi ra'i nang bzhugs la dgra bgegs gnon pa 'grub na spyi sgos su phan pa'i lung bstan 'dug pas bsgrub 'dod yod pa'i steng sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis rdzong thog tu gañdzi ra 'dzugs rgyu gra bsgrigs pa phyogs mthun nang rdzongs dang tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra la mngags shing chos rje rdzong ri ba can gyi tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i gshin rje dmar po'i mnan pa'ang dus thog tu bskyal/ mi ring ba nas lo gcig tsam gyi bar rdzong gi gañdzi ra'i zangs leb bsgrigs mtshams nas chu babs te lce khar myang rgyu byung bar rtse zhol kun nas blta mkhan mang zhing bdud rtsi yin zhes gleng ba yong mi thang ba zhig yin 'dug rung dpyad ma bzod/ 'di nub nas bzung bdun gcig gi ring lusang ga mi 'da' zhing yid kyi glang po kun rtog gi nags su yang yang rgyug kyang dran shes lcags kyus 'debs khul gyi yang zab 'chol pa'i khro rgyal chen po'i bsnyen sgrub bgyis par rtags ya mtshan can ni dngos nyams gang du 'ang ma byung bas las sgrib kyang je 'thug la 'gro yin yod pa 'dra/ — ra mo cher stod pa dang sngags khang du smad rgyud pa gnyis kyi dbu mdzad the ba'i bzhi bcu res bdun gnyis kyi bar bskang gso'i thog shā sa na 'gro gang che'i mjug gtor bzlog /ser 'bras dge gsum du ja tshul bco lnga re'i thog sher snying 'gro gang che/ sde pa blo bzang sbyin pas 'di ga'i rim gror dmigasate tshe chog 'dzugs rtsis kyi rigs 'dzin chen pos 'bras gshongs nas gdan drangs pa'i tshe dpag —28—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)med bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang dwangs (21na)ma bcud 'dren sogs kyi 'bur sku kha shas e nas bag dro can dang / pho brang dbu mdzad phun tsho gos can gyis ldebs ris la tshe dpag med stong sku bskrun par gzungs bzhugs dang rab gnas smin grol gling nas lo chen ngag dbang chos dpal can gyis bstar zhing tshe chog gi bzhi sde yang smin grol gling nas res skor dang de mtshungs ri bo bde chen par sman bla'i bzhi sde pa gsar 'phar bzhi btsugs/ sde pa'i sku rim du gser 'od/ gzungs bsdus/ thang yig gsum brgya rtsa re/ ma ṇi dung / mtshan brjod nyi khri/ gdugs dkar sum khri/ dri med bshagasargyud sum brgya/ bsam yas/ la mo/ gnas chung gsum du gsol mchod bzabs rgyas/ bstan srid spyi rim la dge lugs dgon khag tshor mang ja lnga re/ sa lugs tshor bzhi re'i thog gtor bzlog dang mdo sgrub skabs thob ltar bsgrubs/ dga' ldan dar rgyas kyis rta brgya nyi shu byin cing dpon g.yog phyed nyis brgya skor la mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang bskur/ de'i shog se chen dge slong can gyis rta zhe gcig /dge tshul mas kyang drel bcu dgu dang rta drel bzhi re/ bra nye khu thug rab 'byamasapa can gyis nyer brgyad/ 'bri gung pas bco lnga/ zhang ston gzhen tshang dang da la'i pā thur can gyisabacu dgu re/ sbus mda' bla mas nyer brgyad/ ra la no mun khan gyis nyi shu/ a rig bkra shis rgya mtsho can dang hor rdza dmar rgya mtshos bco brgyad re rnams byin/tshes bcu gsum la de mo sprul pa'i sku/ dhas kho sho'u chi'i bu sogs dge tshul gyi dngos por bsgrubasashing rta 'bul ba lnga bcu skor la byin rlabs (21ba)bgyis/ gong du zhu yig 'bul bar btang ba'i rab 'byams pa blo bzang don grub dang la gdong pa ngag dbang grags pa gnyis zi ling nas mi sna dngos gzhi'i sngun bcad de 'ongs pa dang phrad/ tshes bco lnga nas paṇa chen sku mched kyi zab gter ye shes 'od mchog gi sgo nas bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po dang 'brel pa'i 'chi med grub pa'i rnal 'byor bdun gcig gi bar du nyams su blangs pa dbang po yang rab cig yin na gzhan las zab khyad thon pa'i bogs chen po zhig thon tshod du 'dug kyang rang skyon chos la bkal chog pa bya lam du song / mtshams —29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pokhongs su khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i dpon rin po che yar klungs nas byon pa dang mjal zhing dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal g.yu rtsi ma'i phyag rten mdzad/ lho mos su kye rdor bsnyen chen la 'byon pa'i mthun rkyen dang bslab bya/ rgya nag gi thod phreng byu ru'i rgyan dang gser gyi bcu shad yod pa'i legs pa/ hor dril legasapa shubs bcas/ bzang ja chu thog ma khor gsum/ sku srung la thugs rten gnam lcags kyi rdo rje dang mgon po shing drung ma lo chen rin bzang gis gdan drangs pa'i 'khrul med bla ma dam pa'i sku srung 'bral spang g.yar por phul/ sde pa cung zad bro 'tshal bar mgon po'i byin rlabs bar chad kun sel/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul dang dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang bskur/ rgya nag la 'gro mi rab tshoms pa don grub rgya mtsho can dang bod sog nyis brgya skor dang phrad cing sog po gsar slebs rnams kyis gser dngul ja gos dar pags ras sogs phon che ba/ gzhan yang rang rang gi yul zog gi ster bya bzabs/nyer lnga nas yangs pa can gyi rta 'go'i chu tshan/ (22na snyan bdun gyi bar bsten kyang phan gnod ni ma byung / thod ri bshad sgrub gling pa ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ phun tshogs rgya mtsho/ blo gros rgya mtsho gsum gyis phar phyin gsar rtsoms thal phreng gi rgyugs sprad/ gnam gang gi zhegs lha sa'i bsnyen gnas ma tsho yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims la bkod/hor zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig la phu lung lha dbang rdo rje bsam yas su bskang rdzas dngos bshams yid sprul dang bcas btang ba'i tshe spel ba'i phrin yig tshigs bcad/ rtses dang dpal grong sngagasarams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag khri bcas bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam brtsams/ khal kha ma ga dha/ yu'i ching a kha'i/ da la'i pā thur sogs kyis gser dngul ja gos dar pags rigs sogs rgya sog gi dngos dpyad spams mtho ba'i stong 'bul/ khal kha klu 'bum no mun khan/ no mun e jen gyi dge tshul ma/ yel deng no yon/ dpon mo bso de nams sgrol ma sras blon 'bangasabacas kyis rgyu zog gong la gzhibs pa'i khri 'bul/ tre bo hor tshang dpon po mched sogs kyisagaser dngul ja khrab rta drel gyis gtsos pa'i stong 'bul byung ba dge ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob —30

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)pa'i rgyur bsngos shing dpon g.yog drug brgya skor la yan lag gi 'degs 'jog bgyis/tshes lngar byang khang rgyab pho lhas mang 'gyed 'bras shel gyis sna drangs pa'i bdog pa brkyang ste gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa bstar/ po ta la'i gra shag gsar rgyag zin pa'i legs byar gnyer pas khur blangs pa'i dkar dro dmar dro'i bzhes len dang spyi sger nas (22ba)zang zing gi dngos po ring du brkyang /tshes bdun gyi nyin de mo sprul sku dbon bcas kyis bdog pa phyur bur spungs shing tshogs yon sbyar te gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi tshe chog mdzad/ sprul sku dpon slob la tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa/ 'byung 'dul/ a ra pa tsa na gtso rkyang / seng ldeng nags sgrol/ rnam 'joms ba ri lugs kyi dbang dang rjes gnang / rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs dang phyag drug pa'i byin rlabs rnams byas/ sdings po che'i sprul sku/ rgyal gling mkhan zur sngon po tog /lcags zam sprul sku/ han stag lung sku skye sogs bla ma kha shas/ sde pa mtshal pa/ sa skyong mer gan tha'i ji/ u khe res tha'i ji/ mer gan tha'i ji gsum gyi mi sna/ mer gan a kha'i gyis gos dar dang jas thog drangs pa'i stong 'bul/ dge tshul ma pu rtso dha ra dang tshin+ta ma ṇi dar khan e chi gnyis kyisabargya 'bul byung ba dge ba bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur rgyas btab cing bod sog lnga brgya skor dang phrad/ gong gi gser yig pa rnams mtsho kha bud mtshams nas gnas gsar ba mkhyen rab rnam rgyal 'ongs pa 'byor/ mer gan a kha'i/ da la'i pā thur/ yel deng no yon/ yu'i ching a kha'i/ dpon mo ma ga dha/ no yon u'i ching kha'i dge tshul ma/ dpon mo bsod nams sgrol ma bcasabadun brgya skor la spyan ras gzigs skyer sgang lugs/ 'jam dbyangs gtso rkyang / seng ldeng nagasasgrol gsum gyi rjes gnang dang rags bsdus la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ phyag drug pa'i byin rlabs bar chad kun (23na)sel rnams bskur/tshes bco lnga bcu drug la dge slong sum brgya dang nyer gcig /dge tshul brgya go drug rnams —31—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pobasgrubs/ da'i chin kho lo chis ja gos dar gtso bor gyur pa'i brgya 'bul bstar ba rnam mkhyen gyi ched du bsngos/ tshes bcu bdun la da'i ching kho lo chi/ /erge tha'i ji/ bstan pa bcas nyis brgya skor la thugs rje chen po skyer snang lugs kyi rjes gnang dang / tshe dbang grub rgyal ma bskur/ rdo rje brag rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku/ gra thang mkhan po/ rgyal mo che ba/ mtshur phu phyag mdzod can dang mjal phrad dang rdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku rin po cher nang rten phal cher lo rgyus zhib mo dang bcas rten mjal phul zhing rdzong bda' bzabs rgyas zhus/nyer gcig la che chen tha'i ji yum sras/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ tre bo hor tshang zhal ngo dgu /bla ma nam mkha' mdzod pa sogs bod sog nyis brgya skor dang phrad/ bya bral gu ru can gyis rta brgya dang brgyad/ ldan ma rag shi bas nyer dgu byung / 'di nyin nas bdun gnyis kyi bar rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen pa kha gso byas/ nged rang gi rim gror rdzong gzhis khag nas bka' 'gyur tshar nyis brgya bcu bzhi/ nyi khri sum brgya nyi shu/ mtshan brjod drug stong nga bzhi/ gdugs dkar ba ni khri bzhi brgya/ sgrol ma chig 'bum bdun khri brgyad stong drug brgya/ sher snying nyis 'bum chig khri drug brgya/ tshe gzungs brgyad 'bum dgu stong dgu brgya/ tshe chog khag bzhi/ rnam rgyal stong mchod khag gnyis/ yig drug dung gsum/ dmag zor ma'i bskang ba 'bum/ phyugs (23ba)lug sum brgya'i srog blu rnams dang sde pa'i sku rim la yum chen mo nyi khri brgyad stong pa gsum brgya rtsa re/ chos 'khor rgyal du mgon chos dmag zor ma gsum gyi bskang ba khri re/ bstan srid spyi rim la stong phrag brgya pa dang brgyad stong pa tshig khri re/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa drug /nyi khri gra lnga gser 'od gsum brgya rtsa re/ sman bla nyi khri dgu stong drug brgya/sgrol ma sa ya gcig dang sum khri brgyad brgya/ tshe gzungs lnga khri brgyad stong / 'bras spungs su mang ja sum cu/ se rar nyer brgyad/ dga' ldan du bco lnga'i thog gdugs dkar sum 'bum bdun khri bzhi stong bdun brgya/ sher snying sa ya gnyis drug 'bum lnga khri chig stong rnams bsgrubs/ yang dag snab mchod snga sor nyung bsdus la btsugs grub kyang slar tshogs chen la tshugs pa dgos tshul ltar gong dkar rdo rje 32

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gdan du zla ba bcu pa'i nyer gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i sgrub mchod kyi thebs la ya ju dmar 'degs khal drug nyag bzhi/ sna(ga bu/ spos reng / a ga ru nyag lnga gon snam gcig rnams lo lo bzhin gyi 'dzin dang / bse grong dgon dang byang thang bar gyi shas zhing khyar pa rang gnas thog kha rag thod phu nas mi ser dud 'dzin bdun lag yong sum brgya go gsum/ de mo bar mchod yon rim pa bzhin nas sa rigs bdag rkyen che nges yod rung bar khams phyogs kyi bla ma rnams phyogs lhung gi kun rtog shigs pas rta tshag sprul pa'i skur pag shod sbyar ba'i rkyen gyis don las kyang gtam gtso che ba'i bon po dang 'then 'khyer che ba 'di lo nas rtsa 'jags thog /gsar (24na)du lho rong rdzong 'og spar stod pa dang shog snga/ khang g.yul lte 'bum/ zhed rtse'i 'og nas se dmar ba/rgyu skar stod grong smad/ ri khrod pa/ brag shar/ nyi lung / spo shar/ grong gsum/ gnam gung sngon sa war dgon pa stongs shul/ gur ser rnams kyi dud 'dzin sum brgya drug cur lag 'bab drug brgya skor/ sbus srang gser khang par skyor lung spyil po'i sa tshab tu 'dul ba bla mas 'dzin shul gang skya rnams sbyor 'jags bgyis/rwa ba na mnga' ris pa bsod nams kyis drag po'i mdos/ grib sel don brgyad ma/ sa bdag skyasamados/ lha khrus gsang ba dgu skor/ gshed dmar gtor bzlog rnams bsgrubs/ ston mjug 'char can gyi dbus gtsang gi dgon rnams la ja sbyor gsum sprel dang a rmi dang por gzhor khal gsum re/gnyis par gnyis re yong ba'i dpus char gtsang khul la mo rgyan/ dbus khul la gser 'gyed kyi thog sgrol ma sher snying gang 'gro btang /hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes brgyad la bsam yas su tshogs chas spyan gzigs dang bcas dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa lung bstan zhu bar btang / tshes bcur dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis bka' 'gyur gsar du bzhengs par me tog 'thor ba dang phyogs mthun gzims chung brtan bzhugs dang bka' 'gyur de gra tshang la phul ba'i tshab ma zhig dgos tshul ltar sde par zhus nas —33—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (poganang /tshes bcu gcig la bstan 'dzin da las rgyal po yab yum sras mi bzang / rgyal po gong ma'i dbu skor chung ba (24bsgo ba la kha yu'i ching a kha'i gyi bsngo zhus pa/ da la'i hung tha'i ji sogs dang bar khams nas bkra shis pā thur tha'i ji'i mi sna/ 'brog sman skyong sprul sku/ ka tshal rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub/ stag rtse'i sde pa lha rgyal rab brtan/ lcam nor bu khra sgor rnams dang mjal zhing tshomasachen steng du bod sog stong phrag gnyis la byin rlabs bstar/ nus rim du rdo rje brag pa/ dga' ldan gsang sngags gling pa/ sna tshal zur pa/ smin grol gling pa/ brag sna ba/ gnas gzhi ba/ smra bo lcog pa/gong ra ba/ 'od mchog pa/ sna dkar rtse gsang sngags chos 'khor gling pa/ brag la ba/ sgrol phug pa/ yang lug /chu mig pa/ bkra bzang pa/ nub dgon pa/ brag dkar chu bzang pa/ dpal ri ba sogs kyis so so'i lugs bzhin dgra mnan smin rgyas bgyis/tshes bcu bzhi la de mo sprul pa'i skur paṇa zhus sna drangs pa'i na bza' cha tshang / rdor dril/sbug sil/ zhaX dkar/ dngul las grub pa'i zhal stegs/ bzed zhal/ 'kho gsil/ sdir bu/ lte ri/ tha phag /mdong mo/ lnga bcu ma/ gser sga/ gos dar/ snam phrug sogs spams mtho ba/ dbon por gos sna tshang ma sogs gang 'tsham gyis rdzong bda' zhus shing sprul sku dbon po spo bo sku skye gsum la dpal mgon zhal dang dmag zor ma'i bka' bsgo rgyas par phul/ phyag dpe thugs gnyer mdzad lugs kyi rgyu mtshan mol/mtsho sngon po nas da la'i khung tha'i ji sogs kyis 'di ga'i geg la dmigs pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrig (25na)par bu lod btang ba dga' ldan dar rgyas can dpon po kha shas kong por dmag la song ba dang bcas bod du yod pa thams cad 'dzom ma thub rung dpon po spyi sger gyis bton pa'i bdog par brten te tshogs chas 'gyed rnams 'grig nas gra tshang gis 'chi med 'od snang gi cho ga rgyas par mdzad thog dga' ldan rab 'byams pa dang rtse chen hung tha'i ji yod/ da la'i —34

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)hung tha'i jis lnga bcu ma drug /gser dngul gyi mdong mo/ ja gos dar gyis thog drangs pa dang dpon po gzhan rnams kyis kyang rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i ring du brkyang /'di nyin nas bzung brag dmar gyi sgrub zhag bdun bgyis/ gong gi mi sna rgan pa sbyor ra chi bla ma/ chung ba khi ya dbu mdzad/ 'di ga'i mi sna rtse tshogs mkhan chen dang gnas gsar nas/ o rod rgyal po'i mi sna/ 'grul sdebs ngo ma sum cu rtsa gsum bcas par ngos phrad dang mnyam du bzhes len gyi ston mo btang thog gong gi bka' lha(ga sprad pa blangs/nyer gsum la lha sa ba blo gros legs pa dang ngag dbang mkhas btsun gnyis kyis ster cha 'gyed bcas/ spyi 'bul snyan dar nyis brgya gong bcas spams mtho ba spel ba dang lhan du gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ kho pa gnyis kyi snyan dar dang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis snyan shal brgya skor phul ba'i smon lam/ spo bo sku skyes bskul nas nged rang dang sprul sku'i brtan bzhugs/ gnas gsar dbon rin po che a gi'i bsnyen chen gyi skabs mnal nyams su 'khrul (25bskong gi 'char sgo 'dra byung tshul phebs par bogs 'don gyi tshigs bcad/rnam gling paṇa chen dkon cog chos grags kyi ngor byang bdag rigs 'dzin sprul sku'i brtan bzhugs/spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtsho so thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i zha spungs rabs/ bdel shegs brgyad/ thub dbang la rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyis bskor ba'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos ldan gyis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam rnams bris/gong gi gser yig pa rgan gzhen/ tha yan che bla ma/ u chu mu chu chen ching dbang / rgya mtsho ching dbang /kha ra ching dbang / dur pa khu khu dbang / ba ri kha dar khan rnams kyi bla ma/ cho so 'phel dge slong gi dge rtsa byed mi sbar ra dge slong / bsam blo mer gan chos rje dang cha dkar dar khan chos rje'i dbon po/grags pa dge slong / rgya mtsho dge slong / mkhar sngon blo bzang dga' ba dang shi ral thu dbon po/ sar kha lang / jo stan e mchi/ byings gras e pa bla ma/ dbon po dar rgyas/ ser rab stims pa/ gro tshang —35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pochos rje/ grags pa rin cen/ tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ dkon cog rgya mtsho/ dge slong bsod nams rgya mtsho/ o pa shi/ a mdo dar khan nang so'i tsha bo sogs dang sang nyin ma gcig tha'i ji'i dge tshul ma g.yog bcas/ khal kha 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku'i mi sna dbang po rgyal mtshan dang bstan 'dzin/ thu shi ye thu rdo rje rgyal po'i mi sna bkra shis rnam rgyal dang ba ye spu khu lang / tsho pa bdun spyi'i mi sna dang tha'i ji sirnyi shrī/ pā thur tha'i (26na)ji/ che chen a kha'i/ mer gan hung tha'i ji/ tshin+ta ma ṇi tho yon/ er khe yel deng / er khe a kha'i/ ching kha hong tha'i ji/ u rang khan bing thuda'i ching / thu shi kho sho'u che/ zla ba grags pa/ yon dar dka' bcu/ dur gi chi'i mi sna sogs rgya sog rnams kyis so so'i ster cha gser dngul ja ras kyis thog drangs pa'i bzang stod dang yi ge bskur ma sogs sprad pa rtsis len gyi bkod pa byas/ mi nyag ri khud bla ma shākya kun dga'/ a jo rdzong gi bla ma/ gzhung 'gron tshong dpon/gdan sa gong 'og gi tshong pa can ldebs 'byar kha shas dang phrad/ri khud bla ma des khams phyogs su lam kyi 'bras sa gtsos pa'i chos kyi 'gro don 'phel zhing gser mdog can pa la lar rtag brtan pa'i tshos thebs pa'i brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin lhur len pa dang mi 'dra ba'i snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan don du gnyer bas mtshon dpyod ldan du snang / che chen tha'i ji yum sras/ thu med da'i ching kho lo chi yab sras can nyis brgya skor la phyag drug pa'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs dang mi lhag ri khud bla ma/ 'dar pa rje drung blo gsal bstan 'dzin/ zhabs drung nor bu khra sgor rnams la 'jam dkar shes rab 'khor lo/ spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra/ klu dbang gi rgyal po gsum gyi rjes gnang phul/ ngor gong dkar chos sde/ bkra shis chos sde sogs sa lugs ci rigs dang sngags bon bcas pa khag nyi shu rtsa dgus gtore bzlog /dge lugs la ja lnga re/ sa lugs la bzhi re btang ba'i mdo sgrub dang gtor bzlog gzhi dgon bshad gra ba (26bskobs sbyar nas mthug tu tshogs zangs kha 'byo bar mdzad/hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis la lha ldan bsnyen gnas ma rnams kyis bsdus pa'i rnyed pa dang —36

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)bcas gzims chung brtan bzhugs kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs/ rnam gling paṇa chen dang gsung rab gling pa dka' bcu rgyal mtshan dar rgyas kyi don du gdugs dkar gyi sgrub thabs rdo rje pha lam/ sngags ban ngag dbang rgya mtsho'i kha rtan du snar thang brgya rtsa nas bshad pa'i mi 'khrugs pa gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs ngan 'gro kun 'gegs/ khro chu dug sdong gi rgyun 'byer spu gri 'bar ba/ zha lur cho 'phrul mchod par sgrub mchod gsar btsugs kyi bca' yig shel dkar me long / rtses dang dpal grong sngag rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyi 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i dkar chag /gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gyis rgya can zhal thang dang / ngas pa blo bzang chos ldan gyis 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag bzhengasapa'i rgyab yig /'phan yul bco brgyad pa'i brgyud nyag phra bar da lta'i dbon chung de gegs las grol zhing bstan par phan pa dang / rab stims pa dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi don du dge gzhen blo gros brtan pas bskul ba'i smon lam/ rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku'i bzhed pa ltar e waṃ lcog sgar dang stag lung gsang sngags chos 'khor du 'dzugs pa'i smon lam rnams bris/ gzhu tshang sku 'dun lhun grub dang dga' ldan gsang sngags gling slob dpon par ja gral btang zhing lcags la rab 'byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyis gra tshang gi zhal 'don shog bu lnga brgya skor gyi rgyugs sprad/ 'di (27na)ga'i rim gror phag mo chos sde bas tshe gzungs sa ya drug /sde pa'i sku rim la thar pa gling pas pad+ma bka' thang dang thang yig sde lnga tshar lnga brgya re sgrogs/tshes nyi shur rtogs brjod po ti dang po/ dkar chag che brjod kyi 'phros/ gshed dmar mngon dkyil/dri med bshags rgyud/ gsang snying rtsa ba/ thang yig shel brag ma/ mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi sdom gsum rnam nges/ sgom bde'i 'brug lan dang dus 'khor gyi phyi nang rnam gzhag /sprul sku 'phrang kha ba'i mchod rten sku gzugs thig rtsa rnams kyi par 'byor/nyer gnyis nas bdun gcig gi bar rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen pa kha gso dang nyin gsum la khro mo sme brtsegs kyi bzlas brjod bgyis/—37

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (podagung lo re gcig par ris med 'dus sde khag nas bstan srid spyi dang bod khams bde thabs kyi rim gro dang / kha che paṇa chen lugs kyi bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bskyar du bzhes pa sogs kyi skor/lo mthug gi dus rim le tshan dang / dmar ser can zhes pa me sbrul gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i srid gsum bdag mo mchod cing nyin dang por khal kha o rod kyi dpon khag dang lo gsar 'bul mi gtso bor gyur pa/ nyin gnyis par rin cen rgyan cha ba sogs sngar 'byud bzhin rgyas par bstar/tshes bzhi la khal kha dpon khag rnams la ngos phrad thog a pa la'i gyi dpon mo tshe ring gis hu ja khor drug ma bzhi bcus gtsos gser dngul gos dar sogs brgya phrag gi dngos po spel/tshes lnga la no mun u'i ching dge tshul mas yon gyi bdog pa gya nom pa sbyar te dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ nyi ma phyi ma tshor bya khyung chos rje ye shes rgya mtshos keg la dmigs nas dngos po ched bstad (27ba)bskur ba/ gnas gsar dbon mkhyen rab rnam rgyal/ dan 'bag blo bzang dbang rgyal gsum gyis gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i rten 'brel dang dbang rgyal gyis gra tshang du snyan shal drug cu skor phul ba'i smon lam/khal kha ngag dbang bstan 'phel ma bu gsum dang / rdo pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis bskul ba'i rgyal gsol/ gcung kun dga' tshul khrims kyi ngor gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po'i brtan bzhugs/ lha bris pa legs pa rgyal mtshan dang gzims shag lho pa so sos bskul ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/gram pa blo bzang ngag dbang gi dge skos 'jog tu dngul srang bcu bzhi las grub pa'i pad ster kha byang rnamasabartsams/ mnyan yod mchod pa'i tshes bcu gcig la dge 'dun stong phrag brgyad brdal par gzhung gral gra pa bcu rer ya ju bar khag re/ mtha' gral lnga rer 'go bkag re/ tshes bstobasnyo gzhung —38—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gral la gra pa rer bur nyag lnga re/ mtha' gral la bzhi re bsdoms ltang tse lnga brgya dang bdun song /bco lngar mtha' dbus med par dge 'dun rer dngul zho do re 'bab rtsis kyi rung gos gtos che ba'i spong dag /lha sa/ ra mo che/ po ta la gsum gyi sku rten rnams la gser chab/ lha sar ngan slong rnams la zas gos kyi sbyin pa/ phyugs lug brgya rtsa brgyad kyi srog blu/ tha shi bo lod/ che chen tha'i ji/a pa la'i gyi dpon mo tshe ring / er te ni ja'i sang sogs bco lnga skor la yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa/ 24rnga pa/tshes bcu drug la no mun yu'i ching gi dge tshul ma/ yel deng no yon/ da la'i pā (28na)thur/u'i ching a kha'i/ pu rgya tā ra/ mer gan a kha'i/ no mun khan chos rje so gos la bka' bsgo/ mdud pa/byin rten/ gos chas/ shal dkar dmar/ snam phrug sogs kyi ster cha/ bla ma/ sman pa/ bal po/ lha bris pas mtsho ni 'dod don mtha' dag bkang ste rdzong bda' bgyis/ jo stan mkhan po/ grong smad dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mo/ sngags mkhar slob dpon sogs la ja gral btang /tshes bcu bdun la rgya nag mi sna gzhon pa 'grul sdebs dang bcas pa gtsang nas 'khor ba dang /rgyud r+sā smad kyi chos rje rnam gnyis/ rong byams wo slob dpon pa/ bon lung pa/ snyemado ba/ shag lho pa'i rab 'byams pa sogs dang phrad/ u chu mu chu che chen ching dbang gi༄la jo'i thu tha bu nang tshangs spyod dge bsnyen du bsgrubs pa'i ming ngag dbang rin cen du btags/ 'di pa dkon cog gsum dang 'di gar dad pa thun mong ma yin pa zhig snang ba bzang po'i las sad pa'i skal ldan zhig yin pa 'dra snyam/tshes nyi shur gzhung gral gra pa brgyad re dang mtha' gral gra pa bcu rer srang re bsdoms srang brgyad brgya lnga bcu song / bcu bdun nas smon lam ma grol bar dgongs rdza 'phar ma btang ste lho kong gi gtso bo rnams kyi ming gsal steng mdo sgrub 'gro gang che dang / dgu gtor yang shar phyogs su gtor kha bsgyur zhing tshogs chen gyis mdo sgrub dang bcas tshogs khro zhal sbub mdzad pas nus pa che —39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (keb byung / khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos deng nas bzung ji srid bstan pa rin po che nam gnas bar rnal 'byor (28ba)rgyud kyi bstan pa nyams pa gsob dang / rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan khu dbon/ sgrub khang mkhan chen dpal ldan don grub gsum gyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs dang / khyad par 'di ga'i ring 'tshor dmigs thugs bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas dpal zha lu gser bkang gi chos grar cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar yo ga'i dkyil 'khor bcu gsum/ tshar lugs kyi 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ 'di ga'i brtsams chos gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi mchod pa rgyal bstan 'dzad med nor bu/ dgon shar nub gnyis nas bka' brgyad rnams 'dzugs gnang gi chos gzhis dgos tshul gyi rten spams mtho ba dang bcas phebs pa dang blangs kyis pa nam dgon pa lho/ dar rgyas chu rags/ smon tsho tor khungs bcas pa'i gzhis ka mi ser dud 'dzin bstodagu /lag yong nyis stong nyis brgya so gnyis thon khungs/ gzhis rtse nas lo star ngo sprod ya ju dang sha shan 'dres pa khal sum cu so dgu lhag bco lnga/ bu ram khal bcu nyag gsum rnams sbyor 'jags zhus/gra phyi bye rdzing tsho gis pas bka' 'gyur tshar drug sgrogs/ 'ba' chos sde sngar phan dar rgyas che ba med 'dug pa 'di lo nas bzung ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar lo 'khor du dge 'dun sum brgya skor ngo yod la phogs bsnon bcas zla rer mkha' ru'i 'bru khal re dang nyin star bzhes thug 'phar ma re/ cho 'phrul dang sa ga zla ba so sor bka' 'gyur ro cog 'gro gang che sgrog pa'i ja thug sogs gsung sgrog pa gzhung dpe 'gre yong ba byas/'di lo nas bzung mdzo sgang du hor zla dang po/ gnyis (29na)pa/ gsum pa/ bcu pa ste bzhir nye skor dge lugs dgon tsho bsdus chig brgya bcu gcig gis zla gcig bar bka' 'gyur 'gro gang che'i gsung sgrog yon zhabs tog spyi 'gro ji srid bar btsugs/ nyer gsum la gra sa phan tshun gyi slob dpon dge skos dbu mdzad gra skor ba rnams ja bral bto / nyer lngar dga' ldan khri rin po che/ dung dkar sku skye/ khams pag shod bla ma/ stag lung ka drug bla ma sogs dang phrad/—40

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (rje/nyer bdun la pha bong kha'i gdan sa pa/ rgyal mo bsod nams chos 'dzoms/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ snye nang dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling slob dpon pa/ klungs shod dpal 'bar bla ma/ phun tshogs bla ma mi bzang gnyis dang bcas pas u chu mu chu che chen ching dbang gis ring 'tshor gser bre/ dngul bre/ ber/ ja gos dar sogs dngos po gtos che bskur ba bteg /dga' ldan rab 'byamasapa/ dpon mo bsod nams sgrol ma/ tre bo dpon u'i ching no yon sogs mi ngo brgyad bcas la mdud pa/ gon pa cha tshang re/ shal dkar dmar/ snam phrug /rta sga 'khor/ bur ltang sogs rdzong ba bzabs/ dga' ldan rab 'byams pa dang dpon mo bsod nams sgrol ma ma bu dang bcas par mgon po'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel bka' bsgo sogs lugs gnyis nas re ba bkang /nyer brgyad la sa skyong lha rgyal rab brtan/ thu med da'i ching kho lo chi/ ma gcig tha'i ji'i dpon mo/ mer gan ji nong gi dpon mo bsod nams dpal bzang / mnga' (29ba)ris gra tshang gi gnyer pa/ sprul sku rgyal bzang pa rnams la ja gral bgyis shing jo nong dpon mor bka' bsgo byas/ gnam gang la mtshal zhabs drung grags pa dang phrad/hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la ngag dbang 'phrin las nang mi dang bcas pas dkar dro dang tshan grangs spel/ tshes gnyis la nges gsang rdor gling pa gra bcas kyis tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i cho ga dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs khrod gong dkar sngags 'chang gnas chung pa'ang yod/ phyi dro chos rje thub bstan pa'i tsha bo dang bcas dge tshul bcu gnyis bsgrubs/tshes gsum la 'phyong rgyas pa blo bzang thugs rjes smon lam gyi gra skor sngon 'gror gra tshang gi 'don cha shog bu sum brgya drug gi rgyugs sprad/ tshes bzhin stag lung phyag mdzod dbu ma pa zha lu ri sbug chos khri'i rgya phibs kyi gser gsol do dam par brdzangs/ 'di ga'i rim gror rdzong gzhis khag kha shas su bka' 'gyur chig brgya nyi shu/ brgyad stong pa chig stong / gser 'od dang klu 'bum brgya tshar re/ sman bla lnga khri/ tshe chog khag lnga/ sāts+tsha 'bum ther/ yig drug ther 'bum gnyis/ dga' ldan gsang sngags spro/1—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('agling du phye ring dang trig khrom ma bye ba re/ 'phyong rgyas rdzong gi ldebs zhal du gshed dmar gyi bris sku khru gang bzhengs shing skyes lha yul lha gsol/ khro rol khag ga rjeg /bsam yas dang khra 'brug gnyis su mchod pa sna lnga brgya tshar/ gser chab/ snyan shal/ 'phrul snang du brgya mchod sna lnga/ de dang ra mo che po ta la gsum por khrus gsol/ chab gtor 'bum (30na)ther/ phyugs lug brgya'i srog blu/ gi dang gi dgra mnan gnyis/ klu sbug tu klu mchod dang klu gta' bsdams/ 'phrang zam kha shas zhig pa bsos/ dpal gsol brgya tshar/ rgyal du dmag zor ma'i bskang bshags 'bum ther/ bsil tshal du gur zhal dang beg tser khri/ mthil du phyag drug pa las gshin rnam sras so sor stong rtsa re/ ri mthil gyi chos srung spyir brgya tshar/ dbus gtsang gi ris med dgon ang dang gnyis gsum pa tshang mar dpyid mang 'gyed sgrigs ma'i ang dang por 'gyed dge 'dun rer gzhor khal gsum re/ gnyis par gnyis re/gsum par re'i rtsis/ zhal 'don dge lugs rnams kyis gdugs dkar/ de phyin thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sher snying / tshe gzungs rnams 'gro gang che/ pha bong khar zla gnyis zhag nyer lnga'i bar dge slong sum cu rtsa gsum gyis rigs gsum mgon po'i gzungs star chags/ sde pa'i rim gror rgyas 'bring bsdus pa/ gser 'od/ thang yig gsum brgya phrag re/ mtshan brjod tshig khri/ tshe gzungs sum 'bum/ sāts+tsha dang chab gtor 'bum ther re/ phyugs lug lo grangs kyi srog blu/ bstan srid spyi'i jus rim du 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum tshar bco lnga/ bskal bzang chig stong / sman bla lnga stong / gdugs dkar chig khri/ sgrol sher tshe gzungs gsum 'bum phrag re/ khro rol lnga/ lha sar dpa' bo dpa' mo'i khrus gsol/ nye skor mchod khang brgyar mchod pa sna lnga re/ bsam yas (30ba)dang khra 'brug gnyis su dar chen re/ rdzong gzhis rnams nas yul khams la rnam 'a rdzoms dang sme brtsegs kyi khrus gsol/ bsangs/ dgra lha dpangs bstod/ ri 'go mtho sar dar lcog mang po 'dzugasabacug /sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs/ blo bzang mkhyen brtsegasum tshe bdag /blo bzang mthu stobs dang blo bzang bkra shis gnyis log tri/ ngag dbang tshul khrims bka' —42

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)brgyad/ ngag dbang yid bzhin dang nam mkha' rgya mtsho gnyis phur pa/ byams pa skal bzang yang gsang rkarma drag po rnams kyi bsnyen dmigs khrid nas mtshams byed du bcug /tshes bdun la 'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub kyis dge sbyor rten nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam/ bde chen tha'i ji bsres pa/ da la'i o pa shi'i bsngo rten skyel mi/ da rgan bla ma sogs kyis bsngo rten dang sger 'bul dngul ja gos dar sogs spams bstod/tshes bcur lcam nor bu khra sgor dang byang gling pa so so nas yon sbyar te gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung thog lcam nor bu khra sgor gyis tshe dpag med kyi sku/ sku rgyan gyi shal dkar po/ gser gyi nyag thag sogs yod dgu bteg /tshes bcu gcig rjes mar drung yig dar rgyas bkra shis kyis gos sna cha tshang bdog pa'i skyes 'gyed bcas sbyar nas ring por 'tsho ba'i thabs tshul snga ma dang 'dra/ er khe chos rje mtsho kha nas slebs pa'i ster sbyin byung zhing sprul sku gter bdag gling pas mkha' 'gro grib sel mdzad/tshes bcu gnyis (31na〉la rgya nag gi mi sna 'grul sdebs dang bcas par ja gral btang zhing lcam nor bu khra sgor la dngos po du ma dang bcas rdzong bda' zhus/ mchod dpon pas snyan dar thags su bskrun rgyu'i smon lam/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po'i dgongs bzhed ltar smin grol gling gi rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bzhengs gegs med grub pa'i dkar chag smon lam rgyas pa/ u chu mu chu chen ching dbang gis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs dang sde brgyad kyi gnod pa bsrung ba'i tham ka /dbang gi o pa shi ngag dbang rin cen gyi ngor 'jam dbyangs chos skor nas nang sgrub la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bsam blo chos rgya mtshos bskul ba'i yi dam chos srung la brten pa'i smon lam rnams bris/tshes bcu gsum la gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog smin rgyas mdzad grub nas gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon gra bcas dang phrad/ tshes bcu bzhir dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis yon sbyar te tshe dpag med dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi sgrub khag gcig dang gra dmangs kyis a 43—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('ati khyuḥgacig ma'i sgrub pa bdun gcig btsugs rjes tshan grangs du ma brkyang ste gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i ring por 'tsho thabs grub nas sgrol dkar tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i nyams len tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun nang bzhin bdun phrag gi bar bcad rgya dam por bgyis pas rtags kyang legs pa byung /tshes nyi shur lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug /yum bu/ yer pa/ ka tshal/ mkho mthing /gtsang 'gram/ (31ba)grom pa rgyang rnams su tsho gis brgya/ 'phyong rgyas su rje bdud btsan par gsol mchod/ rdzong che khag nyi shur bsangs dang dgra lha dpangs bstod/ lha sar sgo 'gyed dud drug rer ya ju bar khag re'i rtsis khyon khor drug ma nga bzhi dang / ngan slong gang yod la ja gsil ma phon ches dbul ba bsal/ nyer gcig gnyis tshor sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen por dbang lung kha shas zhus/nyer gsum la brag gdong chos mdzad blo bzang tshe dbang gis smon lam gra skor btang ba'i dusagra tshang du dngul kong phul ba'i kha byang / gong ma rgyal por 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig /gnas gsar dbon mkhyen rab blo ldan gyi don du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar rin 'byung brgyas bskor ba'i rgyab yig smon lam/ 'phyos pa nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i ngor gsol 'debs rnams brtsams/nyer lngar 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling par chos yon gser srang gsum/ dngul lnga bcu ma/rgya sbug khyad 'phags/ ja gos dar sogs gtos che ba dbul te rang gi bste gnas su chibs kha bskyod/ nyer bdun la rgya nag mi sna 'grul sdebs dang bcas par sman bla sprul sku mtho brtsegs/ skyer snang lugs kyi spyan ras gzigs/ sgrub brgya'i nang gi rnam rgyal ma gtso rkyang rnams kyi rjes gnang dang /rgyud stod zhal snga nas/ u chu mu chu chen ching dbang gi o ba shi gnyis sogs la 'jam dbyangs chos skor nas nang sgrub kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs bskur/ dpon mo bsod nams sgrol ma bu bcas/ khal kha yel deng no yon sogs la ja gral btang zhing snga mar bar gcod mi 'jug pa'i bka' (32na)bsgo bgyis/ phyi dro gong gi mi sna 'grul sdebs bcas pa/ bo dong 'chi med sprul sku/ snying ri gdan sa pa/—44—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gdung brgyud rnams dang phrad/nyer brgyad la nges gsang rdor gling gi gra pa blo bzang chos stong gis gsang ba snying po'i rtsa rgyud kyi rgyugs sprad/ rnam gling paṇa chen dkon cog chos grags/ sngags ram pa ngag dbang dpal bzang /gong gi gser yig gzhen pa blo bzang sbyin pa sogs bsnyen rdzogs brgya nyi shu/ dge tshul chig brgya zhe bzhi/ dge bsnyen drug rnams la sdom pa phab/ u chu mu chu che chen ching dbang gi de shi khi yas srog mi gcod pa'i dam bca' blangs/nyer dgur khal kha g.yon ru no yon khu thug thu dang rgya dung pad+ma'i nang tshang sogs la ja gral btang / gnam gang gi shogs u chu mu chu che chen dbang gi de shi khi ya dang bo ro khri ya can drug sogs la yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa 'bebs pa lag ris mthong tsam na phab tshar ba dgos pa len pa po rnams yong 'phyis gshis sngon 'gro'i chos bshad rgyas par ma thub kyang phab grub nas bslab brjod sogs la blang dor chod nges kyi rim pa bshad/ gung tshigs kyi thog gong gi mi sna 'grul sdebs dang bcas pa/ 'di ga'i mi sna gzhen pa rta 'bul dbon chung / bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po'i mi sna da yan ja'i sang sogs la ston mo bzabs rgyas thog mdud pa dam rdzas gon pa cha tshang re/ snam phrug sogs so sor go babs ma log pa'i rdzong bda' bgyid skabs gser yig gzhen pa blo bzang sbyin pas rten la gzungs (32ba)'bul tshul dang rab gnas skor la dri bar sngon chad phyogs der 'di rigs rnam dag ma byung 'dra'ang gang 'tsham gyi lan btab cing / bla chen tsho ni rdzong bzung nas 'bug 'bug mi snang ba'i tshod na 'di gas gleng bslang ba rang ngo mtshar che snyam pa byung / de mtshams khal kha mer gan a kha'i thon gdong la bka' bsgo dang g.yon ru mer gan bla mas rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gser sku gra tshar dngos gtsang sprad byung bar phar gos sna gsum dang / spu ja sbag sogs byin cing bka' bsgo byas/hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig la lha sa spus srang pa dang dmigs brtse ma so so nas tshan grangs dang 45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (geyon sbyar te gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa spel/ de mtshams thod ri bshad sgrub gling bla ma gra bcas brgya lhag gis dngos po spams mthor bteg ste nyi bu'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i bden tshig rgyasapar brjod/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang bskur/ slob dpon pas 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i nyams len skor la dog gnas kyi dri ba byed par so sor lan btab cing gnad 'gag rang la dri ba byed par mi gda'/ zhad ston ri khrod pa rim gro grub nas phrad par 'phros gleng zhib pa byung / phyi dro tha shi bo lod/sems dpa' chen po'i sprul sku/ byams chen slob dpon nga phod pa/ rigs 'dzin stobs ldan dbang po'i slob ma la stod gra ma lung bla ma/ brag gdong rgyal phur rnams la ja gral dang / brag dbar gra tshang brgya skor sogs bod sog skya ser sum brgyar byin rlabs dang / o pa shi ngag dbang rin cen pha bu 'dod pa bzhin rkang par mgo bo gtug tu bcug /tshes gnyis la gong gi mi (33na〉sna 'grul sdebs bcas pa spyi bsdus kyis tshogs chas tshan grangs 'gyed kyi yon sbyar te gra tshang gis rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i byang gter tshe dpag med longs sku ma'i tshe chog rgyas par btang / tshes bzhir 'jam dbyangs chos rjes bskul ma mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / shar khang no mun khan gyi brtan bzhugs/ u chu mu chu che chen ching dbang gi de shi dang bo ro'i ngor smon lam/ gra phyi smon grub pa rin cen bkra shis kyis bskul ba'i byang gter thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi nyams len dang 'brel pa'i smon lam/ skyid thang nor bu'i ngor seng ldeng nags sgrol dang bla ma tha mi dad pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam rnams bris/tshes lngar se chen dbon pos rung mthun gyi gos cha 'grig /gser srang gang gis gtsos pa'i dgu tshan brgyad/ rta dpon rnam 'joms kyis dngul lnga bcu mas gtsos pa'i dgu tshan drug /so sos 'gyed sogs yon sbyar nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs kyi ring 'tsho bstar ba grub nas lha ldan tshes bcu ba khag gis tshan grangs bteg ste yun 'tsho'i tshigs bcad shis brjod kyis mtha' brten/ o pa shi ngag dbang rin cen gyi bu ba yan gyis srog gcod dang ma sbyin len spong ba'i dam bca' blangs/ brgyad gtor —46

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)chen mo'i dus rim bzabs rgyas su btang pa'i mu 'thud nyin gsum gyi bar thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i bskang bshags btang /tshes bcu gcig la sde pa'i rim gror srong btsan du dpal ri bas ma ning gi bskang bshags dang dri med bshags rgyud brgya tshar re/ thus rim (33ba tshe pa khro rol slang gang ma/ nyi zla dmar mdangs che ba brtag par ngan pa rang ma shar kyang rnam rtog byed mi 'dug pa sel byed du rdzong gzhis tshang ma nas phyogs bcu mun sel stong phrag re sgrogs/ nub gling dar dar 'das pa'i rigs brgyud med gshis sman grong dang bsdoms dud chung bcu bzhi lag yong ha lam stong tsam thon tshod lha sa gra phyi shag gi nang bcas grong smad du sbyor 'jags byas/ kun mkhyen bu'i bstan par bsams ri sbugs bzhugs khri'i steng gser zangs las grub pa'i rgya phibs bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa bskrun/ snye nang du snga sor mchod yul rnam dag med par brten bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i ched gra rnying sdom gtsang rnams kyi thog de khul nas tho btsun brgyab pa'i gra grangs bdun cu tham pa'i slob dpon par shel dkar chos sde'i gra pa dkon cog rnam rgyal dang / gnyer pa rong thang spe ba bskos pa'i zhal 'don sman bla'i mdo chog /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ phyag drug pa/ rnam sras ser chen/ dmag zor rgyal mo dang bcas pa'i cho ga bskang gso gtsor brtan gyi sngags gra dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling gsar du btsugs par mchod rdzas rol cha/ yol ba bla bre/ ja tshul thebs kyi tshong pa dang ru ba sogs phyi nang gi sprod tshang ma rgya mi chung ba/ tshul sgrub mchod phogs gtong sgo rnams chos sde gsar btsugs byings las bzang stod yong ba'i chos gzhis su legs shing mo bran rang 'jags thog rtsar ma/ la phyi ba'i bkra shis sgang / shel dkar khul nas sga ra/ yol gdong / mtshams mda'/sa lha/ lung mo/ (34na)phu ri rnams bsdoms dud 'dzin brgya dang bco brgyad/ dud chung rdo thabs dgu bcas par lag yong sum stong brgyad brgya nyer da yi thon khul rnams sbyar/tshes bcu gsum nas bzung nyin gsum par lho kong mi srun sgyu dra'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal 47—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (poba'i gtang rag chos srung spyi bye brag la btang ba'i tshe tshigs bcad bkod pa'i snyan shal rgyas par phul/ rta dpon rnam 'joms/ 'tsho byed sgo mo rag pa/ blo bzang rab brtan so so'i ngor ring la'i tshigs bcad re brtsams/tshes bcu bzhir sa'i tshangs pa bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po sras gnyis se chen dbon po bcas par rnam 'joms kyi bkru byab srung gsum/ tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster brgya tshar/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur/ gong steng mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ a pa la'i gyi dpon mo/ gsang sngags mkhar bla zur sogs la ja gral/ rgya nag 'grul sdebs tha yang chi dang o pa shi ngag dbang rin cen pha bu 'tshe ba las skyob pa'i bka' bsgo bstar/ phyi dro byams gling mkhan po mi sna gzhen pa dang snying ri gdan sa ba gdung brgyud bcas pa dang phrad/tshes bco lngar gong ma'i mi sna rgan gzhen 'grul sdebs bcas par 'gro gdong gi byin rlabs dang bka' bsgo byas/ da'i ching kho lo chi 'khor bcas la mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar gcod kun sel/ bde grol nam mkha' rgyal mtshan mched/ dpon mo bsod nams tshe dbang dang / er khe da'i ching gi mi sna sogs dang phrad cing mes ston pas rigs 'dzin rgod ldem gyi zang zang lha brag gi gter (34ba〉pa'i gtso phur/ thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sku zhugs la phul dus dbu bam ril byon pa/ dbu ral sogs byin byung bar chas rgyal byang pa'i dus la cha bzhag gi drag btsan 'khri med lha sde dkar por gnas pa'i gtan tshigs dang ngam ring rdzong nas bstan pa nam gnas bar lo rer gzhor 'debs nas khal brgya re'i 'dzin/ rta dang ja khor drug ma sogs kyi bdag brkyen bgyis/lcags la rab 'byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub shangs ri bo dge 'phel gyi mkhan por rdzong bda'i sngon 'gror kho pa dang bsnyen rdzogs dgu /dge tshul brgyad bsgrubs/ de'ang glang stag tsam nas thog mar mig g.yon mi gsal ba dang rjes su g.yas kyang rim par mi bde bar mig rtsa rnams gtar zhing phyi nas rgya mo chu 'byed dang khong sman mu khyud 'dzin lugs/ gsal byed sum cu pa btang bas zla ba re gnyis bar 48—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gsal du 'gro ba dang yang star chags byung ba lho brag snyan brgyud chad du nye ba mkhas grub mgon po mdzes pa'i dbang phyug la sprul sku gter bdag gling pas gsan par phebs pa spyan mi gsal bas thob re mi 'dug tshul gsung ba de rigs la gser tshugs sogs bcos ka 'gro bas dar mo sman rams par tho gang zhib byed bcug pa'i nang bzhin gnyal rang du tshugs brgyab pas lung yongs rdzogs mdzad thub byung ba dang / khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po'ang spyan mi gsal bar dar mo bas tshugs phul bas bde zhing gsal ba ljags lung mang po zhu thub pa'i yid ches yod gshis nged rang la'ang rgyab na snyam dar mo bas ltag pa gnyis mtshog ma gnyis te mig gi sgo bzhi rnams bsdams shing gsal byed sman mar sogs bsten pas zla ba kha shas bar shin tu gsal (35na)ba byung rung / phugs 'grib la sogs kyi 'byed dgos shig yong bas mig la sman sogs kyi'ang phan pa e yong re zhing dar mo ba de skabs mig 'byed la mkhas par grags pa bod pa 'tsho byed gnas lugs/ rgya gar ba go ta la dang / ma na ho bcas par dpyad gang legs bslab bcug /gzhan ma mig sman sogs kyis phan gnod che ba ma byung / 'debs sman chu bcir byed pa zhig 'dug pa sde pa a bar gyis rgya gar ba'i 'di yul dus kyis mi 'jug gleng yang dar mo bar ā tsar+shas mig la shin tu phan tshul byas pa ltar nyin kha shas bsten pas mig lcibs bskrangs shing tsha rdog sogs byung / de rjes 'grib smin pa lta bu'i gsal ba ye med du song ste tshogs sogs la bzed zhal rtsad ma chod par sbar myul bgyis pas gra pa rnams mig chu 'don dgos pa zhig byung ba/ mthug po sbo ma tsha rdog mig gnyis spang / zhes pa'i mig ris dang lo'ang lus la dgra ngar spar kha li la babs zhes lo dang nad kyis btab pa min pas mtshon 'grib rang yang / dus 'das rgyal mo'i mthu nyams dbye mi rung / zhes sogs kyis skyon mi 'dug pas/ tshes bcu dgu nas bsnyen mtshams kyi bcad rgyar bsnyad sngon 'gror gang dgos kyi rim gro sogs bsgrubs pa'i nyer gcig gi nyin gza' skar 'phrod sbyor klu rigs ldan sogs gtsug lag ltar sde pa a bar legs par brtsi bcug nas dus dge ba'i snga dro shar bltas lo mthun g.yog gis bsten/ zhes pa ltar grong smad a bar dang 49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gemachod dpon pas rogs byas dar mo bas dam bdar bgyis pa'i tshe dpyad lam du (35ba 'gro ba'i rtags ngo mtshar ba shar don bzhin mig gnyis ka phye bas gsal bar byung zhing / de nas lus drang por bsrang ba'i kun spyod bshad pa dang mthun pa dang mthun pa byas pa'i zhag gsum song mtshams jo bo lo ke shwa ra gdan drangs mig dgab bsal te bltas pas 'phags pa'i sku rgyan chas kyis mtshon phra rags kun gsal por mthong byung / zhag bcu skor nas dreg ro 'phar pa rim par bde/tshes nyi shur mchod dpon pas gsang sngags pho brang gi gnam rgyan yongs rdzogs la ding phon/bum gdan ma/ hor gos sogs khyad mtshar/ nged rang gi khri'i khebs/ snye 'bol/ bla bres phul ba'i smon lam lo tshan gsum/ chos mdzad skal ldan na bar gnas chung du 'bul rgyu'i snyan shal kha yig /gzhisaka shar pas lha ldan du 'phan phul ba'i kha byang rnams bris/nyer dgu'i dkar po nam gru'i 'grub sbyor nas gegs sel du zla gcig zhag nyi shu'i bar gra sa phan tshun so sor nyin rer ja tshul re'i thog gdugs dkar dang sher snying tshar gsum re bsdoms lnga 'bum brgyad khri brgyad stong dang brgya song ba'i mjug 'gyed la dge 'dun bcu rer ya ju khor drug re/ gtang rag tu dpal lha lcog dang gnas chung du gsol mchod/ snyan dar/ spyan gzigs sogasabazabs rgyas phul/ dga' ldan bshad snab gling pasang 'tsho spel zhen khyams rar sman bla chig khri sum stong bzhi brgya dgu bcu/ gdugs dkar rig stong dgu brgya lnga bcu/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig nyi khri nyi shu/ sher snying nyi khri nyis stong brgyad brgya nyi shu/ lha sa/ ra mo che/ po ta la bcas pa'i mchod (36na)khang la spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ brgya mchod sne lnga/ gser chab/ snyan shal/ smon lam rnam gsum gang 'gro/ sde ba'i rim gror gdugs dkar tshig khri lnga stong sum brgya/ tshe gzungs nyi khri drug brgya/ sgrol ma nyis stong bdun brgya sum cu/ sher snying chig stong bdun brgya/ lha sa'i sog dmangs mi grangs tshig stong bdun brgyar ja 'gyed mi rer ya ju mkhar nyag gsum re rnams kyis tshogs bsags/ lha sar phan bde legs bshad gling pa/ bsam yas su dge ba'i dbang po sogs gong dkar chos sde ba/ khra 'brug —50

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)tu gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po sogs so sor grangs bcas kyis dam tshig sems dpar ye shes pa'i tshogs mtha' klas pa bstim rkyen gyis 'jig rten khams kyi bde thabs/ dga' ldan du ja tshul bco lngar sher snying dgu khri brgyad stong lnga brgya/ bod 'brog sogs skye bo'i tshogs mtha' dag la dud rer 'bru gshor khal re zi ba'i skam 'gyed/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug /yum bu gsum du snyan shal/gser chab/ 'phyong rgyas lu ma dang / ra mo che'i klu rgyal so sor klu gtor chig khri sum stong sum brgya nyi shu re/ khyams rar gsang sngags byang chub gling pas khye ring dang trig khrom ma 'bum phrag re/ dbus gtsang ris med dgon ang dang gnyis so sor mang ja sbyor sbrel/ ser 'bras dge gsum gyi dge 'dun lnga rer dngul srang re/ de phyin ang dang gnyis khyad med gra pa bcu rer dngul srang re'i 'gyed thog dge lugs rnams kyis gdugs dkar dang gzhan ma thams cad kyis sgrol sher tshe gzungs 'gro gang che/lha sar dud bcu gnyis rer nag (36ba)po bar khag re'i sgo 'gyed/ lo mnyam kha longs sbrul lo pa bsnan pa'i brgya lhag la ston mo 'gyed bcas/ 'phyong rgyas su bkra shis bde chen pa bzhi sder sman bla'i rgyun 'dzugs yod thog zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bdun nas ji srid bskal pa'i bar ri bo bde chen pa bzhi gra zhig spar ba'i brgyad gras sman bla'i rgyun btsugs/sde pa'i rim gror yer par sāts+tsha chig 'bum chig khri sum stong lnga brgya/ sgrol ma chig khri brgyad stong /sher snying sum stong / lha sa'i shar du rab byung sum cur mar khu dang mar lhor mon pa'i mi sum cur 'bras thug dang 'bras phye/ nub tu a tsa ra dang kha che 'dres pa sum cur gro phye dang bzhes spro/ byang du bshan pa sogs rigs sum cur sha ston/ gzhis ka shar pas btsan mdos sne'u'i bar bskyal/ rgyab chos su khyams ra'i dge 'dun rnams kyis sher snying gi bzlog pa dang bcas bstar/tshes bcur thang po che'i bshan pa lag dmar la tshogs chas spyan ras gzigs bzabs rgyas 'dod don gsol ba'i tshigs bcad dang bcas sdum bu ba nor bu dar rgyas spyan 'dren la btang / tshes bcu dgu nas gra tshang tshogs su bdun gcig rnam 'joms btsugs pa'i gzungs sngags chig 'bum sum —51—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (3/khri drug stong brgyad brgya song / nyi shu nas rkang par babs pa'i 'bam nad zug rngus gzir pa'i tshe thol byung du tshogs gsog byas na snyam lha ldan dang ra mo che'i rten rnams kyi mchod rdzas su rgya gos tshon khra khyad mtshar dang gser gzhi ma gnyis kyis gtsos/ mngags bzos kyi ber legs pa nyer gcig bla bre dang / 'gan sbyar phyi g.yogs la tshal bu glan pa'i snam sbyar kha shas bzo ba'i do dam (37na)sngags rams pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang stag chos pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis byas te nyer bzhir jo shāka rnam gnyis so so'i snam sbyar la smon lam tshigs bcad bris nas phul/ chos srung tshor mchod gtor 'bul dgos pa'i mtshan ma byung ba bzhin 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan dang / ngag dbang nam mkha' gnyis chos 'khor rgyal du btang ba'i snyan dar mchod rdzas bzabs rgyas thog /de sa ko ṭa ri bskang ba 'bum/ bsil tshal du beg tser khri/ mgon chos rnam sras la stong / de phyin la brgya tshar btsugs pas sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs dang / chos skyong srung ma'i nus mthus zla mtshams nas nad dngos gzhi las grol zhing yan lag la phan pa'i sman gyi rigs bsten pa rnams kyang dkon cog gi thugs rjes 'dren byed la gnod par ma gyur/ nad g.yog sde pas bar/ dbu mdzad dang mchod dpon pa/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ dar mo sman rams pa/ sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs rnams kyis byas/nyer bdun nas gra tshang gi tshogs su dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i gsang mdos btsugs pa'i grangs chig 'bum dgu stong lnga brgya/ rgya can nas bod khams bde thabs me sbrul nang du grub dgos pa'i do dam dang bcas lha sa/ ra mo che/ po ta la/ khra 'brug /gtsang 'gram/ ka tshal/ grom pa rgyang /bu chu/ mkho mthing / byams sprin/ pra dun rtse/ mchims phu/ shel brag /sgrags yang rdzong / phung po ri bo che/ bkra bzang / zab phu lung / mkhar chu/ yer pa/ gter sgrom/ 'on phu stag tshang / yum (37ba)bu gla sgang rnams su ras tshon sna lnga so so nas dar lcog re/ rong gi brag rtse gsum 'dra bar yang dag dang /mi hreng 'dra bar rdo rje phur pa'i sku/ skyid shod shun gyi brag rtser thub dbang bdud 'dul rnams bzhengs/52

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)yer par sgrol ma tshig 'bum chig khri bdun stong / yig drug bye ba gnyis dang sa ya gcig /spyi sgosatshang ma bde thabs su yer pa lha ri snying por gong dkar chos sde ba brgyad gras grabs gcig sgrub nyer gcig bar sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i sgrub mchod kyi thog mar tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ngang nas lam bsdus dkar cha bzhi/ gong bstod / sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa rnams song rjes nyin rer cho ga tshar bzhi re dang / sgrol ma nyer waṇi ga bsdoms drug stong chig brgya bzhi bcu/ yi ge bcu pa sham bu dang bcas pa chig 'bum bzhi khri brgyad stong / ring 'tsho ngag dbang 'jam mgon ma chig khri nyis stong / srod thun la gur zhal gyi gtor bsngo bskang ba mdor bsdus/ sgrol ma bzhi brgya brgyad cu/ tshe gzungs bzhi brgya bzhi bcu/ rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs ring dang gdugs dkar chig brgya drug cu re/ sher snying sum brgya/'gong po'i cho 'phrul che ba zhi thabs su gong gi gnas chen rnams su 'brel mtshungs bzhi gra res drag po'i sbyin sreg dang mchod pa sna lnga re/ gtso bor 'gong po spun gsum dang gzhan yang stod smad kun tu 'gong po mang po nor dang mi phyir 'brang ba sogs bzlog thabs su dbu ru stod smad mtshams yo bo gdong la mchod rten/ gtsang rong gi mtshams thob rgyal skam pa rir spyan ras gzigs kyi sku/ yar klungs stod smad kyi mtshams yum bu gla sgang gi rir skyon chen po'i sku/ ru (38na 'ag grom pa rgyang mtshams su mgon po'i sku rnams brag ldebs la brkos/ bod 'bangs spyir shis thabs su rag yan ge re man gyi skyid chu lho byang gi sngags pa nyi shu rtsa lngas yer par lo star sprel zla'i tshes bcu chag med rgyun btsugs/ phungs po ri bo cher sgrol ma ba/ srong btsan bang sor dpal ri ba/ ri bo bkra bzang du rang gra rnams gra slob bcu res grabs gcig sgrub brgyad la nad bdag sa gnyan gyi gdon 'jomasapa'i mnan pa/ nged ring por 'tsho thabs su ngam ring du chos rje bkra bzang pa/ lha rtser gdan sa gong ban gtsang pa dang chu mig pa/ gzhis rtser rtse gdong ban gtsang pa dang sgrol ma ba/ gong dkar du smin grol gling pa dang chos sde ba/ dkon gnyer gra gtsang / gra snye mdo ba/ pho brang du sne'u stong ban gtsang pa rnams gra slob nyi shu rtsa gsum res so so'i lugs kyi phur sgrub bdun gcig dang grabs zhag re/ lha sa/—53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pobasam yas/ khra 'brug /ka tshal/ bu chu/ gtsang 'gram/ grom pa rgyang / 'phags pa wa ti'i bzhugs gnas dang bcas par smyung gnas sogs yig drug gang 'phel gyi gra btsun bzhi gra res dus 'khor mar yig drug gi rgyun btsugs/mchims phur dpal ri ba/ shel bral tu smin grol gling pa/ yang rdzong du rdo rje brag pa/ mkhar chur gnas gzhi ba/ rbab phur sgrol ma pa/ bkra bzang du rang gra rnams gra slob bco lnga res lo star spel zla'i tshes bcu so so'i lugs bzhin chag med/ gtsang ri lug mgo 'dra ba la stod rgyal gyi shrī dgon pa bsam gling gi ltag tu stobs po che'i sku/ yar klungs su ri sprul brgyugs 'dra ba (38ba 'ar stod bar thang sku 'bum gyi rir khyung / skyid shod du ri bya 'dra ba ri bo dga' ldan gyi rgyab rir thugs rje chen po'i sku/ dbur stod du ri sog po khros pa 'dra ba phag mo 'brog gi spus rir byang chub mchod rten rnams bzhengs/ srong btsan bang sor dpal ri ba'i gra pa gnyis kyis nyin star ma ning gi bskang ba tshar gcig ga lhas gang 'gab dang badz+ra gu rur rkangs byas kyi rgyun btsugs shing dkon gnyer kyang zhan lcogs byed/ yum bur ri bo chos gling pa'i bzhi zhes sman bla'i rgyun chag med/ dusang na 'tshub chags bzlog thabs su bkra bzang du nub dgon pa dang / zab phur sgrol ma ba gra slob bco lnga res zla ba drug par tshe bdag gi grabs gcig sgrub bdun re/ mdo smad phyogs dus bde zhing las sgo dar ba'i thabs su dar rtse mdo/ mdzo sgang / lho rong rdzong rnams so sor dge lugs nye skor dgon tsho bsdus brgya res zla gcig bar la spyir yig drug dung phyur gcig kha skong dang bcas pa/ bod 'bangs bde zhing shar phyogs gdug pa zhi phyir phung bo cher sgrol ma bas tshe bdag /'ug bya lung pas 'char ka /brag la bas gi dang dmar chung rnams gra slob nyi shu rtsa gsum res grabs sgrub bsgril ba zhag bcu/ shar phyogs dus bde ba sogs kyi thabs su nyang kong rdzong gzhis khag lnga'i 'og gi dge dgon rnams kyis ma ṇi dung phyur brgyad dang bye ba brgyad lhag dang bcas pa/ bstan srid spyi rim la gong dkar du rdo rje brag pa gra slob bcus byang chub gling pa'i phyag rdor gyi sgrub pa bdun gcig /bstan pa dar rgyas kyi —54

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)ched du yum bur ri bo chos gling pa bzhi zhes sman bla'i zhor la dpang skong phyag brgya (39na)pa nyin star tshar bcu re chag med/ 'phan yul stod slad kyi mi sdes zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes bcu 'grub na dang / de min sprel zla'i tshes bcu chag med/ bcom mda' rwa sgreng sum mdor rigs gsum mgon po dang stobs po che'i sku bzheng ba rnams byas/ /gnam gang la sems dpa' chen pos rta bzhi bcu dang rgyal sras sher 'phel bas rta nyer gcig byung /hor zla lnga pa'i tshes lngar gegs rim du dbus lho byang gi sa dge'i dgon gtsang gra bzhi stso zhe dgu so sor ja tshul bco lnga re'i thog mas brjod dgu khri bdun stong drug brgya lnga bcu/ sher snying sa ya chig 'bum nyi khri brgyad stong / tshe gzungs sa ya gnyis bdun 'bum sum khri drug stong / dpal ri ba brgya bco lngar ja tshul bco lnga'i thog drag sngags so drug pa/ bkra shis chos sde ba brgya dang lngas ja tshul gong 'drar urdzi khe srung ba dang bha ya na'i bzlog pa/ gong dkar chos sde ba sum brgya nyer gnyis kyis ja tshul gong 'drar bha ya na'i bzlog pa/ lha sar gong dkar chos sde ba brgyad sa zhag nyer gcig gi bar sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i sgrub mchod/ de'i rgyab chos su bde yangs pa brgyas zhag gong 'drar sgrol ma drug 'bum lnga khri/ 'bras spungs su ja lnga'i bar brgyad stong pa/ bskal bzang / 'bum rnamasadang / se rar mang ja gong 'drar gdugs dkar/ sher snying / tshe gzungs bcas 'gro gang che/ lha sar dgra lha dpangs bstod/ sde pa'i rim gror yer pa gra tshang gis tshe gzungs sa ya/ skyes lhar bsangs dang dar lcog /khra 'brug rgyal khang du dar rgyas chos sdings pa brgyad kyis bskang ba brgya tshar/ ri (39ba)bo bde chen du chos srung la bskang bshags stong tshar/ rgyal po lcog tu spyan gzigs khrab sag thag spos phor/ jus rim la gong dkar du chos sde bas zhal gyi gtor bzlog /rdo rje brag pas mgon po g.yul bzlog /dkon gnyer bas phyag bzhi pa'i mdos/ bsam yas su snye mdo bas phur bzlog /'phyong rgyas su smin grol gling pas phyag bzhi pa'i mdos dang gi dang gi dgra mnan/ pho brang du bkra shisachos sde bas dmar chen gtor bzlog /khra 'brug tu rtse'i dkon gnyer bas phyag bzhi pa'i mdos dpal —55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pori bas mgon po g.yul bzlog /lha sar rgyud stod smad so sonas drug cu pa dang / gsang sngags gling pas tshe bdag gi gtore bzlog /'ad ston pas zhag bstobadun la bon lugs kyi dgra mnan/ 'bri gung du sprul sku rin po ches yang bzlog dang / rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub dang ban grong pa bsgril bsagashin rje khro chu'i gtor bzlog /'ol khar brag sna bas gshin rje'i dgra mnan dang ma ning / chos ldan pas drag dmar gyi gtor bzlog /rgyal dga' 'tshal nas be ga tse dang dmag zor ma/ mthil nasaphyag bzhi pa'i gtor bzlog /lho brag lha khang du gnas zhi ba dang / dar mar smra bo lcog pas khro rol re/ gzhis rtser snying ri gdan sa pas beg tse'i dgra mnan dang gtor bzlog /dor pas 'jigs byed drug cu pa/ 'ug bya lung pas mgon po g.yul bzlog /dar sdings pas bon lugs kyi mdos dang dgra mnan/ rgyal rtser bgrad pa dang sna dkar rtse ban gtsang pas tshe bdag gi dgra mnan dang gtor bzlog /pa nam du brag la bas wor ga'i gtore bzlog /rin spungs(40na〉kyi gsang sngags glings pas 'char ga'i dgra mnan dang gtor bzlog /nges gsang rdor gling pas la4 ka dang / 'od mchog sprul pa'i skus yang gsang drag po/ shel dkar du brag dkar chu bzang pa/ ngam ring du nub dgon pas tshe bdag rnams kyi gtor bzlog /bkra bzang du rang gras phur bzlog /rtse brgya mkhar bas tshe bdag gi gtor bzlog /lha rtser thub bstan dge 'phel ba/ bsam grub dgon gsar ba/ grang mo cha pa gsum gyis dmar chen gtor bzlog dang zhal gyi gtor bzlog /rnam gling du sgrol ma bas tshe bdag gi gtor bzlog rnams so sor gra slob nyi shu rtsa gsum res grabs sgrub bsgril ba zhag bcu dang brgyad skabs sbyar/nyi zla dmar mdangs can shar ba gter lung nas bshad pa'i bzlog thabs su gra slob grangs gong mtshudas kyis lha sa nas gsang sngags byang chub gling pas khro rol slang gang ma/ nges gsang rdor gling pas ma mo gling bzhi dang / rdo rje brag pas 'char da'i mdos/ po ta lar gra tshang nas phur pa'i dam sri 'byung po'i mnan pa bsgrubs nas lha sar mnan/ rgyab chog tu ser 'bras gnyis su mang ja sbyor sbrel thog sher snying 'bum sogs ci nus bgyis/—56

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)tshes drug la grong smad sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bskul ba'i mdzad btsu'i bstod pa legs byas yongasa'adu'i snye ma dang / mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog gi chog sgrigs 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam rgyal/ rol mo'i deb kyi 'go brjod/ rdo pa bstan pa dar rgyas kyis gra tshang du snyan dar brgya rtsa brgyad phul ba'i kha byang / bsam (40ba)yas mdo sde mchod par spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtsho mngags pa'i tshe 'phrin gsol gyi tshigs bcad/ gra rigs rnams kyis bskul ngor rtse le sprul sku'i yang srid myur 'byon gyi smon lam/ dung skyong rgyal mor dbu khebs bum gdan ma phul ba'i kha byang / jo bo rin po cher na bza' bum gdan ma phul ba'i smon lam/ co ne chos rje blo bzang nyi ma'i ngor phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs/ ja lung bla ma nam mkha' 'phrin las kyi ngor gsol 'debs smon lam/ spun bdun pa yon tan dar rgyas kyi don du lhun 'grub rgya mtshos jo shāka dang khra 'brug tu snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang rnams rim par brtsams/ dga' chags a mdo ba dpon khag drug gis rta re gcig byin/tshes bcu bdun nas nyin bdun gyi bar gter sgrom gyi chu tshan bsten/ nyer drug la stag lung phyag mdzod blo bzang ngag dbang 'das pa'i bsngo rten du thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i tshems kyis gtsos spams mtho ba bteg pa ngan song gi duḥkha las skyob cing thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i smon lam dang bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs yang dag bgyis shing dge 'thud kyang rgya cher spel/nyer bdun la nged rang gi dge sbyor rten seng ldeng nags sgrol mar 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyis bskor ba rags kha 'jam dbyangs dbang po dang dgos bsam gnyis kyis bris pa'i rgyab yig smon lam/ dwags po gra tshang spyi sos bskul ba'i nged rang dang sde pa'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ rnam gling chos mdzad ngag dbang blo gsal gyi 'dod don bzhin gsol 'debs bris/gnam (41na)gang la phyi mtshams grol ba'i gung tshigs thog cung wang gi mi sna he'u jang / wang shu si/ jang zhu gi sogs dang / 'di ga'i mi sna rab stims pa rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang 'jam dbyangs 'od —57—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogezer/ dga' ldan dar rgyas/ rgyal sras dge 'dun/ dpon no yon kha sha kha/ star sdong blo bzang tshe brtan/ sger logs a dar kong dmag nas log pa sogs ston mor gang 'tshams kyi dri ba byas pa mi sna te'u jang de smra mkhas spobs pa bzang ba zhig 'dug kyang lo tsā ba rgya bod gnyis gar thabs jugs pa'i sgra ji bzhin ma byung ba de rigs shes par bdag rkyen dgos gras yin snang de thog cung wang gi yi ge rten dngul las grub pa'i rgyal srid sna bdun rgya bzo khyad mtshar sogs rgya cher bteg /de rjes thog khar khri'u shing gi steng nas sog bod rgya sogs lnga brgyar byin rlabs byas/ phyi dro gser mdog can mkhan zur/ gsang sngags byang chub gling / bkra shis bde chen/ 'phan yul lcang gling chos sdings gsum gyi bla ma/ chos rje dung dgon pa/ kyi ston gu ru tshe brtan/ sha gzug sku skye/ gnyes gu ru ba mched/ che chen tha'i ji'i ma/ 'a zha mkhyen rab rnam rgyal/ 'dus chung pa/ 'phyos pa sku skye so gos la ja gral btang /tshangs pa dung thod can la tshogs chas/ spyan gzigs/ gser skyems/ zhu 'phrin rgyan gyis spras te star sdong pa lung bstan zhu bar rdzangs/hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig snga rting so sor phan bde legs bshad gling gra pa spyis bsdus pa'i tshogs chas grangs sogs kyi dngos pos ring por brkyang ste dwangs ma bcud (41ba 'dren dang 'chi med 'od snang rdul tshon dang 'brel pa'i gong zhag bdun re'i sgrub pa sngon song gi mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog sogs rgyas par mdzad pa'i bsun bzlog gi dgos cha mar dpon pas ba 'a/ 'phyos pa sku skye'i ngor nged rang dang rta tshag rje drung gi brtan bzhugs/ 'tsho byed ngag dbang lhag bsam gyis kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ spyan ras gzigs rnams kyi bris thang bzhengasapa'i rgyab yig /rags kha 'jam dbyangs dbang pos bskul ba'i sman thang pa yab sras brgyud 'dzin rags bsdus dang bcas par gsol 'debs smon lam/ sngags rams pa skyes mchoge gis dad rten 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i kha byang / dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i nyams len kye rdor dang 'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub kyis sgrol dkar gyi thang sku bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam/ u —58—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)chu mu chu che chen ching dbang gi o pa shis bskul ba'i bde mchog la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ sgo mangs gra tshang gi tshogs khro gsar blug gi kha byang / rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling gra tshang gi spyi rdzas deb dpag bsam 'dod 'jo ma bu le tshan drug gi 'go brjod/ sde pa blo bzang mthu stobasakyis zangs rir rten bzhengs re mang mdzad pa'i dkar chag rnams bkod/tshes gnyis la bstan pa'i sbyin bdag bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal pos bdog pa rgya cher bteg cing 'gyed gra pa rer ljangs ja ka 'o ra re dang bcas gzims chung brtan bzhugs rgyas pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig par mdzad/ tshes bzhir dga' ldan rab 'byams pa (42na)dang gzhis ka shar pa so so nas dngos po'i skyes 'gyed dang bcas te gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa bsgrubs/ de rjes dung dkar sku skye tshangs dbyangs 'brug sgra/ bkra shis bde chen dang rme ru bla ma/ kyi ston pa rnams dang phrad cing kyi ston grub pa chen mor phyir bzlog 'khor lo 'bar bas mtshon snga 'gyur gyi skor dri ba bgyis pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon bsten pa'i lag rjes bzang po yod mchis/ brda don lam zab kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang lung / chos rgyal byang pa'i dus kyi gtan tshigs la rgyab bsnon/ ja gos dar sogs kyi rdzong ba dang bcas lugs gnyis nas thugs dam bskang /tshes lngar tshogs gsog tu se 'bras gnyis su ja tshul bco brgyad re'i bar gdugs dkar khyon 'bum ther/ chos 'khor rgyal du dpal ldan dmag zor ma sogs bla mtsho gsum la ga'u sa gtsos mtsho rdzas phul/ rngod a rig dgon par chos gzhis gsar bsnon gzhi rtsa khungs dag seng ge sgang pas 'dzin shul bsdoms mi ser dud chig brgya bcu drug /dud chung drug /lag yong mkha' ru'i khal chig stong drug brgya thon khungs/ ja tshul thebs su tshong pa dang ru khag gsar 'dzugs bcas sbyor 'jags/ sde pa'i gegs sel la dpal lha lcog dang gnas chung du bskang ba brgya tshar re/ lha sar ngan slong brgya dang drug cu skor la sbyin pa/ jus rim la mtshal yang dgon/ dbus gling / gung thang / gdan sa mthil/g.ya' bzang / 'bri gung mthil/ sne'u sdong rtse/ gong dkar rdzong rnams su phyag bzhi pa'i bskang ba brgya —59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogebarda don lam zab kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang lung / chos rgyal byang pa'i dus kyi gtan tshigs la rgyab bsnon/ ja gos dar sogs kyi rdzong ba dang bcas lugs gnyis nas thugs dam bskang /tshes lngar tshogs gsog tu se 'bras gnyis su ja tshul bco brgyad re'i bar gdugs dkar khyon 'bum ther/ chos 'khor rgyal du dpal ldan dmag zor ma sogs bla mtsho gsum la ga lus gtsos mtsho rdzas phul/rngod a rig dgon par chos gzhis gsar bsnon gzhi rtsa khungs dag seng ge sgang pas 'dzin shul bsdoms mi ser dud chig brgya bcu drug /dud chung drug /lag yong mkha' ru'i khal chig stong drug brgya thon khungs/ ja tshul thebs su tshong pa dang ru khag gsar 'phunas bcas sbyor 'jags/ sde pa'i shegs sel la dpal lha lcog dang gnas chung du bskang ba brgya tshar re/ lha sar ngan slong brgya dang drug cu skor la sbyin pa/ thus rim la mtshal yang dgon/ dbus gling / gung thang / gdan sa mthil/g.ya' bzang / 'bri gung mthil/ sne'u sdong rtse/ gong dkar rdzong rnams su phyag bzhi pa'i bskang ba brgya (42bsgor re'i thog spyan gzigs dar tshon sna lnga re/ 'phyong rgyas su dpal ri ba dang gong dkar du rdo rje brag pas mgon po g.yul bzlog /lha sar rgyud smad pas ya ma rā dza gtsor bton gyi drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog /'bras spungs sngags khang du rgyud stod pas shā sa na gtsor bzlas kyi phyag drug pa'i gtor bzlog /dga' ldan man nas ljangs yan gyi dgon adhi dang gnyis la mang skol thog sher snying gi mdo sgrub/ lha sar gsang sngags byang chub gling pa gra slob dgubs zhi gang gi mnan pa bsgrubs pa'i phyogs bzhi'i lam chen 'og lho mon gyi dgra mgo mnan pa/ lhun ra btu rgya 'dre'i cho 'phrul byung ba bzlog thabasasu btsan sgo rum pas bskul ba bzhin dngos grub sdings pas rgyal mdos dang rgyud pa'i gra pa dgusadrug cu pa'i gtor bzlog /sgo rum pa rang gis rgyal rdzongs byas/ tshes drug la g.yon ru sku skye dang / rta tshag rje drung so so nas dngos skyes bzang po 'gyed dang bcas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa mdzad/ de grol nas g.yon ru sku skye khal kha no yon khu thug thu/ 'phags sde mkhan po/ on dur chos rje/ byang ngos pa sogs la ja gral bgyis/—60

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)tshes bdun la grong smad nas rung mthun gyi gos cha tshang gsum re/ ster cha 'gyed gya nom pa dang bcas bsun bzlog sngon 'gro'i tshe dpag med longs sku ma'i rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho smin rgyas kyi rten 'byung bstar/ tshes brgyad la drung yig gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gyis gos sna cha tshang sogs bdog pa'i skyes kyi tshan grangs ring po dang gra tshang du spyi 'bul rgya can gyi thang grangs bco lngar tshang ba gong gzham zhal (43na/spebs sogs phun sum tshogs pa dang 'gyed bcas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/tshes bcur gsang sngags mkhar pa dang / thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor ba so so nas dngos po'i tshan grangs dang mi 'gyur brtan pa'i bden tshig brjod cing sngags mkhar rnams spyi 'gre'i tshigs bcad smon lam dang thang sag pas mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo lugs yin zer bkra shis rtags brgyad dang bcas pa zhig snang /tshes bcu gcig la bka' brgyad sbug pas ja gos dar ras sogs ring por brkyang ste 'gyed dang bcas 'bras gshongs mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i bsun bzlog dang 'brel ba'i cho ga gra tshang gis btang / de mtshams nas dpal ldan 'bras spungs pa spyi tshogs dang rgyud stod pa so so nas rnyed pa spams bstod de 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyas ba'i ring 'tsho mdzad/tshes bcu gnyis la byams khang rgyab gnod sbyin gangs la nyi shar gyis dngos po dang yon sbyar te gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa spel rjes rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag chos rje bco brgyad pa gra bcas kyis zang zing dpangs bstod cing sgrol dkar tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas ring 'tsho mdzad pa gzhan dang mi 'dra'i yid khul ba dang / chos rje nyid kyis gtan sdod dgos tshul la ljags kyi dbang po bskyod de mdo sngags kyis thugs rgyud phyug pa'i lung 'dren sogs rnam dpyod che ba'i dper 'os shing so skye la skye 'chir rang dbang med pas khas len dka' na'ang / gsar ma'i cho ga cha lag tshang ba'i phyag len ting nge 'dzin yo byad phun sum tshogs pa'i (43ba)byin rlabs dang dkon —61—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pocog la gsol ba btab na mi 'grub pa ga la srid pas ngo 'dzin tsam du sdod 'dun rnam dag byed tshul sogs kyi lan btab/gling stod chos rje'i skye ba blo bzang gzhen nu lo bcu gcig 'gro bas gso rig rgyud bzhi gsal dag byang ba'i rgyugs sprad pa sngon sbyangs las 'phro sad lugs kyis skyes bar slar yang nges shes 'drongs par gyur/tshes bcu gsum chad pa'i bcu bzhir se ra theg chen gling spyi tshogs dang gsang ne'u thog gi zhabs drung rnam gnyis r+ṣa slob yos so sos phu dud rgya cher bskrun nas ring por 'tsho ba'i bden brjod yang dag bstar/'phags yul nub phyogs ku ru'i yul gyi bram ze'i paṇ+ḍita spros ud ya rang yul du 'gro bar sa zla zho bzhis gtsos ja ras gos dar lam chas dang rjong bda' bgyis/tshes bco lngar gdan sa chen po 'brog dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas khri rin po che byams pa bkra shis kyis dbus rtse shar chos rje rnam gnyis sogs gra slob bcas pa dang /stag tshang ra ba stod pa bla gra so so nas yul lugs dang mthun pa'i bdog pa spel te nyi bu'i dgra las rgyal ba'i rten 'brel mdzad/sher 'phel sprul sku/yang ri slob dpon pa/kong po bkra shis rab brtan pa'i dbon po rnams la ja gral btang /tshes bcu drug la yer pa gra tshang pa dang lha ldan ru bzhi so sos legs skyes spams mtho ba dang bcasang 'tsho'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/lha sa'i rnying khungs dmigs brtse ma tshor dmigs brtse mar brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgom lung /bco brgyad chos rje/gling stod sku skye/rta spyo rje drung gi dpon po/phu lung dge slong rnams rdzong bda' dang rje drung 44na ji na po chesasnyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa byung ba'i lan kyang de mtshudas phul/ tshes bcu bdun la gong dkar dan gnyer gra tshang bla gras tshan grangs dang bcas te rje rgod tshang pa'i gsang yum mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo lugs kyi ring 'tsho'i cho ga btang ba gdangs snyan zhing gra 'grig pa'i tshad cig snang /de rjesachu shur thar gling pa yongs rdzogs sa kyang dngos po'i skyes dang tsos ring 'tsho spel/ thos bsam dar rgyas gling bla zur/la mo sku rten pa/spus srang smyon rdo rnams dang phrad/

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)tshes bco brgyad pa lha sa zur khang pas zang zing gi sne ring por brkyang nas 'gyed dang bcas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa spel/ gsas khang dgon gra slob rnams kyis dngos po'i rnam grangs dang bcas ring 40 tshigs bcad gsung / kho lo chi'i bu gnyis/ yon dur chos rje/ sku skye nor bu rgya mtsho sogs rang yul du brjangs/ 'phags yul ma hūṃ ra'i sa n+ya si k+ṣe ma gi ri dang nī la ga(so sor gser zho gsum re dang / wa ra ṇa si'i rje rigs sri ta dwa sa lar gser zho do/ rgya bod bar du ci 'dod la phyin chog pa'i lam yig sogs blo'i re ba bkang /tshes bcu dgur smad rgyud gra tshang gis tshan grangs dang bcas bde ldan mgon po ltar brtan pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs par mdzad/ u khe res tha'i ji'i 'og nas ser mo ba drag pa bcu bzhi skor dang phrad/ gung tshigs thog cung wang gi mi sna g.yog bcas/ 'di ga'i mi sna zung chu rab 'byams pa dang rgya tshe ring bcas par ster ma yig lan rten sbrags rtsis sprad de thon/ hung tha'i ji dang dga' ldan rab 'byamasapa'i mi snar ja gral(44ba)btang / nyer gcig la dga' ldan dar rgyas gcig pur 'phral yun gyi gleng mo bgyis/ nyer gnyis la dga' ldan dar rgyas/ tha shi bo lod/ dpon chung gnyis/ nyang re sku skye rnams la mgon po'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel bskur nas dga' ldan dar rgyas la gyon pa cha tshang sogs bdog pa tham kha dang bcas dga' ldan da'i ching bo shog thu ji nong gi cho lo skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po che chen dbon pos skad gsang mthon pos 'dogs pa sogs sna bo'i lugs bzang ma nyams par gzengs bstod/ ba tha yan chi sogs dmangs lnga brgya skor la me tog gtor/nyer gsum la a pa la'i gyi dpon mo 'khor bcas dang / er khe chos rje rnams la ja gral btang /nyer dgu la khon du lu'i ma bu/ dka' bcu ngag dbang don grub/ spom 'bor sku skye/ a tsa lha ri'i bla mar 'gro mi/ rmu le rab stims pa'i dbon po/ dar rgyas rab stims pa gas dang phrad/ gong dkar dkon gnyer ba gra slob la dgos cha grabs sgrub tho rnying ltar gdugs dkar gyi mdos gtong bcug /hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bzhir gsang sngags byang chub gling pa slob dpon gra bcas la ja gral —63—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ḍak+kibatang / tshes lngar da la'i khung tha'i jis mi sna ched du mngags te gser srang brgya/dngul bre/ tha phag /mi gzugs/ gos yug lnga/ rung mthun gyi gos cha 'grig /ja ras kyi dngos po spams mtho/ tshogs chas 'gyed sogs yon sbyar te gra tshang nas bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med 'chi med 'od snang ma'i rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i cho ga rgyas par bstar/ tshes drug la rwa sgreng mkhan zur pas rta drug cu dang / dpal 'khor chos (45na8 mkhan zur pas rta brgya dang gcig byung /tshes bcu gcig la ā tsar+ya dza ma kirti ra gser zho bdun/ ma nu nā da dang bi shwa pa dar zho gsum re/bu dhi nā dar zho phyed gsum/ gaṅgā nā dar zho bzhi/ dar ras sogs byin pas mgu ba'i lugs byed/tshes bcu gsum la sgrib sbyong rim gror rdzong gzhis rnams nas yon sbyar te gdugs dkar sa ya/ ser 'bras gnyis su ja tshul bco lnga/ gra pa bcu rer gser zho re'i 'gyed dang bcas pa'i thog phyag 'tshal nyer gcig bdun 'bum nyi khri bzhi stong lnga brgya/ lha sar 'jim pa'i mchod rten stong dang nyer brgyad byin rten sna tshogs kyis sbags pa gsar du bzhengs te bar khang du bzhugs su gsol bar gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas rab gnas mnga' gsol zhing bkra shis pa'i me tog gi char phab/sde pa'i rim gror 'phyong rgyas su sman bla khri tshar/ yul lha gzhi bdag la gsol mchod/ lha sar sher snying lnga 'bum/ jus rim la 'phyong rgyas su dpal ri ba dang / gzhis rtser lug bya lung pas mgon po g.yul bzlog /gong dkar du rdo rje brag pas 'char ga'i mdos/ pho brang du bkra shis chos sde bas lha mo dud sol ma'i bskang ba brgya tshar/ dbus gtsang gi nad rims bzlog thabs su mi ser lag nas bsdu cha byasan gzan zo mi 'gab kyang rim gro 'gyur khyad che bar sgo re nas rtsam phul re bsdus de phyin dgos cha gzhung nas sprad pa'i rdzong gzhis so sor yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ bstan ma bcu gnyis/ ma rmo/rgyal btsan bzhi'i mdos/ rnam 'joms dang sme (45ba)brtsegs kyis gtsug lag khang dang yul khams thams cad la khrus gsol te ma dag pa'i rigs mtha' dag dbyung / dgra lha dpangs bstod brgyags rngan zhag bdun sbrel/ nad bdag stobs 'joms kyis yas dbus gtsang gi mtshams sgrol —64—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)te lto phyogs su bskyal/ yul lha gzhi bdag gsol/ zla ba gnyis kyi bar ri rgya klungs rgya bsdem mkhos dang rdzong gzhis so so'i ri mgo mtho sar 'dzugs rgyu'i nad bdag stobs 'joms 'khor lo re bsrings/lhun rab kyi rgya 'dre de'i 'tshub 'gyur slar yang byung ba bzlog thabs su gsang sngags byang chub gling pa sum cus brgyad stong pa/ gser 'od/ thang yig gsum brgya tshar re/ slob dpon the ba'i sum cus thugs sgrub kyi las byang dang 'brel ba'i 'gong po ar gtad 'bum the ba'i mthar rgyal rdzongs gdang la bud mtshams bskyal/tshes bcu bzhin rwa sgreng mkhan zur/ brag yag sku skye 'grul sdebs nyi shu skor/ bi yigs ra khe tha'i ji dpon mo sogs dang phrad pa grol nas brag yag sku skye/ er khe chos rje/ chos rje dkon gnyer dpon sogs la 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na/ spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gsum gyi rjes gnang byas shing / brag yag sku skye'i gnyer pa sogs bsnyen rdzogs bzhi bsgrubs/tshes bcu drug la dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis ber sogs gos sna cha tshang / gos dar ja ras kyis gtsos dpangs bstod de gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa bgyis/ tshes nyi shur 'brang rgyas shag pas rung mthun gyi gos cha 'grig (46na)dngos po ring du brkyang ste lha btsun chen po'i bsun bzlog dang 'brel ba'i rten 'byung byung / bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po btsun mo sras bcas dam phyogs la 'degs gdong gi byin rlabs byas shing / 'dul ba gra tshang gis rig gra'i skal ba bskyal/gtsang bkra shis lhun po nas ring 'tsho spel bar ched du mngags pa'i mgron gnyer dge slong / pag shod dang sngags lcog bla ma/ rgyal mo bsod nams chos 'dzoms sogs la ja gral btang zhing shag shar pa'i spun gzhen pa'i skra phud blangs te ming tshe dbang dpal bzang du btags/nyer lnga nas bdun gnyis kyi bar bsnyen pa kha gso byas pa grol nas dbu mdzad ngag dbang phun tshogs/ brag gdong chos mdzad blo bzang tshe dbang / nam mkha' grags pa gsum log tri/ rnam gling chos mdzad ngag dbang blo cags la phur pa/ gong dkar bslab gsum dang zhal ta ba'i bu legs bshad —65

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (porgya mtsho gnyis bka' brgyad/ ngag dbang kun bzang dang blo bzang tshe dbang gnyis yang bzlog /byams pa nor bu rdo rje gro lod rnams kyi bsnyen pa byed pa'i dmigs skor phyag len bcas bslabs nas mtshams bsdam bcug /chos 'khor rgyal gnas srung gis bskul ba'i rtse shod thun mong gi ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis gra tshang la zhing bcu bzhi sbyor 'jags mdzad/ de lhang lhang brag gi gter byung dang rgya can phyogs mthun dgongs don rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad bstan pa nam gnas bar rgyun 'dzugs/ byang (46ba)gling blo bzang lhun grub ma sru dang bcas pa'i ngor gra tshang dang dge 'phel ri khrod so sor rgyun 'dzugs kyi ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ dbu mdzad kyis mdze gu ru dang yang gsang drag po bzhedas pa'i rgyab yig /gsang gling sngags rams pa ngag dbang legs ldan gyis bskul ba'i ring 'tsho/ blo bzang dge 'dun gyi ngor bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bskul ba'i ri bo bde chen du 'dzugs rgyu'i sman bla'i ja mchod/ zur 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyi 'dod pa bzhin mtshan brgyad dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ blo bzang thugs rje'i ngor dus 'khor bshad pa'i 'go rgyangs/ bying pa byams pa nor bu'i ngor rdo rje gro lod kyi bsnyen yig rta ljang dbang po/ ri sgo dge 'dun rab brtan gyi ngor sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pa'i brtan bzhugs/ rdo rje brag rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku'i thugs dam spel ched rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen yig yid bzhin dbang gi 'dod 'jo rnams bris/hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gsum la rgyal tshab sprul skus rang gi chibs pa legs nges lngas thog drangs pa'i bco lnga dang/ zhwa dmar sprul pa'i skus kyang chibs chen bzhi the ba'i nyi shu rtsa gcig stsal/ /tshes bzhir se 'bras lha sa bcas par lo mnyam gang yod kyi steng sprul lo pas kha bkang ste brgya rtsa brgyad la ston mo bzabs rgyas dang gra pa gang yin bcu rer ya ju bar khag re dang / mi nag nyi shur bar khag re'i rtsis kyi gos/ lha sar blo gsal gling pa bco lngas klu 'bum bzhi brgya dang nga bdun/sgrol ma brgya dang bdun cu/ mtshan brjod brgya dang bdun bcu/ (47na thar snying bzhi brgya lnga bcu/ jus—66
