rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)rim du gra sa phan tshun so sor ja bcu re'i thog sher snying 'gro gang che'i mdo sgrub/ ge re dka' bcu'i tsha bor tsha ba mdzo sgang nas dud rkang 'bring stong bcu gnyis lag 'bab dang bcas byin/tshes bcu gsum la lho mos nas chos rje dbon rin po che a gi'i gzhi bsnyen gegs med grol nas byon pa dang mjal gsung gleng zhib par byung / tshes bcu bdun nas nyin gsum kyi bar yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu bo bsten/ tshes bco brgyad la rlung dmar gyi 'khor lo nan tan bsgrubs pa sngags rams pa legs 'byor dang ngag dbang phun tshogs phag rir 'dzugs par rdzong bda' bgyis/tshes nyi shur yul jo'i thu pā thur tha'i ji rgya mtsho/ dpon chung san pi lig /ja'i sang gnyis/ mi bzang bzhi bcu skor/ a pa la'i gyi dpon mo/ dur phod chog thu'i bu bstan 'dzin/ er khe chos rje/ khal kha g.yas ru da'i chin o pa shi/ dpon mo bu bcas/ dga' ldan kha dan pā thur gyi bsngo rten skyel mi/ no gon dha ra/ kun 'dzin kha dan ga thur/ mkha ga khan dge tshul/ er te ni tho yon/ bing thu tha'i ji/ er te ni pā thur/ o rod jong gar er te ni 'bum rdo rje/ er te ni pā thur tha'i ji/ od khon sogs kyi mi sna/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan zur/ 'phan yul lha khang bla gnyer/ ri khrod dga' ldan zur pa blo bzang rnam rgyal/ myug chos gling gi bla mar 'gro mi rab stims pa dpal ldan/ (47bti mo ba'i mgron gnyer/ kho khom dang gu ge'i mi sna rnams dang phrad cing yig ngag blangs/ bkra shis pā thur tha'i jis gser zho brgya las grub pa'i phor pa sder bcas/ ja khor drug ma brgya dang bcu gsum/ dngul gos dar sogs stong phrag bteg /de thog byang ngos pa dang gzhis ka shar mchis brang dang bcas pas dkar dro spoms su bstar zhing phyi dro thog steng nas mas pa/ ri rtsa/ klu 'bum sogs nyis brgya skor/ sog dmangs brgyad brgya lhag bcas la me tog gtor zhing bka' brgyad sbug pas rta bcu gnyis dang dre'u brgyad byung / nyer dgur 'a zha mkhyen rab rnam rgyal 'khor zhag nas 'khor ba dang phrad cing zur chen sprul skur zur gsos nas mkhar khal brgyad cu/ ja nag po bar khag gnyis dang tā tshwa sbag gcig /mar khal bcu saṃ ṭa bcas skyel bar btang / ā tsarla ba tsa la pu rir gser zho bzhi/ dh+wa nu te wa ti la gser —67

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pozho do/ ra gu nā thar gser zho gsum res gtsos tshan grangs zur mas dang bcas pa'i bdag rkyen sprad/gnam gang la skyar po ba rdo rje dbang phyug 'khor ba dang phrad cing rgyu mtshan mang dag byung / dar mo sman rams pa'i sar 'dar los 'phags yul gyi go da ra'i be'u bum gsar du bsgyur ba'i che brjod/ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis gser zangs las nged rang gi 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /dam chos dbang rgyal gyis dge skos 'jog la dngul srang bcu bzhi'i pad sder phul ba'i kha byang / dbu mdzad ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis log tri'i thang ga bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /chos 'khor (48na)rgyal spyi tsho gos kyi ngor nged rang dang sde pa'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pas sho mdor bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhengs pa'i dkar chag che brjod/ a mdo min ju chos rdzong dgon pa ba rab 'byamasa'ajam dbyangs 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i bu chos le'u nyer gnyis dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs/ blo gsal gling gi bla brgyud kha stong gsol 'debs rnams bkod/hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig la bkra shis rtse chos rje dbon la gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa'i bris thang gra tshar legs pa dang bcas pa'i skyes dbul nas lho mos su stan chags/ hor a mdo'i dpon dbang rgyal/ dpang rgyal/ bzung mo/ btsan rgod dar/ gser sbar/ dbang grags can nyis brgya skor la ja gral btang zhing rta sum brgya nyi shu byung / tshes lngar 'phags yul wa ra ṇa si'i bram ze dza wan+ti dang ga ṇi sha te ba ri gnyis la ja gral thog 'dod lha gang yin dang yon tan ci shes sogs dris par srid sgrub kyi rig byed shes shing yi dam khyab 'jug gi rjes su zhugs pa yin tshul sogs zer/ dzi wan+ti ra gser zho gsum/ ja bar khag /snam dkar/ ga ṇi shar gser zho bzhi/ snam dkar/ so sor zur mas sogs 'dod don bsgrubs/ tshes brgyad la mnga' ris gra tshang / gsang sngags chos 'khor ba/tsher gseb dgon pa gsum so so nas dngos po rang 'byor dang bstun thog ring 'tsho'i tshags bcad rgyas par gsungs/ gsang sngags cho me 'khor bar thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgom lung (48ba)brgyas nas zhag bcu bzhi'i bar 'khor lo 'bar ba'i sgrub pa dang bcas smin rgyas byas/—68

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (2)yul jo'i thu pā thur tha'i ji 'khor bcas/ rgyal po'i tha gu sus ra te ba ja'i sang / paṇ+ḍita klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo rten skyel mi/ se ra smad slob dpon gsar 'khod/ gsung rab gling slob dpon pa gung thang lo tsā ba/ grog khang steng bla zur/ nyang re brag yag sku skye chung ba thon gdong / hūṃ pa/ gzims shag byang pa spun/ yam bu'i mi sna sogs brgya skor dang phrad/ yam bu'i skyes sman khrog phon che ba dang rgya gar gyi phug ron gnyis/ ras rnam grangs shin tu mang ba snang / phyi dro gtsang stod zha lu'i chos gra nasamakhan chen kun spangs pa phebs pa dang mjal/tshes bcur khal kha g.yas ru da la'i o pa shis gtsos bsnyen rdzogs bcu gnyis/ dge tshul gcig bsgrubs/ tshes bcu gnyis chad pa'i bcu gsum gyi gza' skar bzang por khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po dga' ldan khang gsar du thegs/ rdo rje brag nas rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i skus dgos tshulu ltar 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong gi bsnyen yig rin cen ke ta ka /stag lung phyag mdzod blo bzang ngag dbang gi phyi rten yum chen brgya thang gi rgyab yig /'phyos pa nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i ngor ring 'tsho'i smon lam/'dar pa ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub kyis paṇa chen dge 'dun grub sogs 'khrungs rabs thang ga bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig skye bar rjes 'dzin dgos tshul bzhin ngo 'dzin/ rnam gling bslab gsum rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ brag gdongs sngags rams pa blo bzang tshe (49na)dbang gi ngor bla ma yi dam dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs/ lha sa ba ngag dbang dkon cog gis bskul nas rje dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs lnga tshar bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /gsol dpon ge ra ba'i ngor sgrol ma bcas thang ga gsum gyi rgyab yig /grong smad kyi gzhis ka mtsho smad khang gsar dang smon grong gnyis kyi bags deb dang shas deb gnyis kyi 'go brjod/ dpon mo tshe ring gis bskul ba'i smon lam/ skyid thang nor bus rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyi skyes rabs bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /mdo gzhigasdod gnyis kyi ngor smon lam/ lha sab ngag dbang mkhas btsun gyi phyi rten du thub dbang stong thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi sku skye grags pa sna'i ga'adzin gyis bskul ba'i —69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gering 'tsho dang gsol 'debs re/ gnang byung chos mdzad ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'i ngor ga rma gu ru'i 'phrin las gzi 'od stongs 'bar/ gtor nag gi las mtha' gnam lcags spu gri/ 'phrin las drag po'i srog gtad byin rlabs sprin phung rnams bris/tshes bco lngar thod ri bshad sgrub gling pa'i gra pa ngag dbang chos ldan/ tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho/ thub bstan rgya mtsho/ byams pa rgya mtsho/ thabs mkhas rgya mtsho rnams kyis phar phyin spyi don mtha' gcod dang bcas pa'i rgyugs sprad/ blo sbyong ltar na na dga' shi skyid las thabs bcos mang bya mi rung na'ang rang gzhan thams cad ring por ma 'tsho dogs rim gro'i skul ma byung ba blos blangs te rdzong gzhis khag kha shas nas sman bla'i mdo chog lnga khri bzhi stong sum brgya/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig chig (49ba༄ brgyad stong bdun brgya nyi shu/ gdugs dkar sum stong / sher snying bzhi khri brgyad stong bdun brgya nyi shu/ yig drug dung phyur gsum bye ba gcig sa ya gsum bzhi 'bum/ tshe gzungs nyis 'bum nyi khri brgyad brgya/po ta la'i zhol du gsang sngags chos ra pa gra pa nyi shu rtsa bdun sa zhag bco lnga'i bar phyir bzlog 'khor lo 'bar ba/ sde pa'i rim gror gangs can chos 'phel bas sgrol ma nyis 'bum lnga khri bdun stong drug cu/ gser 'od drug brgya/ yul lha gzhi bdag la gso lo mchode/ jus rim la ser 'bras gnyisabasdoms par sgrol ma sa ya gcig dang lnga stong dgu brgya/ 'bras spungs sngags khang du rgyud stod pa bzhi bcus zhag drug par shā san 'gro gang che'i 'jug phyag drug pa'i glo bur las bcol gyi gtor bzlog /nad rims zhi byed la dbus gtsang gi rdzong mgo che kha rnams nas ma mdos/ rgyal mdos/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mdos yas rnams lho nang du bskyal/po ta la'i zhol nas nges gsang rdor gling pa gra slob kyis lha 'dre stong dra'i mdos chen/ yul khams so sor sme brtsegs kyi khrus gsol/ dgra lha dpangs bstod rnams btang / gangs can phan bde'i rtsalag dam pa pha bong kha 'di nyid dar rgyas che na spyi sger thams cad la slebs che ba sangs rgyas gnyis pa skyon chen po'i lung bstan nas gsal ba ltar chos gzhis su nyang bran rka ma ba can dud gsum —70—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)lag yong mkha' ru'i khal drug cu re brgyad skor thon khungs kyi sbyor 'jags/ ban pa theg phyir dkon gnyer rnying pa gnyis steng gsar 'phar drug bcas brgyad (50na)gras sman bla rgyun 'don gyi phogs ja thug dang / sa spre nas mchod pa sna lnga bcu tshar yod thog lnga bsnan pa'i bco lnga star chags su btsugs/la phyi rdor 'dzin pa'i chos gzhis bkra shis sgang la gtan tshigs khungs thub med par brten snye nang 'phel rgyas gling chos gzhis su chod pa'i tshab shel dkar nas lo star 'bru khal sum brgya re'i gshor 'debs/ lha khang steng gi chos gzhis la phan tshun rtsod res kyi rmu le sngags rams pa'i dbon po bsam gtan bzang por sger 'jags dang / de tshab bla ma 'jam dbyangs bkra shis kyi sku skye dang rmu le rab 'byams pa mthun mong la mi nyag brgyud rmu le dang 'brel mtshungs nas dud sum brgya skor mi gra yong 'bab dang bcas pa sprad/ shar dar rtse mdo rgya bod kyi sa mtshams 'du sgo che zhing 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i yul gzhan las ches cher med du byung na'ang 'di phyi'i bde 'bras ma lus pa 'bad med du stsol ba'i mchod yul rnam dag mi 'dug gshis phyogs der gnas pa'i skye rgu rnams mngon mtho nges legs kyi sar bkri ba'i byed pa por sngags gra dga' ldan 'gro phan gling gi chos sde gsar tsugs dge 'dun lnga bcu skor la phogs/ tshong pa ru ba sogs 'dzin tshugs bzang ba/ kong po spung dkar bar bya lo phan bde bas 'dzin shul mtsho chu bye stod yod steng mdo chen dgon gsar rtsa 'jags ngos mtsho chur dge 'dun brgyad gra re gsar btsugs kyis sman bla dang kun rig gang rung gis sder phan thogs yong ba dgos tshul ltar phogs ja thug gi mthun rkyen (50ba)bstar zhing a mdo 'bu mis rta nyer drug dang dbang rgyal can drug sde bcas kyis nyis brgya gya brgyad/ gser thog rab 'byams pas nyer gcig /pā ras nang so can gyis bcu drug dang dbon pos nyi shu/ zung chu rdzan tsha sku skye can gyis brgyabadun rnams byung / tshes bcu bdun la rta ra mdo pa ngag dbang lhun grub dang spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtsho gnyis kyis bdog pa'i skyes bzang 'gyed bcas bskrun te gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/—71

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (getshes bcu dgur khal kha g.yas ru da'i ching gi mi sna dang dga' ldan da'i ching bo shog thu ji nong gi na chi can brgyad cu skor la ja gral bgyis/ nyer gnyis la 'ol dga' rdzing phyi ba dge 'dun ragasabasdus kyis mar gtsor btan gyi skyes bstar te mi 'gyur ba'i bden tshig brjod rjes sne mo ba tshor byin rlabs dang dmangs la me tog gtor/ mtshan sgrog mkhan po/ g.yon ru sku skye/ bo dong 'chi med sku skye/ mtshal mtha'i ji grags pa/ stag rtse tha'i ji lha rgyal rab brtan/ 'ga' shing rab 'byams pa'i tsha bo lang ju bla ma/ zhang ston ri khrod pa'i bu/ a mdo smad pa/ pā ras/ lang pu 'a shur sogs kyis rta bzhi brgya skor/ mtshams ra blo bzang don grub can gyis so brgyad/ dka' bcu rin cen blo gros can gyis nyer gnyis rnams byin cing thams cad la ja gral grol rjes tshoms chen steng nas me tog gtor/mdud pa dam rdzas sogs kyi ster cha gang 'tsham dang bcas bshul ring bgrod pa rnams kyi 'dod pa bkang (51na〉ri dar pa khu tshan 'khor zhag la 'gro khar mgon po zhal gyi bka' bsgo ster cha dang bcasathon/ nyer gsum snga ma nas phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi bsnyen pa kha gso bdun phrag bar byas/ nyer dgu nas gra tshang gis ce ring 'bum ther dang / gnam gang la lha ldan bsnyen gnas ma tsho yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom par bkod/hor zla bcu pa sngon ma'i tshes gnyis la mtshan sgrog mkhan po/ yer pa dang ri khud slob dpon pa/yang dgon/ thar pa gling pa/ rgyang ro gser sdings gsum gyi bla zur/ no mun e jen gi no yon khu thug thu/ er khe da'i ching / mer gan chos rje/ o rod bsod nams hung tha'i ji dpon mo bu bcas/ khal kha o rod kyi mi sna mang bar ja gral thog gsar 'byor rnams kyis gser dngul ja gos dar ras sga sogs dngos po stong phrag tu longs pa byin/ dmangs brgyad brgya skor la tsho mes chen steng nas me tog gtor/ phyi dro khal kha'i dpon khag gnyis/ mer gan chos rje/ tre bo/ ka thog bla ma sogs la tshe dpag med lha gcig ma'i tshe dbang / mgon po'i rjes gnang bar gcod kun sel/ sog dmangs spyir thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs kyi rjes gnang / er te ni 'bum gyi mi sna gnyis la bsnyen —72

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)rdzogs kyi sdom pa phab/tshes gsum la rgyal mo bsod nams chos 'dzom dang shag byang pa'i nang tshang la ja gral btang /'di nyin nas bzung zhag brgyad bar gra tshang nas 'dod khams dbang phyug ma dang rgyal po 51ba ) chen po rnam thos sras la mchod gtor spyan gzigs sngon 'gro'i bskang bshags rgyas par bstar/tshes bzhi nas rkang lag gi nad ro mi ldang ba'i ched gter sgrom gyi chu mtshan nyin bdun gyi bar bsten/tshes drug la bram ze de ba nan+da sa rus sbal/bya me na/ba bla khur gcig bcas byung bar gser srang do/ja khor gsum/gos kha bdun/snam dmar/lam yig khur gsos so gos dang /gan rā ma shrī ra gser zho gsum/ja bar khag/gos kha gsum/zur chas dang bcas re ba bkang /tshes dgur khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu pa chen po yun ring 'tsho zhing gzhes na spyi sger gyi bstan pa dar rgyas che bar bsam zhabs brtan gyi tshigs bcad/na bza' skor cha 'grig/ja gos dar sogs tshan grangs dang bcas dga' ldan khang gsar du 'bul bar dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa btang ste mi shigs rdo rje'i khams su byin gyis brlab par mdzad/tshes bco lngar shar phyogs bstan pa'i sgron me dwags po gra tshang rags bsdus po spams bstod bteg nas bden tshig dbyangs su gyer/sde drug mkhan po blo bzang dar rgyas khal kha nas wor pa'i skyosamar gser dngul ja gos dar rta sogs stong phrag tu longs pa/'grul sdebs bzod pa yel deng gi bu dang dal mo kha ra kho las kyi bu tshe brtan/lha btsun blo bzang bstan 'jin gyi mi sna er te ni dge slong /mel deng gi dal khal nang so/che chen ji nong gi dka' bstodze ta mu ni/yer khe 52na ) da'i ching gi er khe nang so/sangs rgyas skyabs/yo ga ga ri bla ma/be+e ro tsa na/blo bzang mgon po rab brtan sogs kyis rang rang gi stobs wor dang bstun bdog pa gang yod bstab/de rjes sems dpal sprul sku/bkra shis ljongs chos rje/gser mdog can mkhan po/skye chu mkhan po/mal dro 'chad ka spyan snga/gser mdog can shangs pa slob dpon grangs chen rab 'byams pa/gsang phu mchod khang bla ma/dgu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ( gegatar ja gsar ster mi bdun cu skor dang phrad/dwags po gra tshang /rdzing phyi mkhan po/gser mdog can mkhan slob sogs la ma ṇi'i bzlas lung /khal kha gnyis kyis gtsos rags bsdus la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma dang phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar gcod kun sel/sog dmangs la gur nas bshad pa'i 'byung 'dul dang spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang bskur/sems dpa' sprul pa'i sku 'di nyin nas 'di gar rgyun bzhugs mdzad/gser mdog can shangs pa slob dpon pa shākya nor bus rnam 'grel gyi rtsa ba/tshad ma kun las btus/so thar gyi mdo/spyod 'jug/dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab/bzhi brgya pa/'jug pa/'dul ba mdo rtsa/mngon pa kun las btus/sdom gsum rab dbye/tshad ma rigs bsdus/mngon pa mdzod/byams chos sde lnga/paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan pa'i rnam 'grel gyi ṭīk+ka kun bzang chos kyi 52ba ) rol mtsho sogs shog bu mda' tshad dgu brgya skor gsal dag byang gsum 'dzom pa'i rgyugs sprad par bstan pa'i mig rkyen gong 'phel la bsamasagos yug ja dar ras sogs kyis gzengs bstod/nged rang ring por 'tsho thabs su sde pa sogs kyisabaskul ma byung ba bzhin 'phyong rgyas kyi gzims chung bkra shis bkod pa'i tshe dpag med lha khang du skyon smin grol gling nas gra pa bzhi sde res tshe dpag med dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi tshe chog rgyun 'dzugs kyi phogs yon sogs bzang ba/rdzong gzhis khag dang ring 'tsho spel bar byon shor ba tshor btsugs pa bsdoms bka' 'gyur brgya dang dgu/gser 'od dam pa chig stong chig brgya nyer gcig/gser 'od rnga sgra chog stong drug brgya/mtshan brjod tshig 'bum sum stong /sgrol ma nyis 'bum lnga khri sum stong dgu brgya brgyad cu/gdugs dkar sa ya gnyis dang nyis 'bus nyi khri chig stong bdun brgya bzhi bcu/sher snying sum 'bum brgyad khri dgu stong sum brgya bdun cu/tshe gzungs lnga 'bum nyi khri lnga stong drug brgya/dbus gtsang gi dgon ang dang la 'gyed dge 'dun rer gshor khal gsum re/gnyis par gnyisare'i rtsis/mang ja bsngo rten deb gsal thog sa dge gnyis nas gdugs dkar/de phyin sgrol sher tshe gzungs gsum 'gro gang che'i 'gyed khyon bsdom/ gshor khal tshig 'bum drug khri tshig stong brgyad

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)brgya re gsum thob par 'bru dang dpus cha gang 'os/ bstan srid spyi rim la dri med bshags rgyud drug stong nyis brgya don lnga/ sgrol ma chig khri lnga stong / tshe gzungs (53na)sum khri sum stong / jus rim la sa dge'i dgon khag rnams su mang ja'i mthun rkyen gtang pa'i gtor bzlog dang mdo sgrub/ nad rims bzlog thabs su yul gru che chung dang bstun pa'i gsung sgrog /brgya bzhi/ ma mo dang bstan ma bstoganyis kyi mdos/ dgra lha dpangs bstod/ rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs kyi khrus/ rdo gzhis ka'i shing chag pa'i dog sel la shing tshab btsugs shing dmag zor ma'i gtor gzhi brjes nas bskang ba brgya tshar dgon par mang 'gyed/ spong dag /ma mo'i khrag mdos/ gzhi bdag rnams la gsol mchod snyan dar/sag thag go mtshon sogs kyi spyan gzigs spel/ mtsho sngon phyogs su ltas ngan pa sna tshogs byung 'dug pa bzlog thabs su gra sa phan tshun gnyis su ja tshul thog gdugs dkar bzhi 'bum lnga khri drug stong /sher snying sa ya gnyis dang chig 'bum bzhi khri drug stong lnga brgya/ mang ja sogs mthun rkyen sprad pa'i dbus gtsang gnyis ka'i dge lugs sngags gra rnams nas gtor bzlog dang bshad gra rnams nasamado sgrub/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg tshar bzhi bcu/ cha gsum tshig stong bdun brgya/ gra pa bzhi sdes gsur bsngo nyin gang ma/ pe skar dang ma mo'i mdos bud med brgya skor dang bya rog la sran rtsam gyi zan dang sha ston/ gdol pa'i rigs sum cur sha khrag dang bur chang / dge slong dang ā tsarla brgya skor la mar khu'i ston mo/ gdugs dkar dang 'char ga'i mdos/ mgon po g.yul bzlog /khro rol slang gang ma bdun rnams bsgrubs pas bar gcod kyi g.yul las rgyal lam snyam/(53ba lhas bco brgyad la rgyal legs bshad gling chos rje/ spyi gnyer dge 'dun sum cu skor gyis yul lugs dang bstun zang zing gi rigs brkyang ste ring por brtan pa'i smon lam shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan/ dga' ldan khri rin po che zur pa/ rgyal mkhan zur/ nyang rong gra tshang dang 'chad ka chos sde'i bla ma/ rgyal sras dge 'dun bkra shis sogs bod sog nyis brgya skor dang mjal phrad byas/rgyal pa'i bla gra/ mdo pa chos rje dge ba'i dbang po/ gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas bcas par tshe dpag med —75

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pogrub rgyal ma'i dbang dang rnam 'joms kyi lung bgyis/tshes nyi shur dar rtse mdo dga' ldan gzhan phan gling gi slob dpon du ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs/dbu mdzad dge rgan sogs la blo gros nor bu/ nor bu rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang dge legs gsum 'gro rgyu'i bla ma dang ngag dbang dge legs kyis thog drangs bsnyen rdzogs gya gsum dang dge tshul zhe gnyis/ dge bsnyen gsum rnams bsgrubs/ nyer gcig la khal kha no yon3kyi'i ching gi dge tshul ma bu bcas dang lho mos nas gnas gsar dbon rin po che phebs pa dang mjal zhing bstan ma khang du bzhugs/ nyer dgur a yo khi'i dpon mo bsod nams sgrol ma bu bcas/ ā nan+da'i dbon mo/ thor gong khon chong sogs gsar 'byor dang / dbu skor che ba sras sa chos rje dung dgon pa/ spong rong mngon dga' bla ma/ lcam mda' bla zur/ mnga' ris rab 'byams pa/ a rig gi rta skyel ba spyod pa bla ma can brgya skor/ sde pa phon mdo ba/ 'brong rtse ba rgyal phur rab brtan rnams la ja gral/ bod sog dmangs (54na〉kyim brgya skor la me tog gtor/ sgo mangs gra spyis bskul ba'i slob dpon don grub rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs/ yar 'brog pa blo gros legs bshad kyis gra tshang du snyan dar brgya dang sum cu skor phul ba'i kha byang / ra chen rdo rje grags kyi thugs dam rten rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bris thang zhal bshus zur 'phrin las rnam rgyal byed bcug pa'i rgyab yig /mdo stod dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling slob dpon pa blo bzang bdud 'joms kyis bskul ba'i zhakhrungs rabs dang / gu shrī ja'i sang gi ngor gsol 'debs/ ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs kyi ngor ring 'tsho bstan pa 'phel rgyas kyi smon lam/ 'bri lung pa blo bzang dpal 'byor gyi ngor rje dge 'dun grub pa'i 'khrungs rabs/ rje bla ma/ bde gshegasabargyad/ gdugs dkar rnams kyi rgyab yig /ri khud bla mas bskul ba'i lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya dang ring 'tsho/ grong smad dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mo'i sdig sbyong la sman bla'i stong thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam/ mchod dpon pa dang dga' gdong sngags rams pa'i ngor log tri'i sbyin sreg lag len gsal byed/ lha sa byang gling pas chos 'khor rgyal du sbub chol spyi rdzas su sbyar nas 'dzugs rgyu'i ring —76

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ dgon thang pa dgos pa rdo rje'i ngor 'bral med rjes 'dzin gyi smon lam rnamasabartsams/ chu shur 'phrang gdong shar par sngar 'dzin khral rkang gcig tu rkang gnyis rtsa chag thog lcang gling sgang khungs nas g.yog mo bran gsum dang lag 'debs brgyad cu skor thon pa byin/ sgam po nyi thang dgon bla ma gra bcas kyis rta nyer gnyis/ lha ri (54ba8 dgon gyis dgu/ nag shod ra dar bla mas so gcig /a rig spyod pa bla mas drug cu re brgyad rnams byung /hor zla bcu pa rting ma'i tshes gcig la yul jo'i thu pā thur tha'i jis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam dang / em chi thabs mkhas kyis gra tshang du snyan shal brgya skor phul ba'i kha byang / dge slong blo gros rgyal bas nged rang gi 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig rnams bris/ 'di nyin nas bzung zla gcig bar dga' gdong sngags rams pas rdo rje slob dpon byas te sngags rgod log tri'i srung bzlog bsad mnan gyi sgrub ba rgyas par gtsugs/tshes gsum la sde drug mkhan chen blo bzang dar rgyas kyis bdog pa'i rim pa rgya cher bteg nas 'gyed dang bcas gra tshang gis gzims chud brtan bzhugs su grags pa mdzad/ sdings po che sprul sku/ yang dgon bla zur be ser bla ma/ lcam mda' bla mar 'gro mi gong dkar gser gling slob dpon pa/ gling dge slong gi nu bo/ paṇ+ḍita klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis ster cha byed mi rnams la ja gral btang /tshes bzhir bco brgyad chos rje gnas gsar dbon rin po che/ mdo pa chos rje dge dbang / ri khud bla ma/ nā lan+da slob dpon sogs la nyang gi drag dmar gyi byin rlabs lu gu rgyud/ phyag drug pa'i gtor dbang bar gcod kun sel byas/ tshes bdun la mkhan chen khyab bdag zha lu pa dga' ldan khang gsar nas rtser phebs/ tshes brgyad nas gra tshang gis gza' mdos dang dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi bskang ba zhag brgyad re smin rgyas su bstar/ tshes bcur khyab bdag rin cen bsod namasamachog grub la drag dmar gyi byin rlabs lu gu rgyud (55na skong 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe dbang brgya tshar phul/ tshes bcu gsum la 'brong rtse ba rgyal phur rab brtan gyis tshogs chas rung mthun gyi gos —77—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (kesogs gos dar ras cha' dngos po dang bcas rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i tshe dpag med longs sku ma'i sgo nas gra tshang gis cho ga rgyas par btang / sgom sde nang chen pas rta nyi shu byin pa rtsis blangs/tshes bcu drug la mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rje dbon nam mkha' bsod nams/ mdo pa chos rje dge ba'i dbang po so so nas bdog pa'i tshan grangs ring por brkyang nas bden tshig smon lam yong dag gis mtshams sbyor mdzad/ phyag mdzod bsod nams rin cen dang / ma he mchod pa'i dus tsa mun+ti'i 'cham pa'i sngags par bar gcod las rgyal ba'i bka' bsgo dang rdzong bda' bgyis/ tshes bcu bdun la blo bzang mgon po rab brtan ming sring / u zhang nang mi bstobadun/ yer khe chos rje/ dar khan chosarje/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ dur bod dpon mo sgrol ma/ dpon mo rgya mtsho sogs mang dag dang phrad/ de steng sog dmangs bsnan pa'i stong brgal bar skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i rjesaganang dang / phyi dro bde chen tha'i ji/ chos 'khor rgyal bla spyi/ kong po chu dag dgon bla ma sogs la ja gral bgyis/ than ltas kha shas byung ba zhi thabs su gdugs dkar mdos chen bzhi/ khro rol slang gang ma lnga/ rtse sgang du dgra lha dpangs bstod/ kong gzha de mo gsol zhing mchod/ na kha tso 'og mar sgrub rten sa bsnon du ra ma rtse yon tan gyi lto skal khungs sras khang gzhis (55ba)ka'i lag 'debs nasazhing gsum la thon khal so lnga skor sprad/tshes bco brgyad la no munas jen gyi dge tshul ma bu/ brag la bla ma/ sha rang sgrub sde'i bla ma bcas pa dang phrad cing chos rje dge ba'i dbang por bka' bsgo bdog pa bstar te thon/ 'di wo nas ho me zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bzhi'i bar thang lha'i gsol mchod btang ba'i snga phyir kha ba cher babs pa ni dri za'i rgyal po mnyes pa'i mtshan mar go /bstan pa spyi dang khyad par chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa rin po che ga rjes spras su bya ba'i slad dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes sgo thar gyi sdom pa bsrungs pas gnas skabs su mngon par mtho ba'i srid pa rgyun mar thob cing mthar thug sgrib —78

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa'i dgra tsho gis bcom par med thabs dang bral ba'i phyir/ sum brgya par/ nyon mongs dgra la khul rgyal byed tshul khrims te/ /dge tshul ༅ la zhugs chu len brtsigs pa dang / /'chi ba'i mche ba 'byin par byed pa'i thabs/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpal nod dbang bskur yin/ /zhes dang / 'dul ba sman gyi gzhin/ dge slong dag tshul khrims goms par byas na ting nge 'dzin yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin goms par byas na shes rab yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro/ shes rab goms par byas na 'di lta ste/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang /gti mug las sems yang dag pa kho nar rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes thub gsung brgyad khri bzhi stong (56na)rnams snying por dril na sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum/ de nang nas mngon pa dang mdo sdes bstan pa'i go rdzo kyang ston pa'i go mi chod cing 'dul ba gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/ slob dpon chos kyi tshong dpon gyis/rgyal ba ston pa de yi dam chos dag /mdo dang chos ma' yin gsung 'dul ba ni/ /ston dang bstan bcos dngos yin de yi phyir/ /gnyis 'gyur phyag byas sangs rgyas khyod gcig bzhin/ /zhes khyad par 'phags pa'i sdom pa de'ang som nyir lus na rgyu 'bras mi 'chol bar 'byung bas na 'bras bu'ang de lta 'byung ba las ma 'das pas nges shes 'drongs pa zhig gal che ba bod yul gling dgu'i rgyal khams 'dir bstan pa snga dar la za hor rgyal rigs mkhan chen bo dha sa twas sad mi mi bdun sogs la bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa'i sdom rgyun 'dzugs par mdzad pa log smon nye bar bdo ste glang dar ma 'u dum btsan gyis bstan pa bsnubs pa'i tshe chu bo ri'i sgom gra'i dmar g.yo gtsang gsum gyis gsan pas gsang thabs kyis drel rgyab non pa'i 'dul dpe dang bcas mnga' ris nas byang lam brgyud mdo smad rma lung dan tig yang rdzong du bzhugs par bon gyi bu shes rab can sngon las sad de rab tu byung bar bskul ba 'dul 'dzin gsum gyi steng rgya'i hwa shang ke 'bag gnyis kyis kha skong bar mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mtshan dgongs pa rab gsal du btags pas spa par gnyis/ ja cog gnyis/ bshad srags gnyis/ 'al bsnub gnyis/ zong tshur gnyis sogs mang dag sdom par —79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (kebakod de skabs dbus gtsang du sdom pa 'bogs len (56ba)dang 'chad nyan sogs kyi rgyun lo bdun cu tsam chad pa'i rjes dbus su mdo smad na bstan pa cung zad tshugs pa mnga' bdag tsha la nas sogs kyis gsan pa cis kyang 'bad pas bstan pa spel bzhed de klu mes tshul she/ 'bring ye ston/ rba tshul blo/rag tshul 'byung / sum pa ye blo lngar mthun rkyen dang bcas brdzangs pa gtsang gi btsad po rnams kyisakyang thos nas lo ston/ tshong btsun mnga' ris pa gnyis/ bo dong pa ste dbus gtsang gi mi bcus bla chen por bsnyen par rdzogs pa las mched pa ka bzhi gdung drug dang lo tsho tshong tsho sogs mang du dar/'a zha ye g.yung gi chab gtor ma dang / 'bre'i der bas ma gnyis kyi rgyun kyang gtsang phyogs su mang po 'phel/ klu mes kyi slob ma gzus la bu chen bzhi byung ba'i phyi ma gsum dang rgya 'dul dbang tshul 'i rgyas rgya cher spel bar snga phyi bar tshar sogs shin tu mang /bstan pa phyi dar la lo chen rin bzang sogasasnga rabs pa'i 'dul 'dzin sdom rgyun der brten pa dang / lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus 'phags yul shar phyogs kyi paṇa chen dharma pā la'i slob ma pā la rnam gsum las kyang mang du 'phel ba stod 'dul bar grags/ ma pham pa'i rnam sprul khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis dka' ba brgya phrag khyad du sad nas kha che'i bsod snyoms pa paṇa chen shākya shrī gangs can bsod nams gsog pa'i mgron du spyan drangs te chu shul srog ma dgon par nyin gcig la sgrub ga gsum dang mi gnyis bsnyen par rdzogasapa'i nang nas gro shul ba kher gad byang chub dpal dang / gtsang pa rdo rje (57na8pal gnyis mkhan bu'i gtso bor gyur te bod mun gling 'dul bstan nyi zla ltar shar bas khyab cing / khyad par sa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ srid gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ shes bya kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs/ rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po sogs skyes chen dam pa de dag gis 'dul bstan gyi rgyal mtshan phyogs thams cad du 'dzugs par mdzad la/ bla chen sdom rgyun bka' gdams sogs phal mo ches phyag len la 'debs par mdzad par ma dag pa'i skur pa btab na chos spong gi sgrib pa gsog —80

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang gleg bam gsum pa/ (5)mod/ 'on kyang bla chen po'i bsnyen rdzogs mdzad dus kha skong gi rgya ban gnyis sprul pa yin min the tshom pa'i sgros rnying dang chab bas sogs kyis kyang sbags ma sbags mngon shes kyis dpyod ma shes pa'i steng paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi mkhan po paṇa chen dam chos yar 'phel gyis thog mar shangs ston blo gros legs bzang la bsnyen par rdzogs pa spos khang tshogs paṇa chen gyi brgyud pa yin cing slar thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho al than rgyal po'i ti shrī ra gdan drangs pa'i tshe bskyar bsgrubs skabs sdom gsum rim gyis nod na bla chen dang bsnyen rdzogs kho na yin tshe sdom pa gzugs can dbang gis phyi ma mi skye na'ang gang yin chos 'byung rnam thar tshor mi gsal bas brgyud pa som nyi'i dra bar chud pa dang / phyag len la'ang tsho gis kyis tshogis la las mi bya ba bya (57ba)bsamatshon 'dul ba'i chos skad mang po zhig pa snga phyir bstan pa rin po che 'dzugs par chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum sogs kyis dka' ba de tsam spyad pa yal 'dor blos ma bzod cing rje btsun btsong kha pa chen pos kyang tshag mig mkhan chen tshul rin par paṇa chen sdom rgyun bzhes pa bcas rang lo rgan po re gcig par slebs kyang rang gzhan mang por phan res brtson pa bskyed de stod 'grel ba'i lugs ltar 'phags yul skad du yid la ste ljongs 'dir dmar ser can gyi lo mgo zla'i dmar cha'i rdzogasapa gnyis pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rang bzhin 'du ba rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po ngo mtshar med byung bkod pa'i zhing khams su gshegs pa'i dus chen dus 'khor ba'i dbyangs ā/ gsal byed ska 'byung ba nam mkha'/ 'dod yon sgra/ dbyangs 'char ba'i dbyangs o/ gsal byed ṭha/ 'byung ba nam mkha'/ 'dod yon sgra/ gnyis ka mthun par dar gud smin pa/ res gza' pad+ma'i gnyen dar zhing / las skar me bzhi dga' ma dang brtse ba'i 'chi med 'grub pa'i sbyor ba/ 'phrod wo yid/ sbyor ba skal bzang byed pa bi phyi/ rten 'brel rnam shes/ spre'u'i nyi ma/ tshes spar dwa/ sme ba bzhi ljang rnamasashar ba'i snga dro'i cha nyin gung ma sleb tsam pa grib tshod rkang pa gcig gi tse dzā ti'i me tog gi 'khri shing 'khrigs pa'i tshal nas za 'og thags su bskrun pa'i kun bzod kyi khyon la gnas so cog gi skye dgu spyi —81—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (podang bre brag mtha' bzhi'i rgyal po sogs dregs ldan thams cad kyi 'dud sa dge bcu'i yon tan kun tshang gangs can yul ljongs mtha' dag gi (58na)sa'i lte ba bzhi'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag cig car 'byed gnas rang byung 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzhal med khang pho brang chen po po ta la'i rtse mor lung sde snod gsum la mkhas shing mngon rtogs bslab pa gsum gyis thugs rgyud yongs su gang ba mi 'phrog pa'i thugs rje dang dmigs pa med pa'i mkhyen brtse nus ldan brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis sogs khyad par bdun tshang 'phags pa'i gnas brtan nye bar 'khor dang dbyer ma mchis pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mkhan slob sbrags ma mdzad/ sgra don rig gnas kun la nang byan chud pa tshangs ris 'dzin pa'i dbang pos gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon/ gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas grib tshod pa/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab dang rat+na mnyu rnam gnyis kyis kha skong / dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba dang bcas lnga'i tsho gos kyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po yang bskyar bsgrubs/ de nas zhag shas bar bdag gis mkhan po/khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos slob dpon/ kha skong dang bcas pas snga dgongs re re dang mgyogs dusasgrub gra bdun re tsam las mi zin/ snga ma'i phyag len la gos byin rlabs sum tshan las gral pasarogs byed cing bsnyen rdzogs kyi mngon gyur bcu'i tha ma las mngon gyur tsam sum tshan du gcod pa ma gtogs gzhan thams cad sdebs su byas chog gshis nyin (58ba)rer nyis brgya tsam grub pa'i las sla zhing chod che ba brel ba che skabs zor yang ba'i tshad cig yod kyang da lam gyi 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bstan la bya ba cung zad byas par song bas sems can la'ang shugs la phan nam snyam rang las sla'ang bstan par phan khyad kyis brtson pa bskyed do/ /mtshams grol nas ste pa blo bzang sbyin pa dang / de rjesamakhan chen zha lu pa dang chos rje dbon rin po cher dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi rig gtad phul/tshes brgyad la dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub dpal bzang —82

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)por stobs 'phrog dbang po dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa sgrub dus mthun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang zhus/ khal kha bzod pa yel deng gi sras dpon mo g.yog bcas brgya skor dang phrad/ 'phyos chang khyim pa'i bu gra tshang du zhugs ston dkar dro tshan grangs dang bcas bteg /spyi sgos kyi blang dor zhu bar bsam yas su spun bdun pa lhun grub mtsho dang / la mor dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa tshogs 'khor spyan gzigs bdog pa dang bcas brdzangs/tshes bcu gcig la mtha' klas dkyil 'khor mnga' bdag bco brgyad chos rjes bskul ma mdzad pa'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad brtsams shing lha chen zur phud lnga pa'i rig gtad phul/ tshes bcu bzhir sprul pa'i sku mchog gter ston rigs 'dzin chen por tshan grangs ring por brkyang ste snga 'gyur bstan pa rgya cher spel ba'i slad snyan ngag nas drangs pa'i tshigs bcad bcas rtsis rig smra ba phu lung dge slong blo bzang yon tan rdzong bda' bgyis/ bram ze so (59na)dwa gi mi shra se nā si go kū la shrī ba/ mo bhi rte bcas par sa zla zho gsum/ ja khor bzhi/ gos chen/ zur mas sogs kyi phan pa bsgrubs/tshes bco lngar bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po dpon mo sras bcas dbu sgor chung ba/ er te ni da'i ching gi shog pā thur kho sho'u chi/ chog thu dge tshul/ rgyal sras bsod nams bkra shis/ g.yon ru sku skye/ma gcig dge tshul/ thor god mgon po yel deng gi tsha bo dang dur ge chi dur phod ma li/ dka' ngag dbang don grub bzhi'i mi sna/ sbu dkar bla mar 'gro mi blo bzang kun dga'/ rgyas gra rab 'byams pa/gnyer pa lha skyabs/ mtshur phu phyag mdzod/ 'od gsal gling bzur/ gzims khang shar bla ma/ zhang ston bstan rgyal gyi bu/ dwags po lcang ra nas/ lum pa nas sogs la ja gral btang / phyi dro blo bzang mgon po rab brtan dang bu jing dha ra dge tshul ma 'khor bcas kyis 'byor bstun gyi bdog pa bteg pa bsngo smon gyi rgyas btab/ byings bod sog tshig stong nyis brgya skor la me tog gtor/ rab 'byamasapa dge 'dun bsam grub kyis rta nyi shu dang 'bri gung nas rta bcu byung /tshes bcu drug la lha chen tshangs pa dung thod can gyi sku rten dbang 'dus rgyal po dang btsun mo tshal —83

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gebacas pas zang:nga gi tshan grangs 'gyed sogs sbyar te gra tshang nas mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten gzimasachung brtan bzhugs su grags pa bstar/ chos skyong gis ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad blo ka bzhi pa zhig gsungs 'dug pa dang bstun gra tshang du btsugs 59bsko mtshungs lha sa chu mig kha pas kyang bgyis/bsod nams dbang rgyal gyi ma/dpon mo phun tshogs dpal 'dzom bu bcas/dga' ldan rab 'byamasapa'i tsha bo rab brtan/er khe ji nong gi bla ma dge 'dun bsam grub/mer gan ji nong gi dpon mo bu bcas/stag lung lhun grub rdzong pa yab yum sras bcas kyi ngo ma tshor byin rlabs dang dmangs brgya skor la me tog gtor/shel dkar chos sde'i gra pa dge slong blo bzang bsam grub kyis lam rim gyi khrid 'jam dpal zhal lung gi rgyugs sprad/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i skur 'tshub ltas shig shar ba sel byed du rkarma gu ru'i gter skus gtsos tshan grangs spel zhing mi 'gyur bden tshig brjod pa'i 'phrin yig dang bcas 'bul mi ched du mngags/rdzong gzhis khag kha shas nas nged rang ring por 'tsho thabs la 'bum rgyas pa tshar drug brgya bdun cu/brgyad stong pa brgya/gzungs 'dus drug brgya re bdun/mtshan brjod tshig stong nyis brgya drug cu/sgrol ma chig 'bum nyi khri drug stong dgu brgya re gcig gdugs dkar sa ya gcig dang chig 'bum lnga khri drug stong nyis brgya drug cu/sher snying nyis 'bum nyi khri drug stong dgu brgya zhe gcig/tshe gzungs lnga 'bum drug khri lnga stong nyis brgya/sāts+tsha khri/khro rol gnyis/srog blu brgya/sde pa'i rim gror bka' 'gyur bcu gcig/sgrol ma nyis 'bum nyi khri/sher snying chig 'bum sum khri/gdugs dkar tshig 'bum/srog blu lo grangs/rgyal po'i gegs sel la sher snying tshig 'bum brgyad stong /tshe gzungs sa yabacu ga dang nyis 'bum brgyad khri/bstan 60na ) srid spyi rim du mang ja'i mthun rkyen sprad pa'i sngags dgon rnams nas ga bzlog dang spyod gra tshos mdo sgrub/khro rol ga snya/das brtsegs/thang yig dang sde lnga/dpal gsol rnams brgya re/bstan ma bcu gnyis dang srid pa chagasapa'i lha chen tshor gsol mchod/ dmag zor mar bskang ba stong / gur zhal phyag bzhi par brgya re/bod khams spyi'i bde thabs su gnas wo khag ༷/ra brgya mar sna lnga re/sman bla drug stong brgyad

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang gleg bam gsum pa/ (ja)brgya/ sgrol ma nyi khri sum brgya/ sher snying drug stong dgu brgya/ tshe gzungs dgu khri/ phyon chen po'i sgrub gnas brgyad du khad gang nye'i sngags 'chang bcu phrag res nyin brgyad kyi bar tshogs brgya/ nyin gnyis sbyin sreg /rtags ngan dus min gyi me tog gang shar sar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ klu bcos/ gong dkar nas khro rol dang mgon po g.yul bzlog /pha rol po'i byad ka bzlog phyir phyag bzhi pa'i bskang ba stong phrag gsum/ ra sabs ma yas khra 'brug gsum du brgya mchod sna lnga re/ mchod rten lnga bcu la zhig gsos/ sa g.yos pa'i ngan bzlog tu 'bum tshar lnga/ gshin rje nag po'i dgra mnan bzhi/ nad rims mi 'byung ba'i ched ri 'go mtho sar bsangs dang dar lcog brgya re/ rgyu 'gros chung zhing rim gror 'gyur khyad kyi mi ser dud re nas rtsam phul re bsdus de phyin dgos cha gzhung nas sprad pa'i sgrol ma sa ya/rdzong gzhis che kha nas rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs khrus kyis lha mi rnams kyi ma dag pa'i dri ma dbyung ba'i sbyor ba byed bcug /nyer dgur gser chos tshor (60ba)mos dungs che ba ltar go don phyag bzhes rnams ma bslabs shes kyi gras su rang nyid ma tshud par brten chos stong che chung las mkhan dang bcas pa dang dmar po skor gsum gyi las rab 'byams la ga tu blang bya'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum dpe ris kyis mtshon dka' gnas thams cad la 'os tshodi min par/ kha sbyor las/ bstan bcos tshad ma slob dpon dang / /lung gi rjes gong de nyid rig /gsang ston de nyid dngos po yang / /gcig nas gcig brgyud shes par bya/ /bla ma rab kyi zhal las blang / /zhes pa ltar bla ma tshad ma/ nyams myong tshad ma/ bstan bcos tshad ma/lung tshad ma ste bzhis gtan la dbab dgos pa bzhin drin can khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen por dog gnas kyi shog hril du ma phul bar bla ma dbu yon pa tsho dang mi 'dra'i gshis 'di ni 'di 'o'i bka' mchan dang / lhag par ngos kyis dka' gnas thams cad kyi don dri bas gtan la phab par yi ger bkod pa gcig tu blun po snying kham can gyi lag tu tshud na rgyun med bzhin du dper bla ma 'chol ba'ang srid pas dge med gsang sgrog gi skyon du mchis mod/ gnyis su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa khyab —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pobadag bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i rigs cho me kyi dbon nam mkha' bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po sogs bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi rjes 'jug bstan 'dzin rnams la med mi rung lta bu'i gnad kun chad tshe bstan rgyun nyams pa ma bzod par yi ger 'dri bar chos srung rnams bka' gnyan pas rung mi rung brtag pa'i phyir mgon khang phur chos skyongs dngos dang dbyer med pa'i rten byin can bkram (61na)pa'i mdun mchod gtor spyan gzigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshams te gra pa kha shas kyis mkha' 'gro rnam lnga dgyes pa bskyed nas gnang ba thob dgos pa/ dkar chag snying gi bdud rtsi zil dngar las/ 'og min zhing dang dur khrod brgyad sogs 'jigs pa'i gnas na khros pa'i gar mdzad bstan dgra'i srog dbugs ga pa de ni phyi yi mgon po zhes su grags/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo rnam lnga'i rtsa khams rlung gi ngo bo bzung 'dzin srog 'phrog lhan skyes ye shes sbyin mdzad de ni nang gi chosaskyong gang de nyid/ /phyi nang sgyu 'phrul dregs pa'i rol rtsed rang sems gcig bu'i dbyings su zhugasapas gsal stong zung 'jug brjod bral de ni gsang chen rgyud gsum dregs pa'i dngos/ /a ho snang srid dregs pa'i rang zhal rjen par mthong ba'i rang rig ye shes 'gyur med bde bas myos pa de ni phyag dang mchod pa'i rab dang phul/ /zhes pa'i zab gnad dang ldan pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la chos skyong grangs med mnga' ba'i gtso bo yin te/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtses/ bgrang yas bstan srung kun gyi sde dpon che/ /dran pas snying gi mun sel rdo rje gur/ /zhes par rgyun 'dzin kyang / dkar chag zab don gsal sgron las/ kho bos rgyal khams yangs pa'i phyogs kun myul/ /mkhas grub bla ma mang po'i zhabs pad bsten/ /rang gzhan gdams pa zab mo'i gnad kun shes/ /dag dang ma dag 'byed pa'i spobs pa thob/ khyad par nag po chen po'i man ngag ni/ /brgyud ldan bla ma bcu phrag gcig (6stob)la zhus/ /'gran zla kun bral drin can rdo rings pa'i/ /snyan brgyud zab mo bum pa gang byor thob/ /e waṃ pa ni bsdus la spros pa chung / /mus srad pa ni dkar chag khrigs chags can/ /rdo rje gdan pa 'chamasadang nus pa'i bdag kho bos thob pa'i thun mong brgyud pa gsum/ /zhes thun mong ba dang thun mong —86—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)ma yin pa phyi ma sa skya tshang gi rna bar ma grags pa zhal ngo nang brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan grub pa'i 'khor sgyur bi rū pa/rdo rje gdan pa/bram ze mchog sred so gos bka' babs du ma mnga' ba de nyid kyi bka' rgya 'grol ba'i tshe/bsam 'phel nor 'phreng las/phyi nang gsang ba'i man ngag zhu ba'i tshe//tsho gos dang gtor mas mkha' 'gro mnyes par byas//rin chen gser gyi maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phul//gsang chen grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i dam bca' byas//zhes pa dang mtshungs pas rten 'brel bsgrig phyir gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas kyis ma grub par mchod gtor dbul zhing 'phrin las bcol/gnang bar shes nas yi ge 'bri mkhan yang dbang dang rjes gnang thob dgos pa ltar dpal grong sngags ram pa dang /bstan 'dzin dbang po gnyis bco brgyad chos rjer zhu bzhi ste 'phrod sbyor bzang por dbu btsugs/dpe 'tshol dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas byas phyi mtshams se ba'i ring nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen 'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i zab don sgo lcags 'byed pa'i rin cen lde mig dang /mkhyen rab dang dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje'i mnga' bdag gdan sa gong nasabadag chen rin po tshe kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug bkra shis62na grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang rigs sras kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gnyis kyis tshar wo rdo rje 'amang gis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i gur mgon gyi 'khor lo'i dpe ris kyi don nyams su blang bde zhig gyis shig ces bka' phebs par rigs kun khyab bdag zha lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos legs so stsal ba dang du blangs/rang gi dran gso dang rje bas mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan dpal bzang po'i rigs dbon 'a zha nam mkha' bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po sogs rjes 'brang rnams la phan pa'i blos gsal byed mthong bas don ldan bkod/khyab gdal du 'dri mi rung ba 'a zha mkhyen rab rnam rgyal/gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/bon phrug pa ngag dbang rab brtan rnams nyi 'od mdor phying gur phub ste 'dri bcug/ 8

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pehor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la ra ba stod bla ma'i kha skongs su drung chen phun tshogs chos ldan gyi gsol 'debs/ rgya mtsho dge tshul ma'i ngor smon lam/ blo bzang thogs med kyi 'dra 'bag gi kha byang / ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'i yang gsang drag po'i rgyab yig /ngag dbang tshul khrims kyis dge skos 'jog la dngul srang bco lnga'i pad sder phul ba'i kha byang / rgyal ba chos rje'i rgyun gyi smon lam/g.yon ru sku skye'i ngor pha bong kha pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i gsol 'debs/ dbon blo bzang mkhas btsun gyi ngor sprul sku myur 'byon gyi smon lam/ dga' ldan gsang sngags gling spyi'i ngor ring 'tsho/ dkyil khang bla ma blo bzang (62ba)mgon po'i gsol 'debs/ bkras rab pa dka' bcu kun dga' rgya mtsho'i bris thang lnga'i rgyab yig /blo bzang thugs rjes gra skor btang ba'i tshe gra tshang du dngul srang nyer gsum gyi kong phul ba'i kha byang / mkhan chen zha lu pa chen po'i gsung bzhin zhad blon gyi 'phrin bcol dang rim lnga'i khrid yig za ma tog gi kha 'byed lde mig gi sbyar byang 'phros/ grong smad kyi deb kyi 'go brjod/ dar mo sman rams pas lha sar mchod 'bul gyi smon lam/ dkon gnyer dge slong kun dga' can gyi 'jog gi dkyil thang rgyab yig /rje'i rim lnga gsal sgron gyi par byang rnams so so'i 'dod pa dang bstun te bris/tshes gnyis la stag lung zur pas rta bdun cu don gsum sogs spams bstod de tshoms chen du 'gyed yon dang bcas mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sgo nas tshe ring por spel ba'i cho ga mdzad/ lcags zam sku skye/ rgyal legs bshad gling chos rje/ sger pa rje drung / dpon mo rgya mtsho/ mtsho kha nas gsar 'byor dga' ldan rab 'byams pa tsha bcas kyis rta brgya dang bcu gnyis kyis thog drangs bdog pa bteg /ser ji sogs lnga brgya skor dang phrad/ lcags zam sku skye dang dpon mo rgya mtshor bka' bsgo bstar/ phyi dro stag lung zhabs drung sku rkyang dang mjal dge skyon gyi gsung gleng smar ba byung / de rjes rgyal mo bsod namasachos 'dzom/ khal kha no yon khu thug thu/ nyi sdings slob dpon pa rnams la byin rlabs dang brgya skor la me tog gtor/ rme ru em chi thabs mkhas spun gyis yon dang dngos po brkyang ste tshes gsum la gra —88

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa spel 63na ) bdag chen yab sras gnyis dbon rin po che sogs bstan 'dzin rnams kyi ched/tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gis/de ltar rgyal pa'i dri med rgyud sde las//gsungs pa'i bstan srung kun gyi mchog gyur pa//drag shul mthu ldan stobs 'phrog nag po zhes//rgya bod mkhas grub kun la rlung ltar grags//zhes sa rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub/ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa/ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma sogs paṇa grub du ma'i chos skyong gi gtso bo gnyan la dar ma grags kyi srung ma brgya rtsa'i mchog rje btsun sa skya ba yab sras la bka' babs pa'i mgon po chung ba 'di ṣ+ka/de yang thog mar tsho gos kyi 'bor lo dang //rin wo gser gyi maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa//snyan brgyud dang po'i rten 'brel kun bsgrigs nas//zhes pa ltar ma 'phyugasapar byas te dpal mgon stobs 'phrog gdong bzhi pa'i 'khor lo'i gsal byed yang gsang snying gi khrag thig bris/rnam sras gling pa dang 'tsho byed ngag dbang lhag bsam la ja gral/mchod pa'i bye brag kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin dper len pa bzhin mu tig sogs rin po che legs nges sna tshogs phra bskongs dang bcas pa'i dra ba dra phyed kyi lda ldi bkod legs sde pa sbyin pas khur len mdzad pa tshes brgyad la phur sgrub tshugs pa'i spyan gzigs su dbul/rgya bod kyi yig rnying dang rjes 'brang mkhas grub rnams kyis gsal byed rim mdzad bla ma dam pa'i zhal gyis drod rlangs nyams med dmar 'khrid du ngo sprod mdzad pa las lhag pa'i gnad zur ba med kyang snang la ma nges kyi the tshom rnams rje bla ma'i drung du dogs gcod 63bgo dka' slar bltos med zhus pa yid la gang zin rigs dbon la sogs bstan 'dzin rnams kyi ched rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i man ngag gi dogs sel snying bcud zil dngar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes ba chu'i nyin bris/tshes bcu bzhir zur thams cad 'phro pa'i mchog sprul/dga' ldan da'i ching bo shog thu ji nong /yul jo'i thu pā thur tha'i ji rnams la ja gral bgyis/tshes bco brgyad la bsod nams dbang rgyal ma bu/dga' chags a bo bkra shis rab brtan gnyer pa/dga' ldan da'i ching gi sog dmangs log mi 89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pobazhi brgya sogs bod sog bdun brgyar nye bar ka sbungs steng nas skyer sgang lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang dang me rtag gtor/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs dngar por 'thul ba'i zab chos tshig brgyud du bzhugs pa mi nub pa'i phyir bla ma dam pa'i rigs dbon rin po che sogs slob bshad 'dzin nges la phan pa'i blos chos skyong che chung las mkhan dang bcas par mchod gtor phul zhing bka' rgya bkrol nas 'dri ba'ang / dbang sdud pad+ma rā ga'i za ma tog kha 'byed gnad kyi lde mig las/ gangs can 'di na dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /gser chos zab mo dmar po skor gsum zhes/ /ming tsam skye bo kun la rlung ltar grags/ /ji bzhin shes pa'i sngags 'chang nyin skar tsam/ shes rlom phal cher 'bab chus rdzing bu bzhin/ /thun mong lung dang rjes gnang tsam gyis khengs/ /sprin chen chu sa rgya mtsho ji bzhin du/ /yongs rdzogs gdams pa'i bcud ldan kho bo tsam/ /zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa'i (64na)rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le/ lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po/ khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po gsum gyi 'khor lo'i gsal byed khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu 'di'ang tshes nyi shu pa sangs me bzhi 'dzom pa'i 'phrod dge bar brtsams/ glegs bam du gab dkrugs 'thor ba'i tshul du yod pa gsal byed phan tshun 'phrul shes dgos mod/ 'on kyang zhal shes phyag len mdzub 'khrid du nos pas shes nus rung rang gi blo gros kyis ma rtogs pa dang log rtog the tshom gyi dra bar chud pa rnams blo mig chung ngus gang mthong rje bla ma'i drung du bcad brdar gyis gtan la phab pa rnams 'di nyid kyi ring lugs 'dzin nges la phan pa'i bsam pas gang zin gser chos dmar po skor gsum gyi dka' gnad mdud 'grol gyi reg zig la dmar po'i chun po dmar phyags mkha' 'gro kun 'du ba nyer gsum la bkod/nyer drug la dbus dpung dmag dpon bzhis gtsos drung 'khor dmag nas lor ba ragasabasdus dang phrad/ rta tshag rje drung gis rta drug cu re gcig dang a yo shi'i bsngo rten la nyer gcig byung /lha sar sgo 'gyed la dud rer mkhar lhag do re bsdoms 'khor drug ma so brgyad dang / nad rims bzlog thabs su bod skyong bstan ma gnas khag bcu bdun la sku mdog dang mthun pa'i dar lcog dmod byang —90

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)spel chag bcas gsol mchod dang lo mthug gi tshe bdag sgrub mchod btang /dgung lo re gnyis par chos 'khor rgyal gyi rten mchod gsar bsgrigs mdzad skor dang / bsgrub bya mang por paṇa chen lugs kyi sdom rgyun stsal ba/'dus sde khag nas ring 'tsho'i brtan bzhugs phul zhing bstan srid kyi jus rim chos sbyin rgya che spel ba sogs kyi skor/badz+ra la dū ti ste dus kyi pho nya zhes pa sa rta gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i zhogs 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bskang bstod rten 'bul dang bcas bzabs rgyas (64ba)kyis mchod/ tsho gos chen du gung gi ston mor mchod yon zung / dga' ldan rab stims pa/ dga' ldan da'i ching bo shog thu ji nong /bkra shis bā thur tha'i ji/ blo bzang mgon po rab brtan sogs dbon khag bzhi bcu skor dang ja'i sang mi bzang bsdoms phyed sum brgya lhag bcas/ ja stan mkhan zur/ sems dpal sprul sku/ gnas rnying sku skye/ rgyud stod chos rje/ gra sa phan tshun gyi slob dpon/ g.yon ru sku skye/ khal kha no yon khu thug thu/mngon dga' bla ma spong rong chos rnga/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i drung 'khor dang bcas pa'i mdun skabasagasum dbang po'i phun tshogs la 'khru ba'i bdog pa phyogs mtha' dag nas 'dus te phyur bur spungasashing bza' bca' bsang ba du ma spros pa'i tshe rong gar gyi rnam 'gyur ji snyed dang phun sum tshogs pa'i shis brjod kyi sgo 'phar rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags kyi lan 'debs tshul sab gru pa lha dbang rdo rjes byas/ de grol mtshams rgyal mo gu rus gtsos dpon mo tshor ja gral btang zhing sog dmangs lnga brgya skor la me rta ge gtore/ bzang po dang po'i tshes kyi dga' ston la mchod yon gnyis sog po'i dpon khag rnams kyi steng khyab bdag zha lu pa rin chen bsod na mas mchogo grub/ sbyor ra sprul —91—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (poskus/ gnas gsar dbon rin po che/ rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa yongs rdzogs/med du byung ba'i rin chen rgyan cha ba dang bcas stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i khengs pa'ang thung ngur byas steng ngo mtshar ba'i legs tshogos rnams rang 'grigs gal (65na ji ba phyi rol gyi rten 'brel du/ ji skad du/ pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa 'du/ /dri ldan me tog bung ba sdud/ /'brog bzang du ni ri dwags 'khor/ kha yi dri la sha sbrang 'khor/ /bza' btung mang sar skye bo tshogs/ /gal te de dag mi ldan na/ /bsdus kyang skye bo phal cher 'bros/ /zhes pa ltar yid can ma lus pa byams brtse me bde bar skyong ba'i mchod yon rnam gnyis kyis thog drangs 'dir 'khod thams cad bsod nams dpal gyis mtho zhing blo gros kyi rtsal mig yangs pa/ dpa' zhing brtul phod pa/ mdzes shing brjid chags pa/ bzang po'i sgrigs kyis spa zhing rigs rus sogs yon tan du mas ma 'a par mtho ba'i khungs can/ blang dang dor bya'i gnas kun la phra zhib 'jug ldog sbyod par mkhas shing ya rabs gra ma blo mdzangs rnam dpyod kyi dpal dang ldan pas gang ba/ yab sras mjal pa'i rtogs brjod las/ sa skyong mkhas na rig pa'i rtse dga' spro la mchog tu reg par 'gyur/ /dpa' na g.yul gyi rol pa dang 'grogs brtul zhugasabartul zhugs 'jin par 'gyur/ blun na rmongs shing g.yo na rnam par g.yo la gdug na ma drangs sbyong / /gang gang sa bdag byed pa de de mtha' dag skye bos byed par 'gyur/ /skye bo legs spyod blo ldan blon po dang / /mi bdag mkhas shing bden par sna byed pa/ /'di dag rnams ni dge ba dar ba'i dus/ /mngon sum mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid bzang po yin/ /zhes pa'i ngang tshul dang ldan pa'ang sa phyogs chos bzhin skyong ba'i rgyal por rag lus pas(65ba〉rugs kyi bstan bcos las/ rgyal po shin tu mang mod kyi/ /chos bzhin skyong ba shin tu nyung / /mkha' la lha gnas mang na yang / /'od gsal nyi zla lta bu med//ces chos srid thams cad kyi char 'gran zla med de/ sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa/ khong mdzangs ba nams bsagasapa'i mi/ /gcig pu yin yang kun las rgyal/ /ri dwags rgyal po seng ge dang / /'khor ༷ la grogs mi dgos/ /zhes mgar ba sogs kyis byas par bltos min rtsibs stong ldan pa'i 'khor lo —92

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)byung ba tsam gyis phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal ngang gis thob pa dang /seng ge dkar mo rtsal gsum yongs su rdzogs par grogs la ma bltos pa'i steng gang la'ang 'jigs pa med cing /nye ma'i 'od zer shar ba na//'byung po'i bya rnams long bar 'gyur//zhes pho brang 'di'i zil ma bzod par nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa bzhin shar rgya nag dang khri bstan/lho rgya gar dang kha che/nub stag sde dang gzig ban/byang khrom dang ge sar te bskos pa'i rgyal po sde bzhi sogs mdor na stod dzā ti'i dri bsung rnam par mthul ba nas smad za 'og thags su 'thag pa'i yul grur gnas pas mtsho ni nyi 'og gi dregs ldan che dgu mtha' dag gi khengs pa nye bar btang ste 'dar 'jigs kyi rnam 'gyur ji snyed pa dang bcas pas yan lag mchog gis btud cing phu dud gya nom pa bstar ba'i dus mkho ba'i rdzas 'dod yon rnam lnga/rgyal srid sna bdun/nye ba'i sna bdun/bkra shis rtags rdzas so gos zad mi shes pa'i mchod sprin lhun gyis grub pa'ang /bshes spring las/rten srin thing 'brel bar 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi//gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zla ba mo ste//gang gis 'di ni yang dag mthong ba des//sangs rgyas de nyid rig pas rnam mchog mthong //zhes dang /gzhan yang mdor/rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i//chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no//'grig tshul yang /ji skad du/legs pa'i cha la rten 'brel thams cad 'grig/phun sum tshogs pa rang gis byas pa yin//zhes 'jig rten gyi khamasardzogs ldan gsar par spyod pa'i bkra shis dang bde legs kyi sgo 'phar bye ba 'byed gnas dga' ldan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang gi 'dun sa chen por sa steng 'khod pa'i skye rgu thams cad 'du bar ma zad sa bla'i gtso bo tshangs pa/khyab 'jug/dbang phyug/brgya byin so gos sum rtsen pa/rgyal chen sde bzhi sogs lha rnams kyis kyang sabaḥsu sti ka ri 6 ti me ga le bha wa skyo zhes sogasakyi shis pa'i sgra 'brug stong ltar ldir me tog char gyis sa gzhi'ang dog por byed cing sngon chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyis chos srid mdzad bzang dbyar mtsho ltar spel ba dang /bstan pa phyi dar la gong ma se wo rgyal po'i lung gis mngon par ma/ ba chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches bod

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pechol kha gsum la mnga' sgyur ba'i tshe bcu gsum las kyis gtsos pa'i sgrigs lam gyi srol rgyas par gyur/ gnam skos kyi sde srid phag mo gru pa gu'i gung / byang pa rigs ldan tā dben gu shri/ khrom ge sar gyi mag pa rgyal mkhar rtse ba/ sger rigs rin chen spungs pa/ sde srid (66bsko tsang pa sogs kyi dusarin chen rgyan cha sprod pa'i srol dod/ khyad par sger rigs sa spyod dbang po ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug grags pa'i rdo rje dpal bzang po zhes rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhyen pa'i spyan ras mchog gyur de nyid bskal bzang sangs rgyas lnga pa ston pa'i rgyal tshab ma pham mgon po dang mjal skabs lha klu dri za mi'am ci sto 'phye chen po nam mkha' lding gnod sbyin kun tu dga' ba shis brjod dga' ba 'khyil pa ste rnam pa brgyad po rang gzugs kyi zlos gar glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun las drangasapa'i snyan tshig dgu ldan nyams dang bstun pa'i gzigs mo lta bas chog mi shes pa'i srol rin spungasanas bstod pa bsam grub rtser dar yang bar du nyams pa shing yos khri 'don gyi dus 'dar pa bsod nams lhun grub rdo rjer bca' bsgrig dgos tshulu mol ba ltar lhos grong stod pa dang bcas wor pas ris su ma chad pa'i mchog dman bar ma thams cad kyi mig gi ltad mo tshar du dngar ba'i dga' ston spel bar brten yid kyi gsos sman dam par gyur nas mi dge ba'i las lam ldog ste dge bcu'i lang tsho gsar du ngom pa'ang / ji skad du/ kwa ye 'dzam gling skye 'gro'i bsod nams nor bu'i sgron/ /thub bstan phun tsho gos lang tshogs ra du spro mkhas pa'i/ /sa las3ma rgyal rgyal srid kun gyi thig le mchog /bsngags pa'i ༄ la gzhon nu dar ba rna ba'i rgyan/ /zhes pa dang mthun par/ lha mthong lo tsā bas/dpal 'byor gser gyi 'khor lo'i shugs bskyod nas/ /gangs can skye 'gro'i bsod nams cha med grong / /rgyal khrims zhabs sen 'od kyis mdzes byed pa'i/ /mi dbang (67na)nga las nu khyod rgyal gyur cig /gang gi mdzad pa bzang po'i rgyud/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag bdun rdzogs pa'i/ /nyams dang gyur ba'i gtam snyan pos/ /snying la kun dga'i dpal ster byed/ /ces dang / dran pa nyer gzhag tu sangs rgyas gtsug tor can gyi gsung drangs par/ gang gi skye bo gtsang ma'i 'khor/ /chos la spyod —94

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang gleg bam gsum pa/ (ja)pa dbang po dul//rgyal po chos byed blo ldan de//mtho ris 'jig rten skye ba yin//mi bdag gang yang chos kyis ni//rtag tu skye dgu yongs skyong ba//rab tu bsngags pa'i chos byed dag/lha yi 'jig rten sa bdag 'gyur//zhes dang /legs bshad las/dam pa dpon du bskos gyur na//don grub pa dang bde skyid 'thob//nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na//phyogs der dge zhes mkhas rnams sgrog/dam ya rgyad na gnas na spung/'khong 'dab phan pa rgyang nas stong //mkha' la lhan chen gas pa lis//sa yi lo rtag khyad par 'phel//zhes pa'i don bzhin 'bel gtam pa dang rol cha ba sogs kyis kyang shis brjod kyi sgo mtha' klas pa phye ba dang chabs cig 'jam dbyangs khri srong lde'u btsan gyis o tan+ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs te zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas bzhengs grub pa na/de ltar mnga' 'og skyid pa'i 'bangs//ma 'tshogs bya ba gang yang med//bza' gas longs spyod sna tshogs kyis//gang la ci 'dod thams cad tshim//dga' ba'i bro brdung 67bskyid pa'i glu//nyin re bzhi du rgyun ho ṣ+ka//gdugs dang rgyal mas ba dan sogs//dgung la nyi ma 'grib pa tsam//'dab chags bya la 'phur sa med//mgo nag mi yis sa gzhi khengs//sil snyan rol mo 'brug bzhin ldir//gyi ling rta la rgyug sa med/khye'u bu mo thams cad kyis//chas brgyan lag na rnga ma thogs//rnga brdung glu len gar stabs bsgyur//g.yag seng dar seng stag seng dang //'bag dang seng phrug gar mkhan dang //dpa' mdzes rnga thogs 'chams pa sogs//rgyal po'i sku la mchod pa 'bul//de ltar rje 'bangs thams cad kyis//dga' ba'i lus la rang dbang med//bro brdung nam mkha'i char pa 'dra//skyid pa'i sems la dran 'dzin med//rang rang mos pa'i glu re len//zhesapas kyang sgrun du med pa bstar bas bstan dang skye dgu'i phan bde 'phel ba'i rtsa lag dam par gyur/tshes gsum la sdings po che sprul skur yig lan snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa bsrings/tshes bzhin bo dong sbyor ra sprul sku/shangs dge 'phel mkhan po lcags rams pa/nag chu kha'i sog dmangs spyi bsdus so sos bdog pa dang yon sbyar gra tshang /sa mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i ring 'tsho spel

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (porjes bla khag gnyis/ lug bya lung pa'i chos rje/ dbon mo ma las/ tsha rong nas gzhone pa so gos bod sog lnga brgya skor la ja gral btang / tshes lngar bzod pa yel deng gi bur byin rlabs byas/ tshes bdun la dga' ldan khri rin po che/ gsang sngags byang chub gling gi slob dpon/ (68na)drung 'khor lnga bcu skor dang mjal zhing phrad/ chos 'khor rgyal du rten mchod gsar du bsgrigs par byams khang g.yasabar khang ka gsum mar rten gtso nged rang gi 'dra 'bag dngul sku sogs der ma shong ba phyi'i dngul gdung khang gi mdo dang spyi so'i tsho gos chen rnams su bsgrigs par dngul sku che chung bzhi/ klu 'jim gyi thub dbang mdzad pa ci bstog ga yod pa/ dzhai k+ṣiṃ gyi thub dbang dang byams sna re/ sangs rgyas byang semasa'aphags yul gyi li sku drug cu re dgu/ bka' gdams li ma dang rag sku 'dres pa nyis brgya so bzhi/rgya nag ma bdun/ sle'u chung pa'i phyag bzo'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku rje btso btsong kha pa chen po'i phyag nas mas gtsos gser sku drug cu re dgu/ 'dra cog bzhi cu zhe lnga ste khyon bzhi brgya so gcig /bka' gdams gdung rten lcags rtse ma sogs bzhi bcu zhe bzhi/ gser ljang brdungs kyi mchod rten mtho gang sor bdun/ yang mtho gang sor gsum re yod pa gnyis bcas g.yu mu tig sogs kyi phra ldan/ dngul gdung khru gang sor bcu gcig pa nas mtho gang sor lnga pa'i bar bcu drug la g.yu mu tig gi rgyan can/ tsha gser gyi gcig /klu sgrub kyi phyag bzo'i byang chub ljon shing gi rdo rje gdan gyi gas la/ 'khrungs rabs so bzhi dang gnas bcu thang grangs bcu gsum re gra tshar/ chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i thang sku gsum/ dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal srang chig brgya bcu bzhis gtsos che chung drug /gser kong srang bcu drug pa/ dngul kong srang (68ba)bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa dang bcas che chung brgyad/ dngul phor dang phud can drug /dngul gyi chab ril srang nyer gcig re yod pa cha/ dngul gyi las bum grang brgyad zho lnga pa/ rnam bum sto ba zangs kha phor dngul grub cha/ dngul lhir khebs ldan srang nyer bzhi pa/byu ru'i rgya lag dngul gyi pad rkang ma/ dngul srang nyer dgu zho lnga'i ting bdun tshar gnyis/ dngul srang lnga zho gsum gyi gtor cha bdun tshar/ dngul srang chig brgya bcu gnyis dang zho drug gi bkra shis rtags—96

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)brgyad tshar gsum/dngul gyi lding spos srang bstodagu zho drug pa/yang srang bstobazhi zho lnga pa/lcags kyi lding spos bkrol ma/rag gi spos phor gnyis/dngul gyi /pā la srang bstobazhi zho gsum pa/g.yang ṭi'i pad phor che chung bdun/dkar dpyad bcu/bse ru'i rwa tsan dan dkar dmar gyi 'bras skyogasadangul gyi nang sha yod med bcu drug/gu gu sha'i ting bdun tshar/rag gi me dam rgya bzo ma cha/hor ting bdun tshar/dkyus ma bdun tshar drug/li rag gi maṇ+ḍal gsum/lcags li'i khrus long gnyis/dung dkar dngul gshog ma g.yu sogs kyi phra ldan gcig dang rag gshom ma gcig/zangs dmar ser gyi rgya dung cha gsum/'khar rnga brgyad/'ur ting bzhi/rgya sbub lnga/hor sil gcig the ba'i silasnyan brgyad/'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che'i dgang blugs brkos bkrol tshags ma/brda ru tshags ma gsegs brdar dang bcas pa/theg chen gan dril rdor bcas bcu 69na〉khog/gar dril rdor bcas bdun/gnam lcags kyi rdo rje bzhi/rag tsha gser ma'i rdo rje dgu/gos dar gyi 'phan phye phur rgyal mtshan sogs nyer gcig/gos yol gnyis/bla bre bcu bdun/sman tse'i yol ba bzhi/gos ber bdun/gos phod brgyad/snyan dar gos ling dar sogs tshoge kha sna tsho gis tshig stong sum brgya gya drug ling lu'i gdugs ra shel gyi rtog ldan che legs/ling skyer gyi snam sbyar gcig dang gosalhan sdebs kyi dra ba dra phyed bzo bkod legs pa rnams bsgrig bcug/mchod khang ri mthil gyi chas/dbyar chos la gsumachog/smon lam/dus ma rdzo los/dus gtore/gtor 'kho/logs ra//dbyar phogs/thul pa brje len/rgya ra'i dbyar chos/tsha ra'i mar dpus bsgyur sogs sngar gtong deb rnying la zhal grangs brgya bzhi bcu chu len me 'bud sogs skal gtong so lnga skor dang bcas cung zad yis skyon nas gra gsar brgya drug sto spar ba'i phogs/mgon chos kyi dus gtor sngar yod bstobadun steng gsar pa brgyad/dga' tshal du lnga gra'i khar 'phar bco lnga bsnan te gto sdod nyi shu/gtong sgo cha phra skyon 'dug pa zur gsal nang ltar 'phel rgyas bsgrubs pas bstan pa spyi dang khyad par bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che nas gsungaXpa bzhin bod 'bangs phan bde'i rtsa lag tu bskrun/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (potshes bcur gsang sngags byang chub gling bla gras dngos po'i tshan grangs ring por brkyang ste gra tshang gi lugs ltar 'bras gshongs (69ba)dag snang mkha' 'gror brten pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel mdzad/ 'di nyin nas smon lam chen mor dge 'dun bdun stong brgyad brgya skor la ya ju khor drug ma chog brgya nga bzhi/ rta nyis brgya nyi shu dang dre'u nga dgu/ 'bo de tse'i phreng ba rkyal pa bco lnga/ sge dos mi rgyab ma bco brgyad/ des ma ldang par ser ljang sbag zhe gcig /bu ram ltang tse sum brgya zhe brgyad bcas 'gyed bzhi btang / tshes bcu gcig la nged rang gis mkhan po/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos slob dpon/ dbon po lo tsā bas gsang ston/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas dus bsgo ba/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab dang rin chen 'jam dpal gyis kha skong byas te/ chos rje dbon rin po che/gnas rnying zhabs drung gi sprul sku/ mngan dga' bla ma spong rong chos rje gsum dang / phyi dro dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to/ dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags/ chos rje gung ru ba dbang rgyal rdo rje gsum rnams bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs shing dbon rin po cher ngag dbang blo gsal mchog ldan du gsol/tshes bco lngar blo bzang mgon po rab brtan sogs sog po lnga bcu skor/ spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtsho/ blo bzang lhun grub/ sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las/ bstan 'dzin dbang po sogs yan lag brgyad ldan gyi sdom par bkod/ dpon tshang tsha rong pas ring 'tsho'i tshan grangs bteg cing drang srong gzhan phan gling du 'dzugs rgyu'i ring 'tsho'ang brtsams/ lha sa/ ra mo che/ po ta la/ byams khang / rme ru gsar rnying bcas pa rten rnams la (70na)gser chab/ snyan shal/ dngul dpyad kyi mchod rdzas phul/gsang sngags byang chub gling pas ring 'tsho spel zhor phye ring zhag bco lnga'i bar btang / bod 'bangs spyi'i bde thabs su dbus gtsang gi ris med dgon ang dang por gra pa rer gshor khal gsum ma dang gnyis par khal gnyis ma'i khyon bsdoms khal chig 'bum drug khri chig stong brgyad brgya re gsum thob par 'bru gser dngul/ dpus cha sogs gang 'os song / chos sde che phra nas dpung gi zhan 'degs la phyin pa'i sdom pa phul ba dang nyams pa rnams skyor bas mtshon bca' khrims bsdams —98—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)shing 'chad nyan sgrub mchod chag pa rnams sngar bzhin gso ba/ mgon khang sogs nas go mtshon khur ba rang slog /chad lus la rang rang lugs ba'i na bskang bshags bzabs rgyas gto me dgos tshulu sogs kyi rgyu mtshan bgyis/tshes bcu drug la gra tshang gi gra pa ngag dbang chos 'jin/ blo bzang mthu stobs sogs bsnyen rdzogs so drug bsgrub pa dang mu mthud nyin gsum gyi bar gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas kyis sdom rgyun gsar ba bskyar/ tshes bcu bdun la bco brgyad chos rje/ tre bo sku skye/ bar bzung tshe ring dar rgyas sogs la ja gral btang / rtse tshogs ngag dbang grags pas gral skor gyi sngon 'gror gra tshang gi 'don cha yongs rdzogs kyi rgyugs sprad/ dkon gnyer sngags rams pa kun dga'/ blo bzang dpal 'byor/ ngag dbang dkon mchog gsum gyis yon sbyar dngos po'i ster sbyin dang bcas gra tshang gis gzims chung ring 'tshor grags pa spel/ phyi dro (70ba〉rgyar chen gyi sprul sku sogs dge tshul brgyad bsgrubs/ tshes bcu dgur rdzing phyi mkhan gnyer/ yul khro'i thu pā thur tha'i ji/ sde pa grags pa/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las pa'i sku skye blo bzang khu thug thu'i mi sna sogs bod sog brgya skor dang phrad/ 'brong rtse rgyal phur khyo shugs kyi ngor pha bsod nams dar rgyas kyi don du smon lam bris/nyer bdun la gsang sngags byang chub gling slob dpon gra bcas la byin rlabs byas/ nyer brgyad la sdom rgyun gsar pa sems dpa' sprul sku ngag dbang phun tshogs/ ser 'bras/ rgyud stod smad kyi zhal snga nas bcas brgyad la phab/ nyer dgur gser dngul gos dar ja ras sogs kyi chos yon rgyas pas bsnyen bkur te rdo rje la4 rin chen bsod nams mchog grub nyang stod dpal 'khor chos sder dal 'gros kyis chibs bskyod/ nad rims zhabrug brtsod bzlog thabs su lha ldan/ zan g.yang /khra 'brug sogs mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gnas chen rnams su thugs rje chen po/ seng ldeng nags sgrol/ slob dpon ོ po/ bla ma rdo rje gro bo lod rnams kyi sku bris 'bur gang rung go yul dang bas bzheng ba/ khyad par stod phyogs kyi mi mthun zhi phyir ri bo bkra bzang / pra dun rtse/ grom pa rgyang / zab —99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pophu'i mgul bzhi nas gshin rje dmar nag gi mnan sreg 'phang gsum/ ma mdos/ 'gong po ar gto/ bye brag ri bo bkra bzang dang phung po ri bo cher mnan pa gtsor bton/ de rnams su thugs kyi lhagasum gyi sgrub pa/ spyir snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang de nang nas rgyal 'gong (71na skom sri'i 'tshub lhongs gcog phyir mchims phur pad+ma dbang chen/ yang rdzong du 'jam dpal gshin rje/ shel brag tu bdud rtsi sman sgrub/ mkhar chur yang dag he ru ka dang rdo rje gro lod/ rigs gsum mgon po rnams kyi sgrub pa 'brel mtshungs byed myong gis bstar zhing / phung po gsum pa'i mdo brtan/ mi dang mi min bdud tshogs kyi 'tshe ba bzlog phyir 'joms byed nyi zla nag po'i srung bzlog smin rgyas su byas/ mchod dpon pas zhu rten dang bcas dgos tshul la brten sgrags phu smon grong gzhis ka bod 'brog bsdoms khral rkang bcu gnyis/ lag yong bdun brgya gya drug rtsis sprad/hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis la stag rtse lha rgyal rab brtan/ mā la'i ma 'khor bcas/ bla ma dge 'dun bsam 'grub/ mer gan blo bzang / dga' ldan hung tha'i ji'i mi sna rgan pa u'i ching dar khan nang so/ gzhon pa gnyer pa bstan 'dzin hung tha'i ji'i mi sna se chen chos rje/ a kha'i gyi mi sna brtson khrus dge slong / cho khur o pa shi'i mi sna tshul khrims rin can/ a dar tha'i ji'i mi sna ngag dbang bkra shis/ o khe res tha'i ji'i mi sna bstan pa rin chen rnams dang / mtsho kha nas yer te ni kho sho'u chi'i mi sna shi ra pā thur/ mer gan tha'i ji'i mi sna chos rgya mtsho/ yer khe lha'i ching gi sog mo/gzhung sog 'go pa dge slong 'jam dbyangs/ bum thang khar pa nan ching can sogs 'go pa dgu rnams la byin rlabs dang / dmangs sum brgya skor la me tog gtor/tshes gsum la (71ba)brgyad gtor mchod pa'i nyin sngar spyi 'gre'i tshogs mchod las med na'ang gzhung dang mthun pa zhig 'phugs snyam mkha' 'gro lnga mnyes par byed pa'i tshogs mchod 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin brtsams/tshes bzhin bsam sdings skyon mtsho mo/ rmog lcog bla ma/ mtsho kha nas yer te ni da'i ching gi mi sna —100—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gsar 'byor dha na/'ba' gzhis sdod bsam grub gling pa dang sab gru pa/ra ba stod bzur so gos dang phrad/ka brgyad sbugs pa bsod nams dpal mo'i gtsug g.yu jo bo shākya mu ner phul ba'i tshe dgos tshul bzhin smon lam/byang gling pas rje dge 'dun grub kyi ga srungs rabs bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig bris/shel dkar chos sde'i gra pa dka' bcu blo bzang rdo rjes sman bla/rgyan 'jug/'jigs byed/mgon chos rnam sras/dmag zor ma rnams kyi 'don cha bcas pa'i rgyugs sprad/tshes lnga nas bzung zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bdun gyi bar ring 'tsho spel mi byung ba sogs dmigs bsal ma gtogos na ma langs sarba ba lta bur dge tshul slong gi sgrub pa nged rang gis mkhan po/legs bshad gling chos rjes las slob/gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas dus bsgo ba/sems dpa' sprul sku/gnas rnying sprul sku/blo gsal gling slob dpon legs pa don grub/g.yon ru sku skye/chos 'khor steng sku skye lnga res mos kyi gsang ston/chos rje na bza' gling pas grogs ldan/sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtsho dang bcas dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang gi dbus sher 'phel sprul sku/co ba dang byamasagling mkhan po//72na〉gsang sngags byang chub gling /thar pa gling /bde yangs pa/'dul ba/sngagasapa/mer pa/brag dbar/ste ser rnams kyi slob dpon/byes dang shel dkar chos sde'i bla zur/khal kha zhabs drung /klu 'bum chos rje/er khe chos rje/gzims shag chos mdzad sogs bsnyen rdzogasabaskyar ba dang gsar du bzhi brgya nga drug/dge tshul drug brgya dang don bdun rnams bsgrubs te bstan pa la cung zad kyi bya ba byas sam snyam/tshes bcu tha ṇi ga la dga' ldan hung tha'i jis tshogs chas dang bcas rnyed pa phul du phyin pa bstab ste gra tshang nas mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog sngon song gi ring 'tsho'i cho ga rgyas par spel/tshes bcu bzhing mchod dpon pas bdog pa ring por bteg nas bsun bzlog dang 'brel ba'i 'chi med 'od snang gi tshe chog bgyis/tshes bco lngar dbu sgor che ba 'khor bcas/gnas gsar rje dpon mkhyen rab rnam rgyal/'jun pa/bon phrug pa/lkog pa ba/sngagaXban ngag dbang rgya mtsho sogs la bsnyen gnas kyi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (posgo nas mngon mtho'i sa bon bskrun/ a yo shi'i dpon mo/ sras bkra shis rgya mtsho/ 'phags pa lha'i dbon po rnams la ja gral btang / tshes bcu drug la sher 'phel sprul sku dang mjal/tshes bcu bdun la g.yon ru'i mi sna nyi shu skor la ngos phrad kyi yi ge rten sbrags blangs/ tshes lnga nas bco brgyad bar gra tshang du gshin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i mye ring sa ya chig 'bum nyis stong drug brgya/ drag sngags so drug pa dgu 'bum bzhi khri (72ba)brgyad stong sa nyas brgya rnams bstar/ nyer bdun la dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas rdo rje slob dpon byas pa'i brgyad gras nad bdag stobs 'joms btang ba'i snga dro nged rang gi dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyi gzugs slob dpon pad+ma sam bha wa'i cha lugs su zhugs te byang chub gling pa dpal rgyal mtshan gyi zab gter las byung ba'i bka' nan rab brjid kyi sgo nas dregs pa sde brgyad sogs bsam sbyor ngan 'chang mtha' dag ting nge 'dzin gyis mngon sum du bkug ste bod 'bangs kyi mi mthun kun gzhil zhing mthun rkyen re ba'i 'dod don bsgrubs pa'i 'phrin bcol dang / log lta'i tshogs kyi tsha dbal ming gi lhag ma'ang ma lus par bsgral bas cho me srid legs lam gyi sgo 'phar phye/ phyi dro rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag bco brgyad chos rje/ mkhas dbang skyed tshal mkhan po/ gsung gling bzur shes ldan bshes gnyen rnam rgyal rnamasadang mdo sngags dang 'brel ba'i mol mchid kyang rgyas par byung / nyer gcig nas bdun phrag gi bar gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcad so sos rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ bstan ma bcu gnyis/ re ma ti'i gsang mdos btang / nged rang ring por 'tsho thabs su rdzong gnyis kha shas bsdoms bskal bzang dang brgyad stong pa brgya tshar re/ sman bla chig khri nyis stong / gdugs dkar nyi khri chig stong / phyag 'tshal nyer gcig bzhi khri nyis stong / sher snying bye ba gcig /sa ya brgyad sum 'bum nyi khri lnga stong bdun brgya drug 'a tshe gzungs brgyad khri bzhi stong / srog blu sum brgya/ na mnyam brgyar ston mo 'gyed bcas/ dbus (73na)gtsang ris med dgon ang dang por gra ba rer gshor khal gnyis re/ gnyis par byed gnyis re/ gsum par khal re rnams khyon bsdoms khal chig 'bum sum khri dgu stong drug brgya thob par 'bru/—102

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gser dngul/ dngos dpyad/ dpus cha sogs gang 'os song / byang stag rtse'i gtsug lag khang du da lta phan mchod pa mi 'dug pa 'di lo nas bzung ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar mar me sdong rkang re chag med dang nya stong brgyad gsum la mchod 'bul gyi rgyun btsugs/ sde pa'i rim 'gror pho brang du mdo mang dang dkon brtsegs bldabs pa'i nyer bzhi re/ mtshan brjod chig stong sum brgya re brgyad/ sgrol ma chig khri sum stong drug brgya brgyad cu/ gdugs dkar chig 'bum sum stong drug brgya bcu gnyis/sher snying brgyad stong lnga brgya don drug /tshe gzungs chig 'bum sum khri drug stong brgyad cu/ bod khams su nad rims mi 'byung ba'i phyir rdzong gzhis so so nas snga 'gyur ba gra slob bcu res zhag bcu'i bar bstan ma'i mdos gang rgyas/ bstan thus rgyas pa'i ched dge lugs dgon khag rnams la mang ja'i mthun rkyen sprad pa'i bshad gra nas mdo sgrub dang sngags gras gtor rgyag mdzad bcug /sngags pa ban grong par rim gro sgrub rten du mal dro gser rta ge dgon gyi sprod che phra gra btsun gang yod lag 'debasathog 'od zer gyang khul nas zhing bsnon bcas 'bru mkhar khal go gnyis thon rtsis/ 'bri gung chosagazhis dom khang dang mthar rgyas bsdoms ban khral brgyad sbyar/ sho pa mdor (73ba)rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog skya pod tshar gcig me 'brug nas las 'go btsugs pa zla ba 'dir 'byor/hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bzhin bi lig khe tha'i dmag nas 'khor ba dang san bi yig /ra sgreng mkhan po'i mi sna/ bsod nams mgon po'i mi sna/ brag dbar gra tshang gi bla ma dge skos/ gra phyi me long dgon pa'i bla ma sogs dang phrad cing tha'i ji bo lod la tham ga dang gyon pas mtshon dngos dpyad ju rig thu kho sho'u ji'i cho lo dang bcas bdag rkyen dpangs bstod de rdzong bda' byas/ sog dmangs sum brgya skor la me tog gtor/ gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas kyis dbang phyug zor mdos btang / tshesabadun la rgyal gling tshogs mkhan po/ yang dgon bla zur/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i gser khang gong dang gser gling gi bla ma/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ rgyas gra rab 'byams pa/ mtshur phu dang stag lung gnyis kyi phyag mdzod/ 'brong rtse ba rgyal phur rab brtan sogs nyis brgya skor drung 'khor gsar 'byor —103

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pokha shas dang bcas par ja gral bgyis/tshes brgyad la mgon po che chung las mkhan dang bcas la mchod sprin rgyas par spros/ tshes bcur dbu sgor che ba'i mas ber gdan dngos po spams bstod de gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i tshe chog gyer bres pa 'jam dbyangs chos rgyal rdo rje'i sku skye myur 'byon/ spun bdun lhun grub rgya mtshos rje btsun btsong kha pa'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /tshes bcu gnyis la rdo rje brag rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i skus bskul ma mdzad pa'i rta mgrin yang (74na)gsang gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg chog sgrigs ye shes snang ba rab 'bar/ tshes bcu gsum la so thar sdom brgyud kyi gsol 'debs/'bras spungs tshogs khro'i kha byang le tshan rnams brtsams shing spun bdun pa lhun rgyam mtsho khar don gcod la brdzangs/nyer bzhin thod ri bshad sgrub gling gi gra pa rab stims pa blo bzang rig 'dzin gyis dbu ma 'jug pa dang / 'grel pa theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings kyi rgyugs sprad/ nyer lnga la gra tshang nasaphyir bzlog 'khor lo 'bar ba bye ba dang / nyer drug nas gra pa grangs bcad kyi rdo rje slob dpon sngagasarams pa don grub rgya mtshos byas te zhag bdun gyi bar sngags rgod log ṭi'i srung bzlog thun mong ba btsugs/ gangs can bde ba'i rten 'brel du lha sa/ bsam yas/ mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang rnams su gser phru gsar du bskrun/ nged kyi rim gror lha sar sman bla chig stong lnga brgya/bzang spyod chig khri nyis stong lnga brgya/ gdugs dkar chig 'bum chig khri lnga stong drug brgya sum cu/phyag 'tshal nyer gcig lnga 'bum bdun khri chig stong brgyad brgya bdun cu/ sher snying dgu stong lnga brgya/byams smon chig khri lnga stong / lhung bshags chig khri lnga stong lnga brgya/ tshe gzungs chig 'bum nyi khri lnga stostong sum brgya bdun cu/ khrus gsol/ gsang sngags byang chub gling pa brgyas zla gcig bar phyir bzlog 'khor lo 'bar ba/ ban pa/ theg phyi/ mkho mthing / pra dun rtse/ dge rgyas rnams su 'phan bla bre phye phur rgyal mtshan snyan (74ba 〉 zhal dang bcas smin rgyas phul/—104—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gcig la 'brong rtse rgyal phur gyis rab ston skal pa'i dkar dro bteg cing /er te da'i ching gi bu rab 'byams pa blo bzang bkra shis dang /bstan 'dzin khung tha'i ji'i mi sna che chen chos rje gnyis kyis bskul ba'i smon lam/bi yig rab 'byams pa'i ngor mgon po phyag drug par brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyun 'khyer/tshong 'dus bya khrid mig gcig pa'i 'phrin lan snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa brtsams te spel/sho mdo lhun grub mi 'gyur rab brtan du dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling pa lnga bcu res ji srid bskal
