pa'i bar lo star sa ga zla ba'i tshes bdun nas zla gcig gi ring tshe chog btsugs/tshes bcu bzhir jo bo shākya mu ner gser ljang brdungs la skye ba lnga pa'i dung g.yu mu tig sogs phra tshom bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa'i mgul rgyan dkar chag gzong ris dang bcas phul zhing 'dar lo 'khor zhag nas 'khor ba dang phrad/tshes bcu dgur phyi mtshams grol ba'i rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling spyi sger nas rung mthun gos sna cha tshang sogs bdog pa rgya cher brkyang zhing tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rdzas dang yos bsun bzlog sngon song 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul r+yā dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i cho ga smin rgyas mdzad/tshogs mgron du/rdo rje brag sprul sku/gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po/kun mkhyen chos dbyings rang grol gyi sprul sku/rgyal legs bshad gling chos rje/gsang sngagasabyang chub gling dang don gnyis gling sogs kyi slob dpon yang yod/tshes nyi shur dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu 75na ) ji nong gis kyang gos sna cha 'grig /bzang ja khor drug bzhi bcus gtsos pa'i ster cha spams mtho tshogs 'gyed dang bcas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung rgyas par bsgrigs/gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal pos kyang rung gos sno tshang sogasadangom che'i dgu tshan bco lnga tshogs yon bcas nyin snga ma dang mtshungs pa nyer gcig la bstar/nyer gnyis la chos lung tshogs mkhan chen gra bcas kyis cho me rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi yum gyi dgongs rdzogs kyi gser zho phyed nyis 0 5 las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal g.yu drug dkar gyi phra

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogebakod legs pas thog drangs zang zing tshan grangs spel te gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pas nyi bu'i g.yul las rgyal bar gyur/ maṇ+ḍal 'gangs can de phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i mchod rdzas su sbyar/ chos 'khor yang rtse dang dum bu chos 'khor ba gnyis kyi slob dpon gra bcas kyis tshan grangs sngon 'gro'i so so'i lugs bzhin bden tshig gi smon lam shis pa brjod pas mtha' brten nyer gsum la 'phyos pa sngags rams pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis 'gan sbyar sogs bdog pa bteg nas gra tshang gis mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ de grol nas rdo rje brag rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku gra slob dang bcas pas gos sna cha 'grig dngos po'i tshan grangs spel te rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje'i zab gter tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang 'brel ba'i bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi lug gzugs la brten pa'i bsun bzlog dang bcas mdzad pa byin chags shing (75ba)mi 'gyur brtan pa'i dgos pa 'grub bam snyam/ sprul sku bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid bdun sogs gsung bshad mdzad pa thams cad kyi yid kyi dbang po'i gsos sman du gyur/ phyi dro sku rkyang dang ja gnyis kyi bar gsung gleng zhib par byung / nyer bzhi la dga' ldan gsung rab gling bla spyi 'dus sde dang bcas pas dngos po maṇ+ḍal du bteg nas bden brjod dbyangs su gyer/ de grol rjes co ne chos rje/ shangs ri bo dge 'phel gyi mkhan zur lcags rams pa thang bu zhal snga nasang ga dbang bkra shis/ thang sag bla zur mdo sde rgya mtsho/ don gnyis gling / gser khang gong / rgyang ro lha khang / gser gling rnams kyi slob dpon/ snye mdo chos rje/ chos dbang gdung brgyud kham mo ba/ dpal de ras chen/ rtse chen grub chen/ sha gzug sku skye/ khams me rag bla ma rgan gzhon/ skyed sbug sprul sku/ a jo rdzong sprul sku/ yul jo'i thu dar khan rab 'byams pa/ thos pa dga'/ dpon mo tshe ring / bla ma lha pa/ rdo rje brag gi gra pa sum cu skor dang mon bum thang du dug sngags rgyag par 'gro mi bzhi/ sger pa ba gzhon pa/ bde mchog mgon po'i bu/ 'brug kun bzang pha bu/ gangs mtsho ba'i bu/ spyi dpon gsum/ sde dpon nyer gnyis/ bsam dar nas pha bu/ mchod dpon pa'i jo sdo dpal —106—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)grong sngags rams pa'i ma/ rtses dang lnga mchod pa/ sgar pa gra tshang / chos 'khor yang rtse/ snye nang dga' ldan 'phel gling / a tsa lha ri/ yer pa gra tshang rnams kyi gnyer pa sogs dang phrad de so sor dri rmed dang /lhag tu (76na)dpal de ras chen gyis spyir nyams rtogs sna tshogs pa shar tshul dang / khyad par snod bcud thams cad thog mar gzugs su grub pa la legs par brtags tshe ka dag gi dbyings su yal 'gro ba dang / skabs 'gar srid rtse nas mnar med bar gyi gzugs can gzugs med mngon sum du mthong ba de'ang stong pa'i ngang du thim pas 'char tshul bzang po dang / rtse chen grub chen gyis bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsten nas dbang khrid man ngag sogs rgya ma chung tsam zhus shing de don sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed blo byas kyang las sgrib ches pas yin nam nyams rtogs gang yang skye rgyu ma byung zer ba'i dman cha len pa gang zag gi tshod gang zag gis 'dzin mi nus par bshad pas sngon gyi las shugs dang bcas gnyis ka tshad ldan yin nam snyam pa dang / dpal de ras chen lo'ang ring por 'tsho zhing nyams rtags brjod par yid mi ches pa'ang ma byung / bsam dar nas dang dpal grong sngags rams pa'i mar bka' bsgo dang bod sog nyis brgya skor la me tog gtor/ 'phyong rgyas mnga' khul skya ser rags bsdus kyis snam phrug gtsor bton gyi bdog pa 'gyed dang bcas nyer lngar gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa grol nas rgyal sras sher 'phel bas gtsos ri bo bde chen pa sogs ring 'tsho spel mi ngo bo rnams dang / rtse tsho gos mkhan zur/ bkra shis sgang drung chen bcas par ja gral bgyis/nyer drug la rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ don gnyis gling slob dpon pa/ rtses dang las (7ba)chen pa sogs la bskyar sgrub dang gsar pa nyer dgu la sdom pa phab/ nyer bdun la rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i skur skyes lan byin rlabs bka' bsgo dang bcas rang gi bsti gnas su dal 'gros kyis gshegs shing / dbu sgor che ba dang dge 'dun ming sring la bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang / tshe dbang /byin rten/ shal dkar dmar snam phrug sogs kyi ster sbyin/ nang rten rags bsdus kyi mjal kha/—107—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pogayog la me rta ge gtor ba sogs re ba bkang ste thon/ rta nag sgrol ma/ 'jun pa/ skyar po ba so gos dang phrad/ dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i slob dpon pa sogs bco lngar sdom rgyun gsar pa'i ngur smig gos kyis lhab lhub ches cher g.yos/ nyer brgyad la skyor lung mkhan po dang slob dpon/ em chi byang ngos pa sogs la ja gral btang / drung 'tsho ngag dbang lhag bsam sogs bskyar sgrub dang bcas nyer bdun gyis bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/nyer dgu ri bo bde chen pa dang gsung rab gling pa sogs bsnyen rdzogs nyer bzhi dang / gnam gang la dge tshul lnga bcu nga lngar sdom pa phab/ er khe chos rje gra bcas la snam phrug sogs rdzong bda' dang / lha sa/ ra mo che/ po ta la gsum du brgya mchod sna lnga/ gser chab/ snyan shal/ rigs lam smra ba'i 'byung gnas gsang phu'i gtsug lag khang gi steng gzhi nga gser zangs las grub pa gsar du btsugs/hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gcig la dge tshul lnga bcu nga drug bsgrubs/ bod khams bde thabs su lha sar rigs 'dzin (77na gi ter bdag gling pa gra slob nyer lngas khro rol sgrub zhag bdun/ bstan ma'i mdos nyin lnga/ tshogs brgya nyin gsum/ rab gnas dang sbyin sreg nyin re gnang ba'i rab yon gter ston rin po cher dgu tshan dngos gtsang / lo chen sku mched la sum tshan re/ ngas la bkras btags re/rim gro le tshan gzhan gyi yon thegs gdong skyes kyi khongs su 'grus rgyu dang / lo chen mched la nyin khal re ma/ dmangs la khal phyed ma bsdoms ya ju khor drug ma gsum/ khro rol gyi rgyab chos pa sgo mangs dang blo gsal gling bsgril ba brgyas zhag bdun par sher snying tshig 'bum sum khri nyis brgya'i yon gra pa rer khal phyed mar ya ju khor drug bzhi song /tshes gnyis la stag rtse tha'i ji/ chos 'khor yang rtse'i bla ma dbu chos/ gsung rab gling gi dbu chos —gnyer pa/ kong po bkra shis rab brtan pa'i gnyer pa/ bstan 'dzin hung tha'i ji'i mi sna'i jo jo/ dpal de ras chen pa/ rtses dang las chen pa rnams dang phrad/ gsung gling pa brgya nyer gcig dang / chos 'khor yang rtse ba brgya go gsum la me tog gtor/ bod 'bangs la gnyan nad sogs mi bde ba mi 'byung —108

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)ba'i ched dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi gangs mgul du rten mkhar 'dzugs par gnang byung pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse dang dan 'bag blo bzang dbang rgyal brdzangs/tshes lngar mda' dpon dam ru ba/ khang dmar ba/ pho lha ba/ rta phug pa'i bu sogs la ja gral bgyis/ tshes bdun la stag rtse tha'i ji rdo rje rnam rgyal/ (77ba〉na zims khang shar bzur/ sngags 'chang chu spe steng ba sogs dang phrad cing skyid shod sprul sku'i ngag ma phran bu nyan/ 'di nyin nas bzung lha ldan khyams rar gra tshang gi gra pa yongs rdzogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtshos byas te rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas sgrub pa zhag bdun 'chams dbyangs sogs rgyas pa sngon song gis tshes bcu bzhir sta gon dang bco lngar dngos gzhi'i sgo nas 'phrul snang gi rten dang brten pa'i lha tshogs rnams la rigs mthun pa dang mi mthun pa'i ye shes sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bstim nas nus ldan du bsgrubs pas bsil ldan ljongs kyi bde skyid dbyar mtsho ltar spel ba'i legs tshogs 'grig pa slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pas zab gter mang por chos rgyal dang skyon gyi gnas chen tshor rab gnas sogs las bzhi bstar dgos par gsungs pa'i dgongs don bzhin lag tu blangs/tshogs pa khag gnyis kyi phyed kyi rdo rje slob dpon snga ma dang bcas pas 'char ga'i mdos/ phyed kyi rdo pa dge slong phyag rdor dbang phyug gis byas te dpal ldan 'dod khams ma'i gsang mdos nyin bdun re btang ba'i khongs zhogs gsum brgyags rngan btang / rab ston nyin gyis mtshon par bkur sti bzabs rgyas/ rab yon rdo rje slob dpon/ dbu mdzad/ mchad dpon pa gsum so sor dgu tshan bzang ba re/ dbu mdzad las thog par dgu tshan 'bring / dge skos/ gnyer pa/ dkon gnyer so sor bdun tshan re/ chab ril ba/ ja ma/ dung pa gnyis so sor lnga tshan re/ mchod g.yog las byed dgur bdun (78na)tshan 'bring / gra pa brgya re bdun so sor bkras btags che ba re/ gos dmar ser gang rung dpus legs kha re/ gser zho re/ rim gro gzhan rnams kyi yon bsdoms rdo rje slob dpon dang mchod dpon par bdun tshan re/ dbu mdzad la lnga tshan/ rnam gzhag byings la bkras btags re/ gra —109

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (popa rer dngul srang do re/'char ga'i rgyab chos pa se ra byes smad bsgril ba brgyas zhag bdun bar sher snying chig 'bum sum khri nyis brgya/de dang phyogs mthun zla ba 'di dang phyi mar pur rgyal bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel ba'i phyir bsam yas su rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po ches gtsos gra slob nyer dgus phur sgrub zhag bdun/rab gnas sbyin sreg nyin re/'char ga'i mdos zor dang ki rkang gi dgra mnan sgrub zhag bdun rer zhabs tog sngar rgyun bzhin la yon sprul sku rin po cher dgu wo gnyis dang bdun wo/dpal ri ba rdor slob the ba'i nyer gsum gyis khro rol zhag bdun/tsho gos brgya wo gnyis/brgyags rngan nyin gcig/rgyab chos pa rdo dga' ldan rnam rgyal ba bzhi bcu bzhi bcus zhag nyi shur sher snying nyis 'bum sum khri/rab byung ba lnga bcus zla phyed la dri med bshags rgyud stong phrag drug dang bzhi brgya/rtse tshogs pa lnga brgyas zhag bcur sman bla chig stong lnga brgya/zhag bcur sher snying brgyad khri drug stong lnga brgya/wo bdun bar brgya mchod sna lnga tshar re/gser btul ma srang phyed do'i zhal gser/khra 'brug tu gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po gra slob nyer lngas phur sgrub zhag bdun/rab gnas/sbyin sreg/747nan pa gsum nyin re/khro rol zhag bdun bcas pa'i yon rigs 'dzin ོ por dgu tshan/rgyab chos pa dge lugs khad nye nas lnga bcus bdun gcig gi bar sher snying drug khri lnga stong chig brgya/chos rje dung dgon pa gra slob nyer gnyis kyis 'cha spu'i mdos zor dang /ki dang gi dgra mnan/so sor bdun re/gas brgya wo ga snya/yon chos rjer bdun wo/ra chos dgon khad nye nas lnga bcus zhag bdun bar sher snying drug khri lnga stong tshig brgya/dpal ri ba lnga bcus dri med bshags rgyud nyis stong lhag bcas dang brgyags rngan/rtses dang lnga mchod pa lnga bcus nyin bcur sman bla nyis stong /bcur sher snying dgu khri sum stong /gser btul ma zho drug gi zhal gser/tsa ri cig car du chos rje brag sna ba gra slob bcu gnyis kyi khro rol slang gang ma sgrub zhag bdun/tshogs brgya nyin gnyis/brgyags rngan nyin gcig/dga' ldan rab brtan pa sum cus nyin bcu'i bar sman bla dang sher snying stong /khro rol gyi rgyab chos su sher snying gaX 'gro/lho brag mkhar chur chos rje gnas gzhi ba

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)nyer gnyis kyis khro rol dang ki dang gi dgra mnan sgrub zhag bdun re/ tshogs brgya nyin gnyis/ lha bsangs nyin gcig /rgyab chos dge dgon khad nye nas brgyas zhag bdun bar sher snying chig 'bum sum khri nyis brgya/ dga' ldan don gnyis gling pa lnga bcur sman bla nyis stong / bcur sher snying dgu khri sum stong / 'on phu stag tshang du gra snye mdo ba gra slob bcu gnyis kyis phur sgrub bdun gcig /(79na7nan pa dang sbyin sreg nyin re/ mnga' ris gra tshang pa nyi shus zhag bdun bar sher snying nyis stong bzhi brgya/ gter sgrom du ban grong pa gra slob bcu gnyis kyis phur sgrub bdun gcig /mnan pa dang sreg pa nyin re/ 'on sna pa nyi shus zhag bdun bar sher snying nyi khri drug stong bzhi brgya/ lho brag mkho mthing lha khang du chos rje smra bo lcog pa nyer gnyis kyis khro rol dang gi dang gi dgra mnan bdun re/rab gnas sbyin sreg brgyags rngan gsum nyin re/ rgyab chos dgon khad nye nas brgyas zhag bdun bar sher snying chig 'bum sum khri nyis brgya/ khyung chang dgon pa ba lnga bcus zhag bcur sman bla nyis stong / bcur sher snying dgu khri sum stong / brgya mchod sna lnga tshar re spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ pra dun rtser brag dkar chu bzang pa gra slob bcu gsum gyis khro rol slang gang ma sgrub zhag bdun/ rab gnas/sbyin sreg /brgyags rngan gsum nyin re/ dga' ldan 'phel gling pa sum cus zhag bdun bar sher snying dgu khri bzhi stong brgyad brgya drug cu/ mchod pa sna lnga brgya tshar re spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ kong po bu chur rnying phu rigs 'dzin chen po gra slob bcu gnyis kyis khro rol slang gang ma sgrub zhag bdun/ sbyin sreg mnan pa/ brgyags rngan gsum nyin re/ rgyab chos dge dgon khad nye nas lnga bcus zhag bdun bar sher snying drug khri lnga stong tshig brgya/ zhag bcu rer sgar pa gra tshang pa lnga bcus sman bla nyis stong / de mo ba lnga bcus sher snying dgu khri sum stong / nyin star brgya mchod nyer spyod lnga tshar re/ spyan (79ba)'dren khrus gsol/ dbu ru ka tshal du rigs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub kyis khro chu'i gtor bzlog dang gshin rje'i dgra mnan sgrub zhag bdun re/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg /brgyags rngan gsum nyin re/rgyab chos dge dgon khyad nye nas brgyas zhag bdun bar sher snying drug khri lnga stong chig brgya/ thang skya —111—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pob sum cus zhag bdun bar sher snying sum khri dgu stong drug cu/wo star brgya mchod sna lnga re/spyan 'dren khrus gsol/gtsang 'gram lha khang du brag la ba gra slob nyer gnyis kyis 'char ga'i mdos dang ki dang sgrub zhag bdun re/rgyab chos pa dge dgon byed bzhin pa lnga brgyas zhag bdun bar sher snying sum khri dgu brgya/myug chos gling pa lnga bcus zhag bcu'i bar sman bla chig stong nyis brgya lnga bcu/nyin star brgya mchod sna lnga re/spyan 'dren khrus gsol/grom pa rgyang du chos rje chu mig pa gra slob nyer gnyis kyis khro rol dang gshin rje'i dgra mnan sgrub zhag bdun re/rab gnas/sbyin sreg/brgyags rngan gsum nyin re/rgyab chos pa dge lugs byed bzhin pa brgyas zhag bdun gyi bar sher snying chig 'bum sum khri nyis brgya/lha rtse chos sde pa lnga bcus zhag bdun bar sman bla chig stong bzhi brgya/nyin star brgya mchod sna lnga re/spyan 'dren khrus gsol/yer par rang gra lnga bcus zhag bdun bar sman bla chig stong dang sher snying khri/nyin star brgya mar sna lnga re/spyan 'dren khrus gsol/pha bong khar rang gra nyer lngas zhag bdun bar sher snying sum khri/nyin star 80na ) brgya mchod sna lnga re/spyan 'dren khrus gsol/yum bu gla sgang du chos rje khra tshang pa bcu gnyis kyis 'char ga'i gtor bzlog dang ki gang gi dgra mnan sgrub zhag bdun re/lha bsangs nyin gang /ri bo chos gling pa nyi shus nyin bdun bar sman bla lnga brgya drug cu/nyin star brgya mchod sna lnga/spyan 'dren khrus gsol/bkra shis chos sde ba brgyad kyisarab gnas nyin gang /yang rdzong du rdo rje brag pa gra slob bdun gyis ki gang gi dgra mnan sgrub zhag bdun/lha bsangs nyin gcig/nyin star brgya mchod sna lnga/shel brag tu dpal ri ba gra slob bdun gyis ki gang gi dgra mnan bdun gcig/wo star brgya mchod sna lnga/chos rje gung ru ba gra slob bcu gnyis kyis gi gang gi dgra mnan bdun gcig/lha bsangs nyin gcig/nyin star brgya mchod sna lnga/zab phu lung du 'ug bya lung pa gra slob bcu gnyis kyis 'char ga'i mdos dang dgra mnan sgrub zhag bdun re/lha bsangs wo gcig/wo star brgya mar sna lnga/bkra bzang du rtse ston thugs mchod 'od 'bar gra slob nyer gnyis kyis phur sgrub dang gi gang gi dgra mnan sgrub zhag bdun re/rab gnas sbyin

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)sreg/brgyags rngan nyin gsum/srong btsan du dpal ri ba brgyad gras zhag bzhin ma ning gi bskang gso/brgyags rngan nyin gcig/gra pa nyer gnyis kyis zhag lnga'i bar thang yig brgya/thang po cher ri bo bde chen pa gra slob brgyad kyis rab gnas nyin gang /gra thang du mkhan po gra bcas80ba ) brgyad gras rab gnas wo gang /chos rje che kha dang mkhan por bdun phywa/rdor slob byings la lnga wo/yon kyang nyin mi khor khal phyed re/'bru dpus byed khyer gyi gud med bsgrubs pa ni/pad gling lung bstan kun gsal me long las/ru bzhi'i chos mdzad thams cad dgongs pa bstun cho 'phrul zla ba spre'u'i zla ba la rgyud dang bstun nas nyin mo sngags la 'bad gtor ma mdos dang mnan sreg yang yang bya bh+yo bzlog zor rnams bshags nas chos khrims bca' nyan bshad sgom sgrub byed pa'i bstan pa tshugs:ri rgya klungs rgya lam rgya la sogs 'dzugs skye 'gro sems can thams cad bde la bkod ces dang /bsam yas khra 'brug lha sa 'on ljang rdo rgyal blon bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams gso:them dgu'i 'og tu rgya 'dre thams cad mnan tsa ri mkhar ri stag tshang gter sgrom bzhir:sgrub gnas tsho gos 'khor sbyin sreg brgya rtsa bya mkho mthing skyer chu pra dun bu chu bzhir sman bla tshar brgya sgrol ma'i mchod pa bya bum thang byams pa lha khang bstan pa'i srog lha sa bsam yas mdo sngags srog yin pas so nams 'bad nas mdo sngags bstan pa tshugs:zhes ru bzhi'i yul khams su 'tshe byed bzlog thabs de ltar byung ba dang /kun skyong gling pa'i zab gter mchod rten lnga'i lung bstan du/sprul ba'i dge slong rnams kyis ni:rab gnas bkra shis gsol bar bya grub thob rnal 'byor rnams kyis ni:bh+yo sngags bzlog zor phyogs bzhin 'phen bka' 'gyur 81na 'a ni 'ur 'don dang :bstan pa spyi rim dag la 'bungs sa yi gzer rnams ma non na bdud sde dmag sgar dpal gyi ri thams cad 'joms shing mtshon 'khrug 'byung :byang chub sems dpa' mtshon gyis tsha:bod 'bangasasdug cing 'khrug rtsod yod grub na bkra shis bde legs 'phel:zhes lung bstan pa'i sel byed rnams bgyis pas spyi sgos kyi don 'grub bam snyam/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogetshes brgyad la bo shog thu ji nong dang rgyal sras dge 'dun sogs sum cu skor yan lag brgyad ldan gyi sdom par bkod/ gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po/ dga' ldan rab 'byamasapa/ bo shog thu ji nong rgyal sras mched/ ja'i sang sogs sum cu skor dang / tre bo dpon/ srin po rir bla zur/ sngags 'chang chu spe steng pa/ paṇ+ḍita go ta la/ dar mo ba'i sman sgrub la 'gro mi gnyisarnams la ja gral thog chu spe steng par rgyal po rtse mdos sogs la dri ba bgyis pa chos yon byed bzhin pa'i dpe las o zog mgo yon du ma mchis par snang / paṇ+ḍita go ta lar sa snying zho lnga bcu/ gla gor brgya sogs ster cha ngom che bgyis pas dga' mgu yi rang ste 'phags yul du bteg /tshes bcur 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon/ dbu mdzad/ dge skos/ gter ston rin po che'i gcung lo chen sogs dang phrad/ bsam yas su chos rgyal chen po dpon blon so sor snyan tshig gis drangs pa'i 'phrin gsol sogs mdo sde 'bul bar dar byung pa brdzangs/ tshes bcu gcig la dga' ldan rab 'byams pa da la'i (81bskos tha'i ji'i bsam par chos tshugs thub pa'i 'phral kho rang dang 'dod pa gcig pa la phugs bu tsha thams cad kyi mgo 'don lta bu byed mkhan zhig byung na snyam pa 'dod par 'dug kyang rab 'byams pa rang ri khrod pa lta bu'i chos mthar phyin yong mi yong la brtag pa dgos gleng ba nged la dus gsum shes pa'i mngon mkhyen ni med dpal ldan lha mo dpang por gsol ba'i dbyangs 'char gyi mo 'khyer bde btab par chos tshugs zin par 'tshub shin tu che ba shar ba bzhin rgyu mtshan byas pa hung tha'i jir rab 'byams pa rang gis labs nas ban log par thag bcad 'dug don ltar 'o skol gyi ston pa 'khor nye sras brgyad dang bcas pa'i gser sku byon gtsang / sngags thang gra tshar spus legs sogs sngon 'gro'i bdog pa bteg nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa len dgos zhes pa ltar blangs te ming dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang du btags shing sog po mi skya'i rgyan pa cha tshang sogs ster cha byas/ dpon mo blo bzang sgron ma dge tshul du bsgrubs/ skyar po ba rdo rje dbang phyug la tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster brgya tshar dang mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel bskur/—114

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po'i gso dpyad mes po'i zhal lung gi par byang / er khe chos rjer bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam/ no mon dha ras bskul ba'i ring 'tsho/ bi yig rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos 'phel gyi 'dod sbyar dga' ldan khri rin po che'i gsol 'debs/ chu mig kha pas dngul gdung bzhengs pa'i smon tshig /pha bong kha pa zhal snga nas 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i phyi rten dngul gdung gi dkar chag /(82na〉ste mo blo bzang ngag dbang gi 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i bris thang rgyab yig /sngags ban ngag dbang rgya mtsho'i ngor gsol 'debs/ rab 'byams pa bsam gtan rgya mtshos bskul ba'i bde chen smon bsngo/ /sems dpa' sprul sku ngag dbang phun tshogs kyi paṇa chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho/nged rang / beg tse gsum gyi thang sku'i rgyab yig /dka' bcu blo bzang rgya mtsho'i ngor nged rang dang phyag drug pa'i gsol 'debs/ 'phyong rgyas blo bzang dge bdun la phyag drug pa'i rgyun 'khyer/ drug brgya grub chen la blang dor bslab bya/ lkog pa ba'i nu bo sum yags kyi don du gnas bcu tshar gnyis dang phyag rdor la gra lngas bskor ba'i rgyab yig /phyon smin grol gling gi dkar chag ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ /dpal ri spyi sos sprul sku ngag dbang pad+ma'i brtan bzhugs bskul ba rnams bris/tshes bcu gnyis la dpal 'khor chos sde'i legs grub slob dpon sogs dang / dga' ldan hung tha'i ji/ rwa sgreng mkhan po'i mi sna thon gdong gi ngos phrad/ skyar po ba rdo rje dbang phyug khal kha o rod kyi gzhung bsgrig ched g.yon ru dga' ldan hung tha'i jir dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi cho lo/ tham ka /gos sna cha tshang sogs legs skyes ring por spros shing / lheb shog sgroms che ba/ngag ma zhi kha tu bgyis nas yon bdag rnams kyi bde thabs bsgrub par mngags/ tshes bcu gsum la gsas khang pa bla gras tshan grangs brkyang ste ring 'tsho dang / dpon mo bsod nams chos 'dzom sogs dpon chung bco lnga skor la ja gral btang / /(82bskol bcu bzhir gsung rab gling slob dpon du 'gro mi se ra smad rab 'byams pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin can dge slong gnyis dang ka thog sku skye skyon chos kyi rgya mtsho dge tshul du bsgrubs/ lha sa'i rab ston gyi skal pa'i ston mo byung /—115

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (getshes bco lngar rgyal sras bsod nams bkra shis ngo ma g.yog bcas dang phrad/ tshes bcu drug la rgyal sras dge 'dun bkra shis thon gdong gi ja gral dang bka' bsgo/ gser mdog can shangs pa slob dpon pa shākya nor bu sgra slob par 'dar pa lo chen sar sdod ring phogs ja thug sogs kyi phan pa bsgrubs/ tshes bcu bdun la lho brag gdang dgon gsar bla ma/ ka thog dar dkar sku skye/ yang ri bla ma gsar rnying / 'bog gong sbyor ra ba/ 'brug kun bzang / bde mchog mgon po/ gangs mtsho ba'i bu/ 'brong rtse khang dmar ba/ bzad bang steng pa/ 'byor rgyas pa/ na gu ba/ 'bag rgyal pha bu/ spyi dpon drag pa lnga/ spe dpon nyer gnyis sogs la ja gral dang phyi dro lo chen mched sogs dang phrad/ gso ba rig pa'i rgyud las/ rin po che yis mi sel gang yang med/ /rin po che dang klu yi nor bu 'dra/ /zhi byed kun gyi log gnon rin po che/ /zhes sbyar dug dbyig dug la sogs ldan 'dus kyi rigs gtso gyur gyi nad bzhi brgya sogs zug rngu gang gi'ang gnyen po/ 'byung po la sogs pa'i gdon kyang thub/khyad par tshe ring zhing lus zungs gso ba'i bcud len mchog tu 'gyur bar bshad na'ang sngon byon gyi bla chen tshos sbyar skabs dngul chu btso bkru rnam dag gi lag len rgyun med cing sman gya gsum la (83na〉nga mtha' dang / chung 'bring dbye ba tsam dang / rgyal rtse chos rgyal gyis bye ba ring bsrel ltar sman sna gya gsum las shel rigs rin po che byu ru g.yu sbur len chur spangs pa bsres pa las gzhan med pa dang / yar stod pas bu mo stag lo ma'i mchin pa dgos pa slo bur du bsad pa dang / zhwa dmar nag /'bri gung pa/ yar rgyab sogs kyi sbyor ba chung 'bring tsam las ma byung bar grags/ rtse chen pa'i grang sbyor 'dzom che ba'i lo rgyus snang yang tshang ma 'byung ba dka'/ ming dang don mthun pa zhig byung na snyam sman khungs btsun yong pa'i las sgo tshor btsal zhing rgyud bzhi 'di khungs btsun kyang de don mdor bsdus las grangs nges kyi zhib cha mi snang /btso bkru'i khungs kyang sngon 'phags yul du drang srong rig pa'i blo gros zhes spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul de nyid kyis ma 'ongs pa'i sems can la dug rigs mi 'dra ba stong dang gnyis 'byung bar —116

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)mkhyen nas de'i sel byed 'tshol bar lto phyogs kyi gling phran zhig tu rdzu 'phrul gyis gshegs pa na der dngul chu btso bkrur mkhas pa'i drang srong dang sman gyi lha mo sogs sprul pa'i skyes chen mang po bzhugs pa'i gtso bo drang srong gzhung skyes las bdud rtsi 'chi med gsum 'dus pa'i bcud len gyi gdams pa lhag ma med par gsan nas 'dzam bu'i gling du grub thob sha ba ri'i dbang phyug dang skyon pa sogs la rim par brgyud pa e 'dug shel dkar rdzong sdod sbyar ra dngos grub la dris pa bod mkhas pa dang sa skya'i dpon tshang la rtsad bcad kyang de skabs gzhan nas ma rnyed par 'khrul zhig gi spyod pa skyong ba dpon tshang nam (83bsgo kha' lha zhes par yod pa ltar be'u bum dang bcas bskur nas brdzangs pa bzhin zhol yong bzhes khang du gsum dar na gsum bslab bcug /zur mkhar dharma su mir sman rgyal g.yu thog pa'i rnam par zhal bstan te gso rig gdams skor mtha' klas pa'i phyag len dmar khrid bcas stsal ba snyan brgyud du bzhugs pa'i nang nas rin chen grang sbyor gtso gyur gyi dug sman zab khyad can bcu phrag gnyis 'bri gung chos kyi grags par bka' babs pa lag tu son pa ra mo bar bslabs pa tshes bcu dgu gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang por slob bcas kyi sman rnams kyang 'dzom che ma tshang ba med pa'i steng nged kyis gong ma'i༄la khab chen por phyin skabs rnyed pa'i rin po che dang shel rigs du ma dang / se wo rgyal po'i rgyal mo rdo rje rab brtan mas stod hor nas byung pa'i rin po che 'gangs can dang / cung wang gis skyes su bsrings pa'i rin po che dang shel rigs sna tshogs/ 'o skol gyi ston pa'i 'phel gdungs bya sgong tsam pas gtsos sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang slob bcas/ rgya bal bod kyi skyes chen mang po'i ring bsrel/ a ru rnam rgyal gser mdog snyam pa tsam pa/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil/ seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma/ stag gson ma'i sma ra/ sbug /sbur len/ mu tig /byu ru sogs lha klu mi'i rin po che bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'gro ba'i ched sa rdo lta bur 'phangs med du btang / sngon gyi rin chen ril bu khungs btsun gyi rta dang bcas rim par sbyor du bsag par grang sbyor/ tsha sbyor/ rta ri ma/ dbang phyug chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud gsum gyi —117—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (kegasung rgyud me lce 'bar (84na)ma'i dgongs don gyi dug 'joms dbang po ril bu sman sna brgya phrag gi skyor ba khyad 'phags bslab tu bcug pa rnams phon che sbyar ba'i dwangs snyigs la sman bla'i bskyed bzlas/ gsum par tshangs pa'i gsung ltar dang / bzhi par dbang phyug gi lugs bzhin rab tu gnas shing me tog gtor bas lha'i bdud rtsi 'chi med/ lha min gyi bdud rtsi 'chi gsos/ mi'i bdud rtsi bde byed du 'gyur bar smon lam nan tan btab don ltar mchog dman mang por byin pas srog bskyabs pa bzhin dge ba'i rgyun bzang po tshugs sam snyam mo/ /nyer gnyis nas sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos byad 'grol sogs rkyen sel kyi rim pa smin rgyas su mdzad de/ nyer bdun la dngul gyi tha phag /mdong mo/ chibs pa sga 'khor sogs dgu tshan lnga'i chos yon dang / gcung gnyis gra dmangs rnamasal gang 'tsham gyi ster cha dang bcas te re zhig rang gnas su bskyod/ drug brgya grub chen sogs bsnyen rdzogs dgu bsgrubs/ gnam gang la bi lig er khe tha'i ji sum cu skor/ thor god khon chen bcas par mngon mtho'i sa bon yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa phab/ gnyis ka rtser gso rig slob gra drang srong 'dus pa'i gling du chos thog zla ba brgyad gyi bar tshes brgyad la sman bla'i mdo chog tshar bdun re star chags gtong ba'i mchod chas/ tsha ra/ ja thug sogs kyi rgyun btsugs/ gsang sngags chos gling par chos gzhis med gshis tshes bcu'i thebs su dpal de ras chen 'di gar gus zhabs kyis dngos chas yod dgu lta bu lhur (84ba)len stabs mkhan nam 'tsho'i bar lo star gzhor 'bo'i khal phyed nyis brgya re/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes gnyis la dad stobs kyi dbang phyug bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po yab yum sras bcas/ blo bzang mgon po rab brtan/ a kha'i/ a la dar/ bsod nams dbang rgyal/ dge tshul ma u zhang pha bu/ bu cing ta ra'i dge tshul ma/ rgyang ro gser sdangs bla ma/ ri khrod dga' ldan bla mar 'gro mi rgyud stod rab 'byams pa bla gras bsam 'phel/ mal dro lhun grub kyi bla ma gsar pa/ rwa sgreng mer gan chos rje/ kong po rdzogs kho dbon pa/ bzhad chos pa/ lhos grong stang pa/shar phyogs pa/ pu shud pa'i bu/ cher gseb pa/ kho khom rgyal po'i sman skyel mi gnyis/ 'bras mo —118

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gzhongs kyi mi sna sogs bod sog drag rigs lnga bcu skor la lag pa'i 'degs 'jog dang dmangs bdun brgyar me tog gtor/ blo bzang mgon po rab brtan dang a kha'i sogs la seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi rjes gnang / gdan sa gong du bsam yas nas rten mdos 'dzugs pa gnang dgos zhus par brten dri ba'i chab shog byung don bzhin pe kur gyi rgyud man ngag nas ji ltar 'byung ba ltar gyi bca' gzhi/ lag len gyer lugs kyis mtsho ni lan phul/ che'i/gsum la se ra theg chen gling bla gnyer dge skos dbu mdzad/ kun dga' ra ba'i gseng g.yabs ldebs bris ngo shus byed mi rags kha 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ chos mdzad bkra shis sogs dang phrad/ tshes bzhin 'phags pa sogs mchod khang yongs rdzogs la brgya mchod/ snyan shal/ (85na 〉 spron lam sogs kyis mtshams sbyar/ dga' ldan hung tha'i ji'i mi sna dbon chung / no mon khang gi mi sna dbon chung / no mon khang gi mi sna dzam bha la sogs nyi shu skor/ ngor mkhan po'i ring 'tsho spel mi dbon po sogs dang phrad/ hung tha'i ji dpon mo bcas pa'i yig rten rgya ser gyi 'phrul bzo dngas shel sbugs nang rta lug khyi ri dwags sogs srog chags du ma dngos su brtse zhing brgyu ba lta bu/ shel sgam sbubs la sbubs brgyud de mtha' dang bral ba lta bu'i khyad mtshar mthong snang mtha' yas pa 'char ba/ su ga rnyi/ nī lam sogs gnangs can mang po snang bar bltas/tshes lngar dpon tshang byang ngos pa khyo shugs bu bcas kyis dkar dro tshan grangs bstar/ tshes drug nas dpal ldan re ma tī mdos mchod kyis gnyes pa'i dus rim bzabs rgyas/ tshes bdun nas rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen pa kha gso bdun phrag song mtshams khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos tshan grangs dang bcas ched du mngags pa gnang ba rten 'brel gyi sgo 'grig /tshes bcu gsum la nang mtshams grol nas khra 'brug tu mchod dpon pa'i lha khang gsar par bzhugs rgyu'i lha rnams gdan 'dren rings par brten rab gnas byas nas bsnyen pa zhag gnyis mu 'thud/ tshes brgya bzhir phyi mtshams grol te byang 'og chos mdzad dang rdor legs par ja gral btang /—119

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (potshes bco lngar thor god khon ching byang la 'gro gdong gi rdzong ba dang bka' bsgo/ tshes bcu drug la gangs can bstan pa'i nyi ma lta bu chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon/ gnyer pa dge 'dun rags bsdus dang bcas pa (85ba)drug brgya skor gyis spyi sger gyi dngos po spams bstod de dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i bden tshig gis 'chi bdag srid sde dang bcas pa'i g.yul las rgyal lam snyam/ de mtshams lha khang chos mdzad blo bzang rab brtan dang phrad cing / da la'i chos rje'i bsngo rten bskyal bar ngan song gi duḥkha las skyob pa'i bsngo smon mchog gsum dpang por gsol te yang dag bstar/ches bcu bdun la se ra theg chen gling slob dpon/ las sne ba/ dge 'dun drug brgya skor gyisakyang ring 'tsho'i bden tshig snga ma dang mtshungs pa mdzad/ rtser dga' ldan khung tha'i ji dang rwa sgreng zur pa'i mi sna gnyis kyis gser dngul gos dar sogs bteg nas gra tshang gi gra pa sum cus ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsungs/ rgyal mo gu rur drag dmar gyi dpa' bo lha gsum gyi dbang dang / rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs bskur khrod se ra smad slob dpon pa dang 'phyos pa sku skye'ang yod/ chos rje sgrol ma ba/ shel dkar chos sde dang skyor lung mas ṣ+ka pa'i bla zur/ ra ba smad/ spe ser/ khams po ti dgon gsum gyi bla ma/ 'phyos pa sku skye/ san khung tha'i ji'i lha btsun blo bzang chos skyong / rdo dgon nas/ rong grags pa ba/ khyung rtse sdings pa/ dngos gzhi ba sogs dang phrad/tshes bco brgyad la gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas khri rin po che byams pa bkra shis kyis dbus shar pa chos rje/ slob dpon pa/ las sne ba/ dge 'dun rags bsdus kyis spyi sger 'byor bstun gyi bdog pa brkyang ste khri rin po ches (86na)bskal par 'tsho dgos ba'i khas len dgos zhes rgyu mtshan mdo sngags kyi lung rigs lam nas drangs te rgyas par gsung ba so skyer rang dbang med mod/ 'on kyang dge 'dun rnams thugs rtse gcig dril dkon mchog gsum la gsol 'debs gnang ba'i nus mthu'i byin rlabs yong ba gzhir bcas shing sdod 'dun byed tshul gyis —120

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)lan phul/ lha ldan ru bzhi pa rnams kyis kyang dngos po maṇ+ḍal tshul du bteg nas bden pa brjod/g.yon ru sku skye/ dwags po lcang ra ba/ sab gru pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ bsam yas sku rten pa sogasal ja gral thog /bram ze ra ma nā thar gser zho gsum/ gla gor bcu gsum/ thus dmar kha bdun/zur chas kyis mtshon re ba bkang /tshes bcu dgur gsang ne'u thog gi khri pa gra slob nyung bsdus dang / skyor lung dgon lag mar khu sbus skyu so sos bdog pa dang bcas ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsungs/ shag byang pa/ jo rjong nas/pad+ma rdo rje sogs dang phrad/ tshes nyi shur gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i 'jug ngogs rgyud stod smad so so nas zang zing gi tshan grangs dang bcas bden tshig dbyangs su gyer/ smad pa'i dge slong dge 'dun shes rab kyis yig drug dung 'dren pa'i dam bca' byed par rjes su yi rang / dga' ldan da'i ching dpon g.yog rags bsdus/ tsa gong bla ma/ ger pa'i tsha bo/ nyi thang bla ma/ stod lung sgang pa/ dar byung ba gzhen pa sogs la ja gral bgyis/ rinyer gcig la g.yon ru dga' ldan hung tha'i ji dang rwa sgreng zur pa'i (86ba)mi snar rdzong bda'/bsam grub gling pa/ rdo dgon nas/ bsam yas sku rten pa pha bu sogs la ja gral dang sku rten par pad 'dab che legs/ rgyan pa cha tshang sogs chos skyong gi stabs bdag rkyen gzengs bstod/ nyer gnyis la lha btsun blo bzang chos skyong sogs dge tshul dgu dang dge bsnyen gnyis la sdom pa phab/nyer gsum la lho mos nas gnas gsar dbon rin po che byon pa dang mjal zhing zhag shas bstan ma khang du bzhugs/nyer bzhir khri rin po che byams pa bkra shis/ nyang rong dang gser sding slob dpon sogs bskyar ma dang / gdong nas/ ge ra ba blo bzang mkhyen brtse sogs gsar pa bcas bsnyen rdzogs bco lnga/ khri rin po cher mas blo bzang bstan 'dzin du gsol/ nyer lngar rgyal mo gu ru 'das pa'i mgyogs bsngo rten rgyan pa cha tshang / dngul lnga bcu ma/ gos yug sogs byung bar 'khor ba dang ga song 'jigs —121—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (keskrag las grol zhing mngon mtho nges legs thob pa'i bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar/ zhi gnas slob dpon/ /bang rim chos sde'i gnyer pa/ cung wang gi sa nas rgya tshe ring snga 'byor dang phrad/ gter lung dang rgya can sogs su skyon rdo rje 'chang gi lung bstan ltar bod khams bde thabs su dwags kong /dbus gtsang / la stod/ bal bod/ de bzhi'i mtshams su bdud 'dul mchod rten re'i bum pa'i nang rta mgrin yang gsang / gshin rje gshed/ rta mgrin/ stobs po che/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ rigs gsum mgon po rnams ldebs bris re dang thang sku re bzhugs su gsol bar rab tu gnas pa (87na)byas/mnga' ris/ lho mon/ shar khams/ byang sog po rnams kyi mtshams su mchod rten dgu re bzheng dgos pa mchod rten rnams nus ldan du byas pa 'di ga nas bskur/ nged rang gi tshogs gsog tu lha sar sman bla brgyad stong sum brgya/ sgrol ma dgu stong brgyad brgya/ sher snying sum 'bum nyi khri dgu stong drug brgya/gdugs dkar nyis stong chig brgya/ mchod khang so sor spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ 'jig rten khams kyi nad rims sad ser sogs zhi thabs su dbus gtsang rdzong gzhis nyi shur zhi ba'i sbyin sreg /rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs gang rung gi khrus gsol/ gnas chen bcu bdun du tshogs brgya/ mchimasaphur 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa'i tshe chog /dbus gtsang gi rdzong gzhis thams cad nas zhogs lnga'i bar dgra lha dpangs bstod/ yul tshan so so nas ri 'go dgur bsangs/ dud ngo yod kyis mkhar khyim so sonas gtong ba'i bkod pa/ chos rje zil gnon rdo rje/ dge slong blo gros rgyal ba/ dge 'dun rin chen/ mkhas btsun dbang phyug /lha dbang rgya mtsho rnams tshe bdag lcags 'dra/ 'jam dbyangasabastan 'dzin bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs/ 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan rdo rje gro lod/ byams pa nor bu dang chos mdzad blo bzang bkra shis rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ ngag dbang dpal bzang byang gter tsha khyung nag rnams kyi dmigs rim hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu gsum nas khrid de bcu bdun la mtshams byed bcug pa 'di smad grol ba kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas grub nas nyer drug la byin rlabs byas/nyer (87ba)bdun la rgyal sras shes rab 'phel ba dang mjal/ nyer brgyad la mchod dpon pa —122

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)khra 'brug gi rten bsgrig tu 'gro ba dang mnyam por gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa gra bcas gzungs 'bul rab gnas la brdzangs/ 'brug pa sprul pa'i skur ja gsum gyi bar ra lung gi rten brten pa las 'phros pa'i dri ba dri lan bstar/ sngar tshugs bzang po rim par shor ba'i da lta'i mdzad pa rnams ya ma zung zhig tu mngon/ yer pa bla gnyer/ rgyud rams pa'i tsha bo/ sa dkar 'go pa sogasakyang yod/ 'brug pa sprul sku dang sems dpa' sprul skur tshe dbang grub rgyal ma phul rjes bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po sras bcas/ dga' ldan ji nong / bkra shis pā thur tha'i ji/ bi lig er khe tha'i ji/u zhad / ja'i sang bcas pa dang mjal/nyer dgur gnas gsar dbon rin po che dang 'dar pa blo gsal bstan 'dzin rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang gsan par nā lan+dar 'byon pa'i rta drel sogs mthun rkyen sbyar zhing bka' bsgo bgyis/ rag pa'i mi ngo rnams kyis dkar dro bteg zhor gsang gling slob dpon pa'ang yod/ gnam gang la 'bag bzo mi dbu mdzad bag dro can la byin rlabs byas/zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig la chos rje thub bstan pa dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i bsngo rten spel bar tsha bo thang po che'i mkhan po 'byor don bzhin thar pa dang rnam mkhyen go 'phang la reg pa'i bsngo bas rgyas btab/ rdor slob dge slong blo gros rgyal bas byas te gshin rje shor sang nyi ma khros pa dang blo bzang mkhyen brtses byas nas ar gtad grangs bcad so sor (88na)mnan pa'i sgrub pa btsugs te dam sri rgyal 'gong gi 'tshub dbal bcag /tshes bzhir rgyal mo gu ru'i bsngo rten dngos gzhi la gyon pa rgyan chas gos dar sogs spams mtho ba rgyal sras mched gnyis kyis bteg par byang chub thob pa'i rgyur bsngo sgron bgyis/ gling stod sku skye/ gnas byang pa/ shangs grong gsar ba/ rgyal rtse sa la ba/ star rdzong du 'gro mi snang dkar bsod nams rab brtan/ sa dkar 'go pa/ chang khyim pa sogs dang phrad pa'i phyi ma gsum por nyer 'tshe las rgyal ba'i bka' bsgo/ phyi dro nas sgo gsum mi 'da' ba'i bcad rgya'i bdun dang por rnam 'joms/—123—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (poganyis par tshe dpag med kyi sgom bzlas la brtson 'grus bskyed/ sa dkar 'go pa lhun grub rgya mtshos mdo dga' ldan gzhan phan gling du 'dzugs rgyur ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ phun tshogs lhun grub kyis dge skos 'jog la dngul gyi pad sder 'bul rgyu'i kha byang / gzhi ba slob dpon phun tshogs chos ldan gyi ngor gling smad chos rje phun tshogs rgyal mas gyi dgongs rdzogs smon lam/tsho:da thang nor bu'i paṇa chen dge 'dun grub gyi 'khrungs rabs rgyab yig /mchod dpon pa'i khra 'brug lha khang gi dkar chag phan bde'i dpag bsam 'dod 'jo dang ri bo chos gling du 'dzugs rgyu'i smon lam/ gnas gsar dbon rin po che'i gsung bzhin gyi gsol 'debs smon lam/ dbu mdzad kyis bkra shis bde chen gyi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs pa'i dkar chag la chun po rnams so so'i bskul ma bzhin brtsams/ (88bsko.a bcu dgur nang mtshams grol ba'i dmag zor tshangs dbang la kha 'bar ma dkar mo'i 'chi blu/ rnam 'joms kyi bkru byab srung gsum/ tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster brgya tshar bskur/tshes nyi shur sngags rams pa nam mkha' bzang po/ grub gling chos mdzad/ brag gdong rgyal phur/ gra tshang gi tshong dpon sogs la ja gral bgyis/ nyer gcig la rgyal sras bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal/ lha bzang klu dbang / ja'i sang gnyis/ byings nyi shu/ chab nag mkhan po/ zhi gnas slob dpon/stag lung gsang sngags chos 'khor ba'i dge skos sogs las sne ba lnga/ kha ba lung pa sogs blon po/shag skor ba'i rigs gra'i skal ba skyel mi nyis brgya/ 'or du su stong skor sku skye dang / er te ni da'i ching gi mi sna/ g.yog dwags po 'tsho byed/ gsar 'byor shi ral thu dge slong/ 'u yan ja'i sang kho sho'u chi'i gzhis 'dzin/ dge slong dar khan nang so/ khal kha no yon khu thug thu'i nu bo/ a pa la'i rgya mtsho/ che chen a kha'i/ er khe a kha'i/ dharma kirti sogs kyi mi sna/ phing sing wang gi mi sna phyir 'khor zung chu rab 'byams pa/ rgya tshe ring rnams dang phrad cing wang gi yi ge rten gser srang bzhi bcu/ so so'i sger gyi gter cha blangs/ mdo khams mgo log dgon gsar bar sa mtshams rang lugs dgon —124

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)par song gshis chos gzhis chung ba'i bsnon mar ngo log pa dud lnga bcu skor lag 'bab ru'i phyed sum brgya thon khungs sbyar/ rgyal thang du bsod nams (yon)gsog pa'i zhing rnam dag mi 'dug pa dga' ldan sum rtsen gling gra pa lnga brgya sum cu skor gyi zhal 'don gsang 'dus gtsor btan gyis phyag drug pa las gshin sogs chos skyong sa lam rnam gsum dang bcas sngags gra btsugs pa'i slob dpon par 'phyong rgyasang ga dbang rnam rgyal/ gnyer pa rgya ma ba blo bzang rab rgyas sogs las byed rnams kyi phogs/ rgyun gtong / tshul sgrub mchod/ bskang gsogatore bzlog bcas pa thebs su dud sum brgya rkang 'gro lag 'don/ ja thug gi 'phar/ gshor 'debs sogs ji srid bstan pa nam gnasabar sbyor 'jags/ 'brug la bar phogs kyi mthun rkyen sa 'byed ma thub bar ru'i khal sum brgya'i gzhor 'debs/ nged rang gi rim gror ser 'bras gnyis su ja tshul nyi shu 'gyed gra pa bcu rer ya ju bar khag re'i thog phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sa ya bdun 'bum chig khri sum stong nyis brgya/ bstan srid spyi rim du lha ldan khyams rar ser 'bras bsgril ba lnga brgyas gdugs dkar chig 'bum chig stong / phun tshogs gling pas sman bla nyi khri bdun stong sum brgya brgyad cu/ sgrol ma sum khri brgyad stong bzhi brgya/ sher snying chig khri lnga stong / sde pa'i sku rim du byams chen pas gser 'od nyis stong lnga brgya nyi shu/ mtshan brjod chig stong nyis brgya brgyad cu/ gdugs dkar chig stong brgyad cu/ sher snying lnga stong / sgrol ma dang tshe gzungs so so dgu khri brgya stong dgu brgya re/ nyer gnyis la gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon bla gras bdog pa dang (yob)bcas ring 'tsho'i cho ga rgyas par btang rjes dga' ldan da'i ching bo shog thu ji nong / g.yog drag pa bco lnga/ byings brgya skor/ bi lig er khe tha'i ji'i dpon mo bu gnyis/ dpon chung blo bzang rab brtan/ jo rig er khe da'i ching / sog dmangs nyisabargya skor la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma dang / phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar gcod kun sel bskur/ rgya nag mi sna snga 'gyogs rta 'bul dbon chung gi nu bo/ bzod ba yel deng gi bu bstan pa'i nyi ma ngam ring gral skor nas 'khor ba/ rgyang ro gser sdings pa dang zim mkhar chos sde'i bla ma/ 'phags sde —125

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (poba'i bla gnyer/ phag ri rdzong sngod 'or pa tshe dbang / shel dkar rdzong sdod grong stod pa/ sbus bde gnyis sdod rtse lnga lto pa/ 'bog gong zhe bo'i rtol/ sgom bde nang chen pa rnams la ja gral btang zhing ji nong dpon g.yog la de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung / nged rang gi bla gos rgya zhe 'phro/ byin rten sna tshogs/ shal dkar dmar snam phrug sogs rdzong ba bzabs/ nyer gsum nas yan lag brgyad ldan gyi sman chu nyin bdun gyi bar bsten/ nged rang re gsum gyi 'phreng la brtag pa byas pa'i sel thabs su gzhis rtser myug chos gling pa/ rnam gling du dga' ldan chos 'khor pa/ rin spungs su byams chen pa dang skyed tshal ba/ pa nam du mtshan sgrog pa/ gong dkar du thod pa ri pa/ pho brang du dar rgyas gling pa/ 'phyong rgyas su bkra shis bde chen te bdun gyis mtshan brjod drug brgya/ sman bla (90na)chig 'bum brgyad stong bdun brgya/ sher snying bzhi khri brgyad brgya/ sgrol ma brgyad khri chig stong dgu brgya/ tshe gzungs drug khri drug stong lnga brgya/ gdugs dkar drug brgya/ sde pa'i rim gror gong dkar du chos 'khor yang rtse bas mtshan brjod 'bum ther/ lha sar shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor ba dang dar rgyas sgrub sde gra slob lnga bcus gser 'od tshig brgya bzhi bcu/ mtshan brjod sum brgya bco lnga/ sgrol ma sum khri bzhi stong / tshe gzungs sum 'bum nyi khri bzhi stong / gdugs dkar dang sher snying so sor nyis stong brgyad brgya/ khams po ti dgon gyi 'du khang 'gyel zhig byung bar lag g.yor gyi 'u lag dang sho mdo nas ja thug gi thebs su 'bru gzhor khal sum brgya dang sha shan khor drug ma gnyis sprad/gnam gang la ser 'bras gnyis kyi slob dpon/ dbyar bdag sogs la byin rlabs byas shing dmangs dgu brgya skor la ngos phrad/ dga' ldan ji nong gi 'dod pa bzhin smon lam bris/zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la 'bras spungs su spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa bzheng dgos pa'i lung bstan bzhin gzungs phul zhing ye shes sems dpa' bstim par me tog gtor/dbon po lo tsā ba/ co ne dang po ti dgon gyi bla ma/ dum bu chos 'khor bla zur/ rngod a rig dgon gyi bla mar 'gro mi 'bras spungs sngags pa'i gra pa blo bzang mkhyen brtse/ dwags po lcang ra ba/ kre pa ngan —126

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)dub kyi bu/ rta 'bul ba lnga bcu skor la ja gral btang (90ba)zhing a mdo chos skyabs kyis rta nyer gcig /nag shod ra dar bla mas rta bcu gnyis/ bya bral dge slong rgya mtsho can gyis rta bcu gnyis/zung chu sngags rams pa blo bzang tshul khrims can gyis rta nyer dgu /klu 'bum bzang po rgyal mtshan can gyis rta nga gcig /sems dpa' dbon po can gyis rta bcu dgu /thu med bstan pa tha'i jis rta zhe gsum/ se ra a rig gong mas rta so lnga/ byams pa 'phrin las kyis rta so dgu rnams byin/tshes gnyis rjes mar grong smad gzhis kar rgyal po rnam thos sras ser chen lha dgu /dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal/ 'go ba'i lha lnga rnams kyi phyi nang gsang rten rgyas par 'dzugs par gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa btang zhing bskang gso'ang zhag kha shas btang / chab nag mkhan po/ thar gling bla zur/ kong po bkra shis rab brtan gyi bla mar 'gro mi se ra dbu mdzad/ nang so dkon mchog dar rgyas sogs dang phrad/ches gsum nas nyin bzhi'i bar dge slong don grub pa/ chos rje kha rag pa/ blo gros rgyal ba/chab nag /thar gling / zhi gnas/ zem mkhar/ se ra dbu mdzad/ skyar po rab 'byams pa sogs dge slong gsar rnying zhe brgyad/ dge tshul so gsum bsgrubs/ rgyal mo gu ru'i zhe dgu thems pa'i bsngo rten dngul gyi zo lag /lte ri/ gzhong pa sogs thab chas phon che ba/ gyon pa cha tshang / phying gur gnyis/ rta sum brgya bco brgyad rnams rgyal sras gnyis skyel bar byung don bzhin 'dis (91na)mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa rnams rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo bas rgyas btab/tshes brgyad la mdo pa chos rje dge ba'i dbang po/ gung thang sku skye'i yab/ don grub dbang rgyal lho nas 'khor ba rnams la ja gral/ tshes bcur bi leg er khe tha'i ji dpon mo bu g.yog bcas thon par 'di pa bstan chen lhag par che bas sangs rgyas 'phel gdung / nged rang gi lham sgrog cha sogs byin rten/ gyon pa cha 'grig shal dkar dmar/ sgam/ snam phrug sogs dpangs bstod/ bka' bsgo bgyis/ de dang lhan cig dga' ldan er khe u'i ching / er te da'i ching gi ja'i sang pak+ṣi/ cho long khā —127—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (7/gi bsngo zhus pa/ rdo rje/ kho lo che/ cha gan no mun khan rnams kyi mi sna/ 'ga' shing rab stims pa'i tsha bo/ hor lha rgyal dar gyi bu/ a mdo rta 'bul ba dzo gi /rtse gdong phyag mdzod/ rgya ma chos mdzad/gdung nag po/ a mdo ba sum brgya skor yod/ grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i ngor 'go ba'i lha lnga'i mchod sprin bsod nams dpal bskyed/ gra tshang rnga deb kyi 'go brjod/ dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang gis bskul ba'i thang lha gnam mtsho gtso gyur gyi byang rgyud kyi yul lha gzhi bdag gi gsol mchod 'dod 'jo'i dpal ster/ ngag dbang grags pa'i ngor bde mchog gi bshad pa'i sngon 'gro spyi bshad/ legs pa rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba'i bkra shis lhun po sngags gra slob dpon pa'i skye ba myur (91ba)'dzin gyi smon lam/ dar mo sman rams pa'i slob ma rnams kyi ngor smon lam/ dga' ldan er te ni u'i ching gi 'dod pa ltar gsol 'debs rnams brtsams/tshes bcu gcig la shangs dar rgyas ri khrod pa bla gras tshan grangs brkyang ste ring 'tsho spel rjes spyan ras gzigs skyer sgang lugs kyi sgom lung phab/ bzang ldan mkhan por dbon po lo tsā ba thon gdong byin rlabs bka' bsgo dang rdzong ba rgyas par byas shing thub bstan dge 'phel gyi mkhan po'i ring lha rtse nas lo star gtsang bre tshad kyi khal sum brgya re dang dgon der ji srid bskal pa'i bar tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su lha rtse khul nas lo bcu rer gra pa bcu re byed dgos pa'i gra rgyun btsugs pa sa skya tshad kyi rna bar ma grags pa'i zab chos la 'phel rgyas byung na snyam mo/ mdo pa chos rje dge ba'i dbang po sgye chu dang lu bu'i mkhan por rdzong ba bzabs shing bka' bsgo dang bcas re ba bkang /tshes bcu bzhir dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang gis rung mthun gyi gos cha tshang sogs dngosapo rgya cher bteg nas gra tshang gis mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i ring 'tsho mdzad nas dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang / dpon chung lnga/ chos rje gcig /ja'i sang drug /byings lnga bstoskor/ lha btsun blo bzang chos skyong / rgyal sras bsod nams bkra shis/ dge tshul ma/ dpon mo/ shangs dga' ldan —128—

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)chos 'khor ba'i bla gnyer/ ngag dbang bzod pa/ dpal de ba/ bsam grub gling pa/ lcang rgyab pa/ tshe ring 'bum (92na po gon thang pa/ ma chen tshe bdag sogs bod sog sum brgya tsam dang phrad/tshes bco lngar khal kha no yon khu thug thus yon sbyar te gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa spel rjes no yon khu thug thu'i nu bo khyo shugs/ dga' ldan chos 'khor slob dpon/ stag rtse tha'i ji lha rgyal rab brtan/ pā thur tha'i ji'i bu/ sgom bde nang chen pa rnams dang phrad cing ngo bo tshor byin rlabs/ no yon khu thug thu dang stag rtse tha'i jir bka' bsgo phyi dro nges gsang rdor gling bla ma sku skye ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs la ja gral/ tshes nyi shur dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang dpon g.yog /er khe u'i ching / 'ga' ru dka' bcu bsod nams rgya mtsho/ bar ta blo bzang dang chos mjad/ sems dpa' chen po'i dbon po/ gser kha rab 'i stims pa gser skyel ba/ rta 'bul bya bral ba mi bcu gnyis sogs bod sog nyis brgya skor dang phrad cing ngo bor byin rlabs/ dga' ldan tshe dbang dpon g.yog rags bsdus la phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang / dga' ldan chos 'khor ba bla grar dmigs brtse mar brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byas/ nyer gcig la dga' ldan chos 'khor bla ma dang se ra stod slob dpon byed rgyu sogs dge slong gsar rnying dgu dang rab byung gcig bsgrubs/ nyer gnyis la zangs ri nas sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs dpon g.yog nyer lnga skor dang ja gnyis kyi bar los pa zhib tu byung / de rjes gnas gsar dbon rin po che gra bcas/ 'bras spungs spyi gnyer/bde chen bsam gling pa dang zar bla ma/ (92ba〉stong skor ba'i bsngo rten skyel mi bstan pa rin chen/zungs chu rta 'bul ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/ blo bzang tshul khrims/ bya bral rta 'bul ba grags pa rgya mtsho/ tsho gos gnyis rgya mtsho/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ bzod pa sogs phyed sum brgya skor gyi ngo bor byin rlabs dang dmangs la me tog gtor/nyer gsum la tsho mes chen du gong gi gser yig pa rgan pa no mo gon dge slong / gzhen pa er te ni dge slong / 'grul sdebs yel pa bla ma/ gtsang pa dge slong sogs 'go pa bzhi bcu skor/ 'di —129

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (poga'i mi sna rgan pa 'dul ba slob dpon/ gzhen pa rta 'bul dbon chung / bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po'i mi sna/ mtsho kha nas rten mas skyel mi pā thur dbon po sogs nyis brgya skor la dkar dro dmar dro'i dga' ston spel/ gong ma'i bka' shog rten spams mtho bar snang / so so'i babs bstun gyi dri rmed byas shing 'dul ba slob dpon pas gos dar sogs zang zing dngos gtsang rgya che ba'i ster byin byas/de nyin rgyun sdod sde pa a bar sogs kyi steng gnas gsar dbon rin po che/ rgyal ba chos rje/ zur chen sprul sku/ 'dar pa rje drung sogs bsgrigs/ phyi dro dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang gcig pu dang 'phros gleng zhib rgyas gleng / rigs 'dzin thugs thig gi lung bstan gab sbas ye shes gsal sgron las/ smon lam lhan cig btab pa'i mthu btsan pas bod yul gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir 'dzom par 'gyur khyad par g.yu ru gra zhes bya ba'i phur da lta'i lo tsā be+e ro tsa na yi sku yi sprul pa (93na)las ldan snying gi bu bongs snyoms gnas lngar rigs lnga'i rtags rgyas spras gsang ba'i ming ni 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal: gsang sngags snod ldan nga yi chos la mos bco brgyad lo la sbas pa'i gter sgo 'byed ces lung gis zin pa'i sprul sku gter bdag gling pas zab gter bzhes par phyi nang gsang rtags rnams rim par ma 'phyugs pa gal che ba/ 'di spyod skyes bur 'du byed rig ma ni lha lcam sa le'i sprul pa rigs ldan pa las kyi 'brel bas sprul pa gsum du 'byung : rat+na mkha' 'gro'i rtags kyis spras pa ni rta yi lo pa shar gyi phyogs nas 'byung : mtshan ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rtags 'chang ma: 'brug gi lo pa nub kyi phyogs nas 'byung : rigs ldan pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i rtags 'chang baḥbya sprel lo pa byang gi phyogs nas 'byung : 'di gsum sprul sku'i rig mar 'brel ba na nyams rtogs gong 'phel tshe yi bar chad sel 'gro don bstan pa mtha' ru 'phel bar 'gyur gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro pad+ma'i rigs 'chang mas te sgrom gter la dbang zhing spyod par 'gyur rigs ldan phyag rgya lnga yi 'du 'khrugs sel zhes dang / o dkar brag gi zab gter kha byang las gzhan yang las ldan bsten bya dang : log spyod spang bya'i skyon tshang ba gang yin sgrib med lung byang bzhin: mthong nas spang —130

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)blang gces par bzung : 'chal par spyad na rang srog gcod mi mthun rkyen dang byu bskyed: de phyir rtog pa rab tu chug don (93bskong ldan no snying gi buḥ zhes sogs lung gis zin pa'i gsang yum 'khrul med cig byung tshe spyi sger thams cad kyi legs rgyur mchis gshis rten 'brel 'grig pa gal che'ang / khab bzhes kyi 'os kha shas dang bcas brtag pa dgos tshul dang yum dang phyag phyi rnams kyi blor yar 'brog khri lcam yod lugs kyi rgyu mtshan byung ba ltar 'os tho rnams kyi nang nas khri lcam bar chad kyi dbang du ma song na ngo dkar shar ba bzhin khri lcam dngos grub dpal 'dzom byon par legs skyes tshan grangs kha shas dang snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i 'phrin gsol zung 'jug snye ma dang bcas nyer bzhin rtsis rig smra ba phu lung blo bzang yon tan mngags/ tshoms chen du gong ma'i mi sna rgan gzhen 'grul sdebs dang bcas pas rang rang gi 'byor bstun gyi dngos po bstab/ spyan g.yas mkhan po/ bkra shis chos gling bla ma/ thu med bstan pa tha'i ji/ tsha bo/ rgya mtsho/ klu 'bum a mdo ba brgyad cu sogs khyon bzhi brgyar ja gral btang zhing dmangs la me tog gtor/ gung tshigs la zur khang pa ngag dbang dpal bzang lus bsgyur ba'i sngon 'gror dkar dro dmar dro sde ba a bar 4 sa nang skor ba dang / phyi rol tu byings la bstar zhing rgyun sdod drung 'khor gras su zhugs/ gra tshang du skye ring sa ya gcig lnga khri chig stong / drag sngags so drug pa'ang gong 'dra btsugs/nyer lngar dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang 'dam du thon gdong dang sgrom mda' mkhan po sbyin pa rgya mtsho gnyer bcas/ ldan ma bkra shis dgon gyi bla ma shes rab rgyal mtshan/ gnas gsar don (94na)grub dang phrad/ nyer drug la gnas gsar chos rje dbon lto mos su rdzong bda' zhus/nyer bdun la gong ma'i gser yig pa rgan gzhon 'grul sdebs dang bcas pa/ no yon khu thug thu 'dul ba chos rje/ sgrom mda' dang dga' ldan rab brtan mkhan po/ chab nag dang thos bsam dar rgyas gling bla ma sogs bod sog sum brgya skor la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dpag med/ skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin dang spyan ras gzigs rnams kyi dbang dang rig gtad bskur nas chos nyan pa'i steng —131—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (podar rgyas sgrub sde'i bla gra/ g.ya' bzang gnyer pa/ chog thu tha'i ji'i mi sna/ lhun grub rab brtan pa rnams la ja gral btang /nyer brgyad la mi sna gzhen pas bsam blo a zhang ngag dbang sbyin pa'i bsngo rten du gser gyi maṇ+ḍal gos dar sogs gto me che ba/ su ga gon gyi a lce'i bskur ma bla bre si'u ma phyogs bzhir rgya 'phan bzo bkod legs pas mtshane pa/ 'phan ring cha/ ser stod zur pa/ dzod mar dpon khu tshan/bā ring tha'i ji spun rnams dang phrad/ gnam gang la sgrom mda' mkhan po ngag dbang dpal bzang mi sna rgan pa chos lhor dpal bzang / gzhen pa blo bzang 'phrin las/ dar rgyas gling bla ma sogs la dge slong gi sdom pa phab/ rwa sgreng mkhan po/ dbu chos/ thugs sras zla ba/ 'od mchog sprul sku/ pad gling sku skye/ bres gdan sa pa/ zhang ston lhun grub khu tshan/ mnga' bdag pad+ma thub bstan/ shar mon dmag dpon (94bsgom sras gling pa/ gnam bde legs pa/ gnyer phyag dpon tsho sde pa dang bkrasagashongs pa/ rnam sras gling pa'i bu bkra shis rab brtan/ sog tsan+dan dgon gnyer pa mngon dga' ba/dzo ge dbon po blo bzang / dge slong bkra shis rgya mtsho sogs dang phrad/ zhang ston ri khrod pas rta lnga bcu dang / rwa sgreng dgon spyis rta nyer gcig byung / 'tsho byed dar mo ba lag g.yog tu 'gyur ba'i mig rgyang du yar stod chu skor ba can dud bcu gsum phye gsal byas pa dang sa brjes dgos tshul ltar shel grong gzhis ka shar la gtogs pa lag 'bab brgyad brgya brgyad cu dang 'bag 'bag can dud bcas la ru'i khal nyis brgya nyer bzhi'i bsnon ma/ lcang ra zil gnon tshe dbang la rang khungs lha steng nas spyil chung gnyis/ zhung sa tham rkang nyer drug lag yong ru'i bdun brgya so lnga rang 'jags thog gus zhabs pa bdag rkyen dgos gras yin pa mdo 'gar mi nor sa gzhis rgya khyon tshugs ka bzang ba'i mag par rdzong bda'/ skyid thang nor bu blo gtod bzang ba dang zhi drag sgrub rten lding grong byang gzhis ka dud 'dzin che chung dgu /lag yong sum brgya re gnyis/ chu mig kha par zhi drag sgrub rten du lding grong lho'i gzhis ka them che chung brgyad/ lag 'bab sum brgya re drug /mchod dpon ngag dbang —132

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)shes rab la sgrags phu smon grong gzhis ka bod 'brog dud bcu gcig /lag 'bab drug brgya bcu gsum/ phyur khal bcu bzhi/ mar khal bdun cu/ sgrol phug nang ma mthun par rgan pa zur sdod byed rgyur dkar brag (95na)gsung gling sogs dud 'dzin bdun/ sku gsung thugs rten mchod rdzas/ lag 'bab drug brgya nyer drug /dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa nged rang gi h+phu sa su sdod rtag cing dpe cha'i do dam sogs la byed sems 'jug pa dang slar yang sgrub rten mig rgyang du khu mi'i shas g.yul dkar gshongs sogs dud 'dzin bcu gnyis/ lag 'bab brgyad brgya so bzhi/ gra tshang phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i mchod gzhis khu mi phul ba'i sa tshab dang mchod yul gzhan dang ma 'dra ba'i rgyun 'gro che bar gnyer tshad 'dzin thebs 'phar dang bcas rdo lhun grub pho brang la gtogs pa'i gzhis ka na lcang rtsa rigs bdag thob nang chas dud chen lnga bcu/ chung ba bcu gsum/ lag 'bab nyis stong sum brgya/ blo bzang don yod la star sdong gu ru byas che'i rigs brgyud stabs mig rgyang du lce te zhol bsam mkhar gzhis ka bsdad grong bcu gnyis/ lag 'bab bdun brgya nga bzhi/ yer pa dga' ldan gsang sngags yang rtse bar mchod gzhis gtong sgo gshor 'debs byed rgyun la sa 'byed dgos tshul bzhin grong stod la gtogs pa'i gzhis ka bsdad grong bcu gnyis/ lag 'bab sum stong brgyad brgya nyi shu/ ru ba gsar snon rtse lha sgang rtsa gu steng gong dkar gra tshang spyir phul pa'i sgrub mchod thebs su lag yong re dgu zhing le tshan bzhi/ 'tsho byed phag ri ba khams su yul jo'i thu pā thur tha'i ji'i g.yog tu 'gyur zhing / dpon mo bsod nams sgrol ma'i sar bcar sdod yin gshis gzhis rtse nas(95ba)zhing sogasum/ dud chung gnyis kyi mi gra/ khang mig drug /dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa yi ge'i lag g.yog tu 'gyur ba'i bdag rkyen du skyid gshongs grags chen nas dud chung gi shul dud che chung drug /lag 'bab lnga brgya/ bde rgyas pa'i skyes dman lto skal dang sa brjes dgosatshul ltar rnam gling nas zhing che chung re gnyis/ chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse yi ge'i lag g.yog tu 'gyur bar gra nang ser khung nas dud che chung bcu gnyis/mi lag 'bab bzhi brgya go lnga/ mdun grong —133—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogepa'i skyes dman ma bu'i lto skal la dud 'dzin drug /lag 'bab nyis brgya gya drug rnams sbyor 'jags byas/ gsang ba grub par/ dpal ldan 'dus las mchog gzhan med/ /'jig rten gsum gyi rin chen gyur/ /snying po las ni snying po mchog khyud kun gyi ni bla ma'i bla/ /bstan dang bshad pa rnam gnas na/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor rim pa nyid/ /'dus pa gang gis mi shes pa/ /de yis dngos grub ji ltar 'grub/ /ces 'di phyi'i bde 'bras dang rgyud sde thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i khyad par yang /dmar nag gi rgyud gnyis las/ rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes shin tu rnyed dka' don che'i chos 'di nyan pa dang 'dri 'don phyogs gcig tsam 'dzin pa mchod bstod byed pa'i gang zag de mthong thos dran reg thams cad byang chub rdo rje ste rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra ltas phyag la sogs pa bya bar gsungs na bskyed rdzogs thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa lta ci smos te (96na)rgyud phyi mar/ e ma'o shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni/ khyud kyi phyi ma'i phyi mar gyur/ /gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya'i rgyud/ /ces bdun ldan phal cher gser sdingasapa gzhen nu 'od la bka' babs pa rim bzhin bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ khyung lhas pa/ chos kyi dpal ba gsum la gnang / gsum gas srid gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen por stsal par brten bcom ldan 'das gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dbyar mtsho ltar ches cher 'phel ba'i 'byung gnas rgyang ro gser sding gzhan dang mi 'dra bar bsams sge grong gi dgon gzhis khang pa rten gsum mchod rdzas nang chas/ them rkang bzhi bcu/ lag 'bab chig stong bdun brgya bzhi bcus gang thon gyis lo star gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod nyin grangs gang 'byongs rgyun du 'dus pa'i bshad srol 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang kun spyod mig rgyan du phan pa dgos rgyu/ shel dkar chos sde dang ma mthun pa'i sa tshab dam pa'i bu bstan 'dzin spun la ltag lung yig mkhan khungs rtse ga chi lta/ka khyim byang gnyis/ lag 'bab sum brgya dang gnyis/ tshags pa mgon po sde pa bsod nams rab brtan dus nas bzo rten 'dug rung byings—134

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)mthun chag cha ma byung ba'i zhu re snga phyir byung ba lag g.yog dbu mdzad da lta lugs yong rtsis kyi zhing tshur blangs ngos sngar 'dzin khang zhing gi bogs khral rtsa chag steng lcang rgyab pa'i sa cha'i sum cha gcig bye (96ba)mda' bas nyis 'dzin gyi bogs/ lho'i zhing chen phyed/ rkang 'gro gcig rtsa chag rnams bgyis/hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig nas zhag bcu gcig gi bar sme brtsegs sgom bzlas la chig dril bstar bas spyi sgos kyi grib ma mi gtsang ba'i dri ma bsal nyams shar/ 'on kyang gnas dus yo byad sogs sger ma nas gcig sel gnyis bgos dbang gis slar yang 'dir 'bad dgos par go /tshes bzhir tsha rong pa'i slob ma bsod nams phun tshogs kyis rgyud bzhi'i rgyugs sprad/ tshes bcu gcig la nang mtshams grol te grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang dmag zor tshangs dbang la byad 'grol dang / byab khrus smin rgyas byas/ tshes bcu gsum la dbu sgor chung ba/ blo bzang er khe tha'i ji'i dpon mo bu bcas/ mi lhag dgon gsar/ mtshal yang dgon/ nam mkha' mdzod/ do nang pad gling / me rag /nag shod sbus mda' rnams kyi bla ma/ gnas gzhi chos rje/ a mdo a li chos rje'i sku skye sogs rta 'bul ba lnga bcu stag rtse tha'i ji/ lhun grub rdzong pa/ bar ta blo bzang / dpon chung tshogs bdag /nga phod pa/ gdang khar a bo/ gzhung 'gron tshong dpon 'phrang gdong pa dang dpal gro ba/bum thang g.yul rgya ba spang rtsa phun tshogs/ thugs dkar ba thogs legs bkra shis tshe brtan sogs bod sog sum brgya skor gyi ngo bor byin rlabs dmangs la ja gral btang / nag shod spus mda' bla mas rta so gcig /a li chos rje'i sku skyes bcu gcig byung / don grub dbang rgyal gyis (97na)sku la mkha' ri'i pha bong rus sbal nag po nas gter ston pad+ma gling pas gdan drangs pa ma dros bye ma las grub pa'i slob dpon pad+ma sam bha ba'i sku khungs btsun byin/ 'tshe ba las skyob ba'i bka' bsgos/ sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis rung mthun gyi gos cha tshang / dgu tshan so drug la rin gong dngul srang drug brgya dang bzhi/ tshogs bcas yon gra pa rer zhwa ser re/ mkha' 'gro'i bsun bzlog sngon 'gro'i tshe chog rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung tshes bcu gnyis la spams bstod/—135

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtonetshes bcu bdun la rgur tsha ba chos dbang lhun grub/ thugs sras zla ba dang pad gling gra pa bzhi bcu dge tshul dang / so dgu bar ma rab byung du bsgrubs/ tshes bcu dgur thugs sras zla ba thon gdong gi mjal kha dang / 'di nyin nas nyer gcig bar bka' 'gyur khang du rgyal pa chos rjes mkhan slob sbrags te dge tshul sum brgya nyer dgu bsgrub tu bcug /phun gling ngag dbang blo gros kyis 'grel pa don gsal dang phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ de 'grel theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings/ rab stims pa nor bzang rgya mtshos dbu mdzod rtsa 'grel dang phar phyin thal 'phrong / dka' bstoblo bzang dar rgyas kyis dbu mdzod rtsa 'grel/ dka' bcu dam chos can lngas dbu ma rtsa 'grel dang phar phyin thal phreng / skal bzang rgya mtsho can bdun gyis mdzod rtsa 'grel/ blo grosargya mtsho can nyer dgus dbu ma rtsa 'grel/ dam cho ge rgya mtsho can gyis phar phyin mtha' gcod/ bstan pa rgya mtshos(97ba)bde legs nyi ma'i 'dul ba gzhi stod / blo bzang yar 'phel gyis mdzod rtsa dang 'grel pa don gsal rnams kyi rgyugs sprad/nyer gcig la 'bri gung sprul sku rin po che/ phyag mdzod/ rigs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub/spo spo ban grong pa/ dge slong dam pa/ bla ma rgyal sras pa bcas rags bsdus kyis rta lnga bcu sogasabadog pa sngon song gis mjal/ ja yun gsum bar chos dang 'brel ba'i gsung gleng rgyas par byung /rtser sgrom mda' mkhan po/ rong byams chen/ phun tsho gos gling / ri bo rnam rgyal gsum gyi bla ma/ ri khrod dga' ldan bla zur/ chos rje smra bo lcog pa/ rmu le rab 'byams pa'i gser khral skyel mi dka' bstod pa la 'byor bkra shis/ sgo mangs pa'i 'bul sdud pa/ khong ji nong gi mi sna sba sun/ rgya'i hwa shang gnyis/ thu med bstan pa tha'i ji sogs nyis brgya skor dang phrad/ nyer gnyis la u khe res tha'i ji'i bu dar khan chos rje ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ thu med nor bu tha'i ji pha bu/ smo ring dang gangs can mkhan po/ gdang pa/ khra 'brug chos skyong gi sku rten pa rnams dang phrad/ sgo mangs bla zur ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis kha btags stong phrag gsum dang brgyad/ dkar yol legs zhel re/ bla bre che legs/—136

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)lnga bcu ma sogs srang chig stong lnga brgya nga gcig /gser zho brgya/ gos yug chig brgya sum cu/ kha btags mthing khra brgya/ ma gtsu gsar rnying 'dres pa yug brgyad brgya/ mtshal sgam brgya/ spos chag brgya/ ja sbag brgya/ sbug chol sil (98na〉snyan re/ dkar yol gyi tha phag gsum/ sbu la ha ri gser ma bzhi/ ras yug sum brgya/ rnga mo bdun/ rta chig brgya so lnga/ dngul sga dang dkyus 'dres bdun/dar dkar yug ring dang bcas khyon lnga stong lnga brgya sogs gra rgan bsam sbyor gnyis ka bzang po'i rjes bzhag /dngos po chud mi za ba'i bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs kyang bgyis/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis rta so brgyad byin/ gong gsal sum brgya skor la thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgom lung phab/nyer gsum la blo gsal gling pa 'phags pa bsod nams kyis 'bum po ti gsum gyi rgyugs blangs/ 'bri gung sprul pa'i sku/ byams chen dang phun tsho gis gling gi slob dpon sogs bsnyen rdzogasare drug bsgrubs shing 'bri gung sprul skur mtshan ngag dbang chos grags phun tshogs su gsol/ me rag bla ma dang mda' dpon gnas gsar ba dang phrad cing don grub dbang rgyal phag rir don gcod la brdzangs/nyer bzhir bsnyen rdzogs nyer drug dang nyer lngar ngam ring dang gangs can mkhan po/ nag shod sbus mda' dang mi nyag dgon gsar bla ma/ yel pa chos rje sogs bsnyen rdzogs zhe lnga bsgrubs/dgu gtor tshong dpon brag gdong pa dang sbus srang pa gnyis mdor thon/ nyer drug snga mar 'bri gung sprul sku rin po cher na bza' cha tshang / dngul mdong / sbug sil/ ja gos dar sogs shangs len rgyas par phul te sti gnas su byon/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan zur kha rab pa/ thang sag slob dpon phun tsho gos cho me ldan/ bde (98bston tha'i ji sogs dang mjal/ phyim red 'brug la slob dpon/sman thang pa/ a mdo dar khan chos rje brtson khrus rgya mtsho/ dpon ser sbar/ a rig ngag dbang /a mdo ba ngo bo brgya skor la byin rlabs/ byings la ja gral/ a mdo ser sbar gyis rta nyer brgyad/ a —137

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (7)rig ngag dbang gis rta lnga bcu byung / nyer drug rjes mar sde pa zur par rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs dang dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang / tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster brgya tshar/ tsha bo rgyal phur la tshe dbang rnams bskur/nyer brgyad la san khung tha'i ji'i tsha bo lha bsno/ dpon mo tshe ring / tsha mo/ blo bzang mgon po'i bā khan dge slong / shel brag /a pa/ 'ol dga' dka' bcu/ kong po mchod khang rtse ste bla ma bzhi/ cho 'khor tha'i ji/ nor bu tha'i ji/ dar khan chos rje/ ldan chos 'khor ba'i mi bcu gnyis/ 'dul ba zur pa o rod chos rjes a'i ching dbon po can gsum mngags te gos dar shel dpyad lnga bcu ma gser dngul gyi sga sogs srang chig stong drug brgyar nye ba bteg /ngo bo tshor lag 'degs 'jog gi byin rlabs/ dmangs la me tog gtor zhing thams cad la ma ṇi'i bzlas lung phab/ nyer dgur rong byams chen bla gra gnyer pa dgon lag g.yag sder bcas pas tshan grangs spel zhing ring por 'tsho ba'i bden tshig brjod/ rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len bstar/ phyi dro sde pa zur par gser dngul sbug sil ja gos dar bye bur sogs dngul srang dgu brgya zhe gnyis la bskor ba spams bstod de (99na)rdzong bda' bgyis/ gnam gang la 'phrul snang bsnyen gnas ma tsho nyin zhag gcig pa'i sdom par bkod/ rme ru bla ma rin chen rgya mtshos gser zho chog brgya sogs yod dgu bteg nas gra tshang gis mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan zur/ rdzing phyi mkhan po co ne/ nam mdzod slob dpon/ do sher rab stims pa/'ga' shing tsha bo/ thor god da'i ching gi dpon mo dge tshul/ bkra shis pā thur tha'i ji'i dbon mo/ zangs ra'i ja gsar skyel mi lnga 'dzom/ yel pa chos rje sogs dang phrad/ do sher rab stims dang pā rasanang sos rta bdun cu byin/ byang gling pas be ser du dge rgyun sbyar ba'i smon lam/ lkog pa phun tshogasadabang po 'du ba 'khrugs pa gzhil bcos kyi skabs snyan tshig gi 'phrin lan gdung sel zla ba'i chu rgyun/ des paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi zhakhrungs rabs lnga tshar/ smon grub pa rin chen bkra shis kyi —138—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)skyon rnam thar theng grangs bcu gsum/ dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mo'i dngul gyi byang chen mchod rten rnams kyi rgyab yig smon lam 'dod dang bstun/zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig la 'brong rtse rgyal phur gyis bdog pa dang bcas te gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa mdzad/ rgyal legs bshad gling cho so rje/ ngam ring dang gangs ga mkhan po chab mdo rje drung / lhos pa sku skye/ dar khan chos rje/ 'dul ba zur pa/ do sher rab 'byams pa/ phun tshogs gling / byams chen/ g.yag sde dgon rnams (99ba)kyi bla gra sum brgya skor la thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa/ a ra pa tsa na gtso rkyang / phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gsum gyi rjes gnang bskur/ ngam ring mkhan pos sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi 'gul phur yin zer ba lag tu son/ phyi dro 4 ring dang gangs can mkhan po/ to po ri kha dang 'on bde r+ṣa steng bla ma drug brgya dge slong / g.yon ru shi ral thu'i sku skye/ dka' bcu blo bzang chos skyong / rnam thar rdzong pa'i mi sna gnyis bcas dang phrad/ drug brgya dgo slong la bka' bsgo/ ban gzan legs pa/ ja mar gyi mthun rkyen sprad/ g.yul rgyal lcog tu yang bzlog gi las sbyor chen mo btsugs/tshes gnyis la dga' ldan phun tshogs gling bla gra gnyer pa dgon lag bcas pas tshogs 'gyed bdog pa bstar te gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i rten 'byung bsgrigs pa'i mgron du 4 ring / gangs༅/ rgyal gsum gyi mkhan po/ chab mdo rje drung / los pa sku skye/ byamasachen dang chab nag bla ma 'dar pa rje drung bcas yod/ tshes gsum la sde pa zangs rir 'degs gdong gi ngos phrad/ 'dul ba zur pa dang chos rje 'od mchog pa gtsang du thon/ bsam blo mer gan chos rje'i ngor gsol 'debs smon lam/ rnam gling paṇa r+pā gyi slob ma ri chos pa ngag dbang chos grub rtses dang du bshad pa byed pa'i 'go brjod/ lha sa byang gling pas 'bras spungs sngags pa/ pha bong kha/ phyon chosagater gling / stag lung gsang sngags chos 'khor/ lha sa/ ra mo che 'i bcas pa dmigs brtse ma khag bzhi/tshes bcu ba khag lnga (100na)bsnyen gnas ma gcig /ma ṇi ba bco lnga rnams la spyi rdzas mang 'gyed —139

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gesogs sbyar te 'dzugs rgyur ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad le tshan brgyad/ rgya nag rgyal por 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig tshig lhug snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa/ rang bstan gyi sgor bzhugs nas bsam sbyor ngan 'chang em chi sangs rgyas 'byung gnas gnang chung rung byed pa ma 'dra bar brten ga nubasta kyi gong khug sro ma can zhag gsum la nges pa 'grub pa'i rgyal po byes chas ke tu bka' gter gnyis ga'i chu bo gcig 'dres chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi zab chos phyag len la ral gri phyung brdeg ma lag tu blangs pas me 'brug gi lo khong khrag kha dang srin sgo nas thon bzhin par 'jig rten phyi ma'i ltad mor song ste las sbyor thog tu khel ba'i gtang rag rgyal po lcog tu gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcad kyis btang skabs rgyal po sku lnga spyi dang / khyad par byes chas ke tur snyan shal go mtshon spyan gzigs sogasabazabs rgyas kyi tshe gos mchin kha yug la tshigs bcad/ kun dga' ra ba'i g.yabs phibs ldebs bris zhal bshus thang kha'i rgyab yig /sems dpa' sprul pa'i skus 'di ga'i 'khrungs rabs rten bzhengasakyi smon lam/ gong ma'i gser yig gzhen pa bsam blo er te ni chos rje'i gser thang rgyab yig rnams brtsams/tshes lngar chos rje gnas gzhi ba brdzangs te nyin bdun gyi bar gter sgrom gyi chu tshan bsten/tshes bcu dgur gnas rnying sku skye ri bo bde chen gyi mkhan por thon/ lnga mchod gling me 'bring stod byung /nged rang la mor shar ba'i gegs sel ngam ring (100ba)du lu bu bas sgrol dkar/ shel dkar du chos sde bas bka' 'gyur/ lha rtser bkra bzang pas 'chi med 'od snang / se brgya mkhar ba dang chu mig pa gnyis kas sgyu 'phrul tshe chog /chos sde bas tshe gzungs/ phun gling du rang gras bka' 'gyur/ gzhisartser zha lu pas rnam rgyal stong mchod/ lhun po rtse pa/ myug chos gling pa/ gangs can pa/ dga' ldan chos 'khor ba bzhis bka' 'gyur/ rin spungs su nges gsang rdor gling pas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ byams chen pa dang skye tshal bas tshe gzungs/ pa nam du ngor pas 'chi bdag 'joms pa 'chi blu dang bcas pa/mtshan sgrog pas tshe gzungs/ 'dus byung du brag la bas tshe dpag med lcags sdong ma/ gong dkar du —140

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja) chos sde bas sgrol dkar/rdo rje brag pas 'chi med sku gsum rigs 'dus/'phyong rgyas su dpal ri bas rigs 'dzin srog sgrub/ri bo bde chen pa/bkra shis bde chen pa/lam rim pa gsum gyis mtshan brjod/pho brang du smin grol gling pas thugs thig gi tshe dpag med/bkra shis chos sde bas sgrol dkar/ri bo chos gling pa dang rtses dang lnga mar pas mas brjod/do bo rdzong du gnas gzhi bsardzong chen tshe dpag med/sku rab dga' ldan rab brtan pas gdugs dkar/rgyal du dmag zor mar bkang ba 'bum/gur zhal beg tser khri/mal dro gung mkhar du ka tshal zur pas yang zab kyi tshe dpag med/lha sar gsang sngags byang chub gling pas dngas ma bcud 'dren/rme ru bas su tsā 'bum/bon chos ni skor dang gzi 10bskor du klu bcos/srog blu phyed sum brgya/ri mtho sar klung dar re gsum/mer par la 'bum/khyon sgrol dkar gyi tshe chog phyed lnga brgya/snying po spel tshig can chig 'bum brgyad khri chig brgya/lcags sdong /srog sgrub/rdzong chen gsum gyi tshe chog so sonas dgu brgya re/sgyu 'phrul tshe chog gsum stong /sku gsum rigs 'dus sum stong dgu brgya/'chi med 'od snang dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa nyis stong bzhi brgya re/thugs thig tshe chog chig stong nyis brgya/dngas ma bcud 'dren sum stong /yang zab tshe chog chog stong brgyad brgya/bka' 'gyur chig brgya nyer lnga/mtshan brjod nyis 'bum nyi khri sum stong lnga brgya drug cu/sher snying chig 'bum bdun khri lnga stong nyis brgya/gdugs dkar chig 'bum nyi khri lnga stong drug brgya/tshe gzungs bye ba gnyas bdun 'bum nyi khri/sāts+tsha nyis 'bum/sde pa'i sku rim du 'ol dga' ri khrod pa rnams kyis tshe gzungs sa ya drug dang drug khri/mkhar rtser thang sag pas bka' 'gyur bcu gnyis/chu shur du thar gling pas gser 'od bdun brgya/lha sar dpal gsol brgya tshar dang sgo 'gyed/dgon khag drug cur mang skol/bstan srid la rgya'i gegs sel du gzhis rtser lug bya lung pas mgon po g.yul bzlog/phung po ri bo cher sgrol ma bsatshe bdag gtor bzlog /rgyab chos su ba so bas sher snying bzhi stong brgyad brgya/ rgyal rtser brag la bas 'char ga'i mdos/ rin spungs su nges gsaX rdor gling pas 'char ga'i mdos/ rgyab chos su

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (kebyams chen 0ba pas sher snying 'bum/sgrol ma mig stong nyis brgya/tshe gzungs sum stong drug brgya/gong dkar du chos sde bas zhal gyi gtor — /dkon gnyer pas phyag bzhi pa'i gtor bzlog/rdo rje brag pas mgon po g.yul bzlog/do rdzong du smra bo lcog pas khro rol/pho brang du bkra shis chos sde bas gur gyi dmar chen gtor bzlog/rgyab chos su dar gling pas sher snying bzhi khri nyis stong /tshe gzungs tshig stong dgu brgya/'bras spungs su rgyud stod pas phyag drug pa'i gtor bzlog/rgyab chosasu tshogs chen du mang ja'i thog mdo sgrub/rdzong so so nas dgra lha dpangs bstod/yul gzhis bdag por gsol mchod/ma rgyal bstan ma gsum gyi mdos/dbus gtsang gi rdzong bcur klu brgyad/klu 'bum dpang skong /'byung bzhi gtor ma/rgyal po'i sku rim du brag dbar bas gser 'od chig stong bzhi brgya/gdugs dkar stong /sher snying nyis stong /sgrol ma sum stong /tshe gzungs chog khri bzhi brgya rnams btang /nyer gsum la gra tshang gi khro rol/tshe bdag/bstan mdos 'char can/grangasabacad kyis gi gang mnan pa btsugs/nyer dgu la rta tshag rje drung /sems dpa' sprul sku/rdzing phyi mkhan po co ne/pha bong kha pa/skyid shod sku skye/chab mdo rje drung /snar thang mkhan po/sgo mangs zur pa/gong ma'i mi sna rgan gzhen/yel ba chos rje/nag shod sbus mda' bla ma/lha bzhi ngag dbang dkon mchog/'dar pa rje drung /mchod dpon pa/dge slong 'jam dbyangs102na grags pa/rgyun sdod 'dar paṇa bcas lnga bstoskor la thugs rje chen po tshem bu lugs kyi dmar khrid dang nyal sgom rim par phul/gnam gang la chos mdzad skyon gling pa khams nas 'khor ba dang phrad/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nas sngags rgod log tri'i las sbyor rgyas pa btsugs/tshes gsum la 'dul ba zur pa bdog pa dang bcas mtsho khar thon/tshes bzhin gong gi chos zhu ba'i thog mi sna 'grul sdebs dang bcas sum brgya skor la sman bla sprul sku/bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs/rgya mtsho'i thub pa dam tshig sum bkod/byams ༷/sher phyin dkar mo/dbyangs can ma dmar mo

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (5)rnams kyi rjes gnang bskur nas rgyal sras sher 'phel ba/ snar thang mkhan po/ snye mo dgon pa ba/chang khyim pa'i pha/ kong po bkra shis rab brtan pa'i dbon po/ lho brag dgon gsar dang spe ser bla ma/ em chi thabs mkhas/ khal kha thu shi yel thu rgyal po'i mi sna bcas la ja gral bgyis/ che'i/lngar rgya nag mi sna 'grul sdebs dang bcas pas dngos po spyi bton gyis byang gter longs sku ma'i tshe chog rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho spel/ tshes drug la lha ldan bsnyen gnas ma tshos zang zing gi bdog pa bteg nas 'bras gshongs dag snang ma'i cho ga gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i sbyin bdag byas/ gong ma'i mi sna 'grul sdebs/ 'di kha'i mi sna snar thang mkhan po brag phyi sku skye/ em chi thabs mkhas/ rgyal po'i mi sna bi lig thu rnams gung gi dror sngar lugs bzhin gyi bdag rkyen sprad/tshes brgyad la sgam po (102ba)sprul sku/ yangs can spyan snga/ gra thang mkhan po bya khang chosamadzad/ sdings po che'i sprul sku/ chos rje snye mdo ba/ bkras lhun thos bsam gling slob dpon/rgyal thang dga' ldan sum rtsen gling gi bla mar 'gro mi 'phyong rgyas pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ rngod a rig dgon dang thang sag gnyis kyi bla zur/
