khams bya mo nang / sa lung chos sde/ yer pa/ grog khang steng / klung shod dpal 'bar/ mi nyag dgon gsar rnams kyi bla ma/ a rig rab stims pa blo bzang bkra shis/ mer gan cho so rje/ bya bral dka' bstod pa la 'byor can/ a rgyal can/ 'a shur blo bzang byams pa can/ gong dkar chos sde'i slob dpon gser gling pa dang gsang sngags mkhar pa/zar pa rigs 'dzin kun bzang/ rgyud smad 'bul sdud pa ldan ma sngags rams pa/ zal dkar bla ma'i dbon po/ kong po dga' mags pa dang rgyal skor ba/ g.yul rgyal lhun rtse'i rdzong sdod lhun grub rtse pa/ li thang du 'gro mi drung yig don grub/ rgyal thang du 'gro mi lha dbang rdo rje'i bu/ mtsho khar 'gro mi sgang khar grong stod pa/ khod pā thur ji nong / da la'i hung tha'i ji/ dzum lang rnams kyi mi sna dang mjal phrad byas/ sgam po sprul pa'i skus rta sum cu/ dka' bcu dpal 'byor can gyis bzhi bcu byung /de thog rta tshag rje drung dpon po 'khor bcas brgya nyi shu/ pha bong kha'i dbon po/ san khang gi mi sna/—143—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pokhong dpon rnam rgyal/ thor god dpon rgya mtsho/ mo ja rag gi dpon mo bu tsos/ lha bas rdo rje ste ngo bor byin rlabs dang dmangs lnga brgyar (103na)me tog gtor/ rta tshag rje drung sprul skus rta brgya dang gcig /dre'u sum cu/ gser dngul ja pags ras sogs stong phrag brgal ba'i bdog pa byung / nyin gnyis kyi bar rgyal mkhan por bsnyen rdzogs zhe gcig /dge tshul nyer drug /rab byung gsum/ dge bsnyen gcig rnams sgrub par bskul/ mi sna gzhen pa er te ni rab 'byams kyi ngor paṇa chen sprul sku blo bzang ye shes kyi brtan bzhugs/ lcang ra zil gnon tshe dbang gis dmag zor ma dang lcang ra rgyal por 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar zhal byang / dge slong phun tshogs kun dga'i ngor rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med dang dbyer med gsol 'debs rgyal thang sum rtsen gling bla gnyer gyi ngor ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ chos lung tshogs pas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal byung bar gsar du bzo skyor byas pa'i kha byang /kha 'om bla ma phun tshogs rgyal mtshan gyi ngor rtsa ba'i bla ma dang thugs rje chen po tha mi dad pa'i gsol 'debs/ sde pa zangs ri ba'i nyams len du byang gter 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi rgyun 'byer phan bde'i 'byung gnas rnams bkod/tshes dgur gong gi mi sna rgan gzhen/ 'di ga'i gnyis/ rgyal pa chos rje/ 'phyos pa sku skye/ spe ser bla ma khri zur/ blo bzang rab rgyas rnams la ja gral btang nas mi sna bzhin bka' bsgo rgyas par byas/ de nub nas bdun phrag gi bar phyi nang gsang ba'i nyer 'tshe rgyang ring skrod phyir byang pa'i zab gnad kyi gshin rje mthu stobs dregs pa'i rgyal po dang saḥdamar gyi sgom bzlas la brtson pa cher bgyis pas rtags kyang bzang ba byung zhing de ga'i mu 'thud gter gsar tshe dpag (103ba)med kyi nyams len bdun gyi bar bgyis/ lcags 'dra lcags sdig gi las rab 'byams/ bskyed pa kha gsorgyun mi bcad/ /ces pa'i dgongs don gyi mchod rten las kha gso dang / gnam sa sto dkrug gi las sbyor te sde tshan gsum du bcad pas lag tu blangs/tshes bco lngar spun bdun lhun grub rgya mtsho mtsho sngon nas 'byor/ nyer gnyis la nang mtshams —144—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)grol ba'i sde pa a bar dang dmag zor tshangs dbang la 'chi blu byas rjes/ mchod dpon/ dbu mdzad/dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ dar mo sman rams pa/ dpal grong sngags rams pa rnams la gter gsar tshe dbang bskur/ nyer bzhin gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa tsho gis 'khor spyan gzigs snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i 'phrin yig dang bcas tshangs pa dung thod can la blang dor dri ba zhu bar btang / spun bdun pa'i byas lugs rgyu mtshan rmed pa phra zhib byung bar mchis/ nyer bdun la dga' ldan phun tshogs gling pa ngag dbang don grub kyis phar phyin 'grel pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan/ ngag dbang lhos rab kyis dbu 'grel theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings/ nyer brgyad la thod ri bshad sgrub gling pa bstan pa 'byung gnas dang / bstan pa chog 'phel gyis phar phyin 'grel pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan rnams kyi rgyugs sprad/ gnam gang la 'chi bdag bzlog pa'i cho ga bde yangs nas bstar/zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la thod ri bshad sgrub gling gi bla ma khri zur gnyis/ zur mkhar mdo sngags gling / lho brag gdang dgon gsar/ sho mdo chos sde rnams kyi bla (104na)ma/mgar sku skye/ sngags pa chu spe steng pa dang dbus sdings pa/ dpon tshe ring gi dpon mo bu bcas/dpon mo no mon dha ra/ lcam snying snying / dpon mo bstan 'dzin/ thor god nor bu dang rdo rje skyabasasogs kyi dpon mo/ ma chig gi ma/ kho sho'u che tha'i ji'i dpon mo bu bcas/ bsod nams chosabazang / pā thur tha'i ji'i chags/ co ne er khe dge slong / rta 'bul ba bkra shis chos 'phel/ phun tsho gos dbang phyug /'dul ba chos rje/ bsod nams hung tha'i ji rnams kyi mi sna/ mtshal zhabs drung grags pa lcam sring / kong po o rod pha bu/ spyang ki grong pa/ rdo dgon pa ba/ she ma ba'i bu/ rmu le rab 'byams pa'i gser khral skyel mi bcas dang phrad/ dpon tshe ring gis kha btags che 'bring chung gsum/ gos chen sna tshogs/ dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/ mdong mo/ tha phag /sbug chol sogs khyon dngul srang brgyad brgya so bdun la bskor ba byin pa rang la spangs rtogs kyi yon tan med kyang kho rang gi ngos —/45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ponas tsham tshom med par ster nus par rjes su yi rang ba shar/ ngo bo tshor byin rlabs dang dmangs lnga brgya skor la me tog gtor/ tshes gnyis la rta tshag sprul pa'i skus tshogs yon tshan grangs spams mtho bas gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i tshogs 'chi bdag gi bdud sde tshar bcad/tshes gsum la o rod 'dul ba zur pas bkra shis kha btags brgya dang gcig /gos yug chig brgya nyi shu dngul srang bzhi brgya sum cu/ dar sna tshogs yug brgyad (104ba〉du/ sman yug brgya nyi shu sogs ring por brkyang ste 'gyed dang bcas gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ tshes bzhin ā tsarla niñtsa la su rir gser zho bzhi/ jus kha drug /kha btags/ sman kha nyi shu/ sho khral mi dgos pa'i lam yig sha ma pu rir gser zho gsum/ gzhan gong 'dra/ go ku la bhi rir jus kha gsum/ sman kha nyi shu/ kha btags/ so sor zur chas bcas 'dod pa brjo/bas/tshes brgyad nas phur sgrub btsugs/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i skus bdog pa sngon bteg gis mjal/tshes dgur sprul pa'i skus khams gsum du bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs la brten pa'i 'chi blu rgyas par mdzad pa'i lhus rtags legs rab shar te rigs 'dzin rjer nges pa rnyed/tshes bcur lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i gsung bgros zhib mor mol zhing shangs len gzabs te thub bstan rdo rje brag la thegs/ tshes bcu gcig la zhing skyong nang so'i bsngo rten skyel bar bu gnyis/ bar bzung tshe ring dar rgyas/ 'dul ba chos rje/ phun tshogs dbang phyug gi mi sna/ co ne chosarje'i dge slong drug /mtshur phu phyag mdzod bstan srung / nyang gi gdung lho brag bla ma zur thog pa/ nang chen lho pa bla ma'i dbon star rdzong sdod mi kha ru ba dang rong bde skyid gling pa/ mas mags pa/ kha reg mngon dga' ba/ snye dgon skyes dman sogs la ja gral bgyis/tshes bcu bzhir bying rnam gnyis/ lhun grub rtse pa/ gsang do bo 'go'i bla ma sogs dang phrad/—146—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)grong smad nas gra tshang gi rtsa ba gsum la 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar kha byang / 'bri lung legs ldan (105na)phun tshogs dang / mi nyag dgon gsar bla ma blo bzang rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis khams phyogs kyi chos sder 'dzugs rgyu'i gsol 'debs smon lam/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i ma g.yang skyid kyi byang rtags 'jam dbyangs kyi gser thang brgya rtsa'i rgyab yig /sngags ban blo gros rgyal ba'i dge skos 'jog la dngul gyi pad sder srang bcu gnyis las grub pa'i kha byang / rgyud stod dbu mdzad blo bzang dge legs dang / dge skos blo bzang rin chen gyis thog drangs bla brgyud kha skong gsol 'debs rnams bskul don dang srid gsum bdag mor lo gsar dus ston gyi tshe snyan shal 'dod gsol/sdings po che dang rdo rje brag nas snyan tshig gis spras pa'i chab shog byung ba de lan rgyan gyis sbud pa rnams bris/ sle ma ba'i bu tshe brtan rig pa 'tsho mi zin pa zhig byung ba chos skyong chen po khog tu zhugasadogs 'dug par rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs bskur/ nyer bdun la sa skyong mer gan tha'i ji dbon mo bu bcas/ shi ral thu chos rje'i sku skye/ dmar khams rab 'byams pa/ yer khe ji nong / dpon mo/ bsod nams hung tha'i ji'i dpon mo dang bu/ er te ni pā thur tha'i ji/ dka' bcu ngag dbang don grub/ dar rgyas gling bla zur/ stag lung pa'i slob dpon gnyis dang phyag mdzod/chos rje kha reg pa'i nu bo ras chung phug phyag mdzod/ 'bog gong mkhar ltag pa/ 'brang rtseb stong gshong a bo/ 'bri lung dbang rgyal sogs la ja gral bstar/nyer dgur zhabs drung nor bu khra sgor/ khal kha u rang khan nge da'i ching gi mi sna dang phrad/ tshe bdag sgrub (105bsgo chod kyi ltad mo tshar du dngar/—147

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (7)dgung lo re gsum par sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sde srid du bskos shing khri 'don gyi rten 'brel rgya cher bsgrubs pa'i skor dang / bsam yas kyi nang rten byin can khag gi dkar chag /'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog mdzad pa bcas kyi skor/don grub ces pa sa lug gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i dpal ldan 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma'i tshes gcig gtor chen rten 'bul sogs sngar bzhin btang / nyin dang por mchod yon gnyis yul jo'i thu pā thur tha'i ji/ sa skyong mer gan tha'i ji/ bsod nams hung tha'i ji/ er khe ji nong / rgyas sras bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal/ lha bzang klu dbang / bsod nams bkra shis sogs dpon mo/ ja'i sang drag bsdus bcas nyis brgya skor/ ser 'bras slob dpon khri gdan zur/ dbu chosasogs las sne ba/ sde pa a bar/ dbu mdzad/ mchod dpon sogs rgyun sdod drung 'khor/ jo stan zur pa/ shar rtse chos rje/ sems dpa' chen po/ phyogs mtha'i lo gsar 'bul mi/ dzum lang / mtsho kha/o rod/ khal kha rgyal po sogs kyi mi sna bcas par dga' ston/ gral 'phros dang rol gar sna tshogs bsgyur/ dpon mo tshor ja gral btang / nyin gnyis par gnyug mar gnas pa'i steng rta tshag rje drung /rin chen rgyan cha ba lnga bcu lhag bcas kyis bkra shis rtags rdzas rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba dang /mchod sprin rnam brgyad 'phar ba'i gzhan nyin sngar dang 'dra ba bstar/ rtser khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos ring 'tsho'i bdog pa dang bcas rdor legs/ lcam nor bu khra sgor dang mjal/ dga' ldan pho brang pa'i dgra ltar song gshis sku rten sras po bsod nams 'das pa nas bzung 'gron gnyer drung pa btang ba'i gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas kyis sku phebs zhus kyang phebs kha sra ba de lam du lus pa skyengs pa —148

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ ltar)lta bu'i skyon byung dogs (106na)gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pa bcas rim par mu 'thud zhu bcugs kyang khog zhugs lo skor bar ma byung bar brten bsam yas/ la mo/ tshong 'dus gsum du yang nge btang ba de skor zhus skabs shig dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags par la mo bas phar tshol ba sogs ring khyad mi dgos pho brang gi nye skor nas yong bar lung bstan/ lo sngon ma nas sle ma ba'i bu 'bring po tshe brtan la khog zhugs shig byung 'dug pa rjes su rim par gsal du song ba bsam yas su smon grub pa rin chen bkra shis/ la mor sgyid thang nor bu dang tshong 'dus su'ang mi btang ste dri skor zhus pa phal cher mthun par gnas chung chos rgyal chen po'i phyogs gtags yin tshul dang / de la'ang brtag pa dgos zer ba ltar bgyis pa lha 'dre'i skor 'khrugs ches pa'i dpyad dka' na'ang bdag byas pa bzang ngo shar ba bzhin rjes su ral grir mdud pa dang bslab ston sogs yid ches su gyur pa tshes gsum skar ma bzang bar rgyal po lcog tu phab pa'i rtser phebs pa thog mar khog ma byang ba'i gsung 'gags kyis 'don mi bde zhing sku khog :/ rtsa sgo yang dog stabs nas gnang lugs rnams sras po bsod nams dang 'dra min sna tshogs byung ba /nga ma don grub rgya mtsho sogs kyis gleng gzhi mang tsam byas 'dug rung nang du byon pa'i tshe gzugs me da dngos su zhugs nyams kyis dkyus ma dang mi 'dra ba'i bkag zil che bar snang ba mkha' 'gro bye ba'i tshogs dpon mkhar chen bza'i phyag rdor dbang po sde yab sras kyi bla rdo rngam can de dbur bzhag /myong grol gyi sman ljags steng blud/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po/ rigs lnga/ gsang bdag (106ba)rta mgrin/ dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga/ khyad par sna(na rdo rje 'chang / sku sprul nyang nyi ma 'od zer/ gsung sprul chos kyi dbang phyug /thugs sprul mnga' ris pad+ma dbang chen sku mched/ yon tan rnam sprul chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sde/ drin can chos dbyings rang grol dang khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po/ rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i bar du byon pa'i bka' babs brgyud pa'i mtshan rnams brjod de bstan pa spyi bye brag gi bde skyid gong nas gong du spel phyir las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrub par yang bskyar bka' bsgos dam tshig bsgrags pa —149—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pobazhin dang blangs kyi spro nyams dang byin shin tu chags pa byung / sku phebs pa'i legs sor bzabs mchor gyi sku chas legs pa cha tshang / sbug chol ja gos dar sogs spams bstod/ dbu rmog ma thar bar sde pa a bar sogs dogs pa byed 'dug rung nged rang gi las byed phal cher hol rgyugs las zhib pa mi yong 'dug gshis bzo mi rnams kyis sku khog gi lus la ma bsdur ba'i rtsing skyon du go /sku chas sgron grub pa dang sde pa dang sde pa a bar ma gtogs gzhan rnams phyir phud de sku phebs 'gyangs pa dang phebs pa'i rgyu mtshan khog pa 'dir lo brgyad las mi yong tshul sogs lung bstan yid ches du ma'i gsung gleng byung / dung dkar sku skye/ shag skor slob dpon gsar brkad/ rta dbon mer gan chosarje/ dar khan chos rje/ khong rnam rgyal/ dpon mo bsod nams dpal bzang / gnas chung sku rten sogs dang phrad/ tshes bzhir mer gan tha'i ji/ er khe ji (107na todang dpon mo bu 'khor bcas pa/byang rtse chos rje/ kong po bkra shis rab brtan mkhan zur rnams la byin rlabs sog dmangs stong brgal bar ka spungs steng nas me tog gtor/tshes lngar dga' ldan khri rin po che dpon slob nyi shu skor/ jo rdzong rdzong sdod myug pa dang rgya yags pa/ dga' chags pa/ rtul mi ming sring / zur khang shar pa'i lcam/ thor god an dar gyi mi sna sogs dang mjal phrad kyi tshe khri rin po che dang lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i gsung 'phros smar/ tshes brgyad la med rang gi ring 'tshor gra tshang nas tshe chog khag lnga 'dzugs rgyu'i sngon 'gror sngar med byang gter tshe dpag med lcags sdong ma'i nang sgrub las byang dbang chog dang bcas pa'i chog khrigs gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/mgron gnyer ngag dbang legs mchog gi ngor kun rig gi brgyud 'debs/ sde pa blo bzang sbyin pasakhur khur te jo shāka phyag mdzod nas bton pa'i phye phur che ba lnga/ 'phan ring che ba cha gsum/ thung ba cha lnga/ stod g.yogs sogs gya dgu/ smad g.yogs re bdun/ pang khebs mig brgya so bzhi 'phrul snang dang / pang khebs nga gcig /stod smad kyi gos bcu re ra mo cher cho phru'i 4 dus phul ba'i smon lam/dge slong blo bzang 'phags pa dang ngag dbang phun tshogs gnyis kyis gra tshang du snyan dar chig brgya —150

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sgrogs bam gsum pa/ (ja)nyer lnga phul ba'i kha byang / tre bo skal bzang gi ngor smon lam/ mchod dpon pa'i mas lha sar na bza' phul pa'i smon lam/ skyon rdo rje 'chang (107bgi zab gter lung bstan las byung ba ltar 'di nyin nas ji srid nam mkha' gzugs g.yin ma bzung bar bstan pa rin po che bla nas blar 'phel ba'i ched du 'phags yul rdo rje'i gdan dang gnyis su med pa bod yul gyi lte ba lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi mchod chog rgyal bstan mdzad med nor bu'i cho ga chu shur dga' ldan thar pa gling pa'i gra pa bzhi sdes tshar re gtong rgyur zhogs star mchod pa sna bdun nyer gnyis re/ gtor zlum drug /nyan thos tshor dkar gsum dngar gsum gyi mchod pa/ tshesabaco lngar snga dro phyi dro gnyis gar bdun tshar re/ ja ma gcig bcas pa'i phogs yon bsdoms gzhor khal nyis stong dang drug sogs bstar/tshes bcu gcig la gra tshang yongs rdzogs la tshe dpag med lcags sdong ma'i dbang dang sgrol dkar thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang bskur/ tshes bcu gnyis nas gra tshang spyis ring 'tshor dmigs tshe chog khag lnga btsugs/ tshes bcu gsum la bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal por dpal mo lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal gtso rkyang go rjes gnang dang / bcu bzhir theg pa chen po'i sdom pa phab/ dpon mo bsod nams chos 'dzoms dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i bsngo rten rta brgyad cu ja gos dar spams mtho byung bar 'khor ba dang ngan 'gro'i duḥkha las grol ba'i bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor yang dag byas/tshes bco lngar nged rang gi spong dag tu paṇa zha gcig the ba'i bcu/ tsar mo bcu gcig (108na)mthang gos bco lnga/ bla gos bco lnga/ 'gan sbyar bcu/ ber bcu bzhi/ gzan bcu dgu/ ska ragasabacu gcig /smad g.yogs gnyis/ stod 'gag zha thul/ lham bcu/ 'ding ba drug /snye 'bol nyi shu/mjing gnon/ lhung bzed bcu/ dkar yol bdun/ rdor dril nyer gcig /dngul gyi stegs/ bzed zhal gnyis/ chab ril gnyis/ bum pa gnyis/ kong bzhi/ byam bum bzhi/ lte ri lnga/ rkyen bu/ mdong mo gsum rnams dngul/ gos stan nga lnga/ gser sga lnga/ dngul sga bcu gsum/ ra ma lug bdun rnams —151—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pocha 'grig /rta bcu bzhi/ dngul srang nyi shu/ ya ju khor drug ma chig brgya drug cu rnams kyis 'bab gra pa rer dngul zho gsum re'i khyon dngul srang nyis stong brgyad brgya nga drug gis tshogs bsags/tshes bcu bdun la dngas ma bcud 'dren ma gtogs pa'i gzhan rnams grol ba'i rdo rje slob dpon sgrol dkar gyi sngags rams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang / rnam rgyal ma'i dge slong phyag rdor dbang phyug /lcags sdong ma'i dge slong blo gros rgyal ba/ 'chi med 'od snang gi chos rje kha reg pa rnams kyis so so'i lugs bawo ring por 'tsho thabs kyi rten 'byung bsgrigs shing / sngags rams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang gis gtan sdod dgos tshul lung rigs kyi lam nas drangs te smra ba'i sgo phye ba rang nyid so skyer sdod dbang ma mchis kyang rnam dag gi cho ga (108ba)khrims ldan dge 'dun tshogasakyis lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas lha sngags ye shes kyis bsgrubs par byin mthu yong ba gzhir bcas pa dang tshig sgra'i dbang gis stong 'dun byed pa'i lan btab/ mchod dpon pa'i ma/ dpon tshang khyo shugs la ja gral btang zhing sgrags phu'i gzhis ka smon grong ge re 'ong stod 'brog bcas pa khe gsum gyi phyir 'gror gzhung nas sa tshab sprad pa'i kha gtsang rnams sbyar ba'i legs byar kha btags nyin bde ma/ hor dkar sangs rgyas dpal mo/ 'dra 'bag si'u ma/ ming sgra yod pa'i bla bre si'u ma/ hor gosabum gdan ma gnyis/ gos log thang yug bdun/ gser zho nyis brgya rnams bteg /tshes bco brgyad la dngas ma bcud 'dren pa min pa'i gra tshang yongs rdzogs kyis bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi 'chi blu dang/ bcu dgur byang gter 'chi bdag bzlog pa'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad pas rim gror 'gyur ba byung / smon lam chen mo'i gzhung gral gra pa bcu rer ya ju kha ya re mtha' gral ba lnga rer 'go bkag re bsdoms khor drug chig brgya drug cu/ gra pa rer bur nyag lnga re bsdoms ltang tse sum brgya re dgu/ gra pa rer 'bru khal ru'i rtsis kyi rta chig brgya go gcig /dre'u nyer dgu /lha sa'i khral pa dud rer 'bru khal gnyis re/ gur pa dud bco lnga rer nag po bar khag re/ sprang long bzhi brgyar ja sdur rag 'gag re/ gtsang / lhun rtse/ lco brag sogs dmag g.yeng med sar dud rer —152

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gshor khal bzhi ma/ dbus (109na/bul dgas kong mtsho sna bcas par byed lnga ma/ dmag g.yeng yod sar 'bru rkyang dang / byings la dpus cha/ bang rim chos sde bar bstan pa rgyas ched lo star hor zla dang po'i tshes dgur tshugs pa'i nyin bdun par brgyad gras gnas brtan phyag mchod kyi rgyun ji srid bar star chags btsug par mchod rdzas phogs sogs sman blar cha bzhag /tshes nyi shur dngas ma bcud 'dren gyi sgrub pa grol ba de gar brten gra tshang yongs rdzogs kyis mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog rgyas pa sngon 'gro'i tshogs bdog pa gya nom pa dang bcas ring por 'tsho thabs smin par mdzad pa nas tshe bsnyen gyi bcad rgya dam por bgyis/ la mo/ gnas chung / bsam yas sogs chos skyong rnams kyi lung bstan/ mo rtsis/ brtag pa bgyis pas mtshon nged rang gi gegs sel du 'brel mtshungs kyi rdzong gzhis so sor/ lu bu/ nā len+da pa/ grang mo che pa gsum gyis sgrol dkar kyi tshe chog bzhi stong brgyad brgya nyer lnga/ bkra bzang pas 'chi med 'od snang dgu brgya/ nub dgon pa/ brag dkar chu bzang pa/ kyi ston pa/ chu mig pa/ brag la ba/ 'od mchog pa/ chu spe steng pa rnams kyis lcags sdong ma'i tshe chog nyis stong dgu brgya/ brgya mkhar ba/ 'ug bya lung pa/ sgrol ma ba rnams kyis sgyu 'phrul tshe chog nyis stong sum brgya/ zha lu bas phyag rdor 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i tshe chog nyis brgya nyer lnga/ snying ri bas yang gsang khros pa'i rdzong chung tshe chog lnga brgya/ ngor pas 'chi med rnga sgra'i tshe chog (109ba'i gu brgya 'chi blu dang 'brel ba/ gong dkar chos sde ba dang bkra shis rtse chos sde bas rnam rgyal stong mchod brgya phrag /rdo rje brag pas sku gsum rigs 'dus tshe chog brgyad brgya bzhi bcu/ dpal ri bas rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi tshe chog lnga brgya drug cu/ smin grol gling pa dang snye mdo bas gter gsar tshe chog brgyad brgya bzhi bcu/ shel brag pa dang gnas gzhi bas rdzong chen tshe chog chig stong bzhi brgya brgyad cu/ smra bo lcog pas mtsho skyes rdo rje'i tshe chog lnga brgya/ tshe chu sgrub sde bas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshe chog lnga brgya bzhi bcu/ ka tshal bas yang zab tshe chog drug brgya/ chos ldan pas ra ta gling rdor 'phreng gi tshe chog lnga brgya bzhi bcu/ gsang sngags byang chub gling pas dngas ma bcud 'dren gyi tshe chog chig stong brgyad brgya/—153—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ḍak+kishel dkar dang rnam gling chos sde ba/ byams chen pa/ myug chos gling pa/ dga' ldan rab brtan pa/ bkra shis bde chen/ lam rim pa/ chos 'khor steng gsum bsgril ba brgya re bsdoms bka' 'gyur tshar brgya nyi shu/ ri bo bde chen pas sāts+tsha lnga 'bum bzhi khri/ rdo rje brag sprul sku dpon slob kyis dgra sri phung sri dur sri mnan/ yang rdzong du tshogs brgya/ skong bshags/ dpal ri bas thang yig dang sde lnga 'gro che ba/ dar gling / ri chos pa/ rtses dang lnga mchod pa bsgril bas mtshan brjod chig 'bum bdun stong brgyad brgya/ mchims phur rang gras skong bshags/ shel brag tu smin grol gling pas skong bshags/ sman sgrub/ tsho gos brgya/ mkhar chur gnas gzhi bas tshogs brgya/ skong bshags(110na)seng rdzong du smra bo lcog pas tshogs brgya/ skong bshags/ yer par gsang sngags gling pas tshogs brgya stong bshags bsdoms brgyad brgya bzhi bcu/ gong dkar du chos sde bas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg brgya tshar/ dkon gnyer bas gdugs dkar dang / rdo rje brag pas 'char ga'i mdos/ rgyab chos su gsung rab gling pas sher snying dang chos 'khor yang rtsebs gdugs dkar/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug gsum du mchod pa sna lnga brgya tshar/ snyan shal/ lha sar srog blu sum brgya/ dpal ltar gsol mchod/ gzhis ka shar pas bdud mdos/ ༅ slong sum brgya nyi shur rtsam mda' zo re/ so hrug bzhi gling re/ ja sdur rag 'gag re/ 'bum rgyas pa dang brgyad stong pa bcu gsum re/ bskal bzang bco lnga/ gzungs 'dus lnga/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshig 'bum nyi khri nyis stong nyer lnga/ sher snying nyis 'bum dgu khri lnga brgya/ lhung bshagasasum stong lnga brgya/ gdugs dkar sum khri sum stong bdun brgya lnga bcu/ tshe gzungs sum 'bum lnga stong brgyad brgya/ mal dror bon gyis klu bcos/ 'phyong rgyas su 'ja' dkar byung ba'i sel byed la bkra shis chos sde bas gdugs dkar gyi mdos/ 'bras spungs su ja tshul steng bzang spyod drug khri sum stong/sher snying dgu khri bzhi stong lnga brgya/ sgrol ma bzhi 'bum bdun khri nyis stong lnga brgya/ se rar bzang spyod chig 'bum brgyad brgya/ na mnyam skya ser dbul 'phongs kyi rigs mang por ja gsum/ rtsam mda' zo re/ rgyar bco lnga dras re/ thud leb dang lag dogs gnyis re/ skya (110ba)r+sā re/ sman kha re/ ja —154

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)'gyed re/ skyes lha yul lhar gsol mchod/ g.yang 'gugs/ 'bangs gtsang phyogs su gshor khal bzhi ma dang dbus la phyed lnga'i rtsis kyi dpus cha/ rgyal du ja tshul thog sgrol ma sa ya gnyis/ 'phyong rgyas su dgra lha dpangs bstod gnyis/ sde pa'i sku rim du dwags po gra tshang pas mdo mang bzhi bcu/sgrol ma chig khri lnga stong / sher snying sum stong lnga brgya/ thod ri bas tshe gzungs sa ya gnyis dang nyis 'bum lnga khri/ gdugs dkar chig stong lnga brgya/ ri bo bde chen pa bzhi gras sbyin sreg brgya tshar/ gzhis rtser brag la bas 'char ga'i mdos/ rgyab chos su lhun rtse bas sher snying drug 'bum/ spyi rim du yul tshan so sos zla thebs cung zad bsdus shing gtso bor rdzong gzhis nas bton pa'i lo glud/ sde brgyad so so dang spyi mdos/ chab gtor/ cha gsum/ lha bsangs/ dpangs bstod/ klu gtor/ klu 'bum/ klu'i dpang skong / 'byung bzhi gtor ma/ yig drug spyan 'byed/ yul lhar gsol mchod/ bdag med mchod rten la sku dkar/ cod pan/ nad rims bzlog thabs su rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs kyi khrus kyi gtsug lag khang dang yul gru thams cad kyi grib dang / mi gtsang ba dbyung / ma mdos/ pho brang du dpal ri ba/ gong dkar du rdo rje brag pa/ 'phyong rgyas su smin grol gling pa/ rgyal rtser brag la ba/ngam ring du bkra bzang pa/ lha rtser chu mig pa rnams kyis bstan mdos/ bstan ma gnas sa tshor gsol mchod/ dar lcogs/ bsangs/ lung pa che chung bstun brgyad stong pa/ gzungs 'dus/ gra lnga dang sgrol ma gang 'grub/ (111na)dgon ang dang gnyis la mang 'gyed/ rgyal po'i sku rim la mdo mang du ma dang / 'phrul snang du mchod pa sna lnga brgya tshar/ dgra lha dpangs bstod/ bstan srid la rgyar brtag pa byas pa'i rim gror dge lugs chos sde dang sngags dgon rnams nas gtor bzlog /mdo pa rnams kyis dgu bzlog /sngags khang du rgyud stod pa lnga bcus zhag drug bar ya ma rā dza 'gro gang che'i bdun par drug cu pa'i glo bur las bcol/ rgyud smad pa lnga bcus zhag drug bar shā sa na dang bdun par glo bur ba'i gtor bzlog /gong dkar du rdo rje brag pas 'char ga'i glang chen sna bsgyur/ rgyab chos su gsung rab gling pas sher snying chig 'bum brgyad khri bdun stong bdun brgya/ sgrol ma lnga stong —155

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (podrug brgya/ pho brang du bkra shis chos sde bas gdugs dkar mdos chen/ rgyab chos su ri bo chos gling pas sher snying chig 'bum brgyad khri/ mtshan brjod nyis brgya/ sgrol ma chig stong drug brgya/ tshe gzungs drug khri/ gzhi rtser 'ug bya lung pas mgon po g.yul bzlog rnams nub phyogs su brgyab/ nyer gsum nas chag gra bzhi po btsugs/ gnam gang la nang mtshams grol ba'i sde pa a bar dang dmag zor tshangs dbang bcas la kha 'bar ma'i 'chi blu bgyis/hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la khe gsum pa dang / lcags la mkhan po so sos dngos po bteg nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa gra tshang nas bstar/ zhang ston ri khrod pa dang gleng mo zhib tu byas rjes sa skyong mer gan tha'i ji/ dpon mo bu bsas/ er khe ji nong / chos rin chen/shi ral (111ba)thu/ tre bo sku skye/ da la'i hung tha'i ji'i mi sna/ er khe da'i ching / dka' bgrang ga dbang don grub/ od khon rnams kyi mi sna/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ nges gsang rdor gling pa/ gsang phu mchod khang / rgyang ro gser sdings pa/ zhom steng / ra ba smad rnams kyi bla ma/ la mo sku rten pa/ ger lha pa yum sras/ smad ta dkon mchog gi bu/ mda' dpon gnas gsar ba/ don grub dbang rgyal/lcang can rdo rje/ chang khyim pa'i pha/ brag la bla ma rnams la byin rlabs dang / sa skyong mer gan tha'i jis rta don lnga/ er khe ji nong gis rta sodagu /gnyis kas ja gos dar pags ras gser dngul gyi sga sogs spams mthon por bteg /bla ma dga' rab kyis gu ru ye shes khyung grags kyi gter ma'i phur pa bh+yo k+ṣiṃ las grub pa rnyed pa'i mchog tu gyur/ sog dmangs bdun brgya skor la me tog gtor/chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa blo bzang tshe ring gis dbu ma rtsa 'grel gyi rgyugs sprad/tshes gnyis la rgyun sdod drung 'khor ser mo ba spyi tshogs dang lha sa byang gling pa so sos tsha ni grangs ring por brkyang ste gra tshang gis 'bras gshongs dag snang ma'i mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog gi sgo nas rten 'byung bsgrigs/ blo bzang mgon po rab brtan/ a kha'i/ dpon mo al dar/ thor god tshe ring rgya mtsho/ rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas bkra shis/ bā khan dge slong / blo bzang er khe tha'i ji/ mo —156

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)ja rag gi dpon mo/ bde chen tha'i ji bstang zhal/ ri khrod dga' ldan/ nor bu dga' ldan/ me rag /rtsa sgrub sde rnams kyi bla ma/ (112na〉sgrol ma ba rgan pa/ lha khang chos mdzad/ grags pa sogasadrung lubor kha shas/ gdung nag po/ chu skor ba rnams dang phrad/ bod sog sum brgyar me tog gtor/tshes gsum la pha bong kha'i gdan sa pa/ ri do dgon gyi bla ma pha bu/ rong pa sku skye/ co ne dar khan nang sa/ spus srang gsar khang pa'i nang mi yongs rdzogs kyis dkar dro dang tshan grangs bteg /gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcad khag gnyis kyis yang gsang drag po dang / srid pa spyi mdos/ kha shas kyis klu gtor/ dmangs kyis cha gsum smin rgyas bstar/ nges gsang rdor gling pa ngag dbang 'gyur med kyis gsang snying rtsa 'grel rgyud don rnam nges kyi rgyugs sprad/tshes drug la sgo mangs zur pa bla ma btsan po ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis rung mthun gyi gos cha tshang / gos stan/ snye 'bol/ stan dmar/ dkar yol stegs bcas/ bzed zhal/ chab ril/ bla bre/'phan drug /rdor dril/ sil snyan/ gser zho chig brgya nyi shu/ dngul srang chig brgya zhe drug /gos yug bzhi bcu/ chu ce yug bcu/ sman yug nyer lnga/ hu je legs pa khar drug so bdun/ kha btags lnga bcu/'gang dkar yug sogs rgya che ba dang tshogs 'khor yon sbyar te 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i cho ga gra tshang gis btang ste nyi bu'i g.yul las rgyal/tshes bdun la sde pa stag rtse bas ber gyis gtsos bdog pa dang bcas tshe dpag med longs sku ma dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog tshogs 'khor (112ba)rgyas pa/ gra pa rer kha btags dang gser zho re bcas dpangs mtho/ tshes brgyad nas zhag shas bar gra tshang du dbu mdzad gsar bsko byed rgyur skad bzang ba rnams dbyangs rol mo sogs la sus do gal byas ma byas dang byang chub ma chub kyi rgyugs blangs/tshes dgur sa skya zhabs drung 'jam dpal rdo rje kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug phebs par ldang ba mjal dar sogs bkur bzos sngar bzhin phul/ ja gsum gyi bar lugs gnyis dang 'brel —157—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (poba'i bka' mchid byung / tshes bcur byams khang rgyab pho lhas yon sbyar zang zing gi bdog pa dang bcas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i ring 'tsho spel/ rgyal sras bsod nams dbang rgyal/ stag rtse tha'i ji yab sras/ 'bog gong mkhar ltag pa/ rgyang ro gser sdings slob dpon/ brag la bla ma dga' rab pa/ khra 'brug sku rten pa rnams la ja gral bgyis/tshes bcu gnyis la rje drung rin po che sa skyong mer gan tha'i ji/ lags a gur sogs la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma dang mgon po'i rjes gnang bar gcod kun sel phul/ dpon mo na ma thar/ dge slong brtson 'grus sogs dang phrad/ tshes bcu gsum la sa skya zhabs drung rin po ches sa snying ras cha spams bstod tshogs 'gyed bcas gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig gnang skyes chen dam pa'i bden tshig 'grub par gor ma chag /tshes bcu bzhi snga rting tshor sa skya zhabs drung rin po che/ dbon rin po che/ 'dar pa rje drung /mchod dpon pa rnams la mig la zon skyor gyis 'phar lung dang (113na)chabs cig mgon po che chung dang dmar po skor gsum gyi 'khor lo'i gsal byed kyi dgongs don bzhin dpe ris sogs dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas spyan lam du phab ste mdzub btsugs kyi ngo sprod phul ba tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i ring lugs rdul khrod nas byi dor bgyis pas las bzhi'i 'phrin las thams cad phyag len du bstar te tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gang la'ang thogs med gnang chog rtsis yin kyang bstan pa'i bgegs chags lta bur gtso bo gnyis ka gzhan don grub mtha' bsgogs pa zhig byung / byang gling pa dung skyong bkra shis sde pa'i drung 'khor dang / blo bzang rin chen gra tshang du zhugs pa'i sngon du phrad/tshes bco lngar bco brgyad chos rje/ khal kha no yon khu thug thu/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las ba'i sku skye nang mir bcas pa/ brgya tsho ba/ kha rab gong pa'i ma bu/ mas chags btsun pa/ dga' ldan ji nong dang / kho khom rgyal po'i mi sna sogs la ja gral/ tshes bcu drug la sa skya zhabs drung rin po cher ja yul gsum bar gsung gleng ngos na bza' cha tshang / zhal dkar/ bzed zhal/ rdor dril/ phyag —158—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)sbug /dngul mdong / tha phag /gser sga legs pa cha 'grig /sga dmar/ ja gos dar sogs shangs len gzabs par phul/ tshes bcu bdun la rgyud stod dang stag lung ka drug bla gsar/ gzhig ka shar nang tshang drug gis dkar dro spoms su bteg /bar bzung tshe ring dar rgyas/ sdings chen pa spun/ bla ma bsod nams/ mnga' ris gra tshang gnyer pa sogs la (113ba)byin rlabs/ dpal grong sngags rams pas gra tshang du dngul bum srang nyer gsum las grub pa phul ba'i kha byang / dga' tshal ba'i ma kun dga' bu khrid kyi don du thang ga gsum dang brgyad stong pa/ skyid thang nor bus dag 'phel ri khrod par dbyar gnas thebs su zhing phul ba/ rta tshag rje drung dang blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis thang ga lnga re/blo bzang don yod kyis gsum/ don grub dbang rgyal gyis 'dra 'bag /se ra smad dge skos kyis tha 'og rgyal po/ chos rgyal mtshan gyis 'jam dbyangs dang tshe bdag rnams bzhengs pa'i smon lam/ zhom sting rdzogs chen pa nam mkha' rigs 'dzin dbang grags/ blo bzang 'phrin las dbang phyug /ngag dbang bkra shis/ dga' gdong chos skyong bzhis bskul ba'i ring 'tsho/ 'a zha dbon rin po ches snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa byung ba'i lan rgyan gyis spras pa/ ri bo che'i zhabs drung ngag dbang gi thugs bzhed ltar las gshin dang dmag zor ma'i gtor 'bul rnams brtsams/tshes bco brgyad la zhabs drung nor bu khra sgor dang / mtsho sna rdzong sdod grags pa bar ja gral/tshes nyi shur sa skya zhabs drung rin po ches 'phrul snang gi rten brten par rab gnas nyin gcig /zan g.yang dang khra 'brug tu nyin gsum re/ mchims phur phur sgrub rab byung bas zhabs phyi zhus te bdun phrag gi bar lha sngags ye shes kyi rol pas dam ye dbyer med kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i mi mthun dpung las rgyal ba'i tshe zhabs tog dang sku yon rgyas par dbul/ nyer gcig nas rdo rje gro lod kyi bsnyen pa bdun bar byed rtsis yin kyang nyams dang rmi (114na)lam du bzang ltas 'dra byung bas mu mthud hor zla gsum pa'i tshes lnga'i bar dge sbyor shin tu 'phel/ gra tshang du lha mo'i sger bskang btsugs par tshig 'bum chig khri chig stong dgu brgya re gsum/ bh+yo bdun ma lnga 'bum dgu khri brgyad stong / nyer dgu —159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ponas rdor slob dge slong phyag rdor dbang phyug bcas grangs bcad kyi bsam yas su gañdzi ra'i 'og tu gnon rgyur 'jam dpal zhi dang gi mnan pa bdun phrag btsugs/tshes gnyis la dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling pa 'jam dbyangs nor bu dang / bshes gnyen rgya mtsho gnyis kyis phar phyin gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs kyi rgyugs sprad/ tshes lngar grong smad nas bsam yas kyi lha khang thams cad la snyan shal/ tshes brgyad dus chen kyi snyan dar/ chos rje zil gnon rdo rjes dngul srang nyer gsum re'i rnam bum cha gra tshang la 'bul rgyu/ sngags rams pa nam mkha' rgya mtshos gra skor btang dus 'bul rgyu'i dngul kong srang nyer gsum las grub pa/ bkras rab dka' bcu kun dga' rgya mtsho'i dge skos 'jog dngul srang bcu gcig gi pad sder rnams kyi kha byang / gra tshang gnyer pa ngag dbang smon lam gyis tshogs khro gsum blug par 'dod dgu 'khyil pa/ ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin/ dpal 'byor 'khyil pa zhes pa'i kha yig bris/ brgyad gtor dang 'phar nyi ma gsum sngar bzhin rgyas par thugs dam bskang /grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub par mkhan po bo dhi sa twa/slob dpon pad+ma sam bha wa/ chos rgyal khri song lde'u btsan te mkhan slob chos gsum thun mong ba'i bzhugs khri'i steng gañdzi ra btsugs na legs pa'i mtshan ma shar ba dang mthun par chos rgyal dpon blon gyis kyang sngon gyi smon lam dbang gis myur por tshugs zhes lung bstan pa bzhin gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa bzhi gra btang zhing / snga sor dkar chag byed bsam pa de mus su lus pa da lam 'dir 'dres su bkod par sbyang gsum sngon btang gis bstan spyir sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi 'phel gdung shākya seng ge'i 'phel gdung sna dkar rtse dang rtse sgang gi re/ sangs rgyas glang po'i gdung /sangs rgyas kyi 'khar gsil gyi shing / ma ga dha bzang mos sangs rgyas la gtor ba'i me tog /jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang lo ke shwa ra'i na bza'/ sangs rgyas btags sku/ dgra bcom 'char ga'i na bza'/nyi ma gung pa'i snam sbyar dang gdung / rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing phur/ sa ra ha'i reg 'jam sprul gyi —160—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)pags pa/ nag po spyod pa'i rus rgyan/ tai lo'i stan/ nā ro'i phyag 'khar/ dbu skra/ rwa'i snyan rgyan/sgom thag /stan/ bum chu ral bu/ zhi 'tsho'i phyag mdzub/ ka ma shī la'i gdung / ni gu'i tshems dang dbu skra/ ma gcig grub rgyal ma dang ti pu pa'i rus rgyan/ dha na shī la'i dbu lo/ bram ze dri med snang ba'i sku sha /mi tra dzo zhi'i rdo rgyus sgom thag /dza ba ri pa'i nya gdub yol mo bas kyang mdzad pa/ pha dam pa'i phyags/ de'i rab gnas ma'i 'bum dga' ldan ma dang sgrub ril/ dam pa bod chung gi gdung / paṇa chen shākya shrī'i gdung / ring bsrel/ dbu skra/ rdo tshos ma'i (115na skom sbyar/ lhung bzed kyi shubs/'khar gsil gyi bar shing / zhabs sgrog /na bza'/ bi bhū ti tsan+da'i dbu lo/ kha che dgon pa ba'i gdung / paṇa chen shri su tra'i tshems dang dbu skra/ srong btsan sgam po'i phyag 'phreng / phyags/ sprul pa'i stag lpags/ rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i gdung dang sku rgyan/ bsam yas su lo paṇa gyis chos bsgyur ba'i khri/ khri ral gyi gdung / lo chen rin bzang gi phyag sen/ bal po a su'i rdo rgyus sgom thag /paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa'i dbu lo/ bal po pham thing pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ mar pa'i ber seng ge mjing bsnol/ mar mi thun mong gi zhal skyogs/ mar pa mgo legs kyi gdung / mar pa stod nyer kyi sku sha /dar ma mdo sde'i dbu skra/ mi la'i gdung / ras gos/ sgom thag /dbu lo/ pur thal/ stan spos sā ra'i pags pa/ rngog mdo sde'i na bza'/ ga chas sku rdo rje'i rus rgyan/ khyung po'i gdung / ring bsrel/rten 'dam/ rin chen brtson 'grus dang skyer sgang pa'i gdung / na bza'/ nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/'bri phyug pa/ lum pa ba/ byang chub dpal bzang bzhi'i dbu skra/ ma gcig zha ma'i 'kho 'gram/ paṇa chen nags rin gyi dbu lo/ chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi mgul srung thag pa/ lo chen rat+na bha dra'i dbu skra/ phreng thag /rgyal ba ri khrod pa'i gdung / chos lung thugs rje chen po'i stan shing rnams dang / snga 'gyur skor la/ slob dpon chen po'i phyag 'phreng / (115ba jig 'a rab rdo rje dang shrī sidha'i dbu lo/ bi mā la mi tra'i gdung / sku rags/ shangs mtshal/ na bza'/ za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi gdung / bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i sku sha/ bram ze dung rna can gyi sku mchin/ bram ze dri med —161—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (posnying po dang khri srong lde btsan gyi gdung/ dbu skra/ 'tsho rgyal gyi phyag bzo'i seng ge /be+e ro'i gdung / rdor dril/ rgya dpe/ na bza'/ lha lung dpal rdor gyi phong ka /dbu rgyan/ ldan ma rtse mang gi yig gril/ nam mkha'i snying po'i dbu lo/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi sku sha/ nyang ta thā ga ta'i gdung / zur shāka 'byung gi chos sman/ gangs pa shāka 'bum dang g.yung ston pa thun mong gi phreng ba/ phyi ma'i ring bsrel/ na bza'/ ka thog pa dam pa bde bshegs kyi slob ma byams pa 'bum gyi gdung / /pañtsa khrol bu/ snam sbyar/ snye mdo shākya dpal ba'i gdung / phyag 'phreng / sku sham dang ber/ rog thams cad mkhyen pa'i gdung / kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i phyag phreng / nyang rin po che'i dbu skra/ bde khrus shog ser/ rig ma sangs rgyas skyid kyi gdung / mnga' bdag bdud 'dul gyi sku gzan/ bka' brgyad pa mkha' klong yangs pa'i na bza'/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi dbu lo/ shangs mtshal/ sku sha /chos sman/ skye bdun/de'i gter ma'i 'phel gdung / bye ma a krong / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / gsang rdzogs dbang 'bum gyi shog ser/ khrus long ma ṇi ma'i khrus ras/ chibs kyi rus pa/ sras pad+ma dbang chen gyi sku sha dang phod ka/ sman lung pa chos ldan pa'i sku sha/ dbu thod/ chos sman/ zhang khrom gyi (116na slog ga ser/dri med lhun po'i gdung / ring bsrel/ ljags/ de'i gter ma mkhan slob chos gsum gyi shangs mtshal ma'i 'bum dmar/ rigs 'dzin rgod ldem gyi skye bdun/ shes rab me 'bar gyi sku sha / phyag phreng / tshe ring 'ja' tshon ma/ de'i gter slob dpon gyis gter sgrom du sbyin sreg mdzad pa'i rdo rje/ skyon yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i phab rgyun/ dbu skra/ za 'og gi ber/ myong grol/brag phug ma ra ti ga'i tshe ril/ shog ser/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i sku sha /gdung / dbu lo/ na bza'/dam rdzas rol chen/ tshe ril/ chos sman/ shog ser/ rdo rje gling pa'i sku tshil/ sku sha /na bza'i/rdzogs chen lta ba klong yangs kyi shog ser/ de slob thogs med rgya gar ba'i sku sha/ rat+na gling pa'i dbu skra/ gdung / sku sha /dbu zhwa/ sku rags/ a tham ma/ tshe ril/ dam rdzas rol pa chen po/ gur drag gi shog ser/ sras tshe dbang grags pa'i skye bdun/ pad+ma gling pa'i sku sha /pur ras/ tshems/ a tham ma/—162

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)chos sman/rten 'dus/skye bdun/de gter skyon sku chos gser gyi pa tra/klong gsal shog ser/bsam gtan gling pa'i sku sha/se ston mgon po bzang po'i dbu klad/gdung /dbu ral/sku sha/dbu zhwa/nub dgon byams pa chos rgyal mtshan gyi gdung /phyag phreng /sku phong /sprul sku mchog ldan mgon po'i sku sha/snyan gong /dbu skra/bde brol mes ston rdo rje'i dpal bzang gi dbu ral/nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/phyag 'phreng /rdo rje 16ba smo.ang kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sgom thag/rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i yum gyi gdung /mgon po rin chen gyi dbu skra/thang stong rgyal po'i tshe ril/dbu lo/phyags/phyag phreng /gtor sgam/gdung /sle bem/legs ldan rje'i dbu skra/gdung dam rdzas/bka' brgyad lugs gsum gyi chos sman/dbu zhwa/sku rags/de dang tshar chen thun mong gi dpag med rigs mang po bsgrubs pa'i tshe bum/mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi gdung /sku sham/snam sbyar/chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi dbu lo/dbu zhwa/chos sman/de dang gdung brgyud 'phrin las rnam rgyal thun mong gi chos sman/bka' brgyad sman rag/snying mdzod shog ser/'gro don las sbyor lnga pa/myol grol pad+ma rā ga'i phab rgyun/rje rin chen phun tshogs kyi phyag 'phreng /sku sha//dbu skra/tsa rmo/pur ras/chos sman/rje shes rob 'od zer gyi gdung /thugs/na bza'/dam rdzas rol r+ṣa/sogs ldan rdo rje'i sku sha/rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i dbu lo gdung /sku gzan/chos sman/rgod ldem nasadabang po'i sde yab sras yan gyi chos sman/yol mo bstan 'dzin nor bu'i dbu ral/gdung /na bza'/skye bdun/'bri gung chos kyi grags pa'i tshems/dbu sgra/rgyal ba rin chen gyi gdung /chos sman/sku srungs ba tshe bdag bkra shis kyi dbu lo/rigs 'dzin du ma rang grol gyi chab ser/yug nor bu dbang rgyal gyi dbu skra/gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje'i chos sman/skye bdun/kong po rdzogs chen pa'i gdung /chos sman/'gro don las sbyor lnga pa/rta mgo bya bral chos rje'i gdung /snang gsal ba ye shes grub pa'i dbu thod/rigs 117na 'dzin 'phrin las rnam rgyal dang sna tsho gos rang grol gyi gdung /chosasman/zur wo chos dbyings rang grol gyi gdung //bu lo/phyag 'phreng /dam rdzas/sman lung pa blo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pogros mchoge gi rdo rje'i dbu skra/ snam sbyar/ brag sna'i chos sman/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku'i skye bdun/gter bdag gling pa'i dbu ral/ sku mtshal/ de gter skyon sku rags/ a tham ma/ rten 'dus rnams/bka' gdams dang dge lugs skor la/ jo bo di paṃ ka ra'i gdung / gsegs dril/ phyag 'phreng snam sbyar/ phyag cha/ sku chos/ dbu zhwa/ stan/ phyag bris/ rgya dpe/ 'brom ston pa'i tshems/ gdung / sku sha /dbu lo/ na bza'/ stan/ po to ba'i thugs dbu skra/ gdung / na bza'/ sku chos/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi dbu lo rngog lo khu dbon gyi na bza'/ rngog lo'i dpe khri'i thag pa/ khu ston brtson khrus g.yung drung gi gdung / zhang ka ma ba'i gdung / sha ra ba yon tan grags kyi sku mtshal/ sha bo sgang pa'i gdung / rtse spyi la bu ba'i snam sbyar/ sne'u zur pa'i dbu lo/ na bza'/ bshes gnyen sgre pa'i gdung / khams pa lung pa'i phyes sbas ti dgra bcoms pa'i dbu skra/ snam sbyar/ bya 'dul 'dzin gyi dbu lo/ gdung / mchims nam mkha' grags kyi gdung / dbu skra/ na bza'/ snar thang gi rten 'dam/bcom ldan ral gri'i gdung dpal ldan gro'i rten 'dam/ lho brag phyag rdor ba'i phyag mdzub/ dbu skra/phyags/ rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po'i dbu lo/ sku mtshal/ tshems/ sku dreg /gsang chab/ dbu zhwa/snam sbyar/ sku chos/ sku snye/ na bza'/ phyags/ phyag nas/ (117bskodha gas ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i zhabasang ra/ mkhas grub rje'i gdung / paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa'i tshems/ sku chos/ dbu zhwa/rje nor bzang rgya mtsho'i gdung / dbu skra/ di bzhugs 'ang / mdung rtse ras pa'i dbu lo/ 'dar ston blo bzang grags pa'i gdung / phyag 'phreng / 'jam dbyangs legs pa chos wor gyi na bza'/ ba so chosakyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbu skra/ 'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun brgyud kyi dbu lo phyag sen sogs yod pa/paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'i na bza'/ rje smon lam dpal ba'i dbu sgra/ shangs phyis/ grub chen na kha ba'i dbu lo/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sku mtshal/ ring bsrel/ dbu skra/ shangs mtshal/gsang chab/ sku rags/ pur sol/ sems dpa' kun bzang pa'i dbu lo/ paṇa chen bsod nams gragasapa'i gdung / dbu skra/ khri chen bde ba can pa'i gdung / rje bstan dar ba'i dbu lo/ sngags rams pa —1yo

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sgrogs bam gsum pa/ (ja)dge 'dun bkra shis kyi gdung / de'i 'phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor/ sgrub mchod kyi rdul tshon/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbu klad/ phyag ngar/ chab ser/ dbu skra/ sku sha/ pur ras/ mgul srung thag pa/ sku chas/gsol pang / sku sbyar/ sku rags/ 'phreng thag /zha thul/ 'ding ba/ tshe ril/rten 'dus/ bla ma sku gsum gyi sgrub pa gnang ba'i bum chu/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ sgom bde nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi dbu skra/ rje drung bstan pa rgya mtsho dang lha dbang pa'i gdung / rje yon tan rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ shangs mtshal gdung (115)gsang chab/ pur ras/ dbu zhwa/ sku g.yogs/ mgul srung thums/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa'i dbu lo/ gdung / tshems/ thugs/ dbu klad/ ring bsrel/ sku sha /phyag sen/ gsang chab dbu zhwa/ snam sbyar/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ khri rin po che dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi dbu skra/ rten 'dus/ nged rang gi skra dang khrag rnams/ sa lugs skor la rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa'i rus rgyan/ sgom dbyug /bdud rtsi ril bu /'brog mi lo tsā ba'i gdung / ba ri lo tsā ba'i na bza'/'khon shes rab tshul khrims kyi phyag 'phreng / rus rgyan/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i dbu lo/ na bza'/ de dang sa chen thun mong gi ras phrug gi na bza'/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa'i gdung / rus rgyan/bzhes can/ zhang ston chos 'bar gyi na bza'/ sa chen kun dga' snying po'i gdung / gar shos/ na bza'/sku bem/ rus rgyan/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ rje bas bsod nams rtse mo'i dbu skra/ na bza'/ gar gos/bdud rtsi ril bu/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gdung / shangs mtshal/ dbu lo/ thod 'phreng me 'bar/ 'ding ba/ gar gos/ ber/ na bza'/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i phan lde/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ sa paṇa gyi gdung / dbu skra/ sku rgyan/ snam sbyar/ der kha chen paṇa chen gyis gnang ba'i rten 'dam dpe bral ma/'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gdung / thugs/ na bza'/ phyag 'phreng / sku chos/rdo rgyus pang khebs/ rgyal ba phyag na'i gdung / na bza'/ theg chen (118ba)cho me rje'i gdung / dbu lo/ pur ras/pur sol/ zhabs sgrog /bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gdung / na bza'/ snam sbyar/gdung tsha/ sku g.yogs/ sku 'gag /gzungs thag /na bza' brag phug pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ sngags—165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (po'achang gzungs kyi dpal ba'i sku phed/ngor chen kun dga' bzang po'i dbu skra/pur ras/'ding ba/na bza'/sku chos/rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi tshems/snam sbyar/sku sham/mnyam med ye shes dpal bzang gi dbu lo/kun mkhyen g.yag pa'i gdung /lam 'bras ba don yod dang paṇa chen shāka mchog gi dbu skra/mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi rten 'dus/yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel gyi na bza'/'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gsum gyi gdung /phyi ma'i gdung tsha/dbu lo/ dbu thod/na bza'/bdud rtsi ril bu lung bstan ma/rdo ring kun spangs chen po'i gdung /pur tsha/tshe bum sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa'i gdung /ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dbu skra/sku rags/sa lo 'jam dpal rdo rje'i dbu lo/na bza'/tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi gdung /shangs mtshal/zhabs sen/chab ser/dbu skra/bur tsha tshems dreg/sku rags/gtor ma/de dang mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen po/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse gsum gyis gsar rnying gi tshe dpag med mang bsgrubs kyi tshe ril/phyi ma'i gdung /dbu lo/shangs mtshal/'ding ba/nag leb/ 19na〉byas sman/myong grol/bka' brgyad sgrub chen gyi tshe ril/bka' brgyad lugs gsum ga'i sgrub pa'i chos sman/bdud ni ril bu/mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i dbu thod/rin po che bod mkhar ba'i dbu sgra/sngags 'amang bsod namasachos 'phel dang mkhan bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyi gdung /mkhan gzhen nu blo gros kyi dbu lo/gdung /tshems/bdud rtsi ril bu/rtag gtor/rdo rje 44 dbang rab kyi dbu skra/gdung /bdud ni ril bu/skye bdun/ nag leb/mgul srung thag pa/ sgrub gtor/mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs kyi sis ra/bdag chen bsod nams dbang po'i dbu skra/sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi bdud rtsi ril bu/'jam dbyangs kun dga' blo gros kyi gur drag bsnyen pa'i phreng thag/rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub kyi dbu lo/sku chos/bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal gyi bdud rtsi ril bu/zhabs drung a mi'i sku sham/na bza'/6/ra pa rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang gi dbu skra/

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)mgon po bsod na mas mchoge ldan gyi gdung / dbu lo/ tshe ril/ skye bdun/ po ta la'i rtser rgyu dbang gnang ba'i rdul tshon/ mkhan chen zha lu pa'i dbu skra/ bsam gtan gling pa'i gtor ma 'jam dbyangasargyal mchog dang kun bzang rtse pas bsgrubs pa/ chos lung byang rtse'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ rgya bod dam rdzas shin tu 'dzom che ba rnams/ dwags brgyud pa'i skor la sgam po zla 'od gzhon nu'i thugs/ gdung /dbu lo/ phyags/ (119bsko bza'/ myong grol/ sgom pa tshul khrims kyi dbu sgra/ gsal stong sho re'i phyags/ phyag tsha/ phag mo gru pa'i dbu skra/ na bza'/ stan/ 'jag spyil/ ber/ bdud rtsi ril bu/gdan sa mthil gyi sku 'bum bar dang sku 'dra rin po che'i sku sha/ rje dbu se'i gdung / dbu lo/ na bza'/ 'bab rong pa'i shangs mtshal/ na bza'/ chibs sga/ 'bri gung 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi dbu skra/ gdung / na bza'/ shangs mtshal/ stag lung thang pa'i na bza'/ rkarma pag shi'i dbu lo/ thugs/ rgyal ba thog brdugs pas thog gtums pa'i na bza'/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i dbu skra/gdung / spyan snga grags yang ba'i gser gtor bdud rtsir song ba/ rkarma ba mthong ba don ldan gyi gdung / shangs mtshal/ rje 'gro mgon gyi phyags/ spyan snga tshes bzhi pa'i phyag 'phreng / spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po'i dbu lo/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa'i gdung / sne'u sdong dgon gsar gyi che sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rten 'dam ste gong gsal rnams nas yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel re/ gzhan tsho'i cha shas re/ 'od dpag med rgya nag ma/ ston pa'i gser sku/ skyon rje dang gdung rten rag /dpal mar med mdzad dang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gser sku re/ rig pa chen mo dang bla gzungs so sor sum brgya re/ gsar rnying gi bla med chig stong lnga brgya/ srog shing brtan pa sum brgya/rag gi bde mchog lhan skyes/ phyag rdor 'khor chen gser sku/ rat+na'i tshe 'khor me'i spu gri'i srung bzlog kha (120na skyor re/ log tri'i srung bzlog re/ rta mgrin gyi srung 'bor/ gra pa'i dzam dmar dang ku ru ku lce'i dbang sdud re/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sa zungs bdun brgya/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rag sku rnying ma/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ 'od zer dri med kyi srog shing brtan pa/ rnam par snang mdzad gzi brjid —167—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (porgyal po'i gzungs rnams chig brgya sum cu re/spyod rgyud lnga brgya/bya rgyud chig stong dang bcu/sde lnga che chung 'dres pa stong phrag phyed gnyis/tshe mdo bcu gsum phyag rdor kha che li ser/shis brjod sum brgya/chos skyong chog stong nyer lnga/nad rims sogs 'tshe ba zhi byed byis pa gter ston gyi srung ba rgyas pa/rdo nag gi mgon po phyag drug/khro li'i dzam ser/brtan bzhugs sum brgya/gter bum gsum/bar mtshams dri bzang gi thum bu dar ras ser pos dkris shing bang mdzod rin po che'i rigs/sman sna 'bru sna/ja sna/zas sna/shing tog/gos dar/ras/rgya dkar nag/bal bod/gnas chen sogs kyi sa rdo shing chu me tog sogs kyi rigs mtha' klas pas phyur bur gtams/'og tu bod 'bangs spyi dang bye brag rgyu sbyor bar gnod pa'i gzugs can gzugs med mnan steng rab gnas can gyi byu bcu bzhugs su gsol/dam tshig par ye shes sems dpa' tshad med pa bstim ba'i rab gnas/me tog gi char dbab/gnod sbyin wo pos kyang rten 'brel sgo du mar 'grig tshul gsungs shing mthil dang mchims phu'i mchod khang thams cad la zhal gser/snyan shal 'dod gsol ma/dkar 120ba ) me mchod tshogs spel/tshes bcu bzhin ngag dbang mkhas btsun dang /nam mkha' rgya mtsho gnyis kyis 'don cha yongs rdzogs kyi rgyugs sprad/tshes bco lngar ser gos gnyis su ja tshul bcu gsum re'i thog spong dag nged rang gi gos rtse zhwa bzhi/chos gos bstoganyis/ser sked drug/thang sham brgya drug/rdul gzan nyer bzhi/ring 'gag brgyad/ber dang 'gan sbyar lnga re/rgya lham cha gsum/snye 'bol gnyis/stod 'gag/'ding ba stan dmar/gzan phrug chen rnams re/gos stan dgu/bla bre bzhi/kha btags kyi yol ba lnga/rdor drilabargyad/sbug chol bzhi/sil snyan/dkar yol/dngul stegs/bzed zhal/mas ril rnams gnyisare/dngul sku cha 'grig bcu gnyis/ra ma lug cha tshang gnyis sa gra pa rer dngul zho do re'i khyon srang chig stong bzhi brgya zhe bzhi phul bar gdugs dkar chig 'bum chig khri bzhi stong lnga brgya/sher snying bzhi 'bum dgu stong lnga brgya/bzang spyod chig ༷༷ma bzhi khri dgu stong lnga brgya song /

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)lcags yos hor zla lnga pa'i nang 'bras spungs 'du khang du sprul sku mkhan slob gra bcas stong du nye ba dang kha 'thor ba bcas la paṇa chen 'jigs med 'byung gnas dang dan ṇa ā tsarla'i dgongs don 'khrul med lugs kyi rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur na'ang la la sdug ge snying rje zhes gsung btsun mdog dang / kha cig ni rang rgyal gzhan dma' dbab 'dod pa'i mkhas khyad kyisang rgyal lam/ 'ga' zhig ni 'di snang 'jig rten chos kyis dus 'das pa yin nam/ gang ltar mig ltos (121na)ngan pasagal chung chos la song skyon gyis sa lugs ltar mang por spel ba lta zhog re gnyis kyang ma 'phel bar brten chad na 'phangs shing spel dgos pa'i gleng byung ba bzhin bstan rgyun la bsams sngar thob pa 'chad thub bam snyam pa sngags rams pa nam mkha' bzang po yod pa dpe 'dzin dang las rung gi bsnyen pa bstocha'i sbyin sreg dang bcas byed bcug /dgos byed rogs sogs gzhung nas gra bsgrigasatshes bcu drug gza' skar bzang thog drin can bla ma'i dbon 'a zha nam mkha' bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po/ khal kha zhabs drung / sngags rams pa blo bzang skyesamachog /ngag dbang dpal bzang / don grub rgya mtsho sogs gra tshang gi gra pa bcas dgur g.yul rgyal lcog tu dbu btsugs/ nyer drug la thang lha'i sku mkhar zhig gsodang bzabs gsol gtong bar ngag dbang mkhyen rtse dang don grub rgya mtsho btang nas mnyes par byas te byang phyogs kyi mi mthun phyogs sel ba'i dgos pa bsgrubs/nyer brgyad la 'bras yul dkar mo ljongs su gtor gsos la dge slong phun tshogs rgya mtsho dang blo gros rgya mtsho btang ste ri mthil gyi mgon khang tshor 'dod gsol gyi kha byang bkod pa'i snyan shal/gser skyems/ khrab rmog /sag thag gzhu bcas/ ral gri sogs spyan gzigs/ mchod gtor thams cad rgyas par gsos nas gra pa brgyad cus zhag gsum gyi bar bskang gso smin rgyas dang tshogs chen la mang ja lnga btang / go khang du chos rje bkra bzang pa gra slob rnams kyis rta mgrin dregs pa zil mnon gyi (121ba〉sgrib pa zhag bdun btsugs te bsam sbyor ngan 'chang gi sde brgyad spyi bye brag btul —169

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pomajug 'chi bdag bzlog pa'i cho ga mdzad pa byin rlabs kyi rtags tshan che/la mo chos skyong gi lung bstan bzhin nged kyi rim gror sgo blo bsgril bas bka' 'gyur brgya/gser 'od chig brgya so gsum/sgrol ma chig stong sum brgya/gdugs dkar sum 'bum bzhi khri lnga stong drug cu/sher snying sum khri drug stong /byes smad gnyis nas gser 'od brgya/thod ri bas brgyad stong pa chig stong /bskal bzang lo grangs/thang po cher phebs/bzabs gso lo dgu tshan gsum/bskang gso zhag bcu/gtsang khang zhig gso/sde pa'i rim gror dar rgyas gling pas sher snying tshig 'bum/mas brjod dang gdugs dkar khri re/'ol dga'i dge dgon tsho bsdus kyis bka' 'gyur tshar bcu/tshong sa chos skyong gi lung bstan ltar ser 'bras su cha gsum dang /pha bong kha pas gtore ma 'bum ther re/thang r+sā chos skyong gisabaskul ma bzhin dpal ri bas khro rol/ka tshal du bla ma zur pa/khra 'brug tu smin grol gling pa/gtsang 'gram du sgrol phug pa/grom pa rgyang du chu mig pa/bu chur snying phu ba/lha khang du gnas gzhi ba/pra dun rtser brag dkar chu bzang pa rnams kyis dam srir mnan pa/rdzong 'go mang por klu rten btsugs shing khrus gso le/sa bdag tshogs gto/snang brgyad sgrog pa rnams sngags ban bon gsum gyis byas/gnas chung nas chos skyong chen pos ring 'tsho spel ba'i gegs sel du lha sa khyams rar bde yangs pa 122na ) brgyas zhag bcur gdugs sher gang 'gro/hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes lngar zha lu mkhan po 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin la ja gral/'di nyin rdo rje 'phrong ba'i dbang bskur grol/dbon rin po che spyan ltos kyis phyogs kun tu brgyud pa 'phel ba zhig yong ba'i re ba yod/tshes drug la dpal ri sprul sku ngag dbang pad+ma gshegs pa'i bsngo rten rgya cher 'dug pa sal ma gyi bar gcod sel ba'i bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs yang dag bgyis shing /khong pa gter gsar rigs 'dzin thugs thig gi lung bstan rab gsal me long du/'tsho rgyal sprul pa rgyal lam pad+ma'i ming :bang so'i phyogs khrung 'di dang phrad pa na mi mthun bar gcod kun zhi 'gro don rgyas zhes mkhar chen bza'i sprul par lung ༷sa zin pa ltar tshul mthun zhig mdzad na bstan

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)'gror phan slebs che rung rang re sgrub sde ba'i chos skal 'byung sa 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs yin/de'i rtsa bla rigs 'dzin legs ldan bdud 'joms/ de'i brgyud 'dzin chos rgyal mo ga'i mtshan can yab sras la lhag par mos gus che dgos rgyur ga log pa'i gter brdzus mkhan snang rtse brgyud 'dzin gong sog la mdzad pa thugs rgyud la 'gong po phebs pa las 'os ci mchis/ 'on kyang rang ngos nas zhabs drung ma'i phyag rjes dang / chos brgyud la bsams log sems ye ma shor ba'i gnyen po bsten/ spyi so'i ngor sku skye myur 'byon gyi smon lam brtsams/tshes brgyad nas jo shāka sku mdun du bde yangs pa bzhi bcus mchod pa sna lnga brgya rtsa dang bcas spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ bzang spyod (122ba)dang ltung bshags 'gro gang che/ lha sa dud chig stong drug brgya brgyad cur sgo rer ja nag po nyag do re bsdoms khor drug phyed so gnyis/ ngan slong la sbyin pa/bsam yas dang la mo chos skyong gi lung bstan du nged rang gi rim gror byang chub chen po'i sku mdun rab byung bas dri med bshags rgyud chig brgya/ lha sar bde yangs pas phal chen so gcig /gser 'od tshig brgya bcu gnyis/ mchu sde lnga/ sprin chen/ dpang skong / rgya nag keg bzlog /dag pa gser gyi mdo tig rnams chig brgya lnga re/ gdugs dkar nyis stong nyis brgya brgyad cu/ sher snying drug stong chig brgya bzhi bcu/ tsher gseb chos skyong gi lung bstan bzhin 'phyong rgyas su ri bo bde chen pas 'bum lo grangs/ sde pa'i rim gror rgyas 'bring bsdus pa lnga bcu re/ nad rims bzlog byed la mo'i lung bstan ltar rdzong gzhis chung 'bring nyer lngas nyin gsum bstan gsol/ rdzong che ba dang sde dpon che kha dgus bstan gsol dang rgyud 'bum sgrogs/ yul gru che chung dang bstun 'bum brgyad stong pa gdugs dkar yig brgya rnams gang 'grub/ shel brag tu dge slong ye shes phun tshogs/ yang rdzong du rdo rje brag /mchims phur rang gra/ khra 'brug tu dpal ri ba rnams grangs bcad kyis tshogs brgya dbul/tshes dgu nas gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcad la rdo rje gro lod kyi sgrub pa btsugs/ tshes bcu chen mo'i mchod pa sngar bzhin phul/ tshes bcu bdun nas rkang lag la phan ched bdud rtsi chu tshan nyin —171—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogebadun brgyab/nyer gnyis la gra tshang gi gra pa grangs 23na ) bcad kyis log tri'i sgrub pa dang /lha sar khro rol btang /nyer dgur dga' ldan gsang sngags gling pa'i tsho gos khro gsar blug/tshesabacu'i 'chams yig 'go rgyangs/mdos bskang 'bum ther dus 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar rnams kyi kha byang bris/gro lod dang log tri'i sgrub khag gnyis po grol pa'i gzugs med spyi bye brag sreg pa hom gyi las la sbyar/nged rang dang sde pa thun mong gi gegs sel du dwags po gra tshang pas yig drug sa ya gnyis dang dgu 'bum sum khri nyis stong drug brgya/se ra byes smad brgyas gdugs sher nyis stong lnga brgya re/dkyil 'khor sdings su bde yangs pa bzhi bcus zhag brgyad bar nyin star spyan 'dren khrusagasol dang /bzang spyod nyi khri bzhi stong brgyad cu/lhung bshags tshig khri drug stong chig brgya/gdugasadakar sum brgya/sher snying nyis stong nyis brgya bzhi bcu/bkra shis rtse chos sder chog mang gtong ba'i mthun rkyen du lo star lha sa nas ya ju dmar 'degs kyi khal bgragacig nyag bcu gnyis dang sne'u rtse nas 'bru mkha' ru'i khal sum brgya zhe lnga lhag bcas chos rgyun chad pa med pa'i ched rgyun btsugs/dpal ri ba brgya dang bcus mchims phur zla gcig bar skyabs sems/le'u bdun ma/sgrol sher/tshe gzungs/chos srung gi bskang ba/ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/cha gsum/thugs rje chen po pad+ma'i dbang phyug gi gzhung bsrangs pa'i yig drug dung gcig/bye ba gcig/sa ya gsum/lnga 'bum rnamasasong /hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gcig la sa skyong mer gan tha'i 3ba ) ji/er khe ji nong gnyis kyisaber gser dngul ja gos dar pags ras sogs dngom che ba bteg nas gra pa nyi shus ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi bden tshig brjod/yon bdag ngo ma tshor phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang /bka' bsgo ༈mdud pa/snam phrug sogs kyi ster cha rgyas par bgyis/khal kha zhabs drung la dza ya paṇ+ḍita khu thug thu'i cho lo tham ka/bsod nams bkra shis ma 'dam dang /khod rnam rgyal/blo bzang yer khe tha'i ji/mo ja rag gi dpon mo mtsho khar rdzong ba/kong po dbu mdzad rnams la byin rlabs dang ja gral byas/gra

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)tshang du mdos bskang 'bum ther btsugs/tshes gnyis la chos rje zil gnon rdo rjes 'gan sbyar sogasarung gos tshang bdog pa spams mtho ba/spyi 'bul dngul bum gnyis/'gyed sogs yon sbyar te 'bras gzhongs dag snang ma'i sgo nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung bstar/tshes bzhir dge slong blo grosargyal bas tshan grangs ring por brkyang 'gyed dang bcas cho ga snga ma bzhin gyer/phyi dro snga sor skad rgyugs blangs pa pho rog nag skya ka khras pa'i dpe ltar la la skad che'ang gre khug gyong ba dang /'ga' zhig gre 'gyur bde rung skad chungs/kha cig mas sogs kyi rol mor brdugs pas mtsho ni gra tshang 'dir skad gzugs che ba rang gis mi chog par kha lag spyod gsum bstun shes pa zhig dgos kyin yod pa cha sgor ma nas 'di dga' snyam pa'i 'dam rgyu ni ma rnyed/phal cher cha 'dra ba'i dbye gsal dka' ba thams cad blo kha rdzogs phyir shog ril sdud bcug pa'i mang ba lnga po mthun snang gzugs 24na ) su grub gshis/rtser chos srung rnams dpang por gsol nas nged rang gis zan ril phul ba dam chos dbang rgyal thon/tshes drug la sa skyong mer gan tha'i ji/tre bo shi ra'i thu sku skye/dza ya paṇ+ḍita/bstan 'dzin chosargyal gyi gsol dpon da la'i/sngags rams pa nam mkha' bzang po thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor gyi bla mar thon gdong rnams dang phrad/tshes brgyad la dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po/gong dkar chos sde'i lar tī pa dge slong wen las/chos rje bkra bzang pa/sne'u sdong dkon gnyer dpon rin chen bzang po rnams la ja gral/lcang lo can pa'i bu'i skra phud blangs pa'i ming phun tsho gos rgya mtshor btags nas drung 'khor gras su bsdad/dpon tshang skyid spe ba'i tsha bos rgyud bzhi'i rgyugs sprad/tshesadagur dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po/gra tshang khag bcu gnyis kyi slob dpon/gnyer pa gra rgan rags bsdus dang bcas pas bdog pa'i skyes dang yon sbyar te gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i ring 'tshomadzad/de mtshungs rgyang ro lha khang bla mas kyang bstar/spos khang mkhan po/dga' ldan shar byang chos rje rnam gnyis/'ol dga' rin chen sgang gi mkhan po/sgo mang dang thar

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogegling bla zur/bkra shis lhun po'i phyag mdzod/de mo dang shel brag bla ma/tre bo dkar lcog dang grub dbang sku skye/sgrol phug pa khu tshan/chos rje chu mig pa dang khra tshang pa/ 24ba ponas chud sku rten pa/bang rim pa ming sring /rnam sras gling pa/'dus byung pa/yam bu/yer khe da'i ching /ma ga dha/ju rig thu kho sho'u chi/bsod nams mgon po/be+e ro tsa na rnams kyi mi sna sogs bod sog lnga brgya tsam gyi ngo mar byin rlabs dang dmangs la me tog gtor/gnas chud sku rten pa/sngags rams pa skye mchog dang ngag dbang dpal bzang gsum la bar gcod las bskyab pa'i bka' bsgo/grub dbang sku skye'i gtsug phud blangs shing mtshan ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor du gsol/tshes bcur sprul pa'i chos skyong rdo rje grags ldan gyis dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyis thog drangs dngos po sbams bstod/tsho gos yon dang sa sa gra tshang nas mdzod dbus ma nas byon pa'i tshe chog rdul tshon la brten rgyas par spel ba'i mgron du chos 'khor rgyal dang mtshan sgrog mkhan po/chosa'achad pa dge slong 'phrin las/dan rna gnyer dpon rin chen bzang po'ang bsgrigs/tre bo dpon dka' ༄ blo bzang chos skyong 'di wo nas drug 'bor gras su sar/tshes bcu gcig la rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling spyi tshogs kyis rung mthun gyi gosacha 'grig sogs spyi sger nas rgya cher bteg ste cho ga snga ma dang mtshungs pa mdzad/sgo mangs zur pa/dpon ngag dbang bstan 'dzin bcas brgya skor la ja gral thog byams smon gyi lung bklags/phyi mar jo rig thu da'i ching gi cho lo/tham ka/gyon pa/mdud pa/snam phrug sogs ster cha bzabs nas thon/tshes 25na ) bcu gnyis la drung 'khor spyi bsdus kyis kyang nyin snga ma dang 'dra ba'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel spel/tshes bcu gsum la bkra shis lhun po'i phyag mdzod dang dkar brag pa ngag dbang byamasapa gnyis kyis ster cha 'gyed bcas sbyar nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i cho ga rim par bstar/sde pa blo bzang sbyin pa 'dod pa chung zhing bsam pa rnam par dag pa byung na'ang thog ma nas brtag par lo gsum las ma babs shing bar 4skabs su sde pa rang la'ang rlung la brten khams

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sgrogs bam gsum pa/ (ja)nan tar ma bde ba stag star dang chang dkar sogs kyis brel ba dkyus ma dang / 'gangs che rigasarnams sde ba a bar brgyud nged la labs par bkod pa byed dgos pa zhig byung yang deng sang snyun gzhi 'ang phal cher sangs rung sde pa rang gis dgongs pa dgos tshul tsha drag mdzad par sde pa a bar/ shag lho pa dkon mchog dar rgyas sogs drung 'khor spyis kyang rgyang tsam mu 'thud na legs pa'i rgyu mtshan zer ba ltar brtag pa bskyar bar ma babs pa dang mthun par la mo chos skyong gis kyang gsungs par brten blo bstan zur bzhugs mdzad pa'i sgo dod/ nged rang na tshod kyis srid 'dzin gyi brel gcod lcogs par mi 'dug pa bcas khri bkod ma byas mthu med la 'os tho bsdus kyang shing yos nas lo 'gyang che ba ma song gshis de dus las lhag po yong don mi 'dug pas gnas gsar tshe dbang dang chang khyim pa blo bzang mkhyen brtse gnyis zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi phyi dro nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor thog sde pa a bar gyi sar btang ba'i nged na so mtho ba dang bcas srid khur mi lcogs pa sogs gang ci nas sde pa gsar bsko (125ba〉pa byas ka med byung ba khyod lung bstan sogs nas bstan par ma zad yos lo khyod la khrol cha thub pa yun bsring brtag par ma babs pa las gnyer pa sbyin pa gang ci nas pher tsam shar ba da cha thengs par slebs song / gzhan rnams kyi brtag babs thams cad khyod rang la rgyus yod pa bcas 'gan 'khur dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bgyis kyang sngon ma ltar yal yol sna tsho gis kyis khri 'khod gzhan su 'dra zhig la gnang yang der thugs rje zhugs pa legs pa mi yong mi srid cing kho rang gzhan la khri bskos grub bstun bsnyen par rdzogs ngos gam du lus kyis nam lcogs bar bcar sdod byas pa'i sa rigs sogs kyang lar rgyar gnod pa bcas kha 'dzin med pa'i 'khor ba dong sprug rang dgos tshul g.yug cig byung yang khrol cha ma bde bas rim par res chang khyim pa kher rkyang dang res gnas gsar ba dang skabs 'gar mnyam du btang ste gsed bkrol la sngon ma bzhin go len ma byung ba'i mthar nged na rgas pa bcas cis kyang khur 'khur byed dgos nan cher byas pa 'phral kun gyi dge skyon gyi rgyu mtshan mang dag dang rang la'ang chung ngu nas sku drin bskyangs par song —175

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gegashis zhabs phyi khrol nan rang zhu ma bde zhing / gang 'dod byung na lo gnyis tsam gyi bar bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rnam dag bsrungs ngos sde pa'i las bka' bstun zhus/ phugs rigs 'khor ba dong sprug gis nam lcogs bar 'phral sel gyi zhabs phyi dang / lus kyis ma phar ba nas ri khrod lta bu byed zer lan thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa yan bka' gdams gtsang ma'i rnam thar lhur bzhes la rag ma lus/ de rjes(126na po per mtshon na phyag mdzod rgya seng nas bzung rim bzhin tshangs spyod yin na'ang gnas par dka' ba dang / dpon rigs kyi blon brgyud 'khor ba dong sprug byed pa phugs rten 'brel kyang mi legs pa dang / rgya le sku mdun chos mdzad kyi dper dang bcas zhib bshad byas par gong ltar 'khor ba dong sprug gi tshe 'dir skal ba med pa dang sde pa'i las tshan khrol cha zhu ba thun mong ma yin pa yin kyang ci ste dgongs par 'phog na 'di phyi gnyis skar mi btub cing dung dkar 'o mas gsos pa de dgra chu srin 'dul gnyen gyi dpe ltar chung ngu nas spyan rgyang bla na med pa gnang ba sku na smin nas zhabs phyi 'grub res bka' gyen bzlogs mi nus kyang bdag gi yid dang ldan tsam thugs rje che na khrol cha dgos tshul gyi mur 'di nyin lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor skar ma bzang ba bcas gnas gsar ba dang chang khyim pa gnyis btang ste lung bstan babs dang 'brel ba tsam du ma zad zer ba bzhin chung dus nas gsos pa lta bu nged na je mthor slebs pa'i chos 'jig rten gang yang mi lcogs pa gzhan byed kyi re ba med pas nged blos gtong na khrol cha yod/ de min khrol cha mi yong zhing sde pa blo bzang sbyin pas brtag pa dgos tshul byas pa las 'di 'dra yang yang ston pa'i rtsed sna min pa dang / khyod lo sngon ma brtag par rtse thon par ma zad rtsa ba gsum gyis lung bstan pa las lhag pa'i brtag pa dgos don kyang ci la yod/ sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs sne'u sdong bdag mo dang bcas nged la'ang gtam cha ngan pa ma bzod par zur bzhugs mdzad rtsis rim brgyangs sogs la brten rjes 'jog mtshams phran bu (126ba〉pas sur yang byed gtad bzos pa med/ khyod de tsho dang mi 'dra bar mchog dman thams cad kyis nged rang dang khyad med khyag bkur byed pa'i bca' bsgrigs kyi yi ge'ang —176

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)yod pas nged zhe thag pa nas blos gtong na ma gtogs khur 'thur gyi rtsis len byed dgos pa'i tsha nan gyis mol bar lugs zung nas lan gyi gleng mo rgyas par byung zhing / spyi dang bye brag gi rgyu mtshan nged kyi yid dang 'gal ba skye ba kun tu mi yong ba'i smon pa byed yod/ bka' de ltar yin tshe da lam dgongs pa zhus na 'di phyi gnyis ka mi yong gshis bka' bstun zhu zhing / yun da lta nas lo grangs ma thub rung slar 'os la'i gas byung tshe khrol cha dang byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs 'og nas mi 'dor ba'i tshig dang len dang smon lam ji ltar btab pa 'grub dgos tshul sogs dang du len nyan tsam byung ba thag bcad de kun la bsgrags pa drung 'khor skya ser gra tshang dang bcas pas legs so'i kha btags sogs btang 'dug /mnga' ris gra tshang pa rab 'byams pa blo bzang bkra shis kyis mkhas grub sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i 'dus chung lta ba'i sgron me'i rgyugs sprad/ sku gzugs kyi rten bzhengs par phan yon mtha' klas pa'i nang nas/ 'phags pa zung gi mdo'i chos kyi rnam grangs las/ yang dag sangs rgyas mchoge dran pa/ /mkhasapa rnams ni bde ba yin/ /theg pa che la dad pa yang / /de dag ga 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur/ /kun tu dpa' ba de bzhin du/ /sngon gyi las kyis rab bskul nas/ /las ni chung ngu byas pa yang / /'bras bu mtha' yas spyod par 'gyur/ /(127na〉ngas rgyas zhing gi zhing mchog tu/ /sa bon btab na 'bras bu che/ /ji ltar sa bon nyung bto las/ /'bras bu mang por spyod pa bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la dga' byed pa/ /mkhas pa rnams ni bde bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phan yon mthong nas tshes bcu drug la sman bla'i mdo chog dang mthun pa'i gser zangs kyi bde gshegs brgyad/ sems dpa' bcu drug /gnod sbyin sde dpon bcu gnyis/ phyogs skyong nyi ma zla ba/ rgyal chen bzhi/ khri gdan bcas bzhengs pa'i sku rgyu/ phogs gla yon bsdoms 'bru gshor khal bdun stong drug brgya/ po ta la'i bla ma lha khang rten gtso rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i bzhugs khang gser zangs kyi rgya phibs bcas pa dang /char da'i mdos tog bzhi rnams kyi rgyu phogs yon la 'bru khal chig stong bcu bzhi rnams song ba'i —177—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (geskur dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas rogs byas te gzungs phul zhing rab gnas rta thog ma bgyis/tshes nyi shur nyi thang bla gras zang zing gi skyes dang bcas ring 'tsho'i bden brjod smon lam mdzad/chab mdo rje drung sku skye/lcam nor bu khra skor/bkra shis rab brtan mkhan po/sgar gra tshang dpon slob/dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang 'khor bcas/gsar 'byor dka' bcu ngag dbang legs bshad rnams la ja gral/brtag pa byas pa'i nged rang gi gegs sel du gzhis rtser myug chos 'khor gling pa dang gangs can chos 'phel ba/lha rtser dga' ldan 'og min gling pa/rin spungs127bsgo byamasar+sā pa dang nges gsang rdor gling pa/jo rdzong du sgar gra tshang pa/g.yul rgyal lhun rtser sde drug spyi bsdus/do rdzong du don gnyis gling pa/pa nam du mas sgrog pa bcas pas bka' 'gyur brgya dang gnyis/sgrol ma drug khri bdun stong don lnga/sher snying bdun khri tshig stong dgu brgya bdun cu/tshe gzungs nyisa'abum nyi khri bzhi stong lnga brgya/gdugs dkar tshig khri nyis stong bzhi bcu/thang chen chos skyong /srong btsun ma ning /rtse sman ma gsum la snyan shal/gsol mchod nyin gang ma/yang rdzong /bsam yas/mchims phu/gong po ri/khra 'brugazhal brag/yum bu rnams su dar lcog brgya re/bstan srid la rgya'i gegs sel la 'phrul snang du rdo rje brag pas mgon po g.yul bzlog/po ta la zhol du tshe chu sgrub sde bas lha 'dre stong dra rnams smin rgyas/dza ya paṇ+ḍita khu thug thu'i tham phud 'bul rgyu'i kha byang /sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i dkar chag dad pa'i gsos sman/dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pas gra tshang du gos yol phul ba'i kha byang /bal po pi la jus dpal 'khor chosasder sman bla'i sku sogs rten mchod phul ba'i deb ther 'go brjod/dpal grong sngags rams pa'ingor bka' gdams glegs bam sogs dang bsdun ga byungs rabs rin chen phreng mdzes/zur khang pas skyon rnam thar dang paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa'i 'khrungs rabs gra tshar bzhengs pa/bi lig rab 'byams pa'i 'dod bstun ring 'tsho/sde pa saXs rgyas rgya mtsho nged rang 2ni ) gis khur ma

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ khonganalcogs par khri 'khod cig dgos pa dang lhag tu da cha na tshod mtho gshis lugs gnyis kyi byed por sde pa snga ma rnams dang yang mi 'dra zhing nged rang gis gang byas dang 'dra ba'i bca' yig chos srid dam can rgya mtshor gnyer gtad dang bcas pa bris pa nas gcig sum skas 'gor bris par lag gnyis rjes kyi rtags gsal bar spras/ sde pa blo bzang sbyin pa zur bzhugs kyi dga' ldan khang gsar du byon/ sangs rgyas rgya mtshos zur pa sngon ma las thugs bsam dang bka' la 'khri ba sogs gang ci nas skal ba spams mtho ba dgos tshul dang / gzhan 'dras mchod dpon gyi las tshan rgyun ring zhing rin chen rgyan cha dang tshes bcu'i chas sogs sna bo'i lugs bzang 'dzin par brtson pa dang khri'i bya ba'ang 'dab thub pa de rtsis kyis 'thus sogs gleng gzhi sna tshogs byung rung nged rang gis sngon ma las cung zad ngo mtho'i rtsis phye gsal sprad par de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung gi phung po dngul gyi mchod rten dang bcas pa/ rgyal ba zas gtsang sras po'i sku li dmar dbus lha khri 'od kor dang bcas pas gtsos bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos chos skyong gi sku li ma gsar rnying rag 'dres pa go drug /klu 'jim gyi gsum/ sman 'dam gyi gnyis/ gser gyi gnyis/ rnam rgyal mchod rten/ byang chub shing lor sangs rgyas kyi sku bris pa/ rgya can gyi thang grangs bcu gsum/ mdzad brgya dang grub thob brgyad cur nyer dgu re/ gnas bcur nyer gsum/ 'khrungs rabs gangs can lha gcig ma dang sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi gser thang bco lnga/ sngags thang (128ba)gzhi nag tshon rdzogs ma dgu /gnas bcu 'dra lcog la nyer gsum/ bka' gdams bu chos zhing bkod la bdun/ sangs rgyas stong skur bdun/ rje bsno btsong kha pa/ jo bo a ti sha/ nged rang gi 'dra 'bag re/ sangs rgyas so lnga'i gser thang la dgu ste khyon chig brgya re bdun/ gong gsham gos bzang bsgrig zhal khebs rgyab sha dngul rag tsan+dan sogs kyi tog sna tshogs spus legs cha 'grig /sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ klu dbang gi rgyal po dang bcas pa/ gos bzang sgrigs kyi gos thang legs pa/ mchod chas skor la g.yang kri dang ma na ho ra shel sogs kyi dpyad pa che chung 'dres pa bco lnga/ zangs tsha gser gyi me dam cha/—179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (7)dkar dam cha/ rag gi man ji che chung gsum/ rgya ting che chung bdun tshar bzhi/ dngul ting bdun/ me shel hril mo che chung bas bdun/ dkar yol ljang khra/ dkar stegs/ dngul sder/ g.yang ṭi dwangs shelagyis mthongs byas pa'i mchod yol/ dngul seng rag stegs ma/ dngul gyi tha phag /bya ma bum shing lo ma/ rag tsha gser gyi pad spungs/ dngul gyi spos khra/ spos gzhed rnams re/ byu ru'i rgya lag stegs bcas bzhi/ me long che chung gnyis/ rgya bya tsha gser ma gnyis/ rag kong bzhi/ gtor cha lnga tshar gsum/ yas 'gu mas 'gu/ ting shags gnyis/ bde chen chos 'khor ba'i hor sbug gis gtsos shubs ldan gsum/ sil snyan gsum/ dril bu rdor bcas shubs ldan gsum/ dung chen dang rgya gling cha re/ lding spos gnyis/ gser btso (129na)ma zho lnga bcu/ grang gser zho brgya tham pa/ gser zho chig stong nyis brgya drug cu/ dngul srang nyis stong lnga brgya/ kha btags nyin bde nan ching nag khra sogs legs pa sum brgya bcu gsum/ rten khebs che chung nyi shu/ sman tse bar rnying 'dres pa yug byed nyis brgya/ ding phon ma ṇi ma'i bla bre/ ding phon gzhi mchin gyi rta khebs/ ding phon sna rdzar can che legs gnyis/ sna rdzar med pa gcig /hor gos bum gdan ma gnyis/ bum gdan dkyus gras lnga/ sne'u stong rtse'i kha thi'i yol ba legs pa the ba'i nyi shu rtsa bdun/ bzang gos kyi bla bre lnga/ dar ling 'dres pa yug tshig brgya bdun cu/ gos kha thi rnying ma/ thon thi/ cod ldan/ log thang bcas khyon chig brgya nga drug /kong rna a tsar sba ril pad 'dab dang bcas pa/ spur len sum sgrogs/ g.yu rdog gcig /byu ru'i brgya phreng dpus legs gcig the ba'i shal pa drug /sbur len gyi shal pa gcig /mu tig gi phreng ba/ dpral g.yu/ gser mdong dang dngul mdong cha re/ mchod kong tshig brgya nyer gcig /gos phan sna tshogs zhe bzhi/ thod ḍi/ dngul gyi nang mchod ka pā la/ spos mdong / sgar sbug brgyad/ tse ber bzhi/ gos chen gyi tsag pa bcu/ stod 'gag bco brgyad/ pags rigs dang snam bu 'dres pa'i sbyar ma bcu/ gzan phya ru ma gnyis/ lham bco lnga/ gzan phrug chen bcu/ gos gdan kha gang ma dang gos 'jag 'dres pa nyer bdun/ dkyus gdan bcu gnyis/ stan (129ba)dmar brgyad/ ras ther gyi rkyong —/80

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gdan sna tsho gos drug cu/ 'bol gcig /snye 'bol gsum/ sa gdan nyer gsum/ kha gdan gnyis/stag gzig gdan dang grum 'jag so sonas bsto re/ khri grum/ lo grum/ dkyus grum grum yug sogasabasdoms pa gya drug /ban khebs pa ri brgyad/ 'bog co gsum/ dwags sle brgyad/ 'og 'jug gnyis/snam stod bcu/ gos sna thig gnyis dang sngon po gcig /mo lham nyer gcig /dngul tsha gser dang g.yang ṭi'i pha gu byas pa'i ska rags smyug shubs tshags ma dang bcas pa gnyis/ hu ja khor drug ma nga drug /nag po khor drug sum cu/ ya ju khor drug chig brgya drug cu/ sha shan dang 'u zi khor drug chig brgya so gsum/ zi ling spu ja ko dra dgu /tā tshwa ko dra so bzhi/ san tshwa ko dra so gsum/ snam bu dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba dpus sna tshogs 'dom chig khri/ phying dkar dos bcu/ sbom tshar khom do/ dwags shog /rab brtan gan shog /lho shog sum gzhor gyi bcu deb chig stong / bal khyem bzhi brgya bzhi bcu/ gshol lcags lnga brgya so bdun/ zam so/ spu kha/ dril/ spen tog /lho ras/ cab ras bcas yug nyis stong dgu brgya bzhi bcu/ 'bras ltang brgya/ rgun ltang bcu drug /spos dkar ltang codagu/ gu gul ltang tse brgyad/ stod ja ltang tse bcu gnyis/ bye gar ltang tse bzhi/ bur ltang chig brgya sum cu/rams ltang brgyad/ mtshal (130ba)mthing spang ma ba bla ldong ros li khri sogs tshon rkyal bco lnga/ sra rtsi ban gang / tsan dan dkar dmar rdum bzhi/ a ka ru rdum nyer brgyad/ bzang drug sogs sman sna tshogs krong tse do/ khrog sman rkyal dos brgyad/ gos chen gyi gsol gdan gsum/ dkyus ma re lnga/ zo lag bzhi/ sder ma drug brgya don gnyis/ rag 'gag re bdun/ dmar btsod 'degs khal chig stong brgyad brgya nyer bdun/ zhu mkhan brgyad brgya/ tshwa khal chig stong / bul khal brgya/ rgya tshos skye dos nyi shu/ me mda' spus legs cam bcu/ od ma/ mtshal phug /mdung / rta go cha 'grig /sag thag mda' gzhu cha 'grig /gsol go legs pa cha 'grig /'khor gsum cha 'grig /khrab rmog cha 'grig sum cu/ gur che ba yol sgor dang bcas pa gnyis/ g.yabs yol sgor dang bcas pa/ dkyus gur dkar nag drug /g.yabs bcu gcig /phying gur gnyis rnams thag bca' cha 'grig /me slang / phaṭa —181—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pobacu gsum/ sgam che chung so drug /krong tse brgyad/ stag gzig gi pags pa'i khom 'bog drug dang dkyus ma nyer gcig /gsar chas gnyis
