kyis gtsos/ gser dngul ra ma lug gi sga cha tshang so lnga/sga dmar cha lag tshang 'grig nyer gsum/ ja lang jang ki'i nor bu khyung sngon dang bon grong bkra shis gro dmar gyis thog drangs rta so gcig /dre'u drug cu sga gdan dkar brtsegs dang bcas pa/ tshong khag gcig gi g.yabs/ dar lcog /thab chas gdangs thag cha 'grig /rgya krong che ba stim sag gi rgyan yod cha/ 'thud gri/ kha sha'i ja khug /mkha' ru gshor 'bo bre bcas lcags shan ma/ mkha' ru'i rgya nyag rdo bcas/ zangs rgyan cha/ tshwa snum gtong ba'i skyogs zangs mgo /gser mgo /lcags mgo /ra kha gnyis/rkyal pa brgyad/ snum ban gsum/ gsol phor spag phor bsdoms gya gsum/ bse 'o ra legs pa nyi shu/ khro zangs bsdoms pa nga bzhi/ zhal dkar sgab shubs dang bcas legs pa/ zangs khal chig brgya brgyad cu/ rdzong sne'u sdong rtse/ gzhis lho gung rgyal/ lha gsol/ ston rug /dogs pa bkra sa chen sogs ma lags bcas pa'i khang pa/ yol ba/ chu khebs/ sku gsung thugs rten/ thab gdan bcas/'dren dpyad/ dkar dpyad/ drag chas/ gnyer chas/ gzhis phyugs/ gnyis lug sogs bdag thob 'dzin thebs cha 'grig rang 'jags thog bka' rgya bkar skyin bcas pa'i 'bru khal chig khri bzhi stong chig brgya re gcig /ru khag gnyis/ lug khag gnyis/ rdzong gzhis gong gsal rnams kyi /chu shing gsum dbang rigs 'dzin bdag /gzhis shas kyi yong sgo/ mi ser gyi 'bab 'phel 'grib bcas khyon gcig tu bsdoms 'bru rkyang thog sha mar dpus char gong brgyab par 'bru mkhar khal sum khri drug stong drug brgya go drug /gzan shing bsdoms rgya ma bdun khri bdun stong sum brgya (131na)drug cu/ mi ser bod pa rkang gi zur cha yan them 'dzin dgu brgya nyer gsum/ dud chung rdo thab yan tshig brgya rgya bzhi/ 'brog rigs sbra dud lnga bcu dang bcas thugs 'dod rdzogs par bkang /nyer bzhir rdo rje brag gi g.yul bzlog gtong mi dbu mdzad ngag dbang blo gsal gra bcas/chos rje khra tshang pa dang phrad/ nyer brgyad la zhabs drung nor bu khra sgor thegs par mdud pa ja gos dar —182—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)sogs kyi skyes lan rgyas par dbul zhing bka' bsgo/ a mdo ba sum cu skor la me tog gtor/ dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang mnga' ris phyogs su snga sor dge lugs dar rgyas che ba de bzhin yin kyang bar du rang phyogs kyi bla ma re gnyis kyis ma 'pher bar brten ding sang zhwa ser po'i bstan pa shin tu nyam dma' bar phan cha zhig e yod re bas dmag la 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan zer yang 'di rigs lhus thingasam byas par stabs 'gros mi 'gab tshul nan chags 'di ga nas labs pa dang mthun par sde pa blo bzang sbyin pa dang stag star sogs kyis shol btab kyang nged chos ma byung phyin bla ma'i gsol ras za yin bsdad par dgos pa mi 'dug pas bstan pa'i zhabs tog bsgrub rtsis kyis mnga' ris su 'gro bar shol ma thebs gshis sde pas mthun rkyen spel te rdzong bda'/ bi lig thu'i 'dod pa ltar ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad kyi lungs bklags/ mdud pa byin rten sogs dang bcas gnam gang la thon/ khri 'don gyi gegs sel la khyams rar bde yangs pas 'bum bcu/ bskal bzang lnga/ rgya rol gsum/phal chen lnga/ (131ba tshe gser 'od/ gzungs 'dus nas bkra shis brtsegs pa/ phyogs bstomun sel/gza' yum/ mtshan brjod/ gnam sa snang brgyad/ nyes pa kun sel/ rma bya chen mo/ gtsug tor/ rnam 'joms/ dag pa gser gyi mdo tig /sdong rgyan/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo/ stobs po che rnams so sor brgya tshar/ gdugs dkar tshig stong tshig brgya so drug sher snying bzhi stong chig brgya so brgyad/ ser 'bras gnyis su ja tshul thog gdugs dkar dang sher snying/ dga' ldan du sgrol ma dang tshe gzungs/ brtag rim du/ bka' 'gyur bcu bdun/ 'bum tshar gnyis/ nyi khri gsum/ brgyad stong pa lnga/ bskal bzang bdun/ gdugs dkar drug stong brgyad brgya/ sher snying nyi khri sum stong dgu brgya bzhi bcu/ sgrol ma sum khri bzhi stong nyis brgya/ rgyal du dmag zor mar bskang pa khri/ beg tser stong / gzhan rnams la brgya tshar/ snyan shal gtor gsos dang bcas pa/ la mo dang bsam yas chos skyong gis khri 'don gegs sel la bde yangs pas la sar stobs po che/ bkra shis brtsegs pa/ gtsug gtor dkar nag rnams bco lnga re/ bka' 'gyur gsum/ dkon gnyer bas gdugs dkar mdos chen/ khra 'brug —/83—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pochos skyong gis khri 'khod rim gror dpal lha'i dbu thog tu rgyal mtshan legs pa/ ser 'bras su spong dag gra pa gsum rer gser zho re'i rtsis dang ja sbyor sbrel/ srog blu lnga bcu/ (132na〉sngags khang/gnas chung / se ra spyi so rnams su bskang gso nyin thub snyan dar dang bcas pa/hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig la rta ra klu gong gi bu nor bu bzang pos dgos tshul ltar khrab rmog cha 'grig snyan dar sogs bsrings/ grom pa rgyang gi lha khang bdun por mchod me sdong rkang re nyin khyongs lha rtse dang phun gling gnyer tshang nas phyed khyer gtong ba ji srid bar rgyun btsugs/ tshes gnyis la sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshor tshe dpag med 'chi med dpal ster/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thun mong ma yin pa/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs rnams kyi dbang dang rjes gnang bskur/ lha 'dre stong dra gtong mi nges gsang rdor gling pa gra bcas/ sde pa bkra shis/ tshe dbang rab brtan/ rnam grol bsam grub/dar rgyas sogs las tshan byed mir ja gral/ mtsho sna gdong pas dngul gyi dong rtse gser gtso gyur gyi yod dgu'i bdog pa dang bcas gra tshang gi gra pa bcus tshigs bcad shis brjod gyis mtha' brten/bstan 'dzen da la'i rgyal po/ yul jo'i thu pā thur tha'i ji/ blo bzang mgon po rab brtan sogs 'dam nas byon pa dang mjal/ tshes lnga phyi mar sde pa'i tham phud jo shāka /lo ke shwa ra/ dmag zor ma/ dpal lha/ mkha' 'gro rnam lnga spyi/ thang lha/ rgyal ri mthil gyi lha tshogs rnams la 'bul ba'i snyan shal kha byang /rnam gling paṇa chen gyi ring 'tsho dang 'brel pa'i gral 'phros rtsa tshig /mes po'i zhal lung kha skong gi par byang / gsang ne'u thog spyi tshogs nas (132ba)bskul ma mdzad pa'i sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i brtan bzhugs rnams brtsams/ rtsis rigs smra ba'i yang rtse bla mkhyen ngag dbang gis zhib rtsis byasapa tshes lnga nyis brtsegs kyi tshes drug gi nyin nam langs nas chu tshod bcu gsum rdzogs pa nyi phyed snga cha tshes bzang po/ dbyangs i/ gsal byed ma/ res gza' pa ba sangs dar ba/ nyin stobs che ba/skar ma dbo/ 'phrod mdung / sbyor ba yongs bsnun/ byed pa khyim skyes/ rten 'brel skye mched/ nyi ma stag /spar kha li/ sme ba gcig dkar/ zla ba'i snyigs ma dang / dus sbyor byed pa sogs mdor na —/84

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gtsugs lag dkar nag dbyangs 'char nas gsungs pa'i spyi sgos tshang ma sgo bstun te dus shin tu dge bar phun sum tshogs shing bkra shis pa'i nyin gtsug lag lugs brgya'i 'dun sa gnam skos kyi pho brang chen po gnam gtad kyi gtsug tor nor bu'i me long gis bteg pa'i 'jigs med seng ge'i khri yangs por 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal thabs chen po'i lugs gnyis kyi byed pa po gnam sa'i dbang phyug tu sa skyong sangs rgyas rgya mtsho bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du mas dbang bskur ba'i sngon 'gro nged la legs skyes bkra shis pa'i kha btags nyin bde ma/ chos dbang rin po che'i gter ma'i gnam lcags las grub pa'i slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i phyag rdor rtse dgu pa/ paṇa zhwa/ 'gan sbyar sogs rung mthun gyi rgyan pa dpus legs cha 'grig gsum/ gos yug chen nyi shu rtsa gcig /byang dar/ ma hasasga ras (133na)ja sogs dgu tshan nyi shu rtsa gcig bstar rjes khrir 'khod thog snying por gyur pa'i zho/gro ma mar khu sogs bkra shis pa'i zas dang / 'bo gros bkang steng lde mig /deb/ dar zab kyi sgrom bu/ thams ka che chung sogs gtad de lugs zung mtha' dag gi byed pa por mnga' gsol/ zhal dkar ba'i thog ma ming bkra'i stabs mtshal zhabs drung grags pa tshe dbang rdo rjes sna drangs/ sde pa zur pa blo bzang sbyin pa'i ngo tshab/ bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po/ yul jo'i thu pā thur tha'i ji/ dpon tshe ring / blo bzang mgon po rab brtan/ da la'i hung tha'i ji sogs mtsho kha'i dpon khag rnams kyi mi sna/ rta tshag rje drung rin po che/ gra sa phan tshul gyi slob dpon khri gdan zur/ las sne sna chen/ dbon chos mdzad/ nye skor nang so drung 'khor/ lding dpon/ lha sa ru bzhi rnams dang / gzhan yang yam bu rgyal po'i mi sna dza shin de ba dang dzi na de ba la sogs phyogs 'dus kyi kha che bal po so sos yul lugs dang bstun pa'i khri 'bul bteg /gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas kyis rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas rtags phul te bden tshigs brjod/ bza' btung gi dga' ston rgyas par bshams shing/rol gar sna tshogs bsgyur ba dang / legs bshad kyi 'bel gtam 'dar pa lo chen dang / rnam gling paṇa chen gnyis kyis khri 'bul ba sde tshan bdun gyi bar star chags su bgyis/ lha sa ba'i rgyal srid sna —/85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pobadun/ bro gzhas pa/ grong smad kyi 'og /dar po gling pa/ (133ba〉rtseng srung khang pa/ dan 'bag pa/gnas chung pa/ spen rtsa ba/ lha lung / bzhi sde/ khe gsum pa/ gtsang pa bro pa sogs kyis ltad mo sna tshogs bstan/ 'di nyin 'ja' khyim kha dog sna lnga pa phyi nang du ma zad nyi ma'i phyogs bzhir 'ja' sna lnga dang 'ja' rdog dkar po nyi ma 'dra ba de dang shar nub tu 'ja' phung sna lnga re byung ba legs pa'i mtshani ma yin pa 'dra snyam/tshes bdun la gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po dang mjal gsung gleng zhib mor byung / phyi dro sa'i tshangs pa bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po/ rgyal mo gzhen pa/ er khe ja'i sang gi gzhis 'dzin/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po/ yer pa dang ding ri glang 'khor bla ma/ kre pa khro bo dkar po/ rme ru ba'i dbu chos sogs la ja gral/ gra pa byings la ngos phrad/ rgyal lha khang pa dang / rme ru ba'i 'chams/ po ta la zhol pa sogs kyis bro gzhas bstar/ tshes brgyad la sde pa zur pa/ rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ yer ba chos rje/ la mo sku rten pa/ tsher gseb bla ma sogs dang mjal/ lha sa tshes bstob rnams kyis stang stabs du ma sgyur zhing so nam pa/ sgrag mtsho gling pa/ gtsang bro sogs kyi rtsed mo snang / tshes dgur stag rtse tha'i ji ma chen shag lho pa'i ma dang btsun ma sogs la ja gral dang / shel grong pa/ lcang grong pa/ gser khang pa/ lho gad pa/ gra bzhi ba/ bkra shis dgos 'dod/ byang gling pa'i g.yog /gtsang bro sogs glu g.yis rtses/tshes bcur dga' ston gnyis par gdan sa chen po 'brog dga' ldan rnam par rgyal pa'i gling nas khri gdan zur gyi sku tshab/ shar byang chos rje rnam gnyis/ mngon dga' sku skye/ slob dpon pa/ lasasne (134na thams tshan/ stag rtse rgyal bu lha rgyal rab brtan/ bde chen tha'i ji/ bkra shis ljongs chos rje/ rgyud stod/ mi nyag dgon gsar/ yer pa/ mtshal dbus gling / gzims khang shar/ chos khri/btsun mo tshal rnams kyi bla gnyer/ glang ra 'og 'thar rgyas pa sogs skyid shod stod kha'i lha sde mi sde/rdzong stod bde 'byor byang pa/ rdzing phyi mkhan po/ dga' tshal ba sogs 'ol kha'i lha sde mi sde/ mkhar —186

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)rtse/ za dam/ lha khang / lhun grub rdzong / glang thang / yul snga rnams su sdod mi dkar yags pa/ zhing mo che ba/ 'phags pa don grub/ mas sgor ba/ lha dbang rdo rje/ gro khud pa/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag bco brgyad chos rje/ thang sag bla ma/ rwa sgreng khri zur dbon/ stag lung zur pa/ 'od 'jo ba/ sum phreng ba rnams kyi tshab ma sogs 'phan yul skor gyi lha sde mi sde/ rgyal/ mkhar thog /lha gsol/ sku rab rnam rgyal/ dwags po gra tshang / bang rim chos sde/ sgam po phyag mdzod/ du pa mi dbang / bang rim sogs dwags phyogs kyi lha sde mi sde/ phag gung gzhis sdod/ 'bri gung phyag mdzod sogs dbur stod phyogs kyi lha sde mi sde dang bcas pas zhal dkar rgyas par bteg /stag rtse nas rta bcu gnyis/ stag lung khri zur gyis rta bcu/ sems dpa' chen pos rta bstogacig /'bri gung pas rta brgya bdun rnams byung / shar byang chos rje gnyis/ slob dpon pa/ (13grub)rgyud stod dang bkra shis ljongs chos rje/ thang sag /brag dbar/ yer pa rnams kyi bla ma/ bco brgyad chos rje/ 'bri gung phyag mdzod/ dga' ldan rab brtan dang mang ra mkhan po/ 'chad ka spyan snga/ rgyal spyi gnyer/ bang rim pa/ sgrom mda' ba/ zur mkhar ba sogs dang sger phrad/ dzo pa'i bu mo rgan pa'i skra phud blangs shing ming blo bzang sgrol mar btags/btsun mo tshal pa'i gra pa lnga bcur me tog gtor/ gung thang chos khri bas tshes bcu'i 'chams chos lung pa/ gar pa/ che gsum pa/ rag pa/ dgon shar ba/ dbus gtsang gi gro gzhas sogs kyis rtsed sna bstan/ gra tshang nas gra pa tshan pa bzhi char 'bebs la btang /tshes bcu gcig nas sad srung gi bum sgrub kyi snga rol kun bzang bde chen du nged rang gis bskyed bstim mchod bstod 'dod gsol byas/ gsang phu zhabs drung rnam gnyis/ slob dpon pa bcu/drung chen sogs spyi tshogs kyis dngos po'i skyes dang bcas ring 'tsho mdzad/ gsang sngags byang chub gling pa'i gra pa rnams la me tog gtor/ khri 'khod kyi dga' ston rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa spyi sger gyis bdog pa bteg cing ston mo rgyas par bshams pa'i mgron du sde pa blo bzang sbyin pa/ rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po/ dpal 'khor chos —187—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (posde'i mkhan po/ gsang gling / thar gling / thang sag gsum gyi slob dpon/ stag rtse bde chen gyi yab srasagasum rnams byon/ zha lu mkhan zur (135na)gyi skyes kyang 'dir 'bul ba mdzad/ phyi dro rigs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub/ ri gsum pa/ rnam rgyal dgon pa ba sogs la ja gral/ gsang sngags byang chub gling pas tshes bcu'i 'chams dang btsun mo tshal pas 'chams sna bstar rjes/ mkhar snga ba/ rin chen tshal pa/ sgang stod pa/ rdo pa/ se ra gzims khang shar pa'i g.yog /glang sa bye lung / yer pa/gtsang bro sogs kyang snga ma dang 'dra/tshes bcu gnyis la chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon las sne ba/ dge 'dun rags bsdus dang bcas pas bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal ba'i bden tshig rtse gcig tu mdzad/de thog sbyar ra dngos grub kyis do dam byas pa'i mnga' ris rdzong dga' spyi bsdus kyis ring 'tsho spel/rtser dga' ldan khung tha'i ji'i mi sna gsas khang sku skye/ rwa sgreng zur pa khal kha g.yas ru ja sag thu'i mi sna/ zhang ston sku mdun lhun grub/ shag byang pa/ rnam rgyal gser khang bla ma sogs dang phrad/ yang dgon pa'i 'chams/ mkhar rtse chags rje/ ra ma rtse/ po ta la/ sbyar ra rnams kyi bro gzhas/ sgo mang zur pa ngag dbang 'phrin las sdom rgyun brje ba/ stag lung gdan sar bsko rgyu'i ka drug pa sogs bsnyen rdzogs drug bsgrubs/ bla ma btsan po bas gser zho brgya dang gzhi/ dngul lnga bstom/ mtshal sgam bco lnga/ hu ja khor drug ma drug /gos dar sogs spam mthor bteg ste gra pa nyi shus ring 'tsho tshigs bcad gsungs/ (135ba〉sgrol ma ba rgan pa/ gnas gzhi pa/ chos rje brag sna ba pha bu gsum/sgrub rnying bla ma sogs kyang yod/ btsan po bla mar rdzong ba dngos gzhi grub kyang 'di nyin 'phel gdung gsum/ grub mtha' ris med kyi byin rten 'dzom che ba/ bla gos rgya ni 'phro/ gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa bzhi sbrags sku gsung thugs rten sogs tshan che'i steng bka' bsgo dang / rgya sog kha shas la me tog gtor/ ritshes bcu gsum la chu shur thar gling bla gras dngos po'i tshan grangs dang bcas tshe'i bar gcod —/88

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)las rgyal ba'i bden pa brjod/ 'brog bsam sdings sprul sku/ thugs sras zla ba/ bon lung sku skye/ mi nyag dgon gsar bla ma/ lhun rtse zhabs drung yab sras gsum/ sna dkar rtse'i zhabs drung lcam sring rnams dang mjal/ thugs sras zla bar drag dmar gyi bka' bsgo phul/ dga' ston gsum par rdzong sdod ra ma rtse pa/ rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ gter ston rin po che/ skyon 'tsho mo/ tsho gos yas mas/byams pa gling / gsung rab gling / bshad sgrub gling / ri bo rnam rgyal/ gong dkar chos sde/ sna dkar rtse bgres gzhen/ gdong nas/ bying rnam/ dpal de ba sogs gong dkar 'og gi lha sde mi sde/ rdzong sdod ri gsum pa/ chos 'khor yang rtse/ gsang sngags gling / thar pa gling / mtshur phu zhwa dmar nas/yangs pa can/ yang zur/ ge re lha pa/ lcang lo can pa sogs chu shur phyogs kyi lha sde mi sde/ rdzong sdod ram pa ba/ gsang phu gling stod smad (136na)kyi chos rje/ nyi thang / spe ser/ star sdong / tshag gur ba sogs sne'u khul gyi lha sde mi sde/ rdzong sdod dan 'bag dgos pa/ skyor lung / ra ba stod/ 'brug phyag mdzod/ zhang ston phu mda'/ lha khang pa sogs shun gtogos kyi lha sde mi sde dang bcas pas zhal dkar bteg /dga' ldan khung tha'i ji/ rwa sgreng zur pa/ khal kha ja sag thu rnams kyi mi snas gser dngul gos dar ras sogs kyi skyes phun sum tshogs pa brkyang / rigs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub kyang gral la bsgrigs/ phyi dro gra thang mkhan po/ sger pa rje drung / bo dong 'chi med sprul sku/ gong dkar da rka zhe gnyer dpon/ yang dgon/ rgyal byed tshal/ bshad sgrub gling spe ser/ skyed tshal 'og /ra ba stod/dga' ldan chos 'khor/ chos 'khor yang rtse/ chu bzang / 'od zer gling / zur ri/ gzhi ba/ glang lung /mtsho smad/ gong dkar chos sde/ kha reg sgrub sde/ bde r+ṣa chos 'khor ba/ do nang pad gling / snye mo rtse dgon/ brag ra/ dum bu chos 'khor ba rnams kyi bla ma/ brgyad gra rab stims pa/ mtshur phu phyag mdzod/ thon dmag dpon/ ge re lha pa yum sras/ dpal de dpon sa/ snye mo dgon nas/ pho brang lcam/tshag gur ba/ lhun grub rab brtan pa/ sgang pa/ ri gsum pa/ mas chags pa/ do nang mig pa/ shar phyogs pa/ sdum bu ba/ 'or pa/ nas khang steng pa/ (136ba)ri bo rnam rgyal/ sle ri/ gong dkar chos—189

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (posde sogs gra tshang khag gi gnyer pa rnams la ja gral thog brgyad gra rab 'byams par bka' 'gyur lung rgyun skor dri bshad rgyas par byung / mtshal dbus gling pa'i 'chams/ skyor lung pa/ ljangs pa/ mkhar rtse gzhung rgyug bcas glu gzhas gtsang bro sogs byas/tshes bcu bzhir se ra theg chen gling slob dpon gra bcas rag bsdus kyis skyes bzang po dang bcas yun du 'tsho ba'i bden brjod mchog gsum dpang por spyan drangs nas mdzad zhor lcang ra btsun ma'ang yod/ lha sa'i bro gzhas pa'ang snang / byams gling dang mang ra mkhan po/ gsung gling dang thod ri slob dpon/ gnas chung sngags 'chang / rab brtan shar pa/ yul ngo'i thu pā thur tha'i ji 'dam la thon gdong la byin rlabs dang / rigs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub rang gnas su 'byon par zang zing gi rdzong ba sogs bstar/ thar pa gling pas phur 'chams/ sa gnas pa/ rgyal grong pa/ glo mkhar ba/ kha ru ba/ tshal thang pa/ ljangs lcang gsar rnams kyi bro gzhas dang gtsang bro'ang mchis/tshes bco lngar thar gling bla ma/ mngon mkhyen pa/ sa pa ba/ ra ma rtse pa/ a ta gling pa sogs dang phrad/ skyar po gzhung sger/ sgar sgom chen dngos gzhi dril ba/ dpal gnas pa/ rgyang mkhar ba/ re ma ba/ shun zhol pa sogs kyi rtsed sna mang ba 'dug /tshes bcu drug la star sdong pas tshogis yon ster byin bzabs te gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang rdul (137na〉grun dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i cho ga mdzad pa'i mgron du sde pa zur pa rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ gter ston rigs 'jin chen po rnams kyang byon/ phyi dro lo rgyus las/ chos skyong rgyal por mnga' gsol ba'i mnga' thang rin chen 'bar ba yod: ces gsungs pa ltar mnga' gsol ba'i dgos pa'ang rin chen 'bar par/ stong 'khor losasgyur ba'i rgyal po'am/ sa la dbang ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ mnga' thang chos bzhin skyong ba'i rgyal po zhig la bskur du rung mnga' 'di gsol phyin chad/ de'i mnga' thang bsod nams thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin rgyas nas 'gro ba mang po'i don rgya chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang /chos khrims bstan sgron du/ rgyal po'i bka' bod kyi rgyal khams thams cad du khyab par mthong / de'i —190

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)'khor 'dus pa dang / rten 'brel shin tu bzang bas mnga' dbang bskur lags kyi gsung ngo / /der rgyal pos bod kha ba can gyi yul yig 'phrin gyis khyab par bkye nas bod 'bangs kun 'dus pa dang /zhes 'byung ba ltar gzims chung khams gsum zil gnon du nged rang dang bcas sprul sku rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pas rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i rdzas dkyil 'khor dus tshes gza' skar 'phrod dge bar mnga' dbang rin po che bskur te rgyal srid bla na ma mchis par mnga' gsol bar ma bsgrigs par dus mtshungs su gra tshang gi tshogs dung btang ba rten 'brel legs/ lo rgyus su/ bdag dang khri srong lde btsan gyis sems (137ba)bskyed smon lam 'phros 'thud nas bod kyi rje 'bangs bde skyid dar de dus blon po nag po yi sri langs snyan phra log pa'i tshig bar chad byed pa mang 'byung gis chos khrims tshugs pas skyid par 'gyur mnga' thang mtha' nas rgyas par 'gyur: rgyal bo'i mnga' thang rgyas pa yis smon lam stobs kyis bod 'bangs skyid rgyal khams bde zhing skyid par 'gyur: zhes pa'i dus la babs pa'i gnad kyis sde pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba sogs 'dir dgos pa mang ngo / /rtse dga' gzhung rgyug /khri phu pa/ drug brgya ba/ bzang mo ba/ snang rtsa ba/ byang ngos pa sogs kyis bro gzhas 'a rbams bcas bgyis/ gra tshang nas grangs bcad la ki gang gi mnan sgrub btsugs/tshes bcu bdun la phrug po che pa/ ra ma sgang / gnyis dga' ba/ za dam zhol pa/ drug brgya stod pa/ lcang lo can pa rnams kyi bro gzhas dang / khe gsum pas lha mo yid 'phrog rtses/ dus bsgrigs kyi dga' ston bzhi pa lnga pa sde bas lha sar bzhes rtsis kyi 'di gar tshes bco brgyad la rdzong sdod dra pa sogs 'phyong rgyas pa/ legs gling pa sogs pho brang pa/ snye lung pa sogs gri khu ba/ rab brtan shar pa sogs do bo rdzong / seng rdzong / dar ma/ lha khang pa bcas lho brag /'bog gong pa sogs rgyal rtse ba/dbang ldan/ g.yag sde ba/ gling dkar sogs byang rgyud/ rnam rgyal dgon pa sogs zho kha/ 'or (138na)ba sogs phag ri ba/ shag byang pa sogs jo mo rdzong / bde gling pa sogs rgya mda' ba/ na kha blo bzang sogs rin spungs pa/ lhun rtse ba/ mtsho sna rdzong sdod/ sne'u sdong sogs kyis bdog pa'i skyes yul —191—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (7)lugs dang bstun pa bteg /sger du 'phyong rgyas ri bo bde chen/ spyan g.yas/ thang po che/ jo stan/ sde drug rnams kyi mkhan spyi/ rgyal sras shes 'phel ba/ dhi tsha/ thugs sras/ sbyor ra rnams kyi sprul sku/gnas rnying zhabs drung / gnas gsar dpon rin po che/ brag sna/ chos ldan pa/ rtsa sgrub sde/ rgyang ro gser sdings/ mdo sngags gling / 'on dgon gong / smra bo lcog /bkra shis chos gling / kong rme phu/chab nag /rtse le/ sang sing rnams kyi bla ma/ bkra shis bde chen/ lam rim pa/ chos 'khor steng /dpal ri ba/ mnga' ris gra tshang / ri bo chos gling / mdong mkhar chos sde rnams kyi gnyer pa/ rgya ri zhabs drung / shag lho byang / bya ba yab sras/ 'bog gong khag /gdang pa/ gri khu phyag mdzod/ sbang che ba/ ge ra ba sogs sde dpon bla ma nang nam drung 'bor/ rdzong sdod/ gzhis gnyer/ bon po ri shing ba sogs mang dag dang mjal phrad/ rtser sne'u sdong bdag mo/ blo bzang mgon po rab brtan dang bsod nams dbang rgyal 'dam la thon gdong gi ja gral/ dgon gsar/ rkang pa/ tshal po gzhung sgar gyisabro gzhas dang / (138ba〉nil grong rdor bas 'brong rtsed bstar/tshes bcu dgur lha sar thog mar bteg dus khri 'bul sogs kyi dus sgrigs shig yod pa rten 'brel legs par go ste sde pa chibs rags shin tu bzabs mchor dang bcas lha sar bteg /ltad mo'i dus bcu bzhi pa snye thang bkra shis sgang pa'i 'chams nas bzung nyer bzhi pa bde chen pa'i bro gzhas bar rnam grangs mang ba lha sar bstan/ zhogs gur sngon gyi dge skosang ga dbang rgyal po dang dbu mdzad dge legs kyi ngor phyag bzhi pa dang rdor legs kyi gtor bsngo 'byer bde/ gra rigs rnams kyis bskul ba'i slob dpon ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi gsol 'debs/ dbang chen rnam sprul thugs sras zla ba bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes 'di ga'i bris thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /thar gling slob dpon pa'i ngor nged rang dang sde pa'i ring 'tsho/ gnas chung chos skyong chen pos gsung 'phrin mdzad pa'i khyab 'jug sogs chos skyong kha shas kyi gsol mchod tshig nyung don tshang / su dhi'i ngor gsol 'debs/ sgo mang zur pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyis dga' ldan dam chos gling du 'dzugs rgyur —/92

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)skye bar rjes 'dzin gyi smon lam/ sde pas lha sa dang ra mo che so so'i lha khang du 'bul rgyu'i snyan shal kha byang / snying tig gi rtogs pa mngon gyur khams pa rdzogs chen pa pad+ma rigs 'dzin gyi yig lan snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa/ lha zhabs drung dga' ldan phun tshogs kyis bskul ma mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs/ mkhan chen ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi zhal 'don gsol 'debs ja mchod/ (139na)gnyis gar bsgyur chog pa/ mchod dpon pas gser zangs kyi nged rang gi 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i kha byang / bya skal bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa 'khrul med gter zhes pa bya pa khri dpon rgyal po bkra shis kyis par du brkos pa'i smon lam rnams bris/ tsha rong ba ga 'one pa/ dkar brag dbon po/ 'bras spungs dge skos gsar pa bcas par byin rlabs/ dmag zor tshangs dbang la gdon 'grol dang byab khrus bgyis/ pa nam thar pa ngag dbang 'od zer gyis dus 'khor bsdus rgyud/blo bzang dang ngag dbang dpal ldan gnyis kyis bsdus rgyud dang brtag gnyis kyi rgyugs/ sman thang pa mgon po tshe ring rgyun sdod drung 'khor la zhugs/ tshes nyi shur ri bo bde chen/ bzang ldan/ sku rab dga' ldan rab brtan gsum gyi mkhan po/ bsam grub dgon/ sgro khyung dgon/ don gnyis gling / spu brag /rtse le/ thang khrog rnams kyi bla ma/ no mun khan gyi mi sna/ srad rin chen rtse pa/ bkra shis mthong smon pa rnams la ja gral dang / dbon rin po che sku rkyang la drag dmar gyi bsnyen pa'i dmigs rim rgyas par phul/nyer gnyis la sde pa lha pa sku mched sde pa lhun po rtse pa yab sras gsum/ sna dkar rtse lcam sring gnyis/ 'bog gong mkhar ltag pa/ 'dar pa ngag dbang 'phrin las dang ngag dbang mkhyen brtse/mkhar ldan pa gzhon pa rnams la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma dang (139ba)rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang byas/ lhun po rdzong pa'i sras la mtshan ngag dbang dpal 'bar dang / sras mo dge bsnyen du bsgrubs/chos rje dung dgon pa/ chu mig pa/ ri bo bde chen gnyer pa rnams dang phrad/ zhang ston sku mdun lhun grub/ gnas chud sku rten pa/ pang do bo mgo'i bla ma/ ngag dbang bzod pa sogs la ja gral dang / dbu —193—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pomadzad dam chos dbang rgyal sogs gra tshang gi gra pa brgyad/ gnas chung sku rten pa gsol kha ba dang bcas par gsol mchod 'khyer bde'i lung bklags/nyer gsum la lha sa dgos nor gyis tshan grangs kyi skyes 'gyed dang bcas gra tshang nas mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i ring 'tsho mdzad/ lha sa ba dud lnga rer ya ju bar khag re'i rtsis khor drug ma lnga bcu song / rtse tshogs mkhan chen rgyal sras sher 'phel ba dang 'od mchog sprul sku/ sang sing / dar rgyas gling / shel brag gsum gyi bla ma/ mes ston pa/ 'tsho byed gzhan phan/ bsam dar ba/ phu lung pa sogs la byin rlabs bgyis/ phyi dro rdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku dang lugs gnyis kye gsung ji snyed byung zhing skyes lan bzabs te rang gnas su bskyod/ nyer bzhin rtse gdong phyag mdzod/ bzhad chos pa/ rgya rgan pa/ khroms pa/ nas khang steng pa/ rang byon pa/ sdings chen pa/ ldan ma ba rnams la ja gral/nyer lngar lha pa zhabs drung yab sras/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po/ dar rgyas gling slob dpon sogs la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / de thog skyed (140na〉khyer mkhan po/ nub dgon bla ma rnams dang phrad/ nyer drug la sa skya phyag mdzod pas ring 'tsho'i legs skyes spel/ thub bstan yangs can dang ngor mkhan po/ grong smad dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mo/ la stod ri bo che pa/ gnyal snang grong dang gur rin sdings bla ma/ da'i ching kho lo che'i mi sna rnams dang phrad/ dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mo zangs rir 'gro ba'i gegs sel du bka' bsgo/ 'phel gdung sogs byin rten/ gser srang gsum gyis gtsos dgu tshan bcas rdzong bda'/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po/ zha lu'i mkhan por 'degs gdong 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ khro phu bla ma snyan grags rgya mtsho/ mtsho sna gdong pa sogs bsnyen rdzogs gsar rnying sum cu/ grub dbang sku skye sogs dge tshul bco brgyad bsgrubs/ nyer brgyad la dga' ston drug par 'dar pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse sogs gzhis rtse/ ram pa ba sogs gting skyes/ mnga' thang pa sogs pa nam/ rnam gling / 'dus byung / lha bu/ rgya tsho sogs rdzong gzhis lha sde mi sde rnams kyis zhal dkar bteg /sger du ngor/ yangs can/ thub bstan/ gser —194

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)mdog can gyi mkhan po/ gsang 'ug gnyis/ sgrol ma ba/ 'dar pa/ tsha rong pa/ glang phu ba/ 'jun pa/jo rdzong pa/ rgya rgan pa/ zur spe ba/ dga' ldan chos 'khor/ zha lu ba/ khro phu ba'i bla ma rnams la byin rlabs/ nyer dgur 'bras spungs su mchod rten gnyis kyi (140ba〉skrub khag mnan pa brgyab/ rgyud smad pa dang / gsas khang pa la so sos bdog pa'i skyes dang bcas ring por 'tsho ba'i bden brjod gsungs/ myug cho so gling dang me rag bla gnyer/ lcang ra ba'i btsun ma/ sgrol ma ba khu tshan/ bsam yasadakar po ba pha bu/ gon jo dbu mdzad/ lhun grub gling pa/ byang ngos pa khyo shugs kyis dkar dro bteg par ja gral/ rta nag la bskyon pa'i glud che bar rdzongs su nged rang gis bsngos shing phyi dro rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pas 'chi bdag bzlog pa'i cho ga mdzad/ gnam gang la 'tsho byed ngag dbang lhag bsam gyis dngos po'i skyes 'gyed bcas sbyar te gra tshang gis gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa dang / gung gi dror sde pa zangs ri blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khri ston rgyas par bshams pa'i mgron du sde zur blo bzang sbyin pa/ bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po/ dpon chung dang bcas pa/ gter ston rigasa'adzin chen po/ rgyun sdod drung 'khor thog /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus mtha' bzhi'i las sgo dang rgyal po rgyal phran thams cad dbang du 'dus pa'i rten 'brel ltar sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i las shugs btsan pos khams kyi rgyal rigs ma lus pa rang dbang med par dbang du 'du ba'i sngon 'gror stod ya rtse rgyal po'i rigs ma nyams pa bram ze lta bu gtsang sbra dang rgyal po'i spyod pa dang mtshungs pa dzum lang na ra sidha 'khor bcas mdo dar sogs rol mo'i bye brag dang bcas te 'byor/ 'on kyang sngon chad rgya dzu sogs phal pa mang ba las rgyal po bteg ma myong ba dang phyi (141na)nang thun mong las phyi pa shas che ba 'dug pa bod rjes 'brang gi srung ma 'dra'i cho 'phrul yin nam de nyin ser chol dang 'brug sgra che zhing shing sdong la khyug sogs 'tshub nyams che/ blon po sam dho ge /ba man gha ja pa ti pra ma dar/ a ri dha ral/ rgyal phran tu ru can gnyis sogs dpon g.yog thams cad kyis mon dar/ rasacha/ me mda'/ gri mdung / bye gar/ bu ram/ rta sogs yul lugs dang mthun pa'i bdog pa dngul —195—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khorasrang brgyar bskor ba bstab/ lha khang pa rdo rje nor bu dang / mig pa ngag dbang gis gral los byas/dbyangs 'char snyan ngag sogs rig byed kyi gzhung mtha' dag dzum lang du dar so che tshul ltar rig byed dang 'phral gyi 'bel gtam sogs la sgo yangs pa'i rnam dpyod can du 'dug /lha sar 'gor ring 'dar lo dang phan tshun rig byed la 'phros gleng byung bar mthong rgya dang shes rab tshul ldan 'dug ces gleng /hor zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig la g.yon ru dga' ldan hung tha'i jis dngos po spams bstod de gra pa bcu gcig gis ring 'tsho'i cho ga bstar/ gung tshigs la tshoms chen du bkra shis lhun po'i mchog sprul dpon slob rags bsdus kyis gser dngul ja gos dar gnang cha bzang po dang bcas mjal/ nye 'khor ba'i steng 'bog gong pa sogs sde dpon chung kha/ 'brong rtse rgyal phur/ mda' dpon gsum/ 'tsho byed g.yin phan/ bla mkhyen ngag dbang so gos bsgrigs shing rol cha ba med pa'i gral 'phros 'dar rnam gyis mol/ rgyal phur rab brtan/ (141ba tsher tsho rgyal gling pa/ brag gdong pa/ rgyang ro gser sdings dang snye nang 'phel gling slob dpon/ sgog mkhar pa/ phug pa ba/ mda' thang pa/ na kha blo bzang sogs dang phrad/ rmotshes gnyis la rgyud stod slob dpon gra bcas kyis zang zing gi tshan grangs bteg nas bden brjod dbyangs su mdzad/ brag dkar chu bzang bla ma byams pa rin chen gshegs pa'i bsngo rten slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i gter sku/ se ston nyi ma bzang po'i dbu thod/ gter bum/ paṇa chen shāka mchog pa'i phyag dril kye rdo rje'i dbang gi dus mkhar bzhag pa rwa la phyag rjes yod par grags pa/mnyam med nub dgon pa'i sku brnyan chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi rab gnas ma/ gser mgur zho sum cu/ ber yol gyis gtsos pa'i dgu tshan dgu brkyang bar sal ma gyi bar gcod zhi zhing 'gro don rgya cher 'byung ba'i bsngo smon gyi rgyas btab pas dngos po chud mi za bar gyur ram snyam rung sems dug gsum gyi sgrib pa shas che bas things dka'/ ru thog dbang po/ bde gling gzhen pa/ brag dkar —/96

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)chu bzang bla ma byed rgyu'i gong ma'i phyag mdzod gra bcas la ja gral/ phyi dro bkra shis lhun po'i gsol dpon/ dge slong rnam rgyal/ mgron gnyer dga' chen/rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bskang gsob/ sho pa bsam sdings pa/ dga' ldan hung tha'i ji'i mi sna thon gdong rnams la byin rlabs bgyis/tshes gsum la bkra shis lhun po'i mchog sprul dpon g.yog la ja gsum bar mol mchid rgyas par byung ba'i bsdebs su lcags la (142na)rab 'byams pa/ 'bras spungs dge skos rnying pa gnyis yod/ sgyid thang nor bus dkar dro bteg cing phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i rten 'byor don bzhin bsngo smon yang dag byas/ tshes bzhir dga' ston bdun par bkra shis lhun po'i phyag mdzod lde chung pa thon pa rje drung / phug pa ba sogs rnam rgyal lha rtse/ tsha mig pa sogs shel dkar/ sgog mkhar ba sogs ngam ring / sbyar ra ba sogs rdzong dga'/ mes srong pa sogs skyid grong / khang ser btsun pa sogs phun gling / byang stag rtse/ glo bo/ snye nang sogs kyi rdzong gzhis mnga' 'og /dge legs dpal ldan dang glang ra ba sogs nag chu kha ba/ er khe da'i ching sogs mtsho kha'i mi sna rnams kyis zhal dkar spams mthor bteg /sger du ngam ring dang bzang ldan mkhan po/ chu mig pa/ ri bo che ba/ sman sdings/ ne ring / yag chos/ zem mkhar rnams kyi bla ma/ phug pa/ 'dar pa ngag dbang 'phrin las/ bde gling pa/ lha bdun pa/ mtsho snga smad pa/ nan phu ba/ mtsho dbar pa/ gling shar pa/ spang la ba/ gda' gdong ba/ sgog mkhar ba/ khri mkhar pa/ khang ser ma/ mes srong pa/ skyid khang pa/ sgrol skyabs/ ra spe ba/ lha ri rtse pa/ ka drug pa/ ka spe ba/ lhug pa/ gle lung pa/mtshal mig pa/ shel dkar chos sde'i bla dbon/ brag dkar chu bzang bla chab/ bsam grub dga' ldan gnyer pa (142bskoms la ja gral dang / rtser bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po 'dam la 'degs gdong gi 'khor bcas khod ma gcig rnams la mjal kha dang / yab sras gsum gar drag dmar gyi bka' bsgo rgyas par phul/ dga' ldan hung tha'i ji'i mi sna gsar 'byor gyi yi ge rten sgrags blangs shing ngag ma huXb tu nyan/—197

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (7)tshes lngar ru thog dbang po/ mtsho sgo ba'i dpon sa/ ā tsa smre dha ṇi/ 'tsho byed ra phu na sogs dang phrad/ tshes drug la sprul pa'i sku blo bzang ye shes dpon g.yog dang ja gsum gyi bar chos srid kyi gleng mo 'brel chags byung / bzang ldan mkhan po/ sgar gra tshang dang ya ga chos sdings slob dpon par ja gral grol nas mkhan por bka' bsgo/ tshes bdun la ngam ring mkhan po/ lha rtse chos sde bla zur/ chos rje chu mig pa bsam grub sgang pa'i nang mi sogs la byin rlabs/ chos 'khor yang rtse ba dka' bcu blo bzang / bshes gnyen gyis mdzod rtsa 'grel dang / dka' bcu blo bzang chos 'phel gyis dbu ma rtsa 'grel gyi sbyo/gas sprad/tshes brgyad la mchog sprul blo bzang ye shes dpon slob nyi shu skor/ rta tshag rje drung ngag dbang dkon mchog nyi ma/ sems dpa' sprul sku ngag dbang phun tshogs/ ngam ring mkhan po ngag dbang 'od zer/ byang rtse chos rje blo gros rgya mtsho/ pha bong gdan sa pa chos rje ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ shangasadage 'phel mkhan po/ thang sag zur pa mdo sde rgya mtsho/ slob dpon pa shag skor zur pa blo bzang mgon po/ sgo mang pa don grub rgya mtsho/ sngags pa blo bzang 'jam dpal/ shag skor (143na)ba ngag dbang don grub/ blo gsal gling pa legs pa don grub/ 'dul ba pa blo bzang dga' ldan/ rgyal pa chos lhun grub/ bde yangs pa blo bzang yon tan/ khal kha dza ya paṇ+ḍita khu thug thu/ tre bo dpon blo bzang chos skyong /spos dga' sku skye ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mer gan dge slong ngag dbang blo gros/ drug brgyad dge slong blo bzang dkon mchog /lhos pa sku skye bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtsho/ gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs/ rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags/ 'dar pa rje drung blo gsal bstan 'dzin sogs la zur bka' jo bo a ti sha'i thugs dam gyi snying po bka' gdams lha bzhi dang sman bla bde gshegs bdun mtho brtsegs kyi rjes gnang / phyi dro thar gling zur pa/ spong rong rje dbon gyi bu/ yul jo'i thu pā thur tha'i ji'i mi bzang mtsho kha nas gsar 'byor dang phrad/—/98—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)tshes dgur chos gsan snga ma'i steng skyor lung mkhan po sgang gu ba ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ slob dpon phug khang pa blo gros rnam rgyal/ khyams pa blo bzang dngos grub/ mtshan nyid pa blo bzang dpal 'byor/rmi ru ba rin chen rgya mtsho/ spu brag pa ngag dbang rgya mtsho sogs la bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs gtso rkyang / paṇ+ḍi ta gser gdugs can gyi 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'khor lo/ rnam 'joms ljang sngon ba ri lugs/ gur nas bshad pa'i 'byung po (143ba)'dul byed/ dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo rnams kyi rjes gnang grub nas chab nag mkhan po'i bsngo rten bskyar ma skyel mi dang nub dgon pa bla ma sogs la ja gral btang /tshes bcur gong steng kong po bkra shis rab brtan gyi mkhan po/ de mo dang zem mkhar bla ma/ me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho/ sde pa mdong mkhar ba bcas par klu dbang rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga pa/ mi g.yo ba sngon po gtso rkyang pus btsugs sam chu srung / mi g.yo ba sngon po dam pa'i phyag len 'khrul med/mi g.yo ba dkar po/ gur rgyan nas bshad pa'i so sor 'brang ma'i rjes gnang rnams/ tshes bcu gcig la gong steng gangs can mkhan po dkon mchog rin chen/ chos rje rgyal ba'i sku skye ngag dbang 'phrin las bcas par snye mdo shākya dpal ba'i zhal gzigs ma'i phyag na rdo rje'i me dbang dang bcas pa spe brtsegs ljang gu jo lugs/ dud ka sa lugs/ 'od zer can gtso rkyang zur bka'/ rta nag lcagasaral can zla rgyal lugs rnams kyi rjes gnang / dpon tshang nam mkha' rgyal tshan dang mig par bka' bsgo bgyis/ tshes bcu gnyis la gong steng rgyal sras shes rab 'phel ba'i sprul sku/ slob dpon ser smad pa blo bzang don grub/ byes pa blo bzang bkra shis/ stod pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan bcas par rta mgrin shwa ṇa bzhis bskor shin tu rgyas pa/ jo bo lugs kyi dzam dkar 'brug zhon/ dzam ser nag zur bka'/ chag lo gsum pa lugs kyi gtsug tor 'bar ba'am sreg byed me'i mtshon cha/ rgya mtsho'i nang gi dbyangs can dmar mo zhal gsum pa rnams kyi rjes gnang dang / (144na po ge slong dar khan nang so sogs la byin rlabs/ tshes bcu gsum la gong steng 'phags sde mkhan po dang nyi thang slob dpon —199—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('a'aphar bcas la jo bo lugs kyi rta mgrin gshog pa can/ paṇa chen nags rin lugs kyi seng gdong dmar mo dang ba ri lugs kyi sngon mo/ spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra rnams kyi rjes gnang dang / slar sprul pa'i sku dpon g.yog gsum/ rta tshag rje drung / sher 'phel/ sems dpa'/ dkar lcog /spos dga'/ skyid shod rnams kyi sprul sku/ ngam ring / rgyal/ skyor lung / gangs can/ byang rtse/ 'phags sde/dge 'phel rnams kyi mkhan po/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ dar mo sman rams pa/ 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtsho/ dar po rje drung blo bsal bstan 'dzin rnams la 'jam dbyangs smra seng / phyag rdor u tsar ya me dbang dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang / ngam ring dang 'phags sde mkhan po/ gzhis rtse las byed gsar pa sogs thon gras/ g.yon ru'i mi sna rjes slebasarnams dang phrad cing thon/tshes bcu bzhir sde pa blo bzang sbyin pas gos sna cha tshang / ding pon dbu khebs ma/ bum gdan ma/ gser dngul gos dar sogs dang gra pa rer kha btags/ gser zho/ sman kha re bcas gya nom pa mdzad de gra tshang gis gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa spel/ tsher gseb dgon pa bas kyang cho ga dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho bstar/ sne'u sdong zhabs drung yab sras gnyis (144ba tshe pa bkur rmobazos sngar bzhin phul zhing ja sbyor gsum gyi bar gsung gleng zhib tu mol/ phyi dro dzum lang rgyal po 'bor bcas/ jo rig thu er khe da'i ring / rgyal sras bkra shis/ dpon tshe ring gi dpon mo/ bsod nams hung tha'i ji gsum bu bcas/ tho gol can ngo bo bdun/ dar rgan nang so/ thor god dge tshul sgrol ma/ dge 'dun sgrom ma/ klu 'bum chos rje/ nyang po glang sa snye phu dgon phyogs kyi bla ma gsum/shag byang pa sogs la ja gral gyi thog dzum lang rgyal por rgya bal gyi dri ba dri bshad mang du byung / bod sog a mdo pa sum brgya skor la me tog gtor/ tshes bco lngar mchog gi sprul pa'i skus dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/tshe dpag med kyi sku/ rung mthun gyi gos cha 'grig gser dngul gos dar spams mtho/ gra pa rer kha btags/ dngul srang re/ gos kha re dang bcas tshe dpag med longs sku ma'i rdul tshon gyi sgrub mchod —200

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)sngon 'gror bsun bzlog rgyas pa dang 'brel ba'i rten 'byung legs pa'i mgron du dzum lang rgyal po'ang byon/tshes bcu drug la sgrub zhag bdun sngon song gi rdor slob chos rje zil gnon rdo rjes tshe bdag dang / dge slong blo gros rgyal bas yang gsang drag po'i gtor bzlog gis bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal/ sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pa'i nyams len du bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang gi sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum pa sgrub thabs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor nye gnas gsung rab rgya mtsho dang 'dra bar gdams pa/ bod 'bangs bde thabs su thugs sgrub kyi (145na〉pas byang rgyas pa zhig gra tshang du 'dzugs 'dod kyang dge dar ba sogs kyi mi bsrun sgyu dra sna tshogs kyis 'dzugs ma bde bar bzo can gyi bsre slad med par drag po rtsal gyi 'phrin las 'bring po'i chog sgrigs rin chen 'phreng ba/ sde pa sangs rgyas mtsho'i gtan tshigs rim song / deb kyi 'go brjod/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan chen ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis bskul ma mdzad pa'i bsngo tshig /mchog sprul blo bzang ye shes kyi gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs dang 'brel ba/ thos bsam gling spyi tshogs kyi ngor slob dpon bde gshegs snying po'i gsol 'debs rnams bkod/ tshes bco brgyad nas nyer bzhi'i bar mchog sprul dpon slob rags bsdus/ rta tshag rje drung / sher 'phel/ sems dpa'/ dkar lcog /spos dga' ste sprul sku bzhi/ gangs can/ dge 'phel/ skyor lung ste mkhan po gsum/ 'bras spungs/ se ra/ skyor lung gsum gyi slob dpon bzhi re/ nyi thang / thang sag zur pa/ yang dgon/ rme sa 'phel gling / spu brag /bkra shis chos gling / zem mkhar/ me rag /klu 'bum/ spong 'bor/ bsam blo/ dga' ldan chos 'khor/ stag lung / 'phyos pa/ lha rtse zur pa ste slob dpon dang sku skye/ tre bo dpon/ mer gan dge slong / drug brgya dge slong / skyid grong 'phags pa'i sku gnyer/ mchod dpon pa/ dge slong / dpal grong pa/ 'jam bstan/ rnam paṇa/ 'dar pa rje drung sogs drung 'khor rags bsdus (145ba)brgya skor la jo lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang / dge lugs nas brgyud pa'i snying po don gsum —201—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pogyi 'khrid smin rgyas/ sne'u sdong ma chen la ja gnyis thog lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i gsung 'phros dang phyag drug pa'i bka' bsgo/ skyes len bzabs par dbul te sti gnas su thegs/nyer gnyis la sne'u sdong gdung brgyud la'ang shangs len bka' bsgo phul/ drug la bla zur dang /chab nag dbon po'ang sdebs su yod/ nyer gsum la mchog sprul/ rta tshag rje drung / sems sprul/ dpal grong pa bcas par dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang thun mong ba dang / mchog sprul/ sher 'phel sprul sku/dpal grong pa/ la mo sku rten bcas par dpal mgon bram nag bshan pa drug skor gyi rjes gnang /lcang ra zil gnon par bka' bsgo/ nyer bzhir chos grol ba'i spyir chag lugs tshe dpag med dkar po'i rjes gnang dang mchog gi sprul sku'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs lung / mchog sprul la ma ti lugs kyi 'jam dkar zab khyad can gyi rjes gnang phul/ da lam mchog sprul gyis dbus/ bla chen/slob chung / shes rab che gras 'gar spyi bka' ltar ma yin par zur bka'/ rang rang gzhung nas mi skad bshad pa bzhin la gsung rgyun gyis brgyan te dril ting rol mo'i bye brag tshun kyang ma 'dres par phul ba bstan rgyun la phan re kho na yin pa thams cad kyis kun go gcig gis bcad pa'i dogs bder ma song ba yod dam snyam/ 'on kyang dus dbang gis 'chad nyan byed pa po rnams (146na)kyang 'phral thoyun gyi nyes dmigs la lta ba dkon pa'i las sla zhing ltogs pa snying la 'khar ba'i rang nor bdag len 'di rang gzhan la 'byung nye ba'i chu ngan lam zhugs su ma gyur tsam yong re yin/ sde pa blo bzang sbyin pa/ rogs byed/ gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas bcas par bla ma bde chen dbang phyug dang / drag dmar gyi dbang / bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang tshan seng ldeng nags sgrol gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang dang de'i sgrub thabs gsar brtsoms/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ rdor sems sgom bzlas rnams kyi lung / rgyal sras bsod nams bkra shis mtsho khar 'degs gdong gi ster cha bka' bsgo/ mtsho kha nas gsar 'byor dpon rdo rje'i bu tshe brtan 'khor bcas/ chos lar pa dge slong 'phrin las/ 'phel gling slob dpon bcas la ja gral/ stod phyogs bstan srid la rgya'i gegs sel la sngags khang du rgyud stod pas —202

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)ya ma rā dza dang drug cu pa/ smad pas shā san dang glo bur las bcol gyi gtor bzlog /mnga' ris kyi jus rim du dge lugs ang dang gnyis yan gyi sngags gra rnams kyis gtor bzlog /bshad gra rnams kyis mdo sgrub/ ser 'bras su ja tshul btsugs te mdo sgrub 'phar ma/ gong dkar du rdo rje brag pas mgon po g.yul bzlog dang ki gang gi dgra mnan/ dkon gnyer bas gdugs dkar mdos chen/sngags pa gnas chung pas urmo'i las sbyor/ pho brang du smin gling pas dregs 'joms gtor bzlog dang gi gang dgra mnan/ (146ba tshe ro1nga rgyas su dpal ri bas gshin rje nag po sum dril gyi gtor bzlog dang dgra mnan/ lha sar gsang sngags byang chub gling pas tshe bdag gi gtor bzlog dang ki gang gi dgra mnan/ mal dro gung mkhar du spo bo ban grong pas khro chu'i gtor bzlog /rgyal rtser brag la pas 'char ga'i glang chen sna bsgyur dang ki rkang gi dgra mnan/ rin spungs su nges gsang rdor gling pas bzlog mnan gong mtshungs/ 'od mchog sprul pa'i skus yang gsang ga rma drag po'i gtor bzlog dang ki dang gi dgra mnan/ gzhis rtser 'ug bya lung pas mgon po g.yul bzlog dang ki gang gi dgra mnan/ sgrol ma bas tshe bdag gtor bzlog dang dgra mnan/ do rdzong du smra bo lcog pas 'char spu'i mdos dang dgra mnan/ ka tshal du rigs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub kyis yang bzlog dang dgra mnan/ 'ol dgar brag sna bas lor ka dang dgra mnan/ bkra bzang du rang gras khro rol dang dgra mnan/ dar mar gnas gzhi bas 'char ka dang dgra mnan/ lha rtser chu mig pas phur bzlog dang dgra mnan/ ngam ring du mes ston pa brgya mkhar ba/ kyi ston pa gsum so so nas tshe bdag gtor bzlog dang dgra mnan/ byang stag rtse nub dgon che ba/ chung ba/ don grub gling so sos tshe bdag gi gtor bzlog dang gi gang gi dgra mnan/ so sor rgyab chos pas sher snying drug 'bum bzhi khri brgyad stong /chos 'khor rgyal pa khag gsum gyis drug cu pa/ dmag zor ma/ beg tse gsum gyi gtor bzlog /rgyab chos tshogs chen du mang ja gsum la sher snying / gong dkar du chos sde ba/ pho brang du bkra shis rtse chos sde ba gnyis kyis dmar chen gtor bzlog /chos skyong (147na sgom gnyis kyi lung bstan jus ma du —203—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pochu mig lung du rgyud smad pas drug cu pa dang gra sa phan tshun du ja tshul thog sher snying dang gdugs dkar/gnas chung du zla phyed bar 'phrin las don bcu ma 'gro gang che/ rdzong che rigs tshang ma nas yar ngor dgra lha dpangs bstod/ nged kyi rim gror lha sar brag dbar bas bka' 'gyur gsum/ rtse shod thun mong du rgyud 'bum gsum/ dpal gsol brgya tshar/ gzungs sa chig brgya nyer gnyis sgrol ma nyis stong chig brgya/ sher snying dgu brgya/ tshe gzungs bzhi brgya/ 'bum rgyas pa bcu gcig /rgyal du dmag zor ma'i bskang ba khri/ beg tser stong / gzhan mar brgya re/ pa nam du mtshan sgrog pas gdug dkar sher snying khri re/ tshe gzungs sa ya/ sprel lo'i sri la dmigs rgyal rtser dpal 'khor chos sde'i dge lugs tsho bsdus kyis 'bum brgya/ dbus gtsang gi dgon adhi gsum pa yan tshang mar mang 'gyed thog gdugs sher 'gro gang che/ gra tshang nas grangs bcad kyis sri rigs thams cad mnan pa 'byung ba rin chen kun 'dus dang dgongs 'dus thun mong nas gnon bcug /lha sar bde yangs pas brgyad stong pa tshig stong bzhi brgya nyer gcig /sgrol ma lnga stong sum brgya gdugs dkar nyis stong / sher snying phyed lnga stong / nyer lngar sde pa zur pa blo bzang sbyin par bdog pa'i skyes bzang dang bcas sne'u sdong rtse phyogs su byon/ bkras lhun phyag mdzod thon pa rje drung bsko rgyu'i sngon 'gror bdog pa'i skyes(147ba)thobastab pa blangs shing zhabs phyir gang 'gyur dgos tshul sogs kyi bslab bya/ mdud pa/ sham thabs/rdul gzan byin cing bka' bsgo byas/ gung tshigs kyi thog mchog sprul blo bzang ye shes dpon g.yog la ston mo rgyas par dbul nas na bza' skor cha chang / dngul mdong / lte ri/ tha phag zhal dpyad/gos dar snam phrug ja ras sogs skyes lan spam mthor bteg /dpon chung tho gol thon gdong gi bka' bsgo/ gsar 'byor khal kha dha ra dpon gyi mi sna sbi lig thu nang so/ dharma shri khung tha'i ji'i mi sna er khe nang so can/ a yo dha ra'i mi sna shri bha ra nang so can sogs kyi yi ge rten sbrags blangs/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ ge re lha pa'i sras/ lnga mchod bla zur/ ltar bu dang klungs shod dgon bla ma/ lha rtse bla mar 'gro mi rab 'byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ la mo sku rten pa nang tshang / mon pa dpal 'byor don grub/—2slo

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gnas rnying lcam sogs la ja gral/ ge re lha pa'i sras kyi gtsug phud blangs shing mtshan lha ngag dbang kun dga' rab brtan du gsol/ rnam sras gling pa pha bur bka' bsgo bgyis/nyer drug la rgyal tshab sprul pa'i skus bkras btags/ bla bre bum stan ma sogs skyes kyi bdog pa brkyang zhing / sku mched kyis gtsos brgyad grar tshe dbang grub rgyal ma phul/ mang ra dang shangs dge 'phel mkhan po/ phun gling bla zur/ rme sa nyi thang / gting skyes bkra shis chos gling / spu brag rnams kyi bla ma/ che chen rab stims pa spun rnams dang phrad/ (148na)thu med da rgan no yon gyi bsngo rten 'byor par byang chub kyi rgyur bsngos/ bsnyen rdzogs bskyar ba dang gsar bcas dgu/ rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku'i gcung dge tshul du shi bsgrubasang mtshan ngag dbang chos grags rgya mtshor btags/nyer bdun la lha rtse chos sde'i bla mar 'gro mi rdo rje rgyal mtshan sogs so drug la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phab/ nyer brgyad la mchog sprul blo bzang ye shes chibs bsgyur gdong gi mjal khar gser gyi maṇ+ḍal steng gser srang gang gi tshom bu dang bcas bskal brgyar 'tsho dgos pa'i bka' mchid phebs par de 'dun byed cing sku na gzhen skabs thugs gnyer la brtson dgos pa sogs lugs gnyis kyi khyab cha gang che dgos pa'i snyan sgron dang bka' bsgo srung mdud phul nas dal 'gros kyis gtsang stod bla ma'i gdan sar gshegs/ blo bzang mgon po rab brtan sogs sum brgya skor la ja gral dang / zhang ston ri khrod par phyi nang gi skad cha du ma 'dug pa nyan par la lar dgod bro ba dang la lar nyam nga ba'ang snang / phreng ba 'di rang cag zhwa ser cod pan can mtha' dag gi bstan pa'i bdag po chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen pos zha lu pa gong gsum bde chen chos kyi dpal bar gsan pa nas thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i bar dang khyad par sngags rams pa dge 'dun bkra shis zhes rdo rje 'a zang dang gnyis su med pa de nyid kyang phreng ba'i yig mjog dang dbang chu dar rgyas shin tu che ba'i rgyun rang gis e thob snyam 'bad pa chen pos btsal kyang rnam dag gi rgyun ming tsam yang ma rnyed par brten gnas gsar rigs (148ba)kun khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog —205

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (7)ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por nos pa sngags rams pa can zhu bcug dus/ dgos pa smos pa ltar ma chad tsam 'byung res rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pas gzhung lugs mang por thos pas gtan la phab pa sngags rams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang gis 'dzam gling rgyan rgyur dpal ldan 'bras spungs dang / sngags rams pa blo bzang skyes mchogo gis se ra theg chen gling gi gnyug mar gnas pa dang phyogs 'dus kyi sprul sku gra slob mang por phreng ba zhe lnga ma'i sta gon nas/ dngos gzhi/mjug gi bar chad lhag med par dbul ba'i rogs yo byad mtha' dag gzhung nas gra bsgrigs te thon/ chos rje bkra bzang pa thugs mchog 'od 'bar la zang zing gi dngos po dang bka' bsgo sogs re ba bkang / gra thang pa chos rab 'byor gyis dus 'khor cho ga lo chen chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i rgyugs sprad/ bdun gcig gi bar rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen pa kha gso'i dge sbyor la 'grus par bgyis/ rgya can gyi dbang lung rnams gra pa re gnyis kyis mchod dpon par dgos tshul labs pa rgya grol sngas par dgos pa che bar ma mthong yang nan cher byung ba sprul sku gter bdag gling pa rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling yongs rdzogs la mdzad du bcug /hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bzhir thod ri bshad sgrub gling pa blo bzang dga' bas mdzod rtsa 'grel gyi dzergyugs byung / ches lngar bcad rgya grol ba'i dpon tshe ring gis tshan grangs 'gyed yon sbyar (149na)te gra tshang nas mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sgo nas ring 'tsho'i cho ga chung ba bstar/ sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos nged dang sde pa lhan cig byad 'grol mdzad/ bye rdzing tshogs mkhan po/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan zur/ tre bo sku skye/ byang chub gling dang kong po bla ru dgon bla ma/ rme ru bla gsar/ shag lho pa pha bu/ 'phags pa lha'i dbon po/ nag tshang sde smad dpon kun dga'/ bar ta blo bzang / mon pa dpal 'byor don grub/ gdung nag po/ a mdo rta 'bul ba sogs bod sog nyis brgya/ yong sdud la thon mi drung 'khor lnga bcu skor/ blo bzang mgon po rab brtan ming sring / da'i ching kho lo che'i tsha bo spun sogs kyi ngo bor byin rlabs dang dmangs la me tog gtor/ de'i ching kho lo che can la ster cha bka' bsgo dang —206

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)bcas thon/ shag lho pha bu/ btsun ma/ chos rje bkra bzang pa/ gra tshang gnyer pa rnams la tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster bskur/ 'dar pa khu tshan/ rnam gling paṇa chen/ rgyal skor ba/ dpal gling btsun pa rnams la bka' bsgo dang / tshes drug nas nyin bdun gyi bar yan lag brgyad ldan sman gyis nad kyi dri ma dbyung / dmag zor tshangs dbang la pha rol mthu gtad rig sngags sbyor ngan sogs byad kyi rigs 'grol ba'i sbyor ba byas/ tshes bcu bzhir gdan sa chen po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas dga' ldan khri rin po che gdan zur/ rtse shar gnyis kyi dbon/ slob dpon gsum byings lnga brgya (149ba〉skor gyis tshan grangs 'byor bstun sngon 'gro'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi mchod chog dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho'i dus khri rin po che sgroms che ba'i lung 'dren dang bcas gtan sdod rgyu mtshan stsal ba sgrib pa'i lus can la rang dbang cir mchis kyang khri rin po ches dbus dge 'dun mi byed 'dun pa'i bden tshig gnas brtan bcu drug gi cho ga dang 'brel ba byin rlabs che ba bcas mos 'dun byed par rten 'brel gyi khyad lan phul/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ stag rtse tha'i ji/dpon tshe brtan/ bi yig er khe tha'i ji'i nu bo/ spong rong nam mkha' mgon gyi bu/ gnam ru dpon/a mdo sku 'bum dge slong can/ rta 'on mdzo ge can/ a rig bsam gtan can/ sku 'bum pha gzhi can/ ra la no mun khan gyi rab 'byams pa sogs nyis brgya skor la ja gral btang / tshes bco lngar dpon rdo rje 'khor bcas sum cu skor la so thar bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa snga char phab cing bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang / bde chen tha'i ji sku mched/ rwa sgreng da rgan chos rje/ nyi lde dbon po rnams kyi ngo bor byin rlabs dang phyi dro gnas gsar chos rje dbon dang zhib mor mol rjes lto mos su byon/ dpal ldan re ma ti'i mdos mchod sngar bzhin btsugs/tshes bcu bdun la lha ldan ru bzhis bdog pa maṇ+ḍal du btegs nas ring 'tsho'i smon lam btab/dpon tshe brtan 'khor bcas/ khal kha bzod pa yel deng dang lha btsun ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyi mi sna thon gdong / gsar 'byor dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu ji nong / da'i ching (150na kho lo —207—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (poche'i mi sna/ gsang phu mchod khang bla ma so gos dang phrad/ dpon tshe brtan la er te ni ching tha'i ji'i cho lo/ tham ga /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung gis gtsos byin rten/ gyon pa/ shal dkar dmar/snam phrug sogs bdog pa rgyas pa dang bka' bsgo/ khal kha'i mi sna tshor yang gang la gang 'tsham gyi ster bya dang bcas brdzangs/ tshes bco brgyad la tre bo dpon gyis dngos po'i skyes dang yon sbyar te gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa mdzad/ dzum lang rgyal po na ra sidha 'khor bcasal skyes len 'phar kha dang bcas bsdoms gser zho drug cu tham pa/ gos yug bcu drug /dar yug sum cu so lnga/ dngas shel gyi pad phor/ gser sga cha 'grig /dngul gyi mdong mo/ gyon pa/ ja ras/snam phrug /rgun ltang bcas dgu tshan bcu gsum sogs dngom che ba'i bdog pa bstar ba shin tu mgu zhing gus pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad/ tre bo hor tshang chos rje blo bzang chos skyong rang yul du 'degs par nye bar rung mthun gos sna tshang 'grigs gos dar sogs spams bstod/ dpa' bo sprul pa'i skus hor gos bum gdan ma sogs nor rnying shas che ba'i skyes lan bzabs par mdzad cing bkur bzos sogs kyang sngar bzhin bgyis rjes dpon g.yog rags bsdus la gur nas bshad pa'i phyag rdor 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang phul/ lketshes bcu dgur stag lung ka drug mkhan po sogs la ja gral btang / nyer gnyis la gra tshang gi gra pa grangs (150ba)bcad kyis dur sri sogs gnon khag gnyis dang / gi dang dgra mnan khag gcig btsugs/ nyer gsum la sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen por rdor gling thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang mtha' brten tshe dbang / sgrol ma'i dbang dang bcas pa zhus/ lho mos nas gnas gsar dbon rin po che bsnyen chen mdzad pa'i dmigs khrid gsan bzhed don bzhin bsgrubs/ nyer bzhin 'phags pa lha dpon slob/ ngag dbang sprul sku/ ldan chos lor sku skye/ chab nag /de mo 'phags pa chos rdzong /rngod a rig dgon/ a tsa lha ri/ do nang pad gling rnams kyi bla ma/ rgyal sras bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyi dpon mo/ khal kha u'i ching no mun gyi mi sna ngo bo la byin rlabs/ 'phags pa lhas slob dpon phyogs—208—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)glang gi thugs dam rten gyi mi g.yo ba'i sku li ser/ gser zho brgya/ dngul srang nga lnga/ gos sna cha tshang /dar tshos 'dres pa yug bco brgyad/ gos yug dang khrab bcu re/ gri bzhi/ lcags mgu sogs lcags dpyad zhe lnga/ nag po khor drug gsum/ ya ju za'u 'dres pa khor drug nyis brgya/ rgun ltang bcu gsum/ba bla dos gcig /ra ma lug gi sga/ rta chig brgya bgragacig /dre'u bco brgyad/ mdzo lnga bcu/ g.yag brgya/ stag gzig gi pags pa sogs bteg /byings bzhi brgya skor la me rtag gtor/ rtser rta 'bul ba blo bzang brtson khrus can/ phun tsho gos can/ rdzi do dbon po can/ bya bral lhun grub can/ dpon bzang mo can/ bra nye (151na lon sogs nyis brgya skor la ja gral thog bi lig er khe tha'i jir ster byin dang bcas thon/ 'di nyin nas bdun bzhi'i bar nged rang gis bcad rgya dam par bsdams shing sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos gter gsar tshe sgrub bdun gcig gnang /nyer brgyad la po ta la/ ra mo che/ lha sa/ yer pa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug /yum bu ste gnas chen bdun por bod 'bangs 'phung byed kyi 'gong po gtso bor gyur pa'i gzugs med gzugs can thams cad sgrub khag gsum po grol nas bskal pa'i bar ldang du med par mnan/ stod kyi jus rim du nged rang gi brtag pa dang gnas chung chos skyong chen po'i gsung bzhin rgyud smad pas phyag drug pa'i gtor bzlog /ser 'bras su ja tshul brgyad rer mdo sgrub/ lha sar gsas khang pas brgyad stong pa drug cu re lnga/ gser 'od tshig brgya dang bdun/ gzungs 'dus bzhi brgya don gnyis/ gdugs dkar nyi khri brgyad stong lnga brgya/ sher snying dgu stong / sgrol ma nyis stong / srong btsan du 'ug pa babs pa sogs ltas ngan bzlog rim du smin grol gling pa dgus grabs gcig sgrub bdun gyi khro rol slang gang ma'i rgyab chos ri bo bde chen pa sum cus sher snying / nye skor mi ser gyis lha bsangs dang dgra lha dpangs bstod rnams btang /hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig la gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi dngul gdung rin po cher snga sor nas mchod pa rnam lnga tshar lnga bcu re dang / bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad —209

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pol mchod pa sna lnga tshar re rgyun btsugs gtong (151ba)gzhi'i shog hril rnams 'thor zhing lhag par la mo chos skyong chen pos bstan srid spyi dang khyad par nged kyi ring 'tshor dmigs nas gsar 'phar dgos zhes bskul ma mdzad don bzhin 'di lo nas bzung lnga tshar lnga bcu ji srid nam mkha' gzugs gzhan ma gyur bar chag med kyi rgyun bzang btsugs te khyon brgya tshar gcig la zla gzhol dus gong steng zla gcig spar ba bcas mchod 'bul ba'i phogs khyon gcig tu dril bar 'bru khal nyis stong gya bdun/ mar khal chig stong brgyad brgya bzhi bcu/ spos ba ma sum brgya don brgyad/ sdong ras gon ma bzhi rnams 'di phyi'i bde 'bras ched bsgrubs/ thang chen chos skyong shing bya can gyis zhig gsos dgos pa'i bskul ma'i don ltar dri gtsang khang sogs tshang ma legs par grub par 'di lo nas bzung ri bo bde chen pa bzhi gras nyin star mchod pa rnam lnga brgya tshar mchod 'bul ba rnams kyis skyabs sems chos spyod smon lam chag med gang rgyas ji srid bstan pa nam gnas bar btsugs pa'i mchod chas/mchod 'bul ba bzhi gra lag g.yog gcig bcas pa'i phogs dbu mdzad kyi skal 'phar/ ja sbyor lnga/ thug pa gnyis/ mchod rdzas sogs gtong sgo tshang ma 'phyong rgyas rdzong sdod kyi rtsis zhakhri khrims shugs steng nas gtong / tshes bzhir tshong 'dus chos skyong gis khri 'bul la sku khog mngags pa'i lan rgyan gyis spras pa/ 'bri gung sprul pa'i skus gter sgrom du nged kyi rim gror dmigs pa'i sgrub pa grol tshul gyi chab shog byung ba'i lan snyan ngag nas drangs pa/ dar rgyas bkra shis kyis rgyas 'bring bsdus pa dang byams pa'i sku bzhengs (152na)pa'i dkar chag che brjod/ rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags kyis snyan ngag gi tshigs bcad byung lan de mtshungs/ khal kha er te ni i la khub san khu thug thu'i tham phud kha byang / tre bo hor tshang chos rjes gzhis kyi mgon po gur dang dmag zor mar snyan dar 'bulatshig dang gsol 'debs phyogs bcu mun sel gyi don dang sbyar ba'i smon lam/ bde gshegs brgyad sogs sangs rgyas byang smos spyi dang / bye brag sa'i snying por gsol ba btab pas sa g.yos kyi 'jigs skyob bden brjod/ sngags rams pa nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ thos bsam dar rgyas gling pa/ skyor lung —210—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho rnams kyis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs bcas brtsams/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos drag dmar gyi gtor bzlog nyin gsum ma nub phyogs su rgyal rdzongs dang bcas smin rgyas/tshes lngar bcad rgya'i mus su rdo rje brag tu gsar bzhengs mdzad pa'i drag dmar gyi 'bur sku dang sngags thang gra tshar la bla ma drag po rtsal gyi sgo nas dam tshig par ye shes pa dpag med bstim zhing bkra shis pa'i me tog gi char phab/ tshes brgyad la gter ston rin po ches 'chi bslu dang / tshes dgur mgon po a sto ra'i rjes gnang zhus/ tshes bcu gcig la gser srang lnga/ dngul sder srang zhe lnga'i dngul mdong / skar dril legs pa/ gos phyi nang / hu ja dang ya ju khor drug gshas dgu tshan dgu'i phebasardzongs rgyas par btab ste re zhig bsti gnas su thegs/tshes bcu gsum la thod ri bshad sgrub gling pa blo ldan rgya mtsho dang dge bsnyen rgya mtsho gnyis kyis phar (152ba)phyin 'grel ba blo bzang dgongs rgyan mtha' gcod dang bcas pa'i rgyugs sprad/bar khams su lha sde mi sde rang rang 'dzin bdag la 'then rtsod kyi rigs gzhung rdzong gzhis rnams kyi dbye 'byed dang byang pa sbyin bdag khag gi khral sde sogs la nang khul 'then khyer rtsod pa mi byed pa'i sne mo so sor bkod pa dang / dge lugs gtsor bton gyi bstan par gang phan dgos pas mtshon don gcod la lha bag sbrel po sde pas rdzong bda' mdzad don bzhin 'gro gdong bka' bsgo dang / nged rang dang sde pa'i ring 'tsho dgon sde tshor 'dzugs par dgos tshul bzhin brtsams/ tre bo dkar lcog sprul sku blo bzang chos kyi dbang por ta'i si tu'i lung las bstar/ nyer gcig la sher 'phel dang dung dkar sprul sku/ rwa sgreng mkhan po/ li thang dgas dwag gra tshang bla zur/ gong dkar chos sde'i chos 'chad pa phrin las rnam rgyal/ lcam mda'/ me rag /lha ri/ yar 'brog sba lung rnams kyi bla ma/ zil gnon dbang rgyal rdo rje/ de mo dbon po gzhon pa/ mtshur phu phyag mdzod zur pa dgon stod pa/ hor rdza dmar dbon/ mkhar nag pa/ lha rgyal dar gyi bu/ gzhung 'gron tshong dpon gnyis/ bod sog dmangs nyis—211—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pobargya skor la ja gral rjes dpon mo tshe ring / thu med bstan pa tha'i ji'i tsha bo/ dbon chung san bi lig /ji nor gi ma las kha sha kha/ pad+ma tha sar kha/ co ne'i khri 'bul ba/ che chen dge slong can 'go pa bzhi mdung nag gi 'go pa mer gan khā pha bu/ byings brgya dang gsum/ mer gan chos rje/ khal 9u'i ching no yon/ dpon mo/ bu gsum/ nom chi tha'i ji'i (153na ji pon mo/ bugasum/ dpon chung no yon dge slong / dge tshul ma/ bu gnyis/ dpon chung nom chi a kha'i dpon mo blo bzang dge tshul/ 'bum dar tha'i ji/ dpon mo/ tsha bo tshe dbang skyabs/ bu gcig /dpon chung sbyin pa a kha'i/ bu e chi spun/shar rtse slob dpon pa'i mi sna no yon dka' bcu/ bu thug sun gyi mi sna ja'i sang dge slong / a mdo rta 'bul ba dzo gi blo bzang phun tshogs/ er te ni da rgan chos rje'i sku skye/ tsha bo gnyis/ byings nyer gsum/pā thur shag shing / tsha bo gnyis/ byings re lnga/ bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byings bcu bdun/ sku 'bum dbon po blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ byings bcu gsum/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan can so brgyad/ rab 'byams pa shes rab lhun grub can sum cu/ dgon lung 'od zer rgya mtsho can bstogasum/ byings brgya skor rnams kyi ngo bor byin rlabs dang dmangs la me tog gtor/ gsar 'byor rnams kyis gser dngul gos dar ja ras sogs dang mdung nag gis rta brgyad cu/ ma las kyis rta bcu gcig /dung dkar —sku skyes rta nyer gnyis sogs byung / nyer gnyis la gong dkar chos sde'i slob dpon bzhi/ chos 'chad pa gnyis/ gra pa rags bsdus lnga bcu skor gyis snam phrug gtsor btan gyi dngos po dang tshe chog dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho yid 'khul ba'i bab chags bstar/ dharma shrī'i mi sna bzhi/ ka dbang tshe brtan sogs dang phrad/ nyer gsum la srad rin chen rtse pas gos sna cha tshang / gser dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/ gos phyi nang sogs dgu tshan (153ba)bcu/ 'gyed/ sman kha gsum ras yug /gtsang snam dmar po bubs ba re bcas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa bstar/ gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin la ster byin bzabs te lugs gnyis thad nas zha lu dang 'dar grang mo cher phan cha gang che dgos pa'i bslab bya dang bcas thon/ khal kha zhabs drung / u'i ching no yon/ bstan pa tha'i ji sogs brgya —2/2

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)skor la ja gral dang bsam grub gling pa mda' dpon du bskos pa'i skyes/ khams pa rdzogs chen pas nyams rtogs kyi 'char tshul brjod pa bcos ma ltar ma yin par klong nas brdol ba'i grub pa'i dbang phyug rtse gcig bskyangs pa'i lag rjes shar bar snang /nyer bzhir bzod pa yel deng gi bu lha btsun ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ dpon khu'i ching no yon/nom chi tha'i ji sogs dpon mo/ dpon chung / ja'i sang sogs nyis brgya skor/ em chi byang ngos pa dar mo ba'i slob ma kha shas la sman bla sprul sku dang thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs kyi rjes gnang /grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang rnams bskur/ lha btsun ngag dbang bstan badzin la er te ni la thug san khu thug thu'i cho lo/ tham ga /byin rten/ rgyan pa cha 'grig /snam phrug /sgam sogs spams mtho dang /u'i ching no yon dang nom chi tha'i jir de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung / rdul gzan dum bu sogs byin rten/ shal dkar dmar/ snam phrug yi/ma tse/ sgam/ rgun 'bras kyi ltang tse sogs dngom che ba/dpon mo/ dpon chung / ja'i sang gis mtshon par 'os 'tsham gyi 'dod don bsgrubs/nyer lngar (154na)jo stan khri gdan zur dang mjal/ rin chen rtse pa'i g.yog 'tsho byed mchog ldan gyis rgyud bzhi'i rgyugs sprad/ spyir sbyin pa rnam bzhin brtson dgos pa mdo rgyud mang po nas bshad pa'i phan yon gyi rim pa sde pa nyid kyis shes pa dang lhag par nged ring por 'tsho bar mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa srog skyob pa gtso bor 'don pa'i rgyu mtshan/ mdo sde pad dkar las/ gang dag srog chags rnam mang dag /longs spyod phyir ni gsod pa dang / /za phyir sha rnams tshogs byed pa/ /de dag drel byed rnam par spang / /zhes dang / bden pa pa'i le'ur/ rgyal po khyod ni srog gcod ma mdzad cig /skye bo kun la srog ni rab tu 'phangs/ /de bas yun ring tshe bsrung su 'dod pas/ /yid kyi dgu la'ang srog gcod mi bsam mo/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer gzhag las/ mngal na gnas pa yan chad kyang / /kun la srog ni sdug pa'i phyir/ /bdag gi srog 'phangs gang yin pa/ /des ni srog chags gsod mi byed/ /ces dang / gzhan yang tshe ring ba'i chos bcu par/ srog gcod pa spangs pa dang / de'i legs pa brjod pa —213

wa wa wa rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum / (podang / tre 'i/ bskul ba dang / bsad par bya ba'i mi dang ba lang dang phag dang bya la sogs pa'i srog 'byin pa dang / sems can 'jigs pas nyen pa rnams la mi 'jigs pa sbyin par gsungs/ byang chub lam rim chung bar/ gsod sar phyung ba legs btang dang / /de bzhin srog gi phan btags shing / /srog chags 'chi ba las ldog pas/ /tshe ring ba ni thob pa yin/ /zhes rgya cher bsngags pa ltar mdo khams khul (154ba)gtsang dgon khag tshang ma'i bsrung khongs su 'di lo nas bzung lo bzhi'i bar rngon pa yong mi chog pa'i skyabs sbyin dang mnga' ris rdzong dga' nas dpal khud chu rags nya gsod sar bsrung mi gnyis la 'di lo nas ji srid bar lo star dbyar zla ba phyed gsum gyi bar sdod ring spyir phogs mkhar khal bco lnga rgyar bcas/ skya skya dang bya mang gnyis por lo star zla ba gsum gyi ring sgong len bsrung mi gra pa gnyis rer rgyar dod bcas mkhar khal dgu re/ kre khror lugs shrī dgon pa bar byang dge tsheg nya kha'i 'jigs skyob rten du lo star rdzong dga' nas mkhar khal brgya'i 'dzin/ 'bras spungs spyi sor sde pa bsod nams rab brtan dus nas sbyor 'jags phon mi chung tsam yod kyang phyisadage 'dun 'phel rgyas je cher song ba'i phogs kyis ma ldangs pa'i nad ma theg tshul nged rang dang sde pa zur pa'i dus skabs nas rgyu mtshan gyi 'go tshugs 'dug pa bzhin la nye lam mu 'thud du zhu nan byung ba ltar phun tshogs gling khul ldog byang rgyud mus nang bcas pa'i gling sngon yan nas khrab man lho rgyud rgyang mkhar yan nas gces man gyi sa rigs zhing shas mi ser gyi yong 'bab/ bogs 'khyar bcas par 'bru mkha' ru'i khal lnga stong sum brgya nga gcig /dud che chung bsdoms chig brgya bdun cu skor/slar yang bskyar zhus byung ba gra sa gzhan dang ma 'dra'i gshis mkha' ru'i bdun brgya go dgu gnas chung chos skyong chen por snga sor mchod gzhis ka drug kyang sa bsnon sras po bsod nams dus nas gleng gzhi mang du yod 'dug rung bar skabs su sku ma phebs par brten rim 'gyangs su lus pa nye lam sku rten tshe dbang dpal 'bar la sku phebs byung ba dang bcas (155na〉sde pas mchod gzhis shig legs tshul gleng ba bsam yas lta bu'i chos skyong dang sku rten pa so sor yin na drag na'ang gnas chung 'di —214

rang rnam du sprula'i gos bzang glegs ba ma ba /sum pa/ (ja)sngar nas dbye ba med gshis sku rten rang yang byed dka' bcas dge med 'dra snyam yang sde pa'i 'dod pa ltar la ba 'phrad gdong phul ba yin kyang la 'phrad klu bdud sku khog la mi 'phrod nyams kyis gzhung len ngos chos skyong wo pos de dod par bkab mi dgos/ster bar shar tshe che chung la ma bltos pa'i lta grub gtsang zhing dam tshig thub pa zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar rnying khung 'brog mo'i sa rigs/zhing shas kyi thon/mi ser yong 'bab bcas 'degs gshor mkha' ru'i khal chig stong bdun brgya lnga bcu/mi ser dud che 'bring chung gsum bsdoms nyi shu rtsa gsum/'phan yul rgyal lha khang pa lta grub gtsang yang chos gzhis che ba mi 'dug pa bcas rin spungs khul g.yung khar lung lag 'debs shas mi ser gyi yong 'bab 'brur bsdoms khal drug brgya re brgyad/dud 'bring brgyad/rdo rje brag par 'phyong rgyas myags ma'i bogs 'khyar khyon sum brgya dang bdun/shing yos gzhung phul gyi sa tshab me 'brug phreng 'go khul nas bogs shas 'khyar pa phye gsal byas pa yin kyang shas 'debs mi gzhung sger sna tshogs kyis za ma bzos pa glang ma steng shar nub bsdad grong them bdun/yong 'bab 'bru khal sum brgya dang drug/bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i ya rgyal stag lung thang pa'i ring lugs dar rgyas byung ba spyi sgor kun la legs cha che ba zhig yin na'ang sger chags lta bu'i zhal ngo rnams thugs nang shin tu ma gshin pa ri klungs kyi khu rdo kho na'i dper nang 'jags e yong re'i dang 155bskyo rus la rtsod pa snum gyi rdo dkar ma thon par bya thebs zad pa byings 'jags 'os ma mchis pa gzhung blangs ngos zhal ngo skya ser rnams stag lung zer ba'i mtshan la bsams gsol skal phye ba zhabs drung khri zur sku ga cho zhe pa mched/lcam sring yum sras thun mong du rkang gcig sngar yod steng g.yag grong gzhis ka dud 'dzin che chung bsdoms nyi shu/'bab 'bru khal chig stong zhe drug/ka drug pa nas bzung su 'khod kyi mkhan gzhis/gtsug lag khang gi mchod pa dkon gnyer gyi phogs/sgrub mchod kyi thebs sogs la bye ma gzhis ka bsdad grong dud so lnga/lag 'bab 'bru khal tshig stong tshig brgya dang gsum/sde pa bkra shis la sum phreng dud che chung bsdoms so lnga/'bab 'bru khal chig stong sum brgya dang drug/spyi sor lhun grub rdzong

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ponas mkha' ru'i khal bcu bre bcu re/gtsug lag khang chen mo dang sku 'bum bcas pa'i sku gnyer bzhin phogs lo rer khal chig brgya gya gsum re/gling pa'i chos gzhis yar klungs dpal grong mkho bed stabs gzhung blangs tshab lhun grub rdzong mdun grong gzhis ka/sbrang char gtsang ma'i spyil po/bsdad grong dud che chung bsdoms bcu gsum/'bab chig stong bdun brgya dang gsum/stag lung gra tshang gi chos gzhis gra nang gad pa kha blangs tshab lhun grub rdzong zhol lcang ma gzhis ka/bsdad grong dud bcu gsum/ 'bab 'bru khal drug brgya dang so drug /mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab rim gro'i lag g.yog tu khur che byung ba'i bdag rkyen du khe gsum nas sne'u sdong rtse/chos sde khag sogs la bogasashas 'gro ba rnams khe gsum du zla bsgril byas 56na ) pa'i 'bab 'bru khal chig stong nyis brgya dang gnyis byin pa'i tshab rtse tshogs par yang ri khungs byang sribs nas bogs 'khyar 'bru khal sum brgya go drug/ri bo chos gling bar bsdad grong rkang gnyis/'bru khal sum brgya go drug/ras chung phug par pho brang khungs ze sna nas bogs 'khyar 'bru khal tshig brgya don gnyis/'phyos lam rim pa'i shas zhing tshab zhing tshab lcang gang khungs sbyar ma gsum/bkra shis bde chen par shos stod nas sngo bzo ba'i 'bab khal drug/ri bo bde chen par 'phags sde khungs dpal ri rnying ma'i bogs 'bru khal nyis brgya re gnyis/skyon gling du pho brang nub stod khrums sogs nas bogs khal nga gnyis/bkra shisachos sde bar bying khungs sogs nas 'bru khal bcu gsum/rtses dang lnga mchod par byang sribs stod khang rgyab khungs skyer pa ma li rnams sprad/chab nag bla ma bkra shis chos 'phel gyis dgos tshul nan che byung ba bzhin se mo mi ser gyi steng dud che chung so brgyad/'bab 'bru khal sum brgya da pa drug/phung po ri bo cher bdud dpung zil gnon gling zhes pa 'dzugs pa'i dgos pa'ang /gter r+ṣa chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul rat+na gling pa'i rta mgrin gsang kyi 'dus them byang rin chen gter mdzod las/rgyal ba'i sras mchoge 'gro 'dul rig pa 'dzin rgya bod kun tu rtsod bral sprul sku grags rdo rje lang dang yon tan dgongs pa mnyam:bdag 'dra mtsho /sa pad+ma'i 'byung gnas kyis rgyal ba 'das nas

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)lo yang zhe gsum na spre'u'i lo la ko sha'i gling du 'brungs sum stong nye bar rgya gar skyon sogs 156ba / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rtsod med seng ger grags bod kyi mnga' thang dgung la reg pa'i dus 'jam dpal sprul pa mnga' bdag khri srong gi zhu ba'i ngo dang gdul bya'i dus gzigs nasastag gi lo la gangs can yul der sleb bsam yas sa btul gtsug lag khang chen grub sangs rgyas bstan pa nyi 'od brdal bar mdzad:chos dang gdams pa bstan srung drag sngags bcas lasa'aphro'i dbang gis mnga' bdag rgyal po la 'phral dang phugs su dgongs nas dpag med gtad:ma 'ongs don phyir gter kha dpag med sbas phyi ma'i dus 'dir bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir da lta dbang bskur bka' lung yongs rdzogs pa'i las can mang pos gter sgo rim par 'byed gter chosabastan pa mtha' dbus rgyas par 'gyur:zhes sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob dpon pad+ma thod 'phrong rtsal gyis dag pa dang ma dag pa'i gnas mtha' klas par 'phrin las sna tshogs kyis rjes su bzung ba'i cha shas gnas ljongs gangs ri brag mtsho sogs byin gyis brlabs shing gter che 'bring chung ba dpag tu med pa sbas pa'i nang tshan/thang yig shel brag mar/gtsang gi phug mo che ru tshe bdag sbas zhes pa de nyid 'don pa'i dus rtags kyang :la stod gcung pa dril chen chu ltar 'khrug g.yung po rdza lhud sbasapa'i gter kha 'di mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags der bstan nas sing :gter ston dum rgya zhang khrom zhes bya 'byung :zhes slob dpon chen pos rje 'bangs dgur bka' brgyad kyi dbang bskur mdzad pa'i lho 'jam dpal gshin 57na ) rje'i bka' babs pa gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che zhes mngal skyes kyi nang che btsan 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba/rdzu 'phrul nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa de'i yang srid ni/zab pa'i chos drug gi dkar chag las/de dus bskal pa'i tha ma la nga min nga yi cha byad can:sha ni ser la skra ni li:bong ni thung la g.yas ni dkar g.yon ni dmar ba'i sha mtshan can:so ni dkar la so tshags dam sme ba'i ga sha yod pa yi:lo ni khyi 'brug lo pa la rusargya ming ni zhang khrom zhes de lta bu yis rnyed par shog ces pa da gnubs kyi zab chos bsam gyis mi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pokhyab pa'i bka' babs pa/ phung po ri bo che'i gter byang las/ g.yung gi phu yi rdza lhud nag po la:dam chos bka' rtags bum skur bcas pa gtad: g.yas ru /ga gi rdo rje sgrom bu sa dbang rtags rdo rje bka' ru bcas pa sbas g.yas ru gtsang khris phung po ri bo cher: dbang rtags bse sgrom smug por bcas pa sbas skal ldan las 'phro can la kha byang bris te bzhag: ces dang / zab pa'i cho ge drug gi dkar chag ltar phung po ri bo che/ myug gi rdo rje sgrom bu/ g.yung gi rdza lhud mo/ mon mo gtsug rum/'bum thang ke sa gtsang 'gram skyer ma/ pra dun rtse/ mkho mthing lha khang / bsam yas/ mchims phu sogs nas byang chub bsgrub chos dang khyad par bstan pa bsrung ba'i drag sngags grangs med pa spyan drangs pa'i gtso bo gsum gyi nang nas kyang mchog tu gyur pa kha ba can pa'i bde skyid 'byung ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/sprul sku nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi zab gter dmag bzlog (157na7sa gtsang gi ri bo che dang dbus ri gsum gyi kha nas mtshon bzlog bya: zhes gsungs pa dang dgongs pa mthun par sdig pa'i rgya can du/ bod 'bangs bde ba bsgrub pa'i thabs/ shar gyi gdug pa zhi ba la/ gtsang gi spungs pa ri bo cher/ /sngags nag gsum gyis las la sbyor/ /bsod nams klungs rta spub pa dang / /las sbyor bskul ba gnad du che/ /zhes dang / chos dung g.yas 'khyil rgya las/ ri bo che ru thugs kyi lha gsum bzheng / /gshin rje nag po'i sgrub pa btsugs na legs/ /zhes lung bstan nang bzhin snga sor ri 'dir 'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi sgrub sde zhig tshugs na spyi sger thams cad la phan tshul sde pa bsod nams rab brtan la bgyis pa bzhi sde zhig mdzad bzhed de/ shing sogs sta gon gyi tshe nang so nor bus bsgyur ba/ rigs gsum mtshan ma'i rgyar/ bdud kyi byin brlabs mthu che bas/ /de dusasnyigs ma'i mi mang brlams/ khyad par bod yul bde ba'i thabs/ /bsgrub la thabs kyis 'tshe zhing smod/ /ces pa'i don sting song nas lo shas 'gyangs kyang slar 'grub pa/ e ma 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab las/ /'gro ba 'dren pa'i dam bca' 'di/ /sems can stongs min bar du yin/ /sna tsho gis sprul pa —218—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)cir yang ston/ /zhes sogs kyis mtshon gtsang la phan pa'i zhal chems sgro bkur dang bral te 'jam dpal zhi khro gtso bor gyur pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs par sngar hor zla bcu pa'i khro rol gtong ba tsam las dgon pa'i tha snyad mi snang ba gtsug lag khang gsar du bskrun pa'i pha rol mi mthun phyogs 'joms pa'i ming gong bzhin btags nas nyang stod brag la ba lhun grub chos sdings pas dpal ldan dus dgra'i dbang po phyag rgya (158na)zil gnon gyi sgrub mchod ji srid bstan pa rin po che nam gnas bar chad med kyi rgyun btsugs par rdor slob gcig the ba'i bzhi gras lo 'khor dang / der mi the ba'i lo lo bzhin zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig nas hor zla drug pa'i gnam gang bar bla ma gra bcas nyer drug gis nyin star las byang rgyas pa sngon song gi phye ring 'gro gang che/ dgongs mo pho mo khrom sogs bzlog sngags kyi rigs gang zab dang bcas bod khams spyi dang bye brag dga' ldan pho brang pa'i chos srid la gnod pa'i rigs la thun gtor re 'phen/ gtor gzhi spo thengs re/ nyer dgu 'byung res kyi thub gtor che bar 'phang / bla gra zla drug par 'bazhugs rang byung ngo cog gi zla ba'i tshes gsum brgyad bco lnga gsum la brgyags rngan/ tshes brgyad la thugs rje chen po/ tshes bcur rigs 'dzin gdung sgrub/ tshes bcu gcig la bka' brgyad rang byung rang shar/ nyer lngar thugs sgrub drag po rtsal/ nyer brgyad la bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs/ lo rer tshe bdag gi sgrub mchod rgyas par bcas pa'i gtor rtsam sogs mchode chas/ tsho gis 'khor/ bla gra'i bogs/ ja thug 'phar ma le tshan bcas gto me sgo tshang ma'i ja phogs sogs nar ma rnams phud/ de phyin deb zur gsal bzhin 'gro rtsis la bal ra dud bco lnga/'bab ru'i chig stong nyis brgya nyer gcig nya 'dabs kyi char thad sogs sbyor 'jags byas pa bla ma dga' rab 'di pa lag 'bras gtsang ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag bzab/ bris 'bur sogs dngos gtsang ba'i lag rjes dang / spyi rdzas mchod chas sogs sna sgor ma nas 'khyil cher bzhag pa bskas bal dga' ba'i tshad(158ba〉byeg byung gzhan ni sku rim pa dang chos sde gsar btsugs kyi bla gnyer sogs kyang re gnyis ma gtogs sde der phan mi 'dogs par rtswa shar ri dang lci ba nub kyi dpe kho nas 'brel —219—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pomed kyi che sa dgos med gzhan la ster ba mang bar snang ngo / /sne'u sdong rtse sde pa blo bzang sbyin pa'i skal bar sprad pa rtse tshogs par sne'i sdong rtse'i gtong deb tu gsal ba'i dod yar klungs dpal grong gra nang gad pa kha/ yar ston sgo mal bcas khag gsum por dud 'bring nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ 'bab sum stong nyis brgya nyer
