lnga/ ngag dbang 'phrin las la 'bru khal lnga bcu dang blo bzang chos ldan la brgya/gdud nag po gzhung sar blo gtad pa'i skyong 'os dang / lhag par dmag snga phyir 'thab 'khrug zhe rusabaskyed pa'i zal thon dang 'brug 'og tshur 'ther gyi thabs blo sogs gang cir khur bsam che nges byung ba'i bdag rkyen du lho brag rdzong gzhis gang bde nas gzhor 'debs khal nyis brgya/ ha sdong rab 'byams pa ngag dbang don grub shag sgor bla ma byed ring yas pa theb chung brag la gtogs pa'i chos gzhis 'bab 'bru khal chig brgya nyer lnga/ yig mkhan lhun grub pha bu'i g.yog sgrub rten gra nang sog phu rkang lnga/ 'bab 'bru khal nyis brgya don lnga/ smon skyid pad tshing yig rtsis kyi g.yog tu 'gyur ba byung ba dang slar yang zhi drag sgrub rten mi ser dud bcu gcig /'bab khal lnga brgya dang drug /lcang lo can pa bstan 'dzin dpal bzang yer pa'i mi ser ma bzos pa dang 'bras spungs spyil bu tshur sprad pa 'i tshab 'bru khal brgya'i gshor 'debs/ bstan 'dzin dbang po yi ge'i lag g.yog tu 'gyur bar byung ba'i rten yer pa sgrom pa khungs them rkang bdun/ 'bab lnga brgya soganyis/ bsod dar gyi zhi drag (159na)sgrub rten rgyal rtsa lung nag glang pa gzhis kar gtogos pa'i khang pa na lcang / them rkang gnyis/ 'babanyis brgya nyer brgyad/ star sdong par rta nag gi sa tshab gzhis rtse zhol mkhu dpal ra/ mgar tshang dpal ra/ chu dbar/ lcang stod spel gsar gling bsdoms dud che chung so lnga/ 'bab tshig stong lnga brgya/sha 'degs brgya dang bcu/ ram pa zur pa lhun grub la sa tshab dang zhi drag sgrub rten du gzhis rtse smon grub khyung rtse rdzong mdun gyi sa rigs dud bcu bdun/ 'bab khal drug brgya re gsum sho grong 'phags pa don grub gzhung 'gal gyi phan bde sogs 'gal rigs la bya len tshang skyel kha lab 'brel brgyud mi byed pa'i sdod mkhas byung phyin/ sho grong gi gyang ra 'bab nyis brgya don dgu/ 'tsho byed lhun sdings—220

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)pa rnam rgyal rdo rje gso rig la blo yangs shing thos pa che ba 'dug pa dang / bslab gra skyong rgyun yod snang ba gzhan phan gyi 'chad nyan sgrigs legs byung phyin mthun rkyen du phun gling nas gshor khal brgya/bsam grub gling pas phag rir zi bun gyi dus bsam phyogs ma log cing khams sogs gzhung don gang la btang yang khur che ba dang / nye lam bu bsod nams rdo rje bum thang dpung 'degs kyi rogs su 'gyur ba bcas gtsang gi mda' dpon gyi 'os su byung ba bskos pa'i skyong thebs dang sbrags rgyal rtse sog khang gi sa ris dbang rigs bdag thob bsdoms dud re gcig /'bab lnga stong re lnga/ sha khal nyis brgya don dgu/ mar khal so bdun/ za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi sku'i skye ba gter ston skyon gling pa'i thang yig las/ bsam yas mchims phu yar klungs shel gyi brag yer pa zla ba phug (159ba)sogs sgrub gnas kun: sgrub gra sgrub mchod rgyud ston tshes bcu tshugs zhes 'phags yul bsil ba tshal dang mtshungs pa'i gnas rnams su gangs can bde skyid spel ba'i sgrub gra 'dzugs dgos par gsungs pa'i 'phrin las kyi gnas 'dir gter chen rat+na gling pa'i gu ru zhi drag dang thugs rje chen po zhi khro btsugs pa'i chos gzhis su sman lung gzims khang sa zhing mo bran lag 'debs sogs khal sum brgya sum cu gnas 'dzin gra pa sogs la sbyor 'jags/ mdo khams rdzong gzhis che kha bcu gsum gyi mnga' khul la dge lugs gtso gyur gyi lha sde khag drug brgya nga bdun yod pa'i dge dgon rnams la gdugs dkar dang mtshan brjod/ ris med tshang mar sde pas nged kyi ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad tshe dpag med mgon ma dang / tshangs pa dung thod can gyi gsung mtha' yas zhing bzhugs la rgyun 'dzugs byang gter shas che ba'i rnying dgon rnams la rim gro gal che dmigs bsal gyi cho ga phyag len ma nyams par dgos pa dang / dge dgon tshugs ka zhan pa rnams la yul gru 'brel mtshungs nas gra rgyun dkor sa dge khongs phye gsal/ mchod pa'i rgyun/ phogs thebs bcas dad 'bul dang blangs byas cho go pa/ sa rnying sogs la tham ga dmar nag gis gtsang chod la de don bzhin gnas pa dang / de min dge lugs gtsor bton dgos pa'i gtan tshigs/ de dag la med mi —221—

rgyal dbang lnga'i ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (porung gi bca' yig yul dus dang bstun pa/ dge dgon rnams la thog ma'i 'dzugs ja sogs kyang brgyab/ 'dra mkhar thog dgon pa bar sngar gyi bdag thob rang 'jags steng rten gsum mchod chas/khang zhing dang bcas pa sbyor 'jags byas par 'o skol gyi ston pa dang rgyal ba ma (160na)pham pa 'dom gang tsam res gtsos gser sku che chung bcu gcig /'jim sku gsum/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i rdo sku rang byon ma dang gdung rten/ bka' pod lnga bcu/ rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po'i thang sku sogs bcu dgu/ gos dar gyi 'phan bla bre bcu gcig /sbug sil lnga/ 'khar rnga bzhi/ li rag gi maṇ+ḍal bcu dang ting bdun tshar bcu gsum/ rag gi mañdzi bcu bzhi/ spos phor bzhi/ kong zhe gsum/ gtor cha cha tshang / pad sder bcu gsum/ zangs bum gcig /lcags kyi mar me'i rgyal mtshan kong brgya lhag yod pa/ dung dkar gcig /khrab glog bcas gsum/ bse khrab gcig /gra pa nyis brgya skor shong tshod kyi ras gur gser zangs kyi 'phru ldan/ yol ba lnga sogs kyi sprod dang 'bab khal drug stong nyis brgya drug cu skor thon pa/ 'dra rtsi thog dge lugs su bsgyur te/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i lung rtogasakyi bstan pa gsar du bskrun par 'dra rtsi thog dgon dang / rgyal chos lha khang la gtogos pa'i rten gsum mchod rdzas khang zhing sogs bdag thob che phra mtha' dag sbyor 'jags byas par sangs rgyas byang sems li dang gser sku bsdoms bcu bzhi/ sman sku bcu gnyis/ gdung rten gsum/ bka' pod zhe gnyis/ bris thang sna tsho gos dgu/ sbug sil dang 'khar rnga gsum re/ li rag gi maṇ+ḍal re/ rag kong nyer bzhi/ ting soganyis/ dung dkar gsum/ lcags kyi mnyi ngazhi/ phan bla bre dung chen sogs dang / thab gdan chas/ 'dren dpyad kyi rigs mang ba/ 'bab sum stong dgu brgya sum cu/ mdo rab sgang khul dga' ldan chos gling par dpal yul bon dgon dam pa (160ba)rang grol gyis 'dzin bdag byed thog nas 'bab lnga brgya skor/ 'gir ba kha par mi'u rong 'du ra dgon gyi mchod zhing dang / tsher rong stag lha'i khang pa bcas pa 'bab bzhi brgya bzhi bcu skor/ rgyud zur dgon spyi sor dben dgon 'geb khrod pa dang nya lnga rgya mtsho/ se'u rong lnga dkar phu bcas pa'i 'dzin bzhul gyi khang zhing / sgo ra shar pa'i —222—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)khral steng nas spu nag bcas par 'bab lnga brgya drug cu skor/ lte lo dgon gsar bar stag stag ri khrod pa/ bon dgon ghi las sgom pa seng ge /'od sku lte ri dgon bcas pa'i 'dzin bshul gyi zhing la 'bab sum brgya bzhi bcu lhag bcas/ stong sku lnga mchod par be lo dgon pa'i 'dzin bshul kha gtsang thog sdum ra ba'i zhing brgyad/ khri 'jam mo snyi zhabs dang mtsho thog gi khang pa le tshan bcas la 'bab sum brgya sum cu skor/ gnas mgo lnga mchod par bsod nams g.yung drung gi zhing dang /dpal 'dzin rong bsdu rab kyi khang pa bcas la 'bab nyis brgya bdun cu lhag pa/ mdo lnga mchod par bon dgon sdum ra ba'i 'dzin bzhul gyi khang zhing 'bab chig brgya bcu skor/ khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi sku tsha mo gnas gsar btsun ma kun dga' chos dbang la zha lur nam sdod ring mkhar khal lnga bcu re/ phu lung dge slong khams nam bzang ring 'phyong rgyas nas 'bru khal zhe drug bre bcu gsum re/ zhang ston ri khrod par bzang yul bkra shis steng gis tshab snga sor gud med song grub kyang sa bsnon zhu re dang rim gro bsgrub rten du gling dkar yongs steng nas mkha' ru'i khal nyis brgya re/ rgyal gling tshogs par bum gdong gling dang / gling lag chu skor gyi phyed cha dar rgyas chu skor bcas (161na)dge bed 'bab bzhi bcu skor/ phun gling par pa dbu mdzad la khal bzhi re/dbon drung zhi ba bzang po'i dbon po g.yog lnga bcas la phogs thebs khal sum brgya sum cu re/stod lung mtsho smad lha khang par ring 'tshor dmigs rgan tshang pa rkang gcig dang dud stongs kyi zhing bcu'i bogs shas/ shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor gnyer tshang gi zi ling tshong 'go'i dngul sra nga bzhi bcu rtsa chag /chos 'khor rgyal gyi dge 'dun rnams la phogs shes dus ma chad kyi thebs snga sor sle phu mda' dang / sgo rab brtan gling sogs chos gnyis tshan che tsam sbyor 'jags yod kyang phyis tho btsun mangs pa'i gtong yong ma 'grig pa gdan sa 'di nyid gzhan dang ma 'dra bas 'phel rgyas ched rgyun mchod/dus gtor/ dbyar chos/ smon lam chen mo/ mgon khang khag gi gtor gso sogs gtong deb gsar sgrigs zur gsal ltar gyi kha bsnon po ta la dang lha sa gang rigs nas ya ju khor drug nyi shu re/ 'ol —223—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (7dga' dang sku rab rnam rgyal bsgril ba'i yong steng nas tsā mkhar khal chig stong lnga brgya zhe gcig /rdzong dkar mchod khang du dkon gnyer gsar bskos kyis mchod pa bdun tshar chag med la lo rer khal chig stong bzhi bcu skor/ 'ol dga' gzims chung khams gsum rnam rgyal dang / bde ba can du mchod pa rgyun 'dzugs/ 'bras spungs rigs gra bar rigs gra'i thebs su lhun grub rdzong khul nas mkhar khal bco brgyad tsam thon khungs steng 'bru khal sum brgya skor gyi gzhor 'debs/nyer drug la rgya bal gyi mtshams rgyal po na ra ha ri ku ma ras bram ze rā ma tsan+d+ra dang / ya sha man+ta gi ri pho nyar (161ba)mngags te yi ge rten bzang ba dang khyad par rak+ṣa bstan bcos wa ra ṇa si'i paṇa chen shrī go pā la nā tha dang 'jam dpal dbyangs mkhyen brtses bsgyur bar dpag bsam gyi ni shing / kriṣ+ṭha tsitra zhing shing nag chud du zos pas rgan po gzhen nur 'gyur pa de'i 'bras bu g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / rak+ṣa gdong pa gcig pa/ gnyis pa/ dgu pa rnams kyis rtag tu ste tshe bsod ring por 'tsho ba de bzhin gsum pa lha ltar rnyed dka' ba mig ma phug pa rten gral du mchod pas thams cad 'khor zhing bde rtag tu rgyal pos 'dud/ bzhi pa mig phug pa'i nang dngul chu blug pa pra chil gyis bcad pa g.yul du zhugs tshe khar bzung bas dgra dang nad mtha' dag gzhil/ lnga pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i phreng bas yon tan dang bsod nams shin tu che ba 'byung / drug pa 'byog med cing che chung ljid gnyis ka mnyam pa bug pa yod kyang rung ba dngul gyi ga'u rdza rnga lta bu'i nang bcug ba sger btags na nor rigs dbyar gyi char bzhin 'bebs/ bdun pa 'o ma dang chus bkrus pa'i khu ba bud med mo gsham la byin pas bu bden por 'byung / brgyad pa rtag tu mgo bor bcangs na me dang rkun po'i 'jigs las skyob/ bcu pa dang bcu gcig pa sngar bzhin mnyam pa gser gyi rdza rnga 'dra nang bcug pa mgul du bcangs na rtag par nor dang phrad pa sogs gcig tsam lus gnas su bcangs pa'i bsod nams kyang / rak+ṣa mgo bor bye ba ste/ /rna ba rnams la bye ba bcu/ /mgul par bye ba bdun nyid de/ /dpung par bsod nams khri thob bo/ /rak+ṣa mgul par btags pa (162na)yi/ khyi dag shi —224

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)bar gyur pa na/ /drag po'i spyan sngar skye 'gyur na/ /mi yis bsod nams cis mi thob/ /ces bshad pa'i nang nas ru rak+ṣa e ka mu kha sogs kyi skyes byung ba'i lan dngul lnga bcu ma/ gser zho sum cu/ gla gor bcu bdun/ thus kha dog sna lnga yug re/ mi sna gnyis la rdzong ba bzabs te thon/ 'phags pa lha/lha ri bla ma/ tre bo blo bzang chos skyong sogs bsnyen rdzogs gsar rnying bcu dgu /ngag dbang sprul sku sogs dge tshul dgu /dge bsnyen gnyis rnams bsgrubs/ nyer bdun la rta tshag rje drung / gong dkar chos sde'i bla gra /tre bo hor tshang chos rje bcas par pha dam pa lugs kyi 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge'i rjes gnang dang / rang rtsom mdzad bcu legs byas yongs 'du'i snye ma'i lung bklags/ dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse ba dge legs rgyal mtshan gyis phar phyin 'grel pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gyi rgyugs sprad/nyer dgur stod la dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang gi dpung rogs su 'gro mi dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu ji nong gi bu lha dbang dpal 'bar/ da'i ching kho lo che'i er te ni tha'i ji/ja'i sang nyi shu skor/ dkyus ma brgya rnams dang / che chen tha'i ji'i mi sna/ bra yag sku skye'i khri 'bul ba dka' bcu can drug cu/ li thang mkhan zur/ spe ser slob dpon/ zhang ston ri khrod pa'i bu/ brag nye'i rta 'bul ba lnga bcu/ bya bral ba bzhi bcu/ 'a shur thabs mkhas can bcu gnyis kyi ngo (162ba)bor byin rlabs dang dmangs la me tog gtor/ phyi dro khal kha u'i ring no yon 'bor bcas/ zi sna nang so sogs la snga ma bgyis grub pa'i gsol 'debs kyi lung dang / lha dbang dpal 'bar dang / er te ni tha'i ji sa la nyi shu/sto sgo chos rje/ li thang mkha zur/ spe ser slob dpon/ si wo rtse pa sogasal tshe dbang grub rgyal ma dang / phyag drug pa'i gtor dbang bar chad kun sel bskur/ gnam gang zhogs snga char lha sa'i bsnyen gnas ma tshor mtho ris kyi sa bon yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa phab/'di nas bzung nyin drug gi bar gter sgrom nas sman chab blangs pa bsten pas yan lag la 'phrod nyams che ba byung /—225—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pohor zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig la yer pa dga' ldan gsang sngags yang rtse ba shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis lam rim chung ba'i rgyugs sprad/ yang bzlog gi las sbyor chen mo'ang btsugs/ tshes bdun la lha sa byang gling pas sde pa mgron du bos pa'i skal ba gung tshigs thog ston mo rgyas pa ster bya dang bcas pa byung ba nang du dmag zor sogs nang skor ba dang gzhan mar phyi rol du bshams/tshes dgur tshoms chen du zur khang pas khri ston bdog pa'i tshan grangs bcas bteg pa'i tshe lha rtse chos sde'i bla zur don grub dpal bzang dang sku skye bstan 'jin rgya mtshos bgro gleng bgyis/ zur khang pa'i ma bur bka' bsgo byas rjes bye rdzing mkhan pos/ zil gnon dbang rgyal rdo rje/ chu bzang bla ma/sog tsan dan dgon gyi khri 'bul ba dbon po can/ ri shong dga' ldan rab brtan bla ma'i khri 'bul ba/ (163na)hor smad ta mer gan blo bzang gi khri 'bul ba/ da la'i khung tha'i ji'i ja'i sang pak+ṣi pha bu/ pā thur khung tha'i ji'i mi sna/ chog thu tha'i ji'i nu bo'i bsngo rten skyel mi dka' bcu bsod nams/a mdo btsan rgod can ngo bo lnga/ spang skyes can bzhi/ dbang rgyal can gsum bcas par ja gral/shog gsum pos rta go bdun byung /tshes bcur zhwa dmar sprul pa'i skus rta bcu bdun/ gos phyi nang sogs cho me rje sgar pa'i spyan ltos bzang po brkyang ba dang / mjal bar mol mchid rgyas par byung zhing grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang phul/mkhan tshang rab 'byams pa/ sku skye blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ khun dur er khe da'i ching sogs gsar 'byor brgya skor gyis gser dngul gos dar sogs kyi dngos po byin/ gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcad kyis rgyal rdzongs btang /tshes bcu gcig la 'brug pa sprul skus gos phyi nang sogs bdog pa'i skyes dang bcas mjal zhabs phyi rags bsdus dang bcas par gur nas bshad pa'i phyag rdor 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang phul/ tshes bcu bdun la chos 'khor rgyal mkhan gra kha shas kyis tsha zho grangs sngon 'gro'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsungs/ bkra shis pā thur tha'i ji 'khor bcas/ da la'i khung tha'i ji dang er ge —226

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)de'i ching gi mi sna/ rgyal pa chos rje/ mtsho sna sku skye/ ser theg chen gling du sde pa bos pa'i skal ba spomasabacas skyel mi byes smad kyi slob dpon spyi gnyer dge skos sogs dang phrad/ tshes bco brgyad la 'phags pa lhas (163ba〉sku gsum thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rten sogs kyi bdog pa mthon po/ tshogs 'gyed dang bcas gra tshang nas mgon po tshe dpag med kyi rdul tshon dang 'brel pa'i tshe chog mdzad/tshes nyi shu dang nyer gcig la rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che dang bka' gter sogs kyi gsung 'phros shin tu smar ba byung / nyer gsum nas khro rol dang tshe bdag bstan mdos rnams btsugs/ rtse gdong zha khas drung rin po tshes thub dbang gi li sku/ gnas bcu'i bris thang / dngul phor/ gos phyi nang /ja ras sogs kyi skyes rgya cher stsal zhing mjal/ bkur bzos rnams sngar ltar phul/ ja gsum gyi bar bka' mchid kha shas bstar ba'i sdebs su byang 'grul gsar 'byor a ra na can mi ngo bdun/dbon chung can lnga/ bo shog ji nong gi khri 'bul ba gnyis/ a mdo a brag gi nu bo can gsum/ a mdo smad pa'i rta 'bul ba nyi shu/ li thang mkhan zur/ khyams pa dang rngod a rig dgon bla ma/ bde chen chos 'khor ba'i bdag po sku skye/ rigs 'dzin stobs ldan pa'i bu/ gong dkar gnas chung pa/ sde pa blo bzang sbyin pa'i dgun gos skyel mi blo bzang don yod/ rdo rje brag rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i skur gos phyi nang ja ras sogs skyes lan dbul zhing bka' bsgo phul/ khams kyi 'bul sdud bla ma dang sne'u sdong gi mi sna bcas par gang 'tsham gyi bdog pa dang bcas thon/nyer bzhir sne'u sdong rtse'i zhabs drung dpon g.yog rags bsdus la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma phul/sngon 'gro rgyun bshags la mdo sngags kyi dbye ba (164na)sogs cung zad spros/ phyi dro zhabs drung dpon g.yog la ja gral gyi thog sbug sil/ dkar dpyad/ dngul mdong / ja gos dar sogs shangs len gzabs pa dang sku rkyang la kye rdor dang phyag bzhi pa gtso gyur gyi bka' bsgo phul/ sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyi dgun gos skyel mi dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang a bo dngos grub kyang de khrod yod/nyer lngar spyi khang dkon mchog gis rje dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs gu ru mtshan brgyad/ mgon —227—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('apo phyag drug pa/ rtsis gzhi bas po ska snying gi don du thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa'i bris thang rnams bzhengasapa'i rgyab yig /mchod dpon pa'i nyams len du rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i las byang snying po bcud bsdus/ sngar nas 'dul ba'i skor snying po tsam zhig las med pa dang sdom rgyun gsar pa dang bcas rtsom bdun yod thog 'brog rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi gdan sa zhe gsum pa bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chos rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ ba so sprul pa'i sku dkon mchog nyi ma/ rgyal sras shes rab 'phel ba'i sprul sku blo bzang bstan 'dzin sogs bla chen/ gzhan yang don gnyer mang pos dgos tshul bzhin bstan pa rin po che spyi dang bye brag chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i lung rtogs bla nas blar 'phel na snyam/ dpyad shin tu bzod pa 'dul ba'i las chog mtha' gcod dang bcas pa 'khrul spong rnam rgyal gser mdog dpang chen lhun grub kyis don gnyis gling du 'dzugs rgyu'i ring 'tsho bcas bris/'brug pa sprul pa'i sku/ 'phags (164ba)pa lha/ lcags zam sprul sku/ pha bong kha'i gdan sa chos rje ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ rgyal pa chos rje/ chab mdo rje drung / ngag dbang sku skye/ sbos dga' sku skye/gong dkar chos sde'i cho ge yod pa dge slong 'phrin las pa/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ sngagasarams pa skyes mchog /sngags rams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang / chos rje zil gnon rdo rje/ dpal grong sngags rams pa/ sngags rams pa blo bzang chos ldan/ ldan ma sku skye/ 'dar ba rje drung blo gsal bstan 'dzin/ rtar mdo ngag dbang lhun grub/ sman thang pa mgon po tshe ring sogs dbang cha gcig la tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang phul/ co ne'i khri 'bul ba ngo bo bzhin byin rlabs dang / lnga mchod chen mo'i gling me shin tu bzhes pa rgan sa kyang ma dran zer/ nyer drug la gong gi chos gsan pa'i steng /rta tshag rje drung / gser mdog can lcang ra slob dpon/ bla ma stag lung pa bcas lnga bcu skor la sman bla sprul sku mtho brtsegs/ ba ri lugs kyi mi g.yo ba sngon po/ klu dbang rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga pa/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i nang nas rdo rje dbyangs can ma dang / dbyangs can lha lnga/ gdugs dkar rnams kyi rjes gnang phul/ rgyal po bar ma'i dbu sgor chung ba lcam sring / rwa sgreng mkhan po'i mi sna dang phrad/—228—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)nyer bdun la chos gsan pa gong steng sems dpa' sprul sku ngag dbang phun tshogs/ gnas rnying sprul sku ngag dbang kun dga' bde legs/ lha rtse bla zur don (165na)grub dpal bzang / rnam gling chos mdzad ngag dbang blo gsal/ dar mo sman rams pa/ dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa/ blo bzang don yod sogs bzhi bcu skor la sme brtsegs dud ka /'jam dbyangs chos skor nas dpa' gcig /lusadakyil/ nang sgrub/ gsang sgrub rnams kyi rjes gnang dang /nyer brgyad la 'brug pa sprul sku/ 'phags pa lha/ rta tshag /sems dpa'/ rgyal mkhan po/ pha bong kha pa/ gnas rnying / ngag dbang / zur chen/ ldan ma rnams kyi sku skye/ sger pa dang 'dar pa rje drung /'dar lo/ dge slong 'phrin las pa/ lcag ra slob dpon/ stag lung sgra pa/ mchod dpon pa/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ chos rje zil gnon pa/ sngags rams pa blo bzang skyes mchog /ngag dbang dpal bzang / ngag dbang dge legs/ dkar brag pa/ rnam gling cho semadzad/ rgyal ba dbu mdzad sogs nyer lngar khros ma nag mo'i byin rlabs grub mtshams sngon ma'i chos gsan pa/ rgyal ba'i ring 'tsho spel mi sum cu dang bcas par bde mchog dkar po'i dbang dang sgrol ma rgyal mtshan ma'i rjes gnang / phyi dro dpal mo lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang phul/ stod kyi sku rim brtag pa dang star chags bcas mang ja gnyis re'i thog bshad grwa rnams kyis mdo sgrub/ sngags gra rnams kyis gtor bzlog /'phyong rgyas su dpal ri bas gshin rje nag po sum bsgril/ smin grol gling pas gshin rje dregs (165ba)pa 'joms byed/ gong dkar du rdo rje brag pa dang / pa nam du brag la bas wor rka'i glang chen sna bsgyur/ lha khang du smra bo lcog pa/ lha rtser chu mig pa/ ngam ring du bkra bzang pa/ 'ol dgar brag sna ba rnams kyis khro rol/ gtsang 'gram du sgrol ma ba/ ngam ring du nub dgon pa dang brag dkar chu bzang pa so sos tshe bdag gi gtor bzlog /rin spungs su nges gsang rdor gling pas 'char ga'i mdos/ gzhis rtser 'ug pa lung pas mgon po g.yul bzlog /'od mchog pas yang gsang dme drag po/ gung mkhar du bon grong pas khro chu/ ka tshal du bla ma zur pas yang bzlog rnams kyi zor —229

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (po'aphen/ gong gsal rnying dgon bcu drug nas dgra mnan re dang so so'i 'brel mtshungs byed myong nas rgyab chos pa rnams kyis sher snying bzhi 'bum bdun khri drug stong / gdugs dkar stong tshar/ tshe gzungs bdun stong / bstan don la rgya'i gegs sel du smin grol gling pas khra 'brug /dpal ri bas btsan thang /rdo rje brag pas bsam yas/ brag la bas rtsis kyi lha khang / chu mig pas grom pa rgyang / sgrol ma bas gtsang 'gram rnams su dgra sri dur sri 'phung sri gtso gyur gyi sri gnon/ lha sar rgyal pa mkhan gra sum cus dmag zor ma'i bskang bshags dang mjug tu gtor rgyag sde pa'i sku rim du dpal lha lcog tu zam so'i rgyal mtshan dang bskang gso brgya/ sngags khang du rgyud stod pa dang / dga' ldan du smad pa rdor slob the ba'i bzhi bcu res zhag drug par ya ma rā dza'i sngags rgyun dang bdun par drug cu pa'i gtor (166na)rgyag /dga' ldan tshogs chen du ja tshul thog sher snying 'gro gang che/ spong dag gra pa rer gshor khal re ma'i rtsis ri bo bde chen/ byams chen pa/ myug chos gling pa/ mtshan sgrog pa rnams brgya re la zla gcig bar gzungs 'dus nyi khri sum stong bdun brgya nyer lnga/ sher snying drug khri drug stong / sgrol ma chig khri nyis stong / gdugs dkar sum stong / tshe gzungs chig 'bum dgu khri lnga stong / shel dkar sogs rdzong 'go lngar dge dgon tsho bsdus brgya rer gra tog gser gsum so so nas chig khri nyis brgya nyi shu/ tshe gzungs drug khri sum brgya/ sher snying nyi khri chig stong / ris med dgon ang dang gnyis yan la mang 'gyed/ nad rims zhi zhing lo chu legs pa'i rim gror yul che chung dang bstun pa'i bka' 'gyur/yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ bskal bzang / gzungs 'dus rnams gang 'grub/ klu gtor/ klu bcos/ ma rgyal gyi mdos shar lho mtshams su bskyal/ rdzong 'go che ba rnams nas dgra lha dpang bstod rgyas pa/ nged rang gi rim gror gnyis rtser gangs can chos 'phel ba dang lhun po rtse pa/ lha rtser chos sde ba dang grang mo che ba/ bsam grub dgon gsar ba/ thub bstan dge 'phel ba/ shel dkar du chosasde ba dang / snye nang du dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling / pa nam du zha lu ba/ khams lho rdzong dang tsha pa mdzo sgang du dge dgon khag rnams bsdoms bka' 'gyur chig brgya nyi shu/ sgrol ma sa ya gcig dang sum —230

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)'bum (166ba)bzhi khri lnga stong nyis brgya/ tshe gzungs bye ba gcig dang sa ya gsum chig 'bum nyis khri/ gdugs dkar chig khri brgyad stong / sher snying sa ya gcig dang chig 'bum bzhi khri bzhi stong /sman bla chig khri nyis stong / lha sa ra sgo dud chig stong bdun brgya nyi shu skor la dud rer ya ju mkhar nyag do re/ ga slong nyis brgya skor la ja ldur rag 'gag re/ tshes bcu bzhi dang bco lngar bde yangs pa brgyad gra res/ lha sa/ ra mo che/ po ta la gsum du brgya mchod srog blu brgya/ na mnyam brgya dang brgyad la ston mo/ sde pa'i sku rim du rgyal rtser dge lugs gtsang gra bdun/ rnam gling du dga' ldan chos 'khor ba/ rin spungs su 'bras yul skyed tshal ba/ phun gling du rang gra/ khams phyogs kyi dge dgon kha shas bcas par bka' 'gyur so bdun/ rgyud 'bum/ bskal bzang / 'bum/ brgyad stong pa tshar re/mtshan brjod sum cu/ sgrol ma sum khri/ sher snying sa ya gcig drug 'bum brgyad khri drug stong / gdugs dkar bzhi khri lnga brgya/ tshe gzungs nyis 'bum chig khri sum stong / srog blu brgya/ na mnyam brgya dang brgyad la sbyin pa/ khra 'brug chos skyong gis bskul ma'i 'bras spungs dang chos 'khor rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang gi rtser rgyal mtshan ser po re/ tsher gseb chos stong chen po'i lung bstan ltar ser 'brasaganyis su spong dag rnams bsgrubs/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la lcags zam sprul sku blo gsal nyi zla 'od 'bar dbang phyug grub pa'i shing rta (167na po gung lo bcu bzhi'i steng brtag gnyis/ rdo rje gur/ sdom gsum rab dbye rnams kyi rgyugs byung / lho brag pa dbang chen lhun grub grogs bcas kyis ster byin 'gyed bcas gzimasachung brtan bzhugs su grags pa byas/ stag rtse zhabs drung / mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ rab brtan gyi dpon mo/ kho shor khor chi tha'i ji'i dpon mo bu yos/ g.yon ru dga' ldan co tha'i ji'i mi sna dar gan chos rje/ 'dul ba chos rje'i pha er khe dge slong / khri 'bul ba dka' bcu/ no yon dka' bcu/ a dang can ngo bo bzhi/ ka shod dga' ldan rab brtan gyi khri 'bul ba/ nyang stod skyed sbug sprul sku/ tre bo shi ral thu dang ldan ma sku skye sogs la ja gral/ log tri'i las sbyor che ba sngar bzhin btsugs/—231—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khoratshes gsum nas bzung gra tshang nas nyin star mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten ring 'tsho'i cho ga zhag shas mdzad/ 'phags pa lha thegs gdong mjal kha'i thog na bza' skor cha tshang /rdor dril/ zhal dkar/sbug sil/ dkar dpyad/ dngul gyi tha phag /gos phyi nang / snam bu/ ja bur ltang / grum tse/ ras cha sogs skyes lan gzengs bstod/ ngag dbang sprul sku/ dbon po rab bstan sogs drag zhan tshang mar rdzong ba 'tshems med ngos sprul sku rin po cher bstan 'gror phan cha lugs gnyis thad nas dgos tshul dang bka' bsgo phul/ 'phyong rgyas pa mkhas btsun rgya mtsho gral skor byed pa'i sngon 'gror gra tshang gi 'don cha yongs rdzogs kyi rgyugs sprad/ stag (167ba tshe shetha'i jir smi gnyis kyi bar snying po don gsum gyi 'phod dmigs zhib mor khrid/tshes bzhir mo gu chi thur dpon mo bu bcas ngo bo bcu gcig /stag rtse tha'i ji/ myug pa spun/sgar gra tshang bla mar 'gro mi 'or pa chos mdzad/ 'phags pa lha'i phyag mdzod du 'gro mi chab nag dbon po/ sngags pa lhun grub sogs dang mjal phrad dang chab nag dbon por bka' bsgo bgyis/tshes brgyad la chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'i ngor mgon po a sto ra'i gtor chag bskang bstod cha tshang ba bkod/ tshes bcu gcig nas gra pa grangs bcad kyis gza' mdos btang zhing bla mkhyen ngag dbang pha bur ja gral dang / tshes bcu bzhir spen snar 'grub sbyor thog rnam sras gan mdzod du nged rang ngos 'gro'i rnam sras kyi gtor gzhi btsugs shing grangs bcad kyis thugs dam rgyas par bkang /tshes bco lngar thang lha gtsor brtan gyi gzabs gsol dang bcas pa bstar/ sa'i tshangs pa bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po sras 'bangs 'dam du 'degs gdong gi byin rlabs ja gral/ rgyal sras kun dga' rab brtan/ bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyi dpon mo/ rme ru bla zur/ li thang mkhan po/ de mo spang leb bla ma/ khal kha dza ya paṇ+ḍita'i mi sna sogs dang phrad/ tshoms chen steng nas sog dmangasabargyad brgya skor la me tog gtor/—232

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)tshes bcu drug la gong dkar chos sde'i chos 'chad pa dge slong 'phrin las par ster bya dang bcas rang gnas su thon/ tshes bcu bdun nas hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig gi bar gyi dmar gshin rje mthu stobs dregs pa'i bdag po (168na 〉 sgogs zab rgyas can gyi srung bzlog bsad mnan sbyor bas phyi nang gsang ba'i bar gcod g.yul las rgyal ba'i thabs lag tu blangs/ lho 'brug sogs dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang 'bacas pa 'a lo bsgoms zla ba dang zla ba zhag gis/ zhag dus tshone kyis bshig pa'i gnam sa lto dkrug /mchod rten kha gso sogs nyi ldog gi rim gro/ gnam gang la mchi bdag bzlog pa rnams 'char can byas/ bod khams spyir nad yams mu ge 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang lo chu mi phyugs sogs 'phel phyir yul gru che chung dang bstun yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ yig brgya 'bum nas khri bar gang 'grub/ che chung bstos med kyis bsangs dang rgyags rngan/ dgra lha dpangs bstod/ bstan ma dang gzhi bdag mchod pa/ tsher gseb chos skyong gi gsung bzhin sde pa'i rim gror gsas khang dang brag dbar ba gnyis kyis 'bum brgya gnyis/ stod dmag 'gro khyab che ba'i gtang rag tu rgyud stod smad/ sngags khang dge slong can/ dga' ldan/ rtser/ gnas chung rnams su brgyad gras gtang rag gi bskang ba nyin gang ma/hor zla bstoganyis pa'i tshes gcig la gong dkar blo bzang bsod nams kyi dad rten 'dra 'bag /sgrub khag rnams kyi dmigs rten rdo rje drag po rtsal/ tshe bdag /zhi rkang / log tri/ bstan ma bcu gnyis rnams kyi thang sku zur 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyis lag dar bris pa/ sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtsho'i lam rim brgyud pa'i thang ka (168ba)gram pa ba dge slong blo bzang dang / gong dkar blo bzang dpal 'byor/ 'phyong rgyas pa ngag dbang nam mkha' gsum gyis gra tshang dkon gnyer 'jog dngul la phab par sum brgyas bdun cu lhag bcas spams mtho byas skabs rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil thang / rdo pa blo bzang bkra shis kyis dge skos 'jog la dngul gyi pad sder phul ba/ dga' ldan rtsedabang dpal bzang ra la khang dmar du la dwags pa'i blon po shākya can gyi dmag gdong bsur yongs—233

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khorapa'i pha rol dgra sde'i dpung las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshe bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul ba'i snyan shal rnams kyi kha byang dang rgyab yig /dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu dang shun gzhis ka ba dngos grub nor bus bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ rang gi brjed byang du pad gling gtum po'i las byang mthong bas rnam grol rgyal byed slob dpon chos dbang rgya mtsho'i ngor smon lam rnams brtsams/tshes bzhir shel dkar chos sde ba dka' bcu gsung rab bstan 'dzin gyis mngon rtogs rgyan dang / phar phyin 'grel pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan spyi don mtha' gcod dang bcas pa'i rgyugs sprad/tshes drug la phun tshogs gling du par gsar brkos rang rtsom gras bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung / dkyil chog dpa' bo'i grong 'jug /dkar chag che brjod sdebs nyis brgya sum cu/ kun mkhyen bu'i las brgya'i ṭīk+ka/ zha lu pa ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i byams smon 'grel pa tshogs (169na)gnyis chu rgyun/ zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dum bu gnyis pa bshad pa'i rgyud gyi 'grel pa mes po'i zhal lung dang / phyi rgyud rtsa mdo yan gyi 'grel pa rnams 'byor/tshes brgyad la phur sgrub sngar bzhin btsugs steng grangs bcad kyis khro rol slang gang ma bdun phrag bar bsgrubs te gtor ma 'phangs/ tshes bcu gsum la dpon mo tshe ring gi bu mon khu/ dpon mo/no yon dge tshul gyi tsha bo bstan 'dzin dge slong / mer gan tha'i ji'i bu dpon mo dang bcas pa/dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi mi sna tshogs gsog rab 'byams pa dang 'di ga'i mi sna che chen dar rgyas/ bstan 'dzin kho sho'u chi'i mi sna dar rgyas dge slong / er te ni dge slong / a chi thu chos rje'i mi sna sbyar go chi/ er te ni dge tshul/ yi kha bsdo'i bsngo rten skyel mi phun tshogs dbang po/'on du su bla ma'i mi sna er te ni dge slong / pā thur gyi mi sna dar khan dbon po/ da la'i hung tha'i ji'i mi sna sna bo khu ban+de/ a chi mgon po'i mi sna/ rgyal mo rdo rje rab brtan gyi sman pa sogs la ja gral dang / gsar 'grul rnams kyis gser dngul ja gos dar sogs kyi bdog pa bteg /phyi dro stag lung zur pa sku mched/ bsam yas dkar po ba/ mtshal pa'i lcam/ shag lho pa'i bu/ mdo sngags gling slob —234

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)dpon/ rgyud stod zhal snga nas/ nag shod bla mar 'gro mi se ra ha sdong dge slong / ldan ma rab brtan pha bu/ ra lhag ga (169ba༄ dbon po/ rwa sgreng mkhan po'i bsngo rten skyel mi/ rngod rab brtan ma bu sogs dang mjal phrad/ mkhan thog rdugs pa'i bsngo rten bla chas cha 'grig /gser dngul ja gos dar ras sogs mthon por btegs par sa lam gyi bar gcod sel ba'i bsngo smon rnam dag bgyis/'di pa phyi nang mi mtshungs pa'i sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yod/ ldan ma rab brtan gyis rta brgyad/ra nyag sha khri dbon gyis rta bcu dgu 'dug /tshes bcu bdun la 'un du su bla mas ring 'tsho'i dngos po tshan grangs dang 'gyed bcas gra tshang nas mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i cho ga mdzad/ blo bzang mgon po rab brtan dang byang rtse chos rjer byin rlabs/ spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtsho dga' ldan tshe dbang gi sar 'gro gdong 'tshe ba las bskyab pa'i bka' bsgo/ bslab bya/ 'di dgongs nas nyer brgyad bar mi mthun phyogs zhi byed du dmigs sgo gsum mi 'da' ba'i bcad rgya dam por bgyis/tshes bco brgyad nas g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtang rag gra sa khag gsum du byas pa'i tshoms chen du tshe bdag sogs snga 'gyur/ gra khang du mgon chos sogs gsar ma/ de los bka' 'gyur khang du gur zhal las mkhan sogs chos srung spyi dang bye brag thams cad la gzabs gsol shin tu rgyas pa gtor ma'i ri bo/ sman rag gi rgya mtsho/ dar gyi lda ldi/ go mtshon spyan gzigs/ mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa kun bzang mchod par 'gran pa spros/ nyer gsum nas (170na)dus dgra'i dbang po'i sgrub mchod/ 'phar zhag lngar phur pa'i khro rol btang /nyer brgyad la rme ru spyi sos mchod yon gnyis bos pa'i skal bar 'khris su bcar ba'i steng 'phyos pa sku skye lha sar gra skor byed pa'i bshad phud byas/ phyi rol tu gnyug mar gnas pa'i tshogs dang bcas par dkar spro dmar dro shin tu rgyas pa bdog pa'i dngos po brkyang bas thams cad tshim/bla ma gsar rnying las sne ba tshor byin rlabs dang/ dmangs la ja gral/ srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa —235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (podang sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos gung thang sri gnon dus mchode khang so so'i snyan shal/ dge slong blo bzang don grub kyis gra tshang gi sku drin bsab ched dngul srang nyer gsum dang zho bdun las grub pa'i rnam bum dang bcas pa'i kha byang / zhal snga nas legs pa don grub gra dmangs dang bcas pa'i ngor blo gsal gling du spo 'bor chog thu chos rje dge 'dun dpal 'byor gyis mtshan brjod 'don pa'i thebs su dngul srang lnga bcu/ sku 'dra bzhed thebs kyang sbyar te gtsang khang du bzhugs pa'i gsol 'debasasmon lam/ sding po che sprul sku'i 'phrin lan snyan tshig nas drangs pa bris/ gnam gang la lho brag dkar po bla ma dang / rdor legs dang phrad/ /dgung lo re bzhi par ris med 'dus sde khag nas rim bzlog sogs kyi ched du rim gro dang / rta tshag rje drung gis gtsos skya ser khri tsho lhag la dam pa'i chos kyi zab chos gnang zhing / dga' ldan bde chen gling gsar 'dzugs dang gzhung sger gyi byas can khag la bdag rkyen stsal skor sogs/drag po zhes pa lcags sbrel gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i dpal ldan srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa dang rten 'bul sogs rgyas par bgyis/ tshoms chen du dga' ston (170ba)nyin dang por mchod yon/ dbon khag /rta tshag rje drung rin po che sogs rgyun 'khod drung 'khor/ gra sa phan tshun/ pha bong kha/rme ru sogs kyi bla ma khri gdan zur/ dbu chos sne'u sdong rtse nas sde pa blo bzang sbyin pa'i gser yig pa blo bzang chos ldan/ gdan sa gong 'og gi mgron gnyer/ dgon che chung / rdzong gzhis sogs kyi legs skyes bstar mi mtha' klas pa/ rol cha gral sa sogs sngar mu bzhin dang / nyin gnyis par rgyal po skor rags bsdus/ rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling yongs rdzogs/ rin chen —236

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)rgyan cha gzhung gi lnga bcu'i steng / sde dbon che chung nang nam drung 'khor sger rgyan bcas bdun cu don lnga/dzum lang rgyal po'i mi sna sogs 'dzoms thog bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun/rdzas brgyad/ mchod sprin rnam brgyad spro ba sogs kyi legs lam rgyas par spel/ rtser sde pa lhun po rtse pa/ mtshal pa/ stag rtse/ lnga ba thon 'bog gong / lho pa dpal bzang / 'bar bla mar 'gro mi ser smad rabs 'byams pa ngag dbang nam mkha'/ nag tshang dbang chen/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ rgyal po'i sras mo kun dga' rab brtan sogs la ja gral dang / rin chen rgyan cha ba byings la byin rlabs/tshes bzhin dga' khri rin po che blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ dbon po/ smad rgyud dbu mdzad/ dung dkar (171na〉sku skye tshangs dbyangs 'brug sgra/ rgyu pa me dbang / rnam gling pa pha bu/ shag byang pa/ snye dgon pa/ mig pa/ o rod pha bu/ gzhis rtse rdzong sdod gnas gsar dbang rgyal/ rgyal :rdzong sdod rdo dgon pa ba/ 4 ring rdzong sdod sgog mkhar ba/ pa nam rdzong sdod tsha ba gru pa/ rtse la sgang rdzong sdod sgang pa/ lhun rtse rdzong sdod dkar brag pa/ rin spungs rdzong sdod skyid sbug pa/ rgya mda' rdzong sdong bde gling pa/ sku rab rdzong sdod 'byor rgyas pa/ rgya mtsho gzhis sdod dga' bzhi ba/ lha bu gzhis sdod re ma ba/seng rdzong sdod mi phreng smad pa/ lha khang gzhis sdod dam ru ba/ chu shur rdzong sdod ri zur pa/ 'grong rtse rgyal phur/ lha sa byang gling pa'i mi ngo sogs la ja gral thog khri rin po ches chos dang 'brel ba'i 'bel gtam shin tu smar/ khams pa rdzogs chen pa pad+ma rigs 'dzin dang snying tig gi skor la zhib cha'i rgyu mtshan mang dag dang zhang ston lhun grub dang yang skad cha sna tshogs byung / phyi ma red gnas chung sku rten par sme brtsegs kyi bkru byab srung gsum gyi rjes/ sngags pa lhun grub/ bla mkhyen ngag dbang / bon po zla ba/ bkra shis tshe brtan/ spyan g.yas pa rnams dang phrad/tshes lngar dge slong blo bzang don grub kyis dngos po maṇ+ḍal du bgyis te gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa bstar zhing mchod sprin rnam brgyad pa tshor byin rlabs byas/ 'di nyin nas tshes bcu bzhi'i bar tshe (171ba)bsnyen gnad du bsnun/—237

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (potshes brgyad la dbu mdzad kyis cho 'phrul thog nyin brgyad bar brgya mchod dang jo bo rnam gnyis la snam sbyar phul ba'i kha byang / gnyan chen thang ltar bzabs gsol thog 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar kha yig /dpal grong sngags rams pas bka' gdams glegs bam nas bstan pa sogs paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa'i 'khrungs rabs gra tshar bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag bco brgyad chos rje'i gsung gis bskul ba'i rtse gdong zhabs drung bsod nams bstan 'dzin dbang po byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs/ se ra ha sdong mi tshan gyi ngor nged rang dang sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i ring 'tsho/ blo bzang rab brtan gyis bskul ba'i tsha mig mkhan po blo bzang bstan 'phel gyi gsol 'debs/ kha rag khyung btsun mar snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang / rtses dang ngag dbang mkhas btsun gyis gra skor btang dus gra tshang du srang nyer gsum gyi dngul skong phul ba'i kha yig /gram pa dge slong blo bzang ngag dbang / gong dkar blo bzang dpal 'byor/'phyong rgyas pa ngag dbang nam mkha' gsum gyis ring 'tsho'i skabs spyi 'bul du gos dmar 'jam sang dra lcags gan jus sangs rgyas stong sku can gcig gis gtsos snam sbyar bcu bdun dang —/ zangs dmar gyi ka 'o ra che legs cha bcas phul ba'i kha byang le tshan/ ri sgo chos sde'i dbu mdzad dge 'dun rab brtan gyi ngor nged rang (172na)dang sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho thun mong gi ring 'tsho spyi sger bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam/ bā khan bzhes bskul ba'i gsol 'debs rnams bkod/tshes dgu nas bzung grangs bcad kyis dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba 'khor bcas la gzabs gsol zhag bdun btang ba'i tshe/ tshugs nyin kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa sogs lha chen dgyes pa'i mtshan ma dngos su bstan/ grangs bcad khag gnyis kyis 'phung dur na dang sprel lo'i keg sri ngan pa gnon pa'i sgrub pa dang / gra tshang byings la phye ring bzlog bcas btsugs/tshes bcu bzhir nang mtshams grol ba'i sde par tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster bskur/ tshes bco lngar gling stod sku skye ngag dbang gzhon nu lo bcu bzhi'i steng cha lag bco brgyad shin tu byang ba'i rgyugs —238

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)sprad/ tshes bcu drug la smon lam chen mor gra pa rer dngul zho do re'i khyon srang bdun brgya re dgu/yang gra pa rer ya ju nyag phyed gsum re'i khyon khor drug ma sum brgya go gcig /lha sa/ ra mo che/ dmar lcags la zhal gser/ snyan shal/ spong dag la nged rang gi gos mang ba/ yol ba bla bre dngul dpyad/mchod chas/ dkar dpyad/ sag thag me mda' sga rta drel sogs gra pa rer dngul zho do re/ 'bo de ci'i phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad pa re/ lcags kro le ma re bcas 'gyed sna lnga phul te tshogs bsags/ la mo chos skyong chen po'i lung bstan nged (172ba)rang gi brtag pa/ rdo rje brag dang gter ston rin po che'i mnal ltas sogs go bstun pa'i gegs sel du sri gnon kha shas dgos pa po ta la/ lha sa/bsam yas/ khra 'brug sogs gnas chen rdzong gzhis bsdoms bco lngar gra tshang / rdo rje brag /smin grol gling sogs rnying dgon 'brel mtshungs nas gra slob bcu gnyis res sgrub zhag bdun re sngon 'gro'i 'phung sri/ dur sri/ god sri/ nad sri/ dgra sri rnams gtsor bton te mnan/ nged rang gi rim gror phun tshogs gling du rang gra/ lha rtse 'og min gling pa/ pa nam du mtshan sgrog pa/ zha lu ba ste brgya pa khag bzhi/ lha sar thang skya ba/ gzhis rtser myug chos gling pa/ yer par rang gra ste brgya pa gsum/ ser 'bras su ja tshul sum cu re bcas bka' 'gyur lnga bcu nga gcig /'bum nyis brgya dang bcu/ brgyad stong pa chig stong nyi khri/ sher khri dang khri brgyad stong pa bcu gnyis re/ mtshan brjod bzhi stong lnga brgya/gzungs 'dus chig brgya/ gdugs dkar sum 'bum nyi khri bzhi stong lnga brgya/ sher snying sum khri chig stong / sgrol ma sum khri bzhi stong lnga brgya bco lnga/ sāts+tsha tshig 'bum/ tshe gzungs sa ya gnyis dang drug stong / pha bong khar chab gtor chig khri/ gzhis rtser zha lu pa dang / pa nam du ngor pas 'chi med rnga sgra/pho brang du bkra shis chos sde bas sgrol dkar/ rgyal rtse brag la bas lcags sdong ma rnams la brten pa'i tshe chog (173na 'chi blu dang bcas pa gra slob nyi shus zhag bco lnga'i bar 'gro gang che/ shel brag tu smin grol gling pa gra slob drug gis zhag gsum gyi bar tshogs brgya/ po ta la'i zhol du chu spe steng pas dbang phyug gi zor mdos brgya tshar/ ka tshal du bla ma zur pa gra slob bco lngas bdun phrag sngon song gi —239

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khoradrag po dmar chen gyi gtor bzlog /rgyab chos su brag dbar ba brgya dang gsum gyis zhag brgyad bar sher snying 'gro gang che/ gra tshang nas brgya bzhi kha shas/ sde pa'i sku rim du gzhis rtser gangs can chosa'aphel ba/ rnam rgyal du dga' ldan rab brtan pa/ rgyal rtser dge dgon tsho bsdus/ rin spungs su byams chen pa/ shel dkar du chos sde ba/ lha sar gsas khang pa rnams brgya res zla gcig bar bka' 'gyur bcu gsum/ gser 'od dang gzungs 'dus brgya re/ mtshan brjod tshig 'bum chig khri sum stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu/ nyi khri dang phal chen bcu re/ gdugs dkar nyis 'bum sum khri brgyad stong lnga brgya nga gnyis/ sher snying lnga 'bum sum khri nyis stong / sgrol ma sum khri drug stong drug brgya nyi shu/ tshe gzungasas ya gcig dang nyi khri chig stong / gong dkar chos sde bas tshe dpag med lha dgu/ rdo rje brag pas lcagasasdong ma/ do bo rdzong du smra bo lcog pas tshe dpag med mtsho skyes rdo rje/ 'phyong rgyas su smin grol gling pasagater gsar tshe dpag med rnams kyi tshe chog /gra slob bcu gsum res nyin bdun (173ba)gyi bar 'chi blu cho ga dang bcas rgyas par btang / chu bo rir nges gsang rdor gling pa drug gis nyin gsum gyi bar tsho gis brgya/ pha bong khar rang gra sum cus su tsā 'bum zer/ gtor ma brgya rtsa khri/ rgyal du dmag zor mar bskang bshags khri/ lha sar gsang sngags byang chub gling pa gra slob brgyas sgrub zhag bdun bar khro rol gtor bzlog /btson dong thar bstogasum/ ra lug ba lang sogs brgya/ nya 'bum rnamasakyi srog blus/ dus bzang la lha sar mchod pa sna lnga brgya tshar/ dbul phongs stong phrag la sbyin pa zas dang snam bu/ mchod rten brgyar sku dkar dar lcog /'di lo nas bzung zla ba byung ngo cog bzhin rgyal btsan ma gsum gyi mdos/ ris med dgon ang dang gnyis yan la mang ja re/ rtse shod thun mong gi rgyal du dmag zor mar bskang ba nyi khri chig stong sum brgya/ gur zhal beg tse gsum la chig stong sum brgya re/ gzhan tshor phyed nyis brgya re/ lhun rtser sde drug gis 'bum bcu/ sgrol ma chig khri lnga brgya/ sher snying bdun stong lnga brgya/ tshe gzungs tshig khri lnga stong / rnam gling du dga' ldan chos 'khor bas bka' 'gyur lnga/ po ta lar mi rus mi gcig pa gsum gyis rma bya chen mo'i gzungs ring nyer drug re/ dbus —240

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gtsang rdzong gzhis tshang ma'i lam zam rig gsos/ bod 'bangs spyi'i bde thabs su po ta lar gra tshang / lha rtse bkra bzang pa/ rgyal rtser brag la ba/ gong dkar du rdo rje brag pa rnams (174na)gra slob dgu res sdi g.yang nor bu mchog rgyal gyi sgrub pa bdun phrag re/ nad rims bzlog thabs su dbus gtsang gi rdzong gzhis sger khag sde dpon tshang mas yar ngor dgra lha dpangs bstod/ ma mdos/ rgyab chos su gzungs 'gro gang che/ rnam 'joms kyi khrus gsol rgyas pa/ stod phyogs kyi jus rim la gong dkar du rdo rje brag pa/ gzhi rtser 'ug bya lung pa/ pho brang du dpal ri ba ste gsum gyis mgon po g.yul bzlog /gzhi rtser sgrol ma phug pas tshe bdag gtor bzlog /rin spungs su nges gsang rdor gling pasa'achar ga'i mdos sgrub bdun rer smin rgyas/ so sor rgyab chos pa lnga bcu res sher snying 'gro gang che/gnas chung chos skyong gi bskul ma bzhin sde pa'i sku rim la do rdzong du don gnyis gling pas 'bum brgya/bstan srid spyi rim la lha sar gong dkar dkon gnyer bas gdugs dkar kyi mdos/ gsang sngags byang chub gling pas phye ring sa ya gnyis dang lnga khri brgyad stong lnga brgya/ trig khrom ma chig 'bum bdun khri lnga stong bdun brgya bsags/ spyi sgos kyi phan bde sgrub chos 'bad de lag tu blangs/ gling stod sku skye/ blo bzang chos ldan/ ngag dbang bzod pa rnams dang phrad cing / sku skyer chos gos/ sham thabs/ya ju khor drug rnams byin/tshes bcu bdun la kha rag khyung btsun mchod par gnang byung pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse mngags/nyer gcig la grong smad a bar la (174ba tsher chi blu dang byab 'khrus byas gram pa dge slong blo bzang ngag dbang can gsum gyis ster bya dang gra tshang nas 'bras gshongs dag snang mar rten pa'i ring 'tsho'i cho ga gsungs/ nyer lngar 'ol dgar bar gling don grub la khog zhugs shig byung ba 'ga' res rdzu'aphrul shin tu che bas thang lha yin tshul dang / la las de 'dra min sogs gleng sna tsho gos byung ba dbyangs 'char gyi mo 'di rang la lkog tu ma gyur pa zhig yod na'ang tshang mas ma mthong gshis yid ches khyad dang bcas gra tshang spyis chos skyong tshor bskang pa dang / gter ston rigs 'dzin chen po'ang gdan —241—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gedrangs te 'byung po'i rigs la lha sngags ye shes kyis skrod/ nged rang gis srung 'khor dang dmod bor zung 'jug gis thang lha yin zhing bsten pa bzang ngo zer ba dang / 'dre ngan yin no zer ba/ lha 'dre gang yang min pas chu babs su bzhag pa bzang zer ba'i zan ril gsum lha mo gsung byon ma dang lha chen rang gi thang sku'i drung zla bo mang ba dang bcas phul ba lha 'dre gang yang min pa'i chu babs su bzhag pa thon pa la mo bas dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags par gsungs pa dang mthun/nyer bdun la dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mo zangs rir thon gdong phrad pa dang lhan du a bar ming sring yod pa gsum gar ja gral bka' bsgo ster byin bgyis/ rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pas bdun gcig gi bar gdon rigs la ched gtad drag dmar sgrub pa'i 'jug sbyin sreg mdzad/ khyab bdag khra tshang (175na)pa chen po'i gra pa legs bshad rgya mtsho dang rin chen rgya mtsho gnyis kyis sgyu 'phrul gsang snying dang thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi brgyud 'debs las byang dang bcas pa'i rgyugs/ gnyis gas lo rer thugs rje chen po'i ma ṇi'i sgrub pa re dang / nyin re bzhin gsang snying rtsa rgyud dang mtshan brjod/ thugs rje chen po'i las byang brgyud 'debs dang bcas pa tshar re chag med 'don pa'i dam bca' byung / gnam gang la mon ge ching pā thur sogs brgya skor la bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa phab ste mngon mtho'i rgyu bskrun/hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la gsang sngags byang chub gling pas tshan grangs dang bcas 'bras gshongs dag snang mar brten pa'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ gong dkar dkon gnyer bas mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo lugs kyi ring 'tsho bdog pa dang bcas gdangs sogs babs chags bstar/ dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi mi sna snga phyi/ rwa sgreng mkhan po'i cho go las/ ba bu la/ 'un du su mkhan po'i mi sna er te ni dge slong dang / dge slong bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ dga' ldan da'i ching gi mi sna a chi thu dar khan chos rje/ u khor dhas/ pā thur tha'i ji'i bu dang mi sna pā thur khu thu chi sogs sog po gsar rnying nyis brgya skor la ja gral dang ma gan u du chi'i bsngo rten dngul ja gos dar —242

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)sag thag me mda' gyon pa rta sga sogs 'dug don bzhin 'khor ba'i — las sgrol zhing byang chub thob pa'i rgyur rgyas(175ba)btab/ bya yul mang ra'i mkhan po/ rwa sgreng mkhan zur gyi dbon po/ sde pa phu mdo ba/ dpon tshang tsha rong pa/ zi na nang so/ sku 'bum chos rje/ sbus srang gser khang pa'i nang mis dkar dro bteg cing bod pa brgya skor dang / yam bu'i mi sna sogs dang phrad/ bde chen chos 'khor ba'i sku skye gzhung rnam rab phyogs su byung bar brtag pa dgos tshul byung ba bzhin yin ngo shar ba mtshan ngag dbang chos rgyal dpal bzang du gsol/tshes gnyis la rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pas ster byin gzengs bstod 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsun bzlog sngon 'gro'i ring 'tsho rgyas par spel ba'i 'gron du dkon gnyer dpon/ gsang sngags byang chub gling slob dpon/ yam bu rgyal po'i mi sna rnams bsgrigs/ sdings po che'i sprul sku gshegs pa'i bsngo rten 'byor don ltar bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs bgyis/tshes gsum la g.yon ru dga' ldan bo shog thu khang gis dngul lnga bcu ma/ tha phag /mdong mo/ /gos phyi nang sogs mthon por bteg /gra tshang nas byang gter tshe dpag med kyi rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i cho ga btang / tshes lngar rtses dang blo bzang thogs med kyis gra skor bgyid pa'i sngon 'gror gra tshang gi 'don cha thams cad kyi rgyugs sprad/tshes brgyad nas sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos bdun gcig gi bar sman gyi sgrub pa mdzad/ tshes dgur gnas chung sku rten tshe dbang dpal 'bar la tshe (176na)rta'i dbang dang drag dmar gyi bka' bsgo bstar/ nged rang gi dge sbyor rten du mnga' bdag nyang gi drag dmar sogs nang bzhugs 'khor lo 'dri mi bzhi/ gzungs 'dri mi drung yig lnga dang bcas par bka' bsgo dang mdud pa byin/ gnyal pa blo bzang chos skyong gis sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi zhabrungs rabs mi g.yo ba ste gsum/ glang ra ba ngag dbang dpal bzang gis sman bla dang rje dge 'dun grub pa'i —243—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (po'abrungs rabs la lnga/ blo bzang don yod kyi bka' brgyad/ rtsis pa lhun grub kyis 'gro la rjes brtsem dang mthun pa'i 'khrungs rabs/ skyid thang nor bus byams pa tshe dpag med kyi brgya thang re rnams bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /sdings po che'i gra rigs rnams kyi ngor sprul sku myur 'byon gyi smon lam/ gsang sngags byang chub gling dbu mdzad ngag dbang nam mkha' dang / ngag dbang mkhas btsun gyis bskul ba'i rtsa gsum gsol 'debs/ ring 'tsho/ ja mchod gang la'ang bsgyur chog pa bdun rnam dag dang bcas pa/ rwa sgreng dbu mdzad rgyal mtshan bkra shis kyi ngor yan lag bdun pa'i nang dmigs bsal ring 'tsho blo ka gcig /bstan 'bar ma dang chos skyong gnyer gtad chang ba/ spe ser bla spyi thun mong gis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi ngor nged rang dang gter bdag gling pa'i gsol 'debs/ sems dpal sprul sku ngag dbang phun tsho gis kyi le'u tho'i 'go brjod/ sngags rams pa don (176ba)grub rgya mtsho dang gnyos btsun dbang rgyal lhun grub kyi bka' brgyad spyi dril zhi khro rnam rol gyi bsnyen yig yid bzhin dbang rgyal rnams brtsams/tshes bcu gnyis la dbu sgor chung ba/ no mun dge tshul/ no yon dka' bcu/ a dar bu bcas/dur bod chog thu'i bu er khe tha'i ji/ dpon mo bu bcas/ a sa la'i dpon mo/ bla ma dga' rab pa/ju ris er khe da'i ching gi bla ma phun tshogs cho me rje/ zur ri bla ma byed rgyu tshul khrims/ phan bde chos rje'i sku skye/ dza ya paṇ+ḍi ta'i mi sna bkra shis rnam rgyal/ rgyal thang khri 'bul ba nor bu can sogs sum cu skor la byin rlabs dang bong bu sku skye sogs dmangs la ngos phrad/tshes bco lngar sngags pa chu spe steng par mdos sogs kyi dri rmed byas/ tshes bcu drug la sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos byad 'grol mdzad/ tshes bcu bdun nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor thog gter ston rin po cher rtse shod dmag zor bcas pas gter gsar gur drag gi dbang dang khyab 'jug gi dug dbyung zhus/ de nyin nas rdo rje gling pa'i gter chos yongs rdzogs zhu ba'i 'go btsugs/ nged rang gis sde pa dang a bar gnyis la rnam 'joms kyi bkru byab srung gsum rgyas par byas/ nged rang ring —244—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)por 'tsho byed gzhis rtser lhun rtse ba/ shel dkar du chos ste ba/ phun gling du rang gra/ rin spungs su skyed tshal ba rnams kyis bka' 'gyur lnga bcu nga lnga/ mtshan brjod sum stong / sde pa'i rim gror rnam gling du chos sde ba dang / gzhis rtser myug chos 'khor gling pas bka' 'gyur bcu dgu/ sgrol (177nasgo nyi khri chig stong / sher snying nyi khri bdun stong / tshe gzungs sum khri/ bstan ma gnas sar dar lcog dang gsol mchod lo sngon ma ltar bto / rtse shod thun mong gi rim gror shel brag tu rang gra rdor slob bcas bco lngas zhag bco lnga'i ring ra ta gling gu ru zhi ba'i las byang gzhung bsrangs pa'i zhi bsnyen 'gro gang che/ zhag gong 'dra drag bsnyen mthar gtor bzlog /sku rab rnam rgyal du rtse le ba gra slob zhag gong mtshungs kyis rat+na'i gur drag gi bsnyen pa 'gro gang che'i mthar gtor bzlog /bstan srid dang bod 'bangs spyi rim la po ta la'i zhol du nges gsang rdor gling pas lha 'dre stong dra/ yang rdzong du rdo rje brag pa dang mchims phur dpal ri ba gra slob brgyad res bka' brgyad kyi gzhung bsrangs pa'i zhag bdun bar bzlas pa 'gro gang che'i mjug tshogs brgya/ snga mas zhag gong 'drar gshin rje 'joms byed nyi zla nag po'i sgo nas log sde bskal par mnan/ mkhar chur smra bo lcog pa/ yer pa zla ba phug tu gsang sngags byang chub gling pa/ gter sgrom du ban grong pa/ — snur gnas gzhi ba/ tsa rir rtse le ba/ g.yung phu rdza lhud du 'od mchog pa/ bkra bzang du rang gra rnams kyis bka' brgyad/ shel brag tu rang gra/ 'on phu stag tshang du e chos ldan pa/ gnam lcags brag tu snye mdo ba rnams kyis phur pa/ g.ya' ma lung du bsam yas dkar po bas dgongs 'dus/ zab phur lug pa lung dī 'phrul zhi khro rnams la(177ba)brten pa'i bzlas pa dang tshogs gra grangs zhag bcas gong 'dra/ shel brag tu smin grol gling pa gra slob bco lngas bdun gsum gyi bar bdud rtsi sman sgrub/ lhun rtser dwags po gra tshang pas ril sgrub dang 'brel ba'i yig drug dung phyur gcig bye ba gsum sa ya lnga/ tshe gzungs chig 'bum drug khri drug stong bzhi brgya/ sher snying sum khri nyis stong brgyad brgya/ sgrol ma chig khri lnga stong sum brgya/ gnas chung chos skyong chen po dang mo rtsis go bstun nged rang gi gegs sel la po ta la sogs rdzong gzhis lnga nas —245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pomachod rten dang ma ṇir zhig gsos sku dkar/ pha bong kha pas gtor ma tshig 'bum dgu brgya/ nya sum 'bum drug khri bdun stong dgu brgya sum cu'i srog blu/ lha sar ngan slong khri sogs chig stong nyis brgya brdal bar sbyin pa/ ārla pa lo'i gling du brag sna ba gra slob kyis zhag bdun gyi bar khro rol/ rgyab chos pa rab byung pa dang li ma lha khang pa bsgril ba brgya dang gsum gyis tshe gzungs nyis 'bum chig khri bzhi stong nyis brgya bzhi bcu/ gtor rgyag nyin sher snying tshig khri bdun stong so dgu/ po ta la zhol du bla mkhyen ngag dbang can gyis nyes pa kun sel dang sa bdag dong tse/ bon pos bong ra btsugs shing snang brgyad kyi mdos/ sde pa'i rim gror gong dkar du mgon po g.yul bzlog /gi gang gi dgra mnan/rgyab chos pa dang bcas pa/ ston pa'i brgya thang / lha sar brag dbar dang thang skya ba brgya res gser 'od dang brgyad stong pa brgya re/ po ta lar bla (178na)mkhyen can gyis gza' klu 'brugs pa'i yo bcos/ gangs can spyi rim du po ta la dang gzhis rtse sogs rdzong che ba bcu bdun nas sngags bon gang rigs kyis gyang ra rgyang sag dang / gtsug tor sde lnga'i mdos/ chos skyong gi gsung bzhin nged kyi rim gror ser 'bras dge gsum du ja tshul lnga rer sher snying / tshe gzungs/ ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad 'gro gang che/ nad rims bzlog phyir lha sa spyi bsdus kyis bka' 'gyur dang ma mdos/ chab gtor klu gtor bsangs/ brgyags brngan/ gtsug lag khang rnams la khrus gsol/ nye skor snye ljangs/ lum pa/lcags zam/ 'brom stod rnams kyi nang khongs kyi grong tshor ma mdos sogs gong 'dra byed bcug /hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gnyis la bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang rtse le'i par mar lhan thabs sbyar ba yin kyang gra pa blo dman pa dag mgo bo mgal me ltar 'khor nas len mi bde zer ba las byang bklags chog dgos pa kun tshang bsgrigs/ yer pa dga' ldan gsang sngags gling bla gnyer gra mang thun mong ngor nged rang dang sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i ring 'tsho/ dar mos sman rams pas bskul ba'i shel grong gzhis bdag gi gsol mchod/ 'brom gyi sngags 'chang dbang grags rgya mtshos dgos tshul byung ba'i nged rang dang gter bdag gling pa thun mong dang / me rag bla ma —246

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)blo gros rgya mtsho'i ngor sde pa'i brtan (174)bzhugs/ des bskul ba'i mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gtor chog legs ldan dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/ dud sol lha mo'i gtor chog 'khyer bde/ jag pa me len gyi gtor chog /tsa ri'i gnas bdag cig car dmar po'i gtor chog /rab stims pa blo bzang ngag dbang gi 'dod pa ltar rje drung dge 'dun bstan pa rgya mtsho'i sprul sku dge 'dun chos rgyal dbang phyug gi 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs/ brgyad gtor dus chen skabs 'bul rgyu dang / dbu mdzad kyisa'aphrul snang / ra mo che/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug /yum bu rnams su dbul ba'i snyan shal kha yig /dga' ldan bstan 'dzin sbo shog thu khang gis dpal ldan 'bras spungs su dngul rkyan bcu dgu phul ba'i kha byang rnams bris/ tshes brgyad la tshoms chen du mgon po las mkhan dang bcas mchod pa'i tshogs dbur phyin pa'i mu 'thud bcu gnyis bar thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa rgyas par bgyis/tshes bcu gcig gi zhogs gsang sngags byang chub gling gi dbu mdzad ngag dbang nam mkha' dang /ngag dbang mkhas btsun gnyis kyis ster byin dang bcas byang chub gling pas 'bras tso rdongs dag snang ma'i cho ga gyer ba dang chabs gcig dpon tshang tsha rong pas kyang ring 'tsho'i dngos po brkyang / yer pa bla gnyer gra bcas kyis rang 'byor dang bstun pa'i skyes spel zhing ring 'tsho'i smon lam gsungs/ bla mas yun du gnas dgos tshul lung (179na 'dren dang bcas khas len dgos zer ba gsung rab rnams nas mi lus thob par tshogs rgya cher gsog dgos par bshad pa rang la dbang mchis na sdod pa gzhir bcas mod/ dge 'dun rnams kyis bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dpang por gsol te smon lam mdzad pa dang rang ngos nas kyang sdod 'dun byed tshul bgyis nas gra sa phan tshun gyi slob dpon las sne ba/ gnas chung sku rten pa/ bco brgyad chos rje/ gong ra gdan sa ba/ gcung lo chen chos dpal/ sgrub rnying bla ma/ sha gzug sku skye/ bkra shis ljongs slob dpon/ glog lcog sprul sku/ mer gan hung tha'i ji'i mi sna 'ur du su tha'i ji/ 'dul ba chos rje'i mi sna dbon chung / dpon mo bsod nams tshe dbang gi mi sna bur gu tha'i ji'i nang tshang / jo rig thu kho sho'u chi'i mi sna/ bar kha sha kha'i bsngo rten skyel mi/ ge re —247

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (polha pa yum sras/ 'jun pa rdo rje rgyal po/ o rong pa pha bu/ chang khyim pa'i bu rgan pa sogs bod sog nyis brgya skor gyi ngo bor byin rlabs dang dmangs la ngos phrad/ tshes bcu gnyis la chang khyim pas rtags brgyad kha btags/ gos sna cha tshang / sgrol dkar gyi dngul sku/ gos yug legs pa dgu/ dngul phor sogs kyis gtsos pa'i dgu tshan bcu gcig 'gyed dang bcas gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa mdzad/ mun khi chi pā thur/ dge tshul ma/ tsha bo tshe (179ba〉nga dar rgyas/ i nag pā thur tha'i ji'i dpon bu bcas/ bsod nams hung tha'i ji/ bi lig er khe tha'i ji/ dbon chung gi bu bcas par byab khrus dang / gtor dbang bar gcod kun sel bskur/ u dkar das pā thur dang blo bzang mgon po'i mi sna/ dar khan kho sho'u chi'i skyes dman sogs log mi nyis brgya skor/ zhol sgrol dkar tshe chog pa log mi brgyad/ yo she'i bu dmag la 'gro mi zhe brgyad/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan zur kha rab pa/ me rag /mtsho smad/ phug khang rnams kyi bla ma/ shag byang pa'i bu 'bring / nag gu ba sogs mang dag la ja gral btang /tshes bcu gsum la dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis rung thun gyi gos dpus gtsang cha 'grig /gser zho nyis brgya/ dngul lnga bcu ma/ sbug chol nyi ma 'brug sgrags kyi shubs mngags bzos mtshal rtsi tshing gin mar ra ma lug gi bshan bzo bkod mtshar ba'i rgyu song mtshal zho bcu gcig /grang gser zho drug ma long tsam/ gser btso zho bcu bzhi rnams song ba/ gos yug dpus legs nyer lnga/ rgya sbug /sman tse/ byang dar tshos sna tshogs/ ja ras zam sogs rgya cher bteg /tshogs dang gra pa rer lnga tshan re/spyi 'bul dang bcas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i mi 'gyur tshe'i rten 'byung bsgrigs pa'i (180na)mgron du gter ston rin po che/ gcung lo chen mched/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan zur/ gong ra gdan sa pa/ byang chub gling / mtsho smad/ sgrub rnying gsum gyi slob dpon mi sna so gos yod/phyi dro rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pas smad 'dul gyi sdom rgyun ma chad na legs tshul gyi bskul ma mdzad pa bzhin kha rab zhal snga nas la khungs dag pa yod par brten mi nub cing dar rgyas che bar —248

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)bsam te dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan zur mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog bstan 'dzin gyis mkhan slob sbrags nas rta tshag rje drung rin po che/ lo chen chos dpal sogs bsnyen rdzogs drug bsgrubs nas srol btod/ tshes bcu bzhir dar byung ba dgra 'dul rab brtan gyis bdog pa'i dngos po dang bcas gra tshang nas mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i ring 'tsho'i cho ga gsungs/ chos 'khor yang rtse ba dka' bcu rin cen rnam rgyal gyis dbu 'grel theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzing dang / dpon tshang tsha rong pa'i slob ma blo bzang phun tshogs kyis rgyud bzhi'i rgyugs sprad/tshes bco brgyad nas zhag bcu'i bar gra tshang gis 'khor lo 'bar ba khyon sa ya gcig chig 'bum brgyad khri chig stong nyis brgya song / nyer gnyis la sde pa dang dmag zor tshangs dbang mnyam du gdon 'grol byab khrus dang bcas pa byas/ nyer (180ba)gsum la brtag pa byas pa'i nged rang gi rim gror bkra shis bde chen pa dang lam rim pa sgril ba brgyas gdugs dkar chig 'bum bzhi brgya bzhi bcu/ sgrol ma nyi khri nyis stong drug brgya brgyad cu/ sde pa na sri lta bus yan lag cung ma bde ba bzlog thabs su gra tshang gis phyir bzlog 'khor lo 'bar ba bye chung gcig /lha sar yer pa ba brgyas sman bla chig khri chig brgya/ pho brang du ri chos pa dang rtses dang lnga mchod pa bsgril pa brgyas gdugs dkar nyis 'bum tshig khri brgyad stong brgyad brgya bzhi bcu/ mtshan brjod chig 'bum chig khri lnga stong bzhi brgya/ sgrol ma nyi khri lnga stong chig brgya zhe lnga/ tshe gzungs bdun khri bzhi stong nyis brgya/ sher snying nyi khri lnga stong brgyad brgya/ sāts+tsha chig 'bum bdun khri lnga stong bzhi brgya/ lha sa dang ra mo che'i lha khang tshor gser chab/ spyan 'byed mchod pa sna lnga brgya tshar/ mchod 'bul ba so sos spyan 'dren khrus gsol mjug bzang spyod nyis stong brgyad brgya bzhi bcu/ lha sa/ dpal lhun/ gra bzhi/ lcags grong / glang sa lho mos/ rin chen tshal/ gsas khang bcas par sgo 'gyed/ ga slong mang bar sbyin pa/ ā tsarla nang pa'i gu sang nyi shu/ phyi pa'i gu sang bcu dgur mar dang gro phye/ snam bu'i sbyin pa/ nad pa nyam thag pa lo grangs la rtsam mkhar 'bo re/ tā tshwa nyag (181na)re/ mar nyag gsum re/ gos sna re/ nad la blta —249—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pobar 'tsho byed ched gnyer btang ste sman rin sprad/ pa nam du brag la bas 'char ga'i mdos/ rgyab chosagrang mo che pas sher snying rig stong drug brgya sogs gang rgyas bstar/ gur drag sogs kyi rten rnams kyi gzungs dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas gra bsgrigs nas nged rang gis so so'i bshad tshod dang mthun par gnas rnams su ma 'chol bar rgyas par phul bar bgegs bskrad/ khrus dang bskyed bstim me tog gtor/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos nā ga ra ka'i sgrub zhag lnga sngon song gis sde par klu'i gdon 'grol smin par mdzad/gnam gang la mnga' ris gra tshang dang rgya shod ban mkhar bla ma/ zhol du nges gsang rdor gling gra slob lha 'dre stong dra dang ma mo gling bzhi gtong bar yong pa/ 'dam du 'degs mi dbu sgor chung ba/ no yon dka' bcu/ a ra na/ al dar dpon g.yog /da la'i khung tha'i ji/ dga' ldan tshe dbang dpalabazang / lha dbang dpal 'bar gsum gyi mi sna/ gsar 'byor zung chu rab cums pa ngag dbang rgya mtsho g.yog bcas sogs bod sog ngo mar byin rlabs dang / nyis brgya skor la ngos phrad/ zung chu rab 'byams pas gser dngul gos dar sogs spams bstod/ ban mkhar bla mas rta brgyad/ nag (181ba)tshang phan dar gyi bsngo rten rta bcu gsum/ rme ru bla zur rin chen rgya mtshos li sku legs pa lnga/ hub ja khor drug ma byin/ brkyang phyag bgyis te ring por sdod pa'i smon lam zhe nas btab/ zhol du sngagasa'achang chu spe steng pas sgrub zhag dgu sngon du btang ste rgyal po rtse mdos phyir thon pa dang rlung glo bur du 'tshubs shing 'chams dang bcas 'gong po 'gro phyogs su rlung rnams brgyugs pa'i lhongs rtags shin tu che ba ltar sde pa'i khams kyang rim bder song ba'i 'phrod ngo che/ sngags pa la las o zob sogs kha zer yang / de lta bu'i skam gsog rlon gsog sogs mdos bzhed 'tshub rtags kyis mtshon pa ston dang rim gro byed mi dgos dang drags yod pa 'chol bas snar mdzub mo tshugs/hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gcig la chu spe steng sngags 'chang dang brag dkar chu bzang bla ma dang phrad/tshes gnyis la sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rang gzhan la ma bltos pa'i bla ma tshor lung rtogs kyi dam —250

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)chos 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ thos bsam sgom gsum mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum sogs kyi sgo nas bstan pa spyi dang bye brag skye 'gro'i bde skyid spel tshul gyi mdzad pa blos mi 'byud pa snang ba dang mthun par rnam thar zhing bkod phun sum tshogs pa yong 'dug pas yid phrogs te de ltar byung na snyam lhag bsam rnam dag gis kun nas blangs pa'i bskul ma yang yang byung ba dang byed rang ngos nas bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba'i mos pa yod (182na)phyin byin rlabs dang dngos grub 'byung ba rten 'brel yin pas yi rang mod/ 'on kyang nged rang nas bstan 'gro'i bya ba 'dzin skyong spel ba 'di byas zer ba'i lag rtags ston rgyu 'di ni 'di'o med par spobs mthos bkod na pha rol rnams kyis 'phyas pa'i rgyur song dogs na'ang mdzes lam ma yin par cis nas kyang dgos tshul nan tan byung ba ltar gtso bo rnams thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho yan rnam dag sku'i skye ba rim bzhin pa dang thugs rgyud gcig pa mang po dus gcig la byon pa rang so skyes ngos bzung dka' na'ang chos 'byung lo rgyus deb zer dang bstun cing bkod pa rnams ni mi mang tshor yang nyin re bzhin chos 'jig rten dang mthun mi mthun sna tshogs yong ba dang cha 'drar nged rang la'ang lo zla zhag za ma dus tshod byas lugs yong ba gzhir bcas pa de dang mthun par phyi'i rnam thar du ming btags pa shog dper lag gi 'du byed skyong ba po gzhis ka shar gu ru rdo rje dang 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ sgur rtsa ba ngag dbang 'phrin las dang ngag dbang rgya mtsho ste bas lag bstar/ dpal grong sngags rams pas dpe klog pa'i snying po nged kyisabasdus te bkod pa byas/ snga phyi'i dogs slong dang chad lhag zhus dag pa 'dar rnam gnyis dang dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis nas 'dri ba'i 'go btsugs/ tshes bzhin chu spe steng sngags 'chang thon gdong gi ster bya brda don lam zab dang sems nyid ngal gsor brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byas/ (182ba〉〈༅ lngar bkra shes lhun po'i phyag mdzod bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal dang mdong mo/ gos dar rta brgyad sogs dngos po byung zhing byin rlabs dang / tshes brgyad la gnas chung chos skyong chen po sku phebs zhus shing lung bstan yid ches sna tshogs gsung /—251—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (getshes dgur bkra shis lhun po nas zang zing gi bdog pa ring por brkyang ste 'gyed dang bcas mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i rten 'byung gra tshang nas bstar rjes thod ri bshad sgrub gling bla gras snam phrug gtso gyur gyi bdog pa btegs nas nyi bu'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i bden pa brjod pa dang lhan du gdan sa gong gi ring 'tsho spel mi 'gron gnyer yang mchis/ stag lung zur pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal legs grub/ rgyal mkhan po/ mal dro 'chad ka bla ma/ bde chen zhabs drung mched/ sgam po phyag mdzod/ldan ma zem mkhar dgon gyi khri 'bul ba/ ra ba smad chos skyong gi sku rten/ ding ri ston chen khro bo tshe ring / dpon mo tshe ring / co ba chos rje dang rdo rje/ bsod nams mgon po rnams kyi mi sna sogs bod sog nyis brgya skor la mjal phrad/ stag lung zur pas rta so brgyad kyis thog drangs pa'i skyes byung zhing sngar bzhin bkur bzos phul/tshes bcu chen mo sngar rgyun bzhin bzabs mchod steng gra tshang rang nas phod ka gsar bzos byas pa rnams kyang dpus shin tu legs pa byung snang / brag dkar chu bzang pas tshe bdag gi yiX thang ye shes sems dpa' dngos dang dbyer med pa brgyud (183na)pa'i bla ma mang po'i thugs dam rten byin pa'i lan du ji srid bstan pa nam gnas bar lha rtse dang ngam ring so so nas gtsang bre tshad kyi khal phyed nyis brgya re'i gzhor 'debs dang bla ma la'ang ster bya bzabs/ shag lho pa'i bu rgan 'bring gnyis dang phrad cing gnas gsar dbon rin po che lho mos nas byon pa dang chos dang 'brel ba'i gsung 'phros smar ba byung / tshes bcu gcig la stag lung zur pa/ bkras lhun phyag mdzod/ dpon tshang tsha rong pa bcas sum cu skor la gur nas bshad pa'i phyag rdor 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang phul/ shag lho pa nang so dkon mchog dar rgyas chos mdzad ma dang bcas pa/ ding ri ston chen la ster bya dang ja gral byas te thon/tshes bcu bzhir gnas chung du sngar phan lo gsar gyi srol mi 'dug kyang sde pas lo gsar gyi mchod pa zhig tshugs na zer ba dga' ldan pho brang pa'i dgra lha gzhan dang ma 'dra gshis legs tshul —252

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)mol ba ltar lo gsar dus mchod 'bul bar sde pa/ bla chen/ sde dpon/ rdzong gzhis/ chos sde khag gi lo gsar 'bul ba sogs brda sngon song bzhin sku phebs te rim par phul ba bag dro byung 'dug /sde pa blo bzang sbyin pas zan g.yang / khra 'brug /yum bu rnams su 'bul ba'i snyan shal/ dpal ldan re ma ting mdos bskang dus 'bul ba'i snyan dar/ rtse tshogs ngag dbang grags pas gra skor byas dus (183ba)srang nyer gsum gyi dngul kong dang tshogs par dung gos 'bul rgyu/ 'a zha mkhyen rab rnam rgyal gyis bkra shis chos sde'i lha khang tshor snyan dar/ lha sa'i tshes bcu shar ma ba rnams kyis lha sar 'phan 'bul rgyu rnams kyi kha byang / a chi thu chos rje'i gra rigs/ a gling sngags rams pa dngos grub rgya mtshos rgyal byed tshal du sman bla 'dzugs pa dang lhan cig /mchims phu'i gnas bdag lha mo rigs 'dzin ma/ ban mkhar bla ma rnams kyis bskul ba'i ring 'tsho dang smon lam/ gra rigs rnams kyis a chi thu chos rje dang sku skye ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs kyis khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po'i sku skye myur 'byon/rtse gdong zhabs drung rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar chos longs sprul gsum/ thod phreng rigs lnga/ gu ru mtshan brgyad dang sbyar ba/ dbu mdzad mchod dpon gyis bskul ba'i gnas chung lcog tu 'don rgyu'i ja mchad/ bkra 'a shas lhun po phyag mdzod pa'i ngor sher phyin lha khang gi deb kyi 'go brjod/ mdos bskang dus 'phrin bcol dgos pa'i mtshan ma shar ba ltar tshigs bcad/ lha mo rigs 'dzin ma'i gsol mchod 'phrin bcol/ sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sprel lo sprel zla 'di nas bzung tshes bcu ji srid bar chag med gtong rgyur thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi las byang dngos grub yongs 'du'i gter mdzod/ dar mo sman rams pas bskul ba'i phun gling du g.yu thog rnam thar le tshan brko rgyu'i par byang rnams brtsams/ (184na〉tshes bcu bdun la lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor nas srid gsum bdag mo mnyes par byed pa'i mdos mchod 'bum ther btsugs/tshes bco brgyad la mtsho khas mtshon bod khams bde thabs su byams sku bzhengs par ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi sogs chas byed lugs kyi bslab bya dang bcas 'bul bar han rab 'byams pa rgya —253—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pomatsho rnam rgyal mngags/stag lung khri zur ngag dbang bkra shis chos rgyal/rgyal ba chos rje rje drung /khyung tshang bla ma sogs bsnyen rdzogs bgraganyis/dge tshul gnyis rnams bsgrubs/thod ri bshad sgrub gling pa bkra shis rgya mtsho/blo gros brtan pa/thub bstan bzang po gsum gyis phar phyin 'grel ba blo bzang dgongs rgyan/bstan pa 'byung gnas kyis dbu 'grel theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzingasarnams kyi rgyugs sprad/nyer gnyis la bkra shis lhun po'i phyag mdzod la dngul gyi mdong mo/dkar dpyad/ra ma lug gi sga/gos dar sogs tshun byung dang bstun bzabs cing bka' bsgo/da sdebs su bsam yasadakar po ba/dum bu chos 'khor dang skam dgon bla ma/rtul mi khra 'brug chos skyong 5rten/mdong mkhar chos sde'i ring 'tsho spel mi/ri bo che'i khri 'bul ba/mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/gsar 'byor khal kha che chen yi tha'i ji'i mi sna sogs nyis brgya skor dang phrad/ri bo che bas rta nyer bzhi byung zhing dar mo ba gzhen nu tshangs dbang gis rgyud bzhi byang ba'i rgyugs sprad/nyer gsum la dpal ri bas mtshims phur dgongs 'dus kyi blos bslangs 84ba ) bzhengasapar legs sor 'bru khal brgya byin/nyer lnga la gnas gsar chos rje dbon yab sras lhan cig lho kha brgyud gtsang du dus 'khor gyi dbang zhur 'byon pa'i thegs rdzongs ber/phying dmar/brtse theb/gosadar ja ras sogs rgyas par dbul zhing bka' bsgo phul/ya ga chos sdings pa bsam grub rgyal mtshan dang /ldog chos 'khor ba sangs rgyas chos 'phel gnyis kyis byams chos sde lnga'i rgyugs sprad/nyer drug nas zhag bdun gyi bar bdud rtsi sman chab bsten/hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum la ri bo bde chen gyi gra pa dngos grub rgya mtshos rgyud bzhi dang /thod ri bshad sgrub gling pa blo bzang mkhas btsun gyi dbu 'grel theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings kyi rgyugs sprad/bla mkhyen ngag dbang rang gnas su rdzong bda' bgyis/tshes drug la lha ldan ru bzhi spyis dngos po maṇ+ḍaX gyi tshul du bteg nas mi 'gyur ba'i smon lam

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)btab/ skyor lung mkhan po/ 'chad ka zhabs drung / rgyud smad/ thang po che/ dpal ri gsum gyi bla gsar/shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor/ e waṃ/ khams snying thang dgon gsum gyi bla ma/ zhang ston ri khrod pa khu tshan/ khams pa rdzogs chen pa sogs skya ser nyis brgya skor la ja gral dang zhang ston khu tshan gsum la tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster bskur/tshes bdun la er khe ri'i dpon po dang dbon chung bsod nams khung tha'i ji sogs bzhi bcu skor la smyung gnas kyi sdom pa phab nas brkyang khug gtong bcug /'brog ri bo dga' ldan nas khri rin po che/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ slob dpon gsum/ khri zur dbon gra pa bzhi brgya (185na)skor gyis bdog pa'i skyes dang bcas 'chi bdag dpung las rgyal ba'i bden tshig gsungs shing khri rin po ches lung rigs kyi lam nas drangs te mi 'gyur brtan pa'i khas len gyis zhes snyan 'jebs 'brel chags phebs par khri rin po ches dbus dge 'dun rnams thugs bstun ring 'tsho'i smon pa mi phyed pa'i gsol 'debs mchogo gsum la mdzad pas mi 'grub pa gar srid/ rang nyid kyang sdod 'dun byed pa'i lan phul/ gsang sngags mkhar dpon slob brgya skor gyis kyang tshan grangs sngon brkyang gis rten 'byung tshigs bcad gsungs/ bsod nams dbang rgyal gyi ma/ er khe ji nong gi mi sna/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma dang phrad/ tshes brgyad la 'chad gzhabs drung / dpal ri dang thang po che'i bla gsar/ bkra shis bde chen bla ma sogs bsnyen rdzogs nyer lnga/ dge tshul gsum rnams bsgrubs/ sgar gra tshang gi bla ma/a chi mgon po dang dur bod kyi mi sna sogs la byin rlabs dang / bal po pi la dzu 'das pa'i bsngo rten sman bla'i lha tshogs ha lam lugs su blug pa sogs kyi rten rgyas pa/ khyad par 'di pa tha mal ba min pa'i bag chags bzang po sad pa'i byas rjes che bar rgyal rtse sku 'bum chen mo'i chos 'khor gdugs brjes pa'i zangs gser bzo bo'i gla yon sto sogs bsdoms gser mgur zho go dgu lhag pa/dngul grang brgya nyi shu song ba'i dge ba bsngo dgos tshul khra bcas 'byor don bzhin yang srid thams cad du mtho ris yon to bdun thob pa'i rjes don gnyis lhun grub sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i —255—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pobasngo smon dkon cog gsum dpang (185ba)por byas te nan tan btab pa ltar 'byung ba'ang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs 'dzin mdor/ sangs rgyas mchod rten mthong nas su/ /zhig pa phyir ni bcos par 'gyur/ /de phyir stobs ni che ba dang / /lus che ba dang mi 'jigs 'gyur/ /gang du dad pa skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas phal po cher/ rab dang sems kyis sangs rgyas mchode rten la/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'phen ni 'dogs byed na/ /gser gyi ri bo lhun po dang mnyam pa/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /zhes phan yon 'byung bar yi rang ste dge 'thud 'bru khal brgya sogs rgya cher byin/ rgya nag mi sna gzhon pa em chi thabs mkhas 'byor/tshes bcur tsho mes chen du skyon chen po'i gter sku byin can du ma/ gzhan yang rtsa ba gsum gyi bris 'bur spyan sngar phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bla na med pa dang yod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas 'phrin las rin cen phreng ba gra tshang du gsar du btsugs par nged rang phyin pa'i sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen po'ang tshogs su byon/ dbyangs rol lha sngags ye shes kyi rol bas cho ga gdung ba'i mos pa dang spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa/ khyad par kha ba ri pa'i lha skal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ de'i rnam sprul skyon rdo rje 'chang la rag lus pa'i phyir 'jig rten khams su nad yams mu ge mtha' dmag sad ser sogs mi dge ba'i rtags mtshan zhi zhing lung rtogs bstan pa'i rtsa ba zhwa ser 'chang ba'i ring lugs rgyas par bltos pa mi nyams shing gong 'phel gyi gsol 'debs rems nas byas skabs mdos bskang (186na)'bum ther gtong ba dang 'grig pa mdos chog gyer zhing 'dod don gzhan med kyang snga ma ltar bcol ba 'grub bam snyam/ sde pas legs byar dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan shal/ go khrab cha tshang sogs sbyan gzigs rgyas pa/ tshogs par kha btags che ba re dang gser zho re'i 'gyed bcas bsgrubs pa/ rigs 'dzin rgod kyi ldem dzus zangs mdzod nas bzhes pa'i rgyal po'i mnga' bskyed nor bu'i bang mdzod las/ bod la bde skyid 'byung 'dod na yar ngo tshes bcu nam shar tshe skyon pad ma'i sprul pa 'byung : de dus nga la mos pa yisaḥ rab kyis bskyed rdzogs gnas lugs ltos phyi nang —256

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)gsang ba'i sgrub pa tshugasaḥ sems skyed bsam pa bzang po yisaḥ 'gro drug thugs rjes 'dren pa yiḥlas dang smon lam rgya cher thob 'bring gis lus ngag yid gsum gyis sgrib spyong las la brtson par gyis: zhes dang / rat+na'i thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa'i bskul byang las/ byung cog zla ba'i tshes bcu la: nga nyid 'byon pa'i dbu snyung bzhes: pad+ma 'byung gnas gzhan mi bslu the tshom spongs shig rjes 'jug rnams las su drang ba'i blo yod na 'di ltar nga yi tshes bcu la brtson zhing gsol ba 'debasapa'i bu 'khor bar lhungs na nga shes kyis blo snying brang gsum nga la gtod: ces zla re tshes bcu'i mchod pa bzung bar phan yon de bzhin dang lhag par sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcur bde can mgon po snang mtha'i thugs rje hūṃ dmar du shar ba dha na ko sha'i mtshor (186ba)pad sdong ze'u 'brur lo brgyad na tshod can du byon par steng lha/ 'og klu/ bar sde brgyad kyis sri zhu/ lha mo bstan mas mtsho skyes rdo rjer gsol/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs mtha' dag gis ston pa'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol bas skyes chen su mchod pa las kyang phan yon ches lhag pa thob bo/ /yar lam se chen tha'i ji dus kyi chos nyid du 'gyur pa'i rten 'byor bar 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa grol zhing byang grol thob pa'i rgyur bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab/ gur drag gi sku rnams tshon rtsi ma gtogs grub par sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos rab gnas bstar/ rtse le bla ma dang / zing po bkra shis dar rgyas sogs dang phrad/tshes bcu drug nas nyin gsum gyi bar rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling par rdo rje gling pa'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro nor lha sogs kyi dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang rig gtad sogs zhus shing zur chen gyi sprul sku/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa sogs kyang yod/ de bzhin tshes bstodagur mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dbang dang / gtad rgya gsang mtshan ma gnyis mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen po brgyud pa zhus/ 'bri gung sprul pa'i skus rdo rje gro lod dang gter gsar pad+ma drag po gnyis/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi 'bral spang dam tshig bris thang du grags pa'i skyon rnam thar zhal bshus zur rigs 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyis bris pa/ rnam gling chos mdzad ngag dbang blo gsal gyi don du rnam paṇa —257

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (podakon cog chos grags kyis gra tshang du zhi khro'i skong bshags thog kha thi'i bla bre 'bul rgyu dang / rin (187na)'byung dang rat+na ḍā ki'i brgya thang byang rtse chos rje ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtshos rgyud smad gra tshang lha sa sogs su bzhugs gnas med par brten dri gtsang khang ma lag dang bcas pa/ ri bo dga' ldan du gsar rnga cha lag nyer drug /sbug chol gyi shubs brgyad/ dgun chos kyi 'tsho ba'i thebs su zhing bcu bdun/ zhogs gur smon du yum chen mo'i brgya thang gsum sogs bzhengs te sbyar bas mtshon bla thog gzhan las chos 'jig rten gnyis ka nas bzhag che bar mngon zhing de rnams kyi rgyab yig smon lam/smon gling pa dge slong ngag dbang tshul khrims kyi ngor smon lam/ hor sog gi rgyal rigs dpon khag tshor
