bdag rkyen byed pa'i deb kyi 'go brjod/ rnam gling pa ngag dbang blo gsal gyi don du jo bo rin po cher snam sbyar dang / bcu gcig zhal dang 'phags pa lo ke shwa rar snyan shal/ gra tshang nas dpal ldan lha mor snyan shal sna lnga rnams kyi kha byang / gnas chung chos skyong chen pos bskul ma mdzad pa'i tshogs chen dang gra tshang du 'dzugs pa'i ring 'tsho/ sku phebs myur dus kyi spyan 'dren dang bcas pa bkod/tshes nyi shur chos 'khor yang rtse ba grags pa bkra shis kyis phar phyin 'grel pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gyi rgyugs sprad/ nyer gnyis la gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos rtse shod gnyis la khyab 'jug gi dug dbyung btags grol gyi dbang / byad 'grol rnams mdzad/ nyer gsum 'chad ka zhabs drung /ngor klu sdings pa/ thod ri bshad sgrub gling pa'i bla zur/ bkra shis bde chen dang rtsa sgrub sde'i (187ba)bla ma/ o tho khon gyi mi sna rin cen dge slong / co ne chos rje'i mi sna mgon po rgyal mtshan/ kha dan bā thur gyi mi sna dbon po/ dga' ldan ji nong gi mi sna u ching khā/ lha dbang dpal 'bar gyi mi sna mer gan khā/ er te ni tha'i ji'i mi sna/ dpon kho shor thu tha'i ji'i bu sogs la ja gral byas/nyer lnga'i pa sangs nam gru'i 'grub sbyor thog sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen por rtse shod thun mong gis rat+na'i gur drag /gdon 'grol/ gter gsar tshe dbang rnams zhus/ chos yon du gser srang gsum/ dngul srang bdun cu yod pa'i mdong mo/ sbug sil/ khyad gos sogs dgu tshan dgu'i bdog —258—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang gleg bam gsum pa/ (ja)pa dang /rang gnas su gshegs gdong 'ja' shel spus legs/phyag phreng legs pa/rtags brgyad kha btags rnams phul/gnam gang la sgar gra tshang bla ma/tsho gis gsog rab 'byams pa/hung tha'i ji'i mi sna sogs la byin rlabs/gong ma rgyal po kun ma 'u san gu'i g.yul las rgyal bar snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i zhu shog rten legs skyes spams mtho ba dang bcas bsam blo rab 'byams pa tshul khrims rnam rgyal dang /blo bzang tshe ring gnyis rdzong bda' dang /sgar gra tshang gi ming dga' ldan gsang sngags bde chen du btags/bstan srid spyi rim la zab phu lung du gnas 'dzin pa sgrub pa pho mo sum cu skor gyis tshes brgyad nas nyer drug gi bar badz+ra gu ru 'gro gang che/sgrol phug pa gra slob bco lngas tshes bcu nas nyin lnga'i bar bla ma'i las byang dang 'brel ba'i tshogs brgya/ 88na shi ba'i sbyin sreg nyin gcig/dregs pa'i sde dpon sogs chos srung gter skyong spyi dang /zab phu'i lha klu sogasagazhi bdag la gsol mchod/khrus gsol/bsangs dang brgyags rngan bon po tsho bsdus bco lngasazhag brgyad kyi ring thang lhas gtsos pa'i rje'i mgur lha bcu gsum dang 'bangs srog lha/srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu/bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs la gsol mchod/ri 'gor dar lcog brgya tshar/ri 'go dgur bsangs/yar lha bye gangs 'dabs su'ang bon po tsho bsdus kyis sham snus gtsos par gong mtshungs/gnas 'dzin gra bas brgya dang bcu skor gyis nyin lnga'i bar badz+ra gu ru 'gro gang che/'di lo nas bzung gangs skor la bkag cha mi byed pa'i bsdam ra 'ol dga' dkon gnyer bar 'di lo nas bzung lo star tshes bcu chen mo'i mchod thebs 'bru khal nga drug lhag bcas/nged rang gi sdig sgrib spyong thabs la/bkra bzang /grom pa rgyang /bsam yas sogs gnas grags can bstobadun du rnying dgon 'brel mtshungs grangs bcad kyis tsho gos brgya/khag gnyis su gra pa sum brgya skor gyis yig drug dung phyur bzhi/bye ba bzhi/khag lngar dgon 'brel mtshudas grangs bcad kyis zla ba gnyisarer badz+ra gu ru dung phyur gsum/bye ba gsum/sa ya drug/lnga 'bum nyi khri lnga stong sum brgya/chos skyong chen po'i lung bstan gyi lo rim du dbus gtsang gi sdong gzhis sgo ma dang /de 'og bla r+ṣa dpon ོ

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (posogs (188ba)kyis 'di lo'i btsas ma ma chod bar shar phyogs la btsan mdos/ nub phyogs la ma mdos/ bka' 'gyur tshar re/ sgrol ma lnga stong / sher snying sum stong re/ zla re bzhin brgyags rngan/ rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs gang rung gis khrus/ klu gtor rnams thengs gsum re/ nyin star dge slong bzhi sde tsam res gtor ma brgya tshar/ yul grong che ba rnams nas zla re'i mtshams su brgyad stong pa bcu re/sgrol ma nyis stong re/ sher snying lnga brgya re/ zla re'i nang gtor ma brgya rtsa bstonge/ bsangs khag gsum re/ yul lhar gsol mchod/ chung ba rnams nas zla ba gnyis re'i mtshams su brgyad stong pa tshar re/sher snying brgya re/ sgrol ma lnga brgya re/ zla rer brgya rtsa gnyis re/ bsangs dang yul lha'i gsol kha/ sdepa'i sku rim la lha sar bde yangs pa lnga bcus nyin gsum gyi bar spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ mchod pa sna lnga/ sman bla 'gro gang che rnams bstar/hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig la grong smad dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mo/ khams pa rdzogs chen pa/don gnyis gling slob dpon/ zung chu rab 'byams pa sogs dang phrad/ dpon sa dang a bar ming sring la 'chi blu'i cho ga bto / 'bras spungs slob dpon dge skos sogs chos skyong r+ṣa pos rdzong bda' mdzad de 'di lo dgon par cis kyang yong dgos tshul gsung ba nged rang yang ma phyin par yun ring ba bcas 'gro 'dod rung 'bam gyi nad 'di rkangs bzang drags ldang rtag pas klu sbug lta bur ṛ ti'i sman chab rgyag pa la'ang (189na)ma phyin par lo skor la bcar ba song bas 'gro sdod ci drag som nyir gyur kyang chos skyong gzhan dang mi 'dra'i gshes skyon mi yong ba ye shes kyis gzigs nas shog gsung ba don la gnas pa gzhir bcas ltar sde pa dang gros bsdur te 'gro bar thag bcad/tshes lnga'i gza' skar phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phyin par rta bsu ba dpon slob stong phrag brgyal ba dang / skyel mi se ra byes smad stod/ rgyud stod smad/pha bong kha/ rme ru rnams kyi slob dpon/ lha sab sogs bdun brgya bskor/ rta rags la mchod yon gnyis/ rta tshag rje drung / 'chad ka zhabs drung / sems dpa' chen po/ sgar gra tshang gi bla ma/ lha btsun —260—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ gra tshang gi gra pa rgyab cha ba bcu bdun/ drung 'khor skya ser/ rkya dar/ rgya gling /rol cha ba sogs gzabs mchor gyis bteg pa bar skabs su ma phyin par yun rings stabs yin pa 'dra skya ser mgo stabs chas gos mi gcig pa'i khrom po ta la nas 'bras spungs bar 'brel ba'i dkyil gshags te skyed tshal klu sdings su rta bas skyel bsu drag pa thams cad la byin rlabs dang ja gnyis song nas sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po'ang khog tu brlams pa ru 'dren ru dar sogs shin tu rgyasapa dang bcas byon nas nam mkhar phyag ris mdzad de khyed gzugs can rnams kyis ji ltar mthong /nged gzugs med kyis bltas na lha klu sogs sde brgyad kun gyis mchod pa byed tshul 'di'o zhes der tshogs thams cad la ston pa'i rnam 'gyur dang sde par nged kyi (189ba)rta 'gros dal ba'i bkod pa dgos tshul dang / gzugs med sngon la 'gro zhes phyir myur bar gshegs/ yas sna nas phyi sgo'i bar gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan rnga rol me tog spos na bza' sogs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyisami khyab pa thogs pa'i dge 'dun gyi ser sbrengs/ bro gzhus 'bag shon sogs rtsed sna shin tu mang ba dang bcas thog mar tshogs chen 'du khang du skyel bsu ba sogs thams cad la spyi sos dkar dro dmar dro'i bsnyen bkur rgyas par bshams pa'i gral 'phros rnam gling paṇa chen dkon cog chos grags dang /tsha rong pa tshe brtan rdo rjes phun sum tshogs pa'i gleng bslang las 'phros te rgyas par spros/ rol cha sogs zlos gar sna tshogs bsgyur/ bgro gleng yang bgyis/ phyi dro dga' ldan pho brang du rtsed sna shin tu mang ba tshar du dngar/tshes drug gi zhogs gsang sngags pho brang du rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pas skya ser stong phrag brgal bar ston mo gzabs par btang zhing tshan grangs spams mthor bteg / gung tshigs la mchod pas lha dbang gling du snga ma dang cha 'dra bstar zhing / shun khul gyi drung 'khor gzhisasdod dang bcas pas tshan grangs brkyang / spyil bur me tog gtor/ tshes bdun gyi gas kun dga' ra bar ha sdong gi ston mo dang / gung gi dror sgo mangs spyi sos snga ma dang 'dra zhing bdog pa'ang byung / so —261—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (poso'i 'jug ring 'tsho'i bden tshig kyang brjod/tshes brgyad kyi snga dro tshogs chen 'du khang du slob gra thams cad kyis rang 'byor gyi dngos (190na)po dang bcas 'chi bdag bdud sde las rgyal ba'i smon lam gsungs shing sprul ba'i chos rgyal chen po'ang byon nas blang dor gyi lung bstan mdzad/ dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gis tshogs chen du dngul rgyan bcu dgu phul zhing ja 'gyed kyang 'dug /gung tshigs la blo gsal gling pas ston mo sngar bzhin thog tsha ba khams tshan gyi dkar dro dang tshan grangs/ rag ma ba'i mi ser spyi'i phrad mi'ang byung / mchod yon gnyis nas sde pa ring 'tsho'i stabs zhag shas bzhugs shing / gnam sa'i dbang phyug rgyal po 'khor bcas phyi dro chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sar bskyod/ tshes dgu'i thegs sngags pa gra tshang gi ston mo'i mu 'thud rgyal ba dang 'dul ba pa'i dkar dro spoms su bteg /gung gi dror bde yangs ba'i ston mo'i rjes spong 'bor khams tshan gyis dkar dro spoms dang dar rtse mdo skya ser gyis khri 'bul bstar/tshes bcur gnas chud chos skyong chen pos tshogs 'gyed tshan grangs dang bcas gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i ring mtsho mdzad skabs chos skyong rang gis bden tshig gsungs pa'i mthun 'gyur der 'khod kyis 'degs dgos pa sogs rngams zil che ba byung / tshesabacu gsum la sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skyob lha dri za'i rgyal po rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi 'phrin las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ u khe res tha'i ji'i brgyud pa er te ni ji nong la sde brgyad kyi gnod pa bsrung pa'i tham ga /sde pa blo bzang spyin pas rgyal dbyar chos thog mang skol dang lhan cig (190ba)byams chen sogs ri mthil gyi mchod khang rnams la snyan dar dang / bkra shis bde chen pa dge dbang don grub kyis dge skos 'jog la dngul srang bcu bzhi'i pad sder gyi kha byang / dga' gdong chos skyong gis dgosatshul ltar gsol mchod 'byer bde rnams bris/tshes bco lngar nged rang ring 'tsho'i ched khams dpal 'bar chos sder ser srang gnyis su gra rgyun —262—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)bcas bstan pa 'phel rgyas su bsam 'then rtsod med pa'i 'jags gnas khra don la rgyab bsnon dang /dgon gso bran la brtson cing bde gsang gis gtsos gsang sngags kyi phyag len sgrub mchod sogs dar ba/ lha khang gnyis la mar me nyin mtshan 'byongs pa sogs mchode pa chag med dang / lcam mda' dang dga' ldan rab brtan dbyen 'dums shing spung ring sbyar ba rnams 'dzin bdag 'phos pa 'os su ma che'ang dud tshig brgya drug cu skor la 'bab chig stong sum brgya drug cu brgal ba/ nged kyi ring por 'tsho thabs su zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad/ gnyis pa'i bcu/ bzhi pa'i bco lnga/ drug pa'i tshes bzhi/brgyad pa'i bco lnga/ bcu pa'i tshes brgyad rnams la 'du khang du mar me nyin 'byongs sogs mchod pa lnga/ gra pa sum brgya skor la ja thug tsha ra btang ba'i gra pa res sher snying chig brgya drug cu re 'gro ba'i thebs sbyar/ sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos zab gter bzhes pa'i sgo dod par gter tshab zangs bum sogs rten 'brel ma log par bsgrigs/ tshes nyi shur chos 'khor yang rtse ba dka' bcu blo bzang tshe ring gis mdzod 'grel chos(191nasgo ba rin cen 'dren pa'i shing rta dang / nges legs dpal bzang gis phar phyin 'grel ba blo bzang dgongs rgyan gyi tshig sbyor dang mtha' gcod rgyugs sprad/ nyer gnyis la kun dga' ra bar rta tshag rje drung / byang rtse chos rje/ spos dga' dang gling stod sku skye/ lar ka zhabs drung / gos spungs/ rgyud stod/ pha bong kha khyams pa/ ra ba stod/ mtshal yang dgon/ spe ser/shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor rnams kyi slob dpon/ gra tshang / drung 'khor/ tshogs chen/ phyogs 'dus kyi gra pa/ rgyal khag sogs skya ser khri tsho lhag dang bcas par gur nas bshad pa'i phyag rdor 'byung 'dul/ sman bla sprul sku/ spyan ras gzigs skyer sgang lugs/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ seng ldeng nags sgrol/ chag lugs kyi tshe dpag med dkar po rnams kyi rjes gnang / 'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel gyi gsung rgyun bzhin dmigs brtse mar brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ da lam gyi zang zing gi bdog pa ster mi byung bas mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad chud mi za ba'i ched bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs yang dag bgyis/ bka' gdams yang rtser bsod nams dbang —263

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (porgyal/ snar thang mkhan po/ pha bong kha'i gdan sa pa/ byang rtse dang ra ba stod slob dpon/ u zhang dpon mo bsod nams hung tha'i ji/ a ra na/ dbon chung dpon mo/ tshe ring gi bu mong gu/ kho shi'u chi tha'i ji'i dpon mo (191ba) bu bcas/ jo rig thu er khe da'i ching / thor god rgya mtsho sgrol ma/ bla khan dge slong / tshogs gsog rab 'byams pa/ khal kha che chen khung tha'i ji'i mi sna/ na ching dang er khe ja'i sang gi ma rnams kyi ngo bor byin rlabs dang byings la ngos phrad/nyer gsum la sde pa blo bzang sbyin pas gos sna cha tshang sogs bdog pa'i dngos po 'gyed bcas tshang nas mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i ring 'tsho spel/ mchod khang dkon gnyer yar klungs pa blo bzang 'phags pa dang / 'phyos pa ngag dbang phun tshogs gnyis kyis kyang gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa bstar/ kun dga' ra bar 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i mi sna mchod rten bla ma bstan 'dzin dge slong / gzhen pa mkhar sngon phyag na rdo rje/ 'grul sdebs pa dang bcas sum brgyar nye ba/'di ga'i mi sna snar thang mkhan po dang em chi thabs mkhas sogs dang phrad pa'i thog mar gong gi bka' shog rten bzang po dang bcas sprad/ nyer bdun la mtshams khang gong 'og tu mchod rten gnyis kyi las sbyor rgyas pa bdun gnyis sngon song gis mnan pa klu bdud te pa tsar gtad/ nyer dgur rgya nag gi mi sna rgan gzhen dang 'di ga'i mi sna bcas so sos bdog pa dngom che ba stong phrag tu longs pa bstab cing ngo bo rnams la lag gi 'degs 'jog /dmangs tshor me tog gtor/ shag skor ba'i dkar dro bteg /er khe da'i ching gi mi sna sogs dang phrad/ gra tshang gis 'chams dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi'i las sbyor kyang rgyas par bstar/gnam (192na)gang la ser stod slob dpon/ gzims khang dbon po/ cha skar bla ma'i gra pa tshul khrims bkra shis sogs la ja gral btang / gos sku sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyi dus bzos pa nub phyogs su bkram pa dang / rtsed sna mang po 'dug par bltas/ skya ser gyi khrom che ba snang /hor zla drug pa rjes ma'i tshes gcig la lha sa'i gong pa lta bu yer pa lha ri snying po 'di nyid du chos —2yo

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo mong bza' khri lcam dang sras gung ri gung btsan gyi rten skal rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku byin can/ lha khang dang bcas bzhengs par dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma 'byung gnas/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje sogs skyes chen du mas zhabs kyis gcags pa dang / khyad par mnyam med jo bo chen po dī paṃ kā ras zab pa las ches cher zab pa bka' gdams khu rngog 'brom gsum la sogs par chos kyi 'khor lo zad mi shes pa bskor ba'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa zhag gcig gi gnas 'brel thogs pas kyang phyir mi ldog par 'byung bas mtshon byin rlabs kyi mtshan kha shin tu che ba zhig yin kyang / mchod thebs che ba med cing ri gyen mtho bas phyogs nas kyang 'bul mi dkon pa'i mchod pa nyag phra bar 'dug pa sde pas nged ring 'tshor dmigs yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa yul wa ra ṇa sir bka' dang po bden don bcu gnyis kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshes nasaji srid bstan pa rin po che nam gnas kyi bar lha khang bcu bzhi so sor 'bru'i mar me nyin mtshan 'byongs pa'i sdong rkang re'i rgyu'i snum dang sdong (192ba)ras lha sa gnyer tshang nas rim sprod byed rgyu dang / dad 'bul gyi mchod me gang byung zur 'bul gong grangs su mi the bar nam byung ba spor ba las mi 'jog pa'i bsdam ra bgyis/ gong ma'i mi sna phyag na rdo rje/ bsod nams tshe dbang gi mi sna/ 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon gdan zur brgyad/ dge skos gnyis/ spyi gnyer/ 'tsho byed phrug po che pa/ shun gzhis ka ba sogs la byin rlabs dang / mgon khang yas mas tshor phyin te rab gnas bskyar ma dang bstan 'gro'i bde skyid gong 'phel gyi 'phrin las nan tar bcol/tshes gnyis la 'bras spungs spyi sos bskul ma mdzad pa'i sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i brtan bzhugs/mchod khang gtso bor gos yug lnga dang / gzhan tshor snyan shal re'i kha byang bkod/ tshes gsum la grog po pha rir zhi rgyas dbang drag gi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor byed pa'i khang pa'i gtso bor chos rgyal paṃ ga'i mtshan can gyi thugs kyi brnog chos 'jam dpal 'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon lcags 'dra'i mchod rten bcas chog dang / gsang sngags pho brang shod du dpal 'bri gung pa'i zab chos gshin rje —265

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (polcags sdig gi mchod rten gnyis bzhengs pa la'ang dam ye dbyer med dang las sbyor 'grub pa'i 'phrin bcol rgyas par byas/ mtsho kha nas gsar 'byor er te ni da'i ching gi mi sna/ pu ti ma'i bla zur/mdzes grong pa'i bu rnams dang phrad/ tshes bzhir gzims chung sgo khra'i gtor gzhi brjes pa'i gra pa bcu gcig dang bcas rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs dam bskang zhing spyi bye brag gi bstan pa rgyas pa dang (193na)sems can la bde ba 'byung ba'i 'phrin las bcol/ de mtshungs kun dga' ra bar grangasabacad kyis chos skyong spyi'i bskang ba/ gza' khang du'ang bskang ba 'dod gsol gzabs rgyas btang /bde ba can dang skyog mo sogs kyi dngos dpyad 'dres pa khungs ldan dang 'gangs can chos dang 'brel bas mtshon pa mtha' dag la so sor dbye nas kha byang btab cing / de phyin sde par gtad de phyag mdzod chen mor 'jog pa sogs gang 'tsham gyi bkod pa bgyis/ gnas chung sku rten par tshe dbang grub rgyal ma bskur zhing 'dul ba'i las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog par du brkos grub pa 'byor/tshes bdun la bde yangs pas rigs gra'i skal ba rtse shod lhan du ston mo gzabs/ bgro gleng byed par sngar nas dga' ba zhig yod pa da lam yang bzhugs gral gyi skabs phal cher byed bcug pa dus phyis 'jig rten gyi 'du 'god rang gi dbang du song ba yin nam/ gang ltar snga phyi'i rgol ba thamasacad jo bzang drags nas the tshom me ba'i ngang la 'jog ran te blo bde sing nge ba'i yid 'gro ba dka'/rta tshag rje drung rin po ches snga rgol mdzad par slob dpon rnams kyis rgol bar la las bzos lugs kyis spam me dang / kha cig gis gnad 'bebs byed na'ang 'di skabs spyi mthun las bla chen spyi'i zhabs la thag pa 'dogs par mi snang / rig bgros ji ltar yang shag skor zur pas sog skad sogs sna tshogs pa'i nyams 'char gyis dgod spro ba'i tshad cig byung ba lugs gcig tu bzang bar mchis/gong ma'i (193bas sna rgan gzhen/ 'grul sdebs blo bzang dpal 'dzin sogs dang dan 'bag gi dmigs brtse ma/ ma ṇi khag bcas par spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom lung / dmigs brtse mar brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor rjes/ khams gser kha lha khang steng / phug khang / lho mdongs mkhar chos sde/—266

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)dwags lha yul rnams kyi bla ma/ tsha ba theg thog gi gnas po bsod nams/ mtshur phu phyag mdzod/ stag lung zur pa'i phyag mdzod/ la mo sku rten pa nang tshang bcas pa/ g.yag sde gzhis sdod mkhar chen pa/a mdo ba sogs bod sog mang por ja gral thog lha khang steng bla mas dre'u bcu bdun/ ldan ma pu la gnyis kyis rta bco lnga/ snying thang dgon bla mas rta bcu bzhi/ stag lung zur pas rta so brgyad rnamasabyung / mchod khang tshor snyan shal 'bul bar mngags/ chos skyong chen pos da cha zhag grangs thengs pas srong btsan sgam po'i gnas su phyin pa 'gab tshul ltar tshes brgyad la dgon pa nas bteg gnas chung lcog tu rags bsdus kyis phyin par chos skyong gis ring 'tsho'i bdog pa rgyas par byung ba'i lan sku chas cha 'grig sogs gzabs nas phul zhing mchod yon gnyis dang bcas spyi sgos kyi lung bstan phra rags thams cad gsal por gsungs/ skyed tshal klu sdings su dpal ldan 'bras spungs slob dpon sogs kyi skyel mi mang ba dang / bsu bar se ra/ pha bong kha/ rgyud stod smad/ rta drung / gnyis gnyer sogs mang po 'byor pa ngo bo tshor byin rlabs dang / dmangs dang (194na)ngos phrad bgyis/ ser theg chen gling gi gra tshang khag khyud smad pa/ pha bong kha ba rnams kyis mchode rdzas du bcas te ser sbrengs/chos skyong bya rung ba 'khor bcas/ nyang dog sde bzhi sogs kyi bro gzhas rtsed sna mang pos bsus te 'du khang chen mor phyin/ spyi sos dkar dro dmar dro'i ston mo gzabs par bshams shing ster byin kyang 'dug pa'i mu 'thud stod gra tshang / pha bong kha/ mi chung ri pa sogs gyis bdog pa dkar dro sbomasasu bteg /tshes dgu'i zhogs byes gra tshang gis ston mo/ tshan grangs brkyang / khams tshan so sos dkar dro sdebs dang ster cha bcas ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsungs/ gung tshigs la smad gra tshang gis ston mo khams tshan dang bcas pas snga ma dang 'dra/ phyi dro ha sdong gis kyang ston mo ring 'tsho brjod pa sogs sngon dang mtshungs/ stod zur mdo mkhar chos sde'i bla ma/ ra ma rtse pa/ tshe gsum pa/ sbyar ra ba/ ri rgya ba sogs kyis kyang dkar dro tshan grangs byung / tshes bcur jo stan mkhan zur gnyis/ byes stod gdan —267—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gezur/ smad pa/ pha bong kha'i gdan sa pa rnams la ja gral dang / 'du khang du spyi sos zang zing gi skyesadang bcas nyi bu'i 'tshe ba las skyob pa'i bden tshig rtse gcig tu mos nas mdzad/ co ne gzhung pasadakar dro bdog pa'i rjes 'brang bstar/ phyi dro rdo gcal ོ mor rgyal po mchod yon gong ma rgyal po'i gser yig pa sogs skya ser khri tsho brgal bar sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i nang gi thakhred dmar/rdo rje (194ba)gdan pa gtso 'khor gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍita gser gdugs can gyi 'jam dbyangs/ bcom ldan ral gri lugs kyi klu dbang rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga pa/ thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs rnams kyi rjes gnang /rje btsun btsong kha par brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams phul ba'i 'jug tu yon bsngo rgyas par byas/ lha khang yas mas thams cad la 'dod tshig bris pa'i snyan shal 'bul bar btang / tshes bcu rjes mar grong smad skor gyi bro gzhas pa 'dug cing gzhis kar bslebs pa'i thog mar rung mthun gos cha tshang dpus legs kyis sna drangs 'gyed spams mtho ba dang bcas gra tshang nas mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung legs par bsgrigs/ gung tshigs la dkar dro dmar dro'i ston mo shin tu rgya che ba phun sum tshogs pa'i steng 'bras spungs gzhung las pha ra rab 'byams pa tshe mgon gyis snga rgol dang / rtser smad lha sab rab 'byams pa blo gros rin cen gyis phyi rgol bgyis te drang nges rnam 'byed nas brtsams te gleng ba blo gros rin cen de kha cag shin tu bde zhing lung yang shog ldebs re 'don pa'i spobs pa mtho nyams dod/ gzhung las pa rkang pa'i sdig sgra dang yon tan gyi gting gzhi gnyis ka things pa 'dug /'du khang sogs kyi tshogs langs pa gzhan rnams ni sngar brjod kyi rjes su ma 'brangs na lugs gnyis ka nas rtsad gcod byung dogs yin pa 'dra srang la bteg pa ltar khyad par mi snang / rol cha zlos gar/ gral sa sogs kyang bstar/ rnam sras dang zur phud lnga pa'i rten sogasal dam tshig (195na)par ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs bstim zhing ci 'dod kyi re ba skong ba'i me tog des mtshon steng 'og bar gsum du khyab par gtor/ rtser ba sogs kyis skyel mi dang rme ru bla ma/ lha sab sogs kyis bsu mkhan/ rme ru ba'i ser sbrengs/ lha sa/ rnying khungs/ bco brgyad/ son ma pa/—268—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)zhol pa sogs kyi bro gzhas pa dang bcas pa'i dkyil brgyud rang byung 'phags pa'i pho brang chen por slebs/ nam dus kyi stabs yin nam/ gang ltar da res kyi 'gro 'dug gzhis len tshang mar char pa tshad med pa zhig byung ba shag skor bla ma lhun grub sngon mo sogs longs spyod che ba'i ltas shin tu bzang zer/ sde pa'i skyid chu'ang sngar mi grags lta bu rgyas pa dang bcas nged dang sde pa gnyis ga'i khams me yin pa gtsug lag ltar na chu bo che zhing char mang dogs pa dgos tshul gleng ba bzhin spor thang gi 'bras brjod ltar na bden pa tsam snang zhing khyad par 'di nyin dang 'bras spungs nas yongs zhogs se rar ma 'byor bar char lhag par che bas rta chas sogs la'ang gzan tsam byung song / 'bras spungs su sdod ring bzang ngan dpyad dka' ba'i bud med kyi nying 'phrul mang ba dang rgyal po'i ltas 'dra rung ba rang gi chos skyong gi rnam 'gyur dang 'drel 'tha cha mi things pa mang po dang / po ta la nas thon nyin bon phrug pa ngag dbang rab brtan gdon gnod kyi nad drag po'i skyon gyis 'das/ 'dar pa lo chen grang nad phran bu las med kyang dgon par glos sna drangs khrag skyug pa sogs shin tu nyen pa dang /byang gling 'dre bor nad ma things pa (195bsko bus myur bar khams ma 'tsho/ mchod dpon pa se ra nas rgyu tshad kyis bab lci bas na/ rnam gling paṇa chen sogs kha shas zhag sbrel du ma bde/ khal kha chos rje ngag dbang grags pa don med du rbab la 'gril/ sde pa'i mgron gnyer yig mkhan 'gag pa sogs la thor yan byung bas mtsho ni 'bras spungs su zla gcig zhag gsum/ se rar zhag gsum las ma song rung nad sna mang zhing char shin tu che ba byung ba dang mthun par sprul sku gter bdag gling pa la'ang mnal ltasang na pa kha shas dang lhag don nged la mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma yod pa lta bu'i 'tshub che ba las bzlog pa'i ched ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung spel bar mchog grub rdzong bda' mdzad pa ltar chab shog tshan grangs dang bcas blangs/ de lan rten gyi khyad dbang mdog gos kha lnga sogs rgyas par phul/tshes bcu gcig la gong ma'i mi sna gzhen pa/ rgyal po'i sras mo kun dga' rab brtan sogs dpon mo bzhi dang bcas par byin rlabs byas/ mchod dpon pa'i ngor gra tshang chos srung tshor 'bul —269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (poba'i snyan dar kha yig dang / yar lha sham bhu/ rdzong btsun pa/ pho lha dpal 'byor rgyal po/ seng gdong dkar po/ thang rtse ba 'a po/ spo shod rgyal po rnams kyi gsol mar/ 'phyong rgyas pa ngag dbang mkhas btsun gyis gral skor dus gra tshang du dngul kong dang / em ji thabs mkhas kyis gra tshang du snyan dar so lnga'i kha byang / nged rang gi snang ba zhig tu shar ba ltar/ sde pas dpal lha lcog tu tshes bcu gsum phur bu chu stod kyi gza' tshes 'phrod sbyor bzang (196na)por bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ rma bya'i gdugs sogs kyi rgyu dang phogs yon bsdoms gshor khal tshig stong bzhi brgya song ba phul ba dang lhan cig dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan shal kha byang 'chi med bdag po'i dpal 'dzin/spus srang gser khang pa'i mgron po bā yan shu ling gsi jo bo rin po cher dkar me'i snod phul ba'i smon lam/ 'chad ka zhabs drung ngag dbang blo bzang lhun grub kyi bzhed skong gsol 'debs dang ring 'tsho dwags po gra tshang bla brgyud kha skong / rgyal sras shes rab 'phel ba'i sprul skus bka' 'gyur ro cog dang paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs gser zangs las grub pa bzhengs par mdzad pa'i dkar chag che brjod/ sa'i tshangs pa bstan 'dzin da la'i khang gis gangs can du 'gyur ro cog gi bka' rnams bzhengs par mdzad pa'i che brjod dkar chag dang / 'dul mdo sher phyin dkon brtsegs phal chen rgyud 'bum rnams so so'i mjug tu 'dri ba'i smon lam dang bcas pa brtsams/g.yon ru'i mi sna gsas khang sku skye can 'byor par ja gral dang yi ge rten sbrags blangs/tshes bcu bzhin 'bras spungs slob dpon/ dge skos/ spyi gnyer/ sku rten pa dang bcas pasagegs med du 'byor bar legs bya bstab/ tshes bcu drug la yer pa gra tshang bla gnyer/ ras chung phug phyag mdzod sogs dang phrad/ lha mo rigs 'dzin mas bod khams bde thabs la mchims phur dgongs 'dus blos bslangs 'og dgra bgegs gnon dgos tshul ltar gra tshang gi gra pa grangs (196ba)bcad kyis ki gang bdun gcig tshes bcu bdun nas sgrub pa'i 'go dang / tshes nyi shu nas sprel lo'i keg srir dmigs grangs bcad kyis dur phung gtso bor gyur pa'i sri gnon kyang btsugs/—270

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)nyer gsum la lha ldan bsnyen gnas ma tshos yon sbyar bdog pa dang bcas gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa spel/ ra ba stod bla gras kyang tshan grangs bcas yun 'tsho'i tshigs bcad dbyangs su bsgrags/ gsas khang dgon dang ri khro dga' ldan bla gras kyang so sor gong dang 'dra/ 'chad ka zhabs drung / 'phags sde bla gnyer/ cung glang ri bla ma/ 'bras mo gshongs pa'i mi sna gnyis/ ma hā ku mā ra dang khod pā thur ji nong gi mi sna/ dar sdings pa ma bu/ tsha ba shi khod gnas po/dga' ldan rab rgyas gling gnyer pa/ ldan ma gling dge slong gi mi sna/ hor a brag dpon/ a mdo 'ga' shing / brag ti'i 'grul pa rnams kyi ngo bor byin rlabs/ spyir ngos phrad/ dar sdings pa'i rta brgyad dang brag ti'i dgu byung /nyer bzhir em chi thabs mkhas kyis ster byin 'gyed dang bcas gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa mdzad/ skyor lung mkhan slob gra bcas kyis bdog pa dang bcas tshigs bcad gsungs/ yul jo'i thu pā thur 'dam nas lor ba/ gong ma'i mi sna gtsang du thon rgyu dang phrad/nyer lnga'i dus bzang por sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshor byang gter thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi byin rlabs thugs rje'i dbang / las byang dngos grub yongs (197na〉〉'i gter mdzod/ gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma/ bsams pa lhun grub ma/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang bcas pa'i lung / de rnams kyi dmigasaskor rnams zhib mor khrid/ se ra byes smad stod slob dpon dge skos dbu mdzad sogs kyis kyang 'dir 'byor legs skyes bstar/hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bzhi nas tshag gur ba blo bzang 'phrin las phag ri nas 'byor par ja gral dang / dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi ngor bsangs mchod dgra lha dpangs bstod dang 'brel ba lha rgyal snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs/ sis rgya mtsho che ba'i zhing bkod chos rgyal byang pa'i ljags bkod thugs dam rten bris legs ma'i zhal yas zur 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyi lag dar ma/ ngam ru bas nged rang gi 'dra 'bag /dge slong blo gros rgyal bas paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs —271—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('a'agro la rjes brtse ma dang mthun pa/ lha sa spyi khang mdo pa dkon cog rab brtan gyis ye shes mkhan po phyag drug pa/ tshe dbang rab brtan gyis sman sku 'gro la rjes brtse ma dang mthun pa/ thang ga so lnga rnams bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig smon lam/ lho 'brug la dmigs ma spyod kyi las rim par nyams su blangs pa'i lag rtags dpon tshab smon skyid pa mi 'gyur brtan pa/ g.yul gsar pa'i tsha bo ngag dbang rab brtan sogs khong pa tshor byas pa che ba mang po dmar gsod kyis mtshon nang zhig byung skabs rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag dar 'chol gyi thugs dam tshes gsum (197bskos nyin gsum bar bskang pa'i tshe 'dod don gsol ba/ gi rkang dang log trir dmigs bsal gsol byang / ser skyems dmod byang / lha sab blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis gra tshang du snyan shal brgya skor 'bul rgyu dang / 'phags pa'i dkon gnyer gong dkar ba blo bzang bzod pas kyang gra tshang du phyed nyis brgya skor gyi kha byang / slob dpon ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs kyi ngor gzhan phan gling du 'dzugasargyu dang shing rtsi bsgrubs pa'i bsngo smon/ 'du khang gi ming tshigs bcad ma/ g.yon ru bo shog thu dbon chung bstan 'dzin tho yon gyi tsha brgyud kyi kha ton/ yod khon thang po che'i zhig gsos grub ga rtenas ma chad 'bul gyi skabs chos skyong gis bskul ma/ mes ston khro rgyal dpal mgon bde ba can du skye ba/ dar chi tha'i ji khyo shugs/ bstan pa dge slong gi tshem bu dmar khrid dang 'brel ba rnams so so'i 'dod sbyar gyi smon lam/ dbu mdzad kyis bkra shis bde chen du rim par sbyar ba'i deb kyi 'go brjod/ ka tshal bla ma rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub kyi 'phrin lan snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa/ u chu mu chu ja sag che chen ching wang gi ngor bde mchog dkar po dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ chos bkra shis dang tshul khrims bkra shis/ rgyal mo rdo rje rab brtan ma gsum gyis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ mtsho sna dga' ldan rab rgyas gling spyi sodang / lha khang pa rdo rje nor bu'i ngor ring 'tsho rnams bkod/ tshes bdun la nad rims bzlog ched sha brgya zan brgya nged rang gis btang / (198na sko pa'i sku rim la gra tshang gi gra pa grangs bcad kyis lha sa nas rgyal po rtse mdos ha la sogs rgyas pa chag med kyi rgyun btsugs/—272

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)tshes brgyad la 'dar pa rje drung ngag dbang 'phrin las dang chu skor bar pa'i mag par ja gral/ gsasakhang sku skye sogs mang dag la nang rten 'jal kha zhib par btang / chos rje zil gnon rdo rje bsam yas pa sku phebs zhus nas 'khor/ tshes dgur rdzong ri ba blo bzang pad+ma dang ngag dbang phun tshogasaganyis bka' brgyad/ a gling dngos grub rgya mtsho rdo rje gro lod/ dkon cog ngag dbang dang dbang phyug rgya mtsho gnyis thugs sgrub/ rin cen rgya mtsho dang don grub rgya mtsho gnyis dregs pa 'joms byed/ legasabashad rgya mtsho rta mgrin gsang sgrub rnams kyi so sor bsnyen dmigs zhib mor khrid nas mtshams bsdam du bcug /tshes bcur sgyid thang nor bus gos sna cha 'grig bdog pa spams mtho 'gyed dang bcas gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa bstar rjes/ 'ol snar thang sag zur pa/ gsas khang dang sgrom mdar se ra smad pa re/ rta dbang dga' ldan lha rtser rgyud smad dbu mdzad rnams gsar 'khod bla ma/ me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho/ bla ma sngon ma'i skye ba/ 'ol sna spyi sa/ skyed tshal gong mkhan po/mon pa a 'dzin pha bu bzhi/ a mdo rta 'bul ba chos 'phel/ klu 'bum bsam grub can/ bya bral rab stims pa/ ra mgo rgya mtsho sogs ngo bo bcas bdun cu skor/ rgya mkhar (198ba༄na ngo bo gsum/rgya nag mi sna'i g.yog nag chu kha sogs nas gsar 'byor/ sngon du log mi 'go pa bsam blo dka' bstong ga dbang bstan 'dzin can/ 'grul sdebs dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ er khe ji/ smad ta dzod mar rnam rgyal/ stong 'khor zhabs drung gi nu bo paṇ+ḍita'i mi sna rnam rgyal dge slong / khod pā thur ji nong gi mi sna dge slong ngag dbang chos 'phel bsod nams kyi ja'i sang kho sho'u chi sogs nyis brgya skor gyi ngo bor byin rlabs/ dmangs la ngos phrad gos dar sogs kyang bteg /klu 'bum blo bzang can gyis rta brgyad/bsam grub can gyis nyer gnyis/ blo bzang chos 'phel can gyis nyer dgu/ pā ras chos lung chos rje can gyis sogasum/ bya bral rab 'byams pas sodagu/ ra go rgya mtsho can gyis bas drug rnams byung /tshes bcu gcig la dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gis tshogs yon ster bya'i bdog pa —273

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pospams bstod de gra tshang nas tshe'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye ste mi 'gyur brtan pa'i cho ga gyer/ tshes bcu gnyis la snar thang mkhan po ngag dbang bkra shis kyis gser zho brgya sogs dngos po dngom che ba/tshogs 'gyed bcas snga ma dang mtshungs/ tshes bcu gsum la lha sab blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis bdog pa'i skyes 'gyed dang bcas 'bras gshongs dag snang ma'i bsrun bzlog gra tshang nas mdzad/dbu mdzad bag dro can gyis go mdzod du sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/ tshe'i lha mo tsaṇ+ḍasnyi la gu ru'i thugs su byon pa'i bud med lngas bskor ba/ lha lcam (199na skong 'tsho rgyal rnams mtshan brgyad lha khang du bzhugs rgyu dang / bal po pi la dza'i bsngo rten du byung ba'i lha tshogs gser sku rnams la bka' 'gyur khang du gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas gzungs phul bar nged rang gis sbyang gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i dam tshig par ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs tshad med bstim ste me tog gtor/tshes bco lngar bo shog thu khang gi nu bo/ er te ni 'bum/ sku 'bum sku skye bsod nams bkra shis/dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang rnams kyi mi sna/ la mo sku rten pa rnams la byin rlabs ja gral bgyis/ tshes bcu drug la li thang mkhan zur gyi mi sna sogs dang phrad cing drang srong bum skyes kyisabaden tshig brjod pas nyal 'gro mtha' dag yan lag brgyad ldan gyi sman chab tu bsgyur ba nas nyin bdun bar nan tan du brgyab/tshes bco brgyad la dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi mi sna gsas khang sku skye dang / g.yon waṃ bla mar 'gro mir ber sogs bdag rkyen gzabs nas thon/ nyer lngar rdzing phyi mkhan po/ jo rdzongasasgar gra tshang gi bla ma/ gong ma'i mi sna gzhen pa gtsang nas 'khor ba/ zhing skyong nang so/ a rgya nang so/gling dpon dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ khod ma gcig gi dpon mo dkon cog 'bangs bu bcas/ kha than no yon gyi bu ban+de thar/ dge 'dun gyi du ral kho sho'u chi/ bā yan su/ dbu sgor chung ba'i ja'i sang sogasal ja gral/ tshogs gsog rab (199ba tshems par snar thang brgya rtsa'i nang gi gdugs dkar gyi rjes gnang bskur zhing ༷ pa'i bu'i skra phud blangs pa'i ming 'phrin las dpal bzang du btags te —274

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)rgyun sdod drug 'khor gras su zhugs/nyer drug la tsho gos rams par rdzong 'da' bka' bsgo/bsam yas chos skyong ོ po'i lung bstan ltar rtse shod thun mong rim gror bka' 'gyur dang /'ol dkar dge dgon tsho bsdus brgyas sgrol sher 'bum ther gnyis re/tshe gzungs sa ya gcig/zan g.yang du rab byung pas dri med bshags rgyud brgya/yul pa nang 'khrugs sogs nyes chung rigs kyi btson pa dge stong sa bcad ma stong tsam byung rjes gzhung sgrub kyi chad khrims yang ngos glod/yar 'brog tu nya 'bum gyi srog blus/sde pa'i sger rim du gra tshang nas rgyal btsun gyi bskang ba stong phrag re/mnga' ris sogs jus rim la khra 'brug tu dpal ri bas khro rol/gong dkar du rdo rje brag pas la 'a ka/rgyab chos su brgyad stong pa brgya/lo rim la rdzong gzhis so so nas ri mgo mtho sar bsangs dang /gzhi bdag la gsol mchod/nad rims zhi thabs su bstan ma dang ma mo'i mdos/g.yang rnams bkug/brtag pa dang chos skyong khag gi lung bstan go bstun nged rang gi rim gror gdugs dkar dang sgrol ma nyer gcig/rgyal chen bzhi/rta mgrin rnams kyi 'bur sku/sher phyin ma'i sku bcas grub par rab gnas dang ldan 200na ) pa pho brang 'di ga'i chos rgyal lha khang du bzhugs su gsol/gnas chen rdzong gzhis/dgon bcas 'brel mtshungs dgur gra pa bco lnga res tshe sgrub smin rgyas/ser 'bras su ja tshul thog tshe gzungs sa ya gcig/sgrol sher 'bum ther re/gnyis rtse sogs rdzong khag drug tu dge dgon 'brel mtshungs tsho bsdus phyed nyis brgya res bka' 'gyur brgya dang brgyad/gdugs dkar dgu stong /tshe gzungs tshig 'bum dgu khri/sher snying lnga khri/sgrol ma chig 'bum sum khri lnga stong / lha sar ngan slong mang bar bza' btung byin/g.yag lug brgya'i srog blus/dbus gtsang rdzong gnyis 'og gi lam zam zhig pa bzos/mchod rten nyi shur sku dkar/pha bong khar lan chags gtor ma 'bum/gra tshang nas phyogs bzhir glud mang ba dang /sde pa'i gegs sel la tshe dbang brgya tshar dang byab khrus byas shing /lha sa/bsam yas/khra 'brug/yer pa/mchims phu/shel brag/yum bu/pha boX kha rnams su mchod pa sna lnga brgya tshar/rgyal du lha

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khoramor stong /srung ma gas tshor brgya re/snyan dar/khrus gsol/rin spungs sogs rdzong gzhis drug tu dgon 'brel mtshungs nas gra pa bco lnga res gsar rnying tshe sgrub zhag bdun re/gzhis rtser 200bzha lu pas gdugs dkar mdos chen/rgyab cho so myug chos gling pas gdugs dkar khri/ser 'bras su ja tshul thog sgrol sher gdugs dkar so so nas 'bum ther re/lha sar gsas khang pas 'bum brgya/gzungs 'dus stong /gong dkar du rdo rje brag pas ki gang gi mnan pa bdun gcig/mchims phur dpal ri bas dgongs 'dus kyi sgrub mchod bdun phrag gcig/lha sa dang bsam yas su dkar me brgya/pha bong khar chab gtor 'bum/klu sbug/klu rgyal/mkhar nag/mal dro gzi chen bzhir 'brel mtshungs dge slong bzhi res klu gtor brgya/sngon ma gnyis su zhang ston pas klu rten btsugs/yer par rang gras sāts+tsha 'bum/bsam yas/gnas chung /bar khang gsum du rgyal gsol brgya re/bsam yas bar rtsis brag btsan par rta sga bcas/ral gri dgos tshul ltar bsrings/rin spungs su byamasachen pa brgyas bka' 'gyur bcu gsum/sher snying /nyi khri bdun stong /tshe gzungs tshig khri brgyad stong /sgrol ma bzhi khri lnga stong /sku rab rnam rgyal du dwags po gra tshang pas gzungs 'dus dang 'bum brgya re/dkon brtsegs bcu/gra tshang nas mi kha bzlog bsgyur/phyogs bzhir glud mang /ris med dgon ang 201na ) gsum yan la mang ja/lha sar g.yag lug lnga bcu'i srog blus/dbul 'phongs lnga bcur sbyin pa/lha sa'i shar phyogs su rma dar dkar po bcu/ri 'go brgyar bsangs/rlung dar/dbus gtsang sgo ma'i lam tsong zhig pa gsos/mar rten bas sku dkar/chos rgyal srong bsto sgam po'i 'bur sku dang /sgrol dkar gyi brgya thang /rtse shod thun mong gi rim gror ser 'bras su ja tshul sum cu re'i thog sgrol ma dgu 'bum/sher snying brgyad 'bum/spe ser nyi thang bsgril ba brgyas brgyad stong pa tshig stong /bstan srid spyi rim la ser 'bras gnyis su gra pa sum cu res mgon chos bskang ba 'gro gang che zhag gsum gyi mjug gtor ma 'phangs/lha sa/bsam yas/khra 'brug gsum du mchod pa sna lnga brgya re/lha sar gra tshang /yang rdzong du zur a gu//mchims phur dpal ri ba/shel brag tu rang

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (5)gra rnams kyis tshogis brgya/ rdzong gzhis so sor mgon khang gang yod la bskang bshags/ dgra lha dpangasabastod/ bkra bzang sogs gnas chen lngar rnying dgon 'brel mtshungs gra slob bcu gcig res sgrub zhag bdun rer gnod byed mtha' 'dre gtso gyur gyi mnan pa/ gong dkar du rdo rje brag pas mgon po g.yul bzlog /rin spungs su nges gsang rdor gling pa/ do bo (201ba)rdzong du don gnyis gling pa/'phyong rgyas su ri bo bde chen pa dang bkra shis bde chen pa bsgril ba/ sne'u sdong du rtsed thang lnga mchod pa dang ri bo chos gling pa bsgril ba brgya res bka' 'gyur bcu gsum/ dmigs brtse ma bye ba gcig /gzungs 'dus dang thang yig brgya re/ sman bla sum stong / dga' ldan du ja tshul thog gdugs dkar dang sgrol ma khri re/ sher snying 'bum/ lo rim la lha sa/ gong dkar/ gnyis rtse/ rgyal rtse rnams nas sngags pa 'brel mtshungs kyis phyogs bzhin ma mo'i khrag mdos/ ri 'go mtho ba lngar bsangs chu mig gnyan sa lngar gra pa brgyad res klu gtor dang klu 'bum nyin gang ma/ po ta la dang 'phyong rgyas sogs rdzong gnyis zhe bdun nas yar ngor dpangs bstod/ rnam 'joms sme brtsegs gang rung gi byab khrus rnams kyis rang gzhan spyi sger gyi bde thabs bsgrubs/ a chi dge tshul ma dpon mo bu bcas drug /cha gan no mun khan gyi mi sna em chi blo gros/ smad ta dpon/ mtshan sgrog 'bul dpon ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ 'bri gung phyag mdzod sogs dang phrad/ smad ta dpon gyis rta brgyad/ mtshan sgrog 'bul dpon pas bco lnga/ 'bri gung phyag mdzod pas nyi shu rnams 'dug /dgongs thun nas hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu'i bar sgo gsum mi 'da' ba'i bcad rgya shin tu dam pa bgyis/tshes brgyad la sde pa dang dmag zor tshangs dbang la rta mgrin zhabs brgyad pa'i byin rlabs dang /bcu gcig la tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster brgya tshar bskur/ dpal (202na)grong sngags rams pas paṇa chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i phyag rjes gsal ba byin pa nang rten gras su bcug /tshes bcu gnyis la gsang phu gling stod smad kyi chos rje/ slob dpon dang drung chen khag /gra dmangs dang bcasapas tshan grangs brkyang ste ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsungs/ dol gsung rab gling pas kyang san khang —277—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khoragis bskul ma mdzad pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug dang 'brel ba'i chog sgrigs nang bzhin gyer/ rgya nag gong ma'i mi sna gnyis/ da'i ching kho lo chi dang li thang mkhan po'i bsngo rten skyel mi/ cha gan no mun khan dang nag pā thur tha'i ji g.yog bcas/ mi sna er khe da'i ching gi dar khan em chi/ jo rig thu kho sho'u chi'i dar khan ja'i sang / rgyal po'i er te ni ja'i sang / pā thur ji nong gi mi sna rnams/phag ri'i lho pa bstan pa rgyal mtshan/ a mdo zung chu/ sku 'bum/ pā ras/ brag nye khams tshan/ 'a shur dang bcas par ja gral rjes skya ser nyis stong lhag tsam bde yangs su 'khod par ka spungs steng nas me tog gtor/ cha gan no mun khan gyis rta nyis brgya/ rnga mo brgyad/ the bo gro sku skyes rta nyi shu/'ur du su paṇ+ḍi ltas bcu/ pā thur tha'i jis brgyad/ 'brom pa dkon cog rgyal pos bcu/ zung chu snang zhig rab 'byams pas nyer gsum/ chos rgya mtshos nyer bdun/ chos rgyal mtshan gyis bcu/ sog po dka' bcu blo bzang bkra shis kyis bcu gcig /(202ba〉sdin ma blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis bcu/a rgya nang sos nyer bdun/ da'i ching kho chis dgu/ dar sdings pas brgyad rnams byin/ phyi dro gsang phu ba dpon slob dang / gsung rab gling pa yongs rdzongs la phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang bskur/tshes bcu gsum la gong ma'i gser yig pa rgan gzhen 'grul sdebs dang bcas pas tshogs yon ster byin gzabs te gra tshang nas tshe dpag med longs sku ma'i rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/ tshes bcu bzhir tha shi bo lod kyis kyang nyin snga ma dang 'dra ba'i ring 'tsho bstar ba'i mur gser khang bla mas yun 'tsho'i tshan grangs byung / dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi mi snas skyes spams mtho dang bcas gra tshang gi gra pa bcus mi 'gyur ba'i bden tshig brjod/tshes bco brgyad la rta tshag rje drung / rdzing phyi dang snar thang mkhan po/ sger pa rje drung / gong gi mi sna sogs bod sog bdun cur kha cig gis thog ma nas rnam sras ser chen gyi rjes gnang bskur ba snang yang tshad ldan bla ma bsten pa'i phyag len la gong gnon phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang lugs kyi rjes gnang bskur nas mdzad pa bzhin sngon du btang ste rgyas bkab dang gti thug rigs 'gre ma yin pa —278—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / gser chos seng gdong sngon mo'i rjes gnang zin steng bod sog bdun brgya skor la ye shes khyung khra/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ rnam 'joms ljang sngon/ seng ldeng nags sgrol rnams zur bka' bskur/tshes bcu dgu nas zhag shas bar rdzing phyi mkhan po/ ra ba stod/ (203na)'or pa/ skyid grong 'phags pa'i sku gnyer gsum gyi bla ma/ gong ma'i gser yig pa phyag na rdo rje/ khams gling / 'dul ba/ bstan 'dzin gsum gyi sku skye sogs bsnyen rdzogs nyis brgya bco lnga/ dge tshul chig brgya bstobazhi/dge bsnyen gcig rnams bsgrubs/ snar thang mkhan po'i gsar bzhengs bka' 'gyur ro cog la rab gnas/ nyer bzhi'i zhogs rta dpon rnam 'joms kyis bdog pa dang bcas gra tshang gis gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa spel/ gung tshigs la gong ma'i mi sna 'grul sdebs dang bcas pa 'di ga'i mi sna rdzing phyi mkhan po bsam grub sgang pa bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po'i mi sna rnams la ston mo/byin rten/ gyon pa/ shal dkar dmar/ snam phrug sogs sngar bzhin bdag rkyen sprad/ phyi dro gong gsal rnams kyi steng / pagi dang bya khyung mkhan po'i mi sna bcas par ja gral btang /nyer lnga la dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang gis ster byin spams mthor bteg cing 'gyed dang bcas gra tshang nas mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i ring 'tsho'i cho ga mdzad/ bya rung chos skyong gis bskul nas lha ldan ru bzhi spyi tshogs bsdu cha byas pa yun 'tsho dang / yer pa bla gras kyang dngos po'i tshan grangs brkyang ste mi mthun sde las rgyal ba'i smon lam gsungs/ stag lung ri bo che pa yab srasagasum/ stag rtse tha'i ji lha rgyal rab brtan/ byams gling dang stag lung mkhan po ka drug pa/ (203ba)brag dbar bla gra nyis brgya skor rnams dang mjal phrad/ ri bo che'i rta brgyad cu sogs skyes snang / yer pa gra tshang yongs rdzogs la rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen por brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / tal khar brtsams pa'i sgom byang gi lung / rgya nag tu 'gro mkhan mi sna rgan gzhon la zhu yig dang ngag mar zhib cha bgyis/ lo dgon pa bas gur mgon las mkhan ru 'dren dang bcas pa'i ltad mo bstan/—279

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogenyer drug la sems dpa' sprul sku lo dgon dang bcas pas bdog pa'i ster byin 'gyed sogs yon sbyar gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa bstar/ rgyud smad gra tshang gi ngor brgyud pa'i bla ma'i kha skong / mchod dpon pas bskul ba'i bkras rab gser gling rgyal po'i gsol mchod dang / snyan dar kha yig /ka gzhi smad pas mtshan brjod brkos pa'i par byang / gzhung gi rgya nag tu thags su 'thag rgyu'i snyan shal kha byang rnams bris/ 'di ga'i mi sna gnyis/ gra tshang gnyer pa/ gnasachung sku rten pa rnams la tshe dbang dang de steng sems dpa' chen po gra slob bcas par sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang bskur nas shar pa chos rje'i mi sna gnyis/ me rag bla ma/ gong ma'i mi sna rgan gzhon 'grul sdebs sogs la nang rten rags rim gyi mjal kha btang / dga' ldan gsung rab gling pa dka' bcu blo bzang mchog legs dang / dka' bcu blo bzang dar rgyas kyis mdzod rtsa 'grel/ sbyin pa rin cen gyis dbu ma rtsa 'grel/ blo bzang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ blo bzang rab 'byor/(204na)bkra shis rgya mtsho/ blo bzang nor bu/ blo bzang blo brtan rnams kyis phar phyin 'grel pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gyi thal phreng / chos 'khor yang rtse ba bsam gtan rgya mtshos dbu 'grel theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings rnams kyi rgyugs sprad/nyer bdun la zhang ston ri khrod pa dang ka ru bla ma sogs dang phrad/ nyer brgyad nas gnam gang bar cha gan no mun khan gyi sku skye/ a mdo a rgya nang so dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ 'u du su tha'i ji dang / paṇ+ḍi ta/ pā ras chos lung chos rje dpal 'byor bzang po sogs bsnyen rdzogs mig brgya zhe drug /tre bo sku skye sogs dge tshul bco brgyad/ dge tshul ma gnyis rnams bsgrubs/ sde pas nged rang ring por 'tsho ched gsung rab gling pa nyis brgyas zhag bcu'i bar brgyad stong pa chig stong lnga brgya/ sgar gra tshang pa bzhi bcu skor gyis gzungs 'dus zhag shas sgrogs/ lho brag sras kyi dben gnas 'di paṇa chen nā ro pa chen po'i dngos slob skad gnyis smra ba'i skyes mchog mar pa lo sto pa yab sras kyi bsti gnas mchog tu gyur pa yin cing bsil ldan ljongs 'dir rgyud thams cad kyi yang rtse dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i —280—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)bshad srol rnam dag cig tshugs na 'phags yul dbus 'gyur 'chang nas thog mar rgyud cha lag dang bcas gdan 'dren mdzad pa po mar pa lo tsā chos kyi blo gros yin gshis rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i mthu las gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs chen por gsang sngags phyi 'gyur gyi bstan pa rin po che dkar cha'i zla ba lta bur 'phel ba'i (204ba)dgos pa che bar mngon na'ang snga sor ma byung 'dug pa da sgos gsang ba 'dus pa gtso bor gyur pa'i sngags gra'i chos sde zhig skabs su babs pas chos 'khor rgyal gyi gra tshang gi ya rgyal sgar pa gra tshang 'pho skyas byas te gra tshang gsar btsugs dga' ldan gsang sngags bde chen du grags pa'i rgyun gyi gtong sgo 'debs gshor mkha' ru zhe gcig gi sras sku mkhar gyi lcags khra lha khang du rje mar pa'i sku 'dra rtsa ris ma gtsor gyur gyi mchod me nyin khyongs sdong rkang gsum res mtshon mchod pa sna lnga gsum re dang / dri gtsang khang byang chub snying po sogs mchod khang gsum dang / gro bo lung gi rje mar pa'i gdung khang bcas par mchod pa lnga tshar re/mar me nyin khyongs/ khyams kyi lha mo'i bris sku shangs mtshal ma dang / mgon khang du mchod pa lnga tshar sgron chas chang phud dang bcas pa re/ rgyun gtong gsar btsugs gra tshang gzhan las dpangs bstod pa'i chos thog zla ba bcu'i phogs/ bla gnyer sger g.yog las byed rta nor gyi rdzi bo bcas par lo 'khor mgron thebs/ bla gra khyon drug cu re bzhi la nar mar ja gnyis dang thug pa gnyis/ zla ba ngo re bzhin gyi tshes gsum la bsangs dang bstan gsol/ tshes bcur dpal ldan srid gsum bdag mo gtso gyur gyi bskang gso/ tshes bcu bzhir rje btsun mi la'i dus mchod sna lnga'i mchod pa 'phar re/tshogs su las gshin gtsor bton gyi bskang ba/ tshes lngar shar phyogs rgyal rigs thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ brgyad la paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa dang kun mkhyen dge (205na)'dun rgya mtsho/ bco lngar mar pa lo chen/ nyer bdun la thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho rnams kyi sku mchod la mchod pa 'phar ma re dang bcas gsang ba 'dus pa'i bdag mdun bum gsum bdag 'jug sogs cha tshang tshar re/ sngar rgyun 'dug pa bcas tshes bdun brgyad dgu gsum la dpal —281—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pomagon zhal gtsor byas kyi bskang gso/ nyer dgur phyag drug pa gtsor brtan gyi bskang ba rnams chag med/ lo star gyi zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig la lo gsar/ bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad nas bco lnga'i bar gsang 'dus kyi sgrub mchod rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa/ drug pa dang bdun pa'i tshes bco lngar dkar me bskul chang gi ltad mo sogs kyi gtong sgo/ bcu pa'i nyer lnga mchod pa chen mor nyer spyod lnga bdun tshar/ bgragacig pa'i nyer dgur bstan srid spyi rim dang / bskyogacig pa dang bcu gnyisapa gang rung la gtor gzhi spo ba'i bskang gso nyin gang ma/ bcu gnyis pa'i nyer dgur lo 'jug gtor rgyag rnams sgrigs chug gi gtong sgo mtha' dag gi rgyur spel gsar rgyu lnga mi ser bsdad grong re lnga/'bab 'bru khal nyis stong dgu brgya don dgu/ mar khal bzhi brgya bco brgyad/ thab gdan 'dren dpyad sogs kyi dngos po/ ru ba khag gcig /ja phogs po ta la dang lha sa gang rung gi 'phral bde nas dmar 'degs khal nga bzhi rim sprod ji srid bskal pa'i bar dang / gro bo lung dgon smad kyi btsun ma rnying pa'i thog phu dkar dang mgar (205ba)tshang gi btsun ma bsgril ba bcas nyer lnga skor gyis dgon gnas kha 'dzin le shor med pa'i sra thang zegs 'thor zom lus ma byung ba'i ngos rim gro sgrub dgos kyi gtong sgo zla ba ngo re bzhin tshes bcu/ bzhi pa'i tshes gnyis nas bcu drug gi bar smyung gnas/bdun pa'i bco lnga skor la dkar thog pa brgyad cu skor gyi gtong sgo/ bcu gcig pa'i nya stong gnyis la yig drug nyin gang ma re/ bcu gnyis pa'i bco lnga nas nyin gsum smon lam rnam gsum 'don zhing mchod chas/ tsha ra/ ja thug sogs ldangs pa sbyar/ zangs phug gi rtogs ldan rnams gnya' gnyar bsgril pa'i zangs phug rang du stag lung gra tshang gi gra rnying sdod yul byas pa'i chos mthun ngos gnas kyi 'dzin skyong le shor dang tshul sgrub mchod zha chag med pa gtong dgos pa'i gra pa so bzhi/ ja ma gcig bcas par zla re bzhin ches bcu dang bco lngar bde dgyes/ drug pa'i bco lngar dkar thog /bcu gnyis pa'i nyer bdun nas dgu'i bar bskang gso rnams kyi mchod rdzas/ ja thug 'phar dang / lo 'khor gyi phogs sogs 'tshems med 'gro rtsis ston mar phu dkar dang / mgar tshang gi zhing / gzhor 'debs—282

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)kyi 'dzin zur gsal ltar ji srid bar dang / gnya' zangs mgar gsum bsgril ba'i sgrub pa ba khyon bco brgyad dgon gnas kha 'dzin le shor med ngos tshes bcu/ bco lnga/ dgu gtor gsum chag med/ drug pa'i tshes lngar dkar me bskul chang / bcu gnyis pa'i nyer bdun brgyad dgu bskang gso rnams kyi (206na)mchod chas ja thug tshogs sogs ldangs pa'i mthun rkyen sbyar/ gnam gang zhags lha ldan bsnyen gnas ma tshor yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa phab/hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gnyis la sbyor ra'i gra pa 'phrin las chos rgyal gyis 'bum dum pa bcu drug gi rgyugs legs par sprad pa'i tshar dgar bkras btags che ba/ gos phyi nang yug re/ gzhung ja khor drug /rta srang bzhi ri ba sogs dgu tshan dpus gtsang byin/ tshes drug la byams khang rgyab pho lhas bzhengasapa'i bka' 'gyur la rab gnas rta thog ma bgyis/ yong sha po kun da'i ching gi bu/ dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi mi sna/ bal po kho khom gyi khri 'bul mi sna bho lwa gi dang / la hor/ sa dkar 'go pa rdo rje skyabs nang mi lnga sogs la ja gral/ yong sha pos rta so gsum dang / 'ba' bla zur gyis dre'u dgu /sa dkar 'go pas ja khor drug phyed nyis brgya skor byung /tshes brgyad la rdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku phebs pa dang mjal/ tshes dgur gur drag phur pa sogs sgrub par rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i skus rab gnas gnang / gzhung gi tshong dpon dpal gro ba can nyi shu skor dang phrad/ tshes bcur gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas kyang rten rnams la sgrub pa byas/ tshes bcu gnyis nas rdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku dpon slob kyis tshe dpag med sku gsum rigs 'dus dang / ki dang gi dgra mnan bdun phrag re smin rgyas gnang / sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i (206ba)dge sbyor rten gyi tshon thang bco lnga dang rta mgrin gsang sgrub rnams gser bris gzabs mchor gong gsham bzang gos sum 'jag mthong 'jug la hor gos/ zhal khebs nyis brtsegs/ tog gser tshagasabacas dpus gtsang gi rgyu dang phogs yon bsdoms gshor khal sum stong lnga brgya lnga bcu song ba'i rgyab yig /gcung kun dga' tshul khrims kyi ngor ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad/ dge slong ye shes phun tshogs —283

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pokyi slob ma rnams kyis bskul ba'i skye ba myur 'dzin dang / bla ma ngag dbang don ldan gyi ngor nged rang gi ming sgra yod pa'i smon lam/ khams pa rdzogs chen pad+ma rigs 'dzin dang / mnga' ris gung thang sgra pa bshes gnyen rnam rgyal so sor gdams pa re/ dmag dpon gangs la nyi shar gyis bka' 'gyur dang 'bum bzhengs pa'i dkar chag /dpal grong sngags rams pas rtsed thang lnga mchod par dung dkar dngul gshog ma cha phul ba'i kha byang / stag lung gdan sa ka drug pa ngag dbang dpal bzang gis 'dra 'bag dang rta tshag rje drung rin po che'i thugs dam rten thang rgyab yig /'phyong rgyas dpal ri slob dpon legs ldan 'od zer sogs spyi tshogs kyis bskul ba'i bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung rol pa'i gad brgyangs/ kho khom rgyal pos mi sna ched du mngags pa'i lan snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i lhug pa rnams brtsams/chos 'khor yang rtse'i gra pa dka' bcu bstan pa yar 'phel gyis phar phyin 'grel pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan gyi rgyugs sprad/ tshes (207na)bcu bdun nas bdun gnyis kyi bar phyi thal gyi mtshan ma shar bar dmigs yang zab gro bo lod kyi dge sbyor la gnad du bsnun/ lo star gyi mang skol/ khro rol/'char ka /mgon po g.yul bzlog sogs bzlog 'phel 'char can steng 'di lo nas kong rtse la sgang du rtse le bas khro rol slang dgu ma/ bu chur gnam gong pas slang gang ma/ rin spungs su chu spe steng pasaslang dgu ma dang 'char ku'i gtor bzlog rgyab chos sogs sngon ma rnams dang 'dra ba bcugs/tshes bcur dus min gyi char babs par brtag par bstan 'dzin dang nad rims sogs la cung zad blta ba bzlog rim du ser 'bras dge gsum gyis gtsos dge dgon nyis brgya lhag bcas la mang ja re'i thog sher snying / dbus gtsang gi rdzong gzhis bzhi bas skor/ sde dpon khag /yul mi byingasadang bcas pas lha bsangs/ dgra lha dpangs bstod/ gzungs 'dus/ lan chags gtor ma so sos gang 'grub/ bstan srid la rgya dang stod kyi jus rim la gzhis rtser zha lu pa dang / pho brang du bkra shisartse chos ste bas gdugs dkar mdos chen/ gzhis rtser sgrol ma ba/ ngam ring du bkra bzang pa/ lha rtser —284

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)chu mig pa rnams kyis sgrub zhag bdun rer khro rol slang dgu ma'i gtor bzlog /nged rang gi rim gror zhol du rdo rje brag pa gra slob bco lngas sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi tshe chog bdun gcig /lha sa dkyil 'khor sdings su bde yangs pa brgyas zhag bcu'i bar sman bla dang lhung bshags 'gro gang che/ nged (207ba)rang gi rmi ltas ngan pa zhi phyir gong dkar du gsung rab gling pa brgyas sman bla chig stong bco lnga/ lha sar sprul lo pa sodagu yan re drug la ston mo/ sde pa la'ang sprul lo pa nyer brgyad man lo grangs la ston mo/ lha sa dang ra mo cher mchod pa sna lnga brgya tshar/ lha sa dkyil 'khor sdings su sngags pa gra tshang lnga bcus sman bla tshig stong lnga brgya/ na mnyam sum cur zas gos sbyin pa/ lha sa'i khral 'then gang yin la ya ju mkhar lhag gsum re'i 'gyed/ gra tshang gra pa grangs bcad sa rgyal rdzongs bcas btang /'phyong rgyas su dpal ri ba gra slob brgya dang bcu gsum gyis thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi cho ga tshar gsum re bka' srung chos stong gi bskang ba tshar re lo star zla ba dgu pa'i nyer bdun la chag med gtong ba'i mchod pa sogs bsdoms khal chig brgya nyer gnyis sbyar/tshes bcu dgur rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku'i bcad rgya grol nas tshe rdzas dang bcas byon te gsung rtsom gyi ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad byung zhing rdzas la longs spyad/ gra tshang gis nyin dang por phyag drug pa/rnam sras/ las gshin/ dmag zor ma/ bstan ma rnams kyi bskang gso chig stong nyis brgya re/ nyin gnyis par gur las mkhan beg tse dang bcas pa bskang ba stong brgyad brgya re/ zhal bskang nyis stong bzhi brgya rnams song /hor zla bcu pa'i tshes gcig la bcad rgya'i 'og rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku kher rkyang dang mjal zhing phebs rdzongs rgyas par zhus te dpal mgon zhal la brten pa'i bka' bsgo (208na)phul/ yang bzlog gi las sbyor chen mo btsugs/ rgyal thang pa stod nas 'khor/ tshes bzhin thar pa ma bu rnamasal byin rlabs dang bka' bsgo byas/ tshes lnga nas bzung nyin dgu'i bar bdud rtsi chu tshan brgyab pa'i khu ba sman chu dang gsang yibs gnyis ka nas res mos kyis blangs/ spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtsho —285—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (postod du dga' ldan tshe dbang gi sar gang cir gros bsdur dang la dwags pa blo khugs kyi don du brdzangs/ thar pa'i ma dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i bsngo rten la gos yug zhe lnga/ rta sga chas sprad pa dgu /ja ko dra dang khor drug sogs dngom che ba bteg pa ltar gnas skabs mtho ris dang ring min rnam mkhyen thob pa'i rgyur bsngos/ tshes bcur chos 'khor yang rtseb ngag dbang sbyin pas phar phyin 'grel pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan dang / shel dkar chos sde ba blo bzang 'byor ldan gyis dbu 'grel theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings kyi rgyugs sprad/tshes bco lngar chos mdzad ngag dbang 'phrin las kyi ngor lo chen ngag dbang chos dpal gyi brtan bzhugs/ skyid shod sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyi rdo rje phreng ba dang kṛ ya sa muñtsa gnyis thun mong gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ sa dkar 'go pa rdo rje skyabs kyis bskul ba'i gnas chung chos skyong gi sger gsol las bzhi lhun grub/ dar mo sman rams pas ston pa lngar g.yu thog gsar rnying gi rnam thar gyis bskor ba dang / rnam sras gtso 'khor/ sman bla/ sgrol dkar gyi stong thang rnams kyi rgyab yig /(208ba)drung chen dang ri bo bde chen dbu mdzad gyi ngor sprul sku ngag dbang kun dga' bde legs kyi brtan bzhugs/ chang khyim pa spun kyis bskul ba'i 'phyos sgrib btsan pa'i gsol mchod rnams bkod/tshes bcu bdun la sa dkar 'go pa rdo rje skyabs kyis zang zing gi bdog pa 'gyed dang bcas gra tshang nas 'bras gshongs dag snang ma'i sgo nas tshe'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ rtse gdong zhabs drung rgyan ngag dbang rig 'dzin dbang po/ 'brog bsam sdings sprul sku/ byang rtse chos rje/ bzang ldan mkhan po/gser mdog can mkhan zur/ se ra bstan 'dzin sku skye/ khams me rag /sgom bde/ ldan ma bras mdo mkhar chos sde/ lha rtse chos sde rnams kyi bla ma/ 'ba' bla zur/ sde pa mdo mkhar bstang zhal/ zhang ston mda' pa sogs dang mjal phrad/ thams cad la lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i gang 'tsham gyi dri ba byas/ sgom bde nang chen pa'i rta lnga bstodang / ldan ma bra'u bla ma'i brgyad byung ba grol nas cha gan no mun khan/ dbu sgor chung ba/ dpon mo na ma thar/ no yon dka' bcu/ thar pa'i ming sring / u zhad bu bcas/—286

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)a ra na kha sho'u tha'i ja'i/ dpon mo tshe ring / 'u du su 'jam dbyangs tha'i ji da la'i hung tha'i ji dang bsod nams khung tha'i ji sogs kyi mi sna/ a mdo bya khyung sku skye/ a rig phun tshogs/ bde legs rgya mtsho/ dbon po bsod nams/ a rig gnas po/ (209na)a mdo khyung mo/ a mdo dka' bcu sogs la byin rlabs dang bod sog lnga brgya skor la bde yangs su me tog gtor/ bya khyung sku skyes rta so gsum/ a rig phun tshogs can gyis zhe bzhi rnams byung / chos rje kyi ston pa khu tshan/ ban grong pa pha bu lnga/ shrī lo paṇa pa sogs la ja gral dang / ban grong pa gra bcas kyi skra phud blangs shing spo bo'i ming 'jam dpal dbang grags zil gnon rnam rol tu btags/ mi ngo tshor yang bzlog rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang bskur/ dpon thar par bka' bsgo byas/tshes bco brgyad la sde pa mdo mkhar bas tshan grangs ring por brkyang 'gyed tshogs yon sbyar te gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i rten 'byung bstar/ kyi ston pa kher rkyang dang phrad cing dri ba kha shas bgyis/ nyer gsum nas khro rol tshe bdag bstan mdos sogs sngar bzhin btsugs/ keg skor mi sngags pa lhun grub dang ngag dbang 'byor pa dang phrad/ gnasachung nas sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen pos shar lho mtshams su bzlog bsgyur dgos tshul ltar ser 'bras gnyis su ja tshul brgyad re'i thog mdo sgrub/ nyer bzhir rtse gdong /ltas drung / khams ri bo che'i zhabasadrung yab sras gsum/ kyi ston pa khu tshan/ sa dkar 'go pa nang tshang / bying pa blo bzang chos ldan sogasal tshe dpag med 'chi med dpal ster gyi dbang bskur/ rtse gdong / ri bo che/ rgyud smad dang gsang (209ba/nyeng slob dpon sogs la ja gral thog zhabs drung rnam gnyis la gos phyi nang dkar dpyad ja sogs shangs len gzabs te dbul/ rtse gdong zhabs drung rin po cher phyi nang gsang ba'i nyer 'tshe las rgyal ba'i ched mgon po che chung las mkhan dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bka' bsgo rgyas par phul/tsho mes chen steng du bod sog nyas brgya skor la me tog gtor/ bsod nams dbang rgyal/ ma/ dpon mo/thos pa dga'/ thu med bstan pa tha'i ji'i tsha bo/ ar khe chu khur/ thar pa'i log mi kha shas la byin —287

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (porlabs dang / mi bzang gnyis dge bsnyen du sgrubs/ nyer lngar gling me 'bring smad tsam byung /nyer drug la rgyal po chen po 'khor bcas byon pa dang mjal khrod du kyi ston pa dang spo bo ban grong pa'ang yod/ nyer dgur grong smad dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mo dang dmag zor tshangs dbang ming sring bcas par sme brtsegs kyi bkru byab srung gsum/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs dang 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe dbang byas/ bzang ldan mkhan por thon gdong gi ja gral btang / gnam gang la kha rab mkhan chen la byin rlabs bgyis te nyi ldog dang bstun srung bzlog bsad mnan gyi zab gnad thun mong ma yin pa rnams nyams su blangs/ shangs bde legs par gser sdings pas 'dzin pa'i sa tshab tu sras khud gzhis ga'i khang pa g.yul sdur lag 'debs dang bcas pa lcags spre sngo thog nas mgo mtho tsam dang / gnam gong bla ma pad+ma legs grub rnying khungs tshad ldan bsnyen sgrub gtsor bton gyi (210na)lhag bsam byung phyin rim gro sgrub rten du gnam dgon la gtogs pa'i khang pa rten gsum mchod rdzas 'bab 'bru khal drug brgya nga gsum/ bla ma chu spe steng par rim gro'i sgrub rten du ba do bas 'dzin shul sgrol ma sdings kyi khang pa rten gsum mchod rdzas 'bab 'bru khal bzhi brgya bskor/dud 'dzin brgyad/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen por gra tshang smin grol gling gi mchod gzhis sogs la gra phyi thar pa gling dgon gnas mi ser dang bcas tshang ma rgya khyon mi chung tsam snga sor nas song yang thang yig nas 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling par bstan pa dang / lo chen be+e ro tsa na'i rnam sprul rigs 'dzin chen pos zab gter kha shas kyi sgo 'byed par mdzad de bod 'bangs skye 'gro'i 'gal spong mthun grub kyi blang dor ji bzhin ston pa po 'bul 'os kyi yul dam pa yin par ma zad spyir gter ston thams cad bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i gegs sel bogs 'don gyis mtshon gnas skab sa mthar thug gi sman yon yin phyir bsnyen dgos pa rigs 'dzin gyi gdung brgyud sogs 'byung ba thang yig tu'ang sangs rgyas gling par khyod nas mi rabs brgya'am nyer gcig par sogs rgya cher gsungs pa dang / bye brag gong smos ltar phugs rigs smin grol gling gi lha chos dang 'brel bslad med par —288—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (5)gdung brgyud gsang yum bcas pa'i skal bar skyil sa dar rgyas khang gsar/ rgyal po na ga'i chu skor sogs ri klungs kyi bdag thob/ dud che chung nyer bdun/ 'bab 'bru khal nyis stong bzhi brgya skor/ rgyal skor (210ba)'og ma'i skye rgyal rdzogs nas gong ma dang bsgril ba la'ang gong 'og nang khul ma dan par 'di gar gtugs sbyangs la 'byor ba rgyal skor ngo bo'i brgyud su yin dang sa ris byings che sur babs thob sogs 'gal mtshams che sar dkrugs bkag lta bu'i yin skyel byas tshe gnyis ka thog ma nas dge lugs pa mig rgyang dgos gras bcas dud che chung bsdoms brgya so bzhi 'bab 'bru khal drug brgya go bzhi 'dug pa bgos phud yangs pa byas te phyed bgos gyi rang cha dang / klu sha gtam sha mig btsugs bcas de mo dbon po bsod nams nor bu'i ngo chen dang / rgyal skor ba bsod nams dbang po zhi drag sgrub par dang dod byed sems re ba bcas yangs par byas shing 'og ma'i phyed cha gzhung blangs kyi phyed cha dud che ba sum cu dang chung ba phran bu yong 'bab mi gra 'byu zhing dang bcas skyes dman ma mad la 'jags gnas/ dar gan dka' bcu bar bkra shis rdzong kha'i khang pa/ lcang ra na gling dud 'dzin bcu dgu /'bab khal dgu brgya nyer bdun/ 'bras khud/ bde chen rtse'i sa ris dang brjes pa'i 'phar cha khal gnyis dang dud gsum/ zing po khang gsar 'og dud stong dang bcas pa'i khang pa/ 'bab khal nyis stong zhe gcig /dud 'dzin nyer gcig rnams rgya nag dbon po dang zing po ba sngar nas zhe 'gras ches pas babs 'bral yod mdog ma kha rung rta ra shar pa bkra shis kyi zhi drag sgrub rten du 'jags gnas/ mchims phu gnas 'dzin rnying pa rnams byed sgo ma legs kyang ngo yong gra pa bzhir nam 'tsho'i bar pho brang nas mkhar khal drug cu re/ (211na)rwa sgreng mkhan po'i tsha bo bla ma skyabs kyi cho ge grags bstan par mkhar khal brgyad/ na ga pā thur tha'i ji/ ching pā thur/ phun tshogasabakra shis rnams kyi bu gsum la khal bcu gsum lhag bcas re/ jo rig thu'i bu rgyal mtshan bkra shis la khal bzhi bcu rnams 'bras spungs su bslab gnyer la sdod ring sprod 'dzin/ dka' bcu blo bzang lhun grub khams nam 'tsho'i bar lho rong nas khal brgyad re/ se ra smad gra tshang par chu smad pa'i —289

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (7)g.yog dngos grub tshe ring gis bsgrub pa'i zhing gzhung skyong stabs sngar 'jags bab 'brel ma byung yang gra tshang gzhan dang ma 'dra gshis ji srid bar 'jags gnas/ sne'u sdong bogs shas kyi yong sgo len deb sel len rnams nas nag 'jam rim lus su song ba sde pa blo bzang sbyin pas zhib gcod mdzad pa tho gsar thon gras rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling mchod yul gzhan dang mi 'dra zhing nged rang gi ring 'tshor dmigs mkha' ru'i khal nyis brgya gya gsum sbyor 'jags/ gzhis rtse gso rig slob grar sman bla rgyun gtong steng chos thog zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga dang gnam gang la nged kyi ring 'tshor sman bla nyin gang ma bcas gtong thebs snga phyi bsdoms bde skyid pa can them lnga/dud stongs zhing 'khyar bcas 'bab 'bru khal drug brgya dgu bcu/ dkon cog rgyal por snye nang tshe ring dar po khungs son khal nyer bzhi'i zhing / sngags pa ban grong pa rim gro'i rigs dgos par lhag bsam dag pa yong khyad nas nag gu bas 'dzin (211na〉zhul dang / gser thog dgon brje dgos tshul byung ba bzhin sa brjes dud 'dzin brgyad 'thol bcas khal bzhi brgya skor/ kun ra'i sa 'dzin sngon ma rgyang sngon smyon pa'i skyes dman tshong 'dus khang gsar pa'i bu mo bsod nams bu khrid khams bzang ring zhing brgyad/ kong po rgyab brag chos rje'i sku skye dang / dpon mo sogs kyi chos brgyags zhing che chung lnga/ rnam sras nor bu mi ngo res rgyun sdod zhi drag bsgrubs phyin rgyal rtse grong mo che ba'i gzhis ka sa ris/ 'bab chog brgya re brgyad/ dgon pa rta mgrin dang / spyi dpon 'brug dar rgyas gnyis kyisadamag snga phyir khur bsam zhe bskyed dang / spyi dpon gyi las 'dzin byas par bdag rkyen 'di yin med par 'go pa dpe 'gre'i gshor 'debs dgos zer ba 'go pa las tshan byed rgyu byung ba gtam don la phan pa las khe med nyen rang yod mdog ma kha bas 'dir brten zhu re ma 'os kyang dpung 'juka snga phyir khur snga bsam che tsam byas gras yin 'dug pa dang / slar yang bstan don la rgya'i rogs dang /dgon pa ba'i tsho 'dzin sogs zhi drag gang cir do khur che ba byung phyin rta mgrin la 'bru khal brgya dang /'brug dar rgyas la dgu bcu thams pa rnams sbyor 'jags byas/ brtag rim rtse shod thun mong dang lnga —290—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)mchod gling me cung zad ma bzhes pa bcas par ris med dgon ang gsum pa yan la ja sbyor bzhi/'gyed kyi thob gdugs sher 'gro gang che/ sde pa'i rmi lam ngan pa bzlog thabs su gzhis rtse sogs rdzong gzhis bcu bdun du dge dgon 'brel mtshungs nas gra pa brgya re bsdoms bka' gyur (212na)gya gsum/ 'bum brgya nga brgyad/ brgyad stong pa chig stong sum brgya nyer lnga/ thang yig chig khri lnga stong rnams song /hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gnyis nas po ta lar gra tshang du phye ring / 'bras spungs su gnam sa lto dkrug dang mchod rten zhal gso le tshan/ de bzhin log tri'i las sbyor chen mo dang / gi gang mnan pa grangs bcad btsugs/ tshes gsum rjes mar thar pa 'das pa'i bsngo rten kha btags dkar mthing /gser rgya thur gyi srang bcu/ gos rtsag gsum/ lham/ or bog /sag thag /gri/ gos chor 'dres pa yug lnga bcu/ ja khor drug bcu/ tā tshwa ko dra bco lnga/ rta sga bcas bdun/ sga med re gsum rnams byung ba gnas skabs lha mi'i rten bzang thob pa dang mthar thug byang chen thob pa'i rgyur bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs rnam dag byas/tshes brgyad nas mthug ring 'od dkar sogs rtags thog ma shar dang / zhag shas nas nub tu byung bar brten rgyal khams bde thabs kyis mtshon zlog byed gsor bar phrin gsol gyi tshigs bcad spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor dang bcas la mor chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse dang / de bzhin bsam yas/ thang po che/ tshong 'dus rnams su skyid thang nor bu btang bar tsher gseb nas rim gro re 'bebs par mdzad/ bsam yas nas gnod sbyin chen pos shar gyi de mjug ring yin cing rgyu skar nag pas skye 'gro'i bde skyid ston phyir gnas 'gyur ba yin pas 'bras rin cen spungs (212ba)pa'i bdag por ngan tsam yin zhes bzlog rim gsungs/ tshes bcu gcig la nad bdag stobs 'joms bka' nan rab brjid dang bcas smin rgyas byas/tshes bcu gnyis nas nyer drug gi bar rigs 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje'i zab gter las byung ba'i —291—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (podrag po dbu dgu'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len tshig dril du byas kyang rtags thon pa ni dka'/ tshes bco brgyad la thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor ba blo bzang yon tan gyis sngags rim chen mo'i rgyugs sprad/ phun tshogs gling du sde pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dpon po'i khur ma byas gong nas chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i gsung 'bum rnams par du 'khod pa byed dgos tshul nan can byung ba ltar par byang spyir byed rgyu'i tshig bcad bzhin sngags rim chen mo/ dar mo sman rams pas brtsams pa'i phyi rgyud chu mdo man gyi 'grel pa dka' gnad rdo rje'i mdud 'grol/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs rnams kyi par 'byor/ nyer drug gi lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor thog nang mtshams grol te sde pa dang dmag zor tshangs dbang la kha 'bar ma dkar mo'i 'chi blu dang / sme brtsegs kyi bkru byab srung gsum smin par byas/nyer bdun la sde pa zangs ri ba dang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gnyis so sos snga rting byas nas bdog pa'i skyes spams bstod de mi shigs rdo rje ltar brtan phyir gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i gsung chog rgyas par gyer/ dar mo sman rams pas mang skol bgyis dus zhal 'don du ring 'tsho'i (213na〉(na lam/ rgyal gyi de sa ko ṭī ra bskang ba 'bum/ bsil ba tshal du gur zhal pu tra beg tse/ mthil du phyag drug pa/ las gshin/ rnam sras gsum la stong / gzhan rnams la brgya tshar btang skabs yi dam chos srung so sor snyan shal phul ba'i kha byang / gra tshang gra pa so sos bsdu cha byas te chos skyong rnams la gzabs gsol nyin bdun btang dus spyi bye brag la phul ba'i 'dod gsol/ gnas chung chos skyong chen por sku chas cha 'grig sogs wen bcol rgyas par gra pa yongs rdzogs byon skabs snyan shal sna lngar las 'chol kha yig /dge slong blo bzang brtson 'grus kyi ngor khal kha er te ni khu thug thu blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi gsol 'debs rnams bris/ dpa' bo sprul sku/yang ri bla gnyer/ se ra bstan 'dzin sku skye/ sngags pa chu spe steng pa/ kong 'brug chos sdings sku skye/gnam gong / rgyang ro/ sgar gra tshang / 'bras rin cen snang rnams kyi bla ma/ par zhus pa blo brtan dang —292

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)smra seng gnyis/yig mkhan par pa bcas bzhi bcu/rta 'bul nang so/han rab stims pa sogs kyi ngo bor byin chas dang /byings la me tog gtor nas blo bzang mgon po rab brtan ma ma dang tsos pa/du ral gyi sku skye/lha gzha nor bu/bsod nams glo tha'i ji/dpon mo/dur bod tshe dbang tha'i ji/er te ni pā thur tha'i ji/badz+ra/ma ga dha/dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang rnams kyi mi sna sogs dang phrad/ 213ba ) phyi dro zhang ston kun 'dun lhun grub dang chos rje kyi ston par byin rlabs ja gral thog chos las brtsams pa'i dri ba dri bshad gnyis ka dang kha shas byung /kyi ston pa tsha bcas la gos phyi nang gzhung ja khor drug sogs ster byin bgyis te rang gnas su bteg/bsam yas la mo/thang po che/tshong 'dus/gnas chung sogs chos skyong khag rnams dang mo rtsis bcas go bstun blang ngor gyi don nged kyi gegs sel du khra 'brug tu bkra shis rtse chos sde/gong dkar du chos sde ba dang dkon gnyer dpon sgrub zhag bdun re'i gdugs dkar mdos chen/de mtshungs nges gsang rdor gling pas ma mo gling bzhi'i mdos/gzhes rtser zha lu pas gdugs dkar mdos chen rjes gza' yum gyi sgrub pa zhag bdun/lha sa sogs gnas chen/gzhis rtse sogs rdzongs gzhis khag brgyad du 'brel mtshungasadagon gra pa brgya res rgyab chos kyi khyon bka' 'gyur tshar gcig/'bum brgya/gdugs dkar drug khri sum stong bdun brgya sum cu/sgrol ma nyis 'bum sum stong /sher snying dgu khri dgu brgya brgyad cu/tshe gzungs bdun 'bum lnga stong bzhi brgya/po ta la zhol du byang gling pa bcu gsum gyis khro rol slang gang ma/bla mkhyen ngag dbang dang bon po zla ba can gyis rgyal btsan ma klu bzhi'i mdos/mtshan ma dgra zor/sha pho rba cus/stong gsum 'khrugs pa'i yo bcos/gling bzhi 'brugs pa'i yo bcos/sde brgyad 'khrugs pa'i yo bcos/gza' klu 'khrugs pa'i yo bcos rnams rgyas 214na ) pa/yer par sāts+tsha khri/pha bong kha pas gtor ma 'bum ther/lha sa nas g.yag lug brgya'i srog blus/bsangs khag brgya/sde pa'i sku rim du khra 'brug tu smin grol gling pas gi rkang gi dgra mnan/bsam yas su rdo rje brag pas sri rkang bcu gsum mnan pa/bu chur /༷ 'brog pas kyang gong mtshungs/dpal lha lcog tu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (germe ru ba brgyad gra dang / rgyal khang so sor bskang gso brgya re/ zhol du sngags bon gyis dgra lha dpangs bstod/ rgya nag geg bzlog /sa bdag zhabrugs gto/ grong smad gzhis kar bsangs dang khrus gsol/lha sar lug lnga bcu'i srog blus/ ri 'go mtho ba lnga bcur dar lcog /lha sa sogs rdzong gzhis gnas chen drug tu dge dgon 'brel mtshungs brgya res rgyab chos khyon brgyad stong pa sum brgya/ gra lnga tshig brgya/gzungs 'dus phyed nyis brgya/ thang yig chig brgya brgyad cu/ sde lnga zhe lnga/ phyogs bcu mun sel tshig khri/ sgrol ma nyis stong bzhi brgya/ sher snying sum stong nyis brgya/ gdugs dkar brgyad brgya/ tshe gzungs bzhi 'bum/ bstan srid spyi rim la khra 'brug tu smin grol gling pas khro rol slang gang ma dang zhag lnga'i bar ma mdos/ bsam yas su rdo rje brag pas khro rol gong 'dra dang / sgrub zhag bdun gyi 'char rka'i mdos/ lho brag lha khang du smra bo lcog pas khro rol gong 'dra/ kyi kang gi dgra mnan/ ka tshal du rigs 'dzin dkon (214ba khyog lhun grub kyis khro rol slang gang ma ltas ngan kha bsgyur las phran dang bcas pa/ grom pa rgyang du chu mig pa/ bu chur thang 'brog pa/ gtsang 'gram lha khang du sgrol ma ba gsum gyis khro rol slang gang ma dang / dam sri mnan pa re/ pra dun rtser nub dgon pas gi dang gi dgra mnan/ mchod rten brgya lhag la sku dkar/ srong btsan bang sor dpal ri ba brgyad kyis zhag gsum gyi bar ma ning gi bskang gso 'gro gang che/ 'phyong rgyas su skyes lhar gsol mchod bsangs dang bcas pa/ gzhis rtse sogs dang 'brel ba'i gnas chen bdun du dge dgon 'brel mtshungs can gra pa brgya res gtor bzlog rgyab chos su sman bla bdun stong / dri med bshags rgyud chig stong chig brgya re lnga/ gdugs dkar lnga brgya/ sher snying bzhi 'bum sum khri bdun stong brgyad brgya/ sgrol ma nyis 'bum chig khri lnga stong / bod khams bde thabs su dbus gtsang gi tshes bcu ba tshang mas bsam pa lhun grub ma brgya tshar la nyung mtha'i 'gro gang che/ brtag rim sde pa'i gegs sel la lha sar gsang sngags byang chub gling pa brgya/ gong dkar du rdo rje brag pa dang / rgyal rtser yar 'brog stag lung gra tshang nas lnga bcu re/ phung po ri bo cher brag la ba sum cu rnams kyis phyir bzlog 'khor lo 'bar ba zhag bco lnga'i bar —294—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)'gro gang tshe/ gnas chung chos skyong chen pos rgya 'dre'i 'tshub zhi byed la bka' 'gyur tshar gcig rnams spyi sger thams cad kyi don du 'bad pas bsgrubs/nyer brgyad la sngags lcog bla (215na)ma/ rgyal phur/ dge slong tshul rgyam pa/ stag ru ba pha bu/tshong 'dus sku rten pa/ phug nas gzhis rtse'i rdzong sdod la thon rgyu bcas par byin rlabs dang / nyer dgur sku rten tshe dbang dpal 'bar dang phrad/ gnam gang la gra tshang nas 'chi bdag bzlog pa'i cho ga sngar bzhin mdzad/hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la khal kha 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku'i mi sna bi lig thu dar khan nang so/ shi ti pā thur khung tha'i ja'i mi sna 'phyong rgyas pa blo bzang chos 'phel/ paṇ+ḍita zhabasadrung gi mi sna er te ni dar khan em chi/ dar khan khung tha'i ji'i mi sna dar khan nang so/ mer gan khung tha'i ji'i ja'i sang nang so/ er te ni no yon khu thug thu'i phyag mdzod dbu mdzad/ no mo ul ching gi tsha bo/ da'i ching chu khor gyi a yo khi/ che chen khung tha'i ji'i bla ma/ er te ni sem chi'i nom chi brnyes/ da'i ching pā thur gyi mer gan chos rje/ ge sar gu yang ja'i sang / blo bzang shes rab sogs kyis yi ge rten rgya cher 'dug pa blangs shing ngag ma rnams nyan/ de dang mnyam du dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi mi sna rab brtan/ dur bod tshe brtan/ u jo'i thu pā thur tha'i ji'i mi bzang / co zhe shes rab bzang po/ sa dkar 'go pa rdo rje skyabs nang tshang / yer pa bla zur/ rin cen rtse pa sogs bod sog khams pa a mdo ba mang por ja gral bgyis/tshes bzhir dar khan dka' bcu khu tshan gyi tshogs yon (215ba tshe mu)da ster bya gser zho brgya/dngul srang brgya/ ja gos dar sogs dgu tshan bcu gcig dang bcas gra tshang nas byang gter tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon dang 'brel bar mi 'gyur brtan pa'i rten 'byung bsgrigs pa'i mjug 'thud zhol nang zan rnams kyis kyang tshan grangs brkyang / 'di nyin nas tshes bcu bzhi'i bar rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen pa'i kha gso dang / tshes brgyad nas phur sgrub char can btsugs/ 'od dkar —295—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (poganyis mjug ring yin min dang sa spre lo byung ba dang gcig mi gcig ci rigs snang yang ltas dkyus ma min pa bcas nged rang gis brtag pa zhib tu byas par 'tshub ngo che ba shar ba'i bzlog rim du 'phyong rgyas su ri bo bde chen sogs tshe bsdus brgya dang brgyad kyis zla gcig bar gdugs dkar 'bum/ lha sar gsas khang pas gzungs 'dus stong / po ta lar gzhis ka shar pas chang la mngar gsum dang spos sna'i rigs btab pa'i dgra lha dang yul lhar phud mchod/ bsangs khag bcu gsum/lha sar na mnyam lo grangs la sbyin pa/ 'phyong rgyas su dpal ri bas khro rol slang gang ma'i gtor bzlog /rgyab chos gra pa sum cus sher snying gang 'gro/ sde pa'i sku rim du'ang 'phyong rgyas su dar gling ri chos bsgril ba brgyas zla gcig bar
