mtshan brjod sa ya gcig dang nyis 'bum/ lha sar brag dbar ba brgyas gser 'od tshig stong / gzhis ka shar pa'i bdud mdos/ gong dkar du chos sde bas zhag gsum bar kye rdor zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'gro gang che/ grong (216na skyod gzhis rkar pha bong kha pa grangs bcad kyis cha gsum brgya/ shel brag tu smin grol gling pas tsho gos brgya/ na mnyam re gsum la sbyin pa/ rin spungs su nges gsang rdor gling pas khro rol slang gang ma/ bstan srid spyi rim la lha khang du gnas gzhi ba/ dar mar smra bo lcog pa/ 'ol dgar brag sna ba/ bkra bzang du rang gra/ gzhis rtser sgrol phug pa/ lha rtser chu mig pa rnams kyis zhag bdun la khro rol slang gang ma'i gtor bzlog /pho brang du bkra shis chos sde bas gdugs dkar mdos chen/ rgyab chos dge dgon tsho bsdus brgyas sher snying 'gro gang che/ gong dkar du sngags 'chang gnas chung pas tshe bdag gtor bzlog /rgyab chos thod ri ba sum cus sher snying bdun khri sum stong / sgrol ma sum stong / tshe gzungs drug stong / pa nam du brag la bas 'char ga'i mdos chen/ dge dgon brgyar mang ja lnga re'i thog mdo sgrub 'gro gang che/ bod khams spyi'i nad rigs bzlog thabs su dbus gtsang gi yul gru che chung dang bstun bka' 'gyur/ 'bum/ brgyad stong pa gsum gang 'os gtore ma brgya rtsa/ ma mdos/ rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs kyi khrus/ dgra lha dpangs bstod/ lha bsangs/ lha sar gra tshang / gong dkar du rdo rje brag pa/—296

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)rgyal rtser brag la ba/ ngam ring du bkra bzang pa rnams kyis nad bdag stobs 'joms mnga' ris phyogs kyi jus rim la ser 'bras dge gsum gyis gtsos dbus (216ba)gtsang gi dge dgon brgya dang so brgyad la mang ja sbyor sbrel thog gdugs sher 'gro gang che/ gnyis rtser 'ug pa lung pas mgon po g.yul bzlog /brtag pa dang keg myul go bstun nged kyi gegs sel la pho brang du bkra shis chos sde ba sum cus zhag bco lngar rnam rgyal stong mchod/ gong dkar du chos sde ba sum cus tshe dpag med kyi sgrub mchod 'chi blu dang bcas pa zhag bco lnga/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs bzhi brgya lnga bcu/sgrol sher chig stong sum brgya re/ gra pa lngas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg /smin grol gling pas gter gsar dang /'phyong rgyas su dpal ri bas rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi tshe chog zhag bcu re/ yer par sāts+tsha chig 'bum chig khri/ pha bong khar gtor ma 'bum ther/ mkhar rtser thang sag pas 'bum brgya/ lha sar thang sag pas tshe mdo sogs chos tshan bcu bdun brgya re/ mchod rten nyi shur sku dkar/ bya khyi byis pa mang por ston mo/ g.yag nyis brgya'i srog blus/ nad pa nyam thag pa nyi shur zas gos sman sbyin/ btson dong thar bcu drug /ser 'bras su mang ja gsum re'i thog tshe gzungs sa ya gcig /sde pa'i sku rim la ser 'bras gnyis su mang ja gsum rer tshe gzungs/ pho brang du bkra shis chos sde bas rnam rgyal stong mchod sogs tshe chog khag bzhi/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg /mer par sāts+tsha dang / mchod rten sku dkar gong mtshungs/ lha sar g.yag lug brgya'i srog blus/ btson dong thar gsum/ gong dkar du thod ri bshad sgrub gling pas 'bum re brgyad/ gdugs dkar chig stong lnga brgya/ tshe (217na)gzungs chig khri lnga brgya/sgrol ma chig khri bdun brgya/ sher snying drug stong / lha sar gsas khang pas sprin chen mo/ khye'u chu 'bebs/ dpang skong phyag brgya pa/ klu 'bum/ gnam lcags mchu rnams lnga bcu re/ tshangs pa dung thod can gyi lung bstan bzhin nged kyi rim gror po ta la/ gzhis rtse sogs rdzong gzhis nyi shur dge dgon tsho bsdus 'brel mtshudas nas rdzong 'go che bar gra pa bzhi brgya lnga bcu/ chung bar brgya re bcas pasabaka' 'gyur bzhi brgya/ lhung bshags sum stong / mtshan brjod drug stong / gdugs dkar bzhi khri —297—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pobargyad stong / sher snying sum 'bum brgyad khri dgu stong chig brgya/ sgrol ma bzhi 'bum drug khri nyis stong /tshe gzungs sa ya gcig dang bzhi khri dgu stong bzhi brgya/ yer pa bas sman bla stong / sde pa'i sku rim la rgyal rtse sogs rdzong 'go bcu gcig tu dge dgon tsho bsdus gra pa brgya lhag res bka' 'gyur nyis brgya/ yer pa bas gzungs 'dus dang gser 'od brgya re/ la mo dang gnas chung gi lung bstan ltar rtse shod thun mong la rgyal du lha mor bskang ba 'bum/ beg tser khri/ phyag drug pa/ las gshin/ rnam sras/ gur zhal/ pu trar stong re/ gzhan rnams la brgya re/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug /yum bu gsum du gser chab snyan shal/ zan g.yang du rab byung pas dri med bshags rgyud chig stong / lha sar chos sde bas gdugs dkar mdos chen/ drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog (217ba)brgya bzhi dang kha 'bar ma nyin re/ lha sa ru bzhi/ ra mo che/ sle ma gung gseb bcas pa dud so drug rer hu ja khor drug re/ khral med drug cu rer khor drug re'i sgo 'gyed/ sde pa'i sku rim la ser 'bras gnyis su ja brgyad rer sher snying dgu bzlog 'gro gang che/ 'phyong rgyas sogs kyi rtags ngan bzlog thabs la gong dkar du sngags pa gnas chung pa dang rgya mdar gnam gong pa gnyis kyis khro rol slang gang ma'i gtor bzlog /'phyong rgyas su bkra shis chos sde bas gdugs dkar mdos chen/ rgyab chos khag rnams kyis sher snying 'gro gang che 'bad de bstar/tshes bcu gsum la gangs can 'dzin ma'i rgyan gcig dpal gsang ba thams cad 'dus pa'i dge 'dun dkon cog rgyud stod smad so so nas tshan grangs sngon 'gro'i sra 'khregs rdo rje ltar brtan pa'i bden tshig 'bras bu g.yur du za/ smad pa'i sdebs su bkra shis chos sde ba'i tshan grangs 'degasami dang / stod pa'i rjes su thar pa'i bsngo rten bskyar ma bteg nas mi ngo dang ja'i sang yang yod/ thar pa'i spun/ dpon mo bcas thon par byin rten snam phrug so gos ster byin bka' bsgo bgyis shing / dpon mo dge tshul ma dang / ja'i sang bdun dge bsnyen du bsgrubs/ me long dgon bla ma/ snye nang sho pa jo rdzong pa/ phun gling par zhus par pa dang bcas pa/ dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi mi sna —298

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)sogs la gang 'tsham rdzong bda' lan yi ge rten sgrags ngag ma dang bcas thon/tshes bco lngar grong smad dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mo/ bco brgyad chos kyi rje/ sems dpa' (218na)chen po rnams la byin rlabs ja gral kyi rjes nas nyer brgyad bar phyi nang gsang ba'i gdon bgegs la dmigs ar btad dang bzlog par brtson par bgyis/ nyer gnyis la rgyal rtse sngags yong bgrad pa 'jam dpal rta mgrin gyis lcags sdig bka' 'gyed gser gyi lde mig sogs tshe bdag gi yig cha brgyad cu skor gyi rgyugs sprad/nyer gsum nas tshe bdag sgrub mchod sngar rgyun bzhin btsugs/ nyer brgyad la phyi mtshams grol te 'a zha mkhyen rab rnam rgyal/ mgron gnyer rdor legs gnyis dang phrad/ (214na)gra tshang gi rtsa ba gsum spyi bye brag gi rtag gtor/ rgyun gtor/ dus gtor/ mngon rtogs bskang bstod/ phyi nang gsang mchod sogs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la dgos pa'i bzo rgyan gyi tshad/ dgos cha rnams kyi lag deb/ bla ma yi dam chos srung gi gdangs dbyangs ga'u le'i 'go brjod/ sa dkar 'go pa rdo rje skyabs kyis gnasachung chos skyong chen por 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar kha byang / ngag dbang kun dgas 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /sde pa sri gcod 'bum skor dus mtshal gung gi lha khang tsho dang / tshes gcig srid gsum dbang mo mchod dus kyi snyan shal 'dod gsol/ skyor lung phug khang bla ma tshul khrims kyi ngor ring 'tsho re smon lam rnams brtsams/nyer dgur sman thang pa mgon po tshe ring dang / ngag dbang bzod pa gnyis la byin rlabs byas/gnam gang gi dgong gtor ma byin rlabs la tshogs su phyin/ 'dzo sgang gsang sngags gling dang / spom (218ba)gta' gsang sngags bde chen bcas dgon khag gnyis kyi gra pa rer lo 'khor gyi phogs nas khal bzhi dang lug sha lnga gling re las mi 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan byung ba gtong gzhi rnying pa'i thog 'di lo nas bzung ji srid bar dgon pa yas mas so sor ya ju khor drug ma lnga re dang mar khal re gsum/ tsha khal bzhi re/ thug thal khal sum sto re/ lug khog brgyad re/ lnga mchod kyi gling me'i mar —299

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (7)khal lnga re/ sdong ras spen tog phyed bcas 'phar ba'i gtong deb bzos na zhes sde pas zer bar mthun 'gyur bgyis/ /dgung lo re lnga par lha rtse chos sde dang / dga' ldan bdud 'joms gling /mtsho sna dga' ldan 'gro don gling sogs chos sde mang po gsar 'dzugs mdzad skor/blo ngan zhes pa lcags bya gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa dngos bshams yid sprul rgyas par spros/ dga' ston nyin dang por bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po sogs byang pa sbyin bdag /khal kha g.yon ru'i mi sna/ rta tshag rje drung sogs gnyug mar gnas pa'i drung 'khor/chos sde chen po gnyis kyi slob dpon khri gdan zur/ dbu chos sogs las sne ba/ dbon chos mdzad/gnas chung sku rten pa/ rtse tshogs mkhan zur/ sne'u sdong / sa skya gong 'og sogs phyogs thams cad nas lo gsar skyes spro mi bcas par bsnyen bkur/ gral 'phros rol gar sum rtsen gnas la co 'dri ba'i dga' ston gyi mjug kun dga' rab brtan sogs dbon mo tshor ja gral/ dmangs stong phrag skor la me tog gtor/ dga' ston nyin gnyis par bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po sogs sbyin bdag /gra tshang yongs rdzogs/ rin cen rgyan cha ba sum cu/ bkra shis rdzas(219na logs/ rin chen bdun/mchod sprin rnam brgyad/ gral 'phros/ rol gar sogs sngar rgyun bzhin bstar/ nged rang gi bsam ngo dang bya byed gang gi sar yang slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa sogs rtsa ba gsum gyi lung bstan rnems nas bstan 'gror gnod byed chos gos 'og nas dug mda' 'phen pa'i tshul 'chos mkhan gyi gral du tshud pa rang ni min nam snyam yod/ 'on kyang de dag nas bzang por bstan pa'i khrod na yod snyam pa ni rmi lam du'ang med kyang rat+na'i gter lung sogs gter rnying nas kha shas byung ba mchog dman bar ma —300

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)sogs mang pos ngos 'dzin byed par snang /gter gsar thugs thig lung bstan gab sbas ye shes sgron mer/ dus der bdag dang las ldan rje 'bangs rnams: smon lam lhan cig btab pa'i mthu btsan pas bod 'bangs gangs ri'i khrod du 'dzom par 'gyur khyad par g.yu ru gra zhes bya ba'i phur da lta'i lo tsā be+e ro tsa na yi: sku yi sprul pa las ldan snying gi bu zhes pa nas cho seb dag lnga'i nang tshan dang / lung bstan rab gsal me long las/ de tshe skyong byed mtsho yi ming 'dzin dang : thugs rje'i zer ldan shar phyogs zab gter bdag:bar chad ma song rten 'brel 'grig pa na bod yul 'gro rnams sprin dbar nyi bzhin bde zhes pa dang blon po thang yig tu 'phrin las sprul pa zur tsam bstan pa yin no sogs mang po'i rgyu mtshan byung yang bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i lhag (219ba)bsam yod par bsnyad 'dra zhing / de ltar na yol mo ba'i zab gter du 'jam dbyangs dang 'dir thugs rje chen po byung ba bka' gdams glegs bam le'u dgu par mkhan brgyud byang chub sems dpa' de rnams ni nga kho na yin gyi gzhan du ma sems shig /ces pa mthun nam/ gzhan yang / sha lug lung bstan dus gsum gsal byed las/ mnga' bdag nyid kyi smon lam mthu btsan pas spyan ras gzigs sprul byang sems bzang po'i ming : rta sprul lo pa 'brel tshad don ldan 'byung : skal ldan chos bdag de la gtad rgya gyis zhes dang / mu khri'i sprul pa blo chen bzang po'i tshul: burnya'i ming can khrims kyi kha lo 'dzin zhes dus 'dzom pa dang / de nyid las/ pur rgyal sa yi me long dbus las can 'di yi rten 'brel mthus sprin mthong nyi bzhin re zhig bde khyad par gdug pa spre'u'i lor bar chad bdud kyi g.yo thabs kyis: phyi bshol le lor ma song bar zab mo'i gter 'di thon pa na mtha' dmag dus kyi zhakhrugs pa zhi rgyal blon chab srid mnga' thang rgyas 'phung byed 'gong po'i gnya' gnon byed bde skyid dpal dang bkra shis shing bod kyi 'gro ba bsod nams che: a la la ste skal ba bzang : zhes rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i gnad kyis 'di nyid dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gis mgo dkar gyi yul gru rnams rang zhabs —301—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (posu bsdus te yer khen gyis gtsos grong khyer phyed nyis stong / mi khyim sa ya (220na)gnyis bcas ster byin byed par blo bzang shes rab can gyis sngon ching gir gyi dus 'og tu tshud pa tsam nas da lta'i bar rgyal po sus kyang lung ma song ba da lam tshems med kyis dbang du bsdus pa 'phangs pa med par 'bul zhes dril bsgrags tho gtad pa stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba las 'phros te bsngags brjod kyi sgo phye nas legs so'i lan btab/ mchod yon gsum nas mi snar spa dar btags/ rta tshag rje drung rin po che/ star sdong pa/ skyid thang nor bu bcas pas legs bya'i skyes ring por spel/ ston mo grol nas pho brang chen po'i rtse shod lha sa sogs nas dar 'phyar gyi lda ldi phyogs kun g.yo zhing rol cha gnam sa 'gul ba tsam du bsgrags/ 'di lta bu mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa brtan pos 'di phyi'i don du rang la tsham tshom med par ster ba bka' bstan rnams nas spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mnga' ba bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing bla na med pa dang der ma zad nges 'byung kun blangs kyis sdom pa dang ldan pa la'ang bkur 'os pa/ mdo rtsar/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pas rab tu byung ba tshul khrims dang ldan pa la ni gos stong phrag brgya pa dang / zas ro mchog brgya pa dang / khang pa brtsegs pa lnga brgya pa yang 'os so/ /zhes bshad pa rang ngos nas khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum sogs so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi sdom pa rnams la mnyam med di paṃ ka ras/ so sor thar pa'i nyes pas gtan nas ma gos pa byar rung / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab (220ba)par nyes pa co le tsam gyis gos/gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la nyes pa ca le nya re brgyab ste nyes pa dang zhag tu 'grogs ma myong gsung ba skyes chen dam pa'i rnam thar tshad bzung dang bral bas de lta ga la zhig /'on kyang bya spyod thams cad kyi sar ngo lkog med pa zla bo rnams la rgyus yod pa ltar da lam yang rtsol bar ma bltos pa'i rnyed wa che/las dkar nag gi rgyu 'bras cung zad kyang mi 'chol ba/ mdor/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tsho gos shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / dpal ldan zla bas/ sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis bde zhes pa'i don thog tu bab —302—

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)na blo bde rung slar 'jal dgos rang ni min las che snyam 'phyang mo nyug tu mchis/ tshad ldan rang zhig gi blo rtse gtod pa ni/ jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams/ chos tshugs gtam la ma skur/ /longs spyod log 'tshos ma sgrub/ /bsnyen pa 'drer mi bskyel/ /ting 'dzin tsab mos mi 'tshol/ 'ug ra rgyal mdza' bor migatong / /zas phyir gto mil i/ /nor phyir chos mi gtong / /mi nus pa'i yas bab mi byed/ /zhi nus ban du gzhan don mi spong / /chos kyis gtam mi nyo/ zer ba lag len la btab na 'phral yun gyi legs tshogs lags kyang rang gzhan kun byed par mi gda'/ tshes gsum la zha lu dang mang ra mkhan po/ ban grong pa pha bu/ smon lam chen mo'i mchod dbyangs pa/ zha lu mkhan zur/ (221na)lhun grub rtse pa/ bco brgyad chos rje'i mgron gnyer sogs la ja gral dang ngag dbang bzod pas ring 'tsho'i tshan grangs tshigs bcad kyang btan/ 'ga' ru dka' bcu 'jig rten pha rol du song ba'i bsngo rten tsha bos gos yug /tā tshwa drug ja brgyad/ khor drug gnyis/ rta bzhi bcas byung ba mi bzad pa'i dulta las grol zhing byang chen thob pa'i bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas btab/tshes bzhin dga' ldan khri rin po che/ rtse gdong phyag mdzod/ dpon tshe ring gi bu/ 'bras spungs dge skos sogs dang mjal zhing phrad/ tshes lngar dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gis tshogs 'khor rgyas par bshams shing mgo dkar gyi zhwa gser rkyang las grub pa rdo rje pha lam/ in+d+ra nī la/margad/ pad+ma rā ga khu tig /su gan+ti sogs phra re re la'ang gser zho brgya phrag du ma ri ba'i rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa mang po/ gser dngul/ stod hor gyi dngos dpyad dngom che ba gtso gyur gyi gos phyi nang sogs spams shin tu mtho ba/ gra pa rer kha btags gser par ma re/ gser zho la'ang se ba nyer brgyad tsam la btags pa re/ sman tse yug re'i yon sbyar gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon dang 'brel bar mi shigs rdo rje ltar brtan pa'i rten 'byung gi sgo 'phar phye/ dbu mdzad/ mchod dpon/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ dar mo sman rams pa/ dpal grong sngags rams pa/ gra tshang gnyer pa rnams kyis wo grangs dang gra pa so (221ba)sos kyang rtse shod du 'dom 'khor ma re'i —303—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (polegs bya byung /tshes drug la dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu rgyal pos dngos gzhi nyin dang po ltar la gser zho'i tshab kha btags re ste gsum tshan dang bcas ring 'tsho'i cho ga mdzad pa'i mu mthud stag ru ba/dar rgyas bkra shis/ dar khan dka' bcu/ rin cen rtse pa/ byang ngos pa/ rta ra mdo pa/ dar byung pa/chang khyim pa/ bstan 'jin dbang po sogs kyis legs bya bstab/tshes bdun chad pa'i brgyad la'ang dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gis tshogs 'khor sogs nyin gnyis pa dang mthun pa'i ster bya yon 'dra ba'i yun 'tsho'i bden brjod rgyas pa'i rjes 'phyos pa sku skye/ mkhar ldan pa/ rag pa/ byang gling pa/ zur khang pa/ ka brgyad smad pa rnams kyis legs bya bstar/ tshes dgur chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs pa'i slob dpon khri gdan zur/dge skos/ spyi gnyer sogs kyi legs bya blangs shing smon lam chen mo 'di chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen pos bstan 'gro'i bde skyid slad brjod bral gyi mdzad pa 'dir gtso bor gra sa phan tshun gnyis thugs mthun mi mthun kyang phal cher dge skos kyi byed las kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa yin pas nye snyoms shing tsha grang ran par brten bsnyen bkur ba'i rgyu'ang 'bras bu bzang por smin pa dang lhag par rje rin po che'i dgongs pa rdzogs tshul las 'phros pa'i bslab bya bgyis/lo sngon ma zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la stag rtse sa skyong rdo rje rnam rgyal mkhan tshang pa bcas par spyir dus ngan snyigs (222nasgo lnga bdo ba dang lhag par rgyu skar 'od can shar ba'i skabs gzhal yas khang gi gnam lha byang chub kyi tshul 'dzin 'di'i lus la 'jol ber nag po dang / rgya zhwa nag po zhig gyon dgos yod de de bzhin mi 'gab 'dug pas lo gsar lha tshes gsum nas gnam lha byang chub kyi tshul 'di'i lus la rgya gos dkar po zhig dang / rgya zhwa dkar po gyon chog pa lha bdag gis bzo ba'i do dam gyis gsungs zer ba'i gnas tshul sde pa tha'i jis byung ba dang / gsung ba bzhin bzos nas gyon pa de la dgos pa gang yin gyi lan dgos tshul zhus par gnod sbyin chen pos chas 'di stag —304

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)yos tsam nas dgos pa yod de lho phyogs mtshon cha'i bkod pa sogs kyis rim 'gyangs su song / da cha sgo gsum dam la 'dogs tshul sogs mang tsam dang / khyad par mdo sde lo gsar gnyis la ma gtogs mi yong / gal te 'bod par shar na nga dkyus ma'i rigs kyis mi 'bod/ dge bshes mkhas btsun dang gzugs can btsan po rnams kyis kyang 'bod tshe rgya ja ko ba ma nyams pa dang / de rgyab mar sogs dgos tshul gsungs shing / lha tshes gsum gyi nyin sngon la gnam lha byang chub kyi sku rten par sku phebs yong rgyu bos tshar ba gyis gsung ba ltar bud med la phab grub par chas gos rnams bsgyur zin thog don dam nges pa'i gnam lha byang chub ni gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim nas med/ kun rdzob bcos ma'i gnam lha byang chub kyi tshul 'dzin de ni da nas khog la yong rgyu med/ da lam khog la yong ba 'di'i pha ni lha bu tshangs(222ba)pa dkar po yin/ ma ni srin mo nag mo yin/ bu ni dge bsnyen dkar po yin pas sems can kun la gnod 'tshe dang / gdug rtsub shin tu che ba zhig yong rgyu yin/ mdo sde lo gsar gnyis las sngar lugs bzhin snang bar gang shar gyis bos yong chog rgyu min/ ming la'ang dge bsnyen dkar po las gzugs can gzugs med kun gyis gnam lha byang chub dang chos rgyal chen po sogs zer dbang yong gin min/ zhes sogs gsungs tshul gyi slar yang tha'i ji'i yi ge 'byor/ de dag la mchog dman bar ma kun yid gnyis su gyur cing / ma nas phal cher chos skyong chen por phrag dog gis phebs sa med pa dang / la la gzhung la cung zad 'khangs te rten 'brel slog thabs yin 'dra sogs brjod rigs sna tshogs byung ba dang / sne'u stong rtse nas sde pa blo bzang sbyin pas chos skyong rang la dri ba dang / gzhan yang lho rgyud kyi lha 'dre phal mo cher dri ba re mdzad 'dug kyang 'di yin gyi gsal cha ma byung bar snang / gnas chung chos skyong chen po dang tshangs pa dung thod can la sde pas dri ba mdzad par gnyis ka mthun par gzugs med de gar dri ba gyis dang gsal yong gsungs 'dug /de skor la sde pas nged la'ang brtag pa dgos zer ba lha 'dre'i brtag pa 'di 'khrugs pa'i gsal dka' gshis ma byas/ de ltar pe rkar chos dbyings su thim nas tshab ma byung na rgyal po'i skye rgyus sogs gter kha re —305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gemang na bzhugs par de bzhin 'byung 'gyur gyi gsal kha mi snang / de bden na dpal 'dzin sogs kyis ma dregs drag gsum bod mar smra ba'i grogs su song ba (223na)dang / mnga' ris paṇa chen sku mched sogs snga 'gyur ba phal cher nges ngor bde gshegs rigs lnga la rnam pa gdul bya gdug pa can 'dul ba'i phyir 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshul bzung bar bshad pas na gdul bya ma rdzogs bar yal ba ga la srid lta bu'i blor chud dka' ba'i mi srid pa dang / yang chos dbang rin po che'i gter byon mkha' ri'i zhus lan sogs kyi dbang du btang na/ khyod dang gang bzang dpal dang gsum lo ni da dung brgyad brgya thub: de nas zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser srin phrug gsum du skyes nas byang chub thob: yang phyi ri bo po ta lar byang chub thob par gdon mi za sogs dang mtshungs par ngo bo rigs lnga'ang snang ngor sprul pa'i rigs su 'byon pa dang 'dra bar yal ba sogs med pa'i nges pa'ang med tsam e yin snyam pa'i the tshom gyi dra bar chud cing gang ltar dpyad dka' ba'i dus rtags khyad par can zhig yin par sems/tshes bcur byams pa skal bzang smon lam gral skor byed pa'i sngon 'gror gra tshang gi 'don cha yongs rdzogs kyi rgyugs sprad/ tshes bcu gcig la zha lu mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gyisabadog pa'i skyes 'gyed dang bcas gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa'i mjug sde pa dang dmag zor tshangs dbang la chu bzlog /byad 'grol/ bkru byab srung gsum byas/ tshes bcu gnyis la pha bong kha gdan sa pa'i legs bya bteg /tshes bcu bzhir bco brgyad pa dang / byang rtse chos rje/ khri rin po che'i dbon sogs gdan sa ri bo dga' ldan gyi slob dpon/ sku skye/ las (223ba)sne ba/skam dgon bla ma/ rdo rje brag phyag mdzod/ gsang sngags byang chub gling bcas pas legs bya byung /tshes bco lngar dge slong dpal 'byor rgya mtshos dge skos 'jog la dngul srang bcu bzhi'i pad sder/ rje btsun btsong kha pa dang 'dra 'bag gi rgyab yig khri/da sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag bco brgyad chos rjes bskul ma mdzad de dbus gtsang gi grub mtha' ris med thams cad kyi ngag 'don ring 'tsho/—306

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)sgam po sprul sku'i gsung bzhin rtse shod thun mong ba'i ring 'tsho'i mjug skye bar rjes 'dzin gyi smon lam gsung ba rang gar 'gro med par gzhan don dka' na'ang snyan ngag shes pa rgyu mtshan du byas pa/rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po ches legs byar tshigs su bcad pa'i chab shog lan snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa/ gzhis ka ba blo bzang chos ldan gyi ngor ring 'tsho/ blo bzang thogs med kyis sngags rams pa byas dus gra tshang du nyer gsum gyi dngul kong phul ba'i kha byang rnams bkod/tshes bcu dgur sde pa blo bzang sbyin pas smon grub pa rin cen bkra shis btang ste legs bya rgyas par byung / de bzhin bde chen tha'i ji sku mched/ stag rtse'i tshab ma/ rme ru bla ma/ lha sa'i sku gnyer spyi bsdus/ 'bras spungs ha sdong dge rgan/ rgyal gnyer pa/ pad rdor sogs kyi legs bya dang / rgyal phur/ kong dga' chags pa/ rtul mi/ rgyal rtse gser khang gong / khams pa rdzogs chen pad+ma rigs 'dzin/ nyang po chos rje sogs la ja gral bgyis/tshes nyi shur rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa spyi sger gyi gos sna tshang zhing dngos po'i ster byin bzang po tshogs 'khor rgya che ba dang bcas tshe chog rdul tshon dang 'brel (224na)ba'i sngon 'gro mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog song nas ring 'tsho mdzad mur sde pa zangs ri ba'i legs bya bstar/nyer gsum nas chag gra bzhi btsugs shing mtshal zhabs drung grags pa/ lcam a snying / gter ston rin po che'i gcung kun dga' tshul khrims/ mnga' dwags ri bo chos gling rnams kyi gnyer pa/mdo mkhar chos sde'i bla ma/ rgyal sras sher 'phel ba rnams kyi legs bya brkyang / dpal ldan lha mo'i mdos kyi mchod par snyan shal sna lnga 'dod gsol dang bcas phul zhing bskang ba tshig 'bum chig khri dgu stong / lha sa smon lam chen mor gra pa rer dngul zho re'i rtsis kyi rung mthun gyi gos sogs spong dag /de bzhin zho re'i mu tig /yang zho re'i rta gos dar sogs kyi 'gyed phul nas tsho gos bsags/chos skyong dang mi rtsis sogs go bstun nged kyi rim gror gzhis rtse dang pa nam sogs rdzong gzhis bco lngar dge dgon tsho bsdus 'brel mtshungs rdzong 'go che bar gra pa sum brgya re dang / chung bar brgya re —307—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ khorabacas bsdoms bka' 'gyur nyis brgya/ 'bum drug brgya zhe drug /bzang spyod dang mtshan brjod chig 'bum re/ gdugs dkar tshig khri drug brgya/ sher snying chig 'bum chig khri chig stong brgyad brgya dgu bcu/ sgrol ma chig 'bum bzhi stong bdun brgya lnga bcu/ tshe gzungs lnga khri brgyad stong dgu brgya/ rgyal du dmag zor mar bskang ba khri/ chos skyong gzhan rnams la stong re/ lug nyis brgya dang nya 'bum gyi srog blus/ sde pa'i sku rim la rin spungs sogs rdzong gnyis drug tu dgon 'brel mtshungs gra pa brgya lhag re bsdoms bka' 'gyur brgya/ bskal bzang / brgyad stong pa/ gser (224bcud/ thang yig rnams rig stong re/ mas brjod sum stong / gdugs dkar dgu stong / sher snying brgyad khri bdun stong /sgrol ma bdun khri lnga stong / tshe gzungs nyis 'bum lnga khri nyis stong / lha sa/ bsam yas/ yum bu/ khra 'brug bcas par bzhi gra res khrus gsol/ gser chab/ snyan dar/ mchod pa sna lnga brgya re/ lug brgya dang nya 'bum gyi srog blus/ lag gi nad ror dmigs byab khrus dang gdon 'grol nged kyis byas/grong smad du pha bong kha pas lan chags gtor ma 'bum/ lha sar gra tshang nas grangs bcad kyis rgyal po rtse mdos dang gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon gyis gdugs dkar mdos 'di lo nas star chags kyi rgyun btsugs/ rgyab chos su rtser ra gdugs dkar 'bum ther lhag bcas/ 'bras sprungs su lhung bshags chig 'bum/ rtse shod thun mong gis mal dro gzi chen gyi 'gram bzhi gras klu dbang rgyal po'i bsgom bzlas dang 'brel ba'i gzungs 'bum/ gra pa gnyis kyis klu 'bum/ klu gtor/ gzungs 'dusabaton/ bon pos klu rten 'dzugs pa dang / gtad rul/ klu bcos kyi rigs mang du byas/ ser 'bras gnyis dang dge dgon bcu nas bka' 'gyur nyis brgya/ brgyad stong pa/ bskal bzang re/ gdugs dkar tshig khri nyis stong / sgrol ma brgyad khri bzhi stong / sher snying sum 'bum bzhi khri lnga stong /nyo ma gyon ma'i gzungs drug 'bum/ mnga' rigs kyi jus rim la gnyis rtser 'ug pa lung pa dang / gong dkar du rdo rje brag pas mgon po g.yul bzlog /pa nam du brag la ba dang / rin spungs su nges gsang (225na)rdor gling pas 'char ga'i mdos/ pho brang du dpal ri ba dang gong dkar du rdo rje brag pas —308

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)bstan ma'i mdos/ rgyab chos su sgrol sher/ gsang phur dbyar chos thog mang ja lnga/ dge dgon lnga bcur bshad gra rnams kyis mang ja sbyor sbrel thog mdo sgrub/ sngags pa rnams kyis ja lngar gtor bzlog /rgyal dga' tshal du grwa pa bco lngas zhag bdun beg tse dang / mgon khang bar du re ma ting gra zhag gong 'dra'i bskang mjug so sor gtor 'phen/ shing gcod tshan ches pa'i nyes sel du skyid shod/ 'phan yul/ snye g.yag /lho kha bcas pa'i rdzong ga'i lta gnas yul lha/ chi ltag/bdag la bsangs/ brgyags rngan/klu gnas grags che sa dang shing phon chen bcad sar klu gtor/ chab gtor/ rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs kyi bum khrus/ sngags bon su rigs kyis klu dang sa bdag /rgyal btsan ma mo rnams kyi mdos/bum gter sba ba bcas thabs bcos smin rgyas bgyis/nyer bzhir spos khang mkhan po/ /mtshal yang dgon bla gnyer/ dbus gling gnyer pa/ bkra shisaljongs chos rje/ rag pa/ sbyar ra ba sogs kyi legs bya 'dug /sgom bde blo bzang bsam grub dang /co ne'i mi sna dang phrad/ nyer dgur bkra shis pā thur tha'i ji/ g.yon ru sku skye/ lhun rtse 'gram skud grwa tshang bla mar 'gro mi rab 'byams pa bstan pa rin cen sogs la byin rlabs dang / gung thang chos khri/gzims khang shar/ nyi thang / rnam rgyal gser khang rnams kyi bla gnyer/ la mo sku rten pa/ tshag gur (225ba)pa/ lha sa'i gnyer pa gsum dang bcas pa'i legs bya blangs/gnam gang la sgom bde lho pa bla ma/ sha gzug bla ma spun/ skyor lung phug khang bla ma sogs kyis legs bya byung / lho pa bla mas sku gsung thugs rten/ rta lnga bcu/ gser dngul ja ras sogs ster byin dang rigs lngar brten pa'i yun gnas kyi bden pa brjod/ yer pa bla spyi/ gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon/ se ra ha sdong dge rgan/ yar 'brog lhun po rdzong pa dang chu shur bla ma'i ngo tshab rnams kyis legs bya bstar/tor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bzhi nas gra tshang du mye ring btsugs par bye ba gcig sum khri nyis stong lnga brgya/ drag sngags so drug pa bye ba gcig dang chig 'bum drug khri nyis stong bdun brgya song / tshes—309

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (7bcur nang pa lo pa'i dkar dro bteg/tshes bcu gcig la gling stod sku skye ngag dbang gzhen nus tshes bdun nas 'di nyin bar rtsa bshad phyi gsum gyi rgyugs byung /klu dbang rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/lha bzo ba chos skyong gis dpal lha'i don du gnas bcu dang byams pa'i brgya thang rgyab yig/'jigs byed sgrub thabs bklags chog ma/ mchod dpon pas gra tshang / 'bras spungs/ ri bo chos gling gsum du 'dzugs rgyur ring 'tsho/khri lcam dngos grub dpal 'dzom gyi ngor chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i gsol 'debs/'phyos pa sku skyes bskul ba'i snyan dar kha byang rnams bris/skyon gling pa'i bka' thang las/chos log khrims ral dam nyams lung pa gang ཿlha mi'i gnas su gtam ngan grags pas khyab sha 'ug stag sgor sbas pa'i gter kha 'di:mi bzhag 'don pa'i 226na ) rtags der bstan nas byung :skyon gter bdag gling pa zhes bya 'byung :zhes pa ltar lung bstan dus la bab ste zab gter gegs med bzhes pa'i gtam sman chab shog dang bcas chos mdzad 'phrin las 'byor bar lnga dar sogs legs so bgyis/sa mtshams su rang bstan gyi gzhi ma tshugs na legs par shar bas rta wang dga' ldan rnam rgyal lha rtse chos sde gsar btsugs la gtong sgo dri gtsang du mchod pa lnga tshar/bla slob gnyis/gnyer pa/nyer gnas/gra dmangs bcas khyon brgya dang bcu gnyis skor la chos thog zla ba brgyad kyi bar phogs/ja thug gnyis re/chos mtshams zla ba bzhin ja thug re/zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig la lo gsar/cho 'phrul ོ ma'i smon lam wo brgyad/lnga mar sogs sku mar wo lnga/zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes bcur dpal ldan lha mo'i bskang ba/tshes bco lngar gsang ba 'dus pa'i cho ga/zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer bdun/brgyad/dgu gsum la lha mo gtso gyur gyi bskang gso dang gtor 'phen/de phyin zla ba byung ngo cog gi nyer dgu byung res kyi bskang gso rnams la 'phar bcas mchod chas sogs gtong sgo khyon bsgril 'bru khal lnga stong nyis brgya bzhi bcu/phyur khal nyis brgya nyer lnga sogs lhun rtse dang mtsho sna rdzong /ja gos dar sogs lha sa nas rim sprod byed rgyu dang /ru khag gcig gsar du btsugs/ 0

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal phyon chen po'i thugs kyi gnas lho brag mkhar chur gnas 'dzin rnam dag cig dgos rgyur snga sor grub pa pho mo mang tsam 'dug pa grub mtha'i 'jug sgo (226na)ma gcig rung chos tshugs tshul bzhin byas na rgyal po kṛ kri'i rmi ltas bzhin thar pa bgrod pa'i 'bras bu sha stag tu mngon pas sdangs zhugs bgyid par mi rigs mod/ 'on kyang phyi'i kun spyod rnams kyang nag phyogs kyis yid brlams te khyim pa'i spyod tshul kho nas bstan pa'i chom rkun du ma zad rang gzhan gyi bde skyid gzhung la re bzhin du bsam sbyor log pa'i mi yan bsten bskyil mchod yon gyi phyogs 'gal lho 'brug dang dgra bsdongs lag sbrel ba'i bya len tshang skyel sogs byed ngan sna tshogs byung bar brten gnas nas mi dbyung mthu med byung zhing / dgon gnas 'di gzhan dang ma 'dra'i gshis bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag gangs can phan bde'i rtsa lag ched chos sde gsar du dga' ldan bdud 'joms gling btsugs te lha khang dang sgrub phug tu mchod pa sna lnga re/ dge brgyar ba brtan gling gi mchod rgyun/ mgon khang du gtor gsos/ tshogs pa brgyad cu skor/ gnyer las byed/ rdzi bo/ tshong pa sogs kyi phog ja thug /zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes gsum la brgyags rngan/ tshes brgyad la mi 'khrugs pa/ bcur bla ma gsang 'dus/ bco lngar yang dag /nyer dgur nag po skor gsum/ rnam sras/ lha mo/ phyag bzhi pa/dud sol ma rnams kyi bskang ba/ zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig la srid gsum bdag mo'i gtor chen/sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcur bla ma gsang 'dus rnams kyi cho ga /gnas mjal bar tsho gis 'khor/sbyin bdag la sne len/ bcu pa'i nyer lnga mchod pa/ bcu gcig par gtor gzhi spo ba/ nyer dgur bstan srid spyi rim gtor bzlog /(227na)phyogs kyi gnas mjal dang gnas 'brel sdod mir ja thug ster zhing dar chen 'dzugs pa sogs gtong sgo bsdoms mkhar khal lnga stong dgu brgya/ gzhis ka rab brtan gling ma lag /'chams chas/ sbug sil/ thab gdan chas/ bsdad grong dud tshig brgya nyer gsum/ ru ba dang tshong pa gsar btsugs/ lha khang dang seng rdzong phyogs su gzhan lugs kyi dgon mang tsam 'dug pa chos tshugs ma dor zhing snyoms chung sdod mkhas byung na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i —31/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pochos sgor zhugs gras yin pas kun slong ngan pa mi rigs na'ang phyi'i kun spyod dang nang gi nyams len gang la'ang lta rgyu med par sgrub gnas 'gangs che sar chos med zog 'khyams byed mang rnams 'du khung du gyur pa ma 'gab pas bdud 'joms gling dang phyogs mtshungs su bar gling dang / dur khrod la kha'i btsun ma rnams rang lugs su bsgyur ba'i thog btsun gsar kha shas bsnan pa dang bcas dge bcu dga' ldan bkra shis gling du btsun ma'i dgon gsar btsugs kyi gtong sgo dri gtsang khang du mchod pa sna lnga gsum re/ mgon khang du mchod pa lnga re/ bla tshab dkon gnyer nyis lcogs gcig bcas drug /byang 'dren/ dge skos/ dung pa/ chab ril ba/ chu ma/ ba rdzi/ tshogs pa rnams khyon bdun cu skor la zla ba brgyad kyi bar nyin star ja thug re/ tshes bcu byung res kyi bla ma mchod pa/ bco lnga nam byung la spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs srid zhi'i gdung sel/ lnga mchod chen mor dmigs brtse ma/ blo bzang rgyal ba ma/ mkhyen (227ba)brtse nus mnga' ma/ sgrol sher/ gtor ma/ smon lam rnam gsum sogs gang rgyas/ zla ba bdun pa'i nang dkar me bskul chang sogs tsha ra ja thug gis mtshon thon rtsis 'bru khal chig stong bdun brgya/ mar khal chig brgya zhe bdun/ phyur khal nga gsum thon nges/ nam steng dgon lag tha skar chu lag dgon pa bar ma ṇi bsgrub thebs su son khal re'i rtsis kyi zhing mig lnga/ gnam spro dgon pa bar tshes bcu'i thebs la lo star gshor khal bzhi bcu re/ mtsho sna phyogs su gzhan lugs kyi btsun ma'i dgon mang tsam so sos rang lugs lhad med bcad mtshams dang mthun pa zhig yod na rnam grol rgyur 'gro'i mchod gnas yin kyang phyi nang spyod pa kun bstan par mig bltos ngan pa kho nas bslad de 'jig rten pa rang ga ba las zher ba de lam du lus na rang gzhan gyi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs gtan brlag tu gyur dogs da nas bzung rgyun ngan de rigs su mi 'gro ba'i rang lugs btsunacidagon gsar 'dzugs byas na mi sde sogs tshang mar phan slebs che ba'i phyir mtsho sna dga' ldan 'gro don gling gsar du btsugs pa'i bla ma slob dpon dbu mdzad ma dang / gra pa/ nyer gnas/ spyi pa/ khang gnyer/ ba rdzi bcas khyon brgya re gsum skor la chos thog zla ba gsum gyi ring phogs/ nyin star ja —312

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)thug gnyis re/ zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig la lo gsar/ zla ba ngo re bzhin bco lngar spyan ras gzigasakyi sgrub thabs srid zhi'i gdung sel/ lnga mchod chen mor mchod pa bdun re/ /tsha ra ja 'phar dang bcas gtong sgo bsdoms 'bru chig stong sum brgya so drug /mar (228na〉la chig brgya zhe bdun/ phyur khal nga gsum thon nges chos gzhis rnying pas ma ldang pa'i 'phros mtsho sna'i dud stongs zhing dang / lhun rtse nas gzhor 'debs/ ja sogs dgos cha byings lha sa dang po ta la gang rigs nas sprod 'dzin chag med/ zur mang khul bod 'brog rnams kyi bsod nams gsog pa'i mchod yul du rang lugs sngags gra bcu drug sde gsar btsugs kyi chu ma gcig dang bcas par chos thog chos mtshams kyi par bkab med par khor yug tu ja thug so so nas gnyis re/ zla rer phogs khal gnyis re/ rgyun mchod nar ma/lo gsar tshes gcig /zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad la sman bla tshar bdun re/ zla ba brgyad kyi ches bco lngar kun rig cho ga re/ rje btsun btsong kha pa dang / paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa sku na rim bzhi'i dus mchod nyin lnga por sa lam smon lam rnam gsum sogs chos spyod la nan tan/ bcu gcig pa'i nang gtor gzhi spo ba nyin gang ma'i mjug drug cu pa'i glo bur las bcol gyi gtor 'phen/ zla ba bcu gcig gi nyer dgu byung res kyi nag po skor gsum/ tshes bcu byung res kyi 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bskang ba rnams la mchod chas/ tsha ra/ ja thug /mgron thebs bcas khyon nas khal phyed lnga brgya/rtsam rjen bsdoms khal chig brgya nyi shu/ ja 'degs khal bcu gnyis lhag bcu/ mar khal gya drug /phyur khal nyer gsum sogs star chags zur mang gzhis sdod kyis rim sprod/ la phyi chu dbar phyogs 'di rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la bzhad (228ba)pa'i rdo rje'i dben gnas mchog tu gyur ba zhig yin zhing 'brel mtshungs kyi sgrub sde chos tshugs dang ldan pa bstan rgyun la phan pa'i sgom sgrub byed mi byung na lta grub la ma bltos pa'i su byung la khyad par che ba mi 'dug kyang dus phyis thar pa don gnyer min pa'i zog 'khyams blo ma srun gyi 'du phung lta bur 'dug pa'i gnas tshul rim par byung ba ltar der yod kyi gra btsun rnams 'pho bskyas ngos rgyal ba bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas dang /—313—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (7mi sde'i mchod yul la dmigs 'dul khrims dang ldan pa bla gra sum cus mi 'khrugs pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ phyag drug pa/ rnam sras/ las gshin/ dmag zor ma/ tshe ring mched lnga/zhing skyong / rgyal po dang bcas pa'i cho ga bskang gso gtso bor bton pa'i sngags gra dgon dga' ldan 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs pa sa sner gra tshang tshugs zin 'phel rgyas che ba zhig byung na snyam phogs gtong sgo tshang ma chos sde gsar btsugs gzhan las gzeng stod/ lo 'khor rgyun mchod nar ma /bla gnyer gra dmangs las byed bsdoms bzhi bcu zhe gcig la chos thog zla ba bcu'i phogs/ ja thug so so nas gnyis re/ chos mtshams la ja thug re/ zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad/ gnyis pa'i bco lnga/lnga pa'i gnam gang / drug pa'i tshes bzhi rnams la mi 'khrugs pa/ bdun pa'i tshes brgyad/ dgu pa'i bco lnga/ bcu pa'i gnam gang / bcu gnyis pa'i bco lnga rnams la gsang 'dus cho ga tshor mchod pa sna lnga nyer gcig re/ zla ba dang (229na)po'i tshes gcig la lo gsar dang gsum la gtor gzhi spo/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes gsum dang nyer lnga byung res kyi bskang ba/ lnga mchod r+ṣa mo sogs sku mchod lnga por mchod pa sna lnga bdun re/ zla ba bzhi pa dang bcu gcig pa'i nya stong brgyad gsum la dus bzang chos spyod/ drug pa'i tshes bco lnga dang gnam gang / bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga bcas par gso sbyong la mang ja 'phar re/ bdun pa'i gnam gang la dgag dbyer mang ja gsum/ 'bras tsha 'phar/ zla ba ngo re bzhin tshes bcur lha mo'i bskang gso/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer dgur 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog bstan srid spyi rim la dmigs pa dang / zla ba gzhan gyi nyer dgu byung res kyi nag po skor gsum dang lha mo'i dus gtor sogs gtong sgo 'brol dang bcas chos gzhis rnying pa chu dbar sgrub sde nye skor/ pha drug klu sdings kyi 'byed khra zur gsal dbus cha bcas bsdoms mkhar khal tshig stong drug brgya gya lnga/ dud nyer drug /sku gsung thugs rten/ thab gdan mas sprod rnying rang 'jags/tshong khag gcig gi drel khag gcig bcas ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar sbyor 'jags byas/tshes bcu gsum la zhabs drung nor bu khra sbyor gyis skyes kyi bdog pa 'gyed bcas gra tshang nas —314

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)mkha' 'gro sde lngar brten pa'i ring 'tsho'i cho ga mdzad/ zha lu mkhan po/ zhabs drung ri bo che pa/ lho brag gnas gzhi ba/ lho pa bla ma/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma/ rab brtan gyi dpon mo/ rgyal skor ba bsod nams(229ba'i bang po dang / 'og ma'i bu mo tshangs ldan/ ze mkhar ba'i btsun ma/ gong dkar chosasde'i bla ma gser gling pa/ 'ba' bla zur/ da la'i khung tha'i ji/ er te ni da'i ching / rwa sgreng mkhan zur/khal kha u rang khang / gu shrī chos rje/ dur bod bas pas/ mer gan khung tha'i ji ste mi sna bdun rnamasal byin rlabs dang / gdan sa gong dang bkra shis lhun po'i mi sna/ ri bo bde chen gyi mkhan tshab dang gnyer pa/ gsung rab gling / thang sag pa/ rin cen brag pa rnams kyi bla gnyer/ rgyud smad bla ma'i dbon po/ rtses dang lnga mchod pa/ dum bu re ba/ thang skya ba/ don gnyis gling pa/ bye rdzing tshogs pa/gsas khang pa rnams kyi gnyer pa/ sbyor ra sprul sku/ tre bo dkar po lcog pa/ sna dkar rtse pa/ 'bog gong mkhar ltag pa/ zhe bo pa rnams kyi ngo tshab/ rnam gling 'byor rgyas pa/ khe gsum dpon tshang rnamasakyis legs bya bstar rjes zha lu mkhan chen/ bla ma lho pa/ mkha' 'gro dge tshul ma sogs la phyag na rdo rje 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang dang bod sog sum brgyar me tog gtor/ gter ston rigs 'dzin chen por mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyis lung bstan ltar dag snang ma'i tshigs bcad tshan grangs dang bcas spel mi 'byor pa rten 'brel 'grig /tshes bcu bzhir sde pa dang dmag zor tshangs dbang la 'chi byu'i cho ga btang / tshes bco lnga nas bzung nyer bzhi bar tshe bsnyen dam du bcad/ yer pa gra tshang pa blo bzang phun tshogs kyis mkhas grub rje'i rgyud sde'i spyi rnam (230na skong / lam rim khrid yig 'jam dpal zhal lung / stag lung gsang sngags chos 'khor ba sngags 'chang yongs grags kyis thang yig shel brag ma/ gsung rab gling pa mi bskyod pas phar phyin 'grel pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan dang 'grel pa don gsal/ blo bzang 'dul bas phar phyin mtha' gcod dang dbu ma 'jug pa/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ mdzod rtsa rnams kyi rgyugs sprad/hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gnyis la dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi dad rten du 'dra —315—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (po'abag dngul las grub pa mi tshad bzhengs par nang bzhugs la de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung /rgya bal bod gsum gyi rten byin can kha shas/ nged rang gi dri chags gos bubs/ dbu dang stod smad bar gsum pad gzungs rnams kyis phyur bur gtams pa la dam ye dbyer med du bgyis/ tshes bzhin dad stobs ldan pa de nyid kyis rgyang ring po nas bskur ba'i gsol 'debs ring 'tsho smon lam/ srid gsum dbang mor dam bsgrags 'phrin bcol/ rgyal sras lha bzang klu dbang gis sgrol ma'i 'dod gsol/ rtar mdo ngag dbang lhun grub kyi ngor gsol 'debs/ dge slong phyag rdor dbang phyug /blo gros rnam rgyal/ sngags rams pa blo bzang tshe dbang gsum gyis gra tshang dkon gnyer 'jog la dngul srang dgu re las grub pa'i bum pa bcu/ blo bzang skyes mchog gis ston pa dang rje btsun btsong kha pa chen po/ mchod dpon pas rta 'grin yang gsang khros pa/ sgyid thang nor bus rgyal ba ma (230ba)pham pa dang 'dra 'bag /byams pa nor bu dang blo gros rnam rgyal gnyis kyis rgyal ba btsong kha pa/ thub dbang /'jigs byed dang gsum/ lcags sprel lo nged rang nas dam pa'i chos kyi 'brel pa tshig gcig yan chad zhus pa'i bla ma rnams kyi sku brnyan gra tshar gsum rnams bzhengs pa'i thang ga'i rgyab yig /brgyad gtor dang 'phyos pa sku skyes gsang phur 'bul rgyu'i snyan dar kha byang / phyir bzlog 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rgyun 'byer/ 'phyong rgyas pa bon po zla ba rgyal mtshan/ bkra shis tshe brtan/ phyag ma ba gsum gyi ngor mal dro gzi chen la brten pa'i klu'i gsol kha phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ li thang mkhan zur blo bzang don grub kyis bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i dkar chag che brjod/ nyi thang spyi tshogs dang dar mo sman rams pas bskul ba'i gling stod sku skye ngag dbang gzhen nu'i gsol 'debs/ mchod dpon pas 'bras spungs su ring 'tsho btsugs dus 'phan phul ba'i kha byang rnams bskul don dang mtshungs par brtsams/tshes bdun la zha lu dang / rgyal gling tsho gos mkhan chen/ sger pa rje drung / bdag po sku skye dang gnyer pa/ rgyal mkhan po'i ngo tshab/ klungs shod dpal 'bar/ dgon mdo sngags gling / ra ba smad bla gnyer/bkra shis bde chen/ ra ba stod/ chos 'khor steng / gra byams gling / 'brog bsam sdings/ mtsho sna —316

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)dga' ldan rab rgyas gling / gra sdings po che/ 'ol dga' sleb ri/ sgro ba dgon/ drin las pa/ bkra shis rtse chos sde/ snye thang (231na〉ra phags sde rnams kyi gnyer pa/ sgam po phyag mdzod/ zhad ston 'dam pa nang tshang sogs kyis legs bya bstar ba'i sdebs su/ spom 'bor sku skye/ co ne chos rje'i mi sna/ khal 9u rang khang / da'i ching hung tha'i ji/ che chen hung tha'i ji/ bsod nams mgon po/ bsod nams bkra shis rnams kyi mi sna/ sman thang pa sogs lha bris pa sum cu bcas bod sog nyis brgya tsam dang phrad/ dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi sar 'gro mi shag skor zur pa dang 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa blo bzang bkra shis/ rgyal po'i mi sna blo bzang shes rab sogs rogs bcas/ da'i ching hung tha'i ji dang che chen nyung tha'i ji'i mi sna sogs lnga bcu skor la phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar gcod kun sel bskur nas so sor snam phrug rgyan pa sogs ster bya bka' bsgo bgyis te thon/ me rag bla ma'i gra pa zhig dge tshul du bsgrubs/tshes brgyad la dpal mgon che chung las mkhan dang bcas mnyes byed mchod pa'i sprin phung mtha' klas pa spro bar tshogs la phyin pa'i mu 'thud gra tshang gis bskang ba nyin gsum rgyas par gyer/ljangs dbon po'i bu dpal 'byor rgya mtsho rgyun sdod drung 'khor gras la bsdad/ tshes bcu nas bzung nyin bdun bar gter sgrom gyi sman chu bsten nas ma dag pa'i dri ma bsal/ dpon tshang tsha rong pa'i slob ma blo bzang dpal 'phel gyis rgyud bzhi'i rgyugs sprad/tshes bcu dgur da la'i rgyal po yab sras bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhengs par rab gnas ched byon pa bzhin dam ye dbyer med du bstim zhing me tog gtor/ stag rtse'i rgyal bu lha rgyal rab brtan/ g.yon ru sku skye/ gra thang (231ba7khan po sogs sdebs su yod/ tshes nyi shur rgya ri zhabs drung / dpon mo tshe ring / bsod nams dbang rgyal/ bkra shis rtse pa sogs dang mjal/ nyer bzhin gnas chung sku rten par tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster bskur/hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gsum la dge slong phun tshogs rgya mtsho'i ngor po ta la'i skor tshad dang rgyun —317

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (po'adon gyi gsol 'debs smon lam/ ngag dbang kun dga'i ngor thugs rje chen por brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ phun tshogs dbang pos bsam pa lhun grub ma'i las tsho gos gsum pa/ dge slong ngag dbang gis rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i rnam thar zhing bkod/ dpal 'byor bzang pos paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs/ rnam paṇa dkon cog chos grags kyis rgyan drug sogs mkhas grub thor bsdus/ zur 'phrin las rnam rgyal gyi don du 'od dpag med dang rdo rje sems dpa'i stong thang /gu ru mtshan brgyad/ 'chams dpon ngag dbang skal bzang gis log tri zhi khro/ phu lung bdud btsan dpal bzang gis dmag zor ma/ mal dro tshe brtan gyis 'jigs byed rnams kyi sku thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /dpal grong sngags rams pas pha'i don du jo bo/ ba lcogacig zhal/ byams pa/ rje rin po che/ lo ke shwa ra rnams la snyan shal dang / lha sa tshes bcu nub ma ba rnams kyis yer par 'phen sum cu phul ba'i kha byang / 'brog khri dpon kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub kyis bskul ma mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs dang / sa phur lha khra'i brgyud 'debs/ da la'i hung tha'i ji dang sa'i tshangs pa bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po'i sras lcam sring gsum (232na)gyis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ spyi khang mdo pa dkon cog rab brtan gyis bla mgon dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs/ jo rig thu kho sho'u chi'i sde dmangs kyis 'don rgyu/ che chen dbon pos sman bla stong tshar lo star btsugs pa/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas gra tshang du spyi rdzas kha shas sbyar dus/ dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mos spyan ras gzigs kyi mig 'byed la brten pa rnams kyi smon lam/ ngag dbang bzod pas shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor du 'dzugs rgyu/ dga' ldan don gnyis gling bla spyi/ so'i sngags 'chang gnas chung pa rnams kyi ngor ring 'tsho/ byams khang rgyab pho lha'i khog pas bskul ba'i 'dod gsol rnams bris/ snyetshes brgyad la tsho mos chen du dbu sgor chung ba/ o rod nas gsar 'byor dpon mo bkra shis/ shi ral thu chos rje/ ang ga byar ja'i sang / dar khan khā/ dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi mi sna dar rgyas ja'i sang / da la'i hung tha'i ji'i ji nong / er te ni pā thur tha'i ji/ jo rig thu kho sho'u chi tha'i —318—

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)jis/ er khe ji nong gi mi sna/ da'i ching pā thur/ khal kha no yon khu thug thu/ mer gan khung tha'i ji gsum gyi mi sna thon gdong sogs sog po nyis brgya skor/ rgya ri zhabs drung / dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan zur kha rab pa/ bkra shis ljongs chos rje sogs bod pa brgya skor bcas dang mjal phrad/ rgya ri zhabs drung dang dpon bkra shis la rta 'grin gsang sgrub kyi sgo nas bka' bsgo phul/tshes dgur dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse'i bla gnyer gra bcas kyis snam phrug sogs spel te mi mthun sde las rgyal ba'i bden pa brjod/ mdo sngags gling dang phag ri 'jigs skyabs bla ma/ dpal de ras ོ/ rdo dgon pa ba'i bu sogs la ja gral dang / tshes bcur ri bo che zhabs drung / chos 'bor yang rtse'i slob dpon/ rdo dga' ldan rnam rgyal gnyer pa/ gnyis bdag klu btsan pa'i ring 'tsho'i tshan grangs skyel mi/ rtse gdong gi mi sna/ sgam po'i phyag mdzod sogs dang phrad cing mdo mkhar bas legs bya bstar/ gnas chung sngags 'chang gi skra phud blangs te ming gnam lcags zil gnon dpa' bor btags/ gra tshang nas tshes bcu'i mchod gar 'chams sogs sngar rgyun bzhin bgyis/ gnam lha dkar po'i chas gos dge bsnyen dkar por bsgyur skor ci yin dang / la rgya'i rgyu mtshan rgyas pa/ slad char sngar rgyun bzhin dgos tshul bcas dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa tshes bcu gcig la gnod sbyin chen po sku phebs zhu bar btang ba lan sna tshogs pa mang po gsungs shing khyad par/ dge bsnyen dkar po zhes bya'i me gzugs da 'di/ /legs nyes rtags kyi bkod pa gsal ba la/ /skye bo kun gyi go ba bde ba'i phyir/ /da nas yun gyi bar du 'jog bsams kyang / /dge bshes nyid kyi rna bar ma gtad na/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i rkyen du 'gro 'dug pas/ /da nas dge bsnyen tshul de sbas nas 'jog /sngar rgyun bzhin du bud med lus 'di la/ /lo mo dus kyi mchod dus sngar ltar 'bod/ /de las mang ba'i bkod pa gang bde ni/ /dge bshes btsan po kun gyis mi 'gab pas/ /gnas tshul mchan du gsal ba yid 'jog (233na ji gos/ /zhes sogs gsungs te sngar rgyun ltar mdzad pa'i ngan khar 'byol/—319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (potshes bcu bdun la dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags bas a mi de wa'i shel sku mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyis gnyal smad ge re brag nas spyan drangs pa smra bo lcog gi nang rten gtsigs can/rtags brgyad kha btags/ kun bzang mchod sprin ma/ ber gnyis/ 'gan sbyar gnyis kyis gtsos rung mthun gyon pa cha tshang bzhi/ gos phyi nang dngos gtsang yug re re yod pa'i dgu tshan sum cu/ hu ja khor drug ma gnyis/ gzhung ja khor drug ma bcu/ mar ltang drug /'ga' snam brgya/ ras dkar yug /gra tshang la spyi 'bul dngul srang nyis brgya dang zho gsum ri ba 'gyed sna lnga bcas gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa spel zhing gra tshang drung 'khor bcas par dkar dro bshams/ phyi dro dpal ri ba bla gnyer dang mdo mkhar chos sde'i legs bya byung zhing mtshur phu phyag mdzod zur pa bstan srung / bsod snyoms pa grub pa'i rdo rje/ do nang pad+ma gling pa/ dkon cog blo gros/ rgyal sras dge 'dun gyi mi sna rnams dang phrad/tshes nyi shur bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal pos gyon sna cha 'grig /gos dar ja ras sogs dgu tshan so lnga/ 'gyed bcas dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi chog sgrigs gsar pa'i thog gra tshang nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung mdzad/ dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang dang / rgyang ro lha khang bla mas ster bya 'gyed sogs so sos spams bstod cho ga snga ma bzhin gyer/ bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po bstang zhal/ rgyal po bar ma'i dbu (233bskor chung ba no yon dka' bcu/ dar 'i rgyas ja sang / jo rig thu da'i ching / bsod nams hung tha'i ji/ rgyang ro lha khang bla ma rnams la ja gral btang / gung grol nas zha lu mkhan chen han rab 'byams pa/ phan bde ba'i gra rnying bla mar 'gro mi rgyas pa rab 'byams pa sogs la byin rlabs dang phan bde'i dgon rnying ming dga' ldan chos gling du btags/ snyenyer gcig la chos gra chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs pa'i bla gnyer gra dmangs dang bcas pas tshan grangs sngon 'gro'i mi 'gyur g.yung drung lta bu'i rang bzhin du dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pas bden stobs bstar ba'i mu sdings kha bla spyis kyang 'thud/ phyi dro 3chad ka bla ma sogs mang dag dang phrad/—320

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)zhang ston sgar pa tsha bcas/ rta ra mdo pa skyon/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i tsha mo bcas la tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster bskur/ bsod snyoms pa grub pa'i rdo rjer ja gos dar sogs kyi ster byin bgyis nas thon/nyer gnyis la se ra theg chen gling bla gnyer gra bcas kyis bdog pa sngon btang gi ring 'tsho mdzad/brtag pa'i rim gro rtse shod thun mong la 'phyong rgyas dpal ri bas khro rol/ smin grol gling pas ki dang gi dgra mnan/ gzhis rtser sgrol ma phug pas khro rol/ 'ug pa lung pas dgra mnan/ do bo rdzong du gnas gzhi ba/ ka tshal du bla ma lha mo/ lha rtser bla ma kyi ston pa ste gsum gyis khro rol/ rgyal rtser bgrad pa/ pa nam du brag la ba/ gong dkar du sngags 'chang gnas chud pa gsum gyis dgra mnan re/ rdo rje brag pas mgon po g.yul bzlog bcas sgrub zhag bdun re/ lo rim la lha sa sogs rdzong gzhis nyi shu (234na skos dge slong gnyis res klu gtor/ gtor ma brgya rtsa/ gcig gis gzungs 'dus/ lha bsangs rnams zla gcig bar dang / yar ngor brgyags rngan bzhi re/ dgra lha dpangs bstod/ de mtshungs yul gru che chung dang bstun so sos gzungs ci 'dus gag nas bcu'i bar/ nad rims zhi phyir phye phud gshor bre re tsam dang de phyin tshangs ma rdzong gzhis so so nas bton te gra pa lnga bcu res bka' 'gyur tshar re song / rgyal gsar sgang pa dkon cog rgyun sdod drung khrod du bsdad/ stag rtse tha'i jir ja gral dang tshe dbang grub rgyal ma dpon g.yog sum cu skor la phul/ nyer gsum la zhang ston ri khrod pa khams phyogs la 'degs par ster bya dang bka' bsgo bgyis/ nyer dgur zha lu mkhan po gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin la byin rlabs bka' bsgo bstar/ rgyal sras lcam sring gis gtsos bod sog nyi shu skor la seng ldeng nags sgrol dang / phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi rjes gnang bskur/ co ba chos rje'i ngor gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs dang / rgyal sras lha bzang klu dbang gis bskul ba'i sgrol bstod smon lam dang bcas pa brtsams/ 'od mchog sprul pa'i sku dang mol mchid rgyas par byung /hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gcig la dar mo sman rams pa'i slob ma ngag dbang don grub kyis rgyud —321—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pebazhi'i rgyugs sprad/ tshes lngar thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor bla spyi gra bcas dang / tsher gseb dgon so sos bdog pa'i skyes dang bcas yid srubs sde las rgyal ba'i smon lam btab/ thang sag bla ma/ po to chos rje/ (234brko mo bla ma/ mdo mkhar lcam ma bu/ hor rdza dmar pha bu/ dga' ldan rab brtan bla mar 'gro mi dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin sogs dang phrad cing mdo mkhar lcam gyi skra phud blangs te ming 'jam dbyangs dbang mor btags/ tshes drug nas grwa tshang du ar gtad btsugs par sngags bye ba gcig sum 'bum nyi khri lnga stong bdun brgya song / tshes brgyad la dmag zor tshangs dbang gi ngor gsol 'debs/ sngags rams pa don grub rgya mtshos bskul ba'i 'bri gung dkon cog phun tshogs la slob dpon chen pos gnang ba'i gzungs sgrub dang 'brel ba'i bsngo smon/ mchod dpon pa'i ngor yang gsang khros pa lha dgu'i sgo nas drag po zor gyi 'phrin las rdo rje pha lam/ sgrub bsnyen la nye bar mkho ba'i dngos grub len chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ tshangs pa dung thod can gyi 'phrin lan tshigs su bcad pa/ 'od mchog sprul sku'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ring 'tsho rnams bris/tshes bcu gcig nas bco brgyad kyi bar 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon cog /blo bzang ye shes sogs bsnyen rdzogs pa sum brgya dang so drug /: pa chos mdzad 'phrin las dpal bzang sogs dge tshul brgya dang zhe gcig rnams bsgrubs/ tshes bcu gnyis la 'od mchog sprul pa'i skur skyes lan dang snga 'gyur gyi bstan par 'chad nyan gang smar dgos tshul mol nas thon/tshes bcu gsum la pha bong kha'i zhal snga nas dang gra tshang yongs rdzogs la bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs kyi rjes gnang bskur/ tshes bcu bzhin rta tshag rje drung / gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas bcas par theg chen bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa phab/ (235na〉sgos bcu drug la ras chud phug sprul sku gshegs pa'i bsngo rten sku gsung thugs rten/ ja gos dar/ sga chas sogs dgu tshan sum cu 'byor don bzhin sa lam gyi bar gcod zhi zhing gzhan don rgya chen 'byung ba'i rgyur bsngos/tshes bco brgyad rjes mar gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas khri gdan zur/—322

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)shar rtse'i tshab ma/ byang rtse chos rje/ slob dpon gsum/ gra pa sum brgya/ dgon lag 'ang long bsko ma dang bcas pas dngos po'i tshan grangs sngon bteg gis ring 'tsho'i smon lam gnas bcur brten pa mdzad pa'i tshe byang rtse chos rjes lung rigs kyi lam nas drangs te gtan sdod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang 'brel ba gsung bar spyir dge 'dun de nang nas kyang gdan sa'i slob dpon rnams kyis bden stobs bstar ba'i nus mthus tshe srog gi bar gcod sel bar phan pa gzhir bcas chos thams cad rten 'brel la bltos pa bsdod pa'i khas len tsam bgyis/ de rjes gsang ne'u thog gi zhabs drung gnyis/ drung chen bzhi/ slob dpon brgyad/ zur phu gnyer pa/ mchod khang pa'i ngo tshab rnams kyis tshan grangs dang bcas rten 'brel bsgrigs/ bye rdzing dang ka drug mkhan po/ byang rtse chos rje/ zha lu sku zhang /ra ba stod/ rnam rab dwags po gra tshang / khams lcam mda' gsum gyi bla ma/ rngod a rig dgon dang star rdzong gi legs bya byung zhing ngo bo thams cad la byin rlabs byas/tshes bcu dgur blo bzang mgon po rab brtan bsod nams dbang rgyal ma bcas/ u zhang ngo bo bdun rnams la skyer sgang (235ba)lugs kyi thugs rje chen po dang / dar rgyas ja'i sang 'khor bcas la gur nas bshad pa'i phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang bskur nas blo bzang mgon po rab brtan/u zhang / dar rgyas ja'i sang sogs sum brgya skor la sku gsung thugs rten/ shal dkar dmar/ snam phrug sogs rdzong bda'i ster bya rgyas par byas shing gsar 'byor khal kha san khang / sirnyi shrī/ bi lig er khe tha'i ji rnams kyi mi sna'i yi ge rten sbrags blangs/ tshes nyi shur bde mchog mgon po'i bur tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster dang / rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs bskur/ bla ma sku gsum dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bsam pa lhun grub ma'i lung bklags/nyer brgyad la gangs can mkhan po/ rgyang ro gser sdings bla zur/ kong rme phu bla ma/ bshad sgrub gling bla zur/ dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi mi sna ngag dbang chos grags/ skyong nga nasasogs la ja gral dang / bshad sgrub gling bla zur gyis lam rim zhi lhag skor la dri ba byed par gang —323—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (po'atsham gyi lan btab/ bsam yas chos skyong dang brtag pa go bstun nged kyi rim gror ser 'bras gnyis su ja tshul sum cu re/ gzhis rtse sogs rdzong gzhis bcu bzhir dgon 'brel mtshungs nas gra pa tsho bsdus rdzong che bar bzhi brgya/ chung bar brgya lhag re bcas pas mtshan brjod sa ya gcig nyi khri nyis stong / sher snying bye ba gcig sa ya gsum chog 'bum chig khri dgu brgya/ sgrol ma bye ba gcig sa ya gnyis nyis 'bum brgyad khri dgu stong / tshe gzungs nyis 'bum bzhi (236na༄ bdun stong lnga brgya/ gdugs dkar sa ya nyi khri dgu stong sum brgya/ sde pa'i sku rim la lha sa dang rgyal rtse sogs rdzong gzhis bco brgyad du dgon 'brel mtshungs gra pa tsho bsdus bzhi brgya nas don lnga yan gyi mtshan brjod brgyad 'bum nyi khri brgyad stong / gdugs dkar sa ya gcig bzhi khri sum stong / sher snying bye ba dang sa ya re chig 'bum nyi khri bdun brgya lnga bcu/ sgrol ma sa ya dgu dang drug 'bum nyi khri nyis stong drug brgya/ tshe tshigazungs ga 'bum nyi khri/ la mo'i lung bstan thogs bab byung ba ltar ser 'bras dge gsum gyis gtsos dbus khul dge lugs dgon cha gnyis dang / sa lugs cha gcig khu spyab mtha' gzhan bcu skor bcas khyon brgya dang bcur mang ja/ 'gyed ang dang la gzhor khal do re dang ang gnyis la khal phyed gnyis re'i thog dge lugs rnams kyis gdugs sher/ sa lugs sogs kyis sgrol ma dang tshe gzungs 'gro gang che/ 'bras spungs sngags khang du rgyud stod pa dbu mdzad sogs bco lngas zhag nyer gnyis bar ya ma rā dza'i sngags rgyun rjes gra pa bco lnga spar ba'i sum cus zhag bdun gyi mjug drug cu pa'i glo bur las bcol gyi gtor bzlog /dga' ldan mgon khang du rgyud smad pas gong 'dra/rgyal du lha mor bskang ba khri/ 'phyong rgyas su ri bo bde chen pas dkon brtsegs dang phal r+sā brgya re/gzung 'dus re lnga/ lha sar pha bong kha pa lnga/ khra 'brug tu bkra shis chos sde ba lnga/ gnas chen 'brel mtshungs nas gra pa lnga res rab gnas nyin re/ khra 'brug tu kha gso'i 'u lag rnams la thug pa dang chang gis mthun rkyen/ sde pa'i sku (236ba)rim du mnga' dwags rang dgon so sor ril sgrub dang 'brel ba'i ma ṇi dung phyur/ rgyal du phyag drug par bskang ba khri/ dpal gsol brgya rtsa tshogs 'khor —324

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)spyan gzigs sogs gzabs gsol/ 'phyong rgyas dang gzhis rtse sogs rdzong gzhis bcu gsum nasadagra lha dpangs bstod/ bsangs dang brgyags rngan gsum re/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'brug gsum du brgya mchod spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ 'phrong rgyas su rtsis 'khri'i shi sha gang yong mi ser 'khyer zhan la byin/ jo rags rgyag mi/ gnas chud gi ar po'i 'u lag /dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi lam 'phog che sar gzhor khal gnyis re'i rtsis kyi dpus 'gyed/ gnas chung chos skyong chen pos rim gro'i bskul ma byung ba bzhin nged kyi shegs sel la po ta lar sgo blo bsgril ba brgya dang byes pa lnga bcu bcas pas bka' 'gyur lnga/ brgyad stong pa dang gzungs 'dus sum brgya re/ gser 'od lnga brgya/gdugs dkar nyis stong lnga brgya/ sher snying chig khri/ sde pa'i sku rim la lha sar gra tshang nas grangasabacad kyis mdos khag gnyis/ rgyab chos su bde yangs pa brgyad cu dang / se ra smad bdun cus sher snying sum 'bum nyis stong bdun brgya/ gdugs dkar chig stong sum brgya lnga bcu/ lha sa'i khral then pa rnams la ya ju nyag gsum re/ ngan slong drug brgya nga gcig gi thog rtsam sha zas sna/ lo rim la yul gru so so nas gzungs 'dus/ brgyad stong pa gser 'od/ dgra lha dpangs bstod/ lo glud/ yul gru che ba rnams nas sman bla dang lha khang rnying pa rnams la mar me sogs ci 'byor phul/(237na tir dgur 'phyos pa sku skyer zhwa ber thang sham sogs dang bka' bsgo bgyis te lho brag bkra shis chos gling ma bu dang spyan g.yas mkhan por brdzangs/ bkra shis dbang phyug gis sgrol dkar gyi brgya thang / nged rang gi dge sbyor rten 'jam dpal khro chu dug sdong gi dkyil thang dpyad shin tu bzod pa 'o rlon pa 'jam dbyangs kyis bris pa/ mchod dpon pas 'dod lha gra tshar bcu gcig /gdong nas kyis thub dbang la snar thang brgya rtsa'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ chab nag pa ngag dbang rgya mtshos rje btsun btsong kha pa sogs lnga tshar/ gnas gsar rje dbon mkhyen rab rnam rgyal gyis bde can zhing bkod rnams bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig /thang sag slob dpon nam mkha' bzang po dang / pha bong kha ba rab 'byams pa dpal 'byor rdo rjes bskul ba'i rje btsun byams pa'i sgrub thabs/ dga' —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogeldan du bgrod pa'i them skas/ mchod dpon pa'i ngor rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i gtor bsngo nyung ngu don tshang / sku skye bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ma ti lugs kyi 'jam dkar gyi sgrub thabs rta ljang dbang po dang / lha de dang bla ma tha mi dad pa'i gsol 'debs/ lha sa blo bzang dpal 'byor gyi ngor 'od dpag med kyi nyal sgom gyi nyams len bde ldan zhing gi 'jug ngogs/ phyag mdzod gzi brjid dbang pos bskul ba'i ras chung phug sprul sku ngag dbang chos rgyal dbang po'i sku skye myur 'byon gyi smon lam/ thang sag slob dpon gra bcas dang rme ru bla ma dkon cog dpal bzang gi ngor ring 'tsho re/ mnga' ris rab 'byams pa blo bzang phun tshogs kyis bskul ba'i byes slob dpon blo (238na)bzang bkra shis kyi gsol 'debs/ se ra smad slob dpon blo bzang don grub kyi ngor tha 'og chosargyal gyi gtor 'bul rnams bkod/hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig la mchod dpon pas rta mgrin yang gsang gi bsnyen pa byas pa'i tshe rdzas bteg /tshes gnyis la sne'u sdong rtse'i mi sna blo bzang don yod dang phrad/ tshes lngar rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pa phebs pa dang mjal/ tshes bdun la sad srung gi bum pa'i bskyed chog la bka' 'gyur khang du phyin/ tshes brgyad la gangs can chos 'phel dang skyed tshal mkhan po/ bsam 'grub dga' ldan dang lho brag dgon gsar bla ma/ 'phags pa lha'i dbon po/ ldan ma dpon/ dpal de ba/bo shog thu khang gi mi sna ngag dbang chos grags/ 'bras gzhongs dang phun tsho gos dbang phyug gi mi sna/khra 'brug chos skyong gi sku rten pa rnams la ja gral dang / tshes bcu gcig la srid gsum bdag mo'i mdos mchode btsugs/ tshes bcu gsum la zhabs drung ri bo che pa/ g.yon ru sku skye/ thing po sngagasa'achang / sha gzugs sku skye/ rtse le dang / dgon gsar bla ma/ 'ba' dang bde 'byor bla zur/ shangs khar kha bla ma rnams dang mjal phrad bgyis/tshes bcu bzhir gnas chung chos rgyal chen pos dngos po'i skyes spams bstod gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang gi rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho spel bar mdzad/ rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde —326

rang rnam du kū la'i go bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)legs bshad gling spyi sgos kyi rim gro par song ba gnas skabs las bzhi dang mthar rnam grol bsgrub pa gang gi tshe'ang tshig don ma dag na 'bras bu yang de kho nar gang gang 'dra ba'i 'bras zhes pa'i don thog 238na ) tu 'bab pa las ma 'das pa'i phyir 'dar pa lo chen dang rnam paṇa/dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gsum dogs gang yin blta bcug par nged rang gis kyang zhib mor dpyad de zhus dag btang ba bod 'bangs bde thabs spyir dgos 'khyar na'ang skyon ma mchis rung zab gnad kyi cha rnams mi gzigs pa'i ched sngags rams pa mkhas btsun rgya mtsho do dam du btang ste phun tshogs gling du par du brkos pa 'byor/dpon sa bu khrid rgyal mos bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad sogs re mang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig la brko rgyu'i tshig rkang bdun ma dang /gzungs kyi spel tshig/kha ton dang gnyis ka byas chog pa'i 'dod gsol tshig rkang dgu ma/dga' ldan khri thog pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin cung zad bsnyun par 'phrin gsol nang brtan bzhugs blo ka gcig yod/lcang gseb bstan 'dzin dbang pos 'dod lha bdun tshar/ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis rje btsun btsong kha pa/seng ldeng nagasasgrol/'dra 'bag sogs lnga tshar/ri mo ba 'ba' lhug gis mtshan brgyad sogs lnga tshar/zur btsun 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal gyis mdzad brgya/sgyid thang nor bus sangs rgyas so lnga sogs dgu tshar/rdo rjes bgrang yas dang /dgos dgos a bar gyis 'gro la rjes brtse ma dang mthun pa'i 'khrungs rabs rnams bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig/slob dpon dkon cog ngag dbang gis phag mo chos sder 'dzugs rgyu/ban grong sngags 'chang mchog grub rgyal po/mnga' ris gra tshang gnyer pa dka' bcu grags pa legs bshad kyis ma ṇi ril sgrub kyi skabs 'don rgyu/rnya 238ba ) brag gsang sngags bde chen bla ma don grub rgya mtsho bzhi'i ngor ring 'tsho re/gnyos btsun chos rje dbang rgyal lhun grub kyis bskul ba'i phur mo klu bdud kyi gsol mchod chos stong spyi'i gtor 'bul nyung ngu /'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku'i gsung gis bskul ba'i gsang ba 'dus par brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/thab chas deb kyi 'go brjod/khra 'brug chos skyong la 'phrin lan snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa/'brom gyi sngags 'chang rdo rje dbang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pogrags rgya mtshos bskul ba'i dge bsnyen mkha' ri'i bstod pa 'phrin bcol/ dbu mdzad kyis bkra shis bde chen gyi tshogs dung dngul gshog ma phra ldan 'gangs can gsar bskrun gyi kha byang / e shag lho pa nang so dkon dar gyis bka' rin po che 'gyur ro cog bzhengs pa'i dkar chag che brjod/ stag tshang lo tsā ba'i dus 'khor spyi don/ dar mo sman rams pa dar khan thing gir e wo o tho che khan gyisabyas pa'i phyi rgyud 'grel pa legs bshad gser phreng / rdo rje brag rigs 'dzin mchog gi sprul skusamadzad pa'i mdo dbang gi cho ga /brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang bcas pa'i par byang / gra rigs rnams kyi ngor tre bo chos rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sku skye myur 'byon/ gtsang rong nges gsang rdo rje gling pa'i gdan sa pa sku skye ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs kyis bskul ba'i mkha' 'gro'i me mchod rigasa'adzin srog 'thud rtsi sman ljon pa dang / khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po'i sprul sku rong rgyal mkhar phyogs su byon pa rdo rje tshe dbang dpal bzang gi brtan bzhugs/ gra tshang 'bag gnyer deb kyi 'go brjod rnams brtsams/nyer gsum la gsang sngags byang chub gling slob dpon/ grub (239na rko bang sku skye/ gnas gzhi chos rje/ gsar 'byor dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi mi sna gnyis/ sa skyong mer gan tha'i ji dang tshe dbang dpal 'bar gyi mi sna/ kong mkhar rgya bo'i bla ma/ lho brag gdang pa/ 'phags pa lha'i dbon po sogs la byin rlabs dang yi ge rten sbrags blangs shing ngag ma nyan/ nyer bzhin ge re dka' bcu/ bsam 'grub dga' ldan bla ma/ sa skya'i mgron gnyer/ kong rtse le rgod tshang gi bla ma sogs la ja gral dang / rtse le bla ma bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs pa'i ming 'phrin las mchog grub tu btags/hor zla bdun pa'i tshes gnyis la gsang sngags theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun dkon cog stod rgyud bla gras bdog pa'i tshan grangs bteg nas mi shigs rdo rje ltar brtan pa'i smon lam gsungs/ byang rtse chos rje/ u zhang gi bu rgya mtsho/ mdo lnga mchod bla ma/ khal kha'i bla mar 'gro mi bstan 'dzin/ bde chen chos 'khor ba'i gnyer pa sogs dang phrad/ bo shog sa khang gi mi sna sngon ma/ 'jam dbyangs sprul sku/—328—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)pā thur hung tha'i ja'i mi sna rnams thon gdong gi ster bya dang bka' bsgo byas/tshes bzhir nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor thog 'di lo'i gter gsar du khri srong lde'u btsan dus kyi dga' ba'i smon lam 'dra'i rten 'brel log nyen sogs 'tshub tsam yod tshul la dmigs grong smad nas gyon pa cha tshang sogs zang zing gi bdog pa mtho bar bteg ste tshogs 'gyed sogs yon sbyar gra tshang nas tshe dpag med longs sku ma'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i sngon 'gror bsun bzlog rgyas pa dang bcas cho ga mdzad pa'i tshe dar lam sdud mtshams su gter ston chen (239ba)po'i dag snang ma'i ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad so sor sbyor ba dang bdog pa'ang sde pa rang gis phyag bdar te brkyang ba dang rigs 'dzin chen pos kyang brag rdo rje tshe brtan nas zur shāka 'od kyis bdud rtsi ka pā la gang dang mnyam du bzhes pa'i gnam lcags rdo rje 'chi bdag bdud dpung 'joms pas thog drangs tshan grangs stsal/ 'di nas bzung gter gsar dang mkha' 'gro snying tig zhus pa dbu btsugs shing ri sti'i nyin bdun ma gtogs nyin star gyi 'khrid thun re chag med kyi zla ba phyi ma'i tshes bcun ngo sprod gto rgya'i bar rdzogs par zhus pas smin par byung /tshes lngar drung 'khor skya ser spyi bsdus kyis rung mthun gyi gos cha 'grig /gser zho bdun cu dang dngul srang brgyas thog drangs dgu tshan bcu gsum/ tsho gos wed dang bcas gra tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang ma'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho bstar/ rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod na mas mchoge grub cung zad bsnyun par de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung brgyad/ sku chos/ sku gzan/bzhugs 'ding / hu ja khor gsum sogs phul/ tshes drug nas gra tshang yongs rdzogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon sngags rams pa skyes mchog gis byas te zhag bcu gcig gi bar chu gtad kyi sgrub pa btsugs shing spyi bskang dang beg tser stong rtsa re song / tshes bdun la yar 'brog stag lung gsang sngags chosa'akhor ba ngag dbang kun mkhyen gyis thang yig shel brag ma'i rgyugs sprad/ tshes dgur khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i gsol 'debs mgyogs bsngo 'byor 'phral/ kye rdor/ nā ro —329

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pomakha' spyod sogs rten khyad par can bshams nas mchod 'bul dang rang sems dang bla ma dbyer mi phyed pa'i lam zab bla ma'i nyams len bskyangs shing sku gdung rin po cher gos dmar 'jam sang yug gi snyan shal la bstan 'gro'i (240na7na yon chen por 'gyur ba'i smon lam bris te 'bul bar mngags/tshes bcur ri mo ba blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis 'phags pa lo ke shwa rar gos 'phan phul ba'i kha byang / e kha'i gyi ngor gsol 'debs/ zing po sngags 'chang tshe bdag dpa' bos bskul ba'i gsol 'debs dang ja mchod gang la'ang bsgyur chog pa/ thugs sras sprul sku bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje'i bzhed pa ltar blang dor/ mgur chos/ rnam thar gsol 'debs/ mchod dpon pas paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs gra tshar/ ma tshe bsring thabs su 'dra 'bag /mdzad bcu/ tshe dpag med/ sgroladakar/ rnam rgyal ma ste khyon bcu bdun/ chos mdzad bstan 'dzin gyis bka' brgyad/ gnas chung sku rten tshe dbang dpal 'bar gyis rta mgrin gsang sgrub rnams kyi bris thang bzhengs par 'dod pa ltar rgyab yig /'jam dbyangs blo ldan gyi ngor dzod mar dpon rgya mtsho'i don du sku dang gsung rten rgyasa'abring bsdus pa bzhengs pa'i dkar chag smon lam/ gtso bo paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi 'khrungs rabs bka' gdams glegs bam gyi dngos bstan 'phros don sogs khungs 'brel gyis kha bkang ba'i don brgyad nas 'di lo mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can yan la re lnga tshon thang bzabs mchor gser bris phyug pa dga' ldan khang gsar du bzhengs pa'i do dam 'bog gong blo gros rgyal mtshan dang lhug po blo bzang shes rab/ ri mo ba sman thang pa mgon po tshe ring / pho brang phun tshogs/ rags kha 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ 'o rlon 'jam dbyangs/(240bskog lung bkra shis/ byings so bdun/phogs sogs dgos cha sprod mi dar khan dka' bcu dang sbus srang pa/ nang gi kha byang bsgrigs mi rnam gling paṇa chen/ yig mkhan rgyal rtse 'jam dbyangs dbang po dang ngag dbang phun tshogs/ gong gzham kha thi rnying ma sum 'jag /mthong 'jug ding phon dang hor gos zhal khabs nyis brtsegs sogs —330—

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)'grig bzo ba'i do dam bya sgo ba blo bzang dbang phyug dang ngag dbang rin cen/dbu mdzad ra phyi shag pa/skyon dang bsod nams sogs tsan dan gyi rtag bzo ba bkra shis rnams kyis byas pa'i rgyab yig bcas bris pa'i rgyu dang phogs yon bsdoms 'bru khal chig khri lnga stong sum brgya gya bzhi song /tshes bcu gcig la bo dkar da'i ching gi bu tshe ring can bzhi/khal kha da la'i khu thug thu/em chi byams pa rgya mtsho/dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang gi mi sna ngag dbang rgya mtsho/er khe tha'i ji/yon to ba po shis/khal kha rdzas mi thu rgyal bo/da la'i hung tha'i ji/tsher ji nong /bi rdzu da'i ching /da'i ching cho khur/thor god ā yu khe rnams kyi mi sna/rta nag thub bstan mkhan po/kha rag sku skye/lho brag bkra shis chos gling /skyor lung khyams phug mtsho smad gsum gyi bla ma/hor dzod mar dpon rnamasadang phrad/gsar 'byor rnams kyis ja dngul gos dar rta sogs byin/tshes bcu gnyis la gdugasadakar da'i ching gi bu bsod nams tshe ring can/byang stag rtse'i chos mdzad dga' ldan blo gros/spar pu dang /shangs khar kha bla ma sogs la ja gral rjes/bsod nams241na ) tshe ring rags bsdus la gur nas bshad pa'i 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang bskur/tshes bco lngar dga' ldan chos 'khor yang rtse ba blo bzang ye shes kyis phar phyin 'grel pa blo bzang dgongs rgyan thal 'phreng gi rgyugs sprad/tshes bcu drug la blo bzang don yod sne'u sdong rtse la thon/tshes bco brgyad la lam pa spyan snga gra bcas kyis bdog pa'i tshan grangs sngon brkyang gis ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsungs/bco brgyad chos rje/lam pa'i slob dpon shā ri'i bu/dbu sgor chung ba'i tsha bo/dpon mo phun tshogs/khal kha da la'i khu thug thu sogs la byin rlabs/chos rje bco brgyad par mgon po che chung gi bka' bsgo dang /er khe ja'i sang gi skye dman dge tshul dang /bar ma rab byung gcig bsgrubs/tshes bcu dgur 'brong rtse ba rgyal phur gyis gos sna tshang ma dang ster byin gya nom pa tshogs 'gyed bcas gra tshang nas longs sku'i ma'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i ring 'tsho byas/tshes nyi shur mchod dpon pas rung gos tshang steng gos dar ja ras snam phrug dgu wo dgu 'gyed

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pospyi 'bul bcas gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa mdzad/ dkar dro'ang drangs/nyer bzhir mi sna da la'i khung tha'i ji'i er khe dang mā las/ ja'i sang dge slong gi mon mo ma das cha gan no mun khan gyi brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ che chen chos rje'i dar khan dge slong / mdo mkhar chos sde'i bla ma/ gnas gzhi chos rje/ chu spe steng sngags yong / chab mdo sngags pa kun dga' dbang po/ hor dbang grags/ dzod mar dpon so gos dang phrad/ stod phyogs kyi jus(241ba'am la bkra bzang ba bco lngas bdun phrag gsum gyi bar phur pa'i mnan sreg 'phang ba/ gnas chung chos skyong chen po'i lung bstan ltar nged kyi rim gror lha sar lam pa bas brgyad stong pa/ gser 'od/ gzungs 'dus gsum so so nas brgya re/ po ta lar ser 'bras so so nas gra pa drug cu res/ gdugs sher 'gro gang che/ lha sa spyi bsdus kyis chu bzlog tu dmigs pha bong kha'i dge slong brgyad kyis nyin gsum bar gtor ma brgya rtsa dang ser 'bras gnyis nas grangs bcas sa bka' 'gyur brgya/ lam pa bas brgyad stong pa/gzungs 'dus/ gser 'od gsum ka brgya re/ nyer drug nas nyi gi bdun gyi bar drang srong a ga sdu'i/nyal 'gro thams cad yan lag brgyad ldan du bsgyur ba nas blangs te bsten/hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bdun la rme ru bla gra thun mong gis skyes bzang po'i bdog pa sngon 'gros mdo lugs chog sgrigs thugs che myur 'jug nang bzhin gyi ring 'tsho bgyis mthug /nom ji tha'i ji pha bu/ pā thur dbon po/ mi sna hung tha'i ja'i a dar/ er te ni tha'i ji/ cha chen chos rje/ dga' ldan da'i ching / yer khe da'i ching / mar gan khung tha'i ji rnams kyi yi ge rten sbrags bzang ba/ skyor lung phug khang pa dang mtshan nyid pa/ yar 'brog brag ra dang pha gzhi sta bzhi'i bla ma sogs la byin rlabs dang pha gzhi bla mas rta bcu gcig byung / mkhan chen zha lu pa chen po'i thugs dam gsal 'debs rten skyel bar bzang ldan mkhan po/ phyag mdzod bsod nams rin cen/ mgron gnyer rdor legs pa gsum gyis na bza' sogs dngos po gtos che ba byung don (242na)bzhin sa lam gyi bar gcod zhi zhing dgongs pa rgya chen po rdzogs pa'i bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs yang dag bgyis zhor rgya ston pa'i gson —332

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)bsngo rten dre'u bcu gnyis ja ras byung /tshes brgyad la lha ldan bsnyen gnas ma tshor yan lag brgyad ldan gyi sdom pa phab/rme ru ba shad po bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis gos sna cha 'grig/gos phyi nang ja ras sogs dgu tshan lnga/bdun tshan gnyis/'gyed bcas gra tshang nas dwangs ma bcud 'dren la brten pa'i tshe chog gyer rjes g.yon ru sku skye/bzang ldan mkhan po/phyag mdzod bsod rin/mgron gnyer rdor legs/lho ka thog pa/lcags zam pa sogs la ja gral dang /rgyal gyi gtor gsos dus 'bul rgyu'i snyan shal byams chen dang ri mthil gyi mgon khang so so/chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtses 'khrungs rabs rin cen 'phrong mdzes ltar dang /sngags rams pa blo bzang chos ldan gyis bde can zhing bkod/rje bla ma/'khrungasarab sogs dgu tshar re/blo gros legs pas — rgya mtsho'i zhing bkod dang tshe bdag/ngag dbang mthu stobs kyis thub pa dam tshig sum bkod dang drag po rtsal/ngag dbang nam mkhas bde ba can gyi zhing bkod sogs bcu tshar/ri mo ba rta mgrin gyi don du rdo rje sems dpa' dang phyon chen po'i brgya thang /rta ra mdo pa ngag dbang lhun grub dang chos dbang rgya mtshos 'dra 'bag re rnams bzhengs par re ba skong ba'i rgyab yig/mnga' ris dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling spyi sodang /sho mdo rdzongs sdod rin cen rgyal mtshan dang cha dkar ba gnyis kyis dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling du 'dzugs rgyu'i ring 'tsho re 242ba po 'ams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon cog gi ngor smin grol gling du 'dzugs rgyur rtse shod thun mong ba dang /gter ston rin po che bcas pa'i brtan bzhugs/sngags rams pa nam mkha' rgya mtshos bskul ba'i tshe dpag med dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi bsnyen yig 'chi med grub pa'i do shal/btags grol bcang thabs kyi dbang bskur dang bcas pa mu tha la'i phreng ba/lha ldan ma ṇi ba dgos pa can gyi ngor thugs rje chen po rgyal po lugs kyi tshogs mchod dang ring 'tsho/du pa mi dbang gis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs rnams brtsams/tshes dgur rje drung rin po che/chos rje bco brgyad pa/mer gan dge slong /mdong dkar bla ma/nom

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (gechi tha'i ji/ er te ni tha'i ji/ che chen tha'i ji'i mi sna sogs bzhi bstoskor la thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i nye brgyud thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa gtso rkyang dang sgrub thabs srid zhi'i gdung sel gyi lung bklags/ bco brgyad chos rjer mdud pa ja gos dar sogs kyi skyes dang bcas thon/phyi dro 'bri gung phyag mdzod/ ldan ma sha khrid bla ma/ dga' ldan bstan 'dzin bo shog thu khang dang thor god ā yu khe'i mi sna sogs la ja gral btang /tshes bcur bzang ldan mkhan po/ phyag mdzod/ mgron gnyer gsum la khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po'i dngul gdung thebs la srang phyed nyis brgya/ pad 'dab dang dpral g.yu re/ g.yu byu ru sogs rin po che'i phra tshan che ba/ pa nam sgang gi chos gzhis/ dpal 'khor cho so sde'i brang khang le tshan sogs phyag mdzod bsod nams rin cen khams bzang ring bar (243na 'jags pa dang / de nas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su snang gi chos gzhis rnams zha lur dus 'khor sgrub mchod kyi thebs/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i dga' ldan skyed tshal rin sdings dang / nor bu brang khang dbang ldan chos 'khor gra tshang la yo ga sgrub mchod kyi thebs su sbyor rgyu sa de don gtsang gras su chod pa'i gtan tshigs sogs byin nas rdzong bda' bgyis/tshes bcu gnyis la rtogs brjod thang ka 'dri mi rnams la thon gdong gi byin rlabs dang / tshesabacu bzhir mer gan dge slong la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bskur/ tshes bcu bdun la chog thu tha'i ji/ bar ta dpon blo bzang / er khe yu'i ching / khal kha das bung hung tha'i ji'i bla ma chos rje rab 'byams pa/ o rod kha dan no yon gyi bla ma/ das bung hung tha'i ji/ sto shrī hung tha'i ji/ er te ni la sun khu thug thu/ a kha'i tha'i ji/ er khe no yon/ er te ni yi tha'i ji/ blo bzang tshe ring / dpon blobazang nyi ma
