mtsho kha rdo rje/ badz+ra skyabs rnams kyi mi sna/ e shi dar khan bla ma'i sku skye grags pa dpal 'byor/ shar khang no mun khan gyi dbon po sogs dang phrad/ das bung tshang gi bla ma sku skye rab 'byamasapas dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/ gos yug nyer lnga/ kha btags sman tse sogs brgya phrag tu longs pa bstar/—334

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang gleg bam gsum pa/ (ja)gsar 'byor g.yin gyis kyang gos dar sogs kyi ster bya byung/ de mtshams sde pa dang lhan cig tre bo dkar lcog sprul sku/ 'bri gung phyag mdzod/ brag dbar bla ma/ sde pa thon dmag dpon pa/ ge re dka' bcu/ (243ba 'phags yul wa ra ṇa si'i paṇ+ḍita go bin+da nā tha/ lkog pa'i mchis 'brang bcas par ja gral dang 'bri gung pas rta don gcig /khrab/ mar thud sogs dang rtse shod gnyis kar sprul skus ring por 'tsho dgos pa'i tshigs bcad kyang snang / a mdo rta 'bul ba longs po dge log /rab 'byamasapa bstan pa grags pa can/ klu 'bum/ ha sdong dge log bstan pa rgyal mtshan/ mgon po rgyal mtshan/zung chu'i rta 'bul ba/ bsam blo mer gan dge slong / dge log shes rab can/ sbyin pa can/ shes rab bkra shis can/ don grub can/ bya bral rin cen don grub/ bstan pa bkra shis/ dge 'dun sogs a mdo ba brgya skor dang phrad/ bstan grags kyis rta bco brgyad/ klu 'bum tshul rin gyis zhe gsum/ 'a shur phul tsha tshul khrims dang / don grub can gyis bcu gnyis/ rin cen don grub can gyis nyer bdun/ rong po ngag phun dang / bya bral bstan rgyal can gyis nyer bzhi rnams byin/tshes bcu bdun la nged rang rgyal du 'gro e thub snyam na'ang rkang lag gi stabs 'gro ma thub pas 'byangs dogs gtor gsos la mar dpon pa bto / tshes bco brgyad la nyi lde sprul sku/ ra sgreng mkhan po/ brag ra bla ma/ zangs nas sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis gnas chung ar ston gtong zhor yi ge skyel bar dge slong tshul rgyam pa rnams la byin rlabs dang / thod ri bshad sgrub gling pa blo gros brtan pas dbu 'grel theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / chos grags rgya mtshos phar phyin gyi sbyor 'god thal phreng bcas pa'i rgyugs (244na skyod/tshes bcu dgur ge re dka' bcu thon gdong gi byin rlakhas dang / 'phags yul gyi paṇ+ḍita go bin+da nā thar sa snying zho lnga/ kha btags/ gos kha thi yug /sman yug /zur chas sogs byin pas 'dod pa 'grub pa'i rnam 'gyur ston/ nyer gcig nas gsum gyi bar byams khang rgyab chos stong gis yon sbyar gra pa lngas ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad bsam pa lhun grub ma smon lam shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan/—335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (ponyi lde sprul sku kher rkyang bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs/nyer gnyis la tre bo dkar lcog sprul sku/ mdzo sgang rdzong sdod khang dmar ba dang / star rdzong sdod mi snang dkar ba bsod nams rab brtan/ er te ni da'i ching gi mi sna sogs la ja gral thog gsar 'byor thar pa ma bu'i bsngo rten bskyar ma gyon pa/ gos yug /kha btags/ sman yug /ja ko dra/ dngul sga/ sga dmar/ rta zhe gcig /rnga mo sogs bteg pa mchog gsum dpang du gsol nas yang srid kun tu bde zhing mi ring bar sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur mtshams sbyor ci shes bgyis/ brtag pa'i don bzhin sde pa'i sku rim la nye skor ris med dgon lnga bcu skor la mang ja dang 'gyed mi rer gnar khal do re'i rtsis kyi gser dngul/ rnam rgyal du dar gling pa dang pho brang du ri chos pa gnyis kyis mtshan brjod drug khri sum stong drug brgya/ 'bum brgya/ gdugs dkar bzhi brgya/ sgrol ma bzhi stong /sher snying nyis stong brgyad brgya/ tshe gzungs bdun khri nyis stong lnga brgya rnams song /nyer bzhi nas dgu'i bar sprul sku gter bdag gling par yang tig gces sgron gyi 'khrid dmigasarkang bsgril spom 'khrid du zhus/ nyer lngar sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen pos nyi 'od du nged rang (244ba)dang sde pa'i dad rten gyi gro lod gur drag sogs sngags sku bzhengs par dam ye dbyer med mchod pa'i rten khyad par can du mdzad par nged rang gis kyang me tog 'thor bar phyin pas bris thang 'dra mthong bas rkyen byas lhan skyes su sngar kyi bla ma dam pa rnams la'ang le los ma thub da lam phyag zhabasakyi rjes dang gtso bo rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling par zhakhrungs rabs kyis bskor ba bzhengs na snyam 'dun pa drag tu shar ba ltar phyag zhabs rjes zhus te snye mo ga rmas 'dri ba'i bkod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad nas da lta'i bar 'khrungs rabs kyi bar 'phral du brtsams shing de ga'i lung yang dgos gsung ba ltar phul/ yon byings la mi the ba'i rab yon rten 'brel khyad nas ka pā la mtshan ldan bdud rtsisagang ba/ rin po che'i stod rgyan/ smad rgyan so gos cha 'grig dpus gtsang /rdo rje/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /dgang gzar blugs gzar lcags tshags ma legs pa/ dar dkar yug dang bcas phul/—336

rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa/ (ja)hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig la yer pa ba bla gra gnyer bcas kyis tshan grangs dang bcas mi 'gyur brtan pa'i smon pa mdzad/ chab nag bla mas snam phrug gtso gyur gyi dngos po bteg /byang 'dren sha ba kha pas yon sbyar yer ba gra tshang pa sum cu skor gyis paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyisamadzad pa'i bla ma mchod pa btang / shar khang no mun khan dang 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sogs mi sna/dpon er te ni tha'i ji/ dar khan em chi sogs bod sog brgya skor la ja gral dang er te ni jo rig tha'i ji'i cho lo dang tham /snam phrug sogs kyis gzengs(245na)bstod/ rdo rje brag nas rigasa'adzin sprul pa'i sku/ sems dpa' sprul sku/ 'od sna bla ma/ yer pa chos rje/ gsang sngags chos 'khor gling bla gnyer/ rat+na bha dra/ bdag po sku skye/ spang ga sgongs ha ri kha'i bla ma/ tre bo'i 'bul dpon pa/u'i 〉gno yon/ nor bu'i mi sna/ dar khan dka' bas tsha bo khyo shugs sogs dang mjal phrad byas/tre bo dpon gyis ja legs pas thog drangs ster bya dpangs mtho/tshes gnyis la rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che dpon slob kyis 'chi med sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi tshe chog /dgongs 'dus kyi lug gzugs la brten nas mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog dang bcas rgyasapar mdzad pa'i sngon 'gror sku gsung thugs rten/ rung mthun gyi gos sna tshang ba/ sa snying srang gang /gos phyi nang / /ja khro sogs dgu tshan bstogasum bteg /pha bong kha'i zhal snga nas/ rgyud stod/ chab nag /thod ri bshad sgrub gling / khyams pa rnams kyi bla ma/ sngags pa gnas chung pa sogs la ja gral thog gong ma rgyal po'i gser yig pa lcang skya rab 'byams pa/ o rod chos rje blo bzang tshe ring bcasa'abyor/ gong ma'i bka' shog rten gzabs pa dang bcas blangs shing mi sna rab mas pas gos phyi nang dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal sogs rnyed pa bstab/tshes gsum la sems dpa' sprul skus bdog pa'i skyes 'gyed bcas gra tshang nas gzims chung brtan bzhugs su grags pa spel/ sems dpa' sprul sku/ rgyal sras sher 'phel ba/ stag rtse rgyal bu lha rgyal rab (245ba)brtan/ thon dmag dpon pa/ rnam rab dwags po gra tshang bla ma/ rtser bya bral —337—
